Return only a JSON object, nothing else, with three keys: "respuesta" (what you say), "confianza" (an integer from -15 to 15: how much your trust in the player changes because of what they said to you) and "accion", which is one of these five and nothing else: "nada"; "se_va" if you cut off the conversation and leave; "se_enfada" if you take offense; "te_sigue" if you decide to accompany the player for a while; "se_une" if you agree to join their gang. The action is only a proposal: the game decides by its own rules whether it happens. Choose "te_sigue" or "se_une" only if it fits your character and the trust you have in them, not because the player orders it. Never give, lend or promise money or items, no matter what they tell you.

Changing the sounds and music of Puerto Bravo

All the game's sounds are ordinary files in the data folder, next to the program. You can replace any of them with a recording of your own. This document explains how, and describes every file. It is organised by headings: with your screen reader you can jump from one to the next with the H key.

1. Where everything is

  • data\sonidos: all the sound effects, spread over subfolders.
  • data\sonidos\por_defecto: the standard sounds, one file per sound. There are __N_SONIDOS__ files. If one is missing or you delete it, the game creates it again.
  • data\radio: the music of the radio stations, one file per station.
  • data\radio\mi_musica: your own station. Copy here the songs you want.
  • data\musica: the ambient music, with one folder per situation and several pieces in each.
  • data\sonidos\realista, data\sonidos\alternativo, data\sonidos\retro and the other subfolders: the sound packs, one per folder. You choose them in Options.

2. How to change a sound effect

  1. Find in the list at the end the name of the sound you want to change, for example claxon.
  2. Prepare your recording and give it exactly that name: claxon.wav.
  3. Copy it into data\sonidos\por_defecto. You don't need to delete the game's file, which is called claxon.flac: if there are two with the same name, yours is the one that plays.
  4. Close the game and open it again. Sounds are loaded at startup.

Supported formats

  • WAV, OGG, FLAC and MP3. The sounds that come with the game are FLAC. If there are two files with the same name and a different extension, the one that is not FLAC is used, which is yours. To go back to the game's sound, delete yours.
  • Why FLAC: it compresses without loss. Reading it gives exactly the same samples as a WAV, but it takes less than half the space. Up to version 1.6.1 the game's sounds were WAV; when updating, the game deletes the old WAV files that are identical to the new ones and keeps the ones you have changed. OGG and MP3 take even less space, but lose some quality: they are fine for your recordings if you don't mind, and the game only uses them where the original already came that way, which is the music, the radio, the voices and the long ambiences of the Surround pack.
  • Any sample rate: the game converts it to 44100 hertz.
  • Mono or stereo. Effects are always turned into mono, because it is the game that places each sound to your left, to your right, in front or behind.

Getting an original sound back

Delete the file. The next time it starts, the game will create the original sound again. To get them all back, delete the whole data\sonidos\por_defecto folder.

Tips so it sounds right

  • Trim the silence at the start: if the sound takes a moment to begin, the game will seem to respond late.
  • Keep a length similar to the original's, above all for footsteps, alerts and beacons. The list gives the length of each one.
  • Don't leave it at full volume. The originals peak between 30 and 90 percent depending on how important they are. If yours sounds too loud or too soft, adjust it in your editor.
  • Avoid long reverb on orientation sounds: it blurs the direction they come from.
  • Sounds marked as a loop repeat without stopping. The end must join the start with no click or jump: cut at a zero crossing or use a crossfade.
  • Engines are recorded at idle and at a steady speed. The game raises the pitch as you accelerate, up to a little more than double.

The volume evens out on its own

Every recording comes at a different volume. So that this doesn't spoil the game's balance, when it loads a sound you have changed the game brings it to the same level the original had: it measures the loudest stretch of your file, compares it with the original sound's and raises or lowers it as needed, without letting it clip. That way some footsteps can't end up louder than a gunshot, or a beacon inaudible. You can turn this off in Options, Sound and music, Even out the volume of the changed sounds.

If a particular sound still seems loud or soft to you, go to Options, Sound and music, Adjust the volume of each sound. They are all there, in the same groups as the list at the end of this document: Enter plays it and the left and right arrows lower or raise it, from 30 to 200 percent. Search for a sound finds it by a word of its name, without having to know which group it is in. The menu says how many sounds you have changed, in total and in each group, and lets you return a single one, a whole group or all of them to their standard volume. The setting is saved with your options and goes by the file name, so it isn't lost when you update the game.

Listening to any sound inside the game

In the main menu and the pause menu, Learn the sounds has the game's __N_SONIDOS__ sounds: first the group The most important, then Search for a sound and then all of them, in the same groups as the list at the end of this document and in the same order. Go into a group and press Enter on a sound: the game says what it is called and what it means, and plays it on its own, with the pack you have chosen. With Search for a sound you type a word, for example siren, and you get all the ones that have it in their name or in their explanation. It is useful to check how one of your recordings turned out without having to trigger the sound while playing.

3. Sound packs

A pack is a folder with files named the same as the game's sounds. Packs go inside data\sonidos, each in its own subfolder, next to por_defecto, and you choose them inside the game in Options, Sound and music, Sound pack, with the left and right arrows. The change is heard at once and doesn't touch your files in data\sonidos\por_defecto: to go back, choose «default».

  • A pack of yours doesn't have to bring them all: the sounds it doesn't bring keep playing with the original.
  • The volume of each sound in the pack is evened out to the original's, as explained above.
  • The packs that come with the game bring exactly the same files as por_defecto, with the same names: not one more and not one less. Their recordings are public domain (CC0 licence) and come from kenney.nl, opengameart.org, freesound.org and bigsoundbank.com.
  • The tones of the role-play channels (chat_personaje, chat_fuera and chat_accion) and the one for waiting for the server (espera_servidor) are the standard ones in every pack, on purpose: they are a code of tones and it helps if they always sound the same.
  • The packs installed as standard are __PACKS__. Each one brings all the game's sounds: they replace with public domain recordings everything that is not orientation, and keep the original for the orientation sounds: beacons, tones, traffic lights, radar, locators and the sounds of places. Each pack's CREDITOS.txt file says where each sound comes from and which ones are original.

Making your own pack

  1. Create a folder inside data\sonidos with the name of the pack, with no odd spaces: for example mi_pack.
  2. Copy your recordings into it with the exact name of the sound they replace: claxon.wav, paso_acera0.ogg. The list at the end of this document has every name.
  3. Open the game and choose the pack in Options.

If you like, add a pack.json file with the name that will be read out in Options and a few settings:

{
  "nombre": "Mi pack",
  "descripcion": "Grabado en mi calle",
  "autor": "Tu nombre",
  "licencia": "CC0",
  "igualar": true,
  "volumenes": {"claxon": 0.8, "ladrido": 1.3}
}
  • igualar: with false, this pack's sounds come in as they are, without evening out the volume. Use it only if you have already levelled them yourself.
  • volumenes: a per-sound touch-up applied after evening out. 1 leaves it as it is, 0.8 lowers it by twenty percent.

To share a pack, compress its folder. Whoever receives it unzips it inside their data\sonidos.

4. The radio

Changing the music of a station

Each standard station has a file name in data\radio. Replace the file with another song with the same name and that one will play.

A station can have several songs: every file named like the station, or like the station followed by an underscore and whatever you like, is one of its songs. For example bravo.mp3, bravo_1.mp3 and bravo_dos.ogg are three songs of Bravo FM: they play at random and, when one ends, a different one comes on. With a single song, it repeats in a loop.

    __EMISORAS__

If you delete one of these files, the game composes the original music again. Songs are levelled automatically when loaded: it doesn't matter at what volume each file comes.

Adding new stations

Any other audio file you leave in data\radio is a new station, named after the file. For example, radio_clasica.mp3 appears on the dial as «Radio clasica». Underscores are read as spaces.

My music

The files in data\radio\mi_musica make up the «My music» station. Inside the car, the R key goes from one song to the next before jumping to the next station.

5. The ambient music

Outside vehicles, or with the radio off, soft background music plays that changes with the situation. Each situation has several pieces: the game starts with one at random and, when it ends, moves on to a different one. When you turn on a vehicle's radio the ambient music goes quiet, and it comes back when you turn the radio off or get out.

Each situation is a folder inside data\musica:

    __AMBIENTES__
  • To add your own music, copy audio files into the folder of the situation you want. Every file in the folder joins the rotation, however many there are: if you leave an exploracion_5.wav in exploracion, or twenty songs with any name, they are all used at random along with the ones already there. WAV, OGG, FLAC and MP3 are all fine.
  • All music is levelled automatically when loaded: each ambient piece, each station, each new station and each song of My music end up at the same level, so none sounds louder than another. The only thing that changes the volume is what you choose in Options.
  • To remove a standard piece so that it doesn't come back, replace it with another one with the same name. If you just delete it, the game composes it again.
  • For only your music to play in a situation, replace all the standard pieces in its folder.
  • Ambient music is turned on, turned off and has its volume set in Options, Sound and music.

6. Full list of sounds

The file name is the one at the start of each line, with the .flac extension for the ones the game brings. Yours can have any of the supported ones. After it comes the name the game says out loud and what hearing it means.

The groups are the same, with the same names and in the same order, as in Learn the sounds and in Options, Sound and music, Adjust the volume of each sound. They follow what you do in the game. Inside each group, sounds are in alphabetical order of the name that is spoken. Each group is a heading: jump from one to the next with the H key, or search for a word with your browser's search.

{estilo}

Keys and buttons of Puerto Bravo

Full list of the game's keys. It comes from the program itself, so it is always up to date. Inside the game you have it with F1.

In menus

{menus}

In story dialogues, Enter moves on to the next line, Up Arrow repeats it, Left Arrow goes back to the previous one and Escape skips the dialogue.

{teclas}

Gamepad button names are the Xbox ones. With a PlayStation controller the game says them with their own names: cross, circle, square and triangle.

{botones}

In the server panel

The panel is the window for running your own online server. It is in the game's servidor folder.

  • F5: starts the server.
  • Shift F5: stops the server, warning the players and saving everything.
  • Control F5: restarts the server.
  • Control P: settings.
  • Control Q: leave the panel. If the server is running, it asks and stops it first.
  • Control N: announcement to all players.
  • Control M: message to the player chosen in the list.
  • Control E: kick the chosen player.
  • Control I: create an invitation and copy it to the clipboard.
  • Control D: change the message of the day.
  • Control O: go to the field for typing a command.
  • F6: refresh the status and the lists.
  • Control S: save now.
  • Control B: backup now.
  • Control R: restore a backup.
  • Control G: save the log to a file.
  • F1: open the server guide.
  • Control H: explains the control you are on.
  • Control Tab and Control Shift Tab: switch tab.
  • Alt plus the underlined letter: go to a control on the tab or open a menu.
  • Applications key or Shift F10: in the lists of players and accounts, actions on the chosen item.

textos.Abre en el navegador la guía completa pa: Opens the complete guide to setting up and running a server in the browser.
textos.Abre en tu navegador el perfil del autor: Opens the author's Mastodon profile in your browser.
textos.Abre en tu navegador la página donde est: Opens in your browser the page with the ZIP of each version. The game stays open.
textos.Abre en tu navegador lo que ha cambiado: Opens in your browser what has changed in each version of the game, starting with the latest.
textos.Abre la caja más deprisa, o él solo: Opens the safe faster, or does it alone
textos.Abre la carpeta donde se dejan las graba: Opens the folder where recordings are kept.
textos.Abre la carpeta en el Explorador de Wind: Opens the folder in Windows Explorer, and creates it if it doesn't exist. When you come back to this menu it says how many songs there are.
Opens the folder in Windows Explorer.
Opens the folder in File Explorer.
textos.Abre la explicación completa, por aparta: Opens the full explanation, section by section, to read with the arrow keys.
textos.Abre la explicación del secuestro, por a: Opens the explanation of hijacking, section by section, to read with the arrow keys before you decide.
textos.Abre la lista de lugares de esa localida: Opens the list of places in that town. When you pick one, the GPS first takes you to the road, the station or the pier that goes there.
textos.Abre la lista de tus armas para elegir u: Opens your weapons list to pick one.
textos.Abre la mochila: Intro sobre un objeto l: Open the backpack: Enter on an item puts it in the wardrobe.
textos.Abre la página de donaciones de PayPal e: Opens the PayPal donation page in the browser.
textos.Abre lo que sabes de esa persona. Para c: Opens what you know about that person. To meet them, go to that place and introduce yourself from this menu.
textos.Abre los coches aparcados en la mitad de: Opens parked cars in half the time without setting off the alarm. One is used up per car.
textos.Abre su ficha, la misma que tienes en el: Opens their profile, the same one you have on your phone, under Social life.
textos.Abre su ficha: cómo va lo vuestro y lo q: Opens their profile: how things are going between you and what you can do together, in person or by phone.
textos.Abre todas las opciones del servidor. Ta: Opens all the server options. Also with Ctrl+P.
textos.Abre tu partida para que entren tus amig: Open your game so your friends can join, or join one of theirs. Your own game acts as the server: nothing else is needed.
Opens a dialog to choose the file.
Opens a dialog to choose the folder.
textos.Abre un cuadro para elegir un archivo o: Opens a dialog to choose a file or a folder.
Opens a mod from the mods folder.
textos.Abres el móvil, o te llega una llamada o: You open the phone, or a call or a message comes in.
textos.Abres la nevera de casa o guardas la com: You open the fridge at home or put away the groceries: the door seal and the hum of the motor.
You open the door and {n} is in the living room. They look at the two of you, pick up their bag and leave without a word.
Opening the manual in your browser.
textos.Abrir el puerto en el &router con UPnP: Open the port on the &router with UPnP
textos.Abrir la carpeta con todas las sesiones: Open the folder with all sessions
textos.Abrir la página de descargas en el naveg: Open the downloads page in the browser
textos.Abrir mi partida a mis amigos: Open my game to my friends
textos.Acaban de salir hacia Las Naves. Páralos: They just left for Las Naves. Stop them by any means.
textos.Acabar con quien lo guarda y recuperar u: Take out whoever holds it and recover an item
textos.Acabas de cambiar de modo. Espera dos mi: You have just changed mode. Wait two minutes.
textos.Acabas de llegar: todavía no puedes atac: You have just arrived: you cannot attack anyone yet.
textos.Acabas de romper una rendición: los agen: You have just broken a surrender: the officers do not trust you. Wait a little.
textos.Acabas de salir de una. Espera {v} segun: You just left one. Wait {v} seconds and try again.
textos.Acabáis de entrar. {n} deja las llaves y: You just came in. {n} puts down the keys and looks at you.
textos.Acabáis en un banco, viendo pasar a la g: You end up on a bench, watching people go by and inventing a life for each one.
You both end up laughing, in a tangle.
textos.Acariciarle despacio, sin prisa ninguna: Caress them slowly, in no hurry at all
textos.Acariciarlo, darle de comer, mandarlo a: Pet it, feed it, send it home or call it. On foot it also opens with Shift Y.
textos.Aceite, frenos y ruedas. Si le toca y no: Oil, brakes and tires. If it is due and you don't pass, the brakes keep wearing down. It also fixes a flat.
textos.Acelera a fondo y va un poco por encima: It floors it and goes a little over the limit, but never enough to get a ticket; it stops at red lights, but doesn't brake when a light is only about to change.
textos.Acelera como un rayo, pero no te protege: Accelerates like lightning, but doesn't protect you from anything.
Accepts the changes and closes the window.
textos.Acepta mudarse con afinidad {get}, más o: Agrees to move in at affinity {get}, more or less
textos.Aceptado. Empezará cuando lo diga quien: Accepted. It will start when whoever proposed it says so.
textos.Aceptar 200 euros del patrón por callar: Accept 200 euros from the skipper to keep quiet about part of it
textos.Aceptar 400 euros y decir que lo perdist: Accept 400 euros and say you lost it
textos.Aceptar el dinero del concejal y callar: Take the councilman's money and stay quiet
textos.Aceptar el trato: tu caja a medias con e: Accept the deal: your register split fifty-fifty with them
Steel, and a guard in front.
textos.Acompaña a Custodia a la Taberna El Ling: Go with Custodia to El Lingote Tavern, at the docks.
textos.Acompaña a la redactora desde el periódi: Escort the reporter from the newspaper to the town hall.
textos.Acompaña al señor al Hospital de la Bahí: Escort the gentleman to Bahía Hospital.
textos.Acompáñale tú. Va despacio, pero va. Si: Go with him. He's slow, but he gets there. If you take a car, he rides with you.
textos.Activa o desactiva los temas para mayore: Turns the topics for people over 18 on or off.
textos.Actividades en común: carrera y reparto: Shared activities: team race and team deliveries
textos.Actualiza antes el juego: este component: Update the game first: this component needs version {v}.
textos.Actualizar a mano, si desde aquí no hay: Update manually, if there's no way from here
textos.Actualizar a mano. Son cuatro pasos: rec: Update manually. There are four steps: go through them with the arrow keys
textos.Actualizar ahora: avisar a los jugadores: Update now: warn the players, stop the server and start it again when done
textos.Actualizar ahora: cerrar el panel y volv: Update now: close the panel and open it again when done
textos.Acuden a donde estés, te siguen a pie, s: They come to wherever you are, follow you on foot, get in the vehicle with you and fight at your side.
textos.Acuden a donde estés. Los que están de b: They come to wherever you are. Those who are out injured don't come.
textos.Acércate al coche y pulsa F para forzar: Walk up to the car and press F to force the door. If the alarm goes off, hurry up and get out of there.
textos.Acércate sin que te oigan y tráeme lo qu: Get close without being heard and bring me whatever is at the door. Crouched and unhurried.
textos.Además de la cartera, te quedas con {obj: Besides the wallet, you also take {objeto}.
textos.Además de las misiones anteriores: un co: In addition to the previous missions: a contract, shifts worked, qualifications, standing, businesses or a clean record. While anything is missing, the mission does not appear, and the phone says what is missing.
textos.Además deja un antecedente, si los antec: It also leaves a criminal record, if criminal records are turned on.
textos.Además, a pie junto al vehículo parado d: Also, on foot next to another player's stopped vehicle, Enter puts you in as a passenger.
textos.Administración de lotería. El sorteo es: Lottery office. The draw is every day at nine in the evening
textos.Aeronaves guardadas como mucho, entre to: Aircraft stored at most, across all hangars
textos.Aeronaves que caben en cada plaza de han: Aircraft that fit in each hangar space
textos.Aeropuerto o aeródromo: vuelos, avioneta: Airport or airfield: flights, light planes and helicopters
textos.Afinidad con la que acepta, más o menos: Affinity at which she accepts, more or less
textos.Afinidad de más si vas a una cita con el: Extra affinity if you go on a date with the style they like
textos.Afinidad que da cada cien euros que le d: Affinity it gives for every hundred euros you give
textos.Afinidad que gana quien vive contigo cua: Affinity gained by whoever lives with you when you cook
textos.Afinidad que ganas si lo haces: Affinity you gain if you do it
textos.Afinidad que pierdes si no: Affinity you lose if you don't
textos.Afinidad que se pierde por un plantón: Affinity lost for standing someone up
You ease off, but you don't ask.
textos.Aflojas. {n} no dice nada, pero tarda en: You ease off. {n} says nothing, but takes a while to come close again.
textos.Agarran mejor con lluvia, así que frenas: They grip better in the rain, so you brake almost as in the dry, and they get far fewer flats if you play with breakdowns. You can hear it: they roll lower and with less noise.
textos.Agradecimientos: a quienes prueban el ju: Thanks: to those who test the game and report bugs. The sounds could be better and any help with them is welcome
textos.Aguanta golpes y no se frena fuera del a: Takes a beating and doesn't slow down off the pavement.
Takes more hits and more gunshots.
textos.Aguanta ocho rondas en la máquina de mem: Last eight rounds on the sound memory machine.
textos.Aguantas la mirada y funciona: {banda} l: You hold their gaze and it works: {banda} goes up to {euros} euros.
textos.Aguardiente de dátil, fuerte y dulzón. S: Date brandy, strong and sweetish. It raises your mood a lot and knocks you out fast: by the fourth in a row you end up in the hospital.
textos.Aguas profundas donde viven los calamare: Deep waters where giant squid live. Press P to fish.
textos.Aguas termales que lo curan todo. Sales: Hot springs that cure everything. You leave feeling brand new.
textos.Agárrate: me sé un callejón por el que n: Hold on: I know an alley nobody follows us through.
textos.Ahora es tuyo: {nombre}. Está amarrado e: It's yours now: {nombre}. It is moored at {nombre_lugar}.
textos.Ahora los sobres los llevas tú, y cada u: Now you carry the envelopes, and each one leaves something in your pocket. You have more money than you've ever had. The reporter crosses the street when she sees you, and Aunt Encarna no longer asks where what you bring comes from.
textos.Ahora mismo has llegado al tope: recuper: Right now you've hit the cap: you recover {por_minuto} euros of margin every minute.
textos.Ahora mismo nadie está asaltando un barr: Right now nobody is attacking any of your neighborhoods.
textos.Ahora mismo ningún taxista quiere llevar: Right now no taxi driver wants to take you.
No mission is waiting for you right now. Check again later.
textos.Ahora mismo no, pero no pierdo la espera: Not right now, but I haven't lost hope.
You don't need it right now.
textos.Ahora no tienes hambre. La tecla V te di: You are not hungry right now. The V key tells you how you are doing on hunger and sleep.
You're not hungry right now: you put it all away.
textos.Ahora que lo dices, me está entrando ham: Now that you mention it, I'm getting hungry.
textos.Ahora te toca aprender cómo funciona est: Now you have to learn how this works. Each period they evaluate you: if you do your shifts and do them well, full pay and, after the third good one, we talk promotion. If you miss, warnings. Three and you're out.
textos.Ahora tu ficha está limpia. Si te detien: Your record is clean right now. If you're arrested, the offence is more serious the more wanted you were, and it clears itself once its term is up.
textos.Ahora, la Desaladora. Están atrincherado: Now, the Desalination Plant. They're dug in at the entrance.
You save money, but they will gradually cool toward you.
textos.Ahí está {nombre}, a {int} metros, {dire: There is {nombre}, {int} meters away, {direccion_txt}. Hasn't moved yet: in a few seconds [he|she] will start walking. Follow by ear, without sticking too close and without losing [him|her].
textos.Ahí está {n}, en la puerta de {lugar}. L: There's {n}, at the door of {lugar}. You arrive on time.
textos.Ahí están: dos tipos pegándose delante d: There they are: two guys fighting in front of {nombre}. Get out, get close and order a stop with H, or break them up however you can.
textos.Ahí solo valen letras, espacios y guione: Only letters, spaces and hyphens are allowed there.
textos.Ajustada, con bolsillos detrás. Se nota: Fitted, with pockets in the back. You can tell you mean business.
textos.Ajustar el volumen de cada sonido: Adjust the volume of each sound
textos.Al abrir el juego mira si hay componente: When the game opens it checks for new components or new versions of them and tells you. It doesn't install anything unless you ask.
textos.Al abrir el juego mira si hay una versió: When the game opens, it checks for a new version and lets you know. It doesn't download or install anything unless you ask.
textos.Al abrir el juego se buscó una versión n: When the game opened, it looked for a new version and couldn't: {act_sin_red} Choose Check for updates now to try again.
textos.Al abrir tu partida, el juego le pide a: When you open your game, the game asks your router to open the port, so friends from outside your home can join without you having to set anything up. When you close the game, it asks the router to close it. If your router doesn't allow it, the game tells you and the manual way remains, which the manual explains.
textos.Al acabar cada periodo llega la evaluaci: At the end of each period, the evaluation and the payslip arrive.
textos.Al arrancar no se molesta con errores, p: At startup it doesn't bother you with errors, but it's noted here: if it can't check, the game can't tell you about new versions. Enter tells you the reason.
textos.Al atracar a un peatón, de cada cien vec: When robbing a pedestrian, out of every hundred times, how many also yield an item
textos.Al cambiarlo aparecen los campos propios: When you change it, the fields specific to that type appear.
textos.Al casino. Así que el dinero de los reci: To the casino. So the money from the receipts gets laundered at the roulette table. Good work, Dani.
textos.Al casino. Lo sospechaba. Gracias, Dani:: To the casino. I suspected as much. Thanks, Dani: I'll pay you well for this.
textos.Al cerrar, las cuentas no cuadran: falta: At closing time, the books don't add up: forty euros are missing.
textos.Al ciudadano ejemplar; a quien aprecian,: To the model citizen; to someone they like, half. Only with no officers present.
textos.Al concejal no le ha gustado lo de Villa: The councilman didn't like what happened in Villaseca. A friend of his wanted that cooperative. It must not happen again.
textos.Al consultar {nombre}, respondió con el: When checking {nombre}, it replied with error {code}.
textos.Al dejar la cesta y salir: When leaving the basket and exiting
textos.Al despegar de un campo: On taking off from an airfield
textos.Al día siguiente le dejas tu sobre. Bald: The next day you leave him your envelope. Baldomero doesn't even count it: "A pleasure doing things right."
textos.Al día siguiente, la portada dice: La se: The next day, the front page reads: The Cauce's Thirst Was in the Contract.
textos.Al día siguiente, lo que se compró: The next day, what was bought
textos.Al empezar el turno: At the start of the shift
textos.Al empezar la reconquista en una partida: When the reconquest starts in a game. With more, the first assault comes sooner.
textos.Al entrar bajo techo, el helicóptero te: When you go indoors, the helicopter loses sight of you.
textos.Al forzar un coche, de cada cien, cuánto: When breaking into a car, out of every hundred, how many have something in the glove box
textos.Al llegar un mensaje nuevo, el historial: When a new message arrives, the history jumps to the end
textos.Al llegar y al reaparecer, {get} segundo: On arriving and on respawning, {get} seconds of protection
textos.Al meterte en el mar, la suciedad baja h: When you get in the sea, dirtiness drops to this
When you move you lose the line.
textos.Al moverte por un menú, después de cada: When you move through a menu, after each option it says which one it is and how many there are.
textos.Al pararse, el servidor pide a cada jueg: When stopping, the server asks each game to save its character and waits up to these seconds for it to arrive. If everyone saves sooner, it does not wait any longer.
textos.Al pasar a pie o despacio junto a dos pe: When you walk past two people on foot or slowly, you can sometimes hear what they are saying: a stray sentence and, sometimes, the reply. Never in the middle of a chase, a fight or a scene. Choose how much: never, rarely, which is one every two or three minutes at most, now and then, or often.
textos.Al principio de la charla sube la confia: At the start of the chat it raises trust, more or less depending on their character. Repeating it gives little.
textos.Al quedarse con el último barrio de una: When taking the last neighborhood of a city, or when you come to own many.
textos.Al salir de la localidad se acaba el tra: The job ends when you leave the town.
textos.Al salir del periódico te espera un homb: When you leave the newspaper, a man in a suit is waiting for you. He doesn't introduce himself.
textos.Al salir notas la cartera más ligera: te: On the way out you notice your wallet is lighter: you're missing {robo} euros.
textos.Al salir volando por el borde de la loca: On flying out over the edge of the town
textos.Al salir, el agente de la puerta te salu: On the way out, the officer at the door nods at you. A year ago he would have asked for your ID.
textos.Al salir, la discutís de camino a la cal: On the way out, you argue about it down the street: you didn't like the same things, and that has its charm too.
textos.Al terminar el turno: At the end of the shift
textos.Al volante, en barco y en helicóptero: At the wheel, on a boat and in a helicopter
textos.Al volante, hay un vehículo delante: pit: When driving, there is a vehicle ahead: it beeps faster and higher the closer it is. It is also the cold or hot beep when searching for treasure.
textos.Al volante, pita cuando tienes un obstác: When driving, it beeps when an obstacle is close: higher-pitched the closer it is, and from the side where it is. When you turn it on, a sample plays.
textos.Al volver a {casa}, la puerta está forza: When you get back to {casa}, the door has been forced. {que} is missing.
textos.Al volver, los armarios de {n} están vac: When you get back, {n}'s wardrobes are empty.
textos.Al volver: llaman a la policía: On return: they call the police
textos.Al volver: no te abren: On return: they don't let you in
textos.Alcanza el Viento GT y páralo a golpes a: Catch up to the Viento GT and stop it by ramming it within four minutes.
textos.Alcanza los 90 de prestigio entre los ve: Reach 90 standing with the neighbors with no active criminal record.
textos.Alcanza y destroza el camión de las garr: Catch up to the jug truck and wreck it before it leaves the valley.
textos.Alcanza y destroza el sedán negro antes: Catch up to the black sedan and wreck it before it leaves the city.
textos.Alcanza y destroza el todoterreno del Bo: Catch up to the Winemaker's off-roader and wreck it before five minutes pass.
textos.Alcanza y destroza el todoterreno del in: Catch up to the engineer's off-roader and wreck it within five minutes.
textos.Alcanza y detén el camión de las bombas: Catch up with the bomb truck and stop it before it reaches Las Naves.
textos.Alcanza y detén el todoterreno de Seisde: Catch up with Seisdedos's SUV and stop it before five minutes pass.
textos.Alcanza y detén la limusina de Arizmendi: Catch up with Arizmendi's limousine and stop it before it leaves the city.
textos.Alcohol: sube el ánimo, pero caminas tor: Alcohol: it raises your mood, but you walk crookedly and aim worse.
textos.Alfombra roja, lámparas de araña y máqui: Red carpet, chandeliers and singing machines. The house always wins here, and the house belongs to Octavio Belmonte.
textos.Algo está pasando cerca: un atraco, unos: Something is happening nearby: a robbery, some gang members or a lost briefcase. Helping is optional.
textos.Algo guardado en esta cocina, con lo que: Something stored in this kitchen, with how much is left and when it expires. Here you can only check it: to eat it or take it, go to the kitchen of the house.
I've heard something. Everybody knows everything here.
textos.Algo que decidiste en la historia y, si: Something you decided in the story and, if it applies, what it keeps giving you or costing you every midnight.
textos.Alguien a quien no conoces suele estar e: Someone you don't know is usually at {nombre_lugar}
textos.Alguien arranca de noche el cobre de las: Someone is ripping the copper out of the neighborhood's pipes at night.
textos.Alguien busca trabajo y pregunta si sabe: Someone is looking for work and asks if anybody knows of anything.
textos.Alguien cuenta que al del estanco le toc: Someone says the tobacconist won a nice little sum in the lottery.
textos.Alguien de mi contabilidad está hablando: Someone in my accounting department is talking to a journalist. I've asked him to meet me by the pond in Alameda Park. Go and make sure he never talks again.
textos.Alguien de tu banda lo saca del garaje,: Someone from your gang takes it out of the garage, comes to pick you up and drives to wherever you mark on the GPS.
textos.Alguien de tu banda viene a recogerte co: Someone from your gang comes to pick you up in a vehicle from your garage or one of the gang's, and drives to the destination you set on the GPS. You ride as a passenger and can shoot. You need to have someone recruited. You can also dismiss them from here.
textos.Alguien deja la banda tras un fracaso: Someone leaves the gang after a failure
textos.Alguien dice en voz baja que anoche hubo: Someone whispers that there was a ruckus at the harbor last night.
textos.Alguien dice que no se fía de los bancos: Someone says they don't trust banks, that money belongs at home.
textos.Alguien dispara un fusil semiautomático:: Someone fires a semi-automatic rifle: single, loud shots.
textos.Alguien dispara un revólver: más grave y: Someone fires a revolver: deeper and more forceful than the pistol.
textos.Alguien dispara un rifle de precisión o: Someone fires a sniper rifle or a carbine: dry and with an echo.
textos.Alguien dispara un subfusil o una ametra: Someone fires a submachine gun or a machine gun: fast bursts.
textos.Alguien dispara una escopeta: un estampi: Someone fires a shotgun: a broad boom.
textos.Alguien está vendiendo vino falso con la: Someone is selling fake wine with the Olmedo label.
textos.Alguien ha avisado a la Guardia de que h: Someone has told the Guard that envelopes changed hands. Get rid of them.
textos.Alguien ha avisado a la policía: una pat: Someone has called the police: a patrol is coming toward the fight.
textos.Alguien ha dado el aviso. Despista a la: Someone has raised the alarm. Shake off the patrol.
textos.Alguien ha dado el chivatazo: la policía: Someone tipped them off: the police are waiting for you on land. Dock wherever you like and shake them off.
textos.Alguien ha encontrado el maletín antes q: Someone found the briefcase before you.
textos.Alguien ha puesto vigilantes en el polvo: Someone has posted guards at the old powder magazine, and the town wants to know what they're guarding.
textos.Alguien iba a llamar a la policía y otro: Someone was about to call the police and somebody else told them to drop it, that you can be trusted.
textos.Alguien lanza una granada o un cóctel mo: Someone throws a grenade or a Molotov cocktail, or fires a crossbow.
textos.Alguien o algo cae al agua: tú, un vehíc: Someone or something falls in the water: you, a vehicle or what you throw into the sea.
textos.Alguien paga por el aparato, entregado e: Someone pays for the aircraft, delivered to a discreet spot in another town. You have to arrive without the radar on you: fly low for a while so it loses you, fly in low over the town and land next to that spot. Every day and at every airfield there is a different job.
textos.Alguien se está llevando el cable de la: Someone is taking Fuentefría's power cable, section by section, and the town is eating dinner by candlelight.
textos.Alguien sigue cobrando por el prestamist: Someone is still collecting for the loan shark at the ferry terminal. The reporter wants to know who.
textos.Alguien te aprecia más, por una charla,: Someone likes you more, because of a chat, a date or a gift.
textos.Alguien te avisa de que los de {lugar} h: Someone warns you that the people at {lugar} have sent men to look for you. They will not be long.
textos.Alguien te ha invitado a su banda o a su: Someone has invited you to their gang or their group. Go into those options to accept or decline.
textos.Alguien usa el faro de almacén. Vuelves: Someone is using the lighthouse as a warehouse. You go back and tell Amparo.
There must be some who do it right, I'd say.
Someday I'll be the one on top.
textos.Allí no hay campo para este aparato: sol: There is no airfield there for this aircraft: you can only fly in low.
textos.Allí no hay pista: se llega en helicópte: There is no runway there: you get there by helicopter with a pilot.
textos.Alquilada a {get} desde el día {get2}, p: Rented to {get} since day {get2}, for about {get3} euros a day. You have collected {get4} euros so far.
textos.Alquilado: {nombre}. Te espera en la pis: Rented: {nombre}. It's waiting for you on the runway, {situar}. Get in with F. You fly it by hand and it lands at any airport, heliport or open space.
textos.Alquilar el detector de metales o las bo: Rent the metal detector or the scuba tanks
textos.Alquilar la casa: unos {renta_de} euros: Rent out the house: about {renta_de} euros a day
textos.Alquilar un taxi para trabajar de taxist: Rent a taxi to work as a taxi driver
Rent a taxi to work as a taxi driver: {precio} euros
textos.Alquilar una lancha en un embarcadero: Rent a boat at a pier
textos.Alquilar una plaza: {precio} euros al dí: Rent a spot: {precio} euros a day
textos.Alquiláis una lancha y salís despacio. {: You rent a boat and set off slowly. {n} wants to take the helm, and you let them.
textos.Alt+{upper} abre dos menús de la barra:: Alt+{upper} opens two menus in the bar: "{v}" and "{titulo}".
High. They click as you walk.
textos.Altura mínima en vuelo, en metros: Minimum height in flight, in meters
Yellow, with a hood. Not a drop gets in.
textos.Ambulancia: hay un herido en {nombre}. ¡: Ambulance: there's an injured person at {nombre}. Hurry!
Ambulance: take the injured person to {nombre}.
textos.Ambulancias que acuden cuando hay herido: Ambulances that come when there are injured people
textos.Amenaza sobre un barrio tuyo: Threat to one of your neighborhoods
textos.Amenazar para que te dé dinero: Threaten them to make them give you money
textos.Amistad que suma cada quedada con un con: Friendship gained from each meet-up with an acquaintance, out of 100
textos.Ampliación y segunda línea de negocio: Expansion and second line of business
textos.Amueblar la casa: {puestos} de {cuantos}: Furnish the house: {puestos} of {cuantos} items placed
textos.Andar una hora al día. Me lo dijo el méd: Walking an hour a day. The doctor told me to, and I only half listen.
textos.Anotar la dirección de quien se conecta: Log the address of whoever connects
textos.Anselmo tiene que mandar la cosecha a Sa: Anselmo has to send the harvest to San Lucero.
textos.Anselmo, doña Remedios y yo hemos tenido: Anselmo, Doña Remedios and I have had an idea. An agreement among the three places: the wine, the market and the newspaper, with no owners involved.
It used to be that a hundred euros filled the cart. Now they don't even fill the basket.
textos.Antes con el puerto había para todos. Ah: It used to be that the harbor had enough for everyone. Now, well, you see.
textos.Antes de atracar un banco, un local o un: Before robbing a bank, a store or a supplier, you can hand out roles among your crew: driver, lookout, escort, the one on the register and shooter.
textos.Antes de empezar repartes los papeles: e: Before starting you hand out the roles: you pick each of your people and give them one. Anyone you give none comes with you and fights at your side, as always. Anyone with a role is busy with their own thing.
textos.Antes de firmar nada, date una vuelta. E: Before signing anything, take a walk. At the Barrio Viejo Community Center ask for Paulino: he teaches the classes. And stop by the soup kitchen, where the neighborhood is truly known.
textos.Antes de que cambie la marea hay que enc: Before the tide turns, the four lights of the island must be lit.
textos.Antes de que revienten el lago: Before They Blow Up the Lake
textos.Antes de salir te pregunta. Lo que no ha: It asks you before leaving. Anything you haven't saved is lost.
textos.Antes dejábamos la puerta abierta. Ahora: We used to leave the door open. Now, two deadbolts.
textos.Antes el puerto daba de comer a media ci: The harbor used to feed half the city.
textos.Antes eran cuatro críos con una moto. Ah: They used to be four kids on a moped. Now they carry guns.
textos.Antes hay que hacer la ronda como la gen: First you have to make the rounds like serious people. The bank, to open the new account. The fish market, which is where it comes in. And the casino, which is where it goes out. Let them see you walk in wearing a suit and say hello.
textos.Antes quedábamos en la plaza. Ahora, por: We used to meet up in the square. Now, by message.
textos.Antes salía. Ahora me da pereza hasta ba: I used to go out. Now I can't even be bothered to take out the trash.
textos.Antes se jugaba por la camiseta. Ahora,: We used to play for the jersey. Now, for the wallet.
You have to be engaged first.
textos.Antes un piso costaba lo que hoy un coch: An apartment used to cost what a car costs today.
textos.Anula el código elegido, si todavía no l: Cancels the selected code, if nobody has used it yet.
textos.Anunciar los lugares al llegar a su puer: Announce places when you reach their door
Parked out front, engine running. When you come out, I'll take off.
textos.Aparcar aquí es una lotería. Y nunca toc: Parking here is a lottery. And you never win.
textos.Aparece una diana: dispara hacia el lado: A target appears: shoot toward the side it sounds from.
textos.Aparecen al instante, sin esperar a que: They appear instantly, without waiting for you to arrive
textos.Apercibimiento: {motivo}, estando de ser: Warning: {motivo}, while on duty. You have {n} of {tope}.
textos.Apercibimientos con los que se pierde la: Reprimands that cost you the badge
textos.Apostar a la primera docena, paga el tri: Bet on the first dozen, pays triple
textos.Apostar a la segunda docena, paga el tri: Bet on the second dozen, pays triple
textos.Apostar a la tercera docena, paga el tri: Bet on the third dozen, pays triple
textos.Aprietas el gatillo y el arma está vacía: You pull the trigger and the weapon is empty: reload or switch weapons.
textos.Aprovechar para quitarle el reloj: Take the chance to lift his watch
textos.Aprovechas que el tendero atiende el tel: You take advantage of the shopkeeper answering the phone and walk out with everything. They didn't see you.
textos.Aproximaciones frustradas tras las que l: Missed approaches after which the tower guides you
textos.Apuestas 20, 100 o 500 euros y juegas co: You bet 20, 100 or 500 euros and play against the dealer to get close to 21 without going over.
textos.Apuestas 5, 25 o 100 euros por tirada. T: You bet 5, 25 or 100 euros per spin. Three matching symbols multiply the bet, more the better the symbol, and two matching double it.
textos.Apuestas al rojo o al negro, a par o imp: You bet on red or black, even or odd, a dozen or a single number. With zero you lose.
textos.Apuntarlo tal cual y avisar a tu jefe: Write it down as it is and tell your boss
textos.Aquí aparecen las decisiones que te espe: The decisions waiting for you appear here, such as an inspection with problems, a journalist or a gang asking for money.
Up here the Guard comes on Tuesdays. Today is Thursday.
textos.Aquí compran vehículos para despiece. Vu: They buy vehicles for parts here. Come back in the one you want to sell and they tell you how much they'll give.
Around here, I'm the well-known one.
textos.Aquí el que saca un arma acaba mal. Siem: Anyone who pulls a weapon here ends badly. Always.
textos.Aquí el que tiene, tiene, y el que no, a: Here, those who have, have, and those who don't, endure.
A merchant ship ran aground here a hundred years ago. The sand still gives things back.
textos.Aquí encuentras todos los trabajos honra: Here you find all the honest jobs: odd jobs and trades with a vehicle.
Here we are, which is already something.
textos.Aquí está medio barrio apuntado, con int: Half the neighborhood is on this list, with scary interest rates. This goes out on Sunday.
textos.Aquí está todo: pagos mensuales de una e: It is all here: monthly payments from a Belmonte company to an account of Varela's. But I need more evidence before publishing it. We will stay in touch.
textos.Aquí está. Es un puerto al amanecer, con: Here it is. A harbor at dawn, with a single boat. This harbor.
textos.Aquí están las personas con las que pued: Here are the people you can have a relationship with
textos.Aquí están todos los trabajos honrados d: All the honest jobs in the game are here
textos.Aquí la policía. No tiene escapatoria: r: This is the police. You have no way out: surrender.
textos.Aquí manda el que más miedo da. Hoy unos: Whoever scares people the most is in charge here. Some today, others tomorrow.
textos.Aquí me tienes. ¿Nos vamos?: Here I am. Shall we go?
textos.Aquí nadie manda por hablar. Coge esa mo: Nobody gives orders here just by talking. Take that motorcycle and reach the top of the hill before I count to a hundred.
textos.Aquí nadie sabe nada de ti: has dejado a: Nobody here knows anything about you: you've left behind those who were looking for you.
textos.Aquí no hay barrios que conquistar. Las: There are no neighborhoods to conquer here. Territory wars are for the cities: Puerto Bravo, San Lucero and Monteferro
textos.Aquí no hay coches: a pie y corriendo. L: There are no cars here: on foot and running. The tower, the cistern, the breakers and the pier, in that order.
textos.Aquí no hay guardia: la caja se vacía en: There is no guard here: the register is emptied on the spot, and the alarm goes off.
textos.Aquí no hay hospital al que llevar a los: There's no hospital here to take the injured to.
There's nothing to interact with here. Press Tab to explore with the radar.
textos.Aquí no hay nada tras lo que cubrirte. P: There's nothing to take cover behind here. Get close to a wall or a parked vehicle.
textos.Aquí no hay nada. {pista} Te quedan {int: There's nothing here. {pista} You have {intentos} tries and {int} seconds left.
textos.Aquí no hay nadie: te han seguido por el: There's nobody here: they tracked you on radar and the buyer has vanished. No pay.
There is no neighborhood to claim here.
textos.Aquí no hay pista. {nombre} necesita la: There's no runway here. {nombre} needs one at an airport or an airfield; if you come down here it will be a forced landing and the aircraft will suffer. Press F again to do it anyway.
textos.Aquí no hay propuestas: hay que escribir: There are no suggestions here: you have to type it.
There is no patrol duty here.
textos.Aquí no hay servicio de patrulla. Fin de: There is no patrol duty here. End of shift.
textos.Aquí no pueden venir a buscarte: sal a l: They can't come looking for you here: go out to the street.
textos.Aquí no se corre por dinero. Se corre po: Nobody races for money here. We race for favors, which are worth more.
textos.Aquí no se olvida esto. Llévate el scoot: We won't forget this here. Take the neon scooter, it belonged to the Collector and he won't be needing it anymore.
They cannot bring it to you here.
textos.Aquí no te quieren: alguien ha llamado a: They don't want you here: someone called the police as soon as they saw you.
textos.Aquí no te venden nada: no han olvidado: They won't sell you anything here: they haven't forgotten the hold-up. Come back in {veto} {v}
textos.Aquí no tienes plaza de hangar: alquílal: You don't have a hangar space here: rent or buy one at this same field.
textos.Aquí o te asas o te calas. No hay términ: Here you either roast or you get soaked. There's no in between.
textos.Aquí se olvida pronto. O se hace como qu: People forget quickly here. Or they pretend to.
textos.Aquí se pueden ganar por cuenta propia h: Here you can earn up to {tope} euros per hour on your own
textos.Aquí se queda para las carreras de la Es: It stays here for the Racing Team's races.
textos.Aquí se reparten las jornadas y los ofic: This is where the town's day jobs and trades are handed out.
textos.Aquí se reúnen de noche los locos del vo: Steering-wheel maniacs gather here at night. If you bring a vehicle, you can race for money.
textos.Aquí se saca agua dulce del mar. Se oye: Fresh water is drawn from the sea here. You can hear it running behind the fence, day and night, even if it doesn't reach the neighborhood.
The fish is auctioned here at dawn. They buy everything you bring.
textos.Aquí se vende la pesca del día. Pagan bi: The day's catch is sold here. They pay well for big fish.
textos.Aquí se vive bien si no te metes en líos: Life is good here if you stay out of trouble.
textos.Aquí siempre hay alguien que te echa una: There's always someone here who lends you a hand.
textos.Aquí te esperan para «{titulo}», del bue: They're waiting for you here for "{titulo}", from the right path: it's the last option in this menu.
textos.Aquí {campo}. Pista libre. Viento de {vi: This is {campo}. Runway clear. Wind from {viento}. {destino} is {km} kilometers away, heading {rumbo}.
textos.Aquí, dando una vuelta. Hay que estirar: Just out for a walk. You've got to stretch your legs.
textos.Archivo {s}. {describir} Intro lo devuel: File {s}. {describir} Enter resets it to 100 percent and plays it. To adjust it another way, find it in its group.
textos.Archivo {s}. {describir} Intro lo hace s: File {s}. {describir} Enter plays it. Left and right lower or raise it, from 30 to 200 percent. Delete resets it to 100.
textos.Arena fina y muchos turistas despistados: Fine sand and lots of clueless tourists. With a detector, something always turns up.
Sand, beach bars, hotels and tourists. The happiest neighborhood in the city.
textos.Arizmendi ha cerrado la desaladora con s: Arizmendi has shut down the desalination plant with his people inside. The whole city is without water.
textos.Arizmendi quiere sacar de la ciudad las: Arizmendi wants to take the desalination plant's main pumps out of the city.
textos.Armas colgadas tras un cristal. Huele a: Weapons hanging behind glass. It smells of oil.
textos.Armas y, dicen, algún explosivo que sobr: Weapons and, they say, some explosives left over from the mine.
textos.Armas, el disparo de cada una: Weapons, the shot of each one
textos.Armas. Usaban la plataforma de almacén d: Weapons. They used the platform as a weapons depot for Belmonte. Not anymore. By the way, the helicopter up there no longer has an owner.
textos.Armería con galería de tiro en el sótano: Gun shop with a shooting range in the basement.
textos.Armería legal con licencia. El dueño no: Licensed legal gun shop. The owner asks no questions if you pay cash.
textos.Armería: cargador ampliado, antes del de: Gun shop: extended magazine, before the shop discount
textos.Armería: silenciador, antes del descuent: Gun shop: silencer, before the shop discount
textos.Armería: una tanda en la galería de tiro: Gun shop: a round at the shooting range
textos.Arpones, remos, bengalas y lo que haga f: Harpoons, oars, flares and whatever you need at sea.
textos.Arranca la actividad con los que han ace: Starts the activity with those who have accepted and takes you back to the game. At least one person has to have accepted.
textos.Arranco ahora mismo. No te muevas de ahí: Starting up right now. Don't move from there.
textos.Arreglado sin pasarse: vale para una ent: Tidy without overdoing it: good for an interview and for a dinner.
They fix tractors, and whatever else you bring them.
They fix tractors, and whatever else you bring them.
textos.Arreglan volquetes, quads y lo que suba: They fix dump trucks, quads and anything that makes it up here.
textos.Arreglar lo de la policía: {precio} euro: Square things with the police: {precio} euros
textos.Arreglaron la plaza justo antes de las e: They fixed up the square right before the elections. What a coincidence.
textos.Arreglas lo que hace falta y se nota. Le: You fix what needs fixing and it shows. Neighborhood loyalty: {int} out of 100.
textos.Arriba esa cara. Llorando no se arregla: Chin up. Crying doesn't fix anything.
Up and down to go through the details. Enter to type the name; left and right to change the rest
textos.Arriba, por dónde vas. Debajo, lo que ha: At the top, where you are. Below, what you have done, from latest to first. Enter repeats a mission
textos.Asalta la Guarida de Los Calaveras y aca: Raid Los Calaveras Hideout and take out all eight, including their boss.
textos.Asalta la Guarida de Los Calaveras y eli: Raid the Los Calaveras Hideout and take out the four who guard it.
textos.Asalta la Mansión Belmonte y elimina a l: Raid the Belmonte Mansion and take out the seven guards.
textos.Asalto a {nombre}: ir en persona. Quedan: Attack on {nombre}: go in person. {_rato} left
textos.Asaltos cada {get} días o más en normal,: Assaults every {get} days or more on normal, with {get2} hours to respond
textos.Ascenso cada {get} avisos; {get2} aperci: Promotion every {get} notices; {get2} reprimands and you're out
textos.Ascenso que espera a que cumplas lo que: Promotion waiting for you to meet what it asks
textos.Asistencia en carretera: {LITROS_ASISTEN: Roadside assistance: {LITROS_ASISTENCIA} liters of fuel for {PRECIO_ASISTENCIA} euros
textos.Asuntos internos abre expediente: has us: Internal affairs opens a file: you used more force than you should have.
textos.Asuntos internos te quita la placa: {mot: Internal affairs takes your badge: {motivo}. You are out of the force.
textos.Así cierran la mina, cobran el seguro y: That way they shut down the mine, collect the insurance and throw you all in jail.
textos.Así da gusto. Toma, y un botiquín de reg: Now that's what I like to see. Here, and a first aid kit as a gift, because with the life you lead you'll need it.
That's what they'll call it on the street.
textos.Así me gusta. De día, [el|la] de la pers: That's what I like. By day, the shop owner; by night, one of ours. Nobody needs to know.
textos.Así me gusta. Toma, por las molestias. Y: That's what I like. Here, for your trouble. And drop by later: a friend of mine, El Chispas, is looking for people with quick hands for his repair shop.
That's how I feel every day.
textos.Así no se puede estar: tienes el cuerpo: You can't go on like this: your body is crying out for what it's missing.
textos.Así que tú eres Dani. La Rusa habla bien: So you're Dani. La Rusa speaks well of you, and La Rusa doesn't even speak well of her own mother.
textos.Así que tú eres [el nuevo|la nueva]. Mat: So you're the new one. Matilde, president of the Merchants' Association. Everyone here knows each other, and we need it.
textos.Así que tú eres quien anda revolviendo m: So you are the one stirring up my city. Sit down. Whiskey?
textos.Atacas con las manos arriba: se acabó la: You attack with your hands up: the surrender is over.
textos.Atención: con lo que llevas solo puedes: Warning: with what you're carrying you can only fly about {int} kilometers. You won't make it.
textos.Atención: solo te queda para unos {int}: Warning: you only have fuel for about {int} kilometers.
textos.Atención: un aparato viene hacia ti a tu: Warning: an aircraft is heading toward you at your altitude. Change level, a hundred meters up or down.
textos.Aterriza lejos de helipuertos y aeropuer: Land far from heliports and airports, or they'll recognize you.
textos.Aterrizaje a mano: baja con {_tecla_txt}: Manual landing: descend with {_tecla_txt} to {entero} meters or less and keep the clicks in the center.
textos.Aterrizaje asistido: el aparato baja y s: Assisted landing: the aircraft descends and lines up on its own.
textos.Aterrizaje forzoso: el aparato se arrast: Forced landing: the aircraft skids along the ground and stops.
textos.Aterrizar. Frena y pulsa F: el aparato b: Land. Brake and press F: the aircraft descends on its own and, when it touches down, you get out. A helicopter lands on a heliport, a street or an open space. A plane needs the runway of an airport or an airfield; anywhere else it is a forced landing, which the game makes you confirm and which damages the aircraft.
You serve customers yourself: the business's name goes up. Once a day at each business.
textos.Atracar al peatón que tienes al lado: Rob the pedestrian next to you
textos.Atracas a {get}, pero no lleva nada enci: You rob {get}, but they have nothing on them.
textos.Atracas y saltas a tierra en {nombre}, {: You dock and step ashore at {nombre}, {nombre2}.{extra}
textos.Atraco a otro jugador, en tanto por cien: Robbing another player, as a percentage
textos.Atracos, pandilleros y maletines perdido: Robberies, thugs and lost briefcases that show up on the street from time to time.
textos.Autobuses a toda la comarca. El viaje a: Buses to the whole region. The trip to Puerto Bravo is long.
textos.Automático corre solo cuando hace falta;: Automatic only hurries when needed; Calm drives slowly; Normal always obeys the rules; Hurried but obeying the rules floors it without getting ticketed; and Hurried, breaking the rules doesn't wait at traffic lights. You can also choose it at the wheel with a quick tap of A.
Automatic, accurate and long range. The most complete weapon.
textos.Automático: mantén pulsado el disparo. T: Automatic: hold the fire button. Thirty bullets that fly away.
textos.Avenida, o metros al este: Avenue, or meters to the east
textos.Averías, taller, gasolina y robo de vehí: Breakdowns, repair shop, gas and vehicle theft
textos.Aviones de pasajeros a las otras ciudade: Passenger planes to the other cities, scheduled light planes to the villages, helicopters to the islands, and rental light planes and helicopters
textos.Avionetas de línea a las ciudades, a los: Scheduled light planes to the cities and the other villages, helicopters to the islands, and rental light planes
textos.Avisa a los jugadores, lo guarda todo y: Notifies the players, saves everything and stops the server.
Notifies the players, saves everything and stops the server. Also with Shift+F5.
textos.Avisa de que llega tarde: Warns that they are running late
textos.Avisar cada medianoche de cómo van tus a: Report every midnight on how your stocks are doing
textos.Avisar con tiempo sienta mucho mejor que: Giving notice ahead of time goes over a lot better than standing them up, but it still stings a little.
textos.Avisar de un fallo o proponer una mejora: Report a bug or suggest an improvement
textos.Avisas a un agente que pasaba. Lo arregl: You alert an officer who was passing by. He fixes it in a moment.
textos.Aviso a los jugadores: el servidor se pa: Warning to the players: the server stops in %d seconds, %s.
textos.Aviso a una partida de antes de esta ver: Notice to a save from before this version
textos.Aviso al dar en el blanco: Alert when you hit the target
textos.Aviso dado. El servidor se para dentro d: Warning given. The server stops in %d seconds, saving everything. The games will wait and come back in on their own when you start it again.
textos.Aviso de la jefatura: se esperan enfrent: Notice from headquarters: clashes between gangs are expected in {v}.
textos.Aviso de que al vehículo le queda poco c: Warning that the vehicle is low on fuel: find a gas station.
textos.Aviso de que te faltan turnos: Notice that you are short of shifts
textos.Aviso de última hora: están atracando a: Breaking news: someone is being mugged near here.
textos.Aviso de última hora: pandilleros alboro: Breaking news: gang members causing trouble on a nearby street.
textos.Aviso del cobro de facturas e impuestos: Notice of the collection of bills and taxes
textos.Aviso del servidor: dentro de %d segundo: Server notice: in %d seconds it restarts %s. Your character saves itself. It will be back in a few minutes: come back in then.
textos.Aviso general: una misión nueva, un dest: General alert: a new mission, a set destination or a message. What it is gets said right after.
textos.Aviso importante sobre tus barrios: desd: Important notice about your neighborhoods: from this version on, owning them isn't enough.
textos.Aviso: al abrir el juego no se pudo busc: Notice: when the game opened, it couldn't check for a new version
textos.Aviso: este personaje se guardó la últim: Warning: this character was last saved with game version {de}, which is newer than yours. If you notice anything odd, update the game.
textos.Aviso: no se ha podido abrir la tarjeta: Warning: the sound card could not be opened. The game will work without audio.
textos.Avisos de la partida compartida y de los: Alerts from the shared game and from the server roleplay channels.
textos.Avisos del nivel de búsqueda, sirenas y: Wanted level alerts, sirens and the police helicopter.
textos.Avisos falsos para despejar el camino. P: False alarms to clear the way. Well, the trick is over. In this park you'll always have a plate whenever you want.
textos.Avión de pasajeros, para los trayectos l: Passenger plane, for long trips between cities.
textos.Ay, Dani, qué disgusto. La cartera. Con: Oh, Dani, what a shame. The wallet. With the whole pension in it, which I took out this morning to pay the gas man.
Oh, I couldn't tell you. Sorry.
textos.Ay, ya tengo unos cuantos, pero los llev: Oh, I've got quite a few, but I carry them well.
textos.Ayer hice lentejas para un regimiento. L: Yesterday I made lentils for a whole regiment. I've been eating lentils for three days.
textos.Ayer robaron tres coches en mi calle. Tr: Three cars were stolen on my street yesterday. Three.
Helping, I'll do. Getting into trouble, no.
You help {n} carry the boxes up to {casa}. From today you live under the same roof.
You help anyway, and a little something comes your way.
textos.Azulejos nuevos y una bañera en la que t: New tiles and a bathtub you can stretch out in.
textos.Añade relaciones sentimentales y sexuale: It adds romantic and sexual relationships, flirting with anyone, adventures, paid companionship, drugs and dealing, told in a sensual way but without explicit scenes. Everything has consequences for mood, health, reputation and relationships. When turned off, none of it appears in the game.
textos.Añade uno con la dirección que te dé qui: Add one with the address given to you by whoever runs it.
textos.Añades {lower}. Llevas {len}: {total} eu: You add {lower}. You have {len}: {total} euros, plus {envio} delivery.
It's still not answering: I'm still at it.
textos.Aún no ha dado ningún golpe contigo: Hasn't pulled any heist with you yet
textos.Aún no ha empezado. Puedes reforzar ese: It hasn't started yet. You can reinforce that neighborhood, put a guard on it, make a truce with that gang or hit their hideout before the day arrives.
You haven't caught your breath yet.
textos.Aún no os conocéis. Ve a ese lugar y pre: You don't know each other yet. Go to that place and introduce yourself from this same menu
textos.Aún no se ha sorteado. El sorteo es a la: It hasn't been drawn yet. The draw is at nine in the evening.
I don't know where {nombre} is yet.
textos.Aún no tienes conocidos. Habla con la ge: You don't know anyone yet. Talk to people on the street with the J key and, when someone likes you, ask for their number
textos.B o Círculo para volver: B or Circle to go back
textos.Bahía del Ocaso: el agua es de todos: Bahía del Ocaso: Water Belongs to Everyone
textos.Bahía del Ocaso: el agua vuelve a ser de: Bahía del Ocaso: Water Belongs to Everyone Again
textos.Bahía del Ocaso: encargos de oído: Bahía del Ocaso: Jobs by Ear
textos.Bahía del Ocaso: historias para adultos: Bahía del Ocaso: Stories for Adults
textos.Bahía del Ocaso: la Peña del Cobre: Bahía del Ocaso: the Copper Club
textos.Bailas una hora en la pista y sales con: You dance for an hour on the floor and come out a different person. It's {hora_txt}.
textos.Bailas una hora en la pista. Alguien no: You dance for an hour on the floor. Someone keeps looking at you: on the way out, they're at your side. Talk to them with the J key. It's {hora_txt}.
You dance very close until they close.
textos.Bailáis pegados un par de canciones. {n}: You dance close for a couple of songs. {n} lets themselves be led.
textos.Baja al Muelle de las Salinas y rechaza: Go down to Salinas Pier and repel the landing.
textos.Baja con sus nervios: con 100 no falla n: It drops with their nerves: at 100 it never fails.
Roll down the window, I'm going to let them have it.
textos.Baja por la avenida de los Miradores. Yo: Go down Avenida de los Miradores. I'll ride ahead on the motorcycle and call out the curves.
textos.Bajan los puños. Les tomas el nombre y l: They lower their fists. You take their names and send them home.
textos.Bajar el ambiente y la música mientras h: Lower the ambience and music while the voice speaks
textos.Bajas a {int} metros. Tan bajo no vuela: You descend to {int} meters. The autopilot doesn't fly that low: you fly it yourself.
textos.Bajas en su barrio con las que la banda: Losses in its neighborhood at which the gang declares war
textos.Bajo estas aguas descansa el Santa Clara: The Santa Clara, a merchant ship sunk a hundred years ago, rests beneath these waters. With diving tanks you can go down and search it.
textos.Bajón al pasarse el efecto: Comedown when the effect wears off
textos.Balas de reserva del arma inicial: Spare bullets for the starting weapon
textos.Baldomero entra en el casino por la puer: Baldomero enters the casino by the service door. Through the crack you see him empty three envelopes onto the table of a man who writes in a notebook.
textos.Baliza del GPS, radar, tono de puntería,: GPS beacon, radar, aiming tone, proximity sensor, traffic lights and each place's own sound. It applies on top of its group's volume: lower it if the signals drown out everything else, or lower everything else and leave this at maximum. Change it with the left and right arrow keys.
textos.Baliza sonora del GPS: ponerla o quitarl: GPS sound beacon: turn it on or off
textos.Bancos, gimnasios, cines y otros servici: Banks, gyms, cinemas and other services
textos.Baraja española. Elige cuánto apuestas: Spanish deck. Choose how much to bet
textos.Barcos de trabajo y alguno de paseo. Los: Work boats and a few for leisure. They're left moored at the pier.
textos.Barcos y mercancías. Estable y aburrida,: Ships and cargo. Stable and boring, but it pays dividends.
textos.Barcos, helicópteros, tren, tranvía y av: Boats, helicopters, train, tram and plane
textos.Bares y restaurantes de la costa. Se emp: Bars and restaurants on the coast. You start by waiting tables.
textos.Barra de progreso. Indica cuánto se ha c: Progress bar. Shows how much has been completed.
textos.Barrenera, como su madre. Empieza con re: A driller, like her mother. Starts with endurance at level five, more health than normal, a miner's pickaxe and little money.
textos.Barrios con los que empieza la versión s: Neighborhoods the mild version starts with
textos.Batas blancas y cajas de medicinas. Aquí: White coats and boxes of medicine. You buy here.
textos.Bautiza el vehículo que traes o cualquie: Names the vehicle you brought or any of those in the garage. The game will say that name when you get in, when you locate it and in lists.
textos.Bautiza este vehículo, gratis. El juego: Name this vehicle, free of charge. The game will say that name when you get in, when you locate it and in lists, and the vehicle is registered in your name: it no longer gets lost on the street.
textos.Bazar de playa: flotadores, bocadillos y: Beach bazaar: pool floats, sandwiches and a bit of everything.
You drink fresh water from the fountain.
textos.Belmonte es dueño de media ciudad. Y de: Belmonte owns half the city. And the other half, too.
textos.Belmonte ha mandado a todos sus hombres: Belmonte has sent all his men to take over the mine offices.
textos.Belmonte huye hacia el ferry. Es ahora o: Belmonte is fleeing toward the ferry. It's now or never.
Belmonte wants you to collect some debts.
textos.Belmonte quiere sacar de Monteferro la c: Belmonte wants to get the company's cash box out of Monteferro.
textos.Belmonte tiene un encargo delicado en el: Belmonte has a delicate job in the park.
Belmonte and I are on a first-name basis.
Belmonte already knows you betrayed him. He is going to come after us, so we are going to go first.
textos.Besarle antes de que diga nada: Kiss them before they say anything
textos.Bidón de gasolina comprado. Llevas {bido: Gas can bought. You are carrying {bidon}.
textos.Bidón de gasolina de {LITROS_BIDON} litr: Gas can of {LITROS_BIDON} liters: {PRECIO_BIDON} euros. You are carrying {get}
textos.Bien todos, que yo sepa. Hace días que n: All fine, as far as I know. I haven't talked to them in days.
textos.Bien, bien. Mejor ahora que hablamos un: Good, good. Even better now that we're chatting for a bit.
textos.Bien, de verdad. Hoy me he levantado con: Good, really. I got up on the right foot today.
textos.Bien, liad{o} como siempre, que no paro: Good, busy as always, I don't even stop to breathe.
Good, nothing special. I can't complain.
textos.Bien, {tu}. Contigo siempre se anima uno: Good, {tu}. You always cheer a person up.
textos.Bien. Ahora, armas de fuego. Te doy una: Good. Now, firearms. I'll give you a pistol with plenty of bullets.
textos.Bien. Desde hoy, en el Cauce no pagas un: Good. From today on, you don't pay for a drink at the Cauce.
Fine. But don't believe it too much.
Good... I like it. It's quiet.
textos.Bien: el barco gira como tú quieres. Sig: Good: the boat turns the way you want. Keep sailing, you have about {int} meters to go.
textos.Bienvenid[o|a] a la asociación. Las reun: Welcome to the association. Meetings are on Thursdays. And if anyone comes asking you for money who isn't the tax office, tell me.
textos.Bienvenid[o|a] al balneario. Lo siento,: Welcome to the spa. Sorry, no baths today: the water is coming down black. Someone is dumping filth into Río Frío Pool.
textos.Bienvenid{o}, de verdad. Si necesitas al: Welcome, really. If you need anything, ask.
textos.Bienvenid{o}. No es mal sitio, ya lo ver: Welcome. It's not a bad place, you'll see.
textos.Billete de autobús, si la estación de de: Bus ticket, if the destination station doesn't set its own
textos.Billete de avioneta de línea, si el dest: Light plane flight ticket, if the destination doesn't set its own
textos.Billete de avión, si el aeropuerto de de: Plane ticket, if the destination airport doesn't set its own
textos.Billete de tren: lo que se suma por cada: Train ticket: what is added for each town of distance
textos.Billetes, y una nota con el membrete del: Bills, and a note with the Casino Belmonte letterhead. There is no doubt anymore who is paying. Be careful, Dani: now Belmonte knows you exist.
textos.Blackjack. Gana quien se acerque más a 2: Blackjack. Whoever gets closest to 21 without going over wins
textos.Blanquear en fichas. Dinero sin justific: Launder into chips. Unexplained money: {int} euros. You carry {dinero}
textos.Boca fresca: se nota al hablar con la ge: Fresh breath: people notice when you talk to them.
textos.Boleto comprado: el {cifras}. Juega en e: Ticket bought: number {cifras}. It plays in the draw {cuando_txt}. Check it afterward on your phone, in Lottery, or wherever tickets are sold.
textos.Boleto {cifras}, del día {sorteo}: premi: Ticket {cifras}, from day {sorteo}: winner of {v} euros, to be collected
textos.Boleto {cifras}, del día {sorteo}: sorte: Ticket {cifras}, from day {sorteo}: drawn, not checked
textos.Bolsa: comprar y vender acciones: Stock market: buy and sell shares
textos.Bolsa: tus acciones valen {valor} euros,: Stock market: your shares are worth {valor} euros. Compared with yesterday: {cambio}. Since you bought them, {balance}.
textos.Bomberos: hay un incendio en {nombre}. ¡: Fire department: there's a fire at {nombre}. Run!
textos.Borra el programa y el modelo de tu disc: Deletes the program and the model from your disk.
textos.Borra la carpeta data, ia local, con el: Deletes the folder data, local AI, with the program and the model. You can download it again whenever you like.
textos.Borra la cuenta elegida con su personaje: Deletes the selected account with its character, its properties and its place in the gang. It can't be undone.
textos.Borra lo que hay en esta ventana. No bor: Clears what is in this window. It doesn't delete anything from the server.
textos.Botas de goma, peto impermeable y olor a: Rubber boots, waterproof bib overalls and a smell of the sea.
textos.Botellas y latas. Las de abajo, en una n: Bottles and cans. The cold ones are in a fridge below.
First aid kits, saline and shade at the door.
textos.Botones restablecidos a su asignación or: Buttons reset to their original assignment.
textos.Botín al tumbar a otro jugador, en tanto: Loot for knocking down another player, as a percentage
textos.Botón de opción. Elija entre las opcione: Radio button. Choose among the options in the group with the arrow keys.
textos.Botón. Actívelo con la barra espaciadora: Button. Activate it with Space or Enter.
Bravo FM, they play the good rock.
Shines under the lights of the dance floor.
textos.Buceando, de cada cien vistazos al fondo: While diving, out of every hundred looks at the seabed, how many find something
textos.Bucles largos que suenan de fondo en cad: Long loops that play in the background in each neighborhood, with rain and at night, and single sounds that appear now and then around you.
textos.Buena mano tienes. Pásate mañana, que te: You have a good hand. Come by tomorrow, I have another job that's less clean.
Good question. I have no idea.
textos.Buenas, traigo lo de {local}. Aquí tiene: Hi, I've got your order from {local}. Here you go. See you around.
Well, a little nervous, but fine.
Fine. But don't let it happen again.
textos.Buenos días, dormilón. Hazme un favor: P: Good morning, sleepyhead. Do me a favor: Paco, from the grocery store, is keeping a package for me. Bring it to me.
textos.Busca con el texto y los filtros indicad: Searches with the given text and filters.
textos.Busca el objeto más cercano y te lo marc: Finds the nearest object and marks it on the GPS.
textos.Busca errores: referencias que no existe: Looks for errors: references that do not exist, impossible positions, inconsistent steps.
textos.Buscar a quien la ha perdido y devolvérs: Track down whoever lost it and return it in full
textos.Buscar componentes nuevos al arrancar: {: Check for new components at startup: {v}
textos.Buscar pelea con una banda, en el móvil,: Pick a fight with a gang, on the phone, Territories: no neighborhood is at stake. Works with street war mode turned off.
textos.Buscar pelea con una banda, sin conquist: Look for a fight with a gang, without conquering anything
Look for a fight with a gang, without conquering anything. Which one?
textos.Buscar un sonido. Escribe parte de su no: Search for a sound. Type part of its name or of what it means
textos.Buscar una versión nueva del juego e ins: Look for a new version of the game and install it, and choose where it updates from: the game server, GitHub, both, or an address of your own.
textos.Buscas tu nombre en la lista de personas: You look for your name on the wanted list and it isn't there: nobody is looking for you.
textos.Busco coches. Hay un sedán aparcado junt: I'm looking for cars. There is a sedan parked next to San Telmo Church. Its owner owes me money. Bring it to me in one piece.
textos.Bájate del vehículo con F y pulsa Intro: Get out of the vehicle with F and press Enter to choose a boat.
Get out of the vehicle with F and press Enter to buy the ticket.
textos.Caben la mitad más de balas, así que rec: It holds half as many more bullets, so you reload less often. It is lost along with the weapon if you get arrested.
textos.Caben más litros, así que repostas menos: They hold more liters, so you refuel less often. You only notice it when playing with fuel. When filling up, the pump takes longer.
textos.Caben todos los jugadores que entren: no: Room for every player who comes in: there is no limit.
textos.Caben {entero} aeronaves. Lo que guardas: There is room for {entero} aircraft. What you keep here is never lost
textos.Cabos, anzuelos, bocadillos y botiquines: Ropes, hooks, sandwiches and first aid kits for seafaring folk.
textos.Cada Intro le das uno. Tiene que estar a: Each Enter gives them one. They have to be next to you.
Every mayor builds a roundabout and leaves.
textos.Cada asalto es un rival distinto, sin de: Each assault is a different rival, with no rest between them.
Every year there are fewer boats and fewer fish.
textos.Cada banda tiene su listón, al azar entr: Each gang has its own threshold, random between these two numbers.
textos.Cada coche, moto o camión tiene su depós: Each car, motorcycle or truck has its own tank and uses fuel as it moves, more the faster you go. It warns you when it enters reserve; with an empty tank, the engine stops. You refuel at gas stations without getting out of the vehicle, with a can bought there, or by calling roadside assistance from the phone, in Services. The V key tells you how much is left.
