It doesn't apply to boats, to anything that flies, to bicycles or to mission vehicles.
textos.Cada cuántas horas hace el servidor una: Every how many hours the server makes a backup in the copias folder, inside the data folder. With 0, it makes none.
textos.Cada cuántos días se reparten dividendos: How many days between dividend payouts
textos.Cada cuántos metros suena el tono de alt: How many meters apart the altitude tone sounds
textos.Cada cuántos minutos se guarda todo en d: Every how many minutes everything is saved to disk. Stopping the server always saves.
textos.Cada delito cuenta la mitad más, así que: Every crime counts half again as much, so your wanted level rises sooner. Each active modifier makes you gain experience twenty-five percent faster.
textos.Cada detención y cada multa que pagas a: Every arrest and every fine you pay an officer is recorded, more serious the more you were wanted. They expire by themselves over time.
textos.Cada día cuelgan encargos nuevos. Vuelve: New jobs are posted every day. Come back tomorrow.
textos.Cada día gasta una tanda de material, qu: Every day they use up a batch of materials, bought from a supplier, and leave the product in that home's wardrobe. It can go wrong.
Every day they ask for more and pay less.
textos.Cada día, cada local tiene una cantidad: Each day, each business has a different amount between the two.
textos.Cada día, de cada cien bandas en tregua,: Each day, out of every hundred gangs under a truce, how many break it
textos.Cada día, de cada cien bandas que pagan: Each day, out of every hundred gangs paying tribute, how many stop paying
textos.Cada empleado cobra al día un {entero} p: Each employee earns a day's pay of {entero} percent of what the business yields at base and makes it yield {entero2} percent more. With people hired, the business keeps going even when you don't come by.
textos.Cada entrenamiento sube cinco puntos tu: Each workout raises your maximum health by five points, up to 150. One a day.
textos.Cada jueves sale del banco con un maletí: Every Thursday he leaves the bank with a briefcase and doesn't return to the office. Follow him. I want to know where he leaves it.
textos.Cada lunes, furgón blindado sale del Ban: Every Monday, an armored van leaves Mercantil Bank carrying Belmonte's money. Today is Monday.
textos.Cada manzana debe pertenecer a un barrio: Each block must belong to a neighborhood.
textos.Cada medianoche te llega el dinero al bo: Every midnight the money lands in your pocket, wherever you are.
textos.Cada medianoche va a tu cuenta del banco: Every midnight it goes to your bank account, where it also earns interest. To spend it, withdraw it at a bank.
textos.Cada miembro con su rango y si está cone: Each member with their rank and whether they are online.
textos.Cada mueble va a una habitación y mejora: Each piece of furniture goes in a room and improves what you do there. They stay in this house
textos.Cada nivel cuesta este precio multiplica: Each level costs this price multiplied by the level number.
textos.Cada nivel hace que el negocio dé más y: Each level makes the business earn more and take on more people. High levels require a management degree and good standing.
textos.Cada nivel hace que piquen antes y que t: Each level makes them bite sooner and your catches worth more.
textos.Cada nivel sube tu probabilidad de acert: Each level raises your chance of hitting.
textos.Cada nivel sube un uno por ciento la vel: Each level raises top speed by one percent and reduces damage to your vehicle.
textos.Cada nivel te hace correr más y recibir: Each level makes you run faster and take less damage.
textos.Cada noche pasará dinero por tu caja y t: Every night money will pass through your register and you keep your cut. But watch out for the inspectors, and the press. If they catch you, we don't know you.
textos.Cada objeto de valor ocupa los huecos qu: Each valuable item takes up the slots its entry says; product takes one slot per that many units.
textos.Cada objeto ocupa unos huecos; la mercan: Each item takes up some slots; product, one per ten units. Clothing stores sell a bigger backpack. Whatever you don't want to carry, leave in the wardrobe at one of your homes or sell at a pawn shop.
textos.Cada oleada trae uno más que la anterior: Each wave brings one more than the previous one. The last one, if the gang has reinforcements with a vehicle, brings some of them in it.
textos.Cada oleada trae uno más. En duro, uno m: Each wave brings one more. On hard, one more in every wave.
textos.Cada patrulla que sale a por el jugador: Each patrol sent after the player at this level brings officers of one of these types, at random. The type sets their weapon, health, vehicle and how many get out.
textos.Cada persona decide. Hace falta que la r: Each person decides. The relationship has to be going very well and you need to have had several dates, and some people won't leave their home for anyone. If you have several homes, you choose which one you live in, in this town or another; later you can move to another.
Each person has their preferred way. What you bought for the occasion shows
textos.Cada persona tiene su propio listón, uno: Each person has their own threshold, a few points above or below.
Each person has their favorite plans. Find them out
textos.Cada plan se cuenta de una manera, y no: Each plan is told a different way, and never the same twice
textos.Cada pulsación la baja un poco. El menú: Each press lowers it a little. The menu doesn't close.
textos.Cada pulsación la sube un poco. El menú: Each press raises it a little. The menu doesn't close.
textos.Cada sesión tiene su carpeta, con la fec: Each session has its own folder, with the date and time in the name.
textos.Cada sustancia tiene su sonido al tomarl: Each substance has its own sound when you take it, so you can recognize it without looking.
textos.Cada tanda que fabricas gasta una de mat: Each batch you make uses up one batch of supplies. Any supplier sells supplies.
Each round brings one more than the previous one.
textos.Cada tarde, el contable de Aguas del Oca: Every afternoon, the accountant of Aguas del Ocaso leaves the bank with an envelope. I want to know where he takes it.
textos.Cada temporal deja en esta playa restos: Every storm leaves wreckage of old ships on this beach.
textos.Cada territorio te deja mantener a uno m: Each territory lets you support one more, up to {TOPE_BANDA}. Each member is paid every midnight whatever the gang pay says; if you can't pay, the least loyal one leaves and the others get angry.
textos.Cada tienda tiene cada día un producto d: Each shop has one product on sale each day. With zero, there are no sales.
textos.Cada tipo de lugar emite su sonido en bu: Each type of place plays its sound in a loop so you can recognize it as you pass. They must be different from each other and not tiring: remember they are heard many times.
textos.Cada tipo de lugar suena de una manera c: Each type of place sounds a different way when you pass by. When you turn it on, a sample plays, the one for a bar. In the main menu, Learn the sounds has them all.
textos.Cada tipo de lugar tiene su propio sonid: Each type of place has its own sound, which you will hear as you approach. You can learn them all in the Learn the sounds menu. At a door, press Enter to go in.
textos.Cada travesía tiene el suyo, de una dire: Each crossing has its own, from a different direction.
textos.Cada título lleva varias sesiones, una a: Each degree takes several sessions, one a day. Once you complete them, it is yours forever
textos.Cada unidad de un producto y cada ración: Each unit of a product and each cooked portion takes up a slot.
textos.Cada uno cobra su parte al acabar, si el: Everyone gets paid their cut at the end, if the heist goes well. Whoever gets arrested doesn't get paid.
textos.Cada uno esconde en el puño de cero a tr: Each player hides zero to three coins in a fist and says how many they think there are between both. Whoever guesses the total takes the bet. If nobody guesses, it is repeated.
textos.Cada uno esconde monedas en el puño y di: Each one hides coins in a fist and guesses how many there are between the two. You bet ten or fifty euros.
textos.Cada uno lo suyo: {partes}. A ti te qued: Everyone's share: {partes}. You keep {neto} of the {botin} euros.
Everyone sees it their own way.
textos.Cada uno se queda lo suyo y tú cobras de: Everyone keeps what's theirs and you collect from all three: three hundred euros every midnight. Nobody gets hurt.
Everyone has their beliefs. I respect that.
textos.Cada vehículo cuenta los kilómetros que: Each vehicle counts the kilometers it travels. Every so often a tire goes flat: you can hear it, and the car won't go above half speed until you change it, with a spare from the phone, at a repair shop or by calling assistance. After a certain number of kilometers it is due for an inspection at a repair shop; if you skip it, the brakes get worse. The V key, while driving, tells you the kilometers and what is wrong with it.
textos.Cada vez hay más. Antes eso aquí no pasa: There are more all the time. This never used to happen here.
textos.Cada vez que aciertas a un enemigo o a u: Every time you hit an enemy or a vehicle, a high-pitched tap sounds and the gamepad gives a short jolt. When you lock onto a target with Q, the gamepad also alerts you.
textos.Cada vez que el juego dice algo, el soni: Every time the game says something, the background sound and the music drop for a moment so it is easier to understand. Important effects, such as engines, footsteps and gunshots, do not drop.
textos.Cada vez tarda un tiempo distinto entre: Each time it takes a different amount of time between the two.
Each time it takes a different amount of time between the two. In rain it takes longer, and at night, a bit less.
textos.Cada vez viene más gente de fuera, y se: More and more people come from outside, and you can tell.
textos.Cada viernes me faltan cajas del almacén: Every Friday I'm missing boxes from the stockroom. They're not expensive, but they're the kind sold by prescription.
textos.Cada vuelo se hace una vez al día. Mañan: Each flight can be done once a day. Tomorrow there will be other jobs.
textos.Cada {entero} avisos resueltos asciendes: Every {entero} calls resolved you get promoted and earn {entero2} percent more. Warnings come for minor offenses while on duty or for using more force than you should have; with the last one, you lose your badge.
textos.Cada {entero} días se cobran la luz y el: Every {entero} days, the electricity and water for your homes, their property tax and the tax on what your businesses have earned are charged. It is charged automatically, from the bank first. If it doesn't go through, it is owed with a surcharge; after three missed payments, seizure.
textos.Cae la noche y {n} te pasa un sobre: {eu: Night falls and {n} hands you an envelope: {euros} euros from {u} units sold.
You go down in the middle of the fight.
Quick coffee for office workers in a hurry.
textos.Caja de un tipo de local: Cash of a type of business
textos.Caja vaciada: {n} euros. Lárgate antes d: Till emptied: {n} euros. Get out before its owner arrives.
Boxes of food and folded clothes.
textos.Cajas de fruta y de verdura. Huele a tie: Crates of fruit and vegetables. It smells of wet earth and orange.
textos.Cajero automático. En el banco tienes {b: ATM. You have {banco} euros in the bank and carry {dinero}
textos.Cajero automático: sacar dinero del banc: ATM: withdraw money from the bank
textos.Cala Brava, un pueblo de pescadores enca: Cala Brava, a fishing village wedged between two cliffs. It smells of tar and fried fish.
textos.Callar y pagarle tú también, para que te: Stay quiet and pay him too, so he leaves you alone
textos.Calle, o metros al norte: Street, or meters to the north
textos.Calles estrechas, ropa tendida y vecinos: Narrow streets, laundry hanging out and lifelong neighbors. This is where you grew up.
textos.Camarera del Chiringuito El Espeto. Risa: Waitress at El Espeto Beach Bar. Quick to laugh, sharp-tongued, with an anchor tattoo on her wrist. She dreams of owning her own bar.
textos.Camas duras, sábanas limpias y nadie hac: Hard beds, clean sheets and nobody asks questions.
textos.Cambia cada día y en cada tienda. Con ce: Changes every day and in every shop. With zero, nothing is ever out of stock.
textos.Cambia cada opción con las flechas izqui: Change each option with the left and right arrow keys. F1 explains the option
textos.Cambia cómo te hablan los demás y cómo t: Changes how others address you and how the game addresses you: welcome, Encarna's nephew or niece. The story and everything else are the same.
textos.Cambia cómo te ven en el barrio: {ahora}: Changes how you're seen in the neighborhood: {ahora}.
Changes how you are seen on the street.
textos.Cambia el aviso que oye cada jugador al: Changes the notice each player hears on joining.
textos.Cambiar de destino. El primero es el más: Change destination. The first one is the closest
textos.Cambiar el movimiento a pie entre brújul: Switch on-foot movement between compass and turns
textos.Cambiar entre conducción asistida y libr: Switch between assisted and free driving
textos.Cambiar la rueda pinchada con la de repu: Replace the flat tire with the spare: you have {get}
textos.Cambiarte de ropa despista a la policía: Changing clothes throws the police off if you have a wanted level of one or two and no officers are nearby.
textos.Cambias de emisora en la radio de un veh: You change station on a vehicle's radio, or turn it off.
textos.Cambias el valor de una opción con izqui: You change the value of an option with left or right.
textos.Caminas por el asfalto, por donde van lo: You walk on the asphalt, where the cars go.
textos.Caminas por el asfalto: cuidado con los: You walk on the asphalt: watch out for cars.
textos.Caminas por el césped de un parque o por: You walk on the grass of a park or in the countryside.
You walk on the grass, with the other foot.
textos.Caminas por la acera. Los dos pies suena: You walk on the sidewalk. Your two feet sound a little different.
You walk on the sand of the beach.
You walk on the sand, with the other foot.
textos.Caminas sobre las losas de una plaza, co: You walk on the paving stones of a square, with the other foot.
You walk on the paving stones of a square.
textos.Caminas sobre los tablones de un muelle,: You walk on the planks of a pier, with the other foot.
You walk on the planks of a pier.
textos.Caminas solo hacia {nombre}. Mantén Mayú: You walk alone toward {nombre}. Hold Shift to run. Any arrow key stops you.
textos.Camináis despacio, del brazo. {n} saluda: You walk slowly, arm in arm. {n} greets half the neighborhood.
textos.Camisa blanca, pantalón negro y delantal: White shirt, black trousers and a long apron.
textos.Camisas de lino y trajes claros, como se: Linen shirts and light suits, as worn on the promenade.
textos.Campaña de tráfico: este mes, más contro: Traffic campaign: this month, more speed checks.
Text field. Type the value here.

Nearby... I'd rather not say where.
Baskets of bread. It's still warm.

Body work, paint and lowered suspensions. This is where the cars cruising Las Palmeras are made.
textos.Chaqueta y pantalón a juego, camisa plan: Matching jacket and trousers, pressed shirt.

Clear skies across the whole region.
textos.Cien balas por cinta. Poca puntería y mu: One hundred bullets per belt. Poor aim and a whole lot of lead.
textos.Cien puntos de blindaje que absorben los: One hundred armor points that absorb damage before your health does.

textos.Cierra el juego. Entra en la carpeta dat: Close the game. Go to the data folder, logs, and find the folder of the session in which it failed: it has the date and time in its name. Compress it into a ZIP: in Explorer, context menu, Send to, Compressed folder. Send it, telling what you were doing, through the project's issues page on GitHub, or on Mastodon, to at HXeBoLaX at comunidad dot nvda dot es.
textos.Cierra el panel. Si el servidor está en: Closes the panel. If the server is running, it stops it first.
textos.Cierra el puño. ¿Cuántas monedas esconde: Close your fist. How many coins do you hide?
textos.Cierra la ventana sin guardar los cambio: Closes the window without saving the changes.
textos.Cierra las opciones. También sirve Escap: Closes the options. Escape also works.
textos.Cierras el trato por esa cifra, la de ah: You close the deal for that figure, the current one, even if it changed when haggling.
textos.Cierras la cartera sin contar los billet: You close the wallet without counting the bills twice.
textos.Cierre de la bolsa: tu cartera vale {val: Market close: your portfolio is worth {valor} euros. Compared with yesterday: {cambio}. In total, {balance}.
textos.Cierro la partida unos minutos para actu: I'm closing the game for a few minutes to update it. When it opens again, come back in.
textos.Cinco cartuchos, y entre uno y otro se o: Five shells, and you can hear the pump between shots. Hits harder and reaches farther than the sawed-off, and is slower than the combat shotgun. Second-hand, at the pawn shops.
textos.Cinco empresas de la comarca. Los precio: Five companies from the region. Prices change every midnight.
textos.Cinco exactamente. Me encanta la gente c: Five exactly. I love people with statistical intuition.
textos.Cine al aire libre con sillas de tijera: Open-air cinema with folding chairs and the smell of the sea.
textos.Cipreses, silencio y la tumba de tu padr: Cypresses, silence and the grave of your father, who was a taxi driver in this city for thirty years.
textos.Citas que hacen falta para saber qué est: Dates needed to learn what style they like
textos.Claro que sí, {tu}. Eres de los pocos de: Of course, {tu}. You're one of the few trustworthy ones left.
Of course. Tell me what you need.
textos.Clases de conducción con un profesor de: Driving lessons with a teacher of steel nerves.

textos.Clave guardada, cifrada, en la carpeta d: Key saved, encrypted, in the settings folder.
textos.Cliente contento, Gordo contento. Tu par: Happy customer, happy Gordo. Here's your cut. And a free piece of advice: don't use what you sell. I've seen a lot of people end badly.
textos.Club nocturno: bailar en la pista, conte: Nightclub: dance on the floor, adult content

textos.Club nocturno: pagar por compañía, conte: Nightclub: pay for company, adult content
textos.Club nocturno: ver el espectáculo, conte: Nightclub: watch the show, adult content
textos.Cobra en la Discoteca Erasmus, en la Mar: Collect at Erasmus Nightclub, La Marina Seafood Restaurant and La Suerte Bingo Hall, in that order.
textos.Cobrar los 100 euros y seguir tu camino: Take the 100 euros and go on your way
textos.Cobras bien, y en Peñas Altas nadie sabr: You get paid well, and in Peñas Altas nobody will ever know what was there.
textos.Cobras lo que ofrecen y durante siete dí: You collect what they offer and for seven days nobody attacks your neighborhoods. That gang respects you a little more.
textos.Cobras por callar, y trescientos euros m: You get paid for keeping quiet, and three hundred euros more every midnight, forever. The water will stay just as expensive.
textos.Cobras veinte mil euros ahora. Pierdes f: You get twenty thousand euros now. You lose street reputation, and the reporter will never trust you again.
textos.Cobras, y el portero se queda sin saberl: You get paid, and the doorman never finds out.
textos.Cobras, y la boticaria se queda con medi: You get paid, and the pharmacist is left with half the truth.
textos.Cobras. Un favor que se cobra ya no es u: You collect. A favor that gets paid is no longer a favor.
Car hooked up. Take it to {nombre}.
textos.Coche entregado en el depósito: Car delivered to the impound lot
textos.Cocheras del transporte público y de los: Depots for public transport and the industrial estate's truck drivers.
textos.Coches de segunda mano y los buggies de: Used cars and the beach buggies.
textos.Coches nuevos, brillantes, con olor a ta: New, shiny cars with that upholstery smell.
textos.Coches patrulla del servidor que rondan: Server patrol cars that roam each town with players. With 0, none.

textos.Coches rebajados, rancheras, motos de mo: Lowered cars, station wagons, dirt bikes and convertibles.
Mountain stew in portions for three.
textos.Cocina de autor a precios de atraco. Eso: Chef's cuisine at robbery prices. Still, you leave feeling brand new.
textos.Cocina equipada: tanto por ciento de sal: Equipped kitchen: extra percent of health
textos.Cocina equipada: tanto por ciento menos: Equipped kitchen: percent fewer burned dishes
textos.Cocina nueva, con horno, y una nevera gr: New kitchen, with an oven, and a big full fridge.
textos.Cocina para los dos o, a veces, te toca: Cooks for both of you or, sometimes, it's your turn. Gives health and takes away hunger and thirst from realistic life. Once a day.
You cook in the pot: the water bubbling.
textos.Cocinas a la sartén: el aceite chisporro: You cook in the frying pan: the oil sizzling.
textos.Cocinas tú. {n} dice que está rico y rep: You cook. {n} says it's delicious and has seconds, which is what counts.
textos.Coge el fardo antes que ellos y síguelos: Grab the bundle before they do and follow them to their hideout. I'd bet my boat it's on Isla Tortuga.
textos.Coge el tractor con el remolque en la Co: Take the tractor with the trailer at the Cooperative and bring it to the Repair Shop in one piece, because a wheel has to be changed before loading.
textos.Coge la carretera en un vehículo: Take the road in a vehicle
textos.Coge la mercancía de los armarios de tus: Take the product from the wardrobes of your homes. With no product stored, there's nothing to sell.
Take what you need. Nobody saves today.
Take a car. You won't make it on foot.
textos.Coge un vehículo si tienes. A pie no lle: Take a vehicle if you have one. You won't make it on foot.
textos.Coges carrera: mantén flecha arriba hast: You pick up speed: hold the up arrow until it lifts off.
textos.Coges los libros y la tarjeta. Remedios: You take the books and the card. Remedios nods slowly.
Grabbing the keys and heading over.

textos.Coloca la segunda antena en el Bingo La: Place the second antenna at La Suerte Bingo Hall.

textos.Combustible. Cada aparato tiene su depós: Fuel. Each aircraft has its own tank: a helicopter flies about {int} kilometers and a plane about {int2}. You refuel with Enter at a heliport, an airport or an airfield. The game warns you when you reach the reserve and when very little is left. If it runs out, the engine stops and you glide as far as you can. It can be turned off in Options.
textos.Combustible: los vehículos gastan y hay: Fuel: vehicles use it up and you have to refuel
textos.Come algo caliente y duerme. Lo demás pu: Eat something hot and get some sleep. The rest can wait.
They say it's going to rain all week.
textos.Comer algo rápido de lo que haya por cas: Eat a quick bite of whatever is around the house
textos.Comer, beber, cocinar en casa y que llam: Eating, drinking, cooking at home and someone knocking at the door.
textos.Comercios, oficinas, la comisaría y el h: Shops, offices, the police station and the hospital. There is always traffic and people.
You eat right away and recover that much health. With full health you don't eat, unless you are hungry with realistic life.
You eat something: you regain strength.
textos.Comes, bailas y te sube el ánimo. No cob: You eat, you dance and your mood goes up. You don't get paid.

textos.Comida y compra que llevas: {_total} de: Food and groceries you are carrying: {_total} of {entero}
textos.Como en la misión: varias decisiones a l: As in the mission: several decisions at once, each as a name, a colon and an option number, separated by commas. For example: concejal:2, cooperativa:2. This lets one branch of the story remember what you decided in another.
textos.Como lo anuncia el tablón: Objetivo a la: As the board announces it: Target on the run.
textos.Como lo dice el juego al llegar al pasil: As the game says it when you reach the aisle, in lowercase with the article in front: the produce section, the frozen foods.
textos.Como lo dice el juego, y como se escribe: As the game says it, and as it is written in a neighborhood's Gang field: Los Calaveras.
textos.Como lo dice el juego. Al comprarla dirá: As the game says it. When you buy it, it will say: You leave with, and the name.
textos.Como lo dice el juego: Zapatillas de cor: As the game says it: Running shoes, High heels.
textos.Como lo dice la persona: camarero, en pa: As the person says it: waiter, unemployed.
How the game will say it.
textos.Como los demás delitos: con 1 o más cae: Like the other crimes: with 1 or more, the first wanted level drops. With zero, there is no crime.
textos.Como sale en el menú de preparar el golp: As it appears in the heist preparation menu.
textos.Como se dice en una frase: un reloj de p: As said in a sentence: a wristwatch, a gold chain.
textos.Como siempre: mucho trabajo y poco sueld: Same as always: lots of work and little pay.
Keep this up and you'll get to know them.
textos.Como un rey. ¿No se me nota?: Like a king. Can't you tell?
textos.Compartís el postre. {n} se queda con la: You share the dessert. {n} gets the last spoonful.
textos.Compartís un algodón de azúcar que se os: You share cotton candy that sticks to everything.
textos.Completa la frase «Eres una persona...»,: Completes the sentence "You are a person who is...", in the feminine: kind and friendly, dry, of few words.
textos.Completa la frase «Te habla...»: amable,: Completes the sentence "They talk to you...": kindly, cockily, tersely.
textos.Completa: al disparar se apunta sola al: Full: when you shoot, it aims by itself at the nearest enemy within your range. Manual: you have to be facing the enemy to hit them.
textos.Completar un servicio de ese trabajo: Complete one service of that job

textos.Compra las armas que hayas pagado y lo q: They buy the weapons you've paid for and the valuables you carry in your backpack. Right now you have none of that.
Buy a lottery ticket. Dreaming is free.
textos.Compran cualquier cosa, sobre todo si es: They buy anything, especially if it is of dubious origin.
textos.Compran el pescado al peso y pagan al mo: They buy fish by weight and pay on the spot.
They buy fresh fish at a good price.
textos.Compran vehículos de cualquier procedenc: They buy vehicles from any source.
textos.Comprar boletos para el sorteo de las nu: Buy tickets for the nine o'clock draw at night, check them and collect small prizes.
textos.Comprar con hipoteca: {entrada} euros de: Buy with a mortgage: {entrada} euros down and {n} payments of {cuota}

textos.Comprar un barrio: no venden: Buy a neighborhood: not for sale
textos.Comprar un barrio: ponen precio: Buy a neighborhood: they name a price

Buying, getting paid and picking things up.
textos.Compras fichas con efectivo, juegas poco: You buy chips with cash, play a little and collect your winnings. {entero} percent is lost along the way, and here no more than {entero2} euros a day can be laundered
textos.Compras {cant} euros en fichas, juegas u: You buy {cant} euros of chips, play a little so it looks right and cash the rest out as winnings, with the paperwork. You lost {perdida} along the way, but {v} euros now have an explanation.

You buy {n} shares for {precio} euros. You have {v}.
textos.Compras {n} de {lower} por {v} euros. Ll: You buy {n} of {lower} for {v} euros. You have {v2}.
I buy just what I need.
textos.Comprobar los datos del juego de quien e: Check the game data of whoever comes in
textos.Comprobar y cobrar tus boletos: tienes {: Check and collect your tickets: you have {len} already drawn
textos.Comprueba el estado y muestra el resulta: Checks the status and shows the result, without changing anything.
Check it to find out whether it has won. It expires {CADUCA} days after the draw.
textos.Comprársela por {oferta} euros: Buy it from her for {oferta} euros
textos.Comprárselo por {oferta} euros: Buy it from him for {oferta} euros
textos.Coméis pipas mirando a los que pescan de: You eat sunflower seeds watching the people fishing from the breakwater.
textos.Con 0.0.0.0 escucha en todas las conexio: With 0.0.0.0 it listens on all the computer's connections, which is the usual. With 127.0.0.1 you can only come in from this same computer. The address of just one of your network connections also works.
textos.Con 100, el precio de cada producto; con: With 100, the price of each product; with 130, thirty percent more expensive; with 90, ten percent cheaper.
textos.Con 100, lo cocinado da el doble de salu: With 100, cooked food gives double the health.
textos.Con 12, cuarenta kilómetros en helicópte: With 12, forty kilometers by helicopter is a little over a minute.
textos.Con 20, un coche caro aparca cinco veces: With 20, an expensive car parks five times less often than a normal one in the same neighborhood. With 100, the same as the others; with 0, never.
With 3 it appears three times as often as one with 1.
textos.Con 50 y un 60 de nervios, la caja tarda: With 50 and 60 nerves, the safe takes 30 percent less.
textos.Con Belmonte esta ciudad ya no es lo que: With Belmonte, this city is not what it used to be.
With Ctrl G you get it back.
textos.Con El Caimán detenido, su negocio en Sa: With El Caimán arrested, his business in San Lucero has no owner. Someone has to decide what happens to it.
textos.Con F subes a un vehículo. En conducción: With F you get into a vehicle. In assisted driving the car follows its lane by itself: you accelerate with up arrow, brake with down arrow and, before each intersection, press left or right if you want to turn. A beep warns you of cars ahead of you.
Get out with F, and [he|she] waits for you.
textos.Con Intro eliges qué hacer con ello: com: With Enter you choose what to do with it: eat it, if it is eaten as it is, carry one with you or throw it away.
textos.Con abogado, tanto por ciento de lo que: With a lawyer, percent of how much the rumor rises
textos.Con algo de fama en la calle o con escol: With some street reputation or an escort, they think twice and leave you alone.
textos.Con alguien que valga 100 es un cuarto m: With someone rated 100 it is a quarter more; with someone rated 0, half.
textos.Con amigos conectados no se puede frenar: You can't slow down time with friends connected.
textos.Con antecedentes graves en vigor no te c: With a serious criminal record in force, nobody will give you a permanent job.
textos.Con antecedentes graves en vigor, el ban: With a serious criminal record in force, the bank won't lend to you.
textos.Con auto, el servidor crea su propio cer: With auto, the server creates its own certificate the first time it starts and encrypts; there is nothing to install.
textos.Con cebolla. Cuatro raciones, y fría est: With onion. Four servings, and it's just as good cold.
textos.Con cero, el nivel de búsqueda cae al mo: With zero, the wanted level drops instantly. With more, the player has that long to get away before they start looking for them.
With zero, they always pick the same one.
textos.Con cero, la denuncia se dice pero no cu: With zero, the report is spoken but does not count.
With zero, they are not said.
With zero, they don't keep it for you.
textos.Con cero, nunca. Lo que reparte cada emp: With zero, never. What each company delivers is on its own sheet.
textos.Con cero, nunca. Una plaza con aeronaves: With zero, never. A space with aircraft inside is not removed.
textos.Con cero, se coge al momento. Con más, a: With zero, it is taken instantly. With more, pressing Enter starts it opening, you hear it progress and the player has to stay beside it until it gives. Works for safes, cameras and locks.
With zero, only the same day.
textos.Con chaleco. De los que se hacen a medid: With a vest. The tailor-made kind.
textos.Con contrato, al acabar cada periodo te: With a contract, at the end of each period you're evaluated on the shifts you've worked and how well you did them, and you're paid according to the grade. With {entero} warnings you're fired.
textos.Con defensa propia encendida: sus miembr: With self-defense turned on: its members sometimes let you through, and knocking down someone who attacks you first does not bring a war.
textos.Con dinero negro, el banco solo admite c: With dirty money, the bank only accepts up to a certain amount each day without asking questions: above that, it asks for explanations, refuses the deposit and alerts the tax authorities. Depositing little by little, day by day, is one way to launder.
textos.Con el depósito lleno, {nombre} hace uno: With a full tank, {nombre} flies about {int} kilometers.
textos.Con el helicóptero de la policía encendi: With the police helicopter turned on, it rises to the level it starts with.
textos.Con el mando: cruceta arriba y abajo rec: With the gamepad: D-pad up and down cycle through the letters, D-pad right types the chosen letter and D-pad left deletes the last one. {n} adds a space. {n2} switches between lowercase, uppercase, numbers and symbols.
textos.Con el modo IA activado en Opciones, la: With AI mode turned on in Options, the person answers with total freedom to whatever you write.
With AI mode, they answer freely.
textos.Con el modo IA, cuando escribes lo que q: With AI mode, when you type what you want to say to someone with the J key, an artificial intelligence answers playing that person, and never answers the same way twice. Without AI mode, the game uses its own conversation engine, offline.
textos.Con el motor clásico, el juego prepara e: With the classic engine, the game prepares the sound in larger chunks. Sounds arrive a few hundredths of a second later, but clicks, dropouts and stuttering stop on low-powered computers or ones with delicate sound cards. Try it if the audio stutters; another fix is the surround engine. The change applies when you close and reopen the game.
textos.Con el motor de sonido envolvente, se le: With the surround sound engine, you hear it from above.
textos.Con el motor envolvente, los sonidos del: With the surround engine, world sounds carry the echo of the place you are in: little in the countryside and on the beach, some in the street, more among warehouses, long in the mountains and short and close inside a building. Also, things that fly sound overhead, and if you fly, the city sounds below you. With the classic engine this option does nothing.
textos.Con el nivel de búsqueda más alto, el he: At the highest wanted level, the police helicopter: you hear it arrive and circle overhead.
textos.Con el nombre a cien da ese tanto más; c: With the business name rating at one hundred it gives that much more; with it at zero, that much less.
textos.Con el plan como está. Hace falta que al: With the plan as it is. At least one of your people needs a role.
textos.Con el vehículo parado, estando en él o: With the vehicle stopped, while in it or next to it. It takes a quarter of an hour. Spare tires are bought at repair shops and gas stations.
textos.Con el vuelo real. Con sí, cada aparato: With real flight. With yes, each aircraft has its own tank, which is filled at heliports, airports and airfields; the game warns you at reserve, and if it runs out, the engine stops and you glide. With no, the tank is never used up.
textos.Con ella puedes hacer vuelos comerciales: With it you can fly commercial passenger and cargo flights from heliports, airports and airfields.
textos.Con ese libro, no le salva ni el Papa. P: With that book, not even the Pope can save him. But his house is full of guards.
With this humidity, not even the laundry dries.
With this rain, nobody's going out.
textos.Con estas escrituras la mina pasa a la c: With these deeds the mine passes to the workers' cooperative. The company is finished and so is Belmonte in Monteferro.
textos.Con este aparato no hay ningún destino a: With this aircraft there's no destination to fly to from here.
textos.Con este golpe rompes la tregua con {ban: With this hit you break the truce with {banda}. They won't forget it.
textos.Con este nivel no caben más de {hon_max_: At this level you can't have more than {hon_max_empleados}. Improve the business to hire more.
textos.Con esto cae Belmonte. Pero mientras Var: With this, Belmonte falls. But as long as Varela is at the police station, no judge will see these papers. We have to go after the chief.
textos.Con esto comen cuarenta familias. Gracia: Forty families will eat with this. Thank you, truly.
textos.Con esto devolvemos a cada tendero lo qu: With this we give every shopkeeper back what was taken from them, and there's still some left for you. Now El Caimán will come out of his hole. Stay alert.
textos.Con esto el electricista del pueblo nos: With this the town electrician can fix our line tonight.
textos.Con esto que me trae, a usted le cae una: With what you've brought me, you get a fine and they get ten years. If I were you, I'd sleep tonight. It's about time.
textos.Con esto y lo que llevas puedes cocinar:: With this and what you are carrying, you can cook: {lower}
textos.Con esto, lo de {barrio} se les ha acaba: With this, the {barrio} business is over for them before it started.
textos.Con esto, tu antecedente más grave queda: With this, your most serious record entry is cancelled.
With experience, it sells a bit more.
textos.Con gente de tu banda al lado, cada uno: With people from your gang beside you, each one plays a part: driver with the engine running, lookout who distracts the police, escort who keeps people in check, the one on the cash box and a shooter for the getaway. The cash box takes time to open and each one takes their share. Inside, the first option explains it. The usual robbery stays under its own option.
textos.Con hambre avisa gimiendo, y sin fuerzas: When hungry it warns you by whining, and with no strength it doesn't search. If it is afraid of you, it follows from a distance and neither warns you of enemies nor searches.
textos.Con horario ampliado da un {entero} por: With extended hours it earns {entero} percent more, but you need at least one employee.
textos.Con horario ampliado, lo que gana de más: With extended hours, how much more it earns, percent
textos.Con horarios, hora a la que llega a su s: With schedules, the time they arrive at their place
With schedules, the time someone without a fixed place arrives
textos.Con la ayuda, el juego dice cada giro de: With help, the game announces each turn of the one fleeing.
textos.Con la cantidad, si quieres: Tomates, un: With the quantity, if you like: Tomatoes, one kilo.
textos.Con la capucha puesta, nadie te mira dos: With the hood up, nobody looks at you twice.
textos.Con la conexión cifrada, nadie que esté: With an encrypted connection, nobody between you and the server can read what you send each other.
textos.Con la gente que sois no podéis sostener: There are not enough of you to hold more neighborhoods. You need a bigger gang.
textos.Con la marea de esta semana asoma un anc: With this week's tide an anchor is poking out at the reef. One of the old ones, wrought iron.
textos.Con la opción Ayuda en las persecuciones: With the Chase help option turned on.
textos.Con la opción de combustible activada, a: With the fuel option on, you can refuel here without leaving the vehicle and buy jerry cans. Put at least one in every town with cars.
textos.Con la opción de soltar armas, de cada c: With the drop weapons option, out of every hundred, how many drop it
textos.Con la policía buscándote así, ningún re: With the police after you like this, no delivery person comes near your door.
textos.Con la policía buscándote no acude nadie: With the police after you, nobody shows up: shake them first.
textos.Con la policía buscándote no hay boda qu: With the police after you, there's no wedding.
textos.Con la policía buscándote no puedes entr: With the police after you, you cannot go on duty.
textos.Con la policía buscándote no puedes sent: With the police after you, you can't sit in class.
textos.Con la policía buscándote no te contrata: With the police after you, nobody will hire you.
textos.Con la policía buscándote, la compañía n: With the police looking for you, the company won't even let you near the runway.
textos.Con la policía buscándote, la grúa no se: With the police looking for you, the tow truck won't come near.
textos.Con la policía buscándote, lo de ingresa: With the police after you, joining the force is not happening.
With the police after you, no.
textos.Con la policía detrás no es momento de c: With the police on your tail, it's no time for dates.
textos.Con la policía detrás no es momento de e: With the police on your tail it's no time to start a war.
textos.Con la policía detrás no es momento de p: With the police on your tail, this is no time for plans.
With the police on your tail, it's not the time.
textos.Con la policía detrás o enemigos cerca: With the police on your tail or enemies nearby
textos.Con la policía detrás se acabó el trabaj: With the police on your tail, the job is over.
textos.Con la policía detrás, la compañía te qu: With the police on your tail, the company pulls you off the flight.
With the police on your tail, better another day.
textos.Con la policía detrás, nadie se sienta c: With the police on your tail, nobody sits down to talk with you.
textos.Con la policía detrás, {nombre} prefiere: With the police on your tail, {nombre} would rather leave it for another day.
textos.Con la portada en la calle, Braulio Seis: With the front page on the street, Braulio Seisdedos packs his bags.
textos.Con la tecla J haces la línea: cinco par: With the J key you run the line: five stops, and the more punctual you are, the better you get paid.
textos.Con la tecla J haces la ruta del helader: With the J key you run the ice cream route. The horn is a little jingle.
textos.Con la tecla J recoges heridos y los lle: With the J key you pick up injured people and rush them to the hospital against the clock.
textos.Con la vida realista, aquí se bebe grati: With realistic life, you can drink here for free: its menu shows Drink water from the fountain. It works for parks, squares, promenades or any place.
textos.Con las armas de fuego no hace falta ace: With firearms you don't need to get so close, but the closer you are, the more you hit. The comma switches to the next weapon, and the I key opens the list of your weapons.
textos.Con las flechas izquierda y derecha elig: With the left and right arrows you choose where versions are looked up and downloaded from: the game server, GitHub, both, or an address you type. With both, the newest version is used and, if one fails, the other. Wherever it comes from, only a version signed by whoever publishes the game is installed.
textos.Con las manos vacías no impones. Saca un: Empty-handed, you do not scare anyone. Draw a weapon.
textos.Con las rebajas, la gente compra lo que: With the sales, people buy what they don't need.
textos.Con licencia, escaparate y precios de ci: Licensed, with a shop window and city prices.
textos.Con lluvia, el doble. Como mucho, una po: In rain, double. At most, one per crossing.
textos.Con lo que cuesta hoy una barra de pan,: For what a loaf of bread costs today, a whole family used to eat.
textos.Con lo que hay no sale ninguna receta: There is no recipe you can make with what is here
textos.Con lo que llevas encima, sale más caro: With what you are carrying, it costs more than a fine and is harder
textos.Con lo que queda se decide cuántos viene: What is left decides how many come.
textos.Con lo recogido alcanza para dos de las: What was collected is enough for two of the four fountains. They turn them on that very afternoon, without any television.
textos.Con los libros no basta: necesito al con: The books aren't enough: I need the accountant to testify. He's hiding at the Grand Hotel San Lucero and doesn't trust my officers.
textos.Con los semáforos que han puesto, ya no: With the traffic lights they've put in, nobody can get across the city anymore.
textos.Con los turistas hablo por señas. Y me e: I talk to the tourists with signs. And they understand me.
textos.Con mala fama o antecedentes, en el nive: With a bad street reputation or a criminal record, at the normal or demanding level, if an officer is nearby.
textos.Con menos de 10 de prestigio, en el nive: With less than 10 standing, at the normal level.
textos.Con mucha hambre, mucha sed u oliendo ma: When very hungry, very thirsty or smelling bad, how many game minutes between each mood drop
textos.Con mucho valor, se te encara si le insu: With lots of courage, they confront you if you insult them and shout for help if you threaten them; with little, they flee or drop the money.
With a higher level you hit more often.
textos.Con más nivel corres más deprisa y te ha: With a higher level you run faster and take a little less damage.
textos.Con más nivel de búsqueda que este, ni e: With a wanted level above this, neither the driver nor the mechanic comes near.
textos.Con más nivel el vehículo corre algo más: With a higher level the vehicle goes a bit faster and takes less damage in crashes.
textos.Con más nivel pican antes y el pescado v: With a higher level the fish bite sooner and are worth more.
textos.Con nivel {n}: {multa} euros de multa, {: At level {n}: {multa} euros in fines, {horas} hours in a cell and you lose your firearms
textos.Con no, los de la banda no os podéis her: With no, gang members can't hurt each other.
textos.Con no, los jugadores no pueden herirse,: With no, players cannot hurt, rob or steal from each other.
textos.Con no, que es lo de siempre, los barrio: With no, which is the usual way, neighborhoods are conquered and defended from the phone, in Territories. With yes, every neighborhood in the cities belongs to a gang and its members walk its streets. A neighborhood is conquered by going there: when you take down two of theirs, or confront them from the phone once you are inside, the gang comes for you in three waves. Your own gang comes to help. You must not leave the neighborhood until it is over. And when a neighborhood of yours is attacked, you defend it by going into it. On an online server it doesn't apply: there, neighborhoods belong to the players' gangs.
textos.Con no, que es lo normal, lo que escriba: With no, which is normal, what you write in each list is added to what the game already has. With yes, each list you fill in replaces the game's list; the ones you leave empty stay as the game's.
textos.Con no, quien entra juega sin el conteni: With no, whoever comes in plays without adult content even if they have it turned on in their game.
textos.Con nombres: quién cobra, quién paga y q: With names: who collects, who pays and who is going to end up with the premises
textos.Con olor a naranja. Mejora las noches tr: Orange scented. It improves quiet nights and massages.
textos.Con poco se puede ser feliz, te lo digo: You can be happy with little, I'm telling you.
textos.Con poco, se quitan las frases que solo: With little, the sentences that only remind you which key to press are removed. With a lot, menus also read the explanation of each option, without pressing F1. Normal is the usual.
textos.Con precios altos, lo que baja el nombre: With high prices, how much the business name rating drops each day
textos.Con precios altos, lo que gana de más, p: With high prices, how much more it earns, percent
textos.Con precios bajos, lo que pierde de ingr: With low prices, how much income it loses, percent
textos.Con precios bajos, lo que sube el nombre: With low prices, how much the business name rating rises each day
textos.Con prudencia: defender a los comerciant: Carefully: defend the merchants without singling anyone out
textos.Con que no haga mucho viento, yo content: As long as there isn't much wind, I'm happy.
textos.Con quién has quedado, dónde y a qué hor: Who you've arranged to meet, where and at what time. Enter marks the place on the GPS; you can also cancel it.
textos.Con qué vehículo espera el conductor: Which vehicle the driver waits in
Which voice the game speaks with.
textos.Con responsabilidad: trae decisiones que: With responsibility: brings decisions that count in the evaluation
textos.Con ropa elegante, cuánto más vendes en: With elegant clothes, how much more you sell at the car dealership, in points per hundred
textos.Con si, a quien tiene buen nombre entre: With si, shops give a small discount to those with a good name among the neighbors, and charge extra to those with a very bad one, as when playing offline on the soft level. Only players with version 1.7.1 or later notice it. With no, everyone pays the same.
textos.Con si, cada jugador puede ponerse en mo: With si, each player can switch to passive mode: they neither hurt other players nor get hurt.
textos.Con si, el registro anota la dirección d: With si, the log records the network address of each connection and the panel shows it. By default, no: the server keeps no personal data.
textos.Con si, el servidor lleva la cuenta del: With si, the server keeps track of each player's money and does not accept what it cannot justify.
textos.Con si, el servidor mira si el mundo que: With si, the server checks whether the world the incoming player's game brings is its own, that of another real version, or one changed with mods, and acts according to the following options. With no, it checks nothing: anyone comes in with whatever they bring, and the server does not catch up with the world of new versions.
textos.Con si, en hospitales, comisarías, casas: With si, nobody can hurt anybody in hospitals, police stations, houses and inside venues.
textos.Con si, la búsqueda, la persecución y la: With si, the wanted level, the chase and the arrest are run by the server, and everyone nearby sees and hears them. With no, each player's game runs them.
textos.Con si, la primera cuenta que se crea en: With si, the first account created on the server is an admin: normally that is you.
textos.Con si, lo que va diciendo el servidor s: With si, what the server says is also written to registro.txt, inside the data folder.
textos.Con si, los coches que circulan los llev: With si, the cars on the road are run by the server and are the same for everyone. With no, each player sees their own traffic.
textos.Con si, los jugadores tienen un canal pa: With si, players have a channel to talk in character, heard only by those nearby, another to talk out of character, heard by the whole server, a command to describe what their character does and a profile line others can read. With no, only the usual chat remains.
textos.Con si, los peatones los lleva el servid: With si, pedestrians are run by the server and are the same for everyone.
textos.Con si, quien está cerca del vehículo de: With si, whoever is near another player's vehicle hears, faintly, the game radio station they have on. Only which game station it is gets shared: no music or anything personal ever travels. With no, nobody's radio is heard.
textos.Con si, quien firma un contrato fijo en: With si, whoever signs a permanent contract at the job center gets their paycheck at the end of each period. The server pays it: it counts the shifts and sets the amount, which comes from the game data and does not use up the hourly earnings. With no, there are no permanent contracts on this server. The server's world must be from version 1.7.1 or later.
textos.Con su firma puedo poner una patrulla en: With your signature I can put a patrol on that street. I won't promise they won't try again, but it won't be free for them anymore.
textos.Con suficientes evaluaciones buenas asci: With enough good evaluations you get promoted, if you meet what the position requires. With a demanding boss a good grade is harder to get, and with a patient one, easier.
textos.Con sí, a pie suena un toque al llegar a: With yes, on foot a tone plays when you reach a crossing and it says where you are; at the wheel it warns you of the coming crossing and which street it is with. With no, crossings are not announced.
textos.Con sí, al acercarte al campo de destino: With yes, as you approach the destination field the aircraft descends and lines up by itself, even if you fly by hand. With no, you do it yourself: you descend to the altitude the tower says and keep the alignment clicks centered; if you come in high or crooked, the tower sends you around again, and on the second try it guides you in. It can also be changed during the flight, in the flight menu.
textos.Con sí, al acercarte el aparato baja y s: With yes, as you approach, the aircraft descends and lines up on its own. With no, and without autopilot, you do it yourself: descend to the altitude the tower tells you and keep the clicks in the center. If you come in too high or crooked, the tower sends you around again; the second time, it guides you in.
textos.Con sí, al coger un taxi o un autobús se: With yes, when you take a taxi or a bus you hear the ride for a while: the engine, the road and the radio. It lasts between twelve seconds and a minute depending on the distance, and with Enter you arrive right away. With no, you arrive instantly.
textos.Con sí, al completarla sube el prestigio: With yes, completing it raises your standing with the neighbors, not your street reputation; and it does not start by itself on reaching its place: it appears as the last option on that place's menu, or you are asked if the place has no menu.
textos.Con sí, al llegar a la puerta de un luga: With yes, when you reach the door of a place it says which one it is and, if a mission starts there, that you can start it with Enter. With no, nothing is said when you arrive.
textos.Con sí, al llegar al nivel 5 acude un he: With yes, at level 5 a helicopter shows up: you hear it arrive and circle above you, and it talks to you over the loudspeaker. While it has you located you can't shake the police. It loses you if you hug a wall for a few seconds or go into a building, and it doesn't recognize you if you change vehicles without it seeing you. It can be shot down with a rifle or an explosive, but then the police take twice as long to forget you and you pay for the helicopter when arrested. It makes level 5 quite a bit harder: that is why it comes turned off. On a server with shared police it doesn't appear.
textos.Con sí, algún coche patrulla hace su ron: With yes, some patrol car does its rounds on the streets even if nobody is after you, as on online servers. They see the crimes you commit nearby, and with traffic rules on they are the ones who issue the fines. If you are attacked and one is nearby, it comes. With no, the police only appear when they are after you. On a server with shared police, the server runs them.
textos.Con sí, aunque el contenido para adultos: With yes, even if adult content is turned off, Love life appears on the phone: people to meet, dates, gifts, being partners, getting engaged, living together and a simple wedding. With no adult content at all. With no, relationships only exist with adult content turned on, as before.
textos.Con sí, cada detención y cada multa que: With yes, every arrest and every fine you pay an officer goes on your record, more serious the more you were wanted. A criminal record closes off positions of trust, joining the police and, if serious, loans; and every crime counts a bit more while you are on file. They expire by themselves: minor ones after {entero} days, medium ones after {entero2} and serious ones after {entero3}, and they can be reduced with community service or a lawyer. What you did before this version doesn't count. With no, nothing is recorded, as before.
textos.Con sí, cada vez que pasas a otro barrio: With yes, every time you move into another neighborhood its name is said. With no, it isn't said, and the N key tells you where you are whenever you want.
textos.Con sí, cada {entero} días te cobran la: With yes, every {entero} days you are charged for the electricity and water of your homes, their property tax and a tax on what your businesses have earned, and now and then an inspection visits one of them. The amounts are small, they are announced {entero2} days ahead, charged automatically and can be checked on the phone. If the money isn't there, it is owed with a surcharge; after {entero3} missed payments, part of what you earn is seized until it is settled, but nothing is ever taken from you all at once. A game already in progress gets {entero4} days of grace. With no, there are no bills, taxes or inspections, as before.
textos.Con sí, cerca del vehículo de otro jugad: With yes, near another player's vehicle you quietly hear the station they have on. You can turn it off in the game options.
textos.Con sí, cuando el servidor en el que jue: With yes, when the server you play on restarts to update, or the connection drops, the game doesn't send you back to the menu: it waits, with your game as it was, tries to rejoin every few seconds and, when the server is back, you carry on where you were: same place, same vehicle, same health, same weapons and same mission. It joins with your usual identity, without asking for anything. Escape stops waiting. With no, as before: you go back to the main menu and rejoin by hand.
textos.Con sí, cuando pasas la noche con alguie: With yes, when you spend the night with someone you decide what you do at each moment and the other person responds. Paying attention to what they want, and stopping if they ask you to, is what makes it go well. It is still told in a sensual way, without explicit scenes. With no, the night is told in a couple of sentences, as before.
textos.Con sí, cuando tienes cerca el vehículo: With yes, when another player's vehicle with a game station tuned in is near you, you hear it faint and muffled, from where their vehicle is, and it fades as you move away. It only plays if you don't have your own radio on, and only one at a time. Nobody's own music is ever heard: nothing from My music leaves your computer, only which game station you are tuned to is sent. With no, you don't hear anyone's radio; others still hear yours.
textos.Con sí, después de hablar contigo una pe: With yes, after talking to you a person may do something on their own, depending on their character and how much they trust you: come along with you for a while if they like you, punch you if you keep at it after offending them, or report you if you insult them. The game decides, without artificial intelligence. With no, people only talk, as before. Asking for a favor and asking someone to join your gang are always in the conversation, because you choose those.
textos.Con sí, el dinero del armario de esa cas: With yes, the money in that home's wardrobe is safe from thieves.
textos.Con sí, el juego habla con la voz de Win: With yes, the game speaks with the Windows voice, which is adjusted just below. With no, your screen reader speaks, and if you don't have one open, the Windows voice. It applies right away.
textos.Con sí, en esos sitios ningún jugador pu: With yes, in those places no player can hurt you and you can't hurt them.
textos.Con sí, en la ficha de tu pareja aparece: With yes, your partner's profile gets the option to ask them to move into one of your homes. Each person decides: some accept when the relationship is going well, and others won't leave their home for anyone. If they accept, you find them at home, they cook for both of you or ask you to cook, they ask you for things now and then and notice if you don't show up. You can ask them to leave. With no, which is the default, each of you stays in your own home. New plans as a couple don't depend on this option. Single-player only.
textos.Con sí, en las comisarías puedes ingresa: With yes, at police stations you can join the police and, once an officer, start a shift: you get a patrol car and the radio gives you alerts about robberies, fights, reckless drivers and chases. You resolve them by ordering a stop, slowing them down, arresting or fining, you get paid for each one and you get promoted. On duty, force against suspects is not a crime; any other crime costs you a reprimand or your badge. With no, which is the usual, none of this appears. Single-player only.
textos.Con sí, es la pista pequeña de un pueblo: With yes, it is a small village airstrip: commuter planes land and take off, not big jets, and only light planes can be rented. With no, it is a city airport.
textos.Con sí, las escenas de las misiones suen: With yes, the mission scenes play with a different voice for each character, instead of your screen reader reading them, and the text still goes to braille. They call you by the name of the character you play and speak to you in masculine or feminine, depending on what you chose. Any sentence without a voice is said by your screen reader. With no, everything is said by your screen reader or, if you don't use one, by the Windows voice.
textos.Con sí, las personas de tu vida social s: With yes, the people in your social life are dealt with face to face: a date, a gift in person, a kiss, the night or asking them out, where that person is, at your home if you live together, or while they are with you. From the phone you call, write, meet up somewhere at a set time, send a gift to their home, give money and break up. A date is lived by going to the place together. With no, everything is done from the phone, as before.
textos.Con sí, los jugadores pueden herirse y t: With yes, players can hurt and knock each other down, and whoever knocks someone down takes part of the money they were carrying.
textos.Con sí, mientras sigues un destino marca: With yes, while you follow a destination set on the GPS, the game tells you when and which way to turn. With no, it says nothing along the way and only the beacon guides you, if you have it on.
textos.Con sí, no contratan con antecedentes gr: With yes, they do not hire people with serious criminal records, and a new record can cost you the job.
textos.Con sí, no es una misión que se empiece: With yes, it is not a mission started at a place: it shows up on the phone, under Missions, with the word Briefing in front, and pressing Enter reads out the lines of all its dialogue steps in a row. The other steps do not count. When it reaches the end it is done and gives its reward.
textos.Con sí, que es lo normal, tumbar a los r: With yes, which is normal, knocking out rivals is not a crime and does not lower your standing with the neighbors. With no, it is an illegal fight: each rival who falls counts as an assault if someone sees it.
textos.Con sí, que es lo realista, tus balas y: With yes, which is the realistic setting, your bullets and explosives hurt them: the dog becomes afraid of you until you make peace, and your crew puts up with two warnings before turning on you. With no, they can't be aimed at or hurt, not even by accident.
textos.Con sí, si has puesto el movimiento en o: With yes, if you have set movement to other keys, menus can also be navigated with them. It helps, for example, if your screen reader takes over the arrow keys. When typing text the keys are always the normal ones. If you get confused, Reset the original keys puts everything back.
textos.Con sí, si la localidad no trae paradas: With yes, if the town has no tram stops, train station, airport or airfield, the game adds them when loading it. With no, the town has only what you put in it.
textos.Con sí, si un atracador, un pandillero o: With yes, if a robber, a thug or anyone attacks you without you having touched them first, shooting or knocking them down doesn't count as a crime, nor does stopping the people in a street event. Also, if officers are nearby or a patrol arrives, they go after them too and not only you. It doesn't apply to mission enemies or to anyone you attacked first, and explosives are still a crime. With no, everything is as before: any shot and any casualty counts.
textos.Con sí, solo aterriza bien en un aeropue: With yes, it only lands properly at an airport or an airfield; anywhere else it is a forced landing. With no, it sets down in any open space, like a helicopter.
textos.Con sí, un enemigo caído deja a veces en: With yes, a fallen enemy sometimes drops the weapon they carried on the ground, if you don't have it: you pick it up as you walk over it. It makes the game easier and the gun shop less necessary, which is why it comes turned off. On an online server it doesn't apply.
textos.Con sí, un enemigo que llevaba un arma d: With yes, an enemy who carried a firearm like one of yours sometimes drops ammo for that weapon on the ground. It is picked up by itself when you walk over it on foot, like money, and a magazine sound plays. With no, they only drop money, as before.
textos.Con sí, un helicóptero o una avioneta de: With yes, a helicopter or a light plane takes off, has altitude, which you raise with D and lower with A, and lands with F; and when you fly out of a town, or with Enter at a heliport or an airport, you make a real crossing to another one, with heading, altitude, wind, tower and approach. There is an autopilot and you can speed up. With no, it is as before: you always fly at the same height and switch towns in a jump from a heliport. The full explanation is at any heliport or airport, in How flying works.
textos.Con sí, un rato después de un tiroteo o: With yes, a while after a shootout or a hit-and-run, an ambulance arrives with its siren, pulls up to the curb, the paramedics treat people and it leaves. It is ambience: it doesn't chase you, doesn't run you over and changes nothing. Single-player only.
textos.Con sí, una pulsación de Mayúsculas te p: With yes, one press of Shift makes you run and another brings you back to a walk, without holding it. With no, you run while you hold it down.
textos.Con sí, y si hay combate entre jugadores: With yes, and if there is combat between players, you can switch to passive mode from the Online menu: you don't hurt anyone and nobody hurts you.
textos.Con tal de que no sople levante, me conf: As long as the east wind doesn't blow, I'm satisfied.
textos.Con tan poca búsqueda es una detención c: With so little heat it is an ordinary arrest: you can settle it with a fine, if the option is turned on.
textos.Con tanta policía buscándote, nadie de l: With so many police looking for you, nobody from the gang will come near. Shake them off first.
textos.Con tanta policía buscándote, tu mecánic: With so many police looking for you, your mechanic won't come near.
textos.Con tener salud y a los míos cerca, ya e: As long as I have my health and my loved ones close, that's all I need.
textos.Con toda la práctica, platos de categorí: With full practice, extra top-quality dishes, out of every hundred
textos.Con toda la práctica, tanto por ciento m: With full practice, percent fewer burned dishes
textos.Con toda tu banda y dos guardaespaldas,: With your whole gang and two bodyguards, missions played themselves. With this option, when you arrive at a mission with people at your side, a few more enemies await you, tougher and better aimed, depending on how many you bring. The first of yours doesn't count, and there is a cap so no mission becomes impossible. Moderate, which is the default: at most half again as many enemies. Strong: at most double. No: the same ones always await you. It doesn't apply in tutorials or on an online server. The game warns you when the opposition goes up because of your escort.
textos.Con un arma de fuego en la mano. Es un d: With a firearm in your hand. It is a major crime: very high wanted level, a serious criminal record entry and the radar following you. It is explained inside.
textos.Con un arma en la mano. Salta la alarma,: With a weapon in hand. The alarm goes off, the warning reaches {dueno} and their gang, and you have to hold the door for twenty seconds, on foot and without moving away. If you manage it, you take the day's till, {ingresos} euros, which is deducted from them at midnight. Each business's till can only be emptied once a day.
textos.Con un contrato tienes jefe, turnos que: With a contract you have a boss, shifts to work, payroll, evaluations and promotions. Without a contract, everything stays as it always was
textos.Con un destino marcado en el GPS y en co: With a destination marked on the GPS and assisted driving, the car drives itself: it accelerates, brakes, turns, waits at traffic lights and stops on arrival. With any arrow key or Space, you take control. It also turns on with the Y key while driving.
textos.Con un mando conectado, lo que el juego: With a gamepad connected, what the game says while you play and what the tutorials and scenes explain name the button that does each thing: press the left trigger, instead of press Q. What belongs to a combination is said with it. What has no button is still said with its key, and is in the actions menu. With no gamepad connected nothing changes. The phrases that change are read by your screen reader, not the recorded voice.
textos.Con un mapa y un GPS se va a cualquier p: With a map and a GPS you can get anywhere.
textos.Con un taxi o una furgoneta te sacas un: With a taxi or a van you can earn a day's pay. Get in and get to work.
textos.Con un taxi puedes hacer carreras de pas: With a taxi you can do passenger fares by pressing the J key.
With a territory you can recruit people. They follow you, get into your vehicle and fight at your side. Each territory lets you support one more.
textos.Con una banda que te respeta, sus pandil: With a gang that respects you, its members don't attack you in the street and don't try to take neighborhoods from you. With one that's after you, the opposite happens. It changes with story decisions, with truces and every time you kill one of theirs.
With a fishing rod and patience, you eat dinner for free.
textos.Con uno o dos niveles de búsqueda y dine: With one or two wanted levels and enough money, when an officer catches you, you can pay the fine on the spot, try to bribe them or let yourself be arrested. With no, you are always arrested, as before.
textos.Con uno, ir con un solo acompañante no c: With one, having just one companion changes nothing.
textos.Con {len} territorios no puedes mantener: With {len} territories you can't support more than {cupo}.
With {len} territories you can't support more than {cupo}. Conquer another neighborhood.
textos.Con {nombre}, {dia} a las {_hora}, en {n: With {nombre}, {dia} at {_hora}, at {nombre_lugar}. Enter sets it on the GPS
textos.Con {n} a tu lado se ha corrido la voz:: With {n} at your side, word got around: they've reinforced the place.
textos.Con {n} se te pasa la hora volando. Al d: Time flies with {n}. As you say goodbye, they tell you some gossip.
textos.Con él lo eligen los grupos de enemigos: With it, enemy groups in missions, gangs, the police and shop cash registers are chosen. If it matches one from the game, it replaces it: for example officer, bodyguard, guard or gangster.
textos.Con él lo eligen los productos y los tip: With it, products and shop types are chosen. If it matches one from the game, it replaces it.
textos.Con él lo piden las recetas. Si coincide: With it, recipes ask for it. If it matches one from the game, it replaces it; if it is new, it is added to its aisle.
textos.Con él puedes ascender a conductor de pr: With it you can be promoted to senior driver and traffic chief.
textos.Con él puedes ascender a encargado y amp: With it you can be promoted to manager and expand your businesses.
textos.Con él puedes ascender a jefe de sala en: With it you can be promoted to head waiter in hospitality.
textos.Con él puedes ascender a jefe de sección: With it you can be promoted to department head in retail.
textos.Con él puedes ascender a oficial de prim: With it you can be promoted to senior technician and shop foreman.
textos.Con él puedes ascender a técnico y a jef: With it you can be promoted to technician and shift chief in emergency services.
textos.Con él puedes llegar a los puestos de di: With it you can reach management positions and take your businesses to the highest level.
textos.Concesionario de coches de lujo. En el e: Luxury car dealership. In the window shine sports cars that cost more than your whole neighborhood.
textos.Concesionario multimarca: del utilitario: Multi-brand dealership: from compact cars to sports cars.
{nombre} drives: you ride as a passenger.
textos.Conductor temerario: hay que darle el al: Reckless driver: you have to pull them over with the siren
textos.Conexiones a la vez desde una misma dire: Simultaneous connections from the same address
textos.Confianza con la que alguien puede acomp: Trust needed for someone to keep you company for a while
textos.Confianza necesaria para que te haga un: Trust needed for them to do you a favor
textos.Confianza que gana con un chiste que le: Trust gained from a joke they find funny
textos.Configuración guardada. Valdrá en cuanto: Settings saved. They will take effect as soon as you start the server.
textos.Conquista todos los barrios de las tres: Conquer every neighborhood in the three cities.

textos.Consecuencia: manda gente a por ti. Cuán: Consequence: sends people after you. How much it weighs
textos.Consecuencia: te sube los precios. Cuánt: Consequence: raises your prices. How much it weighs
textos.Conseguir un vehículo que aparece junto: Get a vehicle that appears next to a place
I sell advice, since I have none for myself.
Canned goods, tackle and first aid kits.
Counted from the day it is bought. Empty or zero, it never expires. Expired items are thrown out automatically when you open the fridge or pantry, with a warning.
textos.Contenido para adultos activado. En el m: Adult content turned on. On the phone, Social life and Substances appear, and in the cities there are nightclubs and suppliers. With Shift Z you open your substances.
textos.Contenido para adultos desactivado. Esos: Adult content turned off. Those places and options disappear from the game.
textos.Contenido para mayores de 18 años. Solo: Content for people over 18. Only used if the option is turned on. All characters are adults.
textos.Contestar y quedar para devolverlo: Answer and arrange to return it
textos.Contiene la versión del juego y de Windo: It contains the game and Windows versions, the screen reader, the sound, the mods, your game options, the screens you open, the keys you press while playing, what the game says, the state of the game every few seconds, and the errors. It contains nothing you type in text boxes, no chat messages, no passwords or keys, not your name or your friends' names, no internet addresses, not your Windows user name, not your folder paths, not the names of your music, and not your saved games. They are text files: you can read them before sending them.
textos.Contigo no quiero líos, que ya sé quién: I don't want any trouble with you, I know who you are.
textos.Contraseña de la partida. Si no tiene, p: Game password. If there isn't one, press Enter
textos.Contraseña para tu partida. Déjala vacía: Password for your game. Leave it empty to set none
textos.Contraseña puesta: solo entrará quien la: Password set: only those who know it can join.
textos.Contratado. Ahora hay {guardia} de guard: Hired. Now there are {guardia} on standing guard, at {coste} euros each every midnight. Neighborhood defense: {int} out of 100.
textos.Contratar a un abogado: {entero} euros a: Hire a lawyer: {entero} euros a week
textos.Contratar a un empleado. Tienes {emp} de: Hire an employee. You have {emp} of {hon_max_empleados}
textos.Contratar un guardaespaldas en una taber: Hire a bodyguard at a tavern
textos.Contratas a un abogado de confianza por: You hire a trusted lawyer for {euros} euros a week. As long as you pay, whatever comes out about you will do half the damage and he will handle the press.
textos.Contratas a una persona: cobra {sueldo}: You hire someone: they earn {sueldo} euros a day, paid from the till.
textos.Contrato cumplido. Vuelve a {nombre} a c: Contract fulfilled. Go back to {nombre} to get paid.
textos.Contratos fijos: carrera con jefe, nómin: Permanent contracts: a career with a boss, payroll and promotions.
textos.Contratos que hay que haber cumplido par: Contracts that must have been completed for it to appear
textos.Contribución de las viviendas, por cada: Property tax on homes, for every ten thousand euros of price
textos.Control Re Pág y Control Av Pág: Ctrl Page Up and Ctrl Page Down
textos.Control de {origen}: te veo salir hacia: {origen} control: I see you leaving for {destino}, heading {rumbo}, {km} kilometers. Wind from {viento}.
textos.Control deslizante. Cambie el valor con: Slider. Change the value with the arrow keys; Page Up and Page Down make bigger jumps.
textos.Contárselo a Matilde y llevar las prueba: Tell Matilde and take the evidence to the inspector
textos.Convénzales y hay doce mil euros para us: Convince them and there are twelve thousand euros for you. Nobody has to know.
textos.Copas caras, música lenta y gente que no: Pricey drinks, slow music and people who don't ask where you come from.
textos.Copas, espectáculo y la gente guapa de l: Drinks, shows and the beautiful people of the coast.
textos.Copia al mod un elemento del juego para: Copies a game item into the mod so you can change it. With the same identifier, it replaces the original.
textos.Copia al portapapeles el código elegido,: Copies the selected code to the clipboard, so you can send it to whoever you want to invite.
textos.Copia al portapapeles la dirección de es: Copies this server's address on your network to the clipboard, to give to whoever plays in your home.
textos.Copia de seguridad automática, cada tant: Automatic backup, every so many hours
Copies the information to the clipboard.
textos.Copiada la dirección %s. Vale para quien: Address %s copied. It works for whoever plays in your home; for people playing from outside, see the guide with F1.
textos.Copiar mi identidad para guardarla: Copy my identity to save it
