Roast lamb and wine of the year.
textos.Corre a la Viña Vieja antes de que empie: Run to the Old Vineyard before it starts to rain. You have a little over three minutes.
textos.Corre. Primero los girasoles, luego el m: Run. Sunflowers first, then the mill.
textos.Correcto. Puntual y discret[o|a]. Vuelve: Correct. On time and discreet. Come back to the casino tomorrow, I'll have something more interesting.
textos.Correr con una pulsación, sin mantener l: Run with one key press, without holding the key
textos.Corres como nadie y casi no notas los go: You run like nobody else and barely feel the hits. The crash takes away your health and mood, and it is the most addictive.
textos.Corres la voz de que esperas a {banda} e: You spread the word that you're waiting for {banda} in {barrio}. It won't take them long to find out.
textos.Corres más y apuntas mejor durante minut: You run faster and aim better for a minute and a half. Then comes the crash, and it is very addictive.
Cut grape clusters and whatever else is needed.
textos.Cosas de comida que el jugador puede lle: Food items the player can carry
textos.Cosas que caben en la despensa de cada c: Things that fit in each home's pantry
textos.Cosas que caben en la nevera: Things that fit in the fridge
textos.Cosas que caben en un pedido: Things that fit in an order
textos.Costa Dorada vuelve a oler solo a brea y: Costa Dorada smells only of tar and rice again.
textos.Crea un código de invitación de un solo: Creates a single-use invitation code and copies it to the clipboard.
textos.Crea un código nuevo, de un solo uso, y: Creates a new single-use code and copies it to the clipboard. Also with Ctrl+I.
textos.Crea un elemento nuevo al final de la li: Creates a new item at the end of the list.
Creates a copy of the selected item.
textos.Creando el certificado para cifrar la co: Creating the certificate to encrypt the connection. It takes a few seconds and is only done the first time.
Sunscreen, bandages and first aid kits.
textos.Creo que hay autobuses... en la estación: I think there are buses... at the station.
I think it's going to change. I don't know.
textos.Cristal, acero y una cascada en el vestí: Glass, steel and a waterfall in the lobby. Leocadia Arizmendi has her office here.
textos.Crédito concedido: {importe} euros, ingr: Loan approved: {importe} euros, deposited in your account. You pay it back in {n} installments of {cuota} euros, one every {entero} days. They are charged automatically, with a notice two days before.
It adds up, but the mistake is still there.
textos.Cualquiera puede fundar una en En línea,: Anyone can found one in Online, Your gang.
textos.Cuando alguien diga algo por estos canal: When someone says something on these channels, it will appear here.
textos.Cuando alguien escriba, sus mensajes apa: When someone writes, their messages will appear here.
textos.Cuando alguien funde otra banda, podrás: When someone founds another gang, you'll be able to propose an alliance to it here.
textos.Cuando el cargador se vacía, la R recarg: When the magazine runs empty, R reloads. V tells you how many bullets you have left.
textos.Cuando el radar diga algo que te interes: When the radar says something that interests you, press B: it sets the GPS and the beacon toward it.
textos.Cuando el servidor se va a parar para ac: When the server is about to stop to update or for maintenance (the actualizar and reiniciar commands, or the game update on Windows), it warns the players with this countdown before closing. With 0 it closes right away. The games wait and come back in on their own when the server returns.
textos.Cuando entre alguien, aparecerá aquí con: When someone joins, they will appear here with where they are.
textos.Cuando estés en el sitio donde suele est: When you are at the place where they usually are, open their profile from Social life and you introduce yourselves. Until then you can't do anything together.
textos.Cuando hay operación salida, de aquí no: When everybody leaves for the holidays, nobody can get in or out of here.
textos.Cuando hay rebajas, la gente se vuelve l: When there are sales, people go crazy.
textos.Cuando le das el dinero: When you give them the money
textos.Cuando levanta la niebla, la barca de lo: When the fog lifts, the wreckers' boat drifts away, empty.
textos.Cuando los necesitas no están, y cuando: When you need them they're not around, and when you don't, they give you a fine.
Call me whenever you need me.
textos.Cuando no tienes prestigio de buena gent: When you have no good-neighbor standing. If you attack them first, it is four points, as always.
textos.Cuando oigas que pican, tira del sedal c: When you hear a bite, pull the line with the attack button or the interact button.
textos.Cuando quieras empezar, en cualquier aca: Whenever you want to start, any academy in the region will enroll you. And now go to the soup kitchen, Casilda will be waiting for you with the ladle.
textos.Cuando se cierra la puerta del ascensor,: When the elevator door closes, on the upper floor only one chair is still occupied. Yours.
textos.Cuando se pelean entre ellos, lo pagamos: When they fight among themselves, the neighbors pay for it.
textos.Cuando te sientas, el silencio dura tres: When you sit down, the silence lasts three seconds. Then Casilda starts to applaud, alone, and the whole room follows.
textos.Cuando tengas alguno, aparece aquí y lo: When you have one, it appears here and you can mark it on the GPS, have it brought to you or send it to a garage.
textos.Cuando tengas una aeronave tuya aquí al: When you have an aircraft of yours right next to it, or you're on board, it appears in this menu so you can store it.
textos.Cuando trabajas de agente: el chasquido: When you work as an officer: the click of the channel and two beeps. You go on duty, a call comes in or the shift ends.
textos.Cuando yo era pequeñ{o}, se podía jugar: When I was little, you could play in the street.
The higher, the more often it bites.
textos.Cuanto más le das, más os acerca, una ve: The more you give, the closer it brings you, once a day. The next day they tell you what they bought
textos.Cuarenta años bajé a La Encantada, y te: Forty years I went down into La Encantada, and I'm telling you that mine is closed. Well, last night there were lights at the mine entrance.
textos.Cuarenta perros y ni una gota. Custodia: Forty dogs and not a drop. Custodia lends us a tanker, but we have nobody to drive it.
textos.Cuarenta plantas de cristal negro. En la: Forty floors of black glass. On the top one is Octavio Belmonte's office.
textos.Cuatro cajas. Contratos, sobres, hasta l: Four boxes. Contracts, envelopes, even the dates. With this, nobody can cover it up.
textos.Cuatro cañas, un techo de palma y el mej: Four rods, a palm roof and the best grilled octopus in the world.
textos.Cuatro de cuatro. Si alguna vez quieres: Four out of four. If you ever want to change careers, there's a place for you here.
textos.Cuatro de cuatro. Si algún día te cansas: Four out of four. If you ever get tired of tankers, there's work for you here.
textos.Cuatro entregas contrarreloj. Cuanto ant: Four timed deliveries. The sooner you arrive, the bigger the tip.
textos.Cuatro entregas por esta localidad en se: Four deliveries around this town in six minutes. If you all do them together, you all get paid.
textos.Cuatro horas de clase y un examen. Vuelv: Four hours of class and an exam. You have {carne_puntos} points on your license again.
Four tables and people talking quietly.
textos.Cuatro milésimas de una casa de 40000 eu: Four thousandths of a 40000 euro house is 160 euros a day.
textos.Cuatro paradas, en este orden, y cinco m: Four stops, in this order, and five minutes for all of them. Grab a car.
textos.Cuatro ruedas gordas para la playa y el: Four fat wheels for the beach and the countryside.
textos.Cuatro. Abre el juego. En Opciones, Actu: Four. Open the game. In Options, Updates, the first line shows the installed version: it must be the new one.
textos.Cuatro. Sube a cualquier vehículo y camb: Four. Get into any vehicle and change station,
textos.Cuatrocientos euros cada medianoche, par: Four hundred euros every midnight, forever, and Los Lagartos start working for you. You lose street reputation and you lose Remedios.
textos.Cuelgas la placa por tu cuenta, sin cast: You hand in your badge of your own accord, with no penalty. You're asked to confirm first. To come back, you have to pay for the course again.

textos.Cursos de conducción, puntería, resisten: Courses in driving, aim, endurance and fishing.
textos.Custodia y la Fundi llevan veinte años s: Custodia and La Fundi haven't spoken in twenty years. Today they will.

Off: everything as in earlier versions; standing only counts for pay, the bank and the police. Mild, which is the default: in stores they give you discounts if they like you, up to {entero} percent, and let you buy on credit; where you are avoided they charge a bit more; neighbors sometimes cover for a minor offense; a business that is looked after earns more and a neglected one a bit less; without street reputation or an escort, some gang may ask your business for money; and if you live a double life, what becomes known can end up in the newspaper. Normal: the same at full strength, and with a bad reputation or a criminal record the police stop you now and then. Demanding: everything weighs half again as much and, where you are avoided, some shops won't serve you. What you choose yourself, such as a permanent contract, a degree, a loan or upgrading a business, is always available, at any level. On an online server it doesn't apply.

textos.Dani Roca estuvo a una firma de volver a: Dani Roca came one signature away from being who he used to be again. It cost him the easy money, a fine and a few nights watching the door. His business is still open and Los Calaveras no longer come down his street. When Aurora found out everything, she only said: "The second time counts too."
textos.Dani Roca salió de la cárcel con lo pues: Dani Roca walked out of prison with the clothes on his back and today raises a shutter every morning that is his own. He pays his taxes, knows his neighbors by name and owes nothing to anyone but the bank. In Puerto Bravo you can still live in two ways. But since that night of the council meeting, nobody calls the second one the fools' way.

Dani Roca walked out of prison with the clothes on his back and today has a business, a diploma on the wall and a clean record. The neighborhood changes slowly and not always for the better, but his shutter still goes up every morning. He stayed out of trouble. Sometimes, closing the register, he wonders if that was all there was to do.
textos.Dani Roca tiene un negocio con las cuent: Dani Roca has a business with its books in order, a place in the merchants' association and the neighbors' greetings. He also has a notebook he shows nobody and a partner with a skull on his neck. In Puerto Bravo you can live in two ways. Dani has decided to live both, and every morning, before opening, he first looks at who is waiting on the sidewalk.
textos.Dani Roca. Te cayeron tres años por un r: Dani Roca. You got three years for a robbery you didn't commit, and Chief Varela signed the report. My name is Marta Salgado and I want to know why.
textos.Dani, tengo un problema. Dos chavales de: Dani, I have a problem. Two kids from Los Calaveras are at the fish market asking Ramiro, the guy who brings me the fish, for money.
textos.Dani. Cuánto tiempo. Me han dicho que ah: Dani. Long time. I hear you're a decent citizen now. I'm glad, really. Decent citizens' businesses burn just like the others.

textos.De {oficio} se aprende mucho de la gente: As a {oficio}, you learn a lot about people.
textos.Debajo de cuarenta toneladas de hierro n: Under forty tons of iron, not even his mother would find it. The pumps stay in the city.
textos.Debajo están los puestos, de menos a más: Below are the positions, from lowest to highest, with what each one requires and pays. You always start with the first.
It must be about {hora}, more or less.
textos.Debería hacer algo, pero el sofá tira mu: I should do something, but the couch pulls hard.
textos.Deberías pasarte por: {titulo}, en {nomb: You should stop by: {titulo}, at {nombre_lugar}. Open the phone with M to mark it on the GPS.
textos.Debes {debe} euros de alquiler de este h: You owe {debe} euros in rent for this hangar. Until you pay, they won't let you take anything out.
You owe {debe} euros in rent for this hangar. Pay it first.
textos.Decenas de perros esperando a alguien. A: Dozens of dogs waiting for somebody. Here you can adopt a companion who warns you of danger and finds objects by smell.
textos.Decide lo que se oye al cocinar. Lo que: Decides what is heard while cooking. Anything without fire does not burn.
textos.Decide qué haces. F1 explica cada opción: Decide what to do. F1 explains each option; Escape, you go on your way
textos.Decide qué pasillos tiene al recorrerla: Decides which aisles it has when you walk through it and how expensive it is: supermarket, market, grocery store... With no value, the game works it out from the shop's name, according to the Food shop types section.
textos.Decide qué se puede hacer en él. Al camb: Decides what can be done in it. When you change it, the fields specific to that type appear.
textos.Decides tú. Uno se va contento y el otro: You decide. One leaves happy and the other grumbling.
textos.Decidir tú y que no se hable más: Decide it yourself and be done with it
textos.Decir cuándo la gente huye o se aparta: Say when people run away or step aside
textos.Decir la posición en los menús, por ejem: Say the position in menus, for example 3 of 9
textos.Decir las localidades junto a las que se: Announce the towns you pass by
textos.Decir los botones del mando en lugar de: Say the gamepad buttons instead of the keys: {v}
textos.Decirle que no grite y que vuelva mañana: Tell him not to shout and to come back tomorrow
textos.Decirle que no, e ir a denunciarlo a la: Tell him no, and go report him at the police station
textos.Decirles a Los Calaveras dónde guarda la: Tell Los Calaveras where he keeps the box
textos.Decirles que se apañen: Tell them to sort it out themselves
textos.Decisiones de los puestos con responsabi: Decisions of the positions with responsibility
textos.Decisión de un puesto con responsabilida: Decision of a position with responsibility
textos.Declarar la guerra por {nombre_b}, que e: Declare war over {nombre_b}, which belongs to {nombre}: {get} euros from the till
textos.Declarar una guerra cuesta %d euros de l: Declaring a war costs %d euros from the till, and there are %d.
textos.Defensa propia: defenderte de quien te a: Self-defense: defending yourself from whoever attacks you first is not a crime
textos.Defensa que da cada miembro de tu banda: Defense each member of your gang gives
textos.Defensa que da un barrio con la lealtad: Defense a neighborhood gives with loyalty at the maximum
textos.Defiende el almacén: acaba con los tres: Defend the warehouse: take out the three Calaveras. Q locks onto the enemy, Space fires, R reloads and X makes you duck so you get hit less.
textos.Defiende la Chatarrería La Fundición. Ya: Defend La Fundición Scrap Yard. They're already arriving.
textos.Deja cualquier desvío y vuelve a marcar: Drops any detour and marks on the GPS again what the mission or job asks for now. If it is nearby, it selects it on the radar. Outside the phone, it is done with Shift O.
textos.Deja cualquier desvío, marca en el GPS l: Clears any detour, marks on the GPS what the mission or job asks for and, if it's close, selects it on the radar.
textos.Deja de vender o de cocinar. Sigue en tu: They stop selling or cooking. They stay in your gang and come with you when you call your crew.
textos.Deja de vivir contigo. No rompe la relac: Stops living with you. It doesn't end the relationship, but it cools it a lot.
textos.Deja de vivir contigo. Seguís siendo par: They stop living with you. You're still a couple, but the relationship cools a lot and it will be a while before they want to come back.
It leaves money in the till every midnight. Another gang can take it from you by declaring war on you.
textos.Deja las opciones como vienen de serie:: Resets the options to their defaults: those on this tab or all of them. Nothing is saved until you press OK or Apply.
textos.Deja los datos como estaban en una copia: Puts the data back as it was in a backup. The server must be stopped.
textos.Deja los periódicos en la estación, el h: Drop the newspapers at the station, the hospital, the town hall and the Grand Hotel, in that order, in five minutes.
textos.Deja los periódicos en la iglesia, la Pl: Drop the newspapers at the church, Plaza Mayor, the town hall and the bus station, in that order, in five minutes.
textos.Deja una señal en el registro para indic: Leaves a marker in the log to show that something odd happened at this moment. While playing, it is done with F12.
textos.Dejar 1000 euros en el comedor social: Leave 1000 euros at the soup kitchen
textos.Dejar que sea quien decida: Let them be the one to decide
textos.Dejarla en la comisaría: Leave it at the police station
textos.Dejarles marchar si no vuelven: Let them go if they don't come back
Showing my face. People appreciate it.
textos.Dejas a {nombre} en la protectora. Aquí: You leave {nombre} at the animal shelter. They will take good care of them here.
textos.Dejas de esperar a {nombre}. {guardado}: You stop waiting for {nombre}. {guardado} To come back, join again from Play on a server.
textos.Dejas el bolígrafo en la mesa. «Hasta aq: You put the pen down on the table. "This far." El Mellao doesn't smile.
You leave the job to start the mission.
textos.Dejas el vehículo de trabajo: se acaba e: You leave the work vehicle: the service is over.
textos.Dejas el volquete atravesado delante de: You park the dump truck sideways in front of the door. Under the tarp there's ore, yes, and some crates stamped with the seal of a Puerto Bravo shipping company.
textos.Dejas el vuelo comercial. La compañía bu: You drop the commercial flight. The company looks for another pilot.
textos.Dejas en el armario todas las sustancias: You leave all the substances you carry in the wardrobe, except alcohol, and their slots are freed up.
textos.Dejas la cesta junto a la puerta, con to: You leave the basket by the door, with everything inside.
textos.Dejas la misión a medias y sin recompens: You leave the mission half done and without a reward. You can start it again later.
You leave the fight to start the mission.
You give up the hangar space at {nombre}.
textos.Dejas las llaves en el mostrador de guar: You leave the keys at the guard desk. Shift over.
textos.Dejas paso al otro aparato: You give way to the other aircraft
textos.Dejas tu puesto en {empresa}. {jefe} te: You leave your post at {empresa}. {jefe} wishes you luck.
You leave {barrio} behind: the fight is over.
textos.Dejas {lugar} a tu {lado}, a {km} kilóme: You leave {lugar} behind, on your {lado}, {km} kilometers away.
textos.Dejas {origen}. Rumbo {rumbo} hacia {des: You leave {origen}. Heading {rumbo} to {destino}, {km} kilometers. Wind from {viento}.
textos.Dejaste {v} en {nombre}, {v2}. Te espera: You left {v} in {nombre}, {v2}. It's waiting for you there.
textos.Del dinero del armario, cuánto se llevan: Of the money in the wardrobe, how much they take, percent
textos.Del mirador al mar: From the Viewpoint to the Sea
textos.Del museo ha desaparecido un cuadro pequ: A small painting has disappeared from the museum. The curator knows where it is and doesn't want a report filed.
textos.Demasiado {motivo}. Motor y al aire: da: Too {motivo}. Go around: power up, circle and approach again.
textos.Demasiados para lo que me queda por hace: Too many for what I still have left to do.
textos.Dentro de un rato, a las {hora}, te espe: In a little while, at {hora}, {n} is waiting for you at {lugar}.
textos.Dentro de un vehículo no puedes cubrirte: You can't take cover inside a vehicle.
textos.Dentro de {dias} días te pasan las factu: In {dias} days you'll get the bills and taxes: about {euros} euros. They are charged automatically, first from your bank account.
textos.Dentro de {dias} días vence una cuota de: In {dias} days a payment on your {tipo} is due: {euros} euros.
textos.Dentro, los sonidos van por orden alfabé: Inside, the sounds are in alphabetical order by name.
Inside, the sounds are in alphabetical order by name. A letter jumps to the next one that starts with it.
textos.Denuncias la extorsión en comisaría. La: You report the extortion at the police station. The police set up surveillance and {banda} don't come back. The neighbours thank you.
textos.Denuncias la extorsión, pero la policía: You report the extortion, but the police don't pay much attention. That night they smash the window of {negocio}: a few days of losses.
textos.Denuncias y sale bien: You report it and it goes well
textos.Denuncias y sale mal: You report it and it goes badly
Depends on what I get out of it.
Depends on what for. Tell me.
textos.Depósito lleno. Con él puedes hacer unos: Tank full. With it you can fly about {int} kilometers. You have {dinero} euros left.
textos.Depósito lleno. Te quedan {dinero} euros: Tank full. You have {dinero} euros left.
textos.Depósito: caben más litros de combustibl: Tank: holds more liters of fuel
textos.Derrotas con las que una banda queda des: Defeats after which a gang is dismantled
textos.Descansa, que se te ve cara de cansancio: Get some rest, you look tired.
textos.Descansar ocho horas y recuperar la salu: Rest for eight hours and recover health
textos.Descarga cancelada. No se ha instalado n: Download canceled. Nothing new has been installed.
textos.Descarga e instala, uno tras otro, todos: Downloads and installs, one after another, every component in this list.
Downloads and installs, one after another, every new component or one with a new version.
textos.Descarga la versión nueva, comprueba que: It downloads the new version, checks that it's authentic, closes the game, updates it and opens it again. Your saved games, your options, your music and your mods are not touched.
textos.Descargando el modelo, {v} megas. Puede: Downloading the model, {v} megabytes. It may take several minutes.
textos.Describir cada barrio la primera vez que: Describe each neighborhood the first time you enter
textos.Describir lo que hace tu personaje: Describe what your character is doing
textos.Descripción cuando el barrio cambia de m: Description when the neighborhood changes hands
textos.Descripción del lugar o del barrio en el: Description of the place or neighborhood you're in
textos.Descuento máximo de los guardaespaldas p: Maximum bodyguard discount for your street reputation, percent
textos.Desde Puerto Bravo, que está en cero. Ne: From Puerto Bravo, which is at zero. Negative, toward the west.
textos.Desde Tu gente, uno por uno. Una vez al: From Your crew, one by one. Once a day.
textos.Desde ahí, LB y RB, o L1 y R1, dentro de: From there, LB and RB, or L1 and R1, inside any menu, continue through the history.
textos.Desde aquí no sale ninguna carretera par: No road for trucks leaves from here.
textos.Desde aquí puedes llevar la vida que qui: From here you can live the life you want. The street: your aunt's jobs lead you to El Chispas and to ever shadier businesses, which bring quick money and the police on your tail. The right path: at the Job Center, Aurora, the counselor, is waiting with work, studies and a story of her own that you can finish without committing a crime. And nothing stops you from living both. It's all on your phone, in Life, reputation and consequences.
textos.Desde aquí se avisaba a los barcos con b: Ships used to be signaled with flags from here. The fog bell still rings.
textos.Desde aquí se ven los tejados de pizarra: From here you can see the slate roofs, the chimneys and, far away, the sea.
textos.Desde aquí, la gente te coge menos confi: From here on, people trust you less, there are no kisses or nights together, and you can't get into demanding venues.
textos.Desde aquí, una cita acerca menos, en el: From here on, a date brings you less closer, you perform worse at work and sell fewer cars.
textos.Desde el mirador se ve toda la comarca:: From the viewpoint you can see the whole region: the harbor, the Villaseca road and, in the distance, the lights of San Lucero. At the bench there are three people, one from each place.
textos.Desde el móvil solo se consultan y se li: From the phone you can only check them and pay them off. To ask for one, go into any bank and choose Loans, mortgages and obligations.
textos.Desde el móvil: eliges el plan y la hora: From the phone: you choose the plan and the time, and the game finds a suitable place. Half an hour before, it reminds you. If you arrive on time, the plan happens there; if you don't show up, you've stood them up, and they take it badly.
textos.Desde el vehículo solo puedes usar armas: From a vehicle you can only use firearms: press I to choose one, Q to lock on to whoever is nearby and Ctrl to fire.
textos.Desde ese momento es tuyo: no desaparece: From that moment it is yours: it doesn't disappear when you walk away or take another one, and it is saved with the game.
textos.Desde esta localidad no se llega por tie: From this town you can't reach any other train station by land.
textos.Desde este mirador se domina toda la ciu: From this viewpoint you can see the whole city: the harbor on one side, the beach on the other and the sea in the background.
textos.Desde hoy, esto te cuesta {v} euros cada: From today on, this costs you {v} euros every midnight.
textos.Desde hoy, esto te deja {int} euros cada: From today on, this earns you {int} euros every midnight.
textos.Desde lo alto de la Torre Belmonte se ve: From the top of Torre Belmonte you can see the harbor, Villaseca and San Lucero. In all three places they pay, and in all three they pay the same person. Aunt Encarna has stopped asking, and in Barrio Viejo they lower their voices when you walk in. You have everything Belmonte had. Including what kept him awake at night.
textos.Desde que cambió de manos el barrio, la: Since the neighborhood changed hands, things have been calmer.
textos.Desde que empieza la reconquista o desde: Since the reconquest begins or since the previous one.
textos.Desde qué valor un vehículo cuenta como: From what value a vehicle counts as expensive, in euros
From land you only catch small fish. The big ones are out at sea.
textos.Deshace todos tus cambios de botones y c: Undoes all your changes to buttons and combinations, on foot and driving, and goes back to the default layout. It does not ask first.
textos.Desintoxicación en la clínica, contenido: Detox at the clinic, adult content
textos.Desintoxicación: {precio} euros y dos dí: Detox: {precio} euros and two days at the clinic
textos.Desmarca todos los elementos de la lista: Unchecks all items in the list.
textos.Despacio y con suavidad: acelera poco, f: Slow and smooth: it accelerates gently, brakes early and stops at every traffic light. It's never in a hurry.
textos.Despacio. Diez mil litros no frenan, se: Slowly. Ten thousand liters don't brake, they stop when they feel like it.
textos.Despedirte: el paseo termina aquí: Say goodbye: the walk ends here
textos.Despegar y la altura. Al subir estás en: Taking off and altitude. When you start, you are on the ground. Up arrow takes off. In the air, D climbs and A descends; with a controller, the right stick sideways. A note plays when your altitude changes: the higher the pitch, the higher you are. Below {alta} meters you fly low, as always. Above that, the ground police lose sight of you.
textos.Despegue abortado. Mantén flecha arriba: Takeoff aborted. Hold the up arrow until the aircraft lifts off.
Clear the door of El Faro del Ocaso.
textos.Despejado. Acércate a {persona}, que sig: All clear. Go to {persona}, who is still at {nombre}, and take them to {nombre2}: they follow you on foot and get into whatever vehicle you take.
textos.Despejado. Busca la caja de armas y llév: Clear. Find the weapons crate and take it: without it they're nobody.
textos.Despides a uno. Quedan {guardia} de guar: You dismiss one. {guardia} remain on standing guard. Neighborhood defense: {int} out of 100.
You dismiss {v}. They won't charge you anymore.
It wakes you up a little and takes the edge off your thirst.
textos.Despista a la policía: aléjate de las si: Shake off the police: get away from the sirens until they stop looking for you, or go through a paint shop.
textos.Después baja al muelle y recíbelos como: Then go down to the pier and give them the welcome they deserve.
textos.Después de irse o de ser derribado, si e: After they leave or are taken down, if the player still has that wanted level.
textos.Después de lo de hoy, aquí hay más polic: After today's events, there are more police here than passengers. Come back another day.
textos.Después de lo de la otra vez, aquí no ha: After the last time, no new stock has been brought in here: there is nothing to take yet.
textos.Después de tantos palos, {banda} se desh: After so many beatings, {banda} falls apart. It will take a long time to come back.
textos.Después del último golpe, {banda} se ha: After the last hit, {banda} has hidden well. Your sources will take {_dias} to find them.
textos.Después eliges la hora. Es en un sitio q: Next you choose the time. It takes place somewhere suitable for this plan, near where they usually are, and you pay there, when you do it. If it's one of the plans they like, it brings you closer.
textos.Después eliges si te hablan en masculino: Then you choose whether people address you as male or female.
After that, its sheet says it.
textos.Destruye casi cualquier vehículo de un d: Destroys almost any vehicle in one shot, from very far away.
textos.Desvío a {nombre}. Al llegar, el GPS vue: Detour to {nombre}. On arrival, the GPS goes back to {nombre2}.
textos.Desvío a {nom}. {como}, el GPS vuelve a: Detour to {nom}. {como}, the GPS goes back to {nombre}. With Shift G you cancel the detour and go back to what you had.
textos.Detenido. La central manda a alguien a r: Arrested. Dispatch sends someone to pick him up.
textos.Detrás de %s, si pones algo, tienen que: After %s, if you add anything, it must be the seconds of warning.
textos.Detrás de esa orden va lo que quieres de: After that command goes what you want to say. For example: slash yo opens the door.
textos.Detrás de invitar, si pones algo, tiene: After invitar, if you add anything, it must be how many codes you want: from 1 to 50.
textos.Detrás de un cuadro, una caja fuerte emp: Behind a painting, a safe built into the wall.
textos.Detrás de una persiana a medio bajar, El: Behind a half-lowered shutter, El Gordo buys and sells everything that can't be bought or sold.
textos.Detrás de una tienda de discos. Aquí se: Behind a record store. Half of Puerto Bravo's nightlife gets its supplies here.
textos.Deuda pagada. Ya puedes sacar tus aerona: Debt paid. You can take out your aircraft now.
Debt paid off: the seizure is lifted.
textos.Devastadora de cerca, inútil de lejos. D: Devastating up close, useless from afar. Two shells.
textos.Devolver un barrio por dinero, comprar u: Give a neighborhood back for money, buy one or collect tribute. F1 explains each deal
textos.Devolver {nombre} a {banda_interesada} a: Give {nombre} back to {banda_interesada} in exchange for money
textos.Devolverle la cartera, pero quedarte el: Give back the wallet, but keep the money
textos.Devolverlo no hace falta. Con que llegue: No need to return it. It's enough if it gets to Campus Repair Shop.
textos.Devolvérsela tal como está: Give it back exactly as it is
textos.Devuelve al 100 por ciento todos los son: Puts every changed sound, from all groups, back to 100 percent, and closes this list.
Resets all the sounds in this list to 100 percent. The others are not touched.
Return the cash box to Radio Taxi Luna.
textos.Devuelve las escrituras a la Cooperativa: Return the deeds to the Cooperative.
textos.Devuelve todas las funciones a su tecla: Puts every function back on its usual key and saves it right away.
textos.Devuelve todos los sonidos del juego al: Resets all the game's sounds to 100 percent.
textos.Devuelve {int} puntos, hasta el tope de: Restores {int} points, up to the cap of {int2}. If your license was taken away, the course gets it back.
textos.Devuelves el coche patrulla y dejas el a: You return the patrol car and drop any alert you had halfway done. You're still an officer: you start your next shift at any police station.
textos.Devuelves la cesta a su montón sin compr: You return the basket to the pile without buying anything.
textos.Devuelves {lower} al estante. Te quedan: You put {lower} back on the shelf. You have {get} left; in total {_cuantos}, {_euros}.
textos.Diario: lo que ha pasado y repetir misio: Journal: what has happened and replaying missions
textos.Dice acera, calzada, césped o arena cada: It says sidewalk, road, grass or sand every time the ground you walk on changes.
textos.Dice algo a todos los jugadores que está: Says something to all the players who are inside.
Says something to everyone who is inside. Also with Ctrl+N.
textos.Dice algo solo al jugador elegido en la: Says something only to the player selected in the players list.
textos.Dice algo solo al jugador elegido. Tambi: Says something only to the selected player. Also with Ctrl+M.
Says what this place is like.
textos.Dice dónde dejaste el vehículo del que t: It tells you where you left the vehicle you got out of and marks it on the GPS. If you were headed somewhere else, once you reach the vehicle the GPS goes back to that destination by itself. Without opening the phone, it is done with Shift L. If you have more vehicles, they are all in My vehicles.
textos.Dice la ropa del jugador más cercano y,: Tells you the clothing of the nearest player and, on a server with role-play channels, their profile if they wrote one.
textos.Dice lo que llevas en la cesta y lo que: Tells you what is in the basket and what it adds up to. You pay at the register.
textos.Dice los atajos de teclado de esta venta: Reads out the keyboard shortcuts of this window.
textos.Dice primero dónde está y hacia dónde va: First says where it is and where it's heading. If the target is moving or time is running, two presses in a row read the whole explanation.
textos.Dice que se lo ganó a las cartas y que n: He says he won it at cards and they never handed it over. I don't care: he pays.
textos.Dice qué tienes que hacer ahora en la mi: Says what you have to do now in the current mission or job, or which mission is waiting for you if you have none.
textos.Dicen cosas. Unas buenas y otras no tant: They say things. Some good and some not so much.
textos.Dicen que aquí cayó el gordo el último a: They say the jackpot fell here the last year it rained.
textos.Dicen que buscan repartidor en la pizzer: They say they're looking for a delivery driver at the pizzeria.
textos.Dicen que cambia mañana. También lo decí: They say it changes tomorrow. They said that yesterday too.
They say there are people in ties behind it.
textos.Dicen que empezó con un bar y ahora no h: They say it started with a bar and now there's no business that doesn't go through him.
textos.Dicen que en Villaseca cobraste por la f: They say in Villaseca you got paid for signing over the cooperative. I won't ask. But I know.
textos.Dicen que en el faro viejo se oyen pasos: They say you can hear footsteps at the old lighthouse. I haven't gone up to check.
textos.Dicen que en la playa hay quien busca te: They say there are people on the beach searching for treasure with a detector. And they find some.
textos.Dicen que era del barco del Tuerto. Yo d: They say it came from One-Eye's ship. I'll say yes, it sells better.
textos.Dicen que hay alguno que cobra por mirar: They say some of them get paid to look the other way.
textos.Dicen que hay carreras de noche. Yo oigo: They say there are races at night. I hear the engines from my bed.
textos.Dicen que la empresa del agua hace lo qu: They say the water company does whatever it wants.
textos.Dicen que la policía anda preguntando po: They say the police have been asking around the neighborhood.
textos.Dicen que les paga un señor de Puerto Br: They say a gentleman from Puerto Bravo pays them. One with a tower.
textos.Dicen que un perro bien enseñado encuent: They say a well-trained dog can find buried things.
They say the weather's about to change.
textos.Dicen que va a haber movida en el puerto: They say something's going to go down at the harbor. They say.
They say it is going to rain.
textos.Dicen, y yo no he dicho nada, que el del: They say, and I haven't said a word, that the guy at the dock warehouse gets more visitors at night than during the day. And they're not there to buy fish.
textos.Dices que no con la cabeza. Las sillas s: You shake your head. The chairs all move at once.
textos.Dices que no. Para entrar más adelante,: You say no. To join later, they will have to invite you again.
textos.Dices que no. Para unirte más adelante,: You say no. To join later, they will have to invite you again.
textos.Dices {total}. Tu rival dice {suyo}. Abr: You say {total}. Your rival says {suyo}. You open your fists: you {mias}, your rival {suyas}. That makes {real}.
textos.Dicho así suena fatal. Llévalo a la Nave: Said like that it sounds terrible. Take it to the Industrial Warehouse in the industrial estate; a technician friend of mine will pull the recording.
textos.Dieciocho hoyos de césped perfecto donde: Eighteen holes of perfect grass where the powerful close deals.
textos.Diez años de taxista de noche. Empieza c: Ten years as a night taxi driver. Starts with driving at level four, four hundred euros, a baton and some standing with the neighbors as well as some street reputation.
textos.Diez dianas que suenan a la izquierda, a: Ten targets that sound on the left, in the center or on the right. It improves your aim and gives a prize with seven hits.
textos.Diez es una carrera asequible; quince, d: Ten is an easy race; fifteen, a hard one. The Place field holds the start, and the places you must pass through hold the route: the last one is the finish.
textos.Diez mil litros de agua sobre ruedas. Le: Ten thousand liters of water on wheels. Slow, heavy and almost impossible to stop. With the J key you do hauls between towns.
textos.Dificultad: los enemigos caídos sueltan: Difficulty: fallen enemies sometimes drop their weapon
textos.Dile a Custodia que no sabemos cómo paga: Tell Custodia we don't know how to repay her.
textos.Dile a Marina que la próxima vez venga e: Tell Marina that next time she should come herself, because I haven't seen her in a month.
Tell me where and I'll take you.
Tell me the hour with a number, from 0 to 23.
Tell me what you need and we'll see.
textos.Dinero al ganar una pelea buscada: Money for winning a fight you picked
textos.Dinero aparte de lo que se lleva en los: Money on top of what they get from heists. It's what earns the most loyalty, and someone loyal won't rat on you if they're arrested. Once a day.
textos.Dinero fácil. Si alguien te ha visto, se: Easy money. If someone saw you, it will get out.
textos.Dinero llama a dinero. Al mío no lo llam: Money calls to money. Nobody calls mine.
textos.Dinero no, pero si tienes hambre, en el: No money, but if you're hungry, the soup kitchen gives out food.
textos.Dinero para la gente del barrio: sube su: Money for the people of the neighborhood: it raises their loyalty. Once a day per neighborhood. A loyal neighborhood defends itself better, is less tempting to the gangs, and its neighbors warn you about what's being planned even if you don't pay informants.
textos.Dinero por cumplir el golpe: Money for pulling off the heist
textos.Dinero que da, o que cuesta si es negati: Money it gives, or costs if negative
textos.Dinero que da, o que quita si es negativ: Money it gives, or takes away if negative
textos.Dinero que deja cada medianoche, para si: Money it leaves every midnight, forever
textos.Dinero sin justificar desde el que una i: Unjustified money above which an inspection notices it
textos.Dinero, y algo de nombre en la calle. Si: Money, and some name on the street. If word gets out, goodbye to the neighbours' esteem.
God and I understand each other.
textos.Dirección copiada al portapapeles. Pégal: Address copied to the clipboard. Paste it in a message to your friend.
textos.Dirección del servicio, empezando por ht: Service address, starting with https. Empty, the OpenRouter one
textos.Dirección para quien juegue en tu misma: Address for whoever plays in your home: %s:%s.
textos.Dirección personalizada del archivo vers: Custom address of the version dot json file
textos.Disfrútalo, que estas cosas no pasan tod: Enjoy it, these things don't happen every day.
textos.Dispara desde el vehículo en la huida: Shoots from the vehicle during the getaway
textos.Dispara varillas de acero. Silencioso y: Fires steel rods. Silent and slow to reload.
textos.Distancia a la que cuenta como llegado: Distance at which it counts as arrived
textos.Distancia a pie: {int} metros. Al volant: Distance on foot: {int} meters. Driving: {int2} kilometers
textos.Dividendo, por ciento del precio cada pe: Dividend, percent of the price each period
textos.Dividendos cada {get} días; noticias, {g: Dividends every {get} days; news, {get2} out of every hundred days
textos.Dividendos de {empresa}: {euros} euros p: Dividends from {empresa}: {euros} euros for your {n} shares, deposited in the bank.
textos.Doble vida: con las consecuencias apagad: Double life: with consequences turned off, nobody connects the dots.
textos.Doblones. Doblones de verdad. Con mi par: Doubloons. Real doubloons. With my share I'll fix the boat and with yours do whatever you like. And take this, I was saving it for a special occasion.
textos.Doce mil euros ahora. La cooperativa pas: Twelve thousand euros now. The cooperative goes to the fund and you stop being welcome in half of Villaseca.
textos.Doce, y nueve ya no son del pueblo. Has: Twelve, and nine are no longer from the town. You looked well. The job is yours, Dani.
textos.Dominó de dos contra un parroquiano. Se: Dominoes, two against one regular. You bet twenty or a hundred euros.
textos.Dominó de dos, con las veintiocho fichas: Two-player dominoes, with all twenty-eight tiles. Each player in turn plays a tile that matches one of the two ends on the table. If you have none, you draw from the boneyard until one fits. Whoever runs out of tiles wins; if nobody can play, whoever has fewer points in hand wins.
textos.Don Anselmo tiene cita en el hospital y: Don Anselmo has a hospital appointment and they told him not to go alone, the neighborhood is in turmoil.
textos.Donarla al Museo del Mar: Donate it to the Sea Museum
textos.Donas {cantidad} euros. Te dan las graci: You donate {cantidad} euros. They thank you from the heart.
textos.Donativo por adoptar un perro en la prot: Donation for adopting a dog at the animal shelter
textos.Donde está el banco había una vaquería,: Where the bank is there used to be a dairy farm, and before the dairy, a vegetable garden that belonged to my great-uncle. He sold it for peanuts and a donkey. The donkey lived twenty years.
Sleeping here boosts your mood quite a bit.
textos.Dos amigas se ríen de algo que no llegas: Two friends laugh at something you can't quite hear.
textos.Dos cascos, mucha vela y casi nada de ru: Two hulls, lots of sail and almost no noise. Press the J key to run courier jobs between piers.
textos.Dos cañones, largo alcance para ser esco: Two barrels, long range for a shotgun and a recoil you can feel.
textos.Dos chavales hablan de una carrera de co: Two kids talk about a car race tonight.
textos.Dos compañeros discuten por los turnos d: Two coworkers argue over the weekend shifts and both look at you.
textos.Dos de {banda} han pasado por {negocio}:: Two of {banda} came by {negocio}: they want {euros} euros every week "for protection". You have {dias} days to answer; it's on your phone, in Life, reputation and consequences, Pending matters.
textos.Dos días en la clínica. Sales limpi[o|a]: Two days at the clinic. You come out clean and clear-headed. It's day {dia}, {hora_txt}.
textos.Dos grupos de pandilleros. Si los echas,: Two groups of gangsters. If you drive them off, the neighborhood stays yours. If midnight comes and you haven't gone, you lose it. Your gang fights at your side. With neighborhood war mode on the street, you defend by going there: the GPS takes you and the fight starts when you enter the neighborhood.
textos.Dos guardias y un todoterreno. Poco trab: Two guards and an off-road vehicle. Little work, until you show up.
textos.Dos hombres discuten de fútbol sin escuc: Two men argue about soccer without listening to each other.
textos.Dos hombres usan la cabina de la gasolin: Two men are using the gas station phone booth and waiting for the siren. They're carrying a can.
textos.Dos horas de grifo al día. Y dando graci: Two hours of running water a day. And we're thankful.
textos.Dos horas de pesas y saco. Tu salud máxi: Two hours of weights and punching bag. Your maximum health rises to {int}.
Two ingredients and a frying pan.
textos.Dos mil euros de Baldomero, ahora. Es un: Two thousand euros from Baldomero, now. It's blackmail: on the street they'll respect you more; in the neighborhood, if it gets out, less.
textos.Dos minutos desde que te subas. Ni uno m: Two minutes from the moment you get in. Not one more.
textos.Dos plantas, espectáculo a medianoche y: Two floors, a midnight show and the longest line in the city.
textos.Dos pulsaciones de la tecla del objetivo: Pressing the objective key twice within that time reads out the whole mission briefing.
textos.Dos sombras te cortan el paso en un call: Two shadows block your way in an alley: "Hand over what you have."
Two taxis and a sleeping driver.
textos.Dos tipos fuerzan la persiana de una tie: Two guys are forcing the shutter of a closed shop. They haven't seen you.
textos.Dos tiros y a recargar. Cabe en cualquie: Two shots and then reload. Fits in any pocket.
textos.Dos vecinos discuten a gritos por una pl: Two neighbors argue at the top of their lungs over a parking space. One has already thrown the first shove.
Two, and they take after me. They'll make it big.
textos.Dos, y son un cielo. Bueno, casi siempre: Two, and they're angels. Well, almost always.
textos.Dos, y ya crecidos. Ni se acuerdan de ll: Two, and all grown up. They don't even remember to call.
textos.Dos. Cierra el juego. Cierra también el: Two. Close the game. Also close the mod editor and the online server, if you have them open.
textos.Dos. Copia ahí tus canciones, como en cu: Two. Copy your songs there, as in any folder: find them on your computer, copy them with Ctrl C and paste them into that window with Ctrl V. mp3, ogg, flac and wav files work. You can also paste whole folders.
textos.Doscientos a la semana y duermes [tranqu: Two hundred a week and you sleep easy. Or, if you remember who you used to be, we'll talk about something else: your register would help us move some bills. Fifty-fifty.
textos.Doy clase en cuatro minutos y tengo que: I teach a class in four minutes and I have to place three antennas to listen in on Los Lagartos. Impossible to be in two places at once. I ran the numbers.
textos.Doña Remedios lleva cuarenta años vinien: Doña Remedios has been coming for novels for forty years. Today she returns the last one: she's moving in with her daughter.
textos.Ducha en los vestuarios del gimnasio sin: Shower in the gym locker rooms without having trained, in euros
textos.Duermen en las salinas. Toma el fusil de: They sleep in the salt flats. Take my husband's fishing gun: it makes no noise.
textos.Duermes ocho horas en una cama estupenda: You sleep eight hours in a great bed. Health at maximum. It is {hora_txt} on day {dia}.
textos.Duermes ocho horas y sales con la salud: You sleep eight hours and leave with full health, showered and not thirsty. With the police after you, they won't let you in.
textos.Duermes ocho horas. Salud al máximo.{al_: You sleep for eight hours. Health at maximum.{al_dormir_en_casa} It is {hora_txt} on day {dia}.
textos.Dueña de la Boutique Las Torres. Elegant: Owner of Las Torres Boutique. Elegant, direct and used to giving orders. She can't stand being kept waiting.
textos.Dueña de la Sala Crepúsculo. Voz ronca,: Owner of the Crepúsculo Hall. Hoarse voice, easy laugh and a prodigious memory for debts. She arrived in the city with one suitcase and has no plans to leave.
textos.Dura {horas} horas. Si es uno de sus pla: It lasts {horas} hours. If it's one of their favourite plans, it brings you much closer and lifts your mood more. One date a day, and you need to know each other a little already.
textos.Durante el juego, la Q fija a quien te h: During the game, Q locks onto whoever attacked you, and Shift Q cycles through everyone nearby, other players included.
textos.Durante ese tiempo sale alguien a dar un: During that time someone comes out for a walk every so often: the player has to stay still or crouch.
textos.Durante ese tiempo, al entrar en el serv: During that time, when you join the server and after you are knocked down, nobody can hurt you.
textos.Durante una misión no te la juegas con e: You don't risk this during a mission.
textos.Durante una misión no: termínala o aband: Not during a mission: finish it or drop it first.
textos.Durante una misión tienes que llegar por: During a mission you have to get there by your own means.
textos.Durante unos días este proveedor te cobr: For a few days this supplier charges you more. The others sell to you at their usual price.
textos.Dárselas a la redactora para que las pub: Give them to the reporter to publish
textos.Dárselo al periódico para que lo publiqu: Give it to the newspaper to publish
textos.Décimos colgados y un bombo pequeño. Aqu: Lottery tickets hanging up and a small drum. You buy here.
textos.Déjalo en general: solo se usa el primer: Leave it as general: only the first one is used.
Leave it as general: only the first one is used. None of this counts on an online server.
Leave it as general: only the first one is used. All of this counts only with realistic life turned on.
textos.Déjalo vacío si no es de ninguna. El nom: Leave it empty if it belongs to none. The name exactly: Los Calaveras, Los Lagartos, Los Barrenos, Los Tiburones or Los Cuervos, or one from the Gangs section. The game works out by itself who owns the neighborhood at any time: that gang, the player if conquered, or at war.
textos.Déjalo vacío, con la sed, la salud y el: Leave it empty, with thirst, health and mood, if it is only for cooking. Hunger and thirst count only with realistic life turned on.
textos.Déjame la cerradura a mí, tú vigila la p: Leave the lock to me, you watch the vault door.
textos.Días de antelación con que se avisa de q: Days of notice before warning that something is about to expire
textos.Días de baja del herido, como poco: Days off for the wounded, at least
textos.Días de calma al cargar una partida ante: Calm days when loading an earlier save that already had the neighborhoods
textos.Días de calma tras conquistarlo todo, co: Calm days after conquering everything, at least
textos.Días de descanso tras un asalto en tranq: Rest days after a quiet assault
textos.Días de más, al azar, hasta: Extra days, at random, up to
textos.Días de verdad sin entrar tras los que l: Real days without coming in after which a player's properties go back on the market. Their share is kept for them.
textos.Días entre el compromiso y la boda: Days between the engagement and the wedding
textos.Días hasta poder repetirlo contra la mis: Days until you can repeat it against the same gang
textos.Días hasta poder volver a pedírselo: Days until you can ask them again
textos.Días hasta poder volver a tratar lo mism: Days until you can deal with the same matter again with the same gang
textos.Días hasta que se reintenta una cuota im: Days until an unpaid installment is retried
textos.Días hasta que un proveedor asaltado vue: Days until a raided supplier has stock again
textos.Días hasta una extorsión, como poco: Days until an extortion attempt, at least
textos.Días para decidir un asunto pendiente: Days to decide on a pending matter
textos.Días que aguantan las raciones en la nev: Days the portions last in the fridge
textos.Días que cuenta el desguace para saber s: Days the scrapyard counts to know whether it is saturated
textos.Días que dura un antecedente leve: Days a minor criminal record lasts
textos.Días que dura un tributo, como poco: Days a tribute lasts, at least
textos.Días que dura una tregua, como poco: Days a truce lasts, at least
textos.Días que el negocio da menos tras el dañ: Days the business earns less after the damage
textos.Días que la tienda no te deja entrar si: Days the shop won't let you in if they have seen you
textos.Días que pasa desmantelada, como poco: Days it stays dismantled, at least
textos.Días que pasa fuera un camello detenido: Days an arrested dealer stays away
textos.Días que quita pedir perdón si te escuch: Days taken off by apologizing if they hear you
textos.Días que quita una sesión de servicios a: Days that a community service session removes
textos.Días que tarda el gestor en ingresarlo: Days the broker takes to deposit it
textos.Días que tardan en preparar un asalto, c: Days it takes to prepare an assault, at least
textos.Días que te recuerda un local atracado,: Days a robbed shop remembers you, at least
textos.Días que tienes para hacerlo: Days you have to do it
textos.Días que tu pareja tarda en volver a fia: Days your partner takes to trust you again if they find out there is someone else
textos.Días sin entrar para perder las propieda: Days without coming in to lose properties
textos.Días sin hablarles, invitarles ni darles: Days without talking to them, inviting them or giving them anything before they feel forgotten
textos.Días sin pagar tras los que te quitan un: Days without paying after which an empty space is taken from you
textos.Días sin pasar por casa para que se resi: Days without coming home before it suffers
textos.Días sin pasar tras los que se da por ab: Days without visiting after which it is considered abandoned
textos.Días sin pisar un barrio antes de que em: Days without setting foot in a neighborhood before it starts to drop
textos.Días sin poder volver a la empresa que t: Days you cannot return to the company that fires you
textos.Días sin venderte, como poco: Days without selling to you, at least
textos.Días tras los que el fiado se cobra con: Days after which credit is collected with the bills
textos.Días tras los que puede llegar una banda: Days after which an outsider gang can arrive
textos.Dónde aterrizar. Lejos de los campos: en: Where to land. Away from the airfields: in the flight plan choose to fly in low over the town, and land on a street or a vacant lot. At an airfield, even if the radar has lost you, they recognize the aircraft.
textos.Dónde está cada uno y todo lo que puedes: Where each one is and everything you can do with them: mark them on the GPS, write to them, give them money or items, invite them to your gang or your group.
textos.Dónde está tu perro, cuánta hambre tiene: Where your dog is, how hungry it is and how much it trusts you.
textos.Dónde está tu vehículo, y marcarlo en el: Where your vehicle is, and mark it on the GPS
textos.Dónde está y si va a pie o al volante. C: Where they are and whether on foot or driving. It changes as they move.
textos.Dónde está, si va a pie o al volante, si: Where they are, whether on foot or driving, whether they are in your gang or your group, and whether they are in passive mode or in a safe zone.
textos.Dónde se guarda en casa: Where it is kept at home
textos.Dónde se guarda todo, cada cuánto y cuán: Where everything is saved, how often and how many backups are kept.
Throw the thugs out of the back of the mill.
textos.Echa diez litros al vehículo que llevas: Puts ten liters into the vehicle you are driving or the one you left parked next to it, or whatever fits if less is missing. You pay right away.
textos.Echar un bidón de gasolina al depósito:: Pour a can of gasoline into the tank: you have {get}
textos.Echar unas monedas a la tragaperras: Drop some coins in the slot machine
textos.Echarle de la banda: Kick them out of the gang
textos.Echas a correr y le dejas atrás. Por los: You run and leave him behind. Just barely.
You cast the line: the hook falls into the water.
textos.Echas un producto a la cesta: un golpe s: You toss a product into the basket: a dull thud and the wire trembling. Lower in pitch, you put it back on the shelf.
textos.Eco según el lugar, solo con el motor en: Echo depending on the place, only with the surround engine
textos.Editor de mods de {NOMBRE}, versión {VER:
{NOMBRE} mod editor, version {VERSION}.

Made by {AUTOR}.
Copyright {ANIO}, {AUTOR}. Free software under the MIT license.

Create places, missions, weapons, vehicles, races, entire towns and all the game content without writing code.

Ctrl+H explains the control you are on. F5 checks the mod. F9 tests it in the game.
textos.Efectivo que admite el banco al día sin: Cash the bank accepts per day without asking questions, if you have dirty money
Uh... no. I don't have any.
Uh... I don't know anything about that.
textos.El Atlético Bravo empata a cero y sigue: Atlético Bravo ties zero-zero and keeps dreaming of promotion.
textos.El Ayuntamiento de Puerto Bravo promete: Puerto Bravo Town Hall promises to fix the plaza clock. Again.
textos.El Bodeguero ha cargado lo que le queda: The Winemaker has loaded what he has left and is leaving town by the road.
textos.El Caimán acaba de encargar un deportivo: El Caimán has just ordered a sports car at Autos San Lucero. I want to install a tracker on it before it's delivered.
textos.El Caimán está entre rejas, pero lo suyo: El Caimán is behind bars, but his stuff is still there: the bingo hall collections, the nightclub, the harbor. If nobody takes it, someone worse will.
textos.El Caimán intenta huir de San Lucero en: El Caimán is trying to flee San Lucero in his limousine.
textos.El Caimán sale a rastras de la limusina,: El Caimán is dragged out of the limousine, straight into the arms of the San Lucero police, who for once arrive on time.
textos.El Calavera sonríe por primera vez. Te d: El Calavera smiles for the first time. He shakes your hand the way he does with his own people.
textos.El Cauce Seco: casas bajas a los dos lad: El Cauce Seco: low houses on both sides of a river that has been three years without water. Two hours of tap water a day and lines with jugs. It's the Los Aljibes neighborhood.
El Cauce Seco: low houses on both sides of a river that has been three years without water. Two hours of tap water a day and lines with jugs. It was the Los Aljibes neighborhood.
textos.El Centro: bancos, el ayuntamiento, el p: El Centro: banks, the town hall, the newspaper and a square with a fountain they only turn on when the television comes.
textos.El Chispas te espera en la Recta del Pol: El Chispas is waiting for you on the Industrial Estate Straight with a crazy idea.
textos.El Chispas tiene que entregar una furgon: El Chispas has to deliver a van against the clock.
textos.El Chispas tiene un encargo que le da ve: El Chispas has a job he's too embarrassed to explain.
textos.El Chispas, el mecánico del Polígono, ti: El Chispas, the mechanic from Polígono, has work for you.
textos.El Faro Noticias, la actualidad de la co: El Faro News, the latest from the region
textos.El Faro del Ocaso va a publicarlo todo,: El Faro del Ocaso will publish everything, if it reaches the printing press.
textos.El Faro ha publicado la historia. El com: El Faro has published the story. Chief Varela is trying to flee.
textos.El Faro lo publica en portada: {nombre}: El Faro runs it on the front page: {nombre} is not who they claimed to be.
textos.El GPS te guiará hasta la carretera, la: The GPS will guide you to the road, the station or the pier that leads there
textos.El GPS te guía hasta el sitio más cercan: The GPS guides you to the closest spot to where you left it. When you are in that town, mark it again from this list and it takes you to the vehicle.
textos.El GPS te lleva hasta el helipuerto, el: The GPS takes you to the heliport, airport or airfield. There, in the hangar, you roll it out to the runway.
textos.El GPS te lleva hasta la casa de ese gar: The GPS takes you to the house with that garage. There you take it out and drive off with it.
textos.El GPS te lleva hasta él. Sin abrir el m: The GPS takes you to it. Without opening the phone, Shift L does the same with the last one you used.
The GPS goes back to the mission: {nombre}.
textos.El Gordo tiene un pedido grande para una: El Gordo has a big order for a party out at sea.
textos.El Grupo Belmonte compra otro hotel en l: The Belmonte Group buys another hotel on the coast.
textos.El Huesos, jefe de Los Calaveras: El Huesos, boss of Los Calaveras
textos.El Lago Negro: agua quieta y fría entre: The Black Lake: still, cold water among pines, with the old mine entrance on the slope across the way.
textos.El Mar de Poniente: la costa queda al no: The Mar de Poniente: the coast lies to the north, with Puerto Bravo to the west, Cala Brava in the center and San Lucero to the east. To the south, out to sea, is Isla Tortuga.
textos.El Mellao espera. Matilde te mira. ¿Qué: El Mellao waits. Matilde looks at you. What do you answer?
textos.El Mellao te alarga un bolígrafo. ¿Qué h: El Mellao holds out a pen. What do you do?
textos.El Profesor ha descifrado la combinación: El Profesor has cracked the combination to the bingo hall safe.
textos.El Profesor necesita repartir tres anten: El Profesor needs to place three antennas around San Lucero before his class.
textos.El Profesor necesita un coche muy concre: El Profesor needs one very specific car for an experiment.
textos.El Profesor te espera en la Universidad: El Profesor is waiting for you at San Lucero University.
textos.El Profesor tenía razón. Los Lagartos gu: El Profesor was right. Los Lagartos keep their boat and half an arsenal at the marina. The fishermen don't even dare go near.
textos.El Pueblo: casas encaladas, naranjos en: The Town: whitewashed houses, orange trees on the sidewalks and a square with a market every morning.
textos.El Tabulador recorre lo que tienes alred: Tab scans what is around you, from the closest to the farthest, and each thing sounds from where it is. Shift Tab goes backward. With F6 you choose whether you want to hear everything, or only places, vehicles, people or objects.
textos.El acuerdo se firma en la Plaza Mayor, c: The agreement is signed in Plaza Mayor, with Villaseca wine and San Lucero spices. Three places where you chose the hard road now hold each other up. Nobody built you a statue, and that's better: they greet you by name in all three.
textos.El agente de la puerta coge el último te: The officer at the door takes the last thermos with both hands, like someone holding a treasure.
textos.El agente mira a los lados, se guarda lo: The officer glances around, pockets the {soborno} euros and turns away. They are no longer looking for you.
textos.El agente se queda con los {soborno} eur: The officer keeps the {soborno} euros and also arrests you for attempted bribery.
textos.El agente te cachea y encuentra {que}. C: The officer frisks you and finds {que}. With that on you, a fine is the least of your worries.
textos.El agente te mira, niega con la cabeza y: The officer looks at you, shakes his head and carries on his round: today he gives you the benefit of the doubt.
textos.El agua del barrio se abre y se cierra d: The neighborhood's water is opened and closed from a room in the desalination plant.
textos.El agua estaba en el mar, Leocadia. Uste: The water was in the sea, Leocadia. You only installed the meter. Smile, this photo will actually come out.
textos.El agua sigue igual de cara y tú cobras: The water is still just as expensive and you collect your cut every night. In the Cauce Seco some greet you with fear and some no longer greet you. The newspaper ran something else on the front page.
Water is worth more than wine now.
textos.El agua ya baja clara. Para ti, el balne: The water is running clear again. For you, the spa is free for life. Well, almost free.
textos.El aguardiente de palma se me acaba y el: I'm running out of palm brandy and the guy who brings it doesn't dare cross downtown. Pick up my order at Nave Catorce and keep a bottle.
textos.El albarán lleva el destino de la carga:: The delivery note lists the cargo's destination: the Aguas del Ocaso headquarters, in the name of Leocadia Arizmendi.
The mayor only shows up in the photo.
textos.El amor es como el levante: viene cuando: Love is like the east wind: it comes when it wants and messes up your hair.
The host has closed the game.
The host has refused the connection.
The host has kicked you out of the game.
textos.El antiguo semáforo marítimo, convertido: The old maritime signal station, turned into a six-bed inn.
textos.El antivirus bloqueó {que}. Añade la car: Your antivirus blocked {que}. Add the game folder to your antivirus exclusions and try again.
textos.El antivirus ha bloqueado un archivo y n: Your antivirus blocked a file and could not {que}. Add the game folder to your antivirus exclusions and try again.
textos.El aparato cae y se estrella. Sales de l: The aircraft falls and crashes. You crawl out of the wreckage as best you can.
textos.El aparato se zarandea: hay turbulencias: The aircraft shakes: there is turbulence, or you are flying through a storm.
textos.El aparato toca tierra: un golpe, el chi: The aircraft touches down: a thump, the screech of the wheels and the roll fading out.
textos.El archivo %s no está guardado en UTF-8;: The file %s is not saved in UTF-8; it was read anyway, but it is best to save it in UTF-8 (saving the configuration from the panel does it right).
textos.El archivo descargado es más grande de l: The downloaded file is larger than it should be.
textos.El archivo descargado no coincide con el: The downloaded file does not match the one that was published. It will not be installed.
textos.El archivo está dañado o ha sido modific: The file is damaged or has been modified.
textos.El archivo no contiene un mod: debe ser: The file does not contain a mod: it must be a JSON object.
textos.El archivo no tiene el formato protegido: The file does not have the game's protected format.
textos.El archivo sin nada detrás es para el pr: The file with nothing after it is for the protagonist Dani, male version. The lines that name them, which change
textos.El arma cuerpo a cuerpo definitiva. Sile: The ultimate melee weapon. Silent and deadly.
textos.El arma que llevas no existe en la versi: The weapon you carry does not exist in the version of the game this server runs: against other players it counts as bare hands.
The robber got away with the loot.
textos.El autobús pasa cuando quiere, no cuando: The bus comes when it feels like it, not when the schedule says.
textos.El autobús sale de la estación. Barato,: The bus leaves from the station. Cheap, but slow.
textos.El autobús te deja en el Barrio Viejo, d: The bus drops you in Barrio Viejo, where you grew up. You have fifty euros, a first aid kit and a duffel bag. Your aunt Encarna is waiting for you at her bar, La Gaviota Bar, a few meters east along Calle Mayor.
textos.El autobús te deja en {nombre}, {nombre2: The bus drops you at {nombre}, {nombre2}. It is {hora_txt}.
textos.El aviso cuando llega y no estás: The notice when it arrives and you are not there
textos.El aviso de que esto existe: al conquist: The notice that this exists: when you conquer a city
textos.El aviso de que vendrán: The notice that they will come
textos.El avión acelera por la pista y despega: The plane accelerates down the runway and takes off
The plane accelerates down the runway and takes off.
textos.El ayuntamiento de Puerto Bravo, con su: Puerto Bravo's town hall, with its clock that is always five minutes slow.
textos.El ayuntamiento está para lo que está: p: The town hall is there for what it's there for: collecting.
textos.El ayuntamiento vota el plan del puerto,: The town hall votes on the harbor plan, and the merchants have chosen you to speak on their behalf.
textos.El balneario de Fuentefría cuelga el car: The Fuentefría spa puts up the sold-out sign.
The bank where the company gets paid.
textos.El banco no se fía lo bastante: tu solve: The bank doesn't trust you enough: your credit rating is
textos.El banco no te presta tanto. Como mucho,: The bank won't lend you that much. At most, {hon_credito_maximo} euros.
textos.El banco pone el resto y lo devuelves en: The bank puts up the rest and you pay it back in installments, one every {entero} days, with a notice before each one. You need good creditworthiness: standing, a payroll or a business, and no serious criminal record.
textos.El banco te cobra la cuota de tu {tipo},: The bank charges the payment on your {tipo}, {euros} euros. {quedan} left.
textos.El banco te da un paraguas cuando hace s: The bank gives you an umbrella when it's sunny and takes it back when it rains.
textos.El bar de tu tía Encarna. Barra de zinc,: Your aunt Encarna's bar. Zinc counter, anchovy tapas and a slot machine that hasn't paid out since 1998.
textos.El bar sigue abierto, con un cristal nue: The bar is still open, with a new window. In one place they greet you and in another they cross the street, and you earned both. Aunt Encarna says nobody is all one thing, and she pours your coffee without asking which of the two people is coming to breakfast today.
textos.El barrio es tuyo. Te pagará {precio} eu: The neighborhood is yours. It will pay you {precio} euros every midnight.
textos.El barrio que creció alrededor de la pri: The neighborhood that grew up around Monteferro Prison, where you spent three years.
The drum is from the supply boat. Someone emptied it here, and it wasn't the seagulls.
textos.El bidón rueda por el suelo, vacío. Nunc: The can rolls across the floor, empty. They never meant to light anything: they just wanted the siren far away.
textos.El bingo de los jueves es lo más emocion: Thursday bingo is the most exciting thing in my week.
textos.El bingo y casino de San Lucero. Fue el: San Lucero's bingo hall and casino. It was the business of El Caimán, the boss of Los Lagartos, until the neighborhood changed hands.
textos.El bingo y casino de San Lucero. Lo cont: San Lucero's bingo hall and casino. It is controlled by El Caimán, the boss of Los Lagartos.
textos.El blindado está cargando en la sede. Tú: The armored van is loading at the headquarters. You get it out and we'll hide it among the scrap. It will follow you all the way to the army.
textos.El botón y lo que hace ahora. Con Intro: The button and what it does now. With Enter you choose another action for it.
textos.El botón «{nombre}» de la barra de herra: The toolbar button "{nombre}" has no menu item or shortcut with the same id.
textos.El boxeo enseña disciplina. A mí me ense: Boxing teaches discipline. It taught me to duck.
textos.El buen camino, {n} de {total}. Para «{t: The right path, {n} of {total}. For "{titulo}" you still need
textos.El buen camino, {n} de {total}. Te esper: The right path, {n} of {total}. They're waiting for you at {nombre_lugar}: "{titulo}".
textos.El buen camino: empieza cuando hayas vis: The right path: it starts once you have seen your aunt Encarna at La Gaviota Bar.
textos.El buen camino: es una historia para jug: The right path: this story is for offline play. It doesn't advance on an online server.
textos.El café de aquí al lado es el mejor. El: The coffee next door is the best. The one in the square is dishwater.
textos.El café te lo pongo yo. Y las llaves del: The coffee is on me. And the keys to Grandma's apartment, may she rest in peace. It is on Calle Mayor, right next door.
textos.El cajero te da {n} euros. Llevas {diner: The ATM gives you {n} euros. You carry {dinero} and {banco} remain in the bank.
textos.El camarero os da la mesa del rincón. {n: The waiter gives you the corner table. {n} orders for both of you and gets it right.
textos.El camino más corto. Dentro hay turbulen: The shortest way. Inside there is heavy turbulence, the aircraft may be damaged and, if you carry passengers, they will complain.
textos.El camionero me ha dejado tirado y tengo: The trucker left me in the lurch and I have the pickup loaded with tomatoes for Doña Remedios, at the Food Market in San Lucero.
textos.El campo del Atlético Bravo, eterno aspi: The field of Atlético Bravo, eternal contender for promotion.
The padlock has been cut with bolt cutters. Inside there are unmarked wooden crates, and it smells of diesel.
textos.El cantante baja sin dar las gracias. La: The singer gets out without saying thanks. The tip, though, is a good one.
textos.El capataz de Belmonte está en la bodega: Belmonte's foreman is at the Villaseca winery threatening the owners.
textos.El capataz quema el papel delante de ti,: The foreman burns the paper in front of you, without hurry.
textos.El capitán Mendoza ha visto luces en la: Captain Mendoza has seen lights on the old oil platform.
textos.El capitán Mendoza ha visto luces raras: Captain Mendoza has seen strange lights near the Santa Clara wreck.
textos.El castillete de la mina, oxidado, y una: The rusted mine headframe, and a spring of meltwater.
textos.El cauce pone las cisternas y los muelle: The riverbed supplies the tankers and we at the docks supply the iron. And the kid, who has already shown what they're good for, is the link.
textos.El centro de Monteferro: el banco, el ho: Downtown Monteferro: the bank, the hospital and the mining company offices.
textos.El certificado cambia si reinstalan el s: The certificate changes if they reinstall the server. If nobody warned you, someone may be impersonating it.
The vest can't take any more.
textos.El chalé más grande de La Colina, con pi: The biggest villa in La Colina, with a pool and a garage for five vehicles.
textos.El chaval del reparto no aparece y la fu: The delivery kid hasn't shown up and the van is still at the fish market, with the keys in it. Take it to La Barraca before the goods spoil.
textos.El chaval sale de debajo de una lona, bl: The kid crawls out from under a tarp, white as a sheet, and runs off toward town.
textos.El chico entra en el comedor social por: The boy enters the soup kitchen by the back door and leaves a bag on the volunteer nurse's table.
textos.El chófer deja el maletín en el coche mi: The driver leaves the briefcase in the car while she dines at El Horizonte. Twenty minutes, every Friday.
textos.El chófer del coche oficial corre por di: The driver of the official car races for money on the Industrial Estate. If you beat him, he'll talk.
textos.El chófer ha dado la alarma. Despista a: The driver has raised the alarm. Shake off the police.
textos.El chófer tarda en llegar, como poco, es: The driver takes at least this many seconds to arrive
textos.El cifrado es obligatorio pero no hay ce: Encryption is mandatory but there is no certificate and it could not be created: the openssl program is needed.
textos.El cliente da una vuelta alrededor del c: The customer walks around the car, runs a finger over the hood and nods.
textos.El cliente se ha hartado de esperar y se: The customer got tired of waiting and gets out without paying.
textos.El cliente se va dando un portazo. Mañan: The customer storms out, slamming the door. Tomorrow your boss will know.
The customer gets in. They want to go to {nombre}.
textos.El cobrador entra en el hotel y sube sin: The collector walks into the hotel and goes upstairs without stopping at reception.
textos.El cobre de las tuberías del barrio se u: The copper from the neighborhood's pipes is used to expand the Los Miradores network.
textos.El coche más rápido de la comarca. Frena: The fastest car in the area. It brakes late and accelerates early.
The fastest and most expensive car in the city.
textos.El comedor del barrio, que da de comer c: The neighborhood soup kitchen, which feeds anyone in need every day. They accept donations and helping hands.
textos.El comedor vecinal está seco. Coge la ci: The soup kitchen is dry. Take the tanker at the door and bring it back full.
textos.El comedor vecinal lleva dos días cocina: The soup kitchen has been cooking with jug water for two days.
textos.El comisario te llama al despacho: te as: The chief calls you into his office: you are promoted to {rango}.
textos.El componente contiene rutas no permitid: The component contains paths that aren't allowed. It won't be installed.
textos.El componente intenta escribir fuera de: The component tries to write outside its place. It won't be installed.
textos.El componente intenta tocar tus datos pe: The component tries to touch your personal data. It won't be installed.
textos.El comprador cuenta los billetes mientra: The buyer counts the bills while his people cover the aircraft with a tarp: {paga} euros.
The buyer was an undercover cop.
textos.El comprador no aparece. Con el radar en: The buyer doesn't show up. With the radar on you, nobody comes near.
textos.El concejal de obras. Con esto abro el p: The public works councilman. With this I open Monday's paper.
textos.El concejal está contento contigo. Tanto: The councilman is happy with you. So happy that he offers you the position of the driver who talked too much.
textos.El concejal nos cobra por dejarnos el pu: The councilman charges us for letting us use the harbor. If you tell us where he keeps the box, we'll handle it. And with you, peace forever.
textos.El concejal paga bien, pero quiere algo: The councilman pays well, but he wants something more: that you be the one to hand out the envelopes.
textos.El concejal sabe lo que llevas. Veinte m: The councilman knows what you're carrying. Twenty thousand euros if those papers don't reach the printing press. Think about it.
textos.El conductor baja la ventanilla: The driver rolls down the window
textos.El conductor del tranvía te reconoce y n: The tram driver recognizes you and won't open the doors.
textos.El conductor llega el último y se baja r: The driver arrives last and gets out laughing, no hard feelings.
textos.El conductor lo arrima a la puerta y te: The driver pulls up to the door and waits for you with the engine running. A vehicle of yours that's nearby works, or one from the gang.
The driver pulls it up to the door and waits for you in it with the engine running.
textos.El conductor te mira, mira el cartel de: The driver looks at you, looks at the wanted poster and shuts the door.
textos.El conductor ve las luces, pone el inter: The driver sees the lights, signals and pulls up to the curb. Get close and press Enter.
textos.El consultorio del pueblo. El médico vie: The village clinic. The doctor comes from San Lucero.
textos.El contable de la fundición saca cada se: The foundry accountant takes a briefcase out of the bank every week, and the payroll doesn't add up.
textos.El contable del Caimán quiere declarar,: El Caimán's accountant wants to testify, and some people would rather he didn't make it.
textos.El contable entra en el Casino La Última: The accountant enters the La Última Luz Casino through the service door. He comes out without the envelope.
