textos.El contable ha dado la voz. Despista a l: The accountant has raised the alarm. Shake off the police before heading back.
textos.El contable ha entrado al salón de juego: The accountant has gone into the gaming room and left the briefcase in the coat check. Grab it: press Enter.
textos.El contador marca un cuarenta por ciento: The meter reads forty percent too much. It's rigged that way. But a meter alone won't bring Arizmendi down: I need his books.
textos.El contenido para adultos incluye relaci: Adult content includes romantic and sexual relationships, paid companionship, drugs and drug dealing, always without explicit scenes. Are you over 18 and do you want to turn it on?
textos.El contenido para adultos se activa en O: Adult content is turned on in Options, in a game that isn't on a server.
textos.El cuaderno tiene fechas, matrículas y u: The notebook has dates, license plates and one name that keeps coming up: the Winemaker.
textos.El cuartel general de la policía de Puer: Puerto Bravo's police headquarters. They say Chief Varela gets paid more by Belmonte than by the State.
textos.El cura de antes daba unos sermones de h: The old priest gave sermons an hour and a half long. The new one, fifteen minutes and home. We came out ahead.
textos.El cura es buena gente. Juega al dominó: The priest is a good man. He plays dominoes better than anyone.
textos.El cura te da las gracias y una bendició: The priest thanks you and gives you a blessing you didn't ask for.
textos.El cursor del explorador de mapa ha pasa: The map explorer cursor has moved to the next intersection. It also sounds when you read a board inside a venue.
textos.El cóctel de la casa. Entra solo y sube: The house cocktail. It goes down easy and lifts your mood more than a regular drink.
textos.El de la camisa rota: The one in the torn shirt
textos.El de la torre de {campo} mira dos veces: The controller at the {campo} tower looks at the registration twice. Bad sign.
textos.El del Viento GT se ha ido sin pagar. Sa: The Viento GT guy left without paying. He's heading out on the north road. I don't want the car wrecked, but I'd rather have it wrecked than lost.
textos.El del chiringuito de Isla Tortuga está: The guy at the Isla Tortuga beach bar is sick and there's a storm: no boat is going out. But you can fly now.
textos.El del chiringuito te paga con un sobre: The beach bar guy pays you with an envelope and a two-scoop cone. If you like the trade, with an ice cream van and the J key you can do the route.
textos.El dependiente se cruza de brazos: «Para: The clerk crosses his arms: "We're closed to you."
textos.El desguace de la Peña del Cobre. Pagan: The Copper Club's scrapyard. They pay for any vehicle and don't look at the plate.
textos.El desguace que fue de la Peña del Cobre: The scrapyard that used to belong to the Copper Club. They pay for any vehicle and don't look at the plate.
textos.El despacho del Caimán huele ahora a tu: El Caimán's office now smells of your tobacco. Every midnight an envelope arrives, and every morning someone crosses the street. Doña Remedios closed her stall at the market and nobody has told you why.
textos.El despacho está vacío y la caja fuerte: The office is empty and the safe is open. On the desk, the account book and a phone that is ringing. It is El Chispas: Belmonte has just left his tower heading for the ferry.
textos.El destino o el desvío que cancelaste po: The destination or detour you last canceled comes back to the GPS, without having to search for it again.
textos.El dinero cambia de manos y las esquinas: The money changes hands and the corners of {barrio} change owners. Now you're in charge.
textos.El dinero común de la banda. Lo meten lo: The gang's shared money. Members put it in, and so do the neighborhoods every midnight, and it pays for neighborhoods and wars.
textos.El dinero de casa no lo pierdes si te at: Money at home isn't lost if you get mugged or arrested, but a house can be broken into, except for what is in a safe.
textos.El dinero del banco no se pierde si te d: Money in the bank isn't lost if you get arrested or end up in the hospital, and it earns a small interest every day.
textos.El dinero es tuyo. Para eso te has jugad: The money is yours. You risked your neck for it.
textos.El dinero que guardas en el armario de e: The money you keep in this house's wardrobe is safe from thieves.
textos.El dinero que reconoce el servidor, las: The money the server recognizes, houses, businesses and vehicles.
textos.El dinero que tienes en el banco, aparte: The money you have in the bank, apart from what you carry. You deposit and withdraw it at the banks.
Money comes and goes. Mostly goes.
textos.El director del museo no se lo cree hast: The museum director doesn't believe it until he sees the chest.
textos.El disco se ha llenado y no se ha podido: The disk is full and could not {que}. Free up space and try again.
textos.El disparo de cada arma debe reconocerse: The shot of each weapon should be recognizable without looking: try to make sure they don't sound alike.
textos.El disparo y, detrás, la palanca que car: The shot and, right behind it, the lever loading the next round.
textos.El distrito financiero: rascacielos de c: The financial district: glass skyscrapers, the casino and the Belmonte family's businesses.
Double if the player is light.
textos.El dueño del chiringuito se recupera en: The beach bar owner recovers in two days and swears that as long as he lives you won't pay for an octopus on his island.
textos.El día de mercado baja medio pueblo. No: On market day half the town comes down. You can't even walk.
textos.El día que llueva, salimos todos a la ca: The day it rains, we'll all go out in the street to get wet.
textos.El economato de la antigua compañía. Sig: The old company's store. It still sells a bit of everything.
textos.El editor de mods, el servidor en línea: The mod editor, the online server or its panel were still open, and Windows does not let you replace a running program. Close them and try again.
textos.El elemento de menú «{texto}» no tiene l: The menu item "{texto}" has no access letter (&).
textos.El embargo se queda {parte} euros. Aún d: The seizure takes {parte} euros. You still owe {int}.
textos.El empresario Octavio Belmonte niega cua: Businessman Octavio Belmonte denies any link to the Los Calaveras gang.
textos.El encargo. Cada día, en cada campo, alg: The job. Every day, at every airfield, someone pays for an aircraft delivered next to a discreet spot in another town. It only pays if you arrive without the radar on you.
textos.El encargo: déjalo junto a {nombre}, en: The job: leave it next to {nombre}, in {nombre2}, without the radar on you. They pay {paga} euros. The O key reminds you.
textos.El escondite de {banda} está junto a {no: The {banda} hideout is next to {nombre}: {n} in all, and {llegan} of them will arrive in a vehicle as soon as it starts. Listen for the engine.
textos.El escondite de {banda} queda arrasado:: The {banda} hideout is wrecked: they lose people, weapons and the will to fight.
textos.El escáner direccional ha encontrado una: The directional scanner has found a wall. The closer it is, the higher the pitch.
textos.El escáner direccional no encuentra ning: The directional scanner finds no wall in that direction.
textos.El escáner son las teclas W, A, S y D: t: The scanner is the W, A, S and D keys: they tell you what is ahead, to the left, behind and to the right, and how far away the wall is. Use it like a cane.
textos.El estanque de los patos, en mitad del P: The duck pond, in the middle of Alameda Park. Wooden benches and the shade of poplars.
textos.El farero está con fiebre y hoy sube la: The lighthouse keeper has a fever and a strong tide is coming in today. The island's four lights must be lit before dark.
textos.El faro apagado del final del muelle. De: The dark lighthouse at the end of the pier. From here you can hear the whole harbor.
textos.El fin del mundo lo anuncian cada año y: They announce the end of the world every year and here we still are.
textos.El fondo de cada sitio: la ciudad, el ma: The background of each place: the city, the sea, the birds, the rain, the thunder and the bells. A sample plays when you change it. Change it with the left and right arrows.
textos.El fondo no se rinde: ha mandado gente a: The fund won't give up: it has sent people to ruin the grape harvest.
The boss decides on friendly fire.
textos.El fuego sube deprisa. Desde el otro lad: The fire spreads fast. From the other side of the pier someone shouts your name.
textos.El furgón oscuro de la unidad de asalto: The dark van of the police assault unit. It only shows up at the highest wanted level, and three officers with rifles ride inside.
textos.El futuro, ya veremos. Bastante tengo co: The future, we'll see. I've got enough with the present.
textos.El fútbol, en el bar y con los amigos. E: Soccer is for the bar with friends. At home it's not the same.
textos.El garaje de Custodia Barral: dos cister: Custodia Barral's garage: two old tankers, a tow truck and a dog that doesn't bark. The neighborhood's water comes from here.
textos.El generador de voces aún no tiene voces: The voice generator doesn't have voices in this language yet.
textos.El generador de voces ha cargado, pero n: The voice generator loaded, but it couldn't generate a line on this computer.
textos.El generador de voces no funciona en est: The voice generator doesn't work on this computer: when tested separately, it shut down abruptly.
textos.El generador de voces no se ha podido ca: The voice generator couldn't be loaded on this computer.
textos.El generador de voces no se ha podido pr: The voice generator couldn't be tested on this computer.
textos.El generador de voces se está comproband: The voice generator is being checked on this computer. This only happens the first time and takes a few seconds: try again shortly.
textos.El generador de voces tarda demasiado en: The voice generator takes too long on this computer.
textos.El gestor cuenta los billetes sin mirart: The fixer counts the bills without looking at you. "In {dias} days you will have it in your account, clean. Minus my cut."
textos.El gestor cumple: te llegan al banco {eu: The fixer delivers: {euros} clean euros reach your bank.
The fixer has disappeared with your money. In this business, it happens sometimes.
textos.El gestor no se mueve por menos de {ente: The fixer will not move for less than {entero} euros in cash.
textos.El gestor. Dinero sin justificar: {int}: The fixer. Unexplained money: {int} euros. You carry {dinero}
textos.El golpe ha salido bien y te ha tocado m: The heist went well and you got more than you expected. What do you do with the surplus?
textos.El grupo de misión está otra vez complet: The mission group is complete again.
textos.El grupo se deshace para todos y se avis: The group breaks up for everyone and the others are told.
textos.El guarda prueba un trago, tose y pide o: The guard tries a sip, coughs and asks for another case.
textos.El hambre y la sed solo cuentan con la v: Hunger and thirst only count with realistic life turned on; health and mood always count.
textos.El hangar está vacío. Trae una aeronave: The hangar is empty. Bring an aircraft to this airfield to store it
textos.El helicóptero de la plataforma. Llévalo: The platform helicopter. Fly it to the clearing on the island with the medicine.
textos.El helicóptero de la policía te habla po: The police helicopter speaks to you over the loudspeaker: a click and a metallic voice. What it says is read out next.
textos.El helicóptero llega y da vueltas sobre: The helicopter arrives and circles over the area: it has not seen you yet.
textos.El helicóptero no te encuentra y se reti: The helicopter cannot find you and pulls back.
textos.El helicóptero te enfoca. Por el altavoz: The helicopter spotlights you. Over the loudspeaker:
The helicopter has lost sight of you.
textos.El hermano de Carmela sabe dónde está la: Carmela's brother knows where the proof of your innocence is.
textos.El historial de mensajes se repasa con R: You review the message history with Page Up and Page Down; Ctrl Page Up goes to the first and Ctrl Page Down to the last. With yes, each new message takes you to the end, as always. With no, if you are reviewing, you stay where you were even when messages arrive, and you go to the last one with Ctrl Page Down.
textos.El hombre del hotel te mete el sobre en: The man from the hotel slips the envelope into your jacket pocket.
The weatherman never gets it right.
textos.El hombre del traje te pone un maletín e: The man in the suit puts a briefcase in your hand. It weighs less than you expected.
textos.El hombre no discute el precio. Tiene el: The man doesn't argue the price. He has the money ready.
textos.El horno al fondo y la caja. Aquí se pid: The oven in the back and the register. You order here.
textos.El horóscopo me dijo que hoy conocería a: My horoscope said I'd meet someone annoying today. Well, look at that.
textos.El hospital de Monteferro, experto en hu: Monteferro's hospital, expert in broken bones.
textos.El hospital de San Lucero, lleno de estu: San Lucero's hospital, full of sleepy-eyed medical students.
textos.El hospital de la ciudad. Urgencias a la: The city hospital. Emergency room around the corner.
textos.El identificador de uno de los estilos d: The identifier of one of the styles in Outfits. If it is the same as the clothes you wear, you are matching, and on a date it shows a little more.

The identifier of one of the styles in Outfits: street, sport, elegant, work, party, beach, coat, tactical, or one you have added there. The shop groups clothes by style. Each person in the social life likes one: dressing like that on a date shows. Elegant also helps sell cars.
The identifier of one of the styles in Outfits: street, sport, elegant... If you dress like that on a date, it shows. Empty, the game decides for each playthrough.
textos.El imperio de Octavio Belmonte. Cara mie: Octavio Belmonte's empire. Expensive as long as he is in charge.
textos.El ingeniero que dirige las voladuras hu: The engineer who runs the blasting is fleeing down the mountain with the detonators.
textos.El ingeniero se ha asustado y se va con: The engineer has panicked and is leaving with the detonators in his off-roader. If he makes it down, he'll come back with another crew.
textos.El inspector levanta la vista: «¿Me está: The inspector looks up: "Are you trying to bribe me?" He calls the police. You get the fine, a report, and you're in the newspaper.
textos.El inspector se guarda el sobre y rompe: The inspector pockets the envelope and tears up the report. Nothing happened here.
textos.El inspector se guarda el sobre. Por aho: The inspector pockets the envelope. For now, he hasn't seen a thing.
textos.El instalador no dejó apuntado el motivo: The installer did not record the reason.
textos.El instalador no llegó a apuntar en qué: The installer did not record which step failed.
textos.El jefe de los cobradores huye con la ca: The collectors' boss is running off with a month's takings.
The boss has kicked someone out of the gang.
textos.El jefe me tiene frit{o}. Que si esto, q: My boss has me fed up. This, that, the other. I say yes to everything and then do what I think is best.
textos.El juego anota lo que pasa en cada sesió: The game records what happens in each session so bugs can be found. Here you see where it is, what it contains and how to send it.
textos.El juego añade solo en qué recetas entra: The game itself adds which recipes it goes into, where it is kept and how long it lasts.
textos.El juego dirá ese nombre al subir, al lo: The game will say that name when you get in, when you locate it and in lists.
textos.El juego distingue tres: rumor, chivataz: The game tells three apart: rumor, tip-off and message.
textos.El juego entero en {idioma}: los menús,: The whole game in {idioma}: the menus, the story, the places, the items, the keys, the mod editor and the server panel. After installing it, choose it in Options, Language: it takes effect when you open the game again.
textos.El juego entiende de qué va lo que escri: The game understands what you write and answers to it.
textos.El juego entiende la intención de lo que: The game understands the intent of what you type.
The game is free and will stay that way. If it has given you a good time and you want to say thanks, Enter opens the donations page in the browser.
textos.El juego está abierto dos veces. Windows: The game is open twice. Windows does not let you replace a running program: close the other Puerto Bravo window before updating.
textos.El juego está en una carpeta con símbolo: The game is in a folder with special symbols in its name and cannot update itself. Download the new version by hand.
textos.El juego lo hace solo cada semana, y cua: The game does this by itself every week, and whenever a model stops existing. Use it if you want to force it.
textos.El juego monta la misión según esto. Al: The game builds the mission according to this. When you change it, its fields appear.
textos.El juego no dice una frase de reacción a: The game won't say a reaction line until this much time has passed since the previous one. Shouts are always heard.
textos.El juego no terminó de cerrarse a tiempo: The game did not finish closing in time. Try again, and if it happens again, restart the computer first.
textos.El juego original no tiene elementos en: The original game has no items in this section.
textos.El juego sabe llevar estos cuatro. Al ca: The game can handle these four. When you change it, its fields appear.
textos.El juego se cierra, se actualiza y vuelv: The game closes, updates and reopens by itself in
textos.El juego te dice una dirección. En Cómo: The game gives you an address. In How to invite a friend you have two: the home one, for anyone on your same network, and the internet one. With Enter they are copied, so you can paste them in a message.
textos.El juego tiene {total} sonidos. Primero: The game has {total} sounds. First come the most important ones, then Search for a sound, and then all of them, in groups and in alphabetical order. Press Enter to open a group
textos.El juego trae amable, hablador, seco, ti: The game comes with friendly, talkative, dry, shy and cocky. With one of those, you change that personality; with a new one, you add another, and people on the street can come out with it.
textos.El juego trae boxeo y mma. Las victorias: The game comes with boxing and mma. Victories are counted with this identifier.
textos.El juego trae frases escritas para sus c: The game comes with lines written for its five personalities. A new personality uses those of one of them.
textos.El juego trae motor, frenos, blindaje, n: The game comes with engine, brakes, armor, tires, suspension, exhaust and tank. With one of those identifiers you change that upgrade; with a new one, you add another to the repair shop.
textos.El juego trae recibidor, sofa, cocina, b: The game comes with entrance hall, sofa, kitchen, bathtub, bed and workshop, and each has its own effect. You can change their name, price and texts. One with a new identifier can be bought and is described when you enter its room, but has no effect of its own.
textos.El juego usa botiquin, ganzua, pienso, c: The game uses first aid kit, lockpick, dog food, vest and walkman. Here you can change their name, price and description.
textos.El juego usa nivel_1, nivel_2, nivel_3,: The game uses nivel_1, nivel_2, nivel_3, nivel_4 and nivel_5: with one of those you change that level.
textos.El juego ya está actualizado. Antes de a: The game is now updated. Before updating you were in {nombre}
textos.El jugador elegido pasa a administrar el: The selected player becomes a server admin: they can give orders from the game chat.
textos.El jugador se come una y las demás van a: The player eats one and the rest go in the fridge.
textos.El juicio dura tres meses y sale en todo: The trial lasts three months and makes every newspaper. El Caimán will never set foot in San Lucero again. Nobody owes you anything and you owe nobody anything: you sleep well that way.
textos.El laboratorio de {casa} ha ardido. {n}: The lab at {casa} has burned down. {n} comes out with burns and the neighbors call the police.
textos.El laboratorio ha contestado, y Nerea ne: The lab has answered, and Nerea needs eyes in Los Miradores.
textos.El libro de caja del casino está en un c: The casino's cash book is in a shed on the dock, with three guards walking around.
textos.El local te recuerda de {get} a {get2} d: The shop remembers you for {get} to {get2} days
textos.El lugar del otro mapa en el que aparece: The place on the other map where you appear.
textos.El lunes, El Faro abre con la foto del c: On Monday, El Faro leads with the photo of the councilman entering the courthouse. You haven't gotten rich, but in Barrio Viejo you no longer pay for a coffee. And Aunt Encarna cuts out the front page and pins it on the bar wall.
textos.El mando vibra con los golpes, los dispa: The gamepad vibrates with hits, shots you take, explosions and when a fish bites.
textos.El mando vibra un momento para que compr: The controller vibrates for a moment so you can check you feel it. It must be connected.
textos.El mantenimiento la deja como nueva. Cue: Maintenance leaves it like new. The cost depends on the damage it has.
textos.El manual y las demás guías en {idioma},: The manual and the other guides in {idioma}, brought up to date without waiting for a new version of the game.
The sea gives and the sea takes away.
textos.El mar en invierno es lo mejor. No hay n: The sea in winter is the best. There's nobody there.
The sea has no secrets from me.
The best rice on the coast.
textos.El mejor marisco de la costa. La cuenta: The best seafood on the coast. The bill is among the best too.
The best spot for rock bream.
textos.El menú «{titulo}» de la barra de menús: The menu "{titulo}" in the menu bar has no access letter (&).
textos.El mercado de San Lucero. Doña Remedios,: San Lucero's market. Doña Remedios, from the spice stall, runs things here more than the mayor.
textos.El mesonero te paga sin dejar de remover: The innkeeper pays you without ever stopping stirring the pot.
textos.El mismo juego, con todo lo que haces po: The same game, with everything you do on your own, missions, jobs, homes and businesses, plus real players: you can hear them, talk to them, give or take money, weapons and vehicles, form gangs, fight over neighborhoods and do group missions. Your online character is separate from your single-player games and is saved on the server. The time is the server's time and it never stops.
textos.El mod se ha guardado protegido, con ext:
The mod was saved protected, with the pbm extension, which is the one the game uses.

The handwritten file is kept as {basename} and the game no longer loads it.
textos.El modelo de cada plaza se sortea cada d: The model of each space is drawn every day from the neighborhood's vehicles, so the street changes from one day to the next.
textos.El modelo local está arrancando. Prueba: The local model is starting up. Try again in a few seconds.
textos.El modelo local está arrancando. Vuelve: The local model is starting up. Try again in a few seconds.
The local model is not responding.
The counter and the bags. You pay here.
textos.El motor de un barco grande: un pesquero: The engine of a large boat: a fishing boat, a sailboat or a yacht.
textos.El motor de un camión o de un autobús, g: The engine of a truck or a bus, deep and heavy.
textos.El motor de un coche. Sube de tono con l: The engine of a car. It rises in pitch with speed.
textos.El motor de un deportivo, más bronco que: The engine of a sports car, rougher than a normal car.
textos.El motor de un tractor, lento y a golpes: The engine of a tractor, slow and chugging.
textos.El motor de una furgoneta o de un todote: The engine of a van or an off-roader.
textos.El motor de una lancha o de otra embarca: The engine of a speedboat or another fast watercraft.
textos.El motor envolvente usa sonido binaural:: The surround engine uses binaural sound: with headphones you can tell whether something sounds in front or behind, and not just left or right. It also mixes the sound outside the program, so it doesn't stutter when there are many sounds at once. The classic one is the usual. The change applies when you close and reopen the game. On computers with an old processor, and with mono sound on, the classic one is always used.
textos.El motor está en marcha. Conduces tú: yo: The engine's running. You drive: I'll watch behind.
textos.El motor no arranca: no queda combustibl: The engine won't start: there is no fuel left.
The engine won't start: no fuel left. You refuel at a heliport, an airport or an airfield, or from the phone, under My vehicles.
textos.El motor suena mucho más bajo. La policí: The engine sounds much lower. The police hear you from less far away: when they're after you, they lose you sooner as you get away.
textos.El motor tose y se para: no queda combus: The engine coughs and stops: no fuel left. You glide.
textos.El motor tose y se para: te has quedado: The engine coughs and dies: you have run out of fuel.
textos.El mueble Cocina equipada y nevera grand: The Equipped kitchen and big fridge furniture.
textos.El muelle de los pescadores. De aquí sal: The fishermen's pier. The boats set out from here at dawn.
textos.El muelle de piedra de la Isla de los Vi: The stone pier of Isla de los Vientos, out at sea, to the east.
textos.El muelle de tablones de Costa Dorada, a: The wooden pier of Costa Dorada, west of Puerto Bravo.
textos.El mundo del juego (lugares, armas, misi: The game world (places, weapons, missions) is not tied to the server: the incoming player's game brings it. A server without a world takes the first incoming player's; if that one is not signed, it replaces it with the first signed one that arrives.
textos.El mundo es muy grande, pero como aquí n: The world is very big, but nowhere else do they eat like they do here.
textos.El mundo pasa de la versión %s a la %s%s: The world goes from version %s to %s%s.
textos.El mundo se apaga de golpe. Demasiado {l: The world suddenly goes dark. Too much {lower}. You wake up twelve hours later in {nombre} with an IV in your arm, {coste} euros poorer and the worst hangover of your life.
textos.El más grande decide que ahora la pelea: The biggest one decides the fight is with you now.
textos.El más listo de mi clase, y no abría un: The smartest in my class, and he never opened a book.
textos.El mío ya ni lo celebro. Me limito a cum: I don't even celebrate mine anymore. I just get through it.
textos.El negocio del Caimán se ha quedado sin: El Caimán's business has no owner. What do you do?
The business up and running, with its people.
textos.El nombre con el que los jugadores ven t: The name players see your server by in their list.
The name your mod is known by.
textos.El nombre con el que te ven los demás en: The name others see you by on this server, and whether you are one of its administrators.
textos.El nombre de cada uno y su puntería, su: Each one's name and their aim, driving, nerves and loyalty. It's what counts when you plan a heist.
textos.El nombre de la banda tiene que tener al: The gang's name must have at least three letters.
textos.El nombre del archivo de la versión no e: The version file name is not valid.
textos.El nombre lo guarda el servidor, y lo ve: The name is stored by the server, and other players see it too.
textos.El nombre tal cual: Los Calaveras, Los L: The name exactly: Los Calaveras, Los Lagartos, Los Barrenos, Los Tiburones or Los Cuervos, or one from the Gangs section.
textos.El notario llega en autobús y hay vecino: The notary arrives by bus and some neighbors don't want him to make it to the signing.
textos.El notario llega en el autobús de las do: The notary arrives on the twelve o'clock bus. Escort him to the cooperative. Some neighbors are itching for a fight.
textos.El número premiado de ese día. Se premia: That day's winning number. Prizes go to the last digits that match it.
textos.El objetivo está dentro de un local: hay: The target is inside a building: you have to go in after them
textos.El objetivo huye en un vehículo: hay que: The target flees in a vehicle: you have to wreck it
textos.El objetivo, {quien}, está en {nombre} c: The target, {quien}, is at {nombre} with {n} escorts.
The target, {quien}, is at {nombre} with {n} bodyguards. Go there and fulfill the contract.
textos.El oficio de policía está desactivado. S: The police job is turned off. You can turn it on in Options, The street.
textos.El orujo del Bodeguero es lo único que s: The Winemaker's pomace brandy is the only thing that sells here in winter. Take these bottles to Amparo at El Ancla, and keep two for yourself.
textos.El otro aparato pasa rozándote. La torre: The other aircraft brushes past you. The tower opens a file on you.
textos.El otro día cayó una que para qué. Se me: The other day it poured like you wouldn't believe. My entryway flooded and I had to go out in my fishing boots.
textos.El otro día pararon a mi vecino por ir s: The other day they pulled over my neighbor for riding without lights on his bike. On his bike! He got a fifty euro fine. Now he walks and says at least he gets some exercise.
textos.El panel del servidor en línea que tenía: The online server panel you had open has opened again, with the server stopped, as it was.
textos.El pantalán de Isla Tortuga, al norte de: Isla Tortuga's jetty, on the north side of the island.
textos.El paquete de la versión contiene rutas: The version package contains paths that are not allowed. It will not be installed.
textos.El paquete de la versión es demasiado gr: The version package is too large.
textos.El paquete de la versión no contiene el: The version package does not contain the game.
textos.El parque de bomberos del polígono. Siem: The industrial estate's fire station. There is always a truck ready at the door.
textos.El paso se cumple cuando el jugador hace: The step is completed when the player really does that, not on arriving at a place. It works for tutorials.
textos.El patrón entra en la Taberna El Ancla y: The skipper walks into El Ancla Tavern and sits at the back, with his back to the door.
textos.El patrón te desliza los billetes por de: The skipper slides the bills to you under the table.
textos.El peatón te da la cartera: {botin} euro: The pedestrian hands you their wallet: {botin} euros, and runs off.
textos.El pedido tarda de {get} a {get2} minuto: The order takes {get} to {get2} game minutes
textos.El pedido tarda, como poco, estos minuto: The order takes at least this many game minutes
textos.El periodista coge el sobre y el reporta: The journalist takes the envelope and the story stays in a drawer.
textos.El periódico El Faro es el único que cue: The El Faro newspaper is the only one that tells the truth.
textos.El periódico del domingo tiene que estar: The Sunday paper has to be at four places before anyone can stop it.
textos.El periódico lo cuenta todo, menos lo im: The newspaper tells everything except what's important.
textos.El periódico tiene que estar en cuatro p: The newspaper has to be at four points in the city before dawn.
textos.El periódico va a publicar el nombre, y: The newspaper is going to publish the name, and at the Aguas del Ocaso headquarters they're destroying papers.
textos.El personaje de %s ocupa demasiado (%d K: %s's character is too big (%d KB) and is not saved: the previous one stays.
textos.El personaje se guarda solo cada minuto: The character saves by itself every minute and on exit. This saves it right now.
textos.El pescado, del día y a la plancha. No h: Fish, fresh from the day and grilled. There's no other secret.
textos.El piloto automático {v} cien metros par: The autopilot {v} one hundred meters to give way.
textos.El piloto no despega con la policía busc: The pilot won't take off with the police after you.
textos.El piloto se detiene: has llegado a {nom: The autopilot stops: you have arrived at {nombre}.
textos.El piso sigue igual: el hule de la mesa,: The apartment is just the same: the oilcloth on the table, the cuckoo clock, the photo of your father next to his taxi. You set the duffel bag on the floor. You are home.
textos.El plan se aprueba con dos cambios peque: The plan is approved with two small changes. On the way out, a councilman shakes your hand and gives you a card.
textos.El plan se vive allí: id a la hora. Si n: The plan happens there: go on time. If you don't show up, they'll take it badly
textos.El plano marca una galería nueva que pas: The plan shows a new tunnel running right under the lake. If they open it, half the mine and half the town will flood.
textos.El plato de los domingos. Lleva marisco: The Sunday dish. It uses fresh seafood, which you need to buy at a market or a supermarket.
textos.El plato está hecho: la loza en la mesa: The dish is ready: china on the table and cutlery.
textos.El plato sale de categoría: The dish comes out top quality
textos.El polvorín lleva veinte años cerrado y: The powder magazine has been closed for twenty years and since Monday there have been two guys hanging around. Nobody dares to look.
textos.El portero coge el sobre sin mirarte. Ya: The doorman takes the envelope without looking at you. You're part of the business now. Your substances are on the phone and under Shift Z. Remember: everything you take has an effect, a comedown and a risk of getting hooked.
textos.El portero del hotel abre las puertas tr: The hotel doorman opens the back doors, looks inside, whistles and puts an envelope in your hand without a word.
textos.El portero no te deja pasar: The bouncer won't let you in
textos.El portero te ha reconocido de las notic: The bouncer recognized you from the news and won't let you into the VIP area.
textos.El portero te para con la mano: «Así no: The bouncer stops you with a hand: "You're not coming in like that. Take a shower and come back."
The price slowly returns toward this.
textos.El prestamista entra en el casino por la: The loan shark enters the casino through the back door, like someone entering his own home.
textos.El prestamista está en boca de todos, pe: The loan shark is the talk of the town, but someone is still collecting for him. I'm told the envelopes are delivered at the ferry terminal.
textos.El prestamista guarda sus libros de cuen: The loan shark keeps his account books in the old factory. There are three men prowling around.
textos.El prestamista sabe de dónde viene lo ro: The pawnbroker knows where the stolen goods come from and pays less.
textos.El prestigio entre los vecinos sube con: Standing with the neighbors goes up with honest work, studies, donations, volunteering and good deeds. It goes down with crimes you are seen committing and with arrests.
textos.El prestigio sube con el trabajo honrado: Standing goes up with honest work, courses, donations and helping at incidents. It goes down with crimes. With good standing you earn more and the police are more understanding.
textos.El primero es el dos; un negocio recién: The first is two; a newly bought business is at one.
The first one is the start.
textos.El procesador de este equipo no puede co: This computer's processor can't handle the voice generator: it lacks
textos.El programa del juego venía en la descar: The game program was in the download, but it vanished right after being extracted: it is almost always the antivirus, which has quarantined it. Add the game folder to your antivirus exclusions and try again.
textos.El propio juego monta el servidor en tu: The game itself sets up the server on your computer. No other program is needed.
textos.El proveedor de Encarna te da las gracia: Encarna's supplier thanks you and takes out his wallet. What do you do?
textos.El próximo sorteo, tus boletos, comproba: The next draw, your tickets, checking whether you won and the latest winning numbers. The draw is every day at nine at night.
textos.El pueblo entero te debe una. Toma, la e: The whole town owes you one. Here, my father's shotgun, I can't see well enough to aim anymore. You'll put it to better use.
textos.El pueblo sabrá qué se guarda en el polv: The town will know what's kept in the powder magazine. You gain street reputation.
textos.El pueblo te debe una, Dani. El velero d: The town owes you one, Dani. My husband's sailboat is yours. It's moored at the pier.
textos.El pueblo te escucha. ¿Qué les dices?: The town is listening. What do you tell them?
textos.El puerto %s ya está abierto en tu route: Port %s is already open on your router. It will close by itself when the server stops.
textos.El puerto al amanecer es precioso. Tiene: The harbor at dawn is beautiful. You have to see it.
textos.El puerto deportivo de San Lucero, con s: San Lucero's marina, with its seafood restaurants and its yachts.
textos.El puerto deportivo de los turistas: yat: The tourists' marina: yachts, sailboats and jet skis.
The port the server listens on. It is the one to open on the router so people can come in from outside your home. With 0, the system picks a free one each time, which is only useful for testing.
textos.El puerto ya no es lo que era, pero sigu: The harbor isn't what it used to be, but it's still the heart of this place.
textos.El puesto al que subes con las evaluacio: The position you move up to with good evaluations. If it requires a degree or more standing, you aren't promoted until you have it.
textos.El punto más alto de la ciudad. Desde aq: The highest point in the city. From here you can see where it's green and where it isn't.
textos.El que conducía ese coche se llama Rubio: The man who drove that car is called Rubio, and he bets his paycheck racing on the Industrial Estate Straight. He says he'll only talk to whoever beats him.
textos.El que firma los pedidos paga bien por c: The one who signs the orders pays well for silence, and now he wants you to do him a favor.
textos.El que quiere trabajar, encuentra. Mal p: If you want to work, you find something. Badly paid, but you find it.
textos.El que se elige en el campo Surtido de u: The one chosen in the Stock field of a shop-type place. If it matches one from the game, it replaces it.
textos.El que tiene dinero aquí es porque no pr: Whoever has money here is someone who doesn't ask where it comes from.
Whoever's good, works. Plain and simple.
textos.El quiosco del parque reparte caldo cali: The park kiosk hands out hot broth to those who stand guard at night, and today it has nobody.
textos.El radar te sigue: mientras vueles por e: The radar is tracking you: as long as you fly above {alt} meters, they know where you are.
textos.El radar te sigue: vuela por debajo de: The radar is tracking you: fly below
textos.El radar. Mientras vueles por encima de: The radar. While you fly above {alta} meters, the radar tracks you: you can't shake the police, and if you land at a heliport or an airport, they are waiting for you. To make it lose you, fly below {alta} meters: {entero} seconds in a row over a town, or {entero2} on a crossing. If you climb again, it sees you again.
{quien}'s errand runner leaves {nombre}. Go there and follow them on foot, by ear, without getting too close and without losing them: they will lead you to the hideout.
textos.El recadero entra en {nombre}: ahí se es: The errand runner goes into {nombre}: that is where {quien} is hiding, with {n} bodyguards. Now, go get them.
textos.El recepcionista no admite huéspedes con: The receptionist won't take guests with the police on their tail.
textos.El registro de esta sesión está en la ca: This session's log is in the data folder, logs, {basename}. The last five sessions are kept, each in its own folder with the date and time; older ones are deleted automatically.
textos.El reparto. Cada uno cobra su parte del: The split. Everyone gets their cut of the loot at the end; altogether, at most {entero} percent. The rest is yours. Before starting, the menu tells you how much you'll keep.
textos.El reportaje no sale y los rumores se ca: The story doesn't run and the rumors die down. It's a bribe: the street will know that you pay.
textos.El rey de San Lucero eres tú: You are the King of San Lucero
textos.El ruido de los neumáticos de tu vehícul: The noise of your vehicle's tires. The faster you go, the louder it gets.
The rumor goes from zero to one hundred.
textos.El río de la ciudad, que es ahora un cam: The city's river, now a path of sand and stones. Kids play where people used to fish.
textos.El salón de plenos está lleno. En la ter: The council chamber is full. In the third row, Paulino with his students. At the back, standing, Salva. Aurora gives you a sign with her folder.
textos.El sargento te tira las llaves: «El de l: The sergeant tosses you the keys: "The one by the door is yours. And bring it back in one piece."
textos.El segundo cuesta el doble; el tercero,: The second costs double; the third, triple.
textos.El seguro de los vehículos se contrata e: Vehicle insurance is taken out on the phone, under My vehicles. Every midnight it charges this for each of the player's land vehicles on the street; those in the garage don't pay. With zero, insurance is free.
textos.El seguro ya tiene {nombre} reparado, pe: The insurance has {nombre} repaired, but you are short of the {franquicia} euros deductible. They hold it for you until you have it.
textos.El servidor en línea avisa a los jugador: The online server warns the players and closes.
textos.El servidor está arrancando. La primera: The server is starting. The first time it takes a few seconds, because it creates its certificate.
textos.El servidor está parado, así que no hay: The server is stopped, so there are no players to warn. The panel closes by itself, the game updates and, when done, the panel opens again by itself, minimized and with the server stopped, as it was. If the update fails, the panel still opens again, with the version you had. Everything is noted in the actualizacion dot log file in the logs folder.
textos.El servidor está parado: arráncalo con F: The server is stopped: start it with F5 to be able to do that.
textos.El servidor está parando y guardándolo t: The server is stopping and saving everything.
textos.El servidor ha recogido la orden: avisa: The server has picked up the order: it warns the players with a countdown, saves everything and stops. The games will wait and come back in on their own when you start it again.
The server has picked up the order: it warns the players, saves everything and stops.
textos.El servidor ha vuelto, pero ahora mismo: The server is back, but it's full right now.
textos.El servidor lleva la cuenta del dinero: The server keeps track of money
textos.El servidor no ha aceptado los datos de: The server didn't accept your game version's data, or cut the connection upon receiving it. Try again in a moment.
textos.El servidor no presenta el mismo certifi: The server does not present the same certificate as last time
textos.El servidor no reconoce {sobra} euros de: The server doesn't recognize {sobra} euros of what you're carrying, and they're removed.
The server doesn't recognize {sobra} euros of what you're carrying, and they're removed. On a server you can't earn more than a set amount per hour outside missions and what other players give you.
The server does not let you in.
textos.El servidor no tenía mundo: toma, de mom: The server had no world: for now it takes the one %s brings, from version %s, which is not signed by the game's publisher. It will replace it with the first signed one that arrives.
textos.El servidor pasa a los datos de la versi: The server switches to the data of version %s of the game. Anyone with another version will have to install this one to come back in.
The server switches to the data of version %s of the game. Anyone with an earlier version can keep playing: they will hear and see the new things as the closest thing their game knows.
textos.El servidor recuerda los últimos vehícul: The server remembers the last vehicles you left on the street, up to the per-player maximum it has set, and for the number of hours it has set. Another player can take them. Anything you want to keep, put in a garage.
textos.El servidor retira {sobra} euros que no: The server removes {sobra} euros it doesn't recognize.
textos.El servidor se está reiniciando por mant: The server is restarting for maintenance.
textos.El servidor se está reiniciando. Prueba: The server is restarting. Try again in a moment.
textos.El servidor se ha cerrado para actualiza: The server has shut down to update.
textos.El servidor se ha cerrado un momento por: The server has shut down for a moment for maintenance.
textos.El servidor se ha parado por un error: %: The server stopped because of an error: %s: %s
textos.El servidor se para un momento para rest: The server stops for a moment to restore a backup.
textos.El servidor se reinicia para actualizars: The server is restarting to update. It will be back in a few minutes: come back in then.
textos.El servidor se reinicia por mantenimient: The server is restarting for maintenance. It will be back in a few minutes: come back in then.
textos.El servidor te ingresa la nómina en el b: The server deposits your paycheck in the bank: {n} euros
textos.El servidor todavía no paga esta nómina:: The server doesn't pay this paycheck yet: according to its calendar, {int} days to go.
textos.El servidor trabaja con el mundo de la v: The server works with the world of the newest version it has seen, and talks to each game about what its version knows: a weapon or vehicle it does not have reaches it as the closest of its own.
textos.El servidor va con los datos de la versi: The server runs with the data of game version {version} and you have {VERSION}: you play together, each with what their version knows
The server runs with the data of game version {version}, the same as yours
textos.El sindicato necesita llevar algo urgent: The union needs to get something urgent to Puerto Bravo, and there's only one fast way.
textos.El sitio, el vehículo o la persona que p: The place, vehicle or person the mission or job asks for now, with its name as it appears on the map. Enter marks it on the GPS, dropping any detour. Without opening this list, it is done with Shift O.
textos.El soborno al inspector sale bien: The bribe to the inspector goes well
textos.El sobrino del capitán vende barcos. Bar: The captain's nephew sells boats. Not cheap, but good.
textos.El sol se mete en el mar y {n} apoya la: The sun sets into the sea and {n} rests their head on your shoulder.
textos.El sueldo llega justo a fin de mes, y a: My paycheck barely lasts to the end of the month, and sometimes not even that.
The pump is filling the tank.
textos.El taller de El Chispas. Arregla, pinta: El Chispas's repair shop. Fixes, paints and, if needed, swaps license plates.
textos.El tamaño del archivo de la versión no e: The version file size is not valid.
textos.El tanto por ciento del dinero de bolsil: The percentage of pocket money lost by whoever falls to another player.
The percentage of pocket money taken by whoever robs another player.
textos.El tanto por ciento del precio que recup: The percentage of the price recovered by whoever sells their house or business to the market.
textos.El taxi te deja en {nombre} por {coste}: The taxi drops you at {nombre} for {coste} euros. It is {hora_txt}.
textos.El teléfono del gestor ya no existe. Ni: The fixer's phone number no longer exists. Neither does your money.
textos.El tendero repasa la cuenta: son {total}: The shopkeeper goes over the bill: it's {total} and you have {dinero}. You are {falta} short. Put something back from the basket.
textos.El tendero te ha visto por el espejo del: The shopkeeper saw you in the ceiling mirror. Police! You run out with everything.
textos.El tendero vacía la caja sobre el mostra: The shopkeeper empties the till onto the counter without looking at you.
textos.El tendero y la caja registradora. Aquí: The shopkeeper and the cash register. Pay for the basket here; without a basket, they serve you for everything else.
textos.El tesoro del Tuerto existe, y la mitad: One-Eye's treasure exists, and half of it is yours. What do you do with your share?
textos.El texto completo de la licencia está en: The full text of the license is on the project's page.
textos.El texto de la licencia de Phonon va con: The text of the Phonon license comes with the game, in the file LICENCIA Phonon Gradium, and in the folder data, phonon.
textos.El tiempo está loco. Ya no hay estacione: The weather's gone crazy. There are no seasons anymore.
textos.El tiempo pasa de golpe: duermes, te esc: Time jumps ahead: you sleep, hide or wait.
textos.El tipo de local que la vende. Sin valor: The type of business that sells it. With no value, in gun shops. Ammunition is also bought in gun shops, wherever the weapon is sold.
textos.El tipo de lugar: tienda, bar, banco, ci: The type of place: shop, bar, bank, cinema... Types without opening hours are always open.
textos.El tono de sus gritos. Sin valor, cada u: The pitch of their shouts. With no value, each one has their own.
textos.El tope de coches en una misma localidad: The cap on cars in the same town when there are players spread over many zones. With 0 there is no cap.
textos.El tope de peatones en una misma localid: The cap on pedestrians in the same town when there are players spread over many zones. With 0 there is no cap.
textos.El trabajo, como siempre: mucho y mal pa: Work is the same as always: a lot of it, and badly paid.
textos.El tranvía arranca: dos toques de campan: The tram pulls out: two rings of the bell.
textos.El tranvía frena detrás de ti y espera a: The tram brakes behind you and waits for you to clear the tracks.
textos.El tranvía no tiene otra parada a la que: The tram has no other stop to take you to from here.
textos.El tranvía recorre las paradas por este: The tram runs through the stops in this order, from lowest to highest, and after the last one goes back to the first. If you leave it empty on all the town's stops, the game orders them going around the city.
textos.El tranvía recorre {nombre}. Hay {len} p: The tram runs through {nombre}. There are {len} stops. Choose where you want to get off
textos.El tranvía va parando en cada parada y l: The tram stops at every stop and announces it. During the ride, Enter gets you off at the next one, even if it isn't the one you chose.
textos.El tren llega a todas las localidades a: The train reaches every town you can get to by land
textos.El tren pita dos veces. Doña Remedios su: The train whistles twice. Doña Remedios boards the car without letting go of the handrail and without looking back.
textos.El tren te deja en {nombre}. Son las {ho: The train drops you at {nombre}. It is {hora_txt}.
textos.El tren, el tranvía y la cabina del avió: The train, the tram and the plane cockpit play in a loop, just like the engines.
textos.El trozo de playa donde los jubilados pa: The stretch of beach where retirees sweep their metal detectors. They say coins from a shipwreck still turn up.
textos.El tráfico, la gente de la calle, la pol: Traffic, people on the street, the police and the characters the server runs.
textos.El turno sale adelante. El nuevo sigue s: The shift goes on. The new guy still doesn't know, and you end up wiped out.
The shift goes on. He doesn't learn.
textos.El valle es de quien lo trabaja. Toma, y: The valley belongs to those who work it. Here you go, and you keep the shotgun.
textos.El valor de cada carácter está en la sec: The value of each personality is in the People's personalities section, from 0 to 1.
textos.El vehículo echa humo y se queda cruzado: The vehicle is smoking and stuck across the road. Get close and press Enter.
The vehicle is in perfect shape.
textos.El vehículo ha quedado destrozado, con e: The vehicle is wrecked, with the driver inside.
The vehicle has taken too much damage.
textos.El vehículo sale a la calle, aparcado ju: The vehicle comes out to the street, parked next to the house. It is still yours: it isn't lost even if you go away.
textos.El vehículo ya no puede más: The vehicle can't take any more
textos.El vehículo, que tiene que tener marcada: The vehicle, which must have the flies box ticked. With the identifier of one in the game, your mod changes how that one flies.
textos.El verano es para los de fuera. Los de a: Summer is for the out-of-towners. We locals work.
textos.El viaje ha sido movido: te descuentan {: The trip was bumpy: {extra} euros are deducted.
textos.El viento en la cara, cuando vas en heli: Wind in your face, when you are in a helicopter.
The commercial flight is considered lost.
textos.El vuelo que llevas: qué transportas, ad: The flight you're on: what you're carrying, where to and what they pay. You get paid on landing at the destination airfield.
The buzz of a light plane propeller.
textos.El {cifras}, del día {sorteo}: premiado: Number {cifras}, from day {sorteo}: won {euros} euros for {que}. Collected
Number {cifras}, from day {sorteo}: won {euros} euros for {que}. {donde}. Expires in {caduca} {v}
textos.El {cifras}, del día {sorteo}: salió el: Number {cifras}, from day {sorteo}: {cifras2} came up. No prize
Sunday's referee was bought. Everybody saw it.
textos.El último camión de vino falso sale hoy: The last truck of fake wine leaves the valley today.
textos.El último de la lista es un tendero que: The last one on the list is a shopkeeper who can't make ends meet. Belmonte wants his money. What do you do?
textos.El último que has usado. Si tienes más,: The last one you used. If you have more, they're on the phone, in My vehicles.
textos.El único bar del pueblo. Aquí se sabe to: The only bar in the village. Everything is known here before it happens.
textos.El único periódico de la ciudad que no e: The only newspaper in the city that doesn't belong to Arizmendi. Nerea Ibarrola works here.
textos.El único sitio abierto de noche en toda: The only place open at night in the whole mountain range.
textos.Elegís la película a suertes. Pierdes tú: You pick the movie at random. You lose, but you end up liking it.
textos.Elegís la película en la cola, entre ris: You pick the movie in line, laughing, by elimination.
textos.Elige adónde vuelas y cómo llegas. La tr: Choose where you fly and how you get there. The crossing is flown for real, with autopilot if you want
textos.Elige antes a un jugador en la lista de: Select a player in the players list first.
textos.Elige antes una cuenta en la lista de cu: Select an account in the accounts list first.
Select an invitation in the list first.
textos.Elige cada letra con la cruceta arriba y: Choose each letter with D-pad up and down and type it with D-pad right. {n} accepts and {n2} cancels.
textos.Elige con las flechas izquierda y derech: Choose with the left and right arrow keys between the default sounds and the packs, which are the subfolders of data, sonidos. It applies immediately. Sounds the pack doesn't include keep playing with the original.
textos.Elige con qué tecla se hace cada cosa mi: Choose which key does each thing while you play. It helps if your keyboard is different, if you play with one hand or if a key clashes with your screen reader.
textos.Elige la copia que quieres restaurar. An: Choose the backup you want to restore. Before restoring, what is there now is saved to another backup, just in case.
textos.Elige otra de tus casas, de esta localid: Pick another of your homes, in this town or another, and you both move in there.
textos.Elige qué copiar de {lower}. Con el mism: Choose what to copy from {lower}. With the same identifier, your version will replace the original.
textos.Elige qué hará este botón: Choose what this button will do
Choose which mods the game loads.
Choose which part of the mod you want to edit. When you change section, the list of items below changes.
textos.Elige un servidor y pulsa Intro. F1 expl: Pick a server and press Enter. F1 explains each option
textos.Elige una de las cinco ranuras para guar: Choose one of the five slots to save the game as it is.
Choose one of the five slots to save the game as it is. You can't during a mission.
textos.Elige una de tus partidas guardadas y si: Choose one of your saved games and carry on from there. Anything you haven't saved in this game is lost.
textos.Elige una de tus partidas guardadas: el: Choose one of your saved games: the autosave, the quick save or one of the five slots.
textos.Elige una función y pulsa Intro. No se p: Pick a function and press Enter. Escape, Enter, F1, F12, the right Shift and the Ctrl and Alt keys can't be changed
textos.Elige una receta. Gasta sus ingredientes: Pick a recipe. It uses up its ingredients, from what is stored here or what you brought, and takes its game time. It makes several portions: you eat one and the rest go in the fridge. Cooked food is far more filling than packaged food, and with practice it turns out better.
textos.Eliges con qué personaje juegas y empiez: You choose which character you play and start the story from the beginning. Your saved games are not touched.
textos.Eliges cuál. Tu personaje no se borra: s: You choose which one. Your character is not deleted: it stays saved on that server.
textos.Eliges de la carta, pagas el pedido y el: You choose from the menu, pay for the order and the delivery, and a while later the doorbell rings. It takes away the hunger and thirst of realistic life and gives some health. While you are in this menu time doesn't pass: go to the door and wait nearby.
textos.Eliges destino, la torre te da salida y: You choose a destination, the tower clears you and the crossing begins.
textos.Eliges el destino y el taxi te lleva. El: You choose the destination and the taxi takes you. The price depends on the distance, and the time of the trip goes by. They won't take you if the police are after you or during a mission.
textos.Eliges el destino. Quien llega primero s: You pick the destination. Whoever arrives first takes everyone's bets.
You pick the destination. Whoever arrives first takes the bets.
textos.Eliges la hora y quedáis en un bar de su: You pick the time and you meet up at a bar in their town. If you go, you pay, you become better friends, your mood goes up, and they tell you what people are saying around here.
textos.Eliges qué hace cada botón cuando conduc: You choose what each button does while you drive. Changes are saved right away.
textos.Eliges qué hace cada botón cuando vas an: You choose what each button does while you are on foot. Changes are saved right away.
textos.Eliges un sitio de esta localidad y el t: You choose a place in this town and the taxi takes you. The price and the hours that go by depend on the distance. With the police after you or in the middle of a mission, it won't pick you up.
You choose an option from a menu.
textos.Eliges uno de los vehículos que guardas: You choose one of the vehicles you keep in your garages, in any town, and your mechanic leaves it in the street, next to you.
textos.Elimina el elemento seleccionado; pide c: Deletes the selected item; asks for confirmation.
textos.Eliminar al objetivo y a sus guardaespal: Eliminate the target and their bodyguards
textos.Embarcadero de Costa Dorada, desde el ma: Costa Dorada Pier, from the sea
textos.Embarcadero donde se amarran los barcos: Pier where purchased boats are moored
textos.Embargo: debes {euros} euros. Desde hoy: Seizure: you owe {euros} euros. From today, half of your paychecks and of what your businesses earn is withheld until the debt is paid, and the neighbours are talking.
textos.Embotelladora, depósito y sede. Cuatro m: Bottling plant, depot and headquarters. Four minutes.
Tie at {yo}. You get your bet back.
Tie. You get your bet back.
textos.Empezar a trabajar con un vehículo de tr: Start working with a work vehicle, with J
textos.Empezáis de broma, con cosquillas y almo: You start playfully, with tickling and pillows, and end up out of breath for other reasons.
textos.Empezáis tres películas y no acabáis nin: You start three movies and don't finish any.
textos.Empezáis una relación: dos latidos y un: You start a relationship: two heartbeats and an arpeggio.
textos.Empieza a correr el rumor de que llevas: A rumor starts going around that you live a double life. While it lasts, it will cost you more to win the neighbours over.
textos.Empieza a llover. El asfalto mojado alar: It starts to rain. The wet asphalt lengthens braking distances.
textos.Empieza al momento: pasa por los puntos: It starts right away: go through the checkpoints before time runs out. The first time you win it you get the whole prize; after that, a third.
textos.Empieza esta misión del buen camino. Es: Start this right-path mission. It's a separate story, played without committing crimes: nobody forces you to follow it, and it will keep waiting for you here.
textos.Empieza la historia con el personaje tal: Starts the story with the character as it is.
A fight starts in the gym.
textos.Empieza un día nuevo: cobras tus negocio: A new day begins: you collect from your businesses and prices change.
textos.Empiezas a abrir: {txt}. Tardará unos {i: You start opening it: {txt}. It will take about {int} seconds. Stay next to it; if you move away, it stops.
textos.Empiezas a cocinar: el cuchillo picando: You start cooking: the knife chopping on the board.
textos.Empiezas a jugar al momento, con el GPS: You start playing right away, with the GPS set to the bar where the story begins. The keys are always on F1.
textos.Empiezas a necesitar {lower}. Si pasas u: You are starting to need {lower}. If you go a day without taking it, you will feel it: worse aim, worse mood and more damage. A hospital can detox you.
textos.Empiezas a trabajar de {v}. Pulsa J otra: You start working as {v}. Press J again to finish.
textos.Empiezas con buen ánimo, algo de fama y: You start in a good mood, with some street reputation and the neighbors' respect: you earn more from honest jobs and the police overlook your minor offenses.
textos.Empiezas con lo puesto y un botiquín. Pa: You start with the clothes on your back and a first aid kit. For those who want a tougher game.
textos.Empiezas con más salud, veinte puntos má: You start with more health, twenty points more, and two first aid kits.
You start with eight hundred euros.
textos.Empiezas con tres juegos de ganzúas, par: You start with three lockpick sets, to open vehicles without breaking the glass.
textos.Empiezas con una navaja y dos botiquines: You start with a switchblade and two first aid kits.
textos.Empiezas de nuevo con lo que tenías: {di: You start over with what you had: {dinero} euros, {len} weapons and {len2} properties. This is your run number {v}: mission enemies are a bit tougher.
textos.Empiezas la historia desde el principio: You start the story from the beginning with the money, the weapons, the properties and everything else you had in this game. The saved game is not touched.
textos.Empiezas la historia desde el principio,: You start the story from the beginning, but with the money, weapons, skills, homes, vehicles and boats of a saved game. Mission enemies are a bit tougher each time. The saved game is not touched.
textos.Empiezas la partida con este personaje y: You start the game with this character and their advantages.
textos.Empiezas una tanda de {lower}. Oirás un: You start a batch of {lower}. You'll hear a steady tone and another one that moves. With up arrow and down arrow, match yours to the steady one and hold it. It lasts {int} seconds. Escape cuts it short.
textos.Empiezas ya. Lo que falte se irá prepara: You start now. Whatever is missing will be prepared while you play.
textos.Empleo de confianza: pide la ficha limpi: Position of trust: requires a clean record
textos.Empujas la puerta de {nombre} y se acaba: You push open the door of {nombre} and the music stops. {quien} has recognized you.
textos.En Bahía del Ocaso, un garaje del Cauce: In Bahía del Ocaso, a garage in the Cauce Seco is looking for a tanker driver.
textos.En Bodegas Hermanos Olmedo falta gente p: At Hermanos Olmedo Winery they're short of people to get the grapes in before the storm.
textos.En Cala Brava, por la carretera de la co: In Cala Brava, along the coast road, an old captain is looking for crew.
textos.En El Ancla. Pues ya sé con quién tengo: At El Ancla. Well, now I know who I need to talk to. Thanks.
textos.En La Gaviota ponen las mejores tapas de: La Gaviota serves the best tapas in the neighborhood.
textos.En La Lumbre, Olalla quiere que alguien: At La Lumbre, Olalla wants an outsider to try her liqueur.
textos.En Monteferro se corre de noche por la c: In Monteferro they race at night on the mine road. Whoever wins is owed a favor.
textos.En Monteferro, la ciudad minera de la si: In Monteferro, the mining town in the mountains, the union is looking for outside help.
textos.En Opciones, Registro para informar de f: In Options, Log for reporting bugs, it explains which folder to attach.
textos.En Radio Taxi Luna falta un chófer para: Radio Taxi Luna needs a driver for a special service.
textos.En San Lucero, la ciudad universitaria,: In San Lucero, the university city, Doña Remedios has a problem with a gang.
textos.En Villaseca nadie olvida quién dijo qué: In Villaseca nobody forgets who said what that afternoon.
textos.En agosto no cabe un alfiler en la playa: In August you can't fit a pin on the beach.
textos.En algún momento os quedáis callados, y: At some point you both go quiet, and it isn't awkward.
textos.En casa tiene comida y agua, y se le pas: At home it has food and water, and its fear wears off. From here you call it back to you.
At home it goes in the {donde_va}.
textos.En casa, el agua no falta: quita toda la: At home, water is never short: it quenches all your thirst.
textos.En conducción asistida el coche sigue su: In assisted driving the car follows its lane by itself. You accelerate with the up arrow and brake with the down arrow. Before an intersection, the left or right arrow turns on the turn signal and the car turns by itself.
textos.En conducción asistida, el coche frena s: In assisted driving, the car brakes by itself to avoid hitting the vehicle ahead. Hold A to overtake it.
textos.En conducción libre, te sales de la calz: In free driving, you run off the road on the side where it sounds.
textos.En cuanto coges el maletín, un hombre co: As soon as you grab the briefcase, a man with an earpiece points at you and shouts. It was a police trap!
textos.En el aire, a {int} metros. La D sube y: In the air, at {int} meters. D climbs and A descends.
textos.En el albarán hay un nombre conocido: Be: There's a familiar name on the delivery note: Belmonte.
textos.En el arrecife asoma con la marea baja u: At the reef, an antique anchor pokes out at low tide. At the boat dealer in Cala Brava they want it for the door.
textos.En el banco te han dado la mano. En la l: At the bank they shook your hand. At the fish market they asked about your business. At the casino they invited you for a drink. Nobody saw anything odd, because there was nothing to see.
textos.En el banco te piden que justifiques de: At the bank they ask you to justify where so much cash comes from. You cannot. They will only accept {ok} euros and they notify the tax authorities.
textos.En el bar se arregla el mundo todas las: At the bar, we fix the world every afternoon.
textos.En el barrio ya te aprecian. Salva, que: The neighborhood already likes you. Salva, who's run a bar all his life, wants to tell you what it takes to have something of your own.
textos.En el cajero solo se saca dinero. Para i: At the ATM you can only withdraw money. To deposit, go to a bank
textos.En el cartel más reciente reconoces tu c: On the most recent poster you recognize your face
textos.En el casino solo gana la casa. Y el del: At the casino only the house wins. And the coat check guy.
textos.En el cine de aquí las palomitas cuestan: At the cinema here the popcorn costs more than the ticket.
textos.En el control de seguridad hay dos agent: At the security checkpoint two officers are looking at a photo of you. Come back when you're no longer wanted.
textos.En el despacho del bingo hay un disco du: In the bingo hall office there's a hard drive with everything on it. I can't even open a can. You, on the other hand...
textos.En el fondo encuentras {nombre}. A la mo: At the bottom you find {nombre}. Into the backpack: a pawn shop will buy it from you.
You can train well at the gym here. And there are fights.
textos.En el gimnasio hay combates. Se apuesta: There are fights at the gym. They even bet on them.
textos.En el hangar de uno de esos campos contr: You rent the space at the hangar of one of those airfields. Then you'll be able to send it there from here.
textos.En el hospital te atienden bien. Cuando: At the hospital they treat you well. When they treat you.
textos.En el hotel. Ya sé en qué habitación pre: At the hotel. Now I know which room to ask about. I owe you a dozen churros.
textos.En el mar no hay calles, así que oriénta: At sea there are no streets, so find your way with the GPS: press L, choose a pier or a buoy, and follow the beacon. Tab tells you what is around you: piers, buoys and other boats.
textos.En el mar no hay calles: tú llevas el ti: There are no streets at sea: you steer with the arrow keys and the GPS calls out the heading. The beacon sounds toward where you need to go.
textos.En el menú del embarcadero puedes alquil: In the pier menu you can rent a boat, set sail with a boat of your own if you have one, or take one without permission. When you set sail you appear at sea, on board.
textos.En el mercado de San Lucero ya no hay qu: At the San Lucero market nobody has to be paid to unload anymore. Remedios says it's your doing. This year we sell there without middlemen.
textos.En el mercado está todo más barato, si s: Everything is cheaper at the market, if you know how to haggle.
textos.En el mercado se compra mejor y más bara: You buy better and cheaper at the market.
textos.En el móvil aparecen Vida social y Susta: Social life and Substances appear on the phone, and nightclubs and suppliers in the cities. You can turn it off from the options whenever you like.
textos.En el periódico quieren saber adónde va: At the newspaper they want to know where the Barrio Viejo loan shark goes every afternoon.
textos.En el proveedor, esa sustancia hoy está: At the supplier, that substance is very cheap today.
At the supplier, that substance is very expensive today.
textos.En el pueblo de Villaseca, al norte, la: In the town of Villaseca, to the north, the cooperative is looking for an outsider.
textos.En el pueblo de montaña de Fuentefría, m: In the mountain village of Fuentefría, beyond Monteferro, the spa has a problem.
textos.En el puerto hay una trastienda donde se: In the harbor there's a back room where a different kind of product moves.
textos.En el puerto siempre hace falta gente pa: At the harbor they always need people to load.
Nobody lasts two rounds against me in the ring.
There's nowhere to fight in that neighborhood.
That neighborhood has no standing guard.
textos.En esta ciudad se puede vivir de dos man: In this city you can live in two ways, and both pay. One pays fast and charges you for all of it. The other takes its time, but what you earn is yours and nobody comes to take it.
textos.En esta localidad no hay casas ni negoci: In this town there are no homes or businesses that can be bought
textos.En esta localidad no hay ningún sitio fi: In this town there is no fixed place to find {v}. You'll have to buy it, or borrow it.
textos.En esta localidad no hay sitios suficien: This town doesn't have enough places for a delivery run.
textos.En esta localidad no se corre ninguna ca: No race is run in this town.
textos.En esta sesión no hay registro: no se ha: There is no log in this session: it was not possible to write to the data folder.
textos.En este grupo no hay nada ahora mismo. P: There is nothing in this group right now. Try another group or All places.
textos.En este servidor hay cosas que tu versió: This server has things your version of the game does not have. %s. You will hear and see them as the closest thing your game knows; they do the damage the server sets, the same for everyone.
textos.En este servidor la policía la lleva el: On this server the police are run by the server, and with them there is no surrendering with your hands up.
textos.En este servidor los canales de rol está: Role-play channels are turned off on this server: there are no profiles.
Role-play channels are turned off on this server: use the usual chat.
textos.En este servidor no hay combate entre ju: There is no player-versus-player combat on this server.
There is no passive mode on this server.
textos.En este servidor no hay nóminas de contr: There are no paychecks for permanent contracts on this server.
textos.En este servidor no hay tope de ganancia: This server has no earnings cap: your game handles the money
textos.En este servidor no se roba a otros juga: On this server you cannot rob other players.
In euros, from the gang's till.
textos.En fiestas no duerme nadie. Ni quien qui: Nobody sleeps during the festival. Not even those who want to.
textos.En fiestas se corre con lo que tenga rue: At festivals they race anything with wheels.
During the festival, I'm the king.
textos.En final. Bien encarado. Autorizado a at: On final. Well lined up. Cleared to land.
textos.En grupo, los enemigos de tus misiones s: In a group, the enemies of your missions are shared, you can't hurt each other, and whoever helps you gets half the reward.
textos.En guerra: es territorio tuyo, pero {ban: At war: it's your territory, but {banda} is attacking it.
textos.En guerra: es territorio tuyo, pero {v}: At war: it's your territory, but {v} is raiding it.
At war: you're contesting it with {v}.
At war: {get} is contesting it with {get2}.
textos.En hora punta se tarda más en coche que: At rush hour it takes longer by car than on foot.
textos.En la Cantina del Barrenero, un minero j: At the Driller's Canteen, a retired miner says there are lights in the closed mine at night.
textos.En la Cantina del Salinero, Chelo dice q: At the Salt Worker's Canteen, Chelo says the supply boat hasn't come in two weeks.
textos.En la Luna Llena, Darío necesita que alg: At Luna Llena, Darío needs someone to pick up an order before the club opens.
textos.En la Sala Crepúsculo, Jimena necesita u: At the Crepúsculo Hall, Jimena needs a discreet errand.
textos.En la Sala Marejada, Marina necesita que: At Sala Marejada, Marina needs someone to carry a box without asking questions.
textos.En la Taberna El Ancla, Amparo necesita: At El Ancla Tavern, Amparo needs someone who isn't from the town.
textos.En la academia dan cursos. Nunca es tard: They give courses at the academy. It's never too late to learn.
textos.En la acera hay una cartera. Dentro, un: There's a wallet on the sidewalk. Inside, an ID, some photos and quite a few bills.
textos.En la armería venden de todo, con papele: The gun shop sells everything, with papers or without, depending on who you ask.
textos.En la bolsa compras acciones de las empr: On the stock market you buy shares in the companies of the region. You gain if you sell them for more than they cost you, and you lose if you sell them for less. Prices move every midnight: some companies a little, others a lot, and every now and then a piece of news makes them jump. Some pay dividends every {entero} days: a percentage of what each share is worth, which arrives in your bank without selling anything. What happens in the story also moves them. While you hold shares, every midnight the game tells you how much they are worth and how much you gain or lose.
There are %d euros in the till.
textos.En la caja hay {caja} euros: There are {caja} euros in the till
textos.En la caja hay, como poco: There is at least this much in the till
textos.En la casa de empeños dan algo por él. S: The pawn shop will pay something for it. If they see you, bad news.
textos.En la colina hay unos chavales con motos: On the hill there are some kids with motorcycles, Los Vigías. They watch the villas for peanuts and know who goes in and out of every house.
textos.En la colina riegan los jardines mientra: On the hill they water the gardens while we line up here with jugs.
textos.En la ermita no hay nadie, pero se oye u: There's nobody at the chapel, but you can hear a grinder below, at the spring. Go down and throw them out.
At the station they'll tell you.
textos.En la farmacia del barrio faltan cajas c: At the neighborhood pharmacy boxes go missing every week, and the pharmacist suspects someone in the house.
textos.En la fuente te esperan seis vendimiador: At the spring, six grape pickers are waiting for you sitting on the basin. The last bread is broken by hand.
textos.En la guantera hay {objeto}. Te lo guard: There is {objeto} in the glove box. You take it.
textos.En la heladería de enfrente, mirando hac: At the ice cream parlor across the street, looking this way. I don't want you to do anything serious to him. Just make him understand it's over.
textos.En la libreta están todos los taxis de l: The notebook lists every taxi in the city, and at the end a license plate underlined twice.
textos.En la lonja de San Lucero ya no se paga: At the San Lucero fish market nobody gets paid to unload anymore. Doña Remedios chairs the market board and always saves you the first plate. All that's left of Los Lagartos is half-faded graffiti.
textos.En la lonja, a primera hora, se ve lo me: At the fish market, first thing in the morning, you see the best stuff.
textos.En la mesa están el concejal, el hombre: At the table sit the councilman, the man from the fund and the second in command of Los Lagartos. All three look at you.
textos.En la mesa, los extremos son {izq} y {de: On the table, the ends are {izq} and {der}. You have {len} tiles left; your rival, {len2}; in the boneyard, {len3}.
textos.En la misma casa o la misma red: {deletr: In the same home or the same network: {deletrear}
textos.En la nevera no cabe más: te llevas {_cu: The fridge can't hold any more: you take {_cuantos} with you, in a lunch box.
textos.En la oficina de empleo eliges la empres: At the job center you choose the company and see its positions, what they pay and what they require.
textos.En la oficina de empleo hay alguien que: At the job center there's someone who doesn't ask where you come from, but where you want to go.
textos.En la oficina de empleo te dan número y: At the job center they give you a number and hope, and not much else.
textos.En la pantalla de espera de un servidor:: On a server's waiting screen: A or Cross repeats the status, B or Circle stops waiting, and Y or Triangle explains it
textos.En la pared, un banco de herramientas bi: On the wall, a well-stocked tool bench.
textos.En la pelea cae uno de los tuyos: te que: One of yours falls in the fight: you have {banda} left.
On the beach, I'm the most tanned.
textos.En la protectora siempre hay perros busc: At the shelter there are always dogs looking for a home.
textos.En la puerta de la desaladora hay una ci: At the desalination plant door there's one of their tankers, full, waiting to go up and water hedges in Los Miradores.
textos.En la puerta del ayuntamiento hay tres h: At the town hall door there are three men who are not civil servants.
textos.En la puerta te miran de arriba abajo y: At the door they look you up and down and wrinkle their noses. You're not getting in today.
