textos.En la salida, con {n_riv} {v}. Son {len}: At the start, with {n_riv} {v}. There are {len} points. Ready.
textos.En la taquilla hay un cartel con tu cara: There's a poster with your face at the ticket office. Better not.
textos.En la verbena del año pasado bailé hasta: At last year's street party I danced until five. With my knee. I couldn't go down the stairs for a week, but it was worth it.
textos.En las afueras: una terminal pequeña, un: On the outskirts: a small terminal, a runway and a hangar. Passenger planes leave for the other cities, and light planes and helicopters are for rent.
At the festival I dance until they throw me out.
textos.En las persecuciones con límite de tiemp: In timed chases. With zero, none.
textos.En las tiendas te rebajan un {entero} po: In shops you get {entero} percent off and they give you credit up to {hon_fiado_limite} euros; the neighbours sometimes look the other way, and if your record is clean an officer gives you the benefit of the doubt once a day
textos.En los cruces con semáforo se oye si pue: At intersections with traffic lights you hear whether you can cross. When you turn it on, a sample plays.
textos.En los cruces suena el semáforo: un tict: At intersections you hear the traffic light: a fast tick means you can cross the street on foot to the north or south. A slow chirp means you can cross the avenue east or west.
textos.En los menús: cruceta o palanca izquierd: In menus: D-pad or left stick to move
textos.En los recreativos de San Lucero hay una: At the San Lucero arcade a little girl has gotten lost and won't let go of her balloon.
textos.En los servidores en los que entres por: On servers you enter for the first time, you will be called {v}.
textos.En los textos de la historia sustituye a: In the story texts it replaces Dani.
textos.En mano, como siempre. A domicilio cuest: In person, as always. Delivery costs a fee and a bit less is appreciated.
In hand: they have to be next to you.
textos.En media hora llega la asistencia y te e: Assistance arrives in half an hour and puts {LITROS_ASISTENCIA} liters in.{combustible_txt}
textos.En mi familia somos todos igual de guapo: In my family we're all equally good looking. What can I tell you.
textos.En mi sitio. Desde aquí veo las dos esqu: In my spot. From here I can see both corners.
textos.En minúscula. Admite las marcas de géner: In lowercase. Accepts gender markers: waiter.
textos.En mis tiempos llovía cuando tenía que l: In my day it rained when it was supposed to rain.
There are no taxis in the middle of the sea.
textos.En mitad del mar no puede venir nadie a: Nobody can come pick you up in the middle of the sea.
textos.En mitad del mar no pueden llegar hasta: In the middle of the sea they can't reach you.
textos.En mitad del mar no te pueden traer un v: They can't bring you a vehicle in the middle of the sea.
textos.En mitad del mar, {perro} no puede llega: In the middle of the sea, {perro} can't reach you.
textos.En modo brújula el oído mira siempre al: In compass mode your hearing always faces north. With turns, the sound turns with you.
textos.En modo pasivo no puedes atracar a nadie: In passive mode you cannot rob anyone.
textos.En modo pasivo no puedes herir a otros j: In passive mode you can't hurt other players and they can't hurt you. It can't be changed in the middle of a fight, nor more than once every two minutes.
textos.En orden alfabético. Pulsa una letra par: In alphabetical order. Press a letter to jump, Enter to choose and F1 for the description
textos.En persona, charlar os acerca más que un: In person, chatting brings you closer than a call. Once a day.
textos.En persona, una vez al día. Si te escuch: In person, once a day. If they listen to you, the wound heals sooner; if not, pushing today is no use.
textos.En persona: elige el plan y se viene con: In person: choose the plan and they come with you; the plan happens when you get there. If you're not together, suggest meeting up.
textos.En plazas, parques, playas y muelles: me: In squares, parks, beaches and piers: meters inside the block. At sea: absolute coordinates.
textos.En plena vendimia nadie baja al pueblo a: In the middle of the harvest nobody goes down to town for bread. The baker needs someone with wheels.
textos.En puntos de delito: un golpe a un coche: In crime points: hitting a car is one; a gunshot, more.
textos.En qué idioma escribe el servidor lo que: The language the server uses for what its admin reads: the console, the log, the command help and the comments of servidor.conf. What players hear does not change: the server sends it to them in Spanish and each player's game says it in their own language, so people with different languages can play on the same server. If the server runs inside the panel, it speaks the game's language.
textos.En qué lado de la manzana está la puerta: Which side of the block the door is on. Leave it with no value if you use an interior position.
textos.En seguir, adonde va la persona. En esco: For follow, where the person goes. For escort, where they must be taken. The Place field holds the starting point.
textos.En singular y en plural, separados por u: In singular and plural, separated by a bar: grenade|grenades, rocket|rockets. Empty, bullet|bullets.
textos.En su menú sale el cajero, para sacar di: Its menu shows the ATM, to withdraw money from the bank. What you buy is paid with what you carry.
textos.En su punto exacto. Te sientes orgullos[: Cooked to perfection. You feel proud.
textos.En tiendas, bares, restaurantes, gimnasi: In shops, bars, restaurants, gyms, repair shops and other venues it already plays without checking anything: each venue has its own radio station, quietly. Check it to put one in a place of another type.
textos.En tu cuenta aparecen {euros} euros de u: {euros} euros appear in your account from a company you do not know. The fixer has delivered.
textos.En tus casas puedes guardar la partida,: At your homes you can save the game, rest to recover health and leave vehicles in the garage. Press Enter at the door to go in.
textos.En un banco del paseo alguien se ha deja: On a bench along the promenade someone has left a phone, and it's ringing.
Only aircraft can be kept in a hangar.
textos.En un mismo servidor pueden jugar juntos: Players with different game versions can play together on the same server. Each one sees and uses what their version knows: what only a newer version has is not seen by those on an older one.
textos.En un pedido caben {tope} cosas como muc: An order holds {tope} items at most.
textos.En un registro, de cada cien veces, cuán: On a raid, out of every hundred times, how many shut down the lab
textos.En un servidor con canales de rol: cuent: On a server with role-play channels: you narrate an action, and those nearby hear your name and what you do.
textos.En un servidor con canales de rol: lo qu: On a server with role-play channels: what your character says. Only those nearby hear it.
textos.En un servidor en línea es distinto: los: On an online server it is different: neighborhoods belong to the players' gangs, and gangs fight over them from the server menu. What is in this menu is for playing offline.
textos.En un servidor en línea la banda es de j: On an online server the gang belongs to players: you don't recruit people off the street.
textos.En un servidor en línea los golpes no se: On an online server heists aren't prepared with the gang: there, your crew are the other players, and the loot and the police are handled by the server. The usual robbery still works.
textos.En un servidor en línea no hay contratos: On an online server there are no permanent contracts, loans, taxes or business management: the server controls the money.
textos.En un servidor en línea no hay créditos,: On an online server there are no loans, taxes or business management: the server controls the money. There are permanent contracts, with the paycheck paid by the server.
textos.En un servidor en línea no hay impuestos: On an online server there are no taxes or bills.
textos.En un servidor en línea no se alquilan c: Houses cannot be rented out on an online server: the server handles the money.
textos.En un servidor en línea no se asalta a l: Suppliers cannot be hit on an online server.
textos.En un servidor en línea no se llevan ant: On an online server criminal records aren't kept.
textos.En un servidor en línea no se negocia co: On an online server you don't negotiate with these gangs: there, the neighborhoods belong to the players' gangs.
textos.En un servidor en línea no se puede: all: You can't on an online server: there, fights are with other players and their gangs.
textos.En un servidor en línea se vuela igual y: On an online server you fly the same and the hangars work, but there are no hijackings or commercial flights.
textos.En un servidor en línea y jugando con am: On an online server and playing with friends, heists aren't prepared with the gang: the usual robbery still works.
On an online server, playing with friends, there are no commercial flights: the server handles the money.
On an online server, playing with friends, you can't hijack aircraft: the server handles the police and the money.
textos.En un servidor que lleva la cuenta del d: On a server that keeps track of money, what you earn on your own has an hourly cap. Story missions, what the server gives you or other players give you, and repeatable jobs the server recognizes do not count against it. Anything over the cap is withheld, and the game tells you how much.
textos.En un servidor, alguien habla como jugad: On a server, someone speaks as a player and not as their character: two dry wooden knocks. The whole server hears it.
textos.En un servidor, alguien que está cerca c: On a server, someone nearby describes what their character does, for example opening a door: a short rustle topped with a note.
textos.En un servidor, alguien que está cerca h: On a server, someone nearby speaks as their character, or you do: two deep, warm notes, slower than the normal message ones.
textos.En un servidor, cada casa y cada negocio: On a server, each home and each business belongs to a single player. Here is what is still free, what another player sells at their price, and who owns the rest.
textos.En un servidor, cada negocio es de un so: On a server, each business belongs to a single player. If its owner sells it, the price shows here.
textos.En un servidor, cada vivienda es de un s: On a server, each home belongs to a single player. If its owner sells it, the price shows here.
textos.En un servidor, esperar y volver a entra: On a server, wait and rejoin only if the connection drops or the server restarts
textos.En un servidor, los vehículos de la call: On a server, vehicles on the street are stored by the server
textos.En un servidor, oír la radio de los vehí: On a server, hear the radio of other players' vehicles
textos.En un servidor, se ha cortado la conexió: On a server, the connection has dropped or the server is updating, and the game waits to rejoin on its own: two slow, weak notes, the second one lower. It repeats every few seconds.
textos.En un servidor: tiene que ir despacio y: On a server: it must go slowly and be next to you.
textos.En un sitio te deben un favor y en otro: In one place they owe you a favor and in another they've got a grudge. Today the two are going to meet at your aunt's bar.
textos.En un supermercado. Cada tipo de tienda: In a supermarket. Each shop type applies its own markup, and every day it changes a little.
textos.En un tiroteo de verdad, medio segundo a: In a real shootout, half a second before shooting you the enemy cocks the weapon: that is your warning to duck with X. Z uses a first aid kit.
textos.En un trayecto corto no da tiempo a subi: On a short trip there is no time to climb to the aircraft's cruising altitude: it stays lower.
textos.En una partida nueva y en una de antes d: In a new game and in one from before this version: nothing is charged until then.
textos.En una persecución el sospechoso se alej: In a chase the suspect speeds away: shooting at the vehicle or ramming it is not a crime until this distance.
textos.En una persecución en vehículo, cada cuá: In a vehicle chase, how often the game says where the one fleeing is.
textos.En una travesía en vuelo: cruceta arriba: On a flight crossing: D-pad up and down, altitude; D-pad left and right, heading; X or Square, autopilot; A or Cross, flight status; Y or Triangle, speed up; LB or L1, repeat the tower message; RB or R1, or B or Circle, the flight menu; and the View, Create or Share button, help
textos.En unidades, repartidas al azar entre la: In units, spread at random among the substances. You can't carry more than a hundred in total.
textos.En vendimia no baja nadie: comen entre l: At harvest nobody comes down: they eat among the vines. And the bread, if it doesn't arrive fresh, they don't want it.
textos.En venta por {n} euros. Quien lo quiera,: For sale for {n} euros. Whoever wants it buys it at the door.
textos.En vigilar, a cuántos metros del lugar h: For keep watch, how many meters from the place you must stay; if you leave it empty, 25.
textos.En {barrio} empiezan a decir que no se t: In {barrio} they're starting to say they never see you. Drop by, or invest in the neighborhood, before it gets worse.
textos.En {barrio} mandamos los de aquí. Y se v: In {barrio} we locals are in charge. And things go the way I say.
textos.En {barrio} no hay secretos. Solo cosas: There are no secrets in {barrio}. Only things said in a low voice.
textos.En {barrio} nos conocemos todos, para lo: In {barrio} we all know each other, for better and for worse.
textos.En {barrio} pasa de todo y nos enteramos: In {barrio} everything happens and we find out about everything. The lady on the third floor, for example... well, I won't tell you that one because you don't know her, but it's enough to write a novel.
In {barrio} they say they don't owe you anything anymore. If you don't go soon, whoever comes to take it from you will have it easy.
textos.En {campo} alguien reconoce el aparato y: At {campo} someone recognizes the aircraft and picks up a phone.
textos.En {campo} te estaban esperando: coches: At {campo} they were waiting for you: patrol cars on the runway.
textos.En {casa} se ha roto el calentador. El a: The water heater in {casa} has broken. The repair, {euros} euros, is on you.
textos.En {casa}, {n} saca una tanda de {sust}:: At {casa}, {n} turns out a batch of {sust}: {u} units into the wardrobe.
textos.En {empresa} no quieren saber de ti hast: At {empresa} they don't want to hear from you until day {int}.
textos.En {empresa} se han enterado de tu probl: At {empresa} they found out about your trouble with the police. {jefe} gives you a warning: you have {avisos} of {tope}.
textos.En {lugar} han decidido que lo que te ll: The people at {lugar} have decided that you will pay for what you took, little by little: higher prices for {dias}.
textos.En {negocio} hace días que no te ven. La: They haven't seen you at {negocio} for days. The customers notice and the business loses its name.
textos.En {nombre_lugar} buscan a alguien para: They're looking for someone for a job at {nombre_lugar}. I wouldn't get involved.
There are no changed sounds in {que}.
textos.Enamorarse está bien. Lo malo viene lueg: Falling in love is nice. The bad part comes later.
textos.Encargado de la Luna Llena. Traje impeca: Manager of Luna Llena. Impeccable suit, elephant's memory and a very dry sense of humor. He was a dancer before a knee gave out.
textos.Encargo: dejarlo junto a {nombre}, sin e: Job: leave it next to {nombre}, without the radar on you, for {paga} euros. {donde}.
textos.Encargos repetibles reconocidos por hora: Repeatable jobs recognized per hour, of each kind
textos.Encarna necesita que le hagas un recado: Encarna needs you to run an errand in the neighborhood.
textos.Encarna te dice qué tienes que hacer aho: Encarna tells you what you have to do now or where you should drop by.
textos.Encarna te manda al Almacén Siete del pu: Encarna sends you to Almacén Siete at the harbor to meet La Rusa.
textos.Encarna y El Chispas quieren golpear a B: Encarna and El Chispas want to hit Belmonte where it hurts most.
textos.Encañonas al piloto, que salta a la pist: You hold the pilot at gunpoint, and he jumps onto the runway with his hands up. The aircraft is yours. The whole region is going to know.
textos.Enciende las luces de la Torre del Semáf: Light the lights at the Signal Tower, the Cistern, the Breakers and the Pier, in that order, within seven minutes. On foot.
textos.Enciendes el detector de metales: You turn on the metal detector
textos.Encuentra cinco tesoros buceando o con e: Find five treasures by diving or with the detector.
A new vein is found in Monteferro.
textos.Enderezar el vehículo hacia el punto car: Straighten the vehicle toward the nearest cardinal point
textos.Enemigo fijado, fuera de alcance: Enemy locked on, out of range
textos.Enemigos de más por cada uno de los tuyo: Extra enemies for each one of yours
textos.Enemigos de una pelea buscada: Enemies of a fight you picked
textos.Enorme, rojo y con sirena. Con la tecla: Huge, red, with a siren. With the J key you go put out fires.
textos.Enseñarle con calma, aunque el turno vay: Teach him patiently, even if the shift goes slower
textos.Enseñas el arma y no hace falta decir má: You show the weapon and nothing more needs to be said. {quien} fills a bag: {botin} euros. The alarm is already sounding.
textos.Entera. No me lo esperaba. Desde hoy la: Whole. I didn't expect it. From today on the Club doesn't touch a pipe in the Cauce.
textos.Entero y todo. Pues igual no sois tan ma: Whole and all. Maybe you folks from the capital aren't such bad people after all. Come back whenever you like, there's no shortage of work.
textos.Entra con tu personaje, tal como quedó g: Join with your character, just as it was saved on the server.
textos.Entra contigo y tiene a raya a la gente: Goes in with you and keeps the crowd and the guards in check: it's much harder for someone to play hero or hit the alarm early.
textos.Entra el inquilino y desde esta medianoc: The tenant moves in and from this midnight you collect the rent. You can take it back whenever you like by returning the deposit.
textos.Entrada de una hipoteca, por ciento del: Down payment of a mortgage, percent of the price
textos.Entran a robar en esta casa muchas menos: Far fewer break-ins happen at this house.
textos.Entras en la banda como miembro. La invi: You join the gang as a member. The invitation expires after three minutes.
textos.Entras en reserva: queda poco combustibl: You hit reserve: fuel is low.
textos.Entras en su grupo de misión: le ayudas: You join their mission group: you help them with their missions and get half the reward.
textos.Entras en un cruce de calles, o te acerc: You walk into an intersection, or you approach one while driving.
textos.Entras en un local: la puerta y su campa: You enter a venue: the door and its little bell. While you are inside, the sound of the place plays in the background.

Each aisle has its own things: Enter opens it and you put whatever you want in the basket. You pay at the register. You carry what you bought with you, to store it and cook it in a home of yours. Inside, F1 tells you where you are and C tells you what's in your basket.

textos.Eres un personaje secundario de un audio:
You are a supporting character in an open-world audio game set in a fictional Spanish coastal region, the one around Puerto Bravo. The game is used by blind people and everything you write will be read aloud by a screen reader.

You play a single person from the street, whose profile you will receive. Always answer as that person, in natural American English, briefly: one or two sentences, with no stage directions in asterisks or parentheses, no emojis and no lists.

Stay in character as the profile says: "amable" is friendly, "hablador" is talkative and rambles on, "seco" answers in few words, "timido" hesitates and cuts himself off, "chulo" shows off and doesn't back down. Trust goes from -100 to 100: with little trust you are reserved; with a lot, you are warm. Take into account the "humor_de_ahora" of the situation. Don't repeat sentences you already said: every answer is new.

You are an ordinary person: you know nothing about missions or game mechanics, you can't give money or items and you don't know facts that are not in the profile or the situation. If you're asked something you wouldn't know, say so the way anyone would.

All characters are adults. You may flirt or turn down a flirt according to the profile, always tastefully: never write explicit sexual content. If the player insists, is rude or threatens, react the way that person would.
textos.Eres un sol. Ahí va el secreto: por toda: You're a sweetheart. Here's the secret: all over the region there are cassette tapes, bottles and doubloons hidden. A collector pays two hundred fifty euros for each one.

textos.Esta noche se vota el plan del puerto. S: Tonight they vote on the harbor plan. If it goes through as presented, half the neighborhood's premises end up in the hands of two companies, and the rest of us get our license fees raised until we're pushed out.
textos.Esta noche viene medio Ayuntamiento y me: Half the Town Hall is coming tonight and I'm short on the house cocktail supplies. Stop by La Trastienda and bring them to me. Keep two for yourself.
textos.Esta partida es de una versión más nueva: This save is from a newer version of the game, format {v}. Update the game to load it.
textos.Esta vez vamos todos: los Aljibes, la Pe: This time we all go: Los Aljibes, the Club and Los Vigías. You go in first, since you have the key.
textos.Esta vivienda es de {dueno}, otro jugado: This home belongs to {dueno}, another player.
I was better off before you showed up.
textos.Estación de tren, a otras localidades po: Train station, to other towns by land
textos.Estado mínimo del vehículo, en porcentaj: Minimum condition of the vehicle, in percent
textos.Estanterías hasta el techo, latas y caja: Shelves up to the ceiling, cans and boxes.
textos.Este aparato puede: por encima de la tor: This aircraft can: above the storm the air is calm.
textos.Este archivo se puede cambiar con un edi: This file can be changed with a text editor or from the server panel, in Configuration.
textos.Este año subimos. Bueno, lo digo todos l: We move up this year. Well, I say that every year.
This neighborhood does not belong to another gang.
textos.Este barrio ya tiene dueño. Para quitárs: This neighborhood already has an owner. To take it you must declare war on them.
textos.Este botón pasa a hacer esto, y el cambi: This button will now do this, and the change is saved right away.
textos.Este es el de la lonja, ese el del hielo: This one is from the fish market, that one's the ice guy and that one, the delivery woman. They know who you are. When you have your place, they'll serve you the way they served me.
textos.Este juego se juega solo con el oído. Us: This game is played by ear alone. Use headphones: what sounds to your right is on your right, and what sounds muffled is behind you.
textos.Este mod no tiene misiones con diálogos,: This mod has no missions with dialogue, so there is nothing to record.
textos.Este negocio es de {dueno}, otro jugador: This business belongs to {dueno}, another player.
This business does not belong to another player.
This business can't grow any more.
textos.Este no es el campo: el encargo es para: This isn't the right field: the job is for {nombre}.
textos.Este plan no se puede hacer aquí. Prueba: This plan can't be done here. Try in another town.
textos.Este servidor acaba de estrenarse y toda: This server has just opened and does not have the game data yet: the first one to come in provides it, and yours did not arrive properly or it cannot accept it. Try again; if it stays the same, have whoever runs the server come in first.
textos.Este servidor cifraba la conexión y ahor: This server used to encrypt the connection and now it doesn't. For safety I won't enter. If whoever runs it changed that, delete it from your list and add it again.
textos.Este servidor es solo para invitados, y: This server is invitation only, and that invitation code is not valid or has already been used.
textos.Este servidor necesita una versión más n: This server needs a newer version of the game. Update the game to join.
This server doesn't encrypt the connection.
textos.Este servidor no se arrancó con un archi: This server was not started with a configuration file: there is nothing to reload.
textos.Este servidor no tiene apuntado ningún c: This server has no contract of yours on record.
textos.Este servidor pide la versión %s del jue: This server requires version %s of the game or later, and yours is %s. Update the game to come in.
textos.Este servidor pone un tope a lo que gana: This server caps what you earn per hour
textos.Este servidor puede poner un tope a lo q: This server may cap what you earn per hour, but its version doesn't say what the cap is
textos.Este servidor va con la versión %s del j: This server runs version %s of the game and yours is older. Update the game to come in.
textos.Este servidor va con los datos de la ver: This server runs on the data of game version {version} and you have {VERSION}: you can play with everyone. The weapons and vehicles your version doesn't have, you'll hear and see as the closest thing you know; you won't see the new places until you update.
This server runs on the data of game version {version} and you have {VERSION}: you can play, but you won't see the new places, vehicles and weapons of other players until you update.

This server runs on the data of game version {version}, older than yours: you can play, but others won't see what's new in your version, new weapons count against other players as bare hands, and in new towns they won't see you.
textos.Este servidor va con una versión anterio: This server runs an older version and can't do that with a parked vehicle. Go to it: you can rename it when you get in, and send it to the garage from Services with the vehicle beside you.
This server runs an older version and has no role-play channels: use the regular chat.
textos.Este vehículo no sirve para trabajar. Pr: This vehicle can't be used for work. Try a taxi, an ambulance, a bus, a patrol car or a truck.
textos.Este verano ha venido tanta gente que el: So many people came this summer that the guy at the beach bar bought a new car. In August. Paid in cash.
textos.Esto antes era todo huerta. Ahora, bloqu: This used to be all vegetable gardens. Now, apartment blocks.
textos.Esto dice cómo va vestido otro jugador,: This tells you how another player is dressed, when you play with friends or on a server.
textos.Esto es un tutorial jugable. Son tres ej: This is a playable tutorial. It is three short exercises and you can't fail: no time limit, no enemies, no police. With Escape, in the pause menu, you can quit whenever you want.
textos.Esto lo levantamos los de aquí. Que no s: We locals built this. Don't forget it.
textos.Esto lo va a saber el barrio entero, que: The whole neighborhood will know this, I talk to everybody for a reason.
textos.Esto me lo regaló mi cuñada. Por eso me: My sister-in-law gave me this. That's why it's too big on me.
textos.Esto no lo hemos ganado en un día, ni en: We didn't win this in a day, or in one place. You've been winning it, decision by decision.
This is ending, Auntie. I'm going after him.
textos.Esto va a tardar. Mientras, ten cuidado: This will take a while. Meanwhile, watch out for Seisdedos. He's missing fingers, but not memory.
I'm fine as I am, thanks.
textos.Estoy bien, estoy bien. Me he escondido: I'm fine, I'm fine. I hid behind the bar with grandpa's shotgun. But look at what they've done to the place.
textos.Estoy en mi mejor momento. Siempre lo es: I'm at my best. I always am.
textos.Estoy enganchad{o} a una serie. No me pr: I'm hooked on a series. Don't ask me which one, I'm embarrassed.
textos.Estrategia, personal y finanzas. Lo más: Strategy, staff and finance. The highest level taught in the region.
You try out what you bought, laughing.
textos.Estudiar no sé, pero aprender se aprende: I don't know about studying, but you learn something every day.
Studying is always a good idea. Go for it.
textos.Estupendamente. Hace un día para estar b: Great. It's a day to feel good.
textos.Estuve en el extranjero una semana. No e: I was abroad for a week. I didn't understand anything, I ate terribly, and they charged me for water. Never again.
textos.Está abierto {lista}. Windows no deja su: {lista} is open. Windows does not let you replace a running program: close it before updating.
textos.Está abierto, no hay que forzarlo: It is open, no need to force it
textos.Está al suroeste, mar adentro. Ve en bar: It's to the southwest, out at sea. Go by boat, climb the jetty and see what's cooking. And come back in one piece, you owe me a round.
It's expired: better throw it out.
textos.Está casi todo. Lo que falta se lo ha ju: Almost everything is here. What's missing he gambled away, and he'll sort that out with the judge.
textos.Está detrás de unas cajas de naranjas. D: It's behind some crates of oranges. Inside, Casilda's ID, a San Telmo holy card and six hundred euros in folded bills.
Is running away and doesn't stop to talk.
textos.Está la cosa muy mal. Hay más gente en l: Things are really bad. There are more people in the line than on the beach.
textos.Está lloviendo: el suelo resbala más y s: It is raining: the ground is slipperier and you hear less well.
You're very close. You can feel their breath.
textos.Están abiertos {lista}. Windows no deja: {lista} are open. Windows does not let you replace a running program: close them before updating.
textos.Están ahora mismo en el colmado. Toma, l: They're at the grocery store right now. Here, the tanker key. It's for opening and for persuading.
textos.Están junto a la sala El Sótano. Haz que: They're next to El Sótano concert hall. Make them understand.
textos.Estás agachad[o|a] y por eso vas despaci: You're crouching, so you move slowly. Press X to stand up.
textos.Estás buceando: un rumor sordo con burbu: You are diving: a muffled rumble with bubbles.
textos.Estás cocinando {lower}. {v}, para no es: You are cooking {lower}. {v}, so you don't have to wait.
You are fit as a fiddle. You don't need anything.
textos.Estás de servicio. Estos encargos no son: You are on duty. These jobs are not for someone who carries a badge.
textos.Estás de servicio. Si atracas esto, se a: You are on duty. If you rob this place, your badge is gone.
textos.Estás de servicio. Si haces eso, se acab: You're on duty. If you do that, your badge is gone.
textos.Estás de servicio: a la espera de un avi: You are on duty: waiting for a call from the radio.
You are too close. Stay back.
textos.Estás dentro de la tormenta: agua, rayos: You're inside the storm: water, lightning and unforgiving air.
textos.Estás dentro de tu casa. Flechas izquier: You're inside your home. Left and right arrows to go from one room to another, Enter to use the room you're in and Escape to leave.
textos.Estás despegando: espera a estar en el a: You're taking off: wait until you're in the air.
Your assets are seized: you owe {int} euros. They keep half of your payroll and of what your businesses earn
textos.Estás embargad[o|a]: el banco no te pres: You are under seizure: the bank won't lend you anything until you pay off the debt.
You're in the water. Swim with the arrow keys. X dives you underwater and brings you back up. To board a boat, get close and press F. If you swim to a pier, you climb out onto land. Don't run out of strength: V tells you how much you have left.
textos.Estás en el aire sobre el campo: eliges: You are in the air over the airfield: you choose a destination and the crossing begins.
You are in the countryside: birds and cowbells.
You are out at sea, far from the coast.
textos.Estás en el puerto: olas y una sirena de: You are at the harbor: waves and a distant ship's horn.
textos.Estás en el taxi. Ahora, lo que has veni: You are in the taxi. Now, what you came to learn: press J to start working. The game will send you to pick up a customer.
You are in the mountains: wind.
textos.Estás en la partida de un amigo: You are in a friend's game
You are at the beach: waves.
textos.Estás en la salida, pero para correr nec: You are at the start, but to race you need a vehicle. Get one and come back.
textos.Estás en la {describir}. {situar}. Camin: You are in the {describir}. {situar}. Walk with the arrow keys and press Enter at the door. Press F1 to see the keys.
textos.Estás en medio de las vías del tranvía o: You are in the middle of the tram or train tracks: a metallic clink from the rail, with gravel underneath.
textos.Estás en mitad de una misión. Esto, mejo: You're in the middle of a mission. This is better once you finish.
textos.Estás en mitad de una misión. La cita, m: You're in the middle of a mission. The date is better once you finish.
textos.Estás en mitad de una misión. Mejor cuan: You're in the middle of a mission. Better once you finish.
textos.Estás en modo pasivo: no puedes herir a: You are in passive mode: you cannot hurt anyone.
textos.Estás en tu mejor forma. Ya no puedes me: You're in the best shape of your life. You can't improve any further.
textos.Estás en tu puesto. Quédate a menos de {: You are at your post. Stay within {int} meters for {int2} seconds and listen. When you hear footsteps approaching, stay still or crouch with the X key.
You are in a residential neighborhood.
You are in a park: birds.
textos.Estás en un polígono industrial: maquina: You are in an industrial estate: machinery.
textos.Estás en {nombre_servidor}. Hay {sum} ju: You are on {nombre_servidor}. There are {sum} players besides you
textos.Estás forzando la cerradura de un vehícu: You are picking a vehicle's lock.
textos.Estás fuera de la calzada: conducción li: You are off the roadway: free driving until you get back on a street.
textos.Estás jugando desde el código fuente: la: You're playing from the source code: the new version only installs itself in the compiled game.
textos.Estás junto a la estación de autobuses:: You are next to the bus station: air brakes and announcements over the loudspeaker.
textos.Estás junto a la estación de tren: resop: You are next to the train station: the huffing of a locomotive.
textos.Estás junto a la oficina de empleo: tecl: You are next to the job center: keyboards and the queue number announcement.
textos.Estás junto a la prisión: una reja que s: You are next to the prison: a gate clanging shut and a distant siren.
textos.Estás junto a la protectora, donde puede: You are next to the animal shelter, where you can adopt a dog: barking.
textos.Estás junto a un banco o una casa de emp: You are next to a bank or a pawn shop: the beeps of an ATM.
textos.Estás junto a un bar, una taberna, una d: You are next to a bar, a tavern, a nightclub or a business: deep bass music through the wall.
textos.Estás junto a un casino o una feria: la: You are next to a casino or a fairground: the little tune of the slot machines.
textos.Estás junto a un cine: el traqueteo de u: You are next to a cinema: the clatter of a projector.
textos.Estás junto a un club nocturno: música a: You are next to a nightclub: muffled music and clinking glasses.
textos.Estás junto a un comedor social o una or: You are next to a soup kitchen or a charity: plates and cutlery.
textos.Estás junto a un embarcadero: el agua co: You are next to a pier: water against the docks and mooring lines creaking.
textos.Estás junto a un gimnasio: pesas que cho: You are next to a gym: weights clanking.
textos.Estás junto a un helipuerto: palas giran: You are next to a heliport: spinning blades and a control tower beep.
textos.Estás junto a un hospital o una farmacia: You are next to a hospital or a pharmacy: the beep of a monitor.
textos.Estás junto a un lugar de un tipo que no: You are next to a place of a type that has no sound of its own.
textos.Estás junto a un lugar donde te espera a: You are next to a place where someone is waiting for you with a job.
textos.Estás junto a un muelle, una boya, un pu: You are next to a dock, a buoy, a fishing spot or a treasure at sea: a buoy bell among the waves.
textos.Estás junto a un periódico o una librerí: You are next to a newspaper or a bookstore: the tapping of typewriters.
textos.Estás junto a un proveedor, donde se com: You are next to a supplier, where product is bought and sold: two hisses and a metal shutter.
textos.Estás junto a un río: agua corriendo ent: You are next to a river: water running over stones.
textos.Estás junto a un sitio donde se come: al: You are next to a place where people eat: something frying.
textos.Estás junto a un taller, un desguace o u: You are next to a repair shop, a scrapyard or a car dealership: a pneumatic wrench.
textos.Estás junto a una academia o una autoesc: You are next to an academy or a driving school: the class bell.
textos.Estás junto a una armería: un arma que s: You are next to a gun shop: a weapon being cocked.
textos.Estás junto a una comisaría: una emisora: You are next to a police station: a police radio.
You are next to a fountain: water falling.
You are next to a church: a bell.
textos.Estás junto a una mina: picos contra la: You are next to a mine: pickaxes against rock.
textos.Estás junto a una parada de taxis o a la: You are next to a taxi stand or the finish of a race: two short honks.
textos.Estás junto a una parada de tranvía: dos: You are next to a tram stop: two rings of the bell.
textos.Estás junto a una salida de la ciudad: c: You are next to a city exit: cars passing quickly. This is the way to another town.
textos.Estás junto a una tienda: el timbre de l: You are next to a store: the door buzzer.
textos.Estás junto a una vivienda o un hotel, t: You are next to a home or a hotel, yours or one you can buy: wind chimes.
textos.Estás junto al aeropuerto: el aviso de m: You are next to the airport: the loudspeaker announcement, three descending notes.
textos.Estás recorriendo {nombre} por dentro. F: You are walking around inside {nombre}. Left and right arrows to go from one aisle to another, Enter to use the spot where you are, {_tecla_cesta} to hear what is in your basket and Escape to leave. You are now at {nombre2}: with Enter, {aqui}. In each aisle, Enter or right arrow on a product puts it in the basket, left arrow puts it back and F1 tells you what it is for and how long it keeps. You pay at the register. If you leave with a full basket, they ask what you are doing with it.

You're walking around inside {nombre}. Left and right arrows to go from one spot to another, Enter to use the spot you're in and Escape to go back to the place's menu. You're now at {nombre2}: with Enter, {aqui}.
textos.Euforia durante un rato largo. El bajón: Euphoria for a good while. The crash afterward sinks your mood.
textos.Euros al día que blanquea una tapadera,: Euros per day that a front launders, per business level
textos.Euros de crédito por punto de solvencia: Euros of credit per solvency point
textos.Euros de ingresos por semana que valen u: Euros of weekly income worth one solvency point
textos.Euros encima a partir de los que te pued: Euros carried above which you can be mugged
textos.Evaluación de {jefe}: buena. «Sigue así: Evaluation by {jefe}: good. "Keep it up and we'll talk about a promotion." Paycheck of {sueldo} euros and {prima} bonus.
textos.Evaluación de {jefe}: correcta. Cobras l: Evaluation by {jefe}: fine. You get your paycheck, {sueldo} euros.
textos.Evaluación de {jefe}: floja. «Esto no es: Evaluation by {jefe}: poor. "This is not what we signed." You get a warning, number {avisos} of {tope}, and only {sueldo} euros paycheck.
textos.Evaluación de {jefe}: muy mala. «No has: Evaluation by {jefe}: very bad. "You didn't show up." A penalty with no paycheck and a warning: you have {avisos} of {tope}.
Stock, cash register, orders and window display.
textos.Explica qué es. Solo se ve aquí, en el e: Explains what it is. Only seen here, in the editor.
textos.Explicación de la partida con amigos: có: Explanation of playing with friends: how to open your game, how to join someone else's and what you can do together. It is read right here.
textos.Explorador de mapa. Las flechas mueven e: Map explorer. The arrow keys move the cursor from intersection to intersection. Tab cycles through nearby places. Enter sets the destination on the GPS. D tells you the distance from where you are. Escape exits.
textos.Explorar el mapa con el cursor: Explore the map with the cursor
textos.Explosivos, y con fecha de la semana pas: Explosives, dated last week. This isn't for the quarry. I know who to show it to.
textos.Explota a ocho metros a la redonda. No l: Explodes within eight meters all around. Don't throw it near yourself.
textos.Expulsarlo de mi partida: Kick them out of my game
textos.Extendéis las toallas donde rompe la bri: You spread the towels where the breeze breaks. {n} falls asleep in the sun.
textos.Extorsión. Llevamos meses esperando a qu: Extortion. We've been waiting for months for someone to sign a complaint. Everyone pays or stays quiet.
textos.F1 dice todas las teclas en cualquier mo: F1 reads out all the keys at any moment, and in the main menu there is Learn the game's sounds, to hear what each one means.
textos.F1 explica cada opción. La primera, con: F1 explains each option. The first one, with Enter, tells how everything works
textos.F1 explica el efecto de cada una: F1 explains the effect of each one
textos.F1 explica lo que va a pasar: F1 explains what is going to happen
textos.Fabricar mercancía para venderla después: Make product to sell later to suppliers or on the street.
textos.Facturas e impuestos del periodo: {euros: Bills and taxes for the period: {euros} euros. {detalle}.
textos.Facturas, planos de la red y un contrato: Invoices, network blueprints and a contract with the town hall. Look at this clause: if the Cauce's consumption drops below a minimum, the company can shut off the branch.
textos.Facultades, bares baratos y estudiantes: Faculties, cheap bars and students at all hours.
textos.Falló el paso de {paso}, y el instalador: The {paso} step failed, and the installer did not record which file.
The name is missing. It is the first option.
textos.Falta la clave de {v}. Escríbela en esta: The key for {v} is missing. Type it in this same section.
textos.Falta un cuadro. Pequeño, una marina sin: A painting is missing. Small, an unsigned seascape. Worth nothing to the insurance; to this city, a lot.
textos.Fama en la calle con la que las bandas r: Street reputation at which gangs respect your businesses
textos.Fama en la calle que da o quita: Street reputation it gives or takes away
textos.Fama que da o quita: Street reputation it gives or takes
textos.Fama que se gana al defender un barrio: Street reputation gained when defending a neighborhood
textos.Fama que se pierde al perderlo: Street reputation lost when losing it
textos.Fantasmas, los que deben dinero y no apa: Ghosts are the ones who owe money and don't show up.
textos.Farmacia de guardia abierta las veinticu: Pharmacy on call, open twenty-four hours. They sell first aid kits.
textos.Fascinante. Su jefe se hace llamar El Ca: Fascinating. Their boss calls himself El Caimán and doesn't trust banks: he keeps everything in cash. Give me a few days.
textos.Fase cinco, huida. Ahora toca desaparece: Phase five, getaway. Now it's time to disappear.
textos.Fase cinco, huida. Despista a la policía: Phase five, getaway. Shake the police and the loot is yours.
textos.Fase cuatro, salida. Fuera de aquí con l: Phase four, exit. Out of here with what you're carrying.
textos.Fase cuatro, salida. Ya lo tienes: a la: Phase four, exit. You've got it: out to the street.
textos.Fase dos, control, con guardia: Phase two, control room, with a guard
textos.Fase dos, control, sin guardia: Phase two, control room, without a guard
textos.Fase dos, control. Aquí no hay guardia:: Phase two, control. There's no guard here: everyone on the floor and nobody plays the brave one.
textos.Fase dos, control. Primero, los que van: Phase two, control. First, the armed ones.
textos.Fase dos, control. Que nadie se mueva ha: Phase two, control. Nobody moves until there's no guard left standing.
textos.Fase dos, control. Sin guardia a la vist: Phase two, control. No guard in sight: people, stay still and quiet.
Phase three: go for the safe.
Phase one, entry. Everyone to their spot.
textos.Fase uno, entrada. Relojes en hora: empe: Phase one, entry. Watches synced: we start.
textos.Favor: te esconde de la policía: Favor: hides you from the police
textos.Favores hago los justos, que luego se ac: I do just the right amount of favors, otherwise they get used to it.
textos.Felicidades. El mío sí que es una fiesta: Congratulations. Mine is a real party.
textos.Felicidades. Invita a algo, ¿no?: Congratulations. You're buying something, aren't you?
textos.Feria: una partida en la máquina de memo: Fairground: a game on the sound memory machine
textos.Feria: una tanda en la caseta de tiro: Fairground: a round at the shooting booth
textos.Fiable y equilibrada. Doce balas por car: Reliable and balanced. Twelve bullets per magazine.
textos.Fianza que devuelves al recuperar la cas: Deposit you get back when you recover the house, in days of rent
textos.Fichas de animales y una mesa. Aquí te a: Animal profiles and a table. You're served here.
textos.Fichas, cartas y la ruleta girando. Aquí: Chips, cards and the roulette wheel spinning. You play here.
textos.Fichas, coges las llaves y la emisora cr: You clock in, grab the keys and the radio crackles: you are on duty.
textos.Fijar a cualquiera, no solo a los enemig: Lock onto anyone, not only enemies
textos.Filas de tragaperras con sus musiquillas: Rows of slot machines with their little jingles.
textos.Fin de la ciudad. No puedes seguir por a: End of the city. You can't go any further this way.
End of the round: {n} targets out of {RONDAS}.
textos.Fin del capítulo tres. Belmonte ha perdi: End of chapter three. Belmonte has lost his money, his accountant and his police chief. Now all he has left is rage.
textos.Fin del capítulo uno. Los Calaveras te h: End of chapter one. Los Calaveras have declared war on you: from now on they will attack you as soon as they see you around the harbor.
textos.Fin del mapa. Da la vuelta, o usa un hel: End of the map. Turn around, or use a heliport to fly to another town.
textos.Fin del mapa: aquí empieza el océano abi: End of the map: the open ocean begins here. Turn around.
textos.Final a medias: una de cal y otra de are: Mixed ending: a bit of good, a bit of bad
textos.Final de la calle: en paz con Los Calave: Street ending: at peace with Los Calaveras
textos.Final de la comarca: en pie y en paz: Region ending: standing tall and at peace
textos.Final del dinero: a sueldo del concejal: Money ending: on the councilman's payroll
textos.Final del poder: la comarca tiene dueño: Power ending: the region has an owner
textos.Final honrado: el concejal ante el juez: Honest ending: the councilman before the judge
textos.Final prudente: cada uno a lo suyo: Prudent ending: each to their own
textos.Firma la multa de mala gana: {euros} eur: He signs the fine reluctantly: {euros} euros.
textos.Firmado. Ha sido un placer hacer negocio: Signed. It's been a pleasure doing business with you. There's no need for us to meet again.
textos.Firmar: la fachada limpia y el dinero po: Sign: a clean front and the money behind it
textos.Firmas el contrato con {empresa}. Tu jef: You sign the contract with {empresa}. Your boss is {jefe}, who has a reputation for being {caracter}. You start as {puesto}: {cupo} turns every {dias} days and {sueldo} euros paycheck per period, on top of what you earn for each turn.
textos.Firmas el contrato en la inmobiliaria: d: You sign the contract at the real estate agency: starting today, {inquilino} moves into {casa}. The rent is about {renta} euros every midnight.
textos.Firmas la hipoteca: {nombre} es {v}. Has: You sign the mortgage: {nombre} is {v}. You paid {entrada} euros down and {n} payments of {cuota} euros remain, one every {entero} days.
textos.Firmas, juras y te dan una placa que pes: You sign, swear in and they give you a badge that weighs more than it looks. You are now a trainee officer.
textos.Firmas. El bolígrafo es bueno; la tinta,: You sign. The pen is good; the ink, not so much.
textos.Firmáis en el ayuntamiento y lo celebrái: You sign at the town hall and celebrate with a long meal. {n} wears the ring and keeps looking at it. You're married.
textos.Firmáis sin papeles. Tres apretones de m: You sign without papers. Three handshakes, and none of them sincere.
textos.Flechas arriba y abajo para moverte, Int: Up and down arrows to move, Enter to choose, left and right to change a value, Escape to go back.
textos.Flechas izquierda y derecha para moverte: Left and right arrows to move, Enter to look at an aisle or pay at the register, {_tecla_cesta} for the basket, Escape to leave.
Arrow keys to move, Enter to search. You have {intentos} tries and {int} seconds left.
textos.Flechas para recorrer la lista. Intro ed: Arrow keys move through the list. Enter edits the item and Delete removes it.
textos.Flechas: mover el cursor. Tabulador: lug: Arrow keys: move the cursor. Tab: places near the cursor. N: description. D: distance from your position. Home: go back to where you are. Enter: set on the GPS. Escape: exit.
textos.Forma de cobro de todos tus negocios: {c: How you collect from all your businesses: {cobro_txt}
textos.Formación profesional para mineros y tra: Vocational training for miners and carriers.
textos.Franquicia: por ciento del precio del mo: Deductible: percent of the model's price
textos.Frases de los atracadores de un servidor: Phrases of the robbers on an online server
textos.Frases de los ladrones de coches de un s: Phrases of the car thieves on an online server
textos.Frases de los paseantes de un servidor e: Phrases of the strollers on an online server
textos.Frases de los pistoleros de un servidor: Phrases of the gunmen on an online server
textos.Frases de los rateros de un servidor en: Phrases of the pickpockets on an online server
textos.Frases que grita al verte: Phrases they shout when they see you
textos.Frases ya escritas para hablar en person: Ready-made phrases for speaking in character
textos.Frases ya escritas para hablar fuera de: Ready-made phrases for speaking out of character
Brake before jumping into the water.
textos.Frena y para a la derecha. Te espera con: He brakes and pulls over to the right. He waits with his hands on the wheel: get close and press Enter.
textos.Fresca y ligera. No lleva fuego, así que: Fresh and light. It uses no fire, so it can't burn.
textos.Fresco y elegante a la vez, como en las: Fresh and elegant at once, like in the coastal movies.
textos.Fue de Los Vigías hasta que se cansó de: Was part of Los Vigías until tired of watching. Starts with driving and aim at level three, street reputation and three lockpick sets.
textos.Fue piloto de rallies hasta que le retir: Was a rally driver until the license was taken away. Starts with driving at level five and three lockpick sets: no lock stays shut, and drives a car like Álex.
textos.Fuego amigo: puedes herir a tu perro, a: Friendly fire: you can hurt your dog, your bodyguards and your gang
textos.Fuentefría, un pueblo de alta montaña fa: Fuentefría, a high mountain village famous for its spa and its trout. Clean air and silence.
textos.Fuerza con la que empieza cada banda, co: Strength each gang starts with, at least
textos.Fuerza con la que una banda se decide a: Strength at which a gang decides to assault, at least
textos.Fuerza desde la que traen una oleada más: Strength from which they bring one more wave
textos.Fuerza mínima de la banda que se suma: Minimum strength of the gang that joins in
textos.Fuerza mínima de una banda para poder go: Minimum strength of a gang for you to be able to hit its hideout
textos.Fuerza por debajo de la cual viene uno m: Strength below which one fewer comes in each wave
textos.Fuerza que gana cada banda al día, como: Strength each gang gains per day, at least
textos.Fui a comprar ayer y casi me da algo. ¡L: I went shopping yesterday and almost had a fit. Tomatoes at gold prices! I asked the fruit seller: is this fruit or jewelry? He laughed, but he didn't knock off a single cent.
textos.Fui a por unos calcetines y volví con un: I went out for socks and came back with a jacket, two shirts and no socks. That's me.
textos.Fui a ver una de miedo y el que más grit: I went to see a horror movie and I was the one screaming the loudest. The woman in front moved seats.
textos.Fui al ayuntamiento por un papel y me ma: I went to the town hall for a paper and they sent me to three different windows. At the third one they told me to go back to the first. The next day I brought a snack.
textos.Fui al banco a pedir un préstamo y me pi: I went to the bank for a loan and they asked for so many papers that in the end I left them money in fees.
textos.Fui al médico por la rodilla y salí con: I went to the doctor for my knee and left with pills for blood pressure, cholesterol and sugar. He said nothing about the knee.
You smoke weed: a lighter, a drag and smoke.
textos.Fumo, pero solo en fiestas. Y en días de: I smoke, but only at parties. And on weekdays.
textos.Funciona. Ha contestado {v}, con el mode: It works. {v} answered, with the model {mod}, in {v2:.1f} seconds. It said: {respuesta}
textos.Fundar la banda lo pagas de tu bolsillo;: You pay for founding the gang out of your own pocket; neighborhoods and wars are paid from the gang's till.
textos.Fundar una banda o, si ya tienes una, su: Found a gang or, if you already have one, its people, its till, its neighborhoods and its alliances.
textos.Fundar una banda: {get} euros. Reclamar: Found a gang: {get} euros. Claim a neighborhood: {get2}. Declare a war: {get3}
textos.Fíjate lo que te voy a decir:: Listen to what I'm going to tell you:
GPS canceled: it no longer guides you to {nombre}. With Ctrl G you get it back.
GPS canceled: it no longer guides you to {nombre}. With G you set the mission again.
textos.GPS hacia lo último que dijo el radar: GPS to the last thing the radar said
textos.GPS hacia {nombre}. Si se mueve, vuelve: GPS to {nombre}. If they move, set it again.
textos.GPS, baliza, anuncios y sonidos de orien: GPS, beacon, announcements and orientation sounds.
textos.Gafas, cadenas, anillos, relojes, gorras: Glasses, chains, rings, watches, caps, bags, belts, bracelets, scarves, ties, perfumes... One of each kind.
textos.Galería de tiro. Sonarán diez dianas: a: Shooting gallery. Ten targets will sound: on the left, in the center or on the right. Press left arrow, up arrow or right arrow right away, depending on where the sound comes from. Ready.
textos.Ganancia por tu cuenta: hasta {int} euro: Earnings on your own: up to {int} euros per hour
textos.Ganas fama en San Lucero, y Los Lagartos: You gain street reputation in San Lucero, and Los Lagartos will come after you.
textos.Ganas mucha fama en Bahía del Ocaso. No: You gain a lot of street reputation in Bahía del Ocaso. You get paid nothing.
textos.Ganas: los guardaespaldas te cobran un {: You gain: bodyguards charge you {int} percent less and bribes work out better
textos.Garfios, fusiles de pesca submarina y cu: Hooks, spearfishing guns and fish-scaling knives.
textos.Gasolinera con tienda. Café de máquina y: Gas station with a store. Vending machine coffee and sandwiches wrapped in plastic.
Uses up one batch of supplies per day.
textos.Gastas un botiquín. Es lo mejor que pued: You use up a first aid kit. It's the best you can do.
Seagulls, on the beach and at the harbor.
textos.Gemma 3 de Google, 770 megas. Es el que: Gemma 3 by Google, 770 megabytes. It answers most sensibly, with short sentences. It uses 1 gigabyte of memory. On a current computer it answers in 1 second; on an older four-core one, in about 6; on a two-core one, in about 10. Its use is subject to the Gemma terms, at ai.google.dev/gemma/terms.
textos.Genera una frase con tu nombre, dicha po: Generates a line with your name, spoken by a character from the story. It takes a moment.
textos.Genera una frase dicha por ti, con la vo: Generates a line spoken by you, with the chosen voice. It takes a moment.
textos.Generar las voces de tu propio personaje: Generate the voices of your own character
textos.Gente de la calle y animales: People on the street and animals
People waiting with papers in hand.
textos.Gente que habla al pasar: People who talk as you pass
textos.Gente que se queda en el barrio. Cada gu: People who stay in the neighborhood. Each guard raises the defense, gets paid every midnight and makes loyalty drop half as fast. If you're attacked and do nothing, the guard defends on its own; with no guard, the neighborhood is lost. If one midnight you can't pay them, they leave. You pay the first day when you hire.
textos.Golpe brutal contra el suelo. Sigues viv: Brutal impact with the ground. You're alive by a miracle.
textos.Golpes preparados: cómo funciona. Recorr: Heists: how it works. Go through the explanation with the arrow keys
textos.Google AI Studio tiene un nivel gratuito: Google AI Studio has a free tier. Enter to type or delete the key.
textos.Graba cada frase en un archivo aparte, e: Record each line in a separate file, in WAV, OGG, FLAC or MP3, with the name shown,
textos.Grabaciones reales para pasos, puertas,: Real recordings for footsteps, doors, weapons, hits, glass, car, rain, water and coins.
Thanks to you for the conversation.
textos.Gracias, de verdad. No hay mucha gente a: Thank you, really. There aren't many people like you.
Thanks, but I have a partner.
textos.Gracias. De verdad. La primera copa de c: Thank you. Really. The first drink every night is yours, as long as I sing here.
Thanks. You fix yourself up as best you can.
textos.Grados que hay que girar, en total: Degrees you must turn, in total
textos.Grados que se puede ir torcido: Degrees you can be off course
textos.Gran Premio de la Era, solo para valient: The Era Grand Prix, only for the brave
textos.Gratificación o descuento por cómo ha id: Bonus or discount for how the flight went, percent
Free, but you might get seen.
textos.Gratis, sin internet y sin clave. Intro: Free, offline and no key needed. Enter to download, change or remove the model.
textos.Gratis. Quita la sed, con la vida realis: Free. It quenches your thirst, with realistic life.
textos.Gravedad del antecedente, de 1 a 3: Severity of the criminal record, from 1 to 3
textos.Gravedad del hurto si te ven: Severity of the theft if they see you
textos.Gravedad máxima con beneficio de la duda: Maximum severity given the benefit of the doubt
textos.Gravedad máxima de la falta que encubren: Maximum severity of the offense they cover up
textos.Gritarles para espantarlos: Shout at them to scare them off

textos.Grúa: retira el {nombre} mal aparcado ju: Tow truck: remove the badly parked {nombre} next to {nombre2}.
textos.Guarda aquí la partida tal como está aho: Saves the game here as it is now. If the slot already had a game, it replaces it.
textos.Guarda aquí objetos de la mochila, merca: Store backpack items, product and weapons here, and take them out when you need them. What is at home can't be taken by the police and isn't lost if you go down.
textos.Guarda de la sierra hasta que cerraron e: Mountain ranger until they closed the hunting preserve. Starts with marksmanship at level four, a mountain carbine with twelve bullets and two hundred euros.
Saves the mod under another name.
Saves the mod and opens the game.
textos.Guarda el punto donde estás para volver: Save the spot where you are to come back later with the GPS, go to one you already saved or delete the last one.
textos.Guarda el vehículo del que te has bajado: It stores the vehicle you got out of, without having to go back for it.
Saves everything on the server to disk.
textos.Guarda en un archivo de texto lo que hay: Saves what is in the log to a text file.
Saves what is in the log to a text file. Also with Ctrl+G.
Put that away, we're not up for scares.
Saves the information to a file.
textos.Guardado final: segundos que se espera a: Final save: seconds to wait when stopping

textos.Guardar el registro en un archivo: Save the log to a file
textos.Guardar toda la mercancía que llevas: {c: Store all the product you are carrying: {carga} units
textos.Guardar todo el dinero que llevas: Store all the money you are carrying
textos.Guardar un marcador en mi posición actua: Save a marker at my current position
textos.Guardarte lo que sabes y cobrarle por tu: Keep what you know and charge him for your silence
textos.Guardas el vehículo en el que has venido: You store the vehicle you came in and stay on foot at the door. Aircraft don't fit, nor vehicles you can't keep, and nothing does if the garage is full.
textos.Guardas en el armario {n} unidades de me: You store {n} units of product in the wardrobe.
textos.Guardas {_cuantos}: lo fresco a la never: You store {_cuantos}: fresh items go in the fridge and the rest in the pantry.
textos.Guardia fija: {guardia} de {entero}. Con: Standing guard: {guardia} of {entero}. Hire one more, {entero2} euros a day
textos.Guardias fijos que admite un barrio: Fixed guards a neighborhood can hold
textos.Guardártelo y hacerle una visita: 2500 e: Keep it and pay him a visit: 2500 euros
