textos.Guerra por %s: atacantes %d puntos, defe: War for %s: attackers %d points, defenders %d. %d minutes left.
textos.Guion escrito en la carpeta de voces, co:
Script written to the voices folder, named {nombre}. It opens now in Notepad.

Each line has above it the name its recording must have. Leave the recordings in that same folder.
textos.Guisos de puchero y menú del día. Aquí c: Home-style stews and set menu. The newspaper crowd eats here.
textos.Guárdalo bien. El día que eso llegue a u: Keep it safe. The day that reaches a judge, it's all over.
textos.Guárdalo en el garaje de una de tus casa: Store it in the garage of one of your homes.
A criminal record entry has expired.
textos.Ha cambiado mucho, pero sigue siendo un: It's changed a lot, but it's still a good place.
textos.Ha cerrado la desaladora entera. Ni el c: He has shut down the entire desalination plant. Not the riverbed, not downtown, not the hotels. He says it won't reopen until the concession is returned to him.
textos.Ha declarado cuatro horas seguidas. Grac: He testified for four hours straight. Thank you. Nobody will thank you for this out loud, so I'm telling you.
That was good. You're getting to know each other.
textos.Ha explotado una granada, un cohete o un: A grenade, a rocket or a vehicle has exploded.
textos.Ha huido de la policía: procede la deten: He fled from the police: arrest is warranted.
textos.Ha ido bien. Tan bien que los de arriba: It went well. So well that those above want more: not a few bills, but everything from the harbor going through your accounts. You provide the clean face; we provide the rest.
textos.Ha llamado a {local}. Tomo nota: {cosas}: You've called {local}. I'm noting it down: {cosas}. It leaves for {casa} as soon as it's ready; allow {minutos} minutes.
textos.Ha llamado una periodista de Puerto Brav: A reporter from Puerto Bravo called, from El Faro. She says she knows you and wants to tell the story of the cooperative. I told her to come for lunch.
textos.Ha llegado consciente, y eso es gracias: He arrived conscious, and that's thanks to you. The town hall pays little, but it pays.
textos.Ha llegado la hora de ir a por Belmonte: The time has come to go after Belmonte at his own house.
textos.Ha llegado un crucero: hay turistas por: A cruise ship has arrived: there are tourists everywhere and the bars raise their prices.
textos.Ha ocurrido un error inesperado y el jue: An unexpected error has occurred and the game must close. Your game was saved automatically. To help fix it, zip this session's folder, which is inside data, logs
textos.Ha parado a uno que iba a por ti: Has stopped one who was coming for you
textos.Ha pasado una inspección por uno de tus: An inspection has gone through one of your businesses: knuckles knocking on the door, papers and a stamp. If it found something, it is on your phone, under Life, reputation and consequences.
textos.Ha saltado la alarma de un vehículo o de: The alarm of a vehicle or a venue has gone off.
textos.Ha saltado la alarma. Calculo {segundos}: The alarm went off. I make it {segundos} seconds until they arrive.
textos.Ha sido una de esas noches que se recuer: It was one of those nights you remember: you understood each other without words.
textos.Ha venido uno con corbata. Quiere la coo: A man in a tie came by. He wants the whole cooperative: the land, the mill, the brand. He pays well, I won't lie to you.
textos.Ha venido uno con traje, de parte de un: A man in a suit came by, on behalf of a councilman. He says you already work for him. He wants his envelope here too.
textos.Haber usado el radar, con el Tabulador,: Have used the radar, with Tab, during this step
textos.Habitaciones con chimenea y desayuno de: Rooms with a fireplace and a village breakfast.
Talk to someone. Even if it's me.
textos.Habla con la gente. Cada uno tiene una h: Talk to people. Everyone has a story.
textos.Hablan bien de ti en el barrio. Dicen qu: People speak well of you in the neighborhood. They say you can be trusted.
textos.Hablan de un coche robado que apareció q: They talk about a stolen car that turned up burned on the outskirts.
textos.Hablan de un negocio que cambió de dueño: They talk about a business that changed owners overnight.
textos.Hablando con la gente de la calle, olien: Talking to people on the street while smelling bad
textos.Hablar en personaje, para quien está cer: Speak in character, to those nearby
textos.Hablarle con tus palabras: Talk to them in your own words
textos.Hablas cinco minutos. Pides tiempo, diál: You speak for five minutes. You ask for time, dialogue and sensitivity. They applaud politely.
textos.Hablas con uno de los tuyos: You talk to one of your crew
textos.Hablas diez minutos. Dices nombres, fech: You speak for ten minutes. You give names, dates and amounts. Nobody coughs.
textos.Habláis de fútbol. {nombre} es del equip: You talk about soccer. {nombre} supports the team that always loses, and defends it like their life depended on it.
textos.Habláis de lo que haréis el fin de seman: You talk about what you'll do over the weekend.
You talk about a bit of everything.
You talk for a while about nothing in particular.
textos.Hace días que no pasas por casa: You haven't been home for days
textos.Hace falta confianza, y uno al día por p: This takes trust, and only one per person per day. What they do depends on how you are doing: if the police are after you at a low level, they hide you; if your health is low, they patch you up; otherwise they give you a tip about something nearby or speak well of you in the neighborhood.
textos.Hace falta mucha química. Tener pareja s: It takes a lot of chemistry. Having a partner lifts your mood every day, but you have to take care of it.
textos.Hace falta para trabajar en un laborator: Needed to work in a lab. The lab is set up in a home of yours, from its menu.
textos.Hace falta que estéis muy unidos y haber: You need to be very close and have had quite a few dates. Once engaged, you can live together and plan the wedding.
textos.Hace falta que le caigas bien. Tus conoc: They have to like you. Your contacts are in your phone and they tell you things.
textos.Hace falta una casa tuya con garaje, com: You need a house of yours with a garage, bought and not rented.
textos.Hace tres meses que las nóminas llegan c: For three months the paychecks have been coming up short. The accountant says it's the banks.
textos.Hace un día de los de quedarse en la cal: It's one of those days to stay out on the street.
textos.Hace un día precioso, ¿verdad? Da alegrí: Beautiful day, isn't it? It's a joy to be out.
textos.Hace una copia de seguridad de los datos: Makes a backup of the data in the backups folder.
textos.Hace una pregunta de prueba y te dice qu: It asks a test question and tells you which service and which model answered and how long it took.
textos.Hace {dias} {v} que no pasas por aquí: It's been {dias} {v} since you came by here
textos.Hacen su trabajo. Otra cosa es que lo ha: They do their job. Whether they do it well is another matter.
textos.Hacer deporte sienta muy bien. Yo salgo: Exercise feels great. I go out for walks.
textos.Hacer el pedido: todavía no has elegido: Place the order: you haven't picked anything yet
textos.Hacer el pedido: {len} cosas, {v} euros: Place the order: {len} items, {v} euros with delivery
textos.Hacer la compra es mi deporte. Cargo com: Grocery shopping is my sport. I carry like a mule.
textos.Hacer tiempo. Tengo que recoger una cosa: Killing time. I have to pick something up and they haven't opened yet.
textos.Hacerle una broma y perseguirle por el p: Play a joke on them and chase them down the hallway
textos.Haces la misión con {nombre}: lo que hay: You do the mission with {nombre}: whatever has to be carried goes with you.
You make a donation: coins falling.
textos.Haces una jornada de trabajo: la sirena: You put in a day's work: the factory siren and the hours go by.
textos.Hacia el {hacia} ya no hay más cruces: s: There are no more intersections to the {hacia}: {nombre} ends.
textos.Hambre que quita cada ración, de 0 a 100: Hunger each portion removes, from 0 to 100
textos.Hambre que quita si se come tal cual, de: Hunger it removes if eaten as is, from 0 to 100
textos.Han avisado a la policía. Despístala ant: The police have been alerted. Shake them off before going back to the neighborhood.
textos.Han cambiado las tiendas, pero la gente: The stores have changed, but the people are the same.
textos.Han cerrado el cine viejo. Ahí vi yo mi: They closed the old cinema. That's where I saw my first movie.
textos.Han cortado la carretera de la costa y n: The coast road has been cut off and no stock is arriving: everything is more expensive today.
textos.Han dado el aviso. Despista a la Guardia: Someone raised the alarm. Shake off the Guardia Civil.
textos.Han detenido a {n} con {u} unidades enci: {n} has been arrested with {u} units on them. They will be out for a few days.
textos.Han entrado a robar en {casa}: se han ll: Someone broke into {casa} to rob it: they took {que}.
textos.Han entrado tres cisternas con los faros: Three tankers came in with their headlights off, and none had the company's sign.
textos.Han llegado a la vez que tú. Echa del ba: They arrived at the same time as you. Throw out the ones who've come to settle old scores at the bar.
textos.Han llegado tres cartas al bar: una de P: Three letters have arrived at the bar: one from Puerto Bravo, one from Villaseca and one from San Lucero. What you decided in each place is starting to come together.
textos.Han pasado inspección por {negocio}: ni: They inspected {negocio}: not a single violation. That's what we like to see.
textos.Han pasado por la farmacia, por Paco y p: They've been to the pharmacy, to Paco and to the laundromat. Two hundred a week each, "in case something happens." Two have paid.
textos.Han retirado el plan. Dicen que «para es: They've withdrawn the plan. They say "to study it better." And tomorrow El Faro leads with what you said.
textos.Han sacado cuatro cajas de archivo y las: They took out four file boxes and loaded them into a van, headed for the town hall.
textos.Han venido preguntando por ti. Están en: They've been asking about you. They're at the spoil heap, waiting for dark.
textos.Han vuelto. Se han hecho fuertes en el m: They're back. They've dug in at the old mill and stolen the deeds to half the town. Without deeds, anyone can take our land.
textos.Hangar: no tienes plaza aquí. Alquilarla: Hangar: you have no spot here. Renting one costs {precio} euros a day; buying one, {hangar_precio_compra}
textos.Hangares. En cada campo puedes alquilar: Hangars. At every airfield you can rent a spot, at {precio} euros a day, or buy it. There is room for {entero} aircraft. What you store is never lost, and there you can refuel and repair. Your aircraft appear on the phone, in My Vehicles: from there you set them on the GPS or send one to the hangar for {precio2} euros.
textos.Has acertado una diana de la galería de: You hit a target at the shooting gallery.
You have run over a pedestrian.
textos.Has caído ante {get}. Se lleva {n} euros: You fell to {get}. They take {n} euros of what you were carrying.
textos.Has cerrado tu partida a los amigos. Sig: You closed your game to friends. You keep playing on your own.
textos.Has completado la historia de Puerto Bra: You have completed the story of Puerto Bravo: Ley del Asfalto. The city is still open: businesses, races, jobs and secrets await you. Thanks for playing.
textos.Has completado las historias de Montefer: You have completed the Monteferro stories.
textos.Has completado las historias de San Luce: You have completed the San Lucero stories.
textos.Has completado las historias del mar. Qu: You have completed the sea stories. There are still bottles with messages floating in Mar de Poniente and doubloons buried on Isla Tortuga.
textos.Has completado todas las misiones de la: You have completed all the story missions. The city is yours.
You have bought shares on the stock market.
textos.Has comprado o vendido mercancía: billet: You have bought or sold product: bills and a package changing hands.
textos.Has conquistado todos los barrios de {ci: You've conquered all the neighborhoods of {ciudad}, but conquering isn't the end.
You've conquered all the neighborhoods of {ciudad}. The gangs will take a while to get back on their feet: you have {dias} of calm.
textos.Has conseguido uno de los logros del jue: You have earned one of the game's achievements.
textos.Has contado tres entregas. Los tres sobr: You've counted three deliveries. All three envelopes were taken by the same man, and he got into a town hall car.
textos.Has dejado atrás el vehículo de la misió: You left the mission vehicle behind.
textos.Has dejado atrás {nombre}. Vuelve a por: You left {nombre} behind. Go back for [him|her].
textos.Has dejado de trabajar. Sube al vehículo: You stopped working. Get in the practice vehicle and press J to start again: you have to complete one service.
textos.Has dejado el vehículo de trabajo: se ac: You left the work vehicle: the service is over.
You let the target get away.
textos.Has dejado la banda o te han echado: ya: You left the gang or were kicked out: you can no longer see its people or its till.
textos.Has despistado a la policía. Ya no te bu: You have shaken off the police. They are no longer looking for you.
You put everything back. The basket is empty.
textos.Has elegido que para crear un personaje: You chose to require the entry password to create a character, but the password is empty. Type one, or change who can create a character.
textos.Has elegido una dirección personalizada,: You chose a custom address, but you have not entered one. Enter it in Options, Updates.
textos.Has encontrado un objeto de colección, {: You found a collectible, {nombre}: you have {n} of {total}. Prize of {premio} euros.
textos.Has entrado con tu personaje desde otro: You have come in with your character from somewhere else.
textos.Has estado {dias} {v} del servidor sin e: You haven't joined the server in {dias} {v}.
You have failed a mission, or you have gone down.
You spoke well. You spoke very well. I wish you'd said something.
You tried to walk into a wall.
textos.Has llegado al destino o has completado: You have reached your destination or completed a mission step.
textos.Has llegado al principio o al final de u: You have reached the start or the end of a menu, or the edge of the map.
textos.Has llegado tarde. Otra ambulancia se ha: You arrived late. Another ambulance took over.
textos.Has llegado tarde: el edificio ha ardido: You arrived late: the whole building burned down.
textos.Has llegado, pero este ejercicio es para: You have arrived, but this exercise is for learning the radar. Press Tab to hear what is near you: that completes it.
You have arrived. Stop the vehicle.
textos.Has matado a uno de {banda_nombre}, de l: You killed one of {banda_nombre}, one of your own. {banda} left.
textos.Has mejorado en conducción, puntería, re: You have improved in driving, shooting, stamina or fishing.
textos.Has pedido girar en el próximo cruce. Su: You have asked to turn at the next intersection. It sounds until you turn.
textos.Has perdido el conocimiento y despiertas: You have passed out and wake up in the hospital.
textos.Has perdido {barrio}: ahora manda {banda: You've lost {barrio}: {banda} is now in charge.
textos.Has puesto la llave de un certificado pe: You have set a certificate key but not the certificate.
textos.Has rechazado un asalto, o has arrasado: You have fought off an assault, or you have wiped out a gang's hideout: a drumroll and three rising notes.
textos.Has recuperado lo de Anselmo y queda un: You recovered Anselmo's things and one rustler is left alive, with his hands up. What do you do?
textos.Has salido de {nombre}. Vuelve antes de: You left {nombre}. Come back within {int} seconds or the fight is counted as lost.
textos.Has subido demasiado: el radar te tiene: You climbed too high: the radar has you again.
textos.Has tardado poco para ser del cauce. Soy: You took little time for someone from the riverbed. I'm Mirlo. Up here they pay us to watch and to keep quiet.
textos.Has tensado demasiado la cuerda. {banda}: You've pushed too hard. {banda} takes back what they said.
textos.Has terminado los estudios de un título:: You have finished studying for a degree: a short fanfare and a long chord.
textos.Has terminado un curso en una academia y: You have finished a course at an academy and a skill goes up.
textos.Has tirado antes de tiempo y espantas a: You pulled too soon and scare off the fish.
textos.Has tumbado a alguien que no se defendía: You took down someone who wasn't fighting back. They're offering {recompensa} euros for your head, and the police are after you.
textos.Has tumbado a {get}. Te llevas {n} euros: You took down {get}. You get {n} euros.{get2}
textos.Has vuelto en buen momento. O en malo, s: You came back at a good time. Or a bad one, depending on how you look at it.
textos.Hasta cuántos golpes sigue aprendiendo: Up to how many heists they keep learning
textos.Hasta {MAX_NOMBRE} letras. Lo que escrib: Up to {MAX_NOMBRE} letters. What you type here is not recorded in the game log.
textos.Hasta {NOMBRE_MAX} letras. El juego lo d: Up to {NOMBRE_MAX} letters. The game will say it when you get in, when you locate it and in lists. If you leave it empty, it goes back to being called by its model name. Tab suggests random names. What you type here is not recorded in the game log.
textos.Hasta {NOMBRE_MAX} letras. Lo guarda el: Up to {NOMBRE_MAX} letters. The server stores it and other players see it too. If you leave it empty, it goes back to being called by its model name. Tab suggests random names.
textos.Hasta {get} vehículos al día por desguac: Up to {get} vehicles a day per scrapyard; stolen ones at {get2} percent
textos.Hasta {get} vehículos del jugador en la: Up to {get} of the player's vehicles on the street; insurance at {get2} euros a day per vehicle; gang driver
textos.Hay alguien esperándote en el Mirador de: Someone is waiting for you at the Bay Viewpoint. He wouldn't come in. He says what comes next depends on everything you've done until today.
textos.Hay barrios enteros atemorizados por cua: Whole neighborhoods are terrified by four guys with guns.
textos.Hay calles que ya no tienen agua ni las: There are streets that don't even get the two hours of water anymore. Someone is taking the copper pipes, section by section.
textos.Hay cambios sin guardar. ¿Quieres guarda: There are unsaved changes. Do you want to save them?
textos.Hay casas en venta, si tienes con qué. T: There are houses for sale, if you can afford one. They even throw in a garage.
textos.Hay cine, hay feria, hay bares. Aburrirs: There's a cinema, a fair, bars. Getting bored here takes some doing.
textos.Hay componentes nuevos: {n}. Puede ser u: There are new components: {n}. It may be a language, some voices or a sound pack. They are in Options, Updates, Components.
textos.Hay contrabandistas usando el pecio del: Smugglers are using the Santa Clara wreck. They drop bundles in the water and others pick them up at night. This cove has always belonged to fishermen, not crooks.
textos.Hay de todo. También hay gente con diner: There's a bit of everything. There are also wealthy people who help out.
textos.Hay demasiadas conexiones desde tu direc: Too many connections from your address. Try again in a moment.
textos.Hay dos variantes de los pasos de cada s: There are two variants of the footsteps for each surface, alternating left foot and right foot. They must last less than a quarter of a second.
textos.Hay huelga de transportes: apenas circul: There is a transport strike: hardly any vehicles are running.
There are lots of people around.
textos.Hay mucha gente... yo voy un rato y me v: There are a lot of people... I go for a while and then head back.
textos.Hay más bares que farmacias. Por algo se: There are more bars than pharmacies. There must be a reason.
textos.Hay plantas, cuadros en las paredes y un: There are plants, pictures on the walls and a rug that feels great underfoot.
You have to eat, drink, sleep and wash. With hunger, thirst or sleepiness you move slower and aim worse, and if you ignore them you lose health. You drink at bars, stores and in your kitchen; the shower is at your home or in a hotel. Being dirty lowers your mood. The V key tells you how you are doing, and Shift V, only that. Besides eating out or ordering delivery, you can buy groceries at grocery stores, store them in your home's kitchen and cook: it is the most filling and the cheapest.
textos.Hay que llevar una copia del expediente: A copy of the file has to get to the Puerto Bravo reporter before Belmonte closes the roads. And he closed them an hour ago.
textos.Hay que llevarse un vehículo concreto: {: You have to take a specific vehicle: {nombre}. Yours stays parked and safe.
textos.Hay que registrarlo hoy en el ayuntamien: It has to be registered at the town hall today, and first you have to stop by the newspaper for the copies. What's left of the councilman's people know it.
You've got to laugh, it's free.
textos.Hay que sacar las cajas del faro antes d: We have to get the crates out of the lighthouse before someone calls the Guardia Civil.
textos.Hay quejas por el vuelo: {extra} euros m: There are complaints about the flight: {extra} euros less.
textos.Hay quien lo quiere y quien le tiene mie: Some love him and some fear him. Me, neither: I keep my distance.
Some people pay well for those.
textos.Hay rachas. La mía duró un año, y aquí s: There are streaks. Mine lasted a year, and here I am.
textos.Hay tres canales, cada uno con su sonido: There are three channels, each with its own sound. In character: your character speaks, and whoever is within {metros} meters hears it. Action: you describe what they do, and your name is heard followed by what you type. Out of character: you speak as yourself, and the whole server hears it. In any message you can start with slash yo, slash ep or slash fp to pick the channel, and slash ficha and a sentence changes your profile. To talk by voice, use a separate voice program.
textos.Hay un cartel con tu cara: ofrecen {reco: There's a poster with your face: they offer {recompensa} euros for your head.
textos.Hay un cartel nuevo, y el del retrato er: There's a new poster, and the one in the portrait is you
There is an enemy. Press Q to lock on.
textos.Hay un frente de tormenta delante, a {km: There's a storm front ahead, {km} kilometers away.
textos.Hay un hombre, Braulio Seisdedos, que tr: There's a man, Braulio Seisdedos, who works for the water company. He sends people to burst the hydrants so we have to buy from them.
textos.Hay un hotel por aquí si no tienes dónde: There's a hotel around here if you have nowhere to sleep.
There's an obstacle and I can't go on alone. Continue with the arrow keys.
textos.Hay un patrón que sale cada tarde de la: There's a skipper who leaves the fish market every afternoon with empty hands and full pockets. Follow him from a distance and tell me where he goes.
textos.Hay un prestamista que sale del banco ca: There's a loan shark who leaves the bank every afternoon and nobody knows where he goes. Follow him on foot, from a distance. Listen to his footsteps: if you stick close, he sees you; if you fall behind, you lose him.
textos.Hay una banda nueva, Los Lagartos, que c: There's a new gang, Los Lagartos, that charges for letting people work. Right now there are three in Cathedral Square, next to the Lion Fountain, scaring the shopkeepers.
textos.Hay una caja de contadores retirados en: There's a box of removed meters at the municipal depot. I can't get in. You already know the way.
textos.Hay una cisterna llena en la desaladora,: There's a full tanker at the desalination plant, and a whole neighborhood waiting.
textos.Hay una fiesta en un yate fondeado junto: There's a party on a yacht anchored next to Mermaid Reef. People from Las Torres, with more money than sense. They want pills, and the best ones are made by La Química, in San Lucero.
textos.Hay una nota en la nevera: «Estoy en {lu: There's a note on the fridge: "I'm at {lugar}. See you later."
textos.Hay una persecución en vehículo: ve con: There is a vehicle chase: go with a fast one, whichever you like.
textos.Hay una reunión en la Torre Belmonte. La: There's a meeting at Torre Belmonte. The top floor has been empty since its owner fell. Someone has to take it.
textos.Hay una versión nueva del juego, la {ver: There's a new version of the game, {version}. To install it, go to Options, Updates.
textos.Hay una versión nueva, la {version}. Tie: There's a new version, {version}. You have {VERSION}
textos.Hay varios encargos, cada uno de una man: There are several jobs, each done a different way. Choose one with Enter
textos.Hay zonas por las que yo ya no paso de n: There are areas I don't walk through at night anymore.
textos.Hay {len} misiones nuevas disponibles, a: There are {len} new missions available, some in other towns. Check them on the phone with M.
textos.Hay {n} enemigos. Pulsa Q para fijar al: There are {n} enemies. Press Q to lock onto the nearest one.
textos.Hay {n} objetivos de prácticas; el más c: There are {n} practice targets; the nearest, {metros}.
textos.Hay {v} aparcado junto a {nombre}. Sube: There is {v} parked next to {nombre}. Get in with F and press J to start working.
Do like me: don't let them see you down.
Do ten good deeds on the street.
textos.Haz la ronda: el Banco Mercantil, la lon: Make the rounds: Mercantil Bank, the fish market and Casino Belmonte, in that order. You just have to be seen.
textos.Haz lo que te pida el cuerpo. Y luego ar: Do what your body asks. And then regret it, like everybody.
Do what I would do: the best you can.
textos.Hazle caso a tu conciencia. No suele fal: Listen to your conscience. It rarely fails.
Listen to me and you won't go wrong.
textos.Hazte con el blindado que carga junto a: Take the armored van loading next to the Aguas del Ocaso Headquarters.
textos.Hazte con el buggy cargado que hay junto: Get the loaded buggy next to the Old Lighthouse Heliport.
textos.Hazte con el volquete cargado junto al T: Get the loaded dump truck next to the Castillete Repair Shop.
textos.Hazte con la cisterna que espera junto a: Take the tanker waiting next to the Desalination Plant, in Las Naves.
textos.He abierto el puerto %s en tu router: qu: I opened port %s on your router: anyone playing from outside your home can now join with your public address. It will close when the server stops.
textos.He abierto el puerto en tu router: tus a: I opened the port on your router: friends outside your home can now join using the internet address.
textos.He estado en el Mercado Central, en el p: I've been to Central Market, at the fruit stand. It must be around there. With these legs I can't make it. Will you go?
textos.He estado en todas partes. Y en todas me: I've been everywhere. And everywhere they know me.
textos.He leído lo del concejal de Puerto Bravo: I read about the Puerto Bravo councilman in the paper. They say you carried the papers. Doesn't surprise me.
textos.He pedido al router que cierre el puerto: I asked the router to close the port.
I've broken more hearts than plates.
textos.He salido poco. Una vez fui a la capital: I haven't been out much. Once I went to the capital and got lost.
It's done. Now let's see where it leads.
textos.Hecho. En la cuenta hay {banco} euros y: Done. The account holds {banco} euros and you are carrying {dinero}.
textos.Hecho. En la próxima conversación se vue: Done. In the next conversation, each service will be asked again.
Done. Go back to {nombre} to get paid.
textos.Hecho. Y el lanchón viejo, el que era de: Done. And the old barge, the one that belonged to both of them, Dani keeps it. At least let it be good for something.
textos.Hecho. Ya sabes fijar, atacar, disparar: Done. You now know how to lock on, attack, shoot and reload.
textos.Hecho. Ya sabes lo fundamental: orientar: Done. You know the basics: getting your bearings, using the GPS and the radar, and driving.
textos.Hecho: has zarpado, has llevado el timón: Done: you set sail, took the helm and docked. That's all it takes to get around by sea.
textos.Hecho: refuerzo de nivel {refuerzo} de {: Done: reinforcement level {refuerzo} of {entero}. Doors, lookouts and neighborhood people paid to warn you. Defense: {int} out of 100.
textos.Helados artesanos frente al puerto depor: Artisan ice cream facing the marina.
textos.Helicóptero de la policía con el nivel d: Police helicopter at the highest wanted level
textos.Herida de {get} días; plantón, {get2} de: Wound of {get} days; stood up, {get2} of affinity
textos.Herido a bordo. Llévalo a {nombre} cuant: Injured person on board. Take them to {nombre} as soon as possible.
textos.Herido entregado en urgencias: Injured person delivered to the emergency room
Crushed ice and the smell of the sea.
textos.Hielo picado y pescado fresco. Aquí se v: Crushed ice and fresh fish. You sell and buy here.
textos.Higiene que da, si es de aseo, de 0 a 10: Hygiene it gives, if it is a toiletry, from 0 to 100
textos.Hij[o|a], ¿tú con qué te crees que se pa: Kid, what do you think paid for this bar?
textos.Hija de viñadores, acostumbrada a trabaj: Daughter of vintners, used to working from sunup to sundown. Starts with endurance at level four, a bit more health, a sickle and a good standing with the neighbors.
textos.Historias de la sierra y más encargos: Stories from the Mountains and More Jobs
textos.Hizo de todo en las lanchas del contraba: Did a bit of everything on the smuggling boats. Starts with driving at level three, some marksmanship, street reputation and two lockpick sets.
textos.Hola, tía. He salido esta mañana. No ten: Hi, Auntie. I got out this morning. I don't even have enough for a coffee.
Honest and without wasting the afternoon.
Time to go home, that's for sure.

textos.Horario {horario}. Ahora da {ingreso_neg: Hours: {horario}. It now earns {ingreso_negocio} euros a day.

textos.Horas de ganancia que se pueden acumular: Hours of earnings that can build up
textos.Horas de juego hasta morirse de sed: Game hours until dying of thirst
textos.Horas de juego hasta necesitar una ducha: Game hours until you really need a shower

textos.Horas que dura un vehículo en la calle: Hours a vehicle lasts on the street

textos.Hospital: lo más que te cobran por una s: Hospital: the most they charge you for an overdose, adult content

textos.Hoy cenas aquí, con luz, y no pagas. Y m: Tonight you eat here, with the lights on, and you don't pay. And tomorrow neither.
The harbor smells like a storm today.
textos.Hoy en El Faro: Puerto Bravo respira. Be: Today in El Faro: Puerto Bravo breathes again. Belmonte, in custody.
textos.Hoy en El Faro: atraco millonario en el: Today in El Faro: million-euro robbery at the Casino Belmonte.
textos.Hoy en El Faro: el Ayuntamiento promete: Today in El Faro: Town Hall promises to fix the square's clock for the fifteenth time.
textos.Hoy en El Faro: el comisario Varela, det: Today in El Faro: Commissioner Varela arrested. The recordings that sink Belmonte.
textos.Hoy en El Faro: el empresario Octavio Be: Today in El Faro: businessman Octavio Belmonte denies any link to organized crime.
textos.Hoy en El Faro: suben los robos de coche: Today in El Faro: car thefts rise in Barrio Viejo.
textos.Hoy en El Faro: tiroteo en el puerto, la: Today in El Faro: shootout at the harbor, police find no witnesses.
textos.Hoy en El Faro: ¿quién paga a Los Calave: Today in El Faro: who pays Los Calaveras? An investigation by Marta Salgado.
textos.Hoy es el día {dia} desde que volviste,: Today is day {dia} since you came back, time flies.
textos.Hoy es fiesta: las calles están llenas d: Today is a holiday: the streets are full of people and there are fewer cars.
textos.Hoy están todos en la guarida, con su je: Today they're all at the hideout, with their boss, El Huesos. Eight of them. If you go in, tomorrow the harbor is quiet. I'll give you something for the party.
textos.Hoy hay caras raras por la calle. Alguie: There are strange faces on the street today. Someone is plotting something against your neighborhoods, but you don't know where.
There is a market today: eating is cheaper.
There is a sale at the gun shops today.
textos.Hoy he comido de bocadillo, que no he te: Today I ate a sandwich, I didn't have time.
textos.Hoy he tenido un día de perros en el tra: I had a dog of a day at work today.
textos.Hoy me he torcido el tobillo. Los termos: I sprained my ankle today. The thermoses stay hot for five minutes, not one more.
textos.Hoy no hay prisa. Caricias, la ventana a: There's no rush today. Caresses, the window open and the sea in the background.
There is not a soul on the street today.
textos.Hoy no hay vuelos desde este campo: There are no flights from this airfield today
textos.Hoy no llega el alquiler de {casa}: {inq: The rent for {casa} does not arrive today: {inquilino} asks for one more day.
textos.Hoy no llega el sobre de {banda}. Han de: The envelope from {banda} doesn't arrive today. They've decided they're not afraid of you anymore.
textos.Hoy no puedes blanquear más aquí, o no t: Today you cannot launder any more here, or you have no dirty money to launder, or you are not carrying cash.
textos.Hoy no puedo, {tu}, pero apúntame para o: I can't today, {tu}, but put me down for another day.
I can't today. Another day, maybe.
Not today. And I don't think tomorrow either.
textos.Hoy ponen {choice} Sales dos horas despu: Today they're showing {choice} You leave two hours later, at {hora_txt}.
Today for you, tomorrow for me.
textos.Hoy rindes menos; mañana tienes un compa: You perform worse today; tomorrow you have a coworker.
textos.Hoy tenías la mano fina: está para chupa: You had a golden touch today: it's finger-licking good.
Today is going to be a good day.
textos.Hoy vence lo pactado con {banda}: desde: Today the deal with {banda} expires: from tomorrow, everyone goes their own way.
textos.Hoy ya habéis comido juntos. Queda algo: You've already eaten together today. There's something left in the fridge for tomorrow.
textos.Hoy ya habéis hecho un plan. {n} quiere: You've already made a plan today. {n} wants to save something for tomorrow.
textos.Hoy ya habéis salido. {nombre} tiene cos: You two already went out today. {nombre} has things to do.
textos.Hoy ya has echado tus horas aquí. Vuelve: You've already put in your hours here today. Come back tomorrow.
textos.Hoy ya has echado una mano. Vuelve mañan: You've already lent a hand today. Come back tomorrow.
You've already talked for a while with {n} today.
textos.Hoy ya has hecho servicios a la comunida: You've already done community service today. Come back tomorrow.
textos.Hoy ya has ido a clase del título. Una s: You've already been to class for the degree today. One session a day.
You've already put money into this neighborhood today. Tomorrow, more.
textos.Hoy ya has removido todo esto tres veces: Today you have already stirred all this three times. Come back tomorrow.
textos.Hoy ya has trabajado una jornada. Vuelve: You've already worked a full shift today. Come back tomorrow.
textos.Hoy ya le has dado dinero a {n}. No hace: You've already given {n} money today. No need for more.
You've already given {n} a bonus today.
You already asked them today. Give it time.
textos.Hoy ya te ha hecho uno: They have already done you one today
textos.Hoy ya te has comido lo que había por ca: You've already eaten what there was at home today. There will be more tomorrow.
textos.Hoy ya tenemos el patio lleno. Mañana ha: Our yard's full for today. We'll talk tomorrow.
textos.Hoy {n} se ha lucido: guiso de los de mo: Today {n} outdid themselves: a stew made for dunking bread.
textos.Huecos que ocupa en la mochila: Slots it takes up in the backpack
textos.Huele a café recién hecho. {n} te sirve: It smells like fresh coffee. {n} pours you a cup without asking.
textos.Huele a chamusquina: se te ha pasado. Lo: It smells of burning: you overdid it. You salvage what you can.
textos.Huele a lonja. Con la tecla J haces el r: It smells like the fish market. Press the J key to do the package delivery.
It smells of popcorn. People are waiting.
It smells odd: you throw out {cosas}.
textos.Hueles mal. La gente se aparta, y a ti t: You smell bad. People move away, and you don't like it either.
textos.Iba al banco, pero he visto la cola y se: I was going to the bank, but I saw the line and lost the will.
textos.Iban a romperme la toma de agua. Gracias: They were going to break my water intake. Thank you, dear. Take whatever you want from the counter.
textos.Ibas de pasajero con {pasajero}: te has: You were riding as a passenger with {pasajero}: you're left on foot where you were.
textos.Ibas en un grupo de misión:: You were in a mission group:

textos.Iglesia de piedra del siglo dieciocho, p: Eighteenth-century stone church, patron of sailors. Its bell can be heard all over Barrio Viejo.
textos.Igualar el volumen de los sonidos cambia: Even out the volume of the changed sounds
textos.Impagos seguidos que traen el embargo: Consecutive missed payments that bring the seizure
textos.Impermeables y con agarre. Para la sierr: Waterproof and with grip. For the mountains.
textos.Imposible pasar desapercibido en la pist: Impossible to go unnoticed on the dance floor.
textos.Impuesto sobre lo que dan los negocios,: Tax on what the businesses earn, percent

textos.Inglés sé decir hola, gracias y la cuent: In English I can say hello, thank you and the check.

textos.Ingresas {cant} euros.{aviso} En la cuen: You deposit {cant} euros.{aviso} The account holds {banco} and you are carrying {dinero}.

Inspection at {negocio}: everything in order. The inspector signs and leaves. The business gains reputation.
textos.Intentar sobornar al inspector: {soborno: Try to bribe the inspector: {soborno} euros
textos.Intento de soborno a un inspector y blan: Attempted bribery of an inspector and laundering
Turn signal off. You will keep going straight.
The internet is like the bar, but without tapas.
textos.Interpretas a una persona corriente de u: You play an ordinary person from a Spanish coastal city who is talking to someone on the street. Answer only with what that person says, in natural American English, in one or two short, natural sentences that respond to what is said to them. No emojis, no quotation marks, no explanations and no explicit sexual content.
textos.Interés del {interes} por ciento, según: Interest of {interes} percent, depending on your creditworthiness. One payment every {entero} days, charged automatically.
textos.Intro abre el barrio: guardia fija, refu: Enter opens the neighborhood: standing guard, reinforcements, investing and setting it on the GPS. Loyalty and defense go from 0 to 100. The threat can always be checked; with informants, or with the neighborhood on your side, you'll also know who is coming and when.
textos.Intro abre lo que puedes hacer con esta: Enter opens what you can do with this gang: hit their hideout or make a truce. Their strength grows every day; when it's enough, they prepare an attack. With level 2 informants you see the exact figure.
Enter opens what you can do with this person: the GPS, a message, giving them things or inviting them.
textos.Intro abre lo que puedes hacer con él: m: Enter opens what you can do with it: mark it on the GPS, have it brought to you, send it to a garage or rename it.
textos.Intro abre tu trabajo: el contrato que t: Enter opens your job: the contract you have, your boss, the next position and resigning.
textos.Intro acepta este encargo. Al cumplirlo: Enter accepts this job. When you complete it you get paid right here, and the board changes. Each contract you complete makes the next ones harder and better paid.
textos.Intro añade cada cosa al pedido. Al fina: Enter adds each item to the order. At the end, Place the order
Enter switches between low, normal and high. With low you save money, but they cool off toward you; with high, they get a bit more loyal every day. If one day you can't afford to pay, the least loyal one leaves and the others get angry. Someone very disloyal may betray you.
textos.Intro cambia entre bajos, normales y alt: Enter switches between low, normal and high. Low: you earn less and the name goes up. High: you earn more and it goes down.
textos.Intro cambia entre las tres formas: que: Enter switches between the three ways: having it brought to you in hand every midnight, having it deposited in the bank, or going to collect it yourself at each business, with ten percent more.
Enter switches between the three ways: having it brought to you in hand every midnight, having it deposited in the bank, or coming to collect it yourself, with ten percent more.
textos.Intro cambia. Aterrizar en el campo te d: Enter switches. Landing at the airfield puts you on the ground, at the heliport or on the runway. Flying in low leaves you in the air over the town, to land wherever you like: it's the right choice if you carry an aircraft nobody should see.
textos.Intro cambia. De pasajero conduce el con: Enter switches. As a passenger the driver drives and you shoot with Q and Ctrl. If you drive, you find the engine running.
textos.Intro cambia. Si abres tú, tienes que es: Enter switches. If you open it, you have to stay next to the safe until it gives. If you cover, the safe guy opens it and you stay close, free to fight.
textos.Intro compra una unidad y te la llevas e: Enter buys one unit and you carry it with you
textos.Intro echa un producto a la cesta; flech: Enter puts a product in the basket; left arrow puts it back
textos.Intro entra. Si ya tienes personaje en e: Enter joins. If you already have a character on this server, you carry on where you left off.
textos.Intro instala o actualiza el componente: Enter installs or updates the chosen component. F1 says what it brings
Enter copies it to the clipboard.
textos.Intro lo activa o lo desactiva, como la: Enter turns it on or off, like Y at the wheel.
textos.Intro lo contrata o lo da de baja. Cubre: Enter takes it out or cancels it. It covers all your land vehicles from the day after you take it out, not aircraft. Every midnight it charges {seguro_cuota} euros for each of your vehicles on the street, from your pocket or the bank; those in the garage don't pay. If one blows up, the next day it is returned repaired and with its upgrades, in one of your garages with space or at the door of a repair shop, paying a deductible: {seguro_franquicia_pct} percent of what the model costs, and at least {seguro_franquicia_min} euros.
textos.Intro lo hace sonar otra vez. Su volumen: Enter plays it again. Its volume is adjusted in Options, Sound and music, Adjust the volume of each sound.
textos.Intro lo marca en el GPS. Un negocio se: Enter marks it on the GPS. A business is run by going to it.
textos.Intro lo quita de tu lista. Tu personaje: Enter removes it from your list. Your character stays saved on that server and you can add it again.
textos.Intro marca el sitio en el GPS. Se compr: Enter marks the place on the GPS. It is bought at the door, at the price they set, and the money goes to that player.
Enter marks where it is on the GPS.
textos.Intro marca en el GPS dónde hay un vehíc: Enter marks on the GPS where there is a vehicle for that job. Every eight services you get promoted and earn twelve percent more.
textos.Intro marca en el GPS el lugar donde emp: Enter marks on the GPS the place where it starts
textos.Intro marca en el GPS el sitio de la mis: Enter marks the mission location on the GPS.
textos.Intro o flecha izquierda devuelve uno al: Enter or left arrow puts one back on the shelf; right arrow takes another.
textos.Intro paga a un abogado para que la recu: Enter pays a lawyer to appeal it: it drops a degree, or disappears if it was minor. Only once per record.
textos.Intro paga de una vez lo que queda, con: Enter pays off what is left in one go, with a five percent discount.
Press Enter to get off there.
textos.Intro para cambiarle el rango, cederle e: Enter to change their rank, hand them command or kick them out of the gang.
textos.Intro para cambiarlo, hasta veinticuatro: Enter to change it, up to twenty-four letters. It is the name your friends see you by.
textos.Intro para cambiarlo. Solo cuenta en los: Enter to change it. It only counts on servers you join for the first time.
Enter to decide what to do.
textos.Intro para empuñar. F1 describe el arma:: Enter to wield. F1 describes the weapon: damage, range, rate of fire and accuracy
textos.Intro para escribirla. Con contraseña so: Enter to type it. With a password, only those who know it can join.
textos.Intro para escribirlo. Así te llamarán e: Enter to type it. This is how you will be called in the story.
textos.Intro para escribirlo. Puedes dejarlo va: Enter to type it. You can leave it empty.
textos.Intro para escuchar. Izquierda y derecha: Enter to listen. Left and right to adjust. Delete resets that sound to 100 percent
textos.Intro para hablar con esta persona, invi: Enter to talk to this person, treat them, give them a bonus or kick them out. Aim, for shooting and keeping people in check; driving, for the getaway; nerves, for not failing under pressure; loyalty, for not ratting you out if they're arrested. They go up with every heist that goes well.
textos.Intro para llamar. Cada día te cuenta un: Enter to call. Every day they tell you something.
textos.Intro para marcarlo en el GPS, enviarle: Enter to mark them on the GPS, send them money
textos.Intro para volver a jugar esta misión. R: Enter to play this mission again. Replaying it gives no reward and doesn't change the story.
textos.Intro pasa al siguiente campo de esa loc: Enter moves on to the next airfield in that town.
textos.Intro salda la deuda de una vez con lo q: Enter pays off the debt in one go with what you have between your account and your pocket. If it's not enough, the seizure continues.
textos.Intro sobre alguien abre lo que puedes h: Enter on someone opens what you can do with them
textos.Intro sobre alguien para tratar con esa: Enter on someone to deal with that person
textos.Intro sobre un vehículo abre lo que pued: Enter on a vehicle opens what you can do with it
textos.Intro sube un nivel; la opción siguiente: Enter raises a level; the next option lowers it. Each level costs the same every midnight, and the first day is paid when you hire. Level 1: the rumor, a day ahead. Level 2: a tip two days ahead, with the gang, and you see each gang's exact strength. Level 3: a phone message as soon as they decide, with day, time and strength. Without informants, a neighborhood with high loyalty also warns you: at 50, like level 1; at 75, like level 2. If one midnight you can't pay them, they leave.
textos.Intro te cuenta qué oyes de tus amigos y: Enter tells you what you hear of your friends and what you can do together.
textos.Intro y escribes el nombre. Si lo dejas: Enter, and you type the name. If you leave it blank, it goes back to being called after its model.
textos.Intro, y después pulsa la tecla que quie: Enter, and then press the key you want to use. The two keys are swapped, so no function is left without a key.
textos.Intro: sacarla, repostarla, revisarla o: Enter: take it out, refuel it, check it or rename it.
textos.Invertir en el barrio: {entero} euros. T: Invest in the neighborhood: {entero} euros. You have {dinero}
textos.Invitar a un café a alguien de la calle: Buy a coffee for someone on the street
textos.Invitar a un café: {precio} euros: Treat them to a coffee: {precio} euros
textos.Invitarle a algo caliente y acompañarle: Offer him something hot and walk him to the soup kitchen
textos.Invitarle a tu grupo de misión: Invite them to your mission group
textos.Invitas a {nombre} a una cerveza en la b: You treat {nombre} to a beer at the bar. It ends up being a round, then another.
textos.Invitas tú: unos {entero} euros. Os hacé: You're treating: about {entero} euros. You become better friends and they tell you what's being said around town
textos.Invítame a un café si te gusta mi trabaj: Buy me a coffee if you like my work
textos.Ir a la caja a pagar: Go to the register to pay
textos.Ir a un concierto en El Sótano: Go to a concert at El Sótano
textos.Ir al primer mensaje del historial: Go to the first message in the history
textos.Ir al último mensaje del historial: Go to the last message in the history
textos.Ir con su estilo a una cita: {get} de af: Going to a date in their style: {get} more affinity
textos.Irene, la cantante de la sala, tiene a u: Irene, the club's singer, has an admirer who can't take no for an answer.
textos.Irá pegada a ti. Si coges un coche, sube: It will stick to you. If you take a car, it gets in with you.
textos.Isla Tortuga, un pedazo de arena y palme: Isla Tortuga, a patch of sand and palm trees in the middle of the Mar de Poniente. No cars, no police and, they say, with the treasure of the pirate One-Eye.
textos.Isla de los Vientos: vida honrada: Isla de los Vientos: honest living
textos.Izquierda y derecha la bajan y la suben,: Left and right lower and raise it, from twenty to one hundred percent. Each change makes the gamepad vibrate so you can feel it.
textos.Izquierda y derecha para cambiar. En aut: Left and right to change. On automatic, the game tries the free options first: the local model and then Google AI Studio. After that, the other services that have a key. If one fails, it moves on to the next. For each service it picks only the cheapest model.
Left and right to see the others. You can only take one.
Ha. You don't waste time. We'll see.
textos.Jamón del bueno, malpensad[o|a]. Y no te: Good ham, you suspicious thing. And don't dawdle, I know you.
textos.Jornada de carpintero en un taller de mu: Day as a carpenter at a furniture workshop
textos.Jornada de peón de descarga: Day as a loading dock laborer
textos.Jornada de reponedor en un supermercado: Day as a shelf stocker at a supermarket
textos.Jornada de socorrista en la playa: Day as a lifeguard at the beach
textos.Jornada de soldador en el astillero: Day as a welder at the shipyard
textos.Jornadas de vendimia y oficios del campo: Grape harvest days and farm trades.
textos.Jornadas en la cantera y oficios de la s: Day jobs at the quarry and trades of the mountains.
Retiring in good health. I have enough of everything else.
textos.Juego actualizado a la versión {VERSION}: Game updated to version {VERSION}. What's new is in the main menu, in About, What's new in this version.
I'm playing with a controller: I type slowly.
textos.Jugando con amigos los golpes no se prep: Playing with friends, heists aren't prepared with the gang. The usual robbery still works.
textos.Jugando con amigos o en un servidor: un: Playing with friends or on a server: a message read aloud to the others.
textos.Jugando con amigos, alguien se une a la: Playing with friends, someone joins the game, or you connect. Three rising notes.
textos.Jugando con amigos, alguien se va, o te: Playing with friends, someone leaves, or you disconnect. Three descending notes.
textos.Jugando con amigos, llega o se envía un: Playing with friends, a message arrives or is sent: two quick, high notes. It is read aloud next.
textos.Jugando sin conexión, conquistar no es e: Playing offline, conquering is not the end: when you hold all the neighborhoods of a city, or many without holding them all, the defeated gangs regroup and, after a few quiet days, try to take them back. They warn you of the assault and you have a few hours to go defend the neighborhood in person or to send your people from the phone; if you do nothing, you lose it. You prepare on the phone, in Territories, Defense of your neighborhoods: guards, reinforcements, informants, truces and strikes on their hideouts. Choose how hard they push: off, and nobody contests them this way; calm, with few assaults and {entero} hours to respond; normal, which is the default, with {entero2} hours; or hard, with more frequent, stronger assaults and {entero3} hours. There are never two assaults at once. On an online server and when playing with friends it doesn't happen.
textos.Junto a la puerta, el teclado de una ala: Next to the door, an alarm keypad with its little red light.
textos.Junto a la tienda hay un coche de prácti: There's an open practice car next to the shop. Walk up and press F to get in. The same key gets you out.
There is justice. For those who can pay for it.
textos.Justo a tiempo. Mira, esa del fondo es R: Just in time. Look, that one at the back is Remigia: seventy-one years old and last week she read her first letter. It was from her son.
textos.Justo a tiempo. Siéntate, que hoy comes: Just in time. Sit down, today you eat here and you don't pay.
Fair, but ugly in front of the customer.
textos.Kilómetros a los que empieza la aproxima: Kilometers at which the approach starts
textos.Kilómetros a los que quedas al dar otra: Kilometers away you end up when going around again
textos.Kilómetros a los que se da por tocado el: Kilometers at which the airfield is considered reached
textos.Kilómetros a los que se entra volando ba: Kilometers at which you enter flying low
textos.LB y RB, o L1 y R1, para repasar los men: LB and RB, or L1 and R1, to review earlier messages
textos.La Arizmendi sabe que pierde la concesió: The Arizmendi woman knows she's losing the concession. If she leaves, she takes the big pumps in an armored van, and without them there's no desalination for anyone.
textos.La Encantada vuelve a dormir. El quad de: La Encantada sleeps again. My grandson's quad is yours: it's at the dealership, ask for it.
textos.La IA puede proponer acciones, y el jueg: The AI can suggest actions, and the game decides: {v}
textos.La Isla de los Vientos: salinas abandona: Isla de los Vientos: abandoned salt flats, dunes, four fishermen's houses and a wind that never stops. No cars and no police.
The L key opens the list of places.
textos.La Marina de Costa Dorada: redes tendida: The Marina of Costa Dorada: nets spread out in the sun, the smell of tar and boats beached on the sand.
textos.La Marina vuelve a oler a marisco y no a: La Marina smells of seafood again and not gunpowder. The boat is yours: it's moored at the marina.
textos.La Naviera Poniente cierra un contrato c: Poniente Shipping closes a contract with a northern port.
textos.La Naviera Poniente pierde a su mejor cl: Poniente Shipping loses its best customer.
textos.La Plataforma Neptuno lleva veinte años: Neptuno Platform has been closed for twenty years. Well, last night it had lights on. And an unflagged boat moored.
textos.La Ribera: huertas, olmos viejos y el rí: La Ribera: vegetable gardens, old elms and the Olmedilla River, which runs cold and full of trout.
textos.La Rusa quiere acabar de una vez con Los: La Rusa wants to finish off Los Calaveras once and for all.
textos.La Rusa sabe cuándo sale el furgón blind: La Rusa knows when the bank's armored van leaves.
textos.La Universidad de San Lucero investiga p: San Lucero University investigates why students sleep so little.
textos.La actualización no se pudo instalar y s: The update could not be installed and the version you had, {VERSION}, was kept. {motivo} You have it again in Options, Updates, and the details are in the logs folder, in the file actualizacion dot log.
textos.La administración de lotería más famosa: The most famous lottery office in the city. They say it brings luck.
textos.La ambulancia no entra mientras haya tir: The ambulance won't come in while there is gunfire. Get away from the enemies.
textos.La ambulancia tarda en salir, como poco,: The ambulance takes at least this many seconds to set out
You call it off for everyone and the GPS is cleared.
textos.La armería más cara y mejor surtida de l: The most expensive and best stocked gun shop in the city.
textos.La asistencia viene a donde esté tu vehí: Roadside assistance comes to wherever your vehicle is: you need to be in it or next to it.
textos.La autovía de la costa hacia el oeste. A: The coastal highway heading west. At the end is Bahía del Ocaso.
textos.La autovía de la costa, que lleva a Puer: The coastal highway, which leads to Puerto Bravo after a long stretch of road.
textos.La avioneta carretea por la pista y desp: The light plane taxis down the runway and takes off
textos.La avioneta empieza a bajar hacia la pis: The light plane starts to descend toward the runway.
textos.La baliza del GPS cambia a este sonido c: The GPS beacon switches to this sound when the next point is already your destination. It is also the tone that marks north.
textos.La banda %s os propone una alianza. Si v: The gang %s proposes an alliance to you. If your boss proposes it to them, it is sealed.
textos.La banda %s rompe la alianza con la vues: The gang %s breaks off its alliance with yours.
textos.La banda %s se ha disuelto. Sus barrios: The gang %s has disbanded. Its neighborhoods are free.
textos.La banda %s se queda con un barrio de %s: The gang %s takes a neighborhood in %s.
textos.La banda desaparece para todos: sus miem: The gang disappears for everyone: its members are left without a gang, its neighborhoods become free and whatever is in the till goes into your pocket.
textos.La barca del martes no viene desde hace: The Tuesday boat hasn't come for two Tuesdays. And last night I saw a fire in the dunes.
textos.La base de datos de esa copia está dañad: The database in that backup is damaged. Nothing has been changed.
The horn of a truck or a bus.
textos.La bolsa: dividendos, noticias y avisos: The stock market: dividends, news and warnings
textos.La botica de siempre, con su báscula de: The same old apothecary, with its iron scale.
textos.La boticaria quiere saber dónde se mete: The pharmacist wants to know where the skipper of a boat that catches nothing disappears to.
textos.La boya donde empiezan las regatas de la: The buoy where the boat regattas start.
textos.La caja del concejal aparece vacía y nad: The councilman's box turns up empty and nobody reports anything. At the harbor they greet you by name and nobody raises a hand to you. The newspaper never printed its story, and on the street nobody dares cross you.
textos.La caja está en la fábrica abandonada, c: The box is at the abandoned factory, with four of the councilman's men. We go in from behind.
textos.La caja está vacía. Se llena cada median: The cash box is empty. It fills up every midnight.
The cash box is empty: you already robbed it today.
textos.La caja fuerte del casino. Hoy guarda la: The casino safe. Today it holds the whole month's takings. I'll open the back door for you; you go in, clean it out and leave.
textos.La caja se hunde despacio. Arriba, en la: The box sinks slowly. Up at the mine entrance, there are no more lights.
textos.La caja tarda de {get} a {get2} segundos: The safe takes from {get} to {get2} seconds; the lookout stalls for {get3}
textos.La caja tiene guardia: {n} {v}. Hay que: The cash box is guarded: {n} {v}. You have to take them out, grab the box and lose the police.
The register and the shopkeeper. You buy here.
textos.La cala donde, según la leyenda, el pira: The cove where, according to legend, the pirate One-Eye buried what didn't fit in the cave.
textos.La cala vuelve a ser nuestra. Por cierto: The cove is ours again. By the way, they say the pirate One-Eye hid his treasure in that cave. I have half the map. The other half... we'll talk later.
textos.La calidad va de cero a cien y cuenta el: Quality goes from zero to one hundred and counts for forty percent of the evaluation.
textos.La calle: gente, policía y bandas: The street: people, police and gangs
textos.La calle: reacciones, policía y helicópt: The street: reactions, police and helicopter
textos.La cama está hecha. Aquí se duerme y se: The bed is made. You sleep and save the game here.
textos.La camarera del Chiringuito El Espeto ti: The waitress at El Espeto Beach Bar has a problem with someone who won't take no for an answer.
textos.La camioneta de campo: resistente y sin: The farm pickup: tough and unpretentious.
textos.La camiseta del equipo del puerto, con u: The harbor team's jersey, with a number on the back.
textos.La cantera sigue dando losa. Está en ven: The quarry still yields slate slabs. It's for sale, with its dump truck at the door: get in and press J to haul loads.
textos.La carga ya va en el camión: no hay que: The cargo is already on the truck: there's nothing to pick up. It's taken by road to {nombre}: {camino}. The GPS guides you to the town exit; there, without getting out, press Enter to take the road, and on arrival it keeps guiding you. It's delivered automatically when you stop in front of the destination. Don't take the bus or get out: if you leave the truck, the job is over.
textos.La carpeta de datos del servidor en líne: The online server's data folder is inside the {mal} folder, which belongs to the program and gets replaced by the update: it could erase what is saved. Close the server, move its data folder somewhere else, for example inside the servidor folder, change the data folder in the server settings and start it again.
textos.La carpeta donde hay que copiar lo que t: The folder where you have to copy what the ZIP contains.
textos.La carpeta donde se guarda todo: persona: The folder where everything is saved: characters, gangs, territories, vehicles, the certificate and the backups.
textos.La carretera de curvas que baja de la si: The winding road that runs down from the mountains to Puerto Bravo.
textos.La carretera de curvas que sube a la sie: The winding road that climbs into the mountains, up to Peñas Altas.
textos.La carretera de la costa es bonita, pero: The coast road is pretty, but it has more curves than you can stand.
textos.La carretera de la costa hacia Cala Brav: The coast road toward Cala Brava and Puerto Bravo.
textos.La carretera de la costa hacia Puerto Br: The coast road toward Puerto Bravo.
textos.La carretera de la costa hacia San Lucer: The coast road toward San Lucero.
textos.La carretera de la costa, que lleva a Ca: The coast road, which leads to Cala Brava and continues to San Lucero.
textos.La carretera de la costa, que lleva a Co: The coastal road, which leads to Costa Dorada.
textos.La carretera de la costa, que lleva a Pu: The coastal road, which leads to Puerto Bravo.
textos.La carretera de montaña que baja a Villa: The mountain road that goes down to Villaseca.
textos.La carretera de montaña que sube a la ci: The mountain road that climbs to the mining city of Monteferro.
textos.La carretera del interior hasta San Luce: The inland road to San Lucero.
textos.La carretera del interior, que cruza los: The inland road, which crosses the fields to Villaseca.
The road that goes down to Monteferro.
The road that goes down to Puerto Bravo.
textos.La carretera que baja hasta Puerto Bravo: The road that runs down to Puerto Bravo through vineyards.
textos.La carretera que sube al pueblo de Fuent: The road that climbs to the village of Fuentefría.
textos.La carretera que sube entre viñedos hast: The road that climbs through vineyards up to Valdeolmos.
textos.La carretera que sube hacia la sierra y: The road that climbs toward the mountains and the town of Villaseca.
textos.La carta colgada y la caja. Aquí se pide: The menu on the wall and the register. You order here.
textos.La cartelera y las entradas. Aquí se com: The movie listings and tickets. You buy here.
textos.La cartera tiene que estar por aquí. Sig: The wallet must be around here. Follow its sound and press Enter when you're on top of it.
textos.La casa de Octavio Belmonte: verja de hi: Octavio Belmonte's house: iron gate, cameras and armed guards.
textos.La casa de empeños paga una parte: más s: The pawn shop pays a share: more if it is found than if it is stolen.
textos.La casa es más acogedora: al dormir aquí: The home is cozier: sleeping here you wake up in a slightly better mood.
textos.La cena se alarga. Cierran el restaurant: Dinner drags on. They close the restaurant with you two still inside, and you don't even notice.
textos.La cesta se queda en la tienda con todo: The basket stays in the store with everything in it. Nothing else happens.
textos.La cifra cambia con la fuerza del jugado: The figure changes with the player's strength and how they get along with the gang, and it fluctuates every day.
textos.La ciudad es una cuadrícula: las calles: The city is a grid: streets run from west to east and avenues from south to north. There is an intersection every 90 meters. Your footsteps sound different on the sidewalk, on asphalt, on grass and on sand.
The private key must be 32 bytes.
textos.La comisaría de Bahía del Ocaso. En la p: Bahía del Ocaso police station. There's always a patrol car at the door.
textos.La comisaría de San Lucero. Aquí, por lo: San Lucero's police station. Here, at least, the police aren't bought.
textos.La compañía se lleva hoy la caja: los su: The company is taking the cash today: the wages they owe us for six months, in an armored truck leaving Miners' Bank.
The shopping, until it is put away at home.
textos.La compra, la despensa y la cocina: núme: Shopping, pantry and kitchen: numbers and phrases
textos.La conexión con tu amigo se cortó un mom: The connection with your friend dropped for a moment and has recovered.
The connection drops right at the start.
The entry password is not correct.
textos.La contraseña que hay que saber para cre: The password you need to know to create a character when entry is by password.
textos.La contraseña se pone antes de abrir la: The password is set before opening the game. To change it, close the game to friends and open it again.
textos.La conversación va sola: {n} te cuenta a: The conversation flows: {n} tells you something about their week and you tell them something about yours.
textos.La cooperativa del pueblo, en venta desd: The town cooperative, for sale since the president retired.
textos.La cooperativa del pueblo. La preside el: The village cooperative. It is run by Uncle Anselmo, who trusts nobody from the capital.
textos.La cooperativa tiene ahora un logotipo n: The cooperative now has a new logo and a gate. The wine sells for more and is made somewhere else. You have twelve thousand euros more, and in Villaseca there are doors that no longer open for you.
textos.La copia al portapapeles. Es como una co: It copies it to the clipboard. It's like a long password: don't give it to anyone.
textos.La crupier dice que el libro de caja de: The croupier says the real cash book isn't in the casino. They keep it in a shed next to the fish market, with three guards.
textos.La cuenta elegida deja de administrar el: The selected account is no longer a server admin.
textos.La cuenta elegida no podrá volver a entr: The selected account will not be able to join again. If they are inside, they are removed.
textos.La cuenta elegida pasa a administrar el: The selected account becomes a server admin.
The selected account can join again.
textos.La curva más famosa de la sierra, punto: The most famous curve in the mountains, the starting point of the races.
textos.La cámara acorazada está abierta. Recoge: The vault is open. Grab the loot.
textos.La cámara acorazada está vacía y llena d: The vault is empty and full of cops: you already robbed it today.
It's provided by the service you've chosen.
textos.La de la náutica: The woman from the boat dealer
textos.La de serie tiene {entero} huecos; esta,: The standard one has {entero} slots; this one has {entero2}. Everything you carry moves over to the new one.
You leave it in the wardrobe with its ammo. If you had it in your hand, you're left with your fists.
textos.La dejas fuera, lista para subir y volar: You leave it outside, ready to board and fly. If you owe rent on this hangar, they won't let you take it out until you pay.
textos.La desaladora vuelve a rugir. En la sala: The desalination plant roars again. In the control room only an empty chair remains, still warm.
textos.La descarga se ha cortado antes de termi: The download was cut off before finishing, and it could not be resumed. Try again in a while.
textos.La descarga terminó, pero el archivo ha: The download finished, but the file has disappeared or cannot be read: it is almost always the antivirus, which has set it aside. Add the game folder to its exclusions and try again.
textos.La descripción completa, el código fuent: The full description, the source code and all the versions.
F1 says it in the shop.
textos.La dirección completa, que empiece por h: The full address, starting with https, of the version.json file. You can paste it with Control V. Wherever it's served from, the version must be signed by whoever publishes the game.
textos.La dirección no puede llevar usuario ni: The address cannot include a username or password.
textos.La dirección que tienes que dar a tus am: The address you have to give your friends, ready to copy, and what has to be opened on the router so friends outside your home can join.
textos.La dirección tiene que empezar por https: The address must start with https.
textos.La discoteca de los universitarios. Un n: The university students' nightclub. A great business.
textos.La discoteca de moda. Los graves se nota: The trendy nightclub. You can feel the bass from the sidewalk. It is for sale for a fortune.
textos.La doble vida. Ciento cincuenta euros ca: The double life. One hundred fifty euros every night and the respect of Los Calaveras. If it gets out, the neighborhood's regard is gone.
textos.La droga ha hecho mucho daño aquí. Mucho: Drugs have done a lot of harm here. A lot of kids lost.
textos.La edad está en la cabeza, dicen. Pues e: They say age is in the head. Well, in my head I'm twenty.
textos.La embarcación más veloz del Mar de Poni: The fastest boat on the Mar de Poniente.
textos.La empleada pone mala cara: con tanto ef: The clerk frowns: with so much unjustified cash, they will only deposit {ok} euros. The tax authorities are going to find out.
textos.La empresa de moda de San Lucero. No rep: The trendy company of San Lucero. It pays no dividends: it reinvests everything.
textos.La entrada al puerto comercial de Puerto: The entrance to Puerto Bravo's commercial harbor.
textos.La entrada de la mina vieja. Sale un air: The entrance to the old mine. A cold air comes out that smells of iron.
textos.La entrada es con clave pero la contrase: Entry is by password but the entry password is empty: nobody new will be able to create a character.
textos.La entregas en comisaría. El agente apun: You hand it in at the police station. The officer writes down your name: "If only everyone did."
textos.La escolta crece con los contratos cumpl: The escort grows with completed contracts, from one to five.
textos.La espera da tiempo a la otra banda para: The wait gives the other gang time to get ready. Whoever has the most people inside the neighborhood and knocks down the most rivals wins.
textos.La estación de San Lucero, con autobuses: San Lucero's station, with buses to the whole region.
textos.La etiqueta «{texto_visible}» de {v} no: The label "{texto_visible}" of {v} has no access letter (&).
The clearing where grain is threshed in summer. The local lads race here with whatever they have.
textos.La explicación entera de los golpes prep: The whole explanation of heists, with its numbers.
textos.La explicación no está en estos datos. E: The explanation is not in this data. The manual covers it under Play with friends.
textos.La explicación, que se dice una sola vez: The briefing, which is said only once
textos.La fama en la calle sube con las misione: Street reputation goes up with missions, contracts and the neighborhoods you conquer. It is independent of standing: you can have both, one or neither.
textos.La familia bien, gracias. Cada uno a lo: Family's good, thanks. Everyone doing their own thing.
textos.La familia, como todas: unos días mejor: Family's like everybody's: some days better, some days worse.
textos.La farmacia de aquí al lado es muy apaña: The pharmacy next door is very handy.
textos.La feria de la playa, con su noria gigan: The beach fairground, with its giant Ferris wheel, raffles, shooting booths and a sound memory machine.
textos.La feria ya no es como antes, pero los c: The fair isn't what it used to be, but the kids have a good time.
The hardware store for the whole mountain region.
textos.La firma de la versión no es válida. No: The version signature is not valid. It will not be updated.
textos.La franquicia nunca baja de esto. Es la: The deductible never goes below this. It is what vehicles that are not for sale pay, like a taxi or an ambulance you have made yours.
textos.La frase que ha escrito sobre su persona: The sentence they wrote about their character.
textos.La fundición entera está en venta. El ne: The entire foundry is for sale. The most profitable business in the region.
textos.La furgoneta de helados, en lugar de cla: The ice cream van plays its little tune instead of honking.
textos.La furgoneta de la lonja lleva dos días: The fish market van hasn't made deliveries in two days and the rice won't wait.
textos.La ganancia por hora que un jugador no u: The hourly earnings a player does not use are not lost: they are kept up to this number of hours, also while they are away, so a good streak fits whole. With 1, they never have more room than one hour's.
Gas prices are through the roof.
textos.La gente actúa y se une a tu banda: People act and join your gang
textos.La gente actúa: seguirte, pegarte, denun: People act: follow you, hit you, report you, favors and recruiting
textos.La gente con la que hablas también actúa: The people you talk to act on their own too
textos.La gente de este barrio ya está contigo: The people of this neighborhood are already with you to the death: it's not needed.
textos.La gente de la calle que te ha dado su n: The people from the street who gave you their number. Talk to anyone with the J key.
textos.La gente de {barrio} se siente abandonad: The people of {barrio} feel abandoned. A visit, or some money for the neighborhood, would fix it.
textos.La gente es buena. Un poco cotilla, pero: The people are good. A bit gossipy, but good.
textos.La gente sale en pijama a la calle. Algu: People come out into the street in pajamas. Someone puts on music. Kids jump into the riverbed fully dressed, which for one night is a river again.
textos.La gran fuente de la Plaza Mayor: tres d: The great fountain of the Main Square: three bronze dolphins spitting water. The meeting point of the whole city.
textos.La grúa de tu seguro se lleva lo que que: Your insurance tow truck takes away what is left of {nombre}. Tomorrow it is returned repaired, with its upgrades, for a {franquicia} euro deductible.
textos.La grúa que se lleva los coches mal apar: The tow truck that hauls away badly parked cars. With the J key you do the service.
textos.La guardan los vigilantes privados. No s: The private guards keep it. They aren't police, and they don't think twice before shooting.
textos.La guerra la declara el jefe o su mano d: War is declared by the boss or their right hand.
The war for %s is over: %d to %d. %s
textos.La guía cambiar sonidos, en la carpeta d: The guide on changing sounds, in the data folder, docs, explains how to replace any sound or build a complete pack.
textos.La has fallado tres veces o más. Si te l: You have failed it three times or more. If you skip it, it counts as done and the story goes on, but you don't get the reward. You can replay it later from the phone journal.
textos.La herida sigue abierta: unos {d} días p: The wound is still open: about {d} days for it to pass.
textos.La hipoteca la acabo de pagar a los oche: I'll finish paying off the mortgage at eighty, if I make it.
textos.La historia de prosperar honradamente en: The story of prospering honestly in Puerto Bravo. Enter marks on the GPS where it continues, if you already meet what it asks.
textos.La historia es la misma para todos; camb: The story is the same for everyone; the advantages you start with change. The last option lets you create your own
textos.La historia mueve algunas: belmonte y mi: The story moves some: belmonte and minas. A new company does its own thing.
textos.La huella del archivo de la versión no e: The version file fingerprint is not valid.
textos.La iglesia de aquí tiene unas campanas q: The church here has bells that wake the dead.
textos.La iglesia del pueblo, con un nido de ci: The village church, with a stork nest in the bell tower.
textos.La información de la versión no está fir: The version information is not signed.
textos.La información de versión de {nombre} es: The version information from {nombre} is too large.
The version information from {nombre} is damaged.
textos.La inspectora te escucha y actúa: dos de: The inspector listens and acts: two of {banda} arrested. The neighborhood speaks well of you.
textos.La jefa de la Escudería Viento Sur busca: The head of the Viento Sur Racing Team is looking for a test driver.
textos.La jefa de la Peña del Cobre quiere habl: The head of the Copper Club wants to talk to you at El Lingote.
textos.La lancha de alquiler se devuelve sola a: The rental speedboat returns itself when you dock at any pier.
textos.La lealtad baja si pasan días sin que pi: Loyalty drops if days go by without you setting foot in the neighborhood, and rises the first time you enter it each day.
The lingerie stays on for very little time.
textos.La letra «{upper}» se repite en el menú: The letter "{upper}" is repeated in the menu "{ruta}": "{v}" and "{texto}".
textos.La libreta tiene tres años de pagos: con: The notebook holds three years of payments: councilmen, inspectors and a newspaper editor.
textos.La limusina está en la puerta de la sala: The limousine is at the door of El Sótano concert hall. Pick it up and take it to the casino without a scratch, because it's rented.
textos.La lista de lo que hace cada botón a pie: The list of what each button does on foot, driving and in the menus, with your current layout.
textos.La lista de los sonidos que no están a s: The list of sounds that are not at their default volume, from all groups. Inside, Enter sets one back to 100 percent.
textos.La lista de todos los logros, cuáles tie: The list of all achievements, which ones you already have and what each one takes.
textos.La llave abre el pañol del semáforo. Den: The key opens the signal station's storeroom. Inside are two weeks of supplies and the boatman, tied up and furious.
textos.La lonja registra capturas récord esta s: The fish market reports record catches this week.
textos.La lonja, donde al amanecer se subasta e: The fish market, where the fish is auctioned off by shouting at dawn. They buy everything you catch here.
textos.La luz, el agua, el alquiler... así no h: Electricity, water, rent... nobody can save like this.
textos.La lámpara está tibia y los raíles brill: The lamp is warm and the rails shine: mine carts have come through here this very night.
textos.La madre baja las escaleras de la catedr: The mother runs down the cathedral stairs two at a time. The girl shows her the balloon before letting herself be hugged.
textos.La madrina de la boda está en la bodega: The wedding godmother is in the winery and the ceremony is about to start.
textos.La madrina se ha quedado en la bodega pr: The godmother stayed behind at the winery tasting the wine, and the wedding starts at the parish church. Go get her and bring her, because I can't leave the stove.
textos.La madrina te invita al convite. El meso: The godmother invites you to the reception. The innkeeper, for his part, owes you for the delivery. What do you do?
