textos.La mano en la cocina va de 0 a 100, y se: Kitchen skill goes from 0 to 100, and is expressed in levels from 0 to 10. It is saved with the game.
The blanket is too small for two. All the better.
textos.La matrícula es de un sedán negro. Se va: The plate belongs to a black sedan. He's leaving by the east exit with the whole month's takings. That money belongs to the guys.
textos.La mejor arma cuerpo a cuerpo: rápida y: The best melee weapon: fast and very damaging.
textos.La mejor comida es la que te hacen en ca: The best food is what they make you at home.
textos.La mercancía de las sustancias, con el c: Substance products, with adult content. There is still a cap of one hundred units.
textos.La mercancía no te cabe: llevas la mochi: You cannot fit the goods: your backpack is full.
textos.La mercancía va en la mochila: cada diez: Product goes in the backpack: every ten units take up a slot. What you don't want to carry, keep in the wardrobe of one of your homes.
textos.La mercancía y la caja de {nombre}: The goods and the cash box of {nombre}
The mission will keep waiting for you here.
textos.La mitad de las veces le dejas atrás; si: Half the time you leave him behind; if he catches you, he takes the same as if you'd handed it over.
textos.La mochila va llena: {objeto} se queda d: The backpack is full: {objeto} stays where it was.
textos.La mochila y el armario de casa: The backpack and the home wardrobe
textos.La moto más rápida. Un golpe serio y se: The fastest motorcycle. One serious hit and it's over.
textos.La máquina del rincón. La misma que hay: The machine in the corner. The same one as at the casino.
textos.La máquina toca una secuencia de notas y: The machine plays a sequence of notes and you repeat it with the arrow keys. With five rounds there is a prize; with twelve, {precio} euros.
textos.La música amansa a las fieras. A mi jefe: Music soothes the savage beast. Not my boss, though.
The music is loud and the floor is packed.
textos.La nevera y la despensa tienen cada una: The fridge and the pantry each have their own limited space.
The fridge hums. It smells of coffee.
textos.La noche con alguien, paso a paso: A night with someone, step by step
textos.La noche de Puerto Bravo: un barrio de l: The Puerto Bravo night: a new neighborhood of venues with a concert hall, an early-morning churro shop, a hotel, a penthouse, a night taxi company with its own taxi to work in, a limousine, three driver and doorman missions and, with adult mode, a party hall, two people to meet, plans, gifts, a cocktail and two stories.
textos.La noche del pleno: The Night of the Council Meeting
textos.La noche tiene su gente. No es la misma: The night has its own people. They're not the same as in the day.
textos.La nota más aguda de la máquina de memor: The highest note of the sound memory game.
textos.La nota más grave de la máquina de memor: The lowest note of the sound memory game.
textos.La opción «{texto_visible}» de {descripc: The option "{texto_visible}" of {descripcion} has no access letter (&).
textos.La parada principal de taxis. Puedes ped: The main taxi stand. You can ask to be taken anywhere or get behind the wheel yourself and race.
textos.La parte nueva de San Lucero: bancos, la: The new part of San Lucero: banks, the station, the police station and the bingo hall.
textos.La partida que tienes abierta a tus amig: The game you have open to your friends is closing, and I've told them: open it again when you're back.
The game is blocked: nobody can play. You are left with {mios} points and your rival with {suyos}.
textos.La pesca y los juegos del casino, de la: Fishing and the casino, fairground and gym games.
textos.La pista de los ejecutivos, en la azotea: The executives' landing pad, on the lowest rooftop of Las Torres. Here you can take a helicopter or pay for a flight.
textos.La pista está llena, pero {n} baila como: The floor is packed, but {n} dances like nobody else is there.
textos.La pizza se ha enfriado. Te quedas sin t: The pizza has gone cold. You're out of work for today.
The beach in the afternoon is wonderful. I recommend it.
The hangar space at {nombre} is yours.
textos.La policía anda buscando a alguien por a: The police are looking for someone around here. I haven't seen anything.
The police here are honest, kid. That's why they can't keep up.
textos.La policía ha registrado {casa}. Alguien: The police have searched {casa}. Someone in your crew has talked.
textos.La policía local busca voluntarios para: The local police are looking for volunteers for the street party. Nobody has signed up.
textos.La policía no se ha olvidado de ti: te s: The police haven't forgotten you: they're still looking for you.
textos.La policía tardará unos {int} segundos e: The police will take about {int} seconds to arrive.
The police are looking for you with less zeal.
The police are looking for you with more zeal.
textos.La policía te buscará con nivel {max}. U: The police will look for you at wanted level {max}. Once a day, and the place remembers you: for a few days they will not let you in, or they call the police as soon as they see you.
textos.La policía te pasa por alto parte de las: The police overlook some of your offenses
The police already know there's a new owner. Shake them off.
The police, the farther away the better.
textos.La pones en ese extremo de la mesa y jue: You place it on that end of the table and your opponent plays. If you run out of tiles, you win double your bet.
textos.La portada sale con el nombre y la firma: The front page runs with the name and the signature. A week later, the Aguas del Ocaso headquarters is sealed off and the tanker trucks deliver without charging. It finally rains, on a Thursday afternoon, and half the city goes out to get wet.
textos.La primera cuenta es administradora: The first account is an admin
textos.La primera la ha traído en mano uno de L: The first was hand-delivered by one of Los Calaveras. He says you're at peace and the harbor is as much yours as theirs. Owing favors to those people is bad business.
textos.La primera no trae remite. Dentro hay un: The first has no return address. Inside there's an envelope with bills and a card from the town hall. I'm not asking. But it hurts.
textos.La primera vez en cada asalto: nadie pie: The first time in each assault: nobody loses a neighborhood by sleeping one night.
textos.La primera vez pregunta a un servicio de: The first time it asks an internet service what your address is. After that, Enter copies it.
textos.La primera vez que pisas un barrio, adem: The first time you step into a neighborhood, the game says what it's like as well as its name. After that it only says the name. The N key repeats it whenever you want.
textos.La primera, del periódico. La redactora: The first, from the newspaper. The reporter says the councilman's trial starts next month, and she's saving you a seat in the front row.
textos.La prueba da positivo. Te ponen tratamie: The test is positive. They prescribe treatment for {coste} euros and in a few days you'll be fine. Next time, use protection.
textos.La prueba es gratis. Si da positivo, pag: The test is free. If it comes out positive, you pay for the treatment on the spot and you get better in a few days.
textos.La puerta se cierra de un golpe y ya no: The door slams shut and there is nothing else in the world but the two of you.
textos.La quiero para la puerta de la tienda. A: I want it for the shop door. Rent a boat, go slowly when you get there and haul it aboard.
textos.La radio de los vehículos, el reproducto: The vehicle radio, the headphone player and the background music. A sample plays when you change it. Change it with the left and right arrows.
textos.La radio, al bajarte del vehículo: {v}: Radio when you get out of the vehicle: {v}
textos.La redacción del último periódico indepe: The newsroom of the last independent newspaper in the city. Marta Salgado works here until the small hours.
textos.La redactora va a entregar las pruebas e: The reporter is going to deliver the evidence to the courthouse and some people don't want it to get there.
textos.La relación va de menos cien a cien. Apa: The relationship goes from minus one hundred to one hundred. Separately, each casualty makes it worse as usual.
textos.La renta llega sola cada medianoche. Mie: The rent arrives by itself every midnight. While it is rented out you cannot sleep, save the game or use the garage here.
The AI's answer could not be read.
You go around it on the {v}.
Clothes are starting to be too much.
Clothes, on sale or not at all.
textos.La ruta del archivo PEM con la llave pri: The path of the PEM file with your certificate's private key. Empty if the key is inside the certificate itself or if you use the one the server creates.
textos.La sardina escasea y Conservas Cala Brav: Sardines are scarce and Cala Brava Canned Goods stops the factory.
textos.La secuencia más larga que has repetido: The longest sequence you have repeated without a mistake on the memory machine.
textos.La sede del Banco Mercantil, con sus col: The Mercantil Bank headquarters, with its marble columns. What you deposit here is safe even if you get arrested or end up in the hospital.
textos.La segunda nota más aguda de la máquina: The second highest note of the sound memory game.
textos.La segunda nota más grave de la máquina: The second lowest note of the sound memory game.
textos.La segunda ronda la paga {n}, que insist: {n} pays for the second round, and insists.
textos.La segunda, de Villaseca. Anselmo manda: The second, from Villaseca. Anselmo sends a case of wine with your name on the label and says the cooperative has paid out profits for the first time in ten years.
textos.La segunda, de Villaseca. Es de un fondo: The second, from Villaseca. It's from a fund, on letterhead. They thank you for your handling of things and offer you a similar one in the next town over.
textos.La sucursal de los estibadores. Tu cuent: The dockworkers' branch. Your account is the same at every office.
textos.La suerte es para el que la busca. Y par: Luck is for those who look for it. And for some well-connected folks.
textos.La suerte: {_suerte} para los tuyos, y {: Luck: {_suerte} for yours, and {_suerte2} for them. Result: {int} against {int2}.
textos.La taberna de los mineros. Carmela, la p: The miners' tavern. Carmela, the union president, has her office here, which is a table next to the stove.
textos.La taberna del capitán Mendoza, que cono: Captain Mendoza's tavern, who knows every rock of the Mar de Poniente.
textos.La tecla P pesca cuando estás en el mar: The P key fishes when you're at sea and turns on the siren in emergency vehicles.
textos.La tecla Q fija al enemigo más cercano y: The Q key locks onto the nearest enemy and tells you where it is. You'll hear a tone coming from it: low and double if it's in range, high if it's out of reach.
textos.La terminal del ferry a las islas. El úl: The ferry terminal to the islands. The last boat leaves at midnight.
textos.La tienda de los mineros: barata y con d: The miners' store: cheap and with a bit of everything.
textos.La tormenta te envuelve. El aparato cruj: The storm engulfs you. The aircraft creaks.
The tower hasn't said anything yet.
textos.La travesía. Al llegar volando al borde: The crossing. When you fly to the edge of the town, or press Enter at an airfield, you choose a destination and how to get there. Then you fly for real: the tower gives you the wind and the heading, you climb to your level and cross the region. The autopilot does everything if you want, and the N key speeds up the trip. Enter tells you at any time how much is left.
textos.La tubería lleva una etiqueta de encargo: The pipe has an order tag. Whoever pays for the copper isn't the Club: it's a company called Aguas del Ocaso.
textos.La vendimia entra entera en la cooperati: The whole harvest makes it to the cooperative. Your name is in the members' book, between Anselmo's and Uncle Lucas's, and at El Cazador Bar they no longer let you pay.
textos.La versión del juego que tienes ahora. T: The version of the game you have now. After updating, the new one must show here.
textos.La versión más antigua del juego con la: The oldest version of the game that can come in, for example 1.7.0. Empty, any.
textos.La versión no indica de dónde descargarl: The version does not say where to download it from.
textos.La versión que tienes instalada. Las ver: The version you have installed. New versions are checked for in Options, Updates.
textos.La versión que tienes, quién ha hecho el: The version you have, who made the game, where to report a bug and how to buy the author a coffee.
Version {version} is already downloaded. To install it, go to Options, Updates, Install the downloaded version. The game will close, update and reopen by itself.
textos.La vida del capo: tu gente, tu dinero y: The crime boss life: your crew, your money and laundering
textos.La vida realista está desactivada: no pa: Realistic life is turned off: you don't get hungry, thirsty or sleepy. Turn it on in Options, Combat and difficulty.
textos.La vida social se vive en persona: Social life is lived in person
textos.La voz con la que hablas tú en las escen: The voice you speak with in the story scenes. There are four male and four female; the one that matches how people address you plays. Left and right to change.
textos.La vía del tren cruza la localidad de la: The train line crosses the town from side to side, in a straight line, and goes through the station. Trains you can hear coming run on it. If you leave it with no value, it runs along the street or avenue in front of the train station. Without a station there is no line.
textos.La víctima te da las gracias y una recom: The victim thanks you and gives you a reward.
textos.La última gasolinera antes de la carrete: The last gas station before the coast road.
textos.La última vez no arrancó:: The last time it did not start:
The only fresh water on the island.
Barking and tails thumping against the cage.
textos.Lanza una granada al doble de distancia: Throws a grenade twice as far as your arm: sixty meters, and it blows up within seven all around. Cheaper than the rocket launcher and plenty for a car.
textos.Lanzas el anzuelo. Cuando oigas que pica: You cast the hook. When you hear a bite, press Space right away. Don't move.
textos.Larga, negra y con los cristales tintado: Long, black and with tinted windows.
textos.Largo, pesado y siempre a mano en un pue: Long, heavy and always handy in a fishing town.
Super long, heavy and with a minibar.
textos.Las Conservas Cala Brava llegan a los su: Cala Brava Canned Goods reach the supermarkets of the capital.
textos.Las Minas de Monteferro firman la paz co: The Monteferro Mines make peace with the miners.
textos.Las Naves: la desaladora, los depósitos: Las Naves: the desalination plant, the depots and Aguas del Ocaso tankers coming and going day and night, with private security.
textos.Las actividades conjuntas son carreras c: Joint activities are bet races and team deliveries. Also, on foot next to a friend's stopped vehicle, the F key puts you in as a passenger.
textos.Las alianzas las propone el jefe, a otra: Alliances are proposed by the boss, to another gang that exists.
textos.Las armas con menos daño por bala no le: Weapons with less damage per bullet do nothing to it. Explosives always do.
Weapons are loaded by the devil.
textos.Las avenidas van de sur a norte y las ca: The avenues run south to north and the streets west to east. That way you won't get lost.
textos.Las balas rebotan en el helicóptero: hac: Bullets bounce off the helicopter: you need a heavy weapon, a rifle or an explosive.
textos.Las bandas están en las ciudades: Puerto: The gangs are in the cities: Puerto Bravo, San Lucero and Monteferro.
textos.Las bandas intentan reconquistar tus bar: Gangs try to reconquer your neighborhoods
textos.Las bandas que has vencido intentan recu: The gangs you've beaten are trying to take back your neighborhoods. Here you see the threat, loyalty and defense of each one, set guards and reinforcements, pay informants, make truces, hit hideouts and, when they attack, send your crew. Inside, the first option explains everything.
textos.Las bandas que has vencido se están reha: The gangs you've beaten are rebuilding and will try to take back what's theirs. You have {dias} of calm. After that, when a gang attacks a neighborhood, you'll have a few hours to go and defend it in person or to send your crew from the phone; if you do nothing, you lose it. Get ready on the phone, in Territories, Neighborhood defense: there you put guards, reinforce a neighborhood, pay informants who warn you in time, make truces and hit hideouts. And visit your neighborhoods now and then: an abandoned one falls sooner. If you'd rather it didn't happen, turn it off in Options, The street.
textos.Las bandas que has vencido se rehacen co: The gangs you've beaten rebuild as the days go by and try to take back your neighborhoods. When one attacks a neighborhood, you're always notified and you have a few hours: go there and defend it in person, in waves and with your gang by your side, or send your crew from this menu, and the result is worked out from their strength against your defense, plus luck. If you do nothing, the standing guard defends on its own, if there is one; if not, the neighborhood is lost, along with its daily money and some street reputation, and you'll have to reconquer it. The deadline doesn't run while you're on a mission, and if you sleep or end up in the hospital or the holding cell, your crew holds out: when you come back you always have a few hours left. A neighborhood's defense goes up with standing guards, who are paid every day, with reinforcements, which are paid once, with its loyalty and with the people of your gang. Loyalty drops if days go by without you setting foot in the neighborhood, and rises when you visit it, defend it or invest in it. Informants are paid every day and warn you ahead of time: without them, you find out late or when they've already arrived. With a gang you can make a truce for a few days, or hit their hideout to sink their strength. A gang beaten several times is dismantled for a long spell, but someone new always ends up arriving. There are never two attacks at once and there are always a few days of rest between one and the next. The intensity is chosen in Options, The street: off, calm, normal or hard.
textos.Las bandas respetan tus negocios y no te: Gangs respect your businesses and don't ask you for money
textos.Las bandas vencidas intentan recuperar t: Defeated gangs try to take back your neighborhoods. Loyalty drops if days go by without you setting foot in the neighborhood; defense rises with guards, reinforcements, loyalty and your gang; and the threat tells you whether something is being planned against it. Everything is managed further down, in Defense of your neighborhoods.
textos.Las calles se cuentan desde el sur y las: Streets are counted from the south and avenues from the west.
textos.Las carreras de noche, si te gusta el mo: The night races, if you like engines. I haven't told you anything.
textos.Las casas se compran en las inmobiliaria: Homes are bought at real estate agencies. It takes a home, not a business.
textos.Las casas y los negocios que se compran: The houses and businesses you can buy are in other towns.
textos.Las cepas más viejas del valle, retorcid: The oldest vines in the valley, twisted like hands.
textos.Las cifras de tu partida: misiones, dine: The figures of your game: missions, money, time played, places visited, distances and more.
textos.Las clases se dan en las academias: ve a: Classes are given at the academies: go to one.
textos.Las condenas que constan en tu ficha, cu: The convictions on your record, when they expire and how to reduce them. They close off positions of trust, loans and joining the police.
textos.Las consecuencias están apagadas: el pre: Consequences are turned off: standing only counts for pay, the bank and the police, as before
textos.Las cuatro encendidas y con luz de sobra: All four lit, with light to spare. Nobody runs aground tonight. It's on the house.
textos.Las cuatro luces están encendidas. Chelo: All four lights are lit. Chelo wants to thank you. What do you ask her for?
The accounts of {n} do not quite add up. Something is missing, but they say nothing.
The homemade kind, with melted cheese.
textos.Las del fondo son para el suero de los a: The ones in the back are for the grandparents' saline drips. Thank you, truly.
textos.Las demás localidades del juego, cada un: The other towns in the game, each with its places. The GPS guides you to the exit that leads to the one you pick.
textos.Las dos cosas se te dan bien. Eso es lo: You're good at both. That's what scares you most.
textos.Las dos últimas veces, el juego se cerró: The last two times, the game closed while loading the voice generator, so it has been turned off on this computer.
textos.Las etiquetas llevan el sello de una imp: The labels bear the stamp of a Puerto Bravo print shop. Someone in the city is paying for all this.
textos.Las fases. Un golpe preparado tiene cinc: The phases. A heist has five, and the game announces them: entry, control, safe, exit and getaway. The O key tells you which one you're in. The safe is no longer grabbed instantly: it takes between {entero} and {entero2} seconds depending on the place, and longer at a bank. You can hear it progress. If you step away, it stops.
textos.Las fiestas son preciosas. Tienes que ve: The festival is lovely. You have to come.
textos.Las frases marcadas con la palabra GRABA: Lines marked with the word RECORDED already have a file.
textos.Las gaviotas te roban el bocadillo de la: The seagulls steal the sandwich right out of your hand.
textos.Las grúas de Bahía del Ocaso, muy al oes: The cranes of Bahía del Ocaso, far to the west of Puerto Bravo.
textos.Las guerras en marcha o a punto de empez: The wars under way or about to start, all the gangs and who owns each neighborhood.
textos.Las hipotecas se piden al comprar: ve a: Mortgages are requested when buying: go to the house or business you want and choose to buy with a mortgage
textos.Las mejoras que lleva este vehículo y su: The upgrades this vehicle has and its faults, if any. Enter reads it again.
textos.Las mejores pizzas de Puerto Bravo. Siem: The best pizzas in Puerto Bravo. They are always looking for delivery riders.
textos.Las misiones pagan la mitad. Cada modifi: Missions pay half. Each active modifier makes you earn experience twenty-five percent faster.
textos.Las misiones que puedes hacer ahora, con: The missions you can do now, with where each one starts. Enter sets the spot on the GPS.
textos.Las montamos esta noche. Has salvado el: We'll set them up tonight. You saved the well, and that isn't forgotten here.
The motorcycles go by like airplanes.
textos.Las noticias las sé yo antes de que pase: I know the news before it happens.
textos.Las obras de la avenida llevan tres años: The roadwork on the avenue has been going on for three years. The pyramids took less time.
textos.Las opciones están agrupadas por seccion: Options are grouped into sections. Press Enter to open one
textos.Las opciones marcadas con «necesita rein: Options marked «Needs a restart» only apply when the server is stopped and started again.
textos.Las opciones que piden reiniciar lo dice: Options that need a restart say so in their help, with Ctrl+H. Ctrl+Tab switches tabs.
textos.Las palas de un helicóptero en el que va: The blades of a helicopter you are riding in.
textos.Las películas de antes sí que eran buena: The old movies were really good.
textos.Las personas con las que tienes relación: The people you have a relationship with and how it's going: calling, writing, meeting up, giving gifts and everything else you do with each one.
textos.Las prendas de este estilo, con su preci: The clothes in this style, with their price. What's already yours you put on for free. Each person in your social life likes a style.
textos.Las que guardas en el puño. Tu rival no: The ones you keep in your fist. Your opponent can't see them. Then you say how many there are between the two of you.
textos.Las que te quedan en la mano. Al cerrars: The ones left in your hand. If the game gets blocked, whoever has fewer points in them wins.
textos.Las recetas se cocinan en la cocina, rec: Recipes are cooked in the kitchen, by walking around inside the house.
textos.Las reglas de las peleas, los atracos y: The rules for fights, robberies and bounties.
textos.Las ruedas besan la pista de {campo}. Bu: The wheels kiss the runway at {campo}. Nice landing.
textos.Las salinas se pueden volver a poner en: The salt flats can be started up again. They pay out money every midnight.
textos.Las sardinas en el puerto, con las manos: Sardines at the harbor, with your hands. Now that's eating.
textos.Las segundas funciones: mantienes pulsad: The second functions: you hold the View, Create or Share button and press another. By default: next intersection, where your vehicle is, hunger and sleep, walk automatically, talk, time, heading, surrender with the left trigger and, with the right trigger, the actions menu, which has everything that doesn't fit on a button.
textos.Las sirenas se acercan. Esta vez no vien: The sirens are getting closer. This time they're not coming for you. Marta steps out of a car with the recorder in her hand, and behind her, the judge.
textos.Las situaciones en las que puedes ayudar: The situations in which you can help or take advantage.
textos.Las sustancias que llevas: cada diez uni: The substances you carry: every ten units take up one slot. They're stored in the wardrobe of a house of yours.
textos.Las tareas de vender y cocinar necesitan: The selling and cooking tasks need adult content, and there's none on a server
textos.Las teclas W, A, S y D son tu bastón: di: The W, A, S and D keys are your cane: they tell you what is in each direction and how far away the wall is.
textos.Las tiendas del centro son para turistas: The stores downtown are for tourists.
textos.Las treguas son cosa de la reconquista d: Truces are part of the neighborhood reconquest, which isn't underway here.
textos.Las tres consecuencias se sortean con es: The three consequences are drawn with these weights. With zero, that one never comes up.
textos.Las vendes al precio de hoy y te dice si: You sell them at today's price and it tells you whether you gain or lose compared to what they cost you. If you have fewer than ten, you sell the ones you have.
textos.Las voces grabadas de las escenas de la: The recorded voices of the story scenes in {idioma}. Without them, your screen reader says the scenes.
textos.Latas, pasta, arroz y legumbres en estan: Cans, pasta, rice and legumes on shelves up to the ceiling.
textos.Le cierras la cartera con la mano. En la: You snap his wallet shut. Word will get around the fish market.
textos.Le das a {nombre} {euros} euros, aparte: You give {nombre} {euros} euros, on top of their share. They say nothing, but you can tell.
textos.Le das algo de dinero, a tu elección. Os: You give some money, your choice. The more you give, the closer it brings you, once a day, and the next day they tell you what they bought.
textos.Le das efectivo y te lo devuelve limpio: You hand over cash and they give it back clean in the bank in a few days, keeping a good part. Sometimes they disappear with the money.
textos.Le das la paga extra: You give them the bonus pay
textos.Le das las llaves a Remedios. Las mira c: You hand the keys to Remedios. She looks at them as if they were burning.
textos.Le das las llaves de {casa} a {inquilino: You give the keys to {casa} to {inquilino}. The rent, about {renta} euros a day, arrives by itself every midnight.
textos.Le das un beso. {n} sonríe y te lo devue: You give them a kiss. {n} smiles and returns it.
textos.Le das un botiquín a {nombre}. Te quedan: You give {nombre} a first aid kit. You have {botiquin} left.
textos.Le das un masaje en los hombros. {n} cie: You massage their shoulders. {n} closes their eyes and sighs.
textos.Le das uno de tus botiquines, esté donde: You give them one of your first aid kits, wherever they are. If you have none left, you can't.
You give them {quita} euros and they run off. What is in the bank and at home stays safe; what you lose is what you were carrying.
textos.Le dejas ir con un aviso. Te da las grac: You let him go with a warning. He thanks you three times.
textos.Le dejas veinte euros junto a la mano. A: You leave twenty euros next to his hand. He opens an eye and thanks you without a voice.
textos.Le devuelves la fianza, {entero} días de: You return the deposit, {entero} days of rent, and you can sleep, save the game and use the garage here again. You're asked to confirm first.
textos.Le dices a {banda} que no pactas con nad: You tell {banda} you don't make truces with anyone. The street likes it, but they may come back.
textos.Le dices a {nombre} que no puedes. Lo en: You tell {nombre} you can't. They understand, but they're not happy about it.
textos.Le dices al capataz que no está en venta: You tell the foreman it's not for sale.
textos.Le dices algo al oído. {n} se ríe y te m: You whisper something in their ear. {n} laughs and looks at you differently.
textos.Le dices que tienes mala memoria para la: You tell him you have a bad memory for faces, but a good one for hotels.
textos.Le dices que ya está saldado. No entiend: You tell him it's settled. He doesn't understand a thing. Better that way.
textos.Le echas de la banda: You kick them out of the gang
textos.Le entraron a la vecina la semana pasada: They broke into my neighbor's place last week. They even took the ham.
textos.Le entregas el boletín: {euros} euros y: You hand him the ticket: {euros} euros and points. He protests, but signs.
textos.Le escribes lo que quieras y te contesta: You write whatever you want and they answer, just like when talking to people on the street. If you're not in the same place, by phone. Talking often brings you a little closer, once a day.
textos.Le esperas a la salida y le dices dos pa: You wait for him at the exit and say two words: "casino" and "notebook." He pays without arguing.
textos.Le fallan los nervios: sin ventaja: Their nerves fail: no head start
They like it when you're dressed {v}.
textos.Le habla la policía. Tire el arma y quéd: This is the police. Drop your weapon and stay where you are.
You treat them to a coffee for {precio} euros. {nombre}: Well, I'll take you up on that.
textos.Le llega la invitación y tiene tres minu: They get the invitation and have three minutes to accept it. They would join as a member.
textos.Le llenas el depósito sin sacarla del ha: You fill its tank without taking it out of the hangar.
textos.Le llevas de la mano hasta un agente. An: You take him by the hand to an officer. Before you leave, the boy waves goodbye with his little hand.
textos.Le mandas {lower} a domicilio, con {envi: You send {lower} delivered, with {envio} euros delivery fee. {nombre} writes to thank you{v}. In person it would have meant more to them. Now {afinidad_txt}.
textos.Le pagas a {nombre} un bocadillo y un ca: You buy {nombre} a sandwich and a coffee. They say working with you is a pleasure.
textos.Le pides perdón a {n} sin excusas. Se le: You apologize to {n} with no excuses. A half smile slips out. Something mends.
You stand up to him. He pulls out a knife.
textos.Le pones las esposas. Una unidad se lo l: You put the handcuffs on him. A unit takes him to the station.
textos.Le pones nombre y apellido, eliges si te: You give it a first and last name, choose whether people address you as male or female, spread eight levels among the four skills and pick what you start with.
textos.Le quitas el rango de mano derecha, si l: You take away their right hand rank, if they had it: they will no longer be able to invite, withdraw from the till, claim neighborhoods or declare wars.
textos.Le sube la confianza poco a poco. Si le: Its trust rises little by little. If you hurt it, this is how you make peace.
textos.Le subes las bolsas hasta el tercero sin: You carry the bags up to the third floor with no elevator. She wants to give you a tip and you don't take it. She gives you a container of croquettes, and that you do take.
textos.Le subes las bolsas. Te pone diez euros: You carry the bags up. She puts ten euros in your hand and won't take no for an answer.
textos.Le tapas la herida, le hablas y no te mu: You cover the wound, talk to him and don't leave his side. When the ambulance arrives, the paramedic thanks you in front of everyone.
textos.Le tenemos localizado. Deténgase y salga: We have you located. Stop and come out with your hands up.
textos.Le vemos desde el aire. No empeore las c: We can see you from the air. Do not make things worse: give yourself up.
textos.Lealtad por debajo de la cual se avisa: Loyalty below which a warning is given
textos.Lealtad por debajo de la cual se avisa e: Loyalty below which a serious warning is given
textos.Lealtad por debajo de la cual un detenid: Loyalty below which an arrested person gives your name
textos.Lealtad que gana al invitarle: Loyalty gained when you treat them
textos.Lealtad que gana un camello por cada bue: Loyalty a dealer gains for each good day
textos.Lealtad que gana uno de los tuyos al hab: Loyalty one of your crew gains when you talk to them
textos.Lealtad que ganan al día con la paga alt: Loyalty they gain per day with high pay
textos.Lealtad que ganan cuando el golpe sale b: Loyalty they gain when the heist goes well
textos.Lealtad que pierde cada día alguien olvi: Loyalty someone forgotten loses each day
textos.Lealtad que pierden al día con la paga b: Loyalty they lose per day with low pay
textos.Lealtad que pierden cuando fracasa: Loyalty they lose when it fails
textos.Lees la nota tres veces. Tu nombre, la f: You read the note three times. Your name, Varela's signature, Belmonte's stamp. Three years of your life on half a sheet of paper.
Slow and hard as a rock.
textos.Lento como una procesión y duro como una: Slow as a procession and hard as a rock.
textos.Lento como él solo, pero pasa por encima: Slow as can be, but it rolls over anything.
textos.Lento y robusto. Un barco de trabajo de: Slow and sturdy. A classic working boat.
I read a lot... I like it more than going out.
textos.Leocadia Arizmendi baja de la colina por: Leocadia Arizmendi comes down from the hill for the last time.
You tell them no, looking them in the eye. They know who you are on the street and don't push it.
textos.Les dices que no. Esa noche arde un cont: You tell them no. That night a dumpster burns in front of {negocio} and the shutter is found broken open: a few days of losses.
textos.Les dices que no. Por esta vez se van si: You tell them no. This time they just leave.
textos.Les dices que se apañen. El sábado falta: You tell them to sort it out themselves. On Saturday one is missing, and the mess is yours.
textos.Les exiges que te paguen cada día por de: You demand that they pay you every day for letting them stay. You need to own at least one neighborhood. If they fear you, they pay for a few days; if not, they refuse, and if you don't carry much weight they may send someone after you. While they pay, that gang doesn't attack your neighborhoods.
textos.Les hablas de números. El de la corbata: You talk to them about numbers. The man in the tie nods from the back of the bar.
textos.Les ofreces el barrio por las buenas. Si: You offer them the neighborhood the easy way. If they're interested, they name a figure: you accept, ask for more or drop it. You lose the neighborhood and what it pays you every midnight, but you get paid all at once and your relationship with that gang improves.
textos.Les pagas y durante unos días esa banda: You pay them and for a few days that gang doesn't raid your neighborhoods, and it rebuilds half as fast. If it was preparing a raid, it drops it. They ask for more the stronger they are and the worse you get along, and the figure isn't the same every day. You can ask for a discount, once. The truce can be broken: by them, some day, or by you, if you hit their hideout.
textos.Les pagas y durante unos días no asaltan: You pay them and for a few days they don't attack your neighborhoods, and they rebuild half as fast. If they were preparing an attack, they drop it. They ask for more the stronger they are and the worse you get along; you can haggle once. The truce can be broken: by them, some day, without warning, or by you, if you hit their hideout.
textos.Levantas las manos y gritas que te rinde: You raise your hands and shout that you surrender. The officers stop shooting and come for you: do not move or attack.
textos.Licor casero de endrinas de la sierra. D: Homemade sloe liqueur from the mountains. Sweet, deceptive and stronger than it seems.
textos.Licor de endrinas casero y lo poco que s: Homemade sloe liqueur and the little that makes it up from the city.
textos.Ligera como una bicicleta y con un motor: Light as a bicycle and with an engine that never stalls.
textos.Ligera y precisa a mucha distancia. La d: Light and accurate at long range. The mountain rangers' choice.
textos.Ligero y nervioso. Acelera como un demon: Light and twitchy. It accelerates like crazy and breaks if you so much as look at it.
textos.Ligero y rápido, ideal para la playa y e: Light and fast, ideal for the beach and the countryside.
textos.Limosna a alguien de la calle: Spare change for someone on the street
textos.Limpio y rápido. Te voy a presentar a un: Clean and quick. I'll introduce you to a friend: they call him El Profesor and he lives in the basement of the University. Tell him I sent you.
textos.Limpio. A partir de hoy, usted y yo somo: Clean. From today on, you and I are partners. Don't go telling people.
textos.Liquidarlo cuesta {total} euros y entre: Settling it costs {total} euros and between your account and your pocket you don't have it.
textos.Lista de casillas. Muévase con las flech: Checklist. Move with the arrow keys and check or uncheck with Space.
textos.Lista de lugares, para marcar un destino: List of places, to mark a destination
textos.Lista de opciones. Elija con las flechas: List of options. Choose with the arrow keys.
textos.Lista desplegable. Ábrala con Alt+flecha: Drop-down list. Open it with Alt+Down Arrow and choose with the arrow keys.
textos.Lista. Arriba y abajo cambian de element: List. Up and down change the item; left and right move through the columns; Ctrl plus a number reads that column; Enter opens the item.
textos.Literas, mantas gordas y una chimenea qu: Bunk beds, thick blankets and a fireplace that never goes out.
textos.Litros del depósito según el sonido del: Tank liters according to the engine sound
textos.Llaman al timbre de tu casa: llega la co: Someone rings your doorbell: the food you ordered for delivery has arrived. Two notes, ding, dong.
textos.Llamar a emergencias y esperar con él: Call emergency services and wait with him
textos.Llamar a la policía y dar la descripción: Call the police and give the description
textos.Llamar a los de tu banda que faltan: Call the missing members of your gang
textos.Llamar a quien se equivocó para que lo e: Call whoever made the mistake so they can explain
textos.Llamar a {perro} para que vuelva contigo: Call {perro} to come back to you
textos.Llamas a uno de {banda} y le dices dónde: You call one of {banda} and tell them where you are. They hang up without answering: they're already coming.
textos.Llamas desde la esquina. La patrulla lle: You call from the corner. The patrol arrives in time. The shopkeeper will know who to thank.
textos.Llamas, esperas y le das la mano. La amb: You call, wait and hold his hand. The ambulance arrives in ten minutes.
textos.Llega al campo de girasoles y después al: Reach the sunflower field and then the old mill before they set them on fire: three minutes and twenty seconds.
textos.Llega al día treinta sin una sola conden: Reach day thirty without a single conviction in the whole game.
textos.Llega al puesto más alto de un empleo fi: Reach the top position of a steady job.
textos.Llega con la moto a la puerta de la Vill: Ride the motorcycle to the gate of the Villa del Mirador, at the top of the hill, in a hundred seconds.
textos.Llega corriendo desde casa. En mitad del: It comes running from home. In the middle of the sea it can't.
textos.Llega gente nueva a la comarca: se hacen: New people are arriving in the region: they call themselves {banda}, and they're coming for what's yours.
textos.Llega la ambulancia y los sanitarios ati: The ambulance arrives and the paramedics tend to the wounded. {situar}.
textos.Llega una patrulla y se bajan {ocupantes: A patrol car arrives and {ocupantes} officers get out. {situar}. They are after whoever attacked you, not you.
textos.Llega uno armado con pistola, te sigue y: One arrives armed with a pistol, follows you and fights by your side. He also charges {precio} euros every midnight. You can have two at most.
textos.Llegar a un punto vigilado sin que te oi: Reach a watched point without being heard
textos.Llegar. O aterrizas en el campo, con la: Arrive. Either you land at the airfield, with the tower guiding you, or you fly in low over the town and land wherever you like. With assisted landing, which is on by default, the aircraft descends and lines up on its own. By hand, descend to the altitude the tower tells you and keep the alignment clicks in the center.
textos.Llegas con el radar encima: You arrive with the radar on you
textos.Llegas con los primeros goterones. Entre: You arrive with the first big raindrops. Six of you load the last crates.
textos.Llegas nadando a {nombre} y sales del ag: You swim to {nombre} and climb out of the water, dripping, in {nombre2}.
textos.Llegas tarde a un aviso: You are late to a warning
You arrive and find a good spot.
textos.Llena el depósito del vehículo que lleva: Fills the tank of the vehicle you are driving or the one you left parked next to you. You pay right away.
textos.Llenar el depósito: ven con tu vehículo: Fill up: come with your vehicle or leave it parked next to you
textos.Lleva a Belmonte a su mansión de La Coli: Take Belmonte to his mansion in La Colina. Drive smoothly: the car can't take any damage.
textos.Lleva cada sonido de un pack, o que haya: Brings each sound from a pack, or that you replaced by hand, to the same level as the original, so none ends up too loud or too quiet.
textos.Lleva el Centella al Desguace Hierro Vie: Take the Centella to Hierro Viejo Scrapyard without wrecking it.
textos.Lleva el Fórmula a la Recta del Polígono: Take the Formula car to the Industrial Estate Straight in a hundred seconds. Careful: it's extremely fast and breaks at the slightest thing.
Take the loot to La Gaviota Bar.
textos.Lleva el buggy al Taller Mecánico Naranj: Take the buggy to Naranjo Auto Repair.
Take the cable to the inn.
textos.Lleva el coche al Gimnasio El Yunque. Co: Take the car to El Yunque Gym. Drive with the arrow keys, or press Y to let the car drive itself.
textos.Lleva el coche patrulla a la Nave indust: Take the patrol car to the Industrial Warehouse in Polígono Hierro.
Take the chest to Captain's Tavern.
textos.Lleva el contador a El Faro del Ocaso an: Take the meter to El Faro del Ocaso before they notice it's missing. You have a little over three minutes.
Take the painting to the museum.
textos.Lleva el deportivo a Talleres Campus, en: Take the sports car to Campus Repair Shop, in Barrio Universitario.
textos.Lleva el descapotable al desguace sin de: Take the convertible to the scrapyard without wrecking it: it has to make it at least halfway.
Take the money to Almacén Siete Gun Shop.
Take the money to Casino Belmonte.
Take the money to the Food Market.
Take the hard drive to the University.
textos.Lleva el expediente a la Taberna del Sin: Take the file to the Union Tavern.
textos.Lleva el foco al campo de órdenes, en la: Moves focus to the command field, on the Log tab.
textos.Lleva el jarabe a la Despensa Solidaria: Take the syrup to the Community Pantry in two and a half minutes.
textos.Lleva el lápiz de memoria a la Redacción: Take the memory stick to El Faro Newsroom.
Take the briefcase to El Faro del Ocaso.
textos.Lleva el maletín a la Redacción de El Fa: Take the briefcase to El Faro Newsroom.
textos.Lleva el maletín a las oficinas de la fu: Take the briefcase to the foundry offices.
Take the package to La Gaviota Bar.
textos.Lleva el paquete en barco al Arrecife de: Take the package by boat to Mermaid Reef.
textos.Lleva el primer pedido a la Farmacia Lun: Take the first order to Luna Pharmacy.
textos.Lleva el sedán a Talleres El Chispas sin: Take the sedan to El Chispas Repair Shop without wrecking it. Up arrow accelerates, down arrow brakes, and the side arrows turn on the turn signal for the next intersection.
textos.Lleva el segundo pedido al Gimnasio El Y: Take the second order to El Yunque Gym.
textos.Lleva el sobre a la Redacción de El Faro: Take the envelope to El Faro Newsroom.
textos.Lleva el sobre al Club Paraíso, en el pu: Take the envelope to Club Paraíso, in the harbor.
textos.Lleva el sobre al Hospital General en tr: Take the envelope to General Hospital in three minutes.
textos.Lleva el tractor a la Cooperativa agríco: Take the tractor to the Farmers' Cooperative. Be patient: it doesn't go fast.
textos.Lleva el vehículo a {nombre} en buen est: Take the vehicle to {nombre} in good condition.
textos.Lleva el volquete a la Hermandad Minera: Take the dump truck to the Miners' Brotherhood without wrecking it.
textos.Lleva el último pedido a la Iglesia de S: Take the last order to San Telmo Church.
textos.Lleva este jarabe a la Despensa Solidari: Take this syrup to the Community Pantry, stop by the Guild to pick up my papers and bring me saffron from the grocery store.
textos.Lleva la Sala Marejada desde que murió s: She has run Sala Marejada since her uncle died. Serious by day, a different person at night. She knows every secret in town and tells none.
textos.Lleva la caja a la Taberna del Sindicato: Take the box to the Union Tavern.
textos.Lleva la caja a la guarida de Los Calave: Take the box to Los Calaveras Hideout.
Take the box to Almacén Siete Gun Shop.
textos.Lleva la caja de libros al centro cívico: Take the box of books to the community center.
textos.Lleva la camioneta al Mercado de Abastos: Take the pickup to the Food Market in San Lucero without hitting anything. The GPS guides you to the edge of town: there, press Enter to take the highway.
textos.Lleva la cisterna a la Protectora El Abr: Take the tanker to El Abrevadero Animal Shelter, carefully.
textos.Lleva la cisterna a la puerta del Gimnas: Take the tanker to the door of El Aljibe Gym, in the Cauce Seco.
textos.Lleva la cisterna al Comedor Vecinal del: Take the tanker to the Cauce Neighborhood Soup Kitchen without bumping it.
textos.Lleva la dinamita a la Taberna del Sindi: Take the dynamite to the Union Tavern.
textos.Lleva la furgoneta a la Arrocería La Bar: Take the van to La Barraca Rice Restaurant in four minutes without wrecking it.
textos.Lleva la furgoneta al Chiringuito El Esp: Take the van to El Espeto Beach Bar before the goods melt.
textos.Lleva la furgoneta al Hotel Miramar, en: Take the van to Hotel Miramar, in Playa Dorada, before time runs out.
textos.Lleva la furgoneta con las cajas al Banc: Take the van with the crates to the Food Bank, without any bumps.
textos.Lleva la llave a la Cueva del Tuerto y r: Take the key to One-Eye's Cave and pick up the chest.
textos.Lleva la primera caja al Mesón del Lagar: Take the first crate to El Lagar Inn.
textos.Lleva la ranchera a la Chatarrería La Fu: Take the station wagon to La Fundición Scrap Yard.
Take the second one to the Olmo Inn.
textos.Lleva las botellas a la Taberna El Ancla: Take the bottles to El Ancla Tavern.
textos.Lleva las botellas al Refugio del Collad: Take the bottles to the Collado Refuge.
textos.Lleva las escrituras a la Taberna del Si: Take the deeds to the Union Tavern.
textos.Lleva las huchas a la Plaza de las Fuent: Take the collection boxes to Plaza de las Fuentes.
textos.Lleva las planchas a la Embotelladora La: Take the plates to La Gota Bottling Plant, in Las Naves, in four minutes.
textos.Lleva los detonadores a la orilla del La: Take the detonators to the shore of the Black Lake and throw them in the water.
Take the rifles to Almacén Siete Gun Shop.
textos.Lleva los sobres a la terminal del ferry: Take the envelopes to the ferry terminal, the casino and Belmonte Mansion, in that order, in four minutes.
textos.Lleva los termos al hospital, al parque: Take the thermoses to the hospital, the fire station and the harbor police station before they go cold. You have five minutes.
textos.Lleva refuerzos: te deja el blindaje en: Reinforced: sets your armor to {blindaje} if you had less.
textos.Lleva un golpe contigo: Has pulled one heist with you
Take one of your businesses to the highest level.
textos.Lleva un rato, pero nadie sale perdiendo: It takes a while, but nobody loses out.
textos.Lleva una hora ahí sentada, con el globo: She's been sitting there for an hour, with the balloon. She says her mother works at the cathedral, as a guide.
textos.Lleva {_junta}. {int} minutos, {v}. Sale: It takes {_junta}. {int} minutes, {v}. It makes {_cuantos}, which keep {_cuantos2} in the fridge. Each serving {efecto_txt}. {v2}
textos.Llevabas tanto sin entrar que {nombre} h: You'd been away so long that {nombre} went back on the market. You have {n} euros of its value left.
textos.Llevar el timón: navegar unos metros y c: Take the helm: sail a few meters and change course
textos.Llevar los libros a la policía: Take the books to the police
textos.Llevarle de la mano al dormitorio: Take them by the hand to the bedroom
textos.Llevarle las bolsas hasta su casa: Carry his bags to his home
textos.Llevarte una encima, para comer fuera: Take one with you, to eat out
textos.Llevas %d minutos sin hacer nada y el se: You have been idle for %d minutes and the server has kicked you to make room. Your character is saved: you can come back in.
textos.Llevas 1 misión de la historia. La últim: You have done 1 story mission. The last one was {titulo}: {resumen}
textos.Llevas demasiado sin beber. Estás perdie: You've gone too long without drinking. You're losing health.
textos.Llevas demasiado sin comer. Estás perdie: You've gone too long without eating. You're losing health.
textos.Llevas encima {_cuantos} de comida, de {: You are carrying {_cuantos} of food, out of {entero} you can carry:
textos.Llevas rueda de repuesto: párate y cámbi: You carry a spare tire: stop and change it from the phone, in Services.
textos.Llevas {carga} de {v} unidades de mercan: You carry {carga} of {v} units of product; you have room for {hueco_mercancia} more. {moc_txt}. To sell, stand next to a pedestrian with no weapon in hand and press E
textos.Llevas {n} misiones de la historia. La ú: You have done {n} story missions. The last one was {titulo}: {resumen}
textos.Llevo aquí tanto que ya ni me acuerdo de: I've been here so long I don't even remember when I arrived.
textos.Llevo media vida de {oficio}. Ya no sabr: I've been a {oficio} for half my life. I wouldn't know how to do anything else.
textos.Llevo veinte años jugando al mismo númer: I've been playing the same number for twenty years. Someday it'll hit.
textos.Llevárselas y aceptar la propina: Take them and accept the tip
textos.Llevárselo al cantinero, como quedasteis: Take it to the canteen keeper, as you agreed
textos.Llueve dentro del comedor. La cantera no: It's raining inside the dining hall. The quarry gives us the slate, but someone has to go get it.
textos.Llueve en toda la comarca: precaución en: It's raining across the region: take care on the roads.
textos.Llévalo a Autos Platino en tres minutos: Take it to Autos Platino in three minutes and nearly intact.
Take it to Las Palmeras Beach.
textos.Llévalo al Taller Agrícola Ruedas sin go: Take it to Ruedas Farm Repair Shop without bumping it.
textos.Llévalo al casino en poco más de tres mi: Take it to the casino in a little over three minutes and without any bumps.
textos.Llévame. Si voy sola, me doy la vuelta e: Take me. If I go alone, I'll turn back at the door.
textos.Llévaselo en tres minutos y sin un rasgu: Take it to him in three minutes and without a scratch. If it arrives in good shape, there's more work.
textos.Llévatelo a la puerta de la Hermandad Mi: Take it to the door of the Miners' Brotherhood, where the whole town will see it in the morning. Slowly, it's heavy.
They thank you with a smile.
textos.Lo apagas y te lo guardas. El del quiosc: You switch it off and keep it. The guy at the kiosk saw you, and he knows the owner.
textos.Lo apagas y te lo guardas. Setenta euros: You switch it off and keep it. Seventy euros at the pawn shop.
textos.Lo apuntas todo en un papel, con la hora: You write everything down on a piece of paper, with the time. Tomorrow it will be on Inspector Olalla's desk.
textos.Lo apuntas y avisas. Tu jefe agradece qu: You write it down and report it. Your boss appreciates that you didn't cover it up.
textos.Lo arregla quien se equivocó, colorado h: Whoever made the mistake fixes it, red to the ears. It didn't turn out well.
textos.Lo cerraste aceptando el dinero de una b: You sealed it by accepting money from a gang. After that day, the attacks may come back.
textos.Lo comunicas por la emisora: ha caído. N: You report it on the radio: he has fallen. This was not what was expected of you.
textos.Lo contrario también es verdad. Tres cuo: The opposite is also true. Three unpaid installments and we garnish half your paycheck. Don't take it personally: it's the same for everyone.
textos.Lo de San Lucero nos interesa. Un mercad: The San Lucero thing interests us. A market with a single owner is an orderly market. We'll call you.
textos.Lo de antes no era mejor. Éramos más jóv: The old days weren't better. We were younger, which isn't the same.
textos.Lo de la droguería no baja la suciedad d: The hardware store stuff does not lower the dirt below this: you need a shower
textos.Lo de pedirles dinero les ha sentado mal: They didn't take it well that you asked them for money. {banda} won't let it slide.
textos.Lo de siempre: comisaría, una multa mayo: The usual: police station, a bigger fine, and you lose your firearms, product and anything stolen you are carrying.
textos.Lo de siempre: suben los precios y bajan: Same old: prices go up and wages go down.
textos.Lo de siempre: una vez al día, te prepar: The usual: once a day, you make yourself something and recover health. It uses nothing from the pantry.
textos.Lo de {oficio} da para vivir, que no es: Being a {oficio} pays the bills, which is something.
textos.Lo dejan al 100 por ciento. Cuanto más d: They leave it at 100 percent. The more damaged it is and the more it is worth, the more it costs.
textos.Lo dejas a medias. La tanda se ha echado: You leave it half done. The batch is ruined.
textos.Lo dejas atado a la puerta del cuartel c: You leave him tied to the barracks door with a note.
textos.Lo dejas con {nombre}. No ha sido agrada: You leave it with {nombre}. It wasn't pleasant.
textos.Lo dejas en el armario de esta casa y te: You leave it in this house's wardrobe and its slots are freed up. You take it out whenever you like from the same wardrobe.
textos.Lo dejas en un aviso: You leave it at a warning
textos.Lo dejáis al momento, sin pedir confirma: You split up at once, with no confirmation. The relationship drops a lot, your mood goes down and, if you lived together, they move out.
textos.Lo dejé hace diez años. Sueño con él tod: I quit ten years ago. I dream about it every night.
textos.Lo dejé tres veces. La primera duré un m: I quit three times. The first lasted a month, the second a week, and the third until the afternoon coffee.
textos.Lo del contrabando en el puerto lo sabe: Everybody knows about the smuggling at the harbor. And nobody does anything.
textos.Lo desconecta. Si vuelve a entrar y no q: Disconnects them. If they come back in and you don't want that, close the game and reopen it with a password.
textos.Lo destilo yo. Si gusta abajo, dejo de s: I distill it myself. If they like it down there, I can stop serving drinks to four miners. Take these bottles to the guy at the Refuge and keep two.
textos.Lo dices en la plaza, en voz alta. Hay q: You say it in the square, out loud. Some applaud and some walk away. Anselmo puts a hand on your shoulder.
textos.Lo escribes en un papel y lo dejas encim: You write it on a paper and leave it on the newsroom table.
textos.Lo fresco va a la nevera y lo demás a la: Fresh items go in the fridge and the rest in the pantry, as far as they fit. Whatever doesn't fit stays with you.
textos.Lo fresco y lo que has cocinado. Desde a: Fresh items and what you have cooked. From here you eat, take something with you or throw out what is left over. Expired items are thrown out automatically when you open it, with a warning.
textos.Lo has hecho en defensa propia y en el b: You did it in self-defense and the neighborhood knows it: their gang won't hold it against you.
textos.Lo has hecho por Encarna. Ganas fama en: You did it for Encarna. You gain street reputation in the neighborhood and feel good about it.
textos.Lo hecho, hecho está. Ahora, mirar adela: What's done is done. Now, look ahead.
textos.Lo honrado. Baldomero cae, y el barrio s: The honest way. Baldomero falls, and the neighborhood knows who brought him down.
textos.Lo honrado. Casilda no lo olvidará, y el: The honest way. Casilda won't forget it, and neither will the neighborhood.
textos.Lo honrado. En la calle no gusta el que: The honest thing. On the street, nobody likes a snitch.
textos.Lo honrado. Funciona mejor cuanto más te: The honest way. It works better the more the neighbours like you: with good standing, the police act and the gang doesn't come back. If almost nobody knows you, it can go wrong.
textos.Lo honrado. Ganas fama y la gente del ba: The honest way. You gain street reputation and the neighborhood people thank you, but you earn nothing and make a powerful enemy.
textos.Lo honrado. Los vecinos te lo agradecerá: The honest way. The neighbors will thank you and Los Calaveras will hold a grudge.
textos.Lo importante es lo que hagas a partir d: What matters is what you do from now on.
Just enough for the beach bar.
textos.Lo justo: si les haces caso, ni ganan ni: Just enough: they neither gain nor lose loyalty.
textos.Lo lee solo esta persona, esté donde est: Only this person reads it, wherever they are on the server.
textos.Lo leen solo los de tu banda que estén c: Only the members of your gang who are online read it, wherever they are.
textos.Lo leen solo los de tu grupo de misión,: Only the members of your mission group read it, wherever they are.
textos.Lo leen solo los jugadores que estén a m: Only players less than eighty meters from you, in the same town, read it.
The legal way. They'll appreciate it in Villaseca.
textos.Lo legal: dos mil euros de recompensa y: The legal way: two thousand euros reward and some street reputation. Nobody keeps anything.
textos.Lo limpio. Pagas, el negocio deja de ser: The clean way. You pay, the business stops being a front, and what you couldn't justify gets regularized.
textos.Lo menos que cuenta si te pidió dinero,: The least that counts if they asked you for money, in euros
textos.Lo menos que piden, en euros: The least they ask for, in euros
textos.Lo menos que vale alguien recién recluta: The least a new recruit is worth, from 0 to 100
textos.Lo mismo que desde el móvil, pero en per: The same as from the phone, but in person: chat, meet up, give a gift or ask them to go for a walk with you.
textos.Lo mismo que hay en los pasillos, sin pa: The same as what is in the aisles, without walking around: {nombres}. Each item is paid for when you pick it up and you carry it with you; afterwards it is stored in the kitchen of a home of yours, and whatever is for cooking is cooked there. What can be eaten as it is, you can eat on the street, from the phone, in Inventory. If you prefer to walk around the store with a basket and pay at the register at the end, choose Walk around inside the store.
The same as the Y key.
textos.Lo mismo, y parte de la escolta llega en: The same, and part of the escort arrives in a vehicle
textos.Lo más alto que sube. Para pasar una tor: The highest it climbs. To fly over a storm it has to be greater than the height of the storms.
textos.Lo más con que puede empezar un personaj: The most a new character can start with, in euros.
textos.Lo más que paga el servidor por la nómin: The most the server pays for one period's paycheck, in euros, whatever the game world or a mod says.
textos.Lo más que se da por bueno de la paga de: The most accepted from the pay of a single repeatable job, in euros. Anything above that counts against the hourly earnings.
textos.Lo más que se lleva tu gente entre todos: The most your crew takes all together, percent of the loot
textos.Lo más que se puede ganar en una hora de: The most that can be earned in one clock hour from jobs, sales, gambling and street loot, in euros. What the server itself gives does not count.
textos.Lo más que se puede perder al caer ante: The most that can be lost when falling to another player, in euros.
textos.Lo más que se puede quitar en un atraco: The most that can be taken in a robbery of another player, in euros.
textos.Lo más rápido que hay. No lleva fuego, a: The fastest there is. It uses no fire, so it can't burn.
textos.Lo más rápido que puede y sin esperar en: As fast as it can, without waiting at traffic lights. If the police see you, it will cost you fines and license points.
textos.Lo mínimo que acepta el gestor, en euros: The least the broker accepts, in euros
textos.Lo oirán todos los que están dentro ahor: Everyone inside right now will hear it, with "Server notice" in front.
textos.Lo pasáis en grande: es justo lo que le: You have a blast: it's right up the alley of
textos.Lo piensas mejor y dejas la cesta en el: You think better of it and leave the basket on the floor, full.
textos.Lo primero que mira el juego, después de: The first thing the game checks, after the place's own Stock field.
textos.Lo primero, saber dónde estás. La tecla: First, knowing where you are. The C key tells you the street, the neighborhood and which way you're facing. K plays a tone from the north. N describes the place or the neighborhood.
textos.Lo que acierta a quemarropa. Un enemigo: How well they hit point-blank. An ordinary enemy has 0.42. Empty, the one for their type.
textos.Lo que acierta a quemarropa; de lejos ac: How well they hit point-blank; from far away they hit less. An ordinary enemy has 0.42.
textos.Lo que acorta el de la caja, por ciento,: How much the safe specialist shortens it, percent, if worth one hundred
textos.Lo que aguanta tu chaleco o tu protecció: How much your vest or your protection can take before the damage reaches your health. It is restocked at the gun shop.
textos.Lo que baja cada día después: What it drops each day afterward
textos.Lo que baja cada día tranquilo: How much it drops each calm day
textos.Lo que baja el nombre cada día de abando: How much the business name rating drops each day of neglect
textos.Lo que baja si no se paga a los guardias: What it drops if the guards or the gang are not paid
textos.Lo que cobra cada guardia al día: What each guard is paid per day
textos.Lo que cobra el abogado a la semana: What the lawyer charges per week
textos.Lo que comenta mientras va contigo: What they say while going with you
textos.Lo que compras en una tienda de comida l: What you buy at a grocery store, you carry with you until you store it in the kitchen of a home of yours.
textos.Lo que compras se paga con lo que llevas: What you buy is paid with what you're carrying: bank money has to be withdrawn first. The ATM only withdraws.
textos.Lo que compres a un proveedor aparece aq: What you buy from a supplier appears here to take.
textos.Lo que compres aquí mejora tus noches y: What you buy here improves your nights and works as a gift.
textos.Lo que compres para casa en una tienda d: What you buy for home at a grocery store is stored from the kitchen menu, with Store what you are carrying.
What you buy for home at a food shop is stored in the kitchen, with Store what you are carrying.
textos.Lo que consta en tu ficha, cuándo caduca: What is on your record, when it expires and how to reduce it: community service or a lawyer.
textos.Lo que cuesta cada nivel de informantes: What each informant level costs per day
textos.Lo que cuesta comprar una plaza de hanga: What it costs to buy a hangar space at this airfield. With zero or no value, the one from the rates.
What it costs is in the rates.
textos.Lo que cuesta fundar una banda, reclamar: What it costs to found a gang, claim a neighborhood and declare a war.
textos.Lo que cuesta invertir en un barrio: What it costs to invest in a neighborhood
textos.Lo que cuesta invitarle a algo, en euros: What it costs to treat them to something, in euros
textos.Lo que cuesta un desperfecto, en días de: What a damage costs, in days of rent
textos.Lo que cuesta, por ciento del precio del: What it costs, percent of the business price
What you decide counts in your evaluation. F1 explains each option
textos.Lo que decidiste en su día te cuesta {pa: What you decided back then costs you {pago} euros.
textos.Lo que decidiste en su día te deja: What you decided back then earns you
textos.Lo que deja cada barrio en la caja de la: What each neighborhood leaves in the gang's till at midnight, in euros.
textos.Lo que dejó apuntado el instalador: en q: What the installer noted down: which step failed, with which file and what to do so it works next time.
textos.Lo que dice al despedirlo: What they say when you dismiss them
textos.Lo que dice al llegar al destino: What they say on reaching the destination
textos.Lo que dice al marcarle un destino: What they say when you set a destination
textos.Lo que dice cuando no hay destino marcad: What they say when there is no destination set
textos.Lo que dice cuando te bajas: What they say when you get out
textos.Lo que dice cuando ya le han traído otro: What they say when others just like it have already been brought
textos.Lo que dice el agente que viene a esposa: What the officer coming to cuff you says
textos.Lo que dice el desguace con el cupo del: What the scrapyard says when the daily quota is full
textos.Lo que dice el juego con la tecla N y en: What the game says with the N key and in lists.
textos.Lo que dice el repartidor al llegar: What the delivery person says on arriving
textos.Lo que dice el tendero al cobrar: What the shopkeeper says when charging
textos.Lo que dice por el altavoz: What they say over the loudspeaker
textos.Lo que dice tu personaje. Lo oye quien e: What your character says. Whoever is within {metros} meters hears it. Also with Shift F10 during the game and, with a gamepad, in the actions menu. There are ready-made phrases: Tab, or the X or Square button, cycles through them.
textos.Lo que encuentres o robes por ahí va a l: Whatever you find or steal out there goes in the backpack, if it fits.
textos.Lo que espera una decisión tuya: una ins: What is waiting for a decision from you: an inspection with problems, a journalist or a gang asking for money. If the deadline runs out, it resolves itself.
textos.Lo que está en el armario de casa no te: What's in the wardrobe at home can't be taken by the police and isn't lost if you get knocked out. Keep here whatever you don't want to carry.
textos.Lo que grita el agente que va a por el a: What the officer going after the attacker shouts
textos.Lo que ha decidido quien lleva el servid: What the person running the server has decided: combat, safe zones, gang prices, earnings cap and more.
textos.Lo que hace al tomarla. Lo que llevas se: What it does when you take it. What you carry is taken from your substances, with Shift Z.
What it does with a full tank.
textos.Lo que hace en el golpe. Puedes tener va: What they do in the heist. You can have several roles with the same effect, but in each heist only one of them does it.
textos.Lo que hace en el vehículo. Sin valor, l: What it does in the vehicle. With no value, the upgrade can be bought and is described, but changes nothing.
textos.Lo que hace este botón del mando. Los bo: What this gamepad button does. Buttons are reassigned in Options, Gamepad.
textos.Lo que hacía {nombre} se hace ahora con: What {nombre} used to do is now done with {nombre2}
textos.Lo que has comprado alguna vez es tuyo:: Anything you have ever bought is yours: here, or in your homes, you put it on without paying.
textos.Lo que has comprado en las tiendas de co: What you have bought at grocery stores and haven't stored at home yet. What can be eaten as it is, you eat from here, wherever you are. What is for cooking is stored in the kitchen of a home of yours.
What you've caught and haven't sold yet. From land only small fish bite; the big ones are out at sea.
textos.Lo que hay en esa dirección no es un ser: What's at that address isn't a Puerto Bravo server, or it isn't answering.
textos.Lo que hay en esa dirección no es una pa: What's at that address is not a Puerto Bravo game.
textos.Lo que hay en la caja vale para todos lo: What is in the till applies to all businesses of that type.
textos.Lo que hay en la nevera y en la despensa: What is in the fridge and the pantry of this home, and the recipes you know how to make. To cook, eat from what is stored or store your groceries, you have to go to the kitchen: Walk around inside the house, and use the arrow keys to get to the kitchen. Fresh food expires after a few days.
textos.Lo que hay, ingresar o sacar dinero y lo: What's in it, depositing or withdrawing money and the latest entries.
What I've heard about you isn't good.
textos.Lo que la alarga si le fallan los nervio: How much longer it takes if their nerves fail, percent
textos.Lo que la misión pide de tu vida: What the mission asks of your life
textos.Lo que le fían al ciudadano ejemplar: What is given on credit to the model citizen
textos.Lo que le pasa a un vehículo cuando no l: What happens to a vehicle when you are simply not driving it.
textos.Lo que llevas encima para tomar o para v: What you carry to take or to sell, the effects you feel now and your dependence.
textos.Lo que llevas encima: objetos de valor e: What you are carrying: valuables you found or stole, and product. You sell them at pawn shops and store them in the wardrobe in your homes.
textos.Lo que llevas puesto ahora. Hay quien se: What you're wearing right now. Some people notice your style, and on a date it shows if you're dressed to their taste.
textos.Lo que manda Belmonte. Te llevas una com: That's Belmonte's order. You take a 500 euro commission.
What I have plenty of is suitors.
textos.Lo que no necesita frío: latas, pasta, a: What doesn't need refrigeration: cans, pasta, rice, legumes, potatoes, bread and fruit.
textos.Lo que no tiene botón propio en el mando: What has no button of its own on the gamepad
textos.Lo que paga como poco, aunque esté satur: The least it pays, even when saturated, percent
textos.Lo que paga el encargo, como poco: What the job pays, at least
textos.Lo que pagan, más o menos, por devolverl: What they pay, more or less, to get a neighborhood back
textos.Lo que pagas al tomar algo con un conoci: What you pay when having a drink with an acquaintance
textos.Lo que pasa después es solo vuestro.{pro: What happens next is only yours.{proteccion} In the morning, it's {hora_txt} and you feel {animo_txt}.
textos.Lo que pasa en el aire. Turbulencias, ot: What happens in the air. Turbulence, another aircraft at your altitude that you must give way to by climbing or descending, and storms that you can go around, fly over if your aircraft climbs high enough, or fly through. In rain there is more wind and more storms.
textos.Lo que pasa si sale mal: What happens if it goes badly
textos.Lo que pesa que esté mal defendido: How much it weighs that it is poorly defended
textos.Lo que pesa que sea el que más dinero da: How much it weighs that it is the one that brings in the most money
textos.Lo que pesa que su lealtad sea baja: How much it weighs that its loyalty is low
textos.Lo que pesa, al elegir barrio, que fuera: How much it weighs, when choosing a neighborhood, that it was theirs
textos.Lo que pesques mar adentro se vende en l: What you catch out at sea sells at the fish market and at the fishmongers. To head back out, any pier rents boats. Safe travels.
textos.Lo que pide de la vida del jugador: What it asks of the player's life
textos.Lo que pide el inspector para evitar la: What the inspector asks to avoid the raid, per territory
textos.Lo que pide el periodista por callar: What the journalist asks for to keep quiet
textos.Lo que piden, más o menos, por una tregu: What they ask for, more or less, for a truce
textos.Lo que piden, más o menos, por venderte: What they ask for, more or less, to sell you a neighborhood
textos.Lo que piden, por ciento de lo que da el: What they ask for, percent of what the business earns per week
textos.Lo que pierde de ingresos esos días, por: How much income it loses those days, percent
textos.Lo que pierdes de lo que llevas si le da: What you lose of what you carry if you hand over your wallet, percent
textos.Lo que puede salir mal. A quien le falla: What can go wrong. Someone whose nerves fail arrives late, doesn't warn you, or takes longer with the safe. The one inside can get hurt and is out for a few days. The lookout can get arrested, and if their loyalty is low, they give your name: your wanted level goes up and you get a criminal record entry. If the heist fails, everyone loses trust in you, and whoever is left with none leaves.
textos.Lo que puedes pedir por teléfono: que te: What you can ask for by phone: having a vehicle brought from a garage, a driver, bodyguards, an ambulance, a taxi or roadside assistance.
textos.Lo que quedaba en las cajas, {resto} eur: What was left in the cash boxes, {resto} euros, arrives {v}.
textos.Lo que se añade si empiezas a pie: What is added if you start on foot
textos.Lo que se blanquea al día en fichas del: What is laundered per day in casino chips
textos.Lo que se compra con tu dinero: What is bought with your money
textos.Lo que se cuenta al elegirla: What is told when you choose it
textos.Lo que se dice al empezar el asalto: What is said when the assault begins
textos.Lo que se dice al empezar una conquista: What is said when a conquest begins
textos.Lo que se dice al empezar una defensa: What is said when a defense begins
textos.Lo que se dice al empezar: hay dos camin: What is said at the start: there are two paths
textos.Lo que se dice al encontrar algo en la g: What is said when you find something in the glove compartment
textos.Lo que se dice al entrar en la habitació: What is said when you enter the room
textos.Lo que se dice al ganar: What is said when you win
textos.Lo que se dice al ganar la pelea: What is said when you win the fight
textos.Lo que se dice al llegar: qué hay, a qué: What is said on arrival: what there is, what it smells like, what you hear.
textos.Lo que se dice al retar a una banda: What is said when you challenge a gang
textos.Lo que se dice cuando alguien se aparta: What is said when someone steps away from the horn
textos.Lo que se dice cuando el atracado lleva: What is said when the person robbed is carrying something extra
textos.Lo que se dice cuando huye una persona: What is said when one person flees
textos.Lo que se dice cuando huyen varias: What is said when several flee
textos.Lo que se dice cuando la oposición sube: What is said when the opposition rises
textos.Lo que se dice cuando llegan: What is said when they arrive
textos.Lo que se dice cuando no cabe: What is said when it doesn't fit
textos.Lo que se dice cuando se va con el pedid: What is said when they leave with the order
textos.Lo que se dice cuando un agente te cache: What is said when an officer pats you down and finds something
textos.Lo que se dice cuando vas con su estilo: What is said when you go in their style
textos.Lo que se dice si no lo llevas: What is said if you do not have it
textos.Lo que se explica al empezar una persecu: What is explained when a vehicle chase begins
textos.Lo que se han dejado en la huida: What they dropped in their escape
textos.Lo que se le dice a cada jugador nada má: What each player is told as soon as they come in.
textos.Lo que se olvida cada día del dinero sin: How much of the unjustified money is forgotten each day, percent
What is heard with the option's help.
textos.Lo que se paga cuando el seguro devuelve: What is paid when insurance returns a vehicle that exploded, repaired: this percent of what the model costs at the car dealership.
textos.Lo que se paga, al ser detenido, por cad: What is paid, when arrested, for each helicopter shot down
textos.Lo que se pierde blanqueando en el casin: What is lost laundering at the casino, percent
textos.Lo que se publica aparte del juego, sin: What is published apart from the game, without waiting for a new version: a language, its voices, corrected documentation, a sound pack or a mod. It is looked for in the same source as the versions, and installed without closing the game. Everything is signed by whoever publishes the game.
textos.Lo que sube al defenderlo: What it rises when defending it
textos.Lo que sube al invertir en él: What it rises when investing in it
textos.Lo que sube al visitarlo, una vez al día: What it rises when visiting it, once a day
textos.Lo que sube con una detención: How much it rises with an arrest
textos.Lo que sube con una multa pagada a un ag: How much it rises with a fine paid to an officer
textos.Lo que sube el negocio con cada empleado: How much the business grows with each employee, percent
textos.Lo que sube el nombre cada vez que lo at: How much the business name rating rises each time you tend it
textos.Lo que sube el rumor por cada punto de d: How much the rumor rises for each crime point witnessed
textos.Lo que sube lo que da, por ciento sobre: How much what it earns rises, percent over the base
textos.Lo que sube o baja el negocio con su nom: How much the business rises or falls with its name rating, percent
textos.Lo que sube, en euros, la recompensa por: How much, in euros, the bounty rises on whoever knocks down someone who was not defending themselves.
textos.Lo que suena al acabar una misión, en el: What plays when you finish a mission, during honest work and when how people see you or how you feel changes.
textos.Lo que suena es la radio del vehículo de: What you hear is the radio of {nombre}'s vehicle. If you don't want to hear other people's radios, turn it off in Options, Sound and music.
textos.Lo que suma cada miembro de tu banda al: What each member of your gang adds when sending them
textos.Lo que suma o resta a la calidad del tur: What it adds to or subtracts from the quality of the shift
textos.Lo que te cuesta una redada, por cada te: What a raid costs you, per territory
textos.Lo que te da este negocio cada medianoch: What this business gives you every midnight, depending on how you collect it. To manage it, go to the business.
What this business gives you every midnight, depending on how you collect it. It can go up or down depending on how you look after it.
