textos.Lo que te darían hoy por todas tus accio: What you would get today for all your shares, and what you gain or lose compared to what you paid for them.
textos.Lo que te dicen al pedir: What they tell you when you ask
textos.Lo que te diga sale de lo que de verdad: What they tell you comes from what is really happening in your game.
textos.Lo que te encargaron. Ganas fama en Cost: What they asked of you. You gain street reputation in Costa Dorada.
textos.Lo que te encargaron. Ganas fama entre l: What they asked of you. You gain street reputation among the locals.
textos.Lo que te fían donde te aprecian, en eur: How much credit you get where they like you, in euros
textos.Lo que te paga una banda por un pacto, p: What a gang pays you for a pact, per territory
textos.Lo que te preparas en casa te da el dobl: What you make at home gives you double the health, burns less and fits more in the fridge.
Whatever you have to do, do it in the daytime.
textos.Lo que tienes en el cuerpo y los segundo: What's in your body and the seconds left on each effect. Some are followed by a comedown.
textos.Lo que tienes guardado en la cocina de e: What you have stored in the kitchen of that home. To cook, eat or store groceries, you have to go there.
textos.Lo que toca por conducir así. Te llevas: That is what you get for driving like that. You keep a share as a bonus.
textos.Lo que trae la barca del martes, y poco: What the Tuesday boat brings, and little else.
textos.Lo que va diciendo el servidor: quién en: What the server keeps saying: who joins and leaves, the notices and the answers to your commands. The newest is at the end.
textos.Lo que vale cada uno. Cada persona de tu: What each one is worth. Every person in your gang has aim, driving, nerves and loyalty, from 0 to 100, different in each game. You see them on the phone, in Territories, Your gang, Your crew. With every heist that goes well they learn and get more loyal to you.
textos.Lo sabes en cuanto lo deciden: banda, ba: You know as soon as they decide: gang, neighborhood, day, time and strength.
textos.Lo saca de tu garaje. Cuando despidas al: Takes it out of your garage. When you dismiss the chauffeur, the vehicle stays with you, on the street.
textos.Lo siento mucho, de verdad. Si pudiera,: I'm really sorry. If I could, I'd give it to you.
textos.Lo siento mucho. Si necesitas hablar, aq: I'm very sorry. If you need to talk, I'm here for a while.
textos.Lo siento, de eso no sé nada. Pregunta a: Sorry, I know nothing about that. Ask around and see if someone tells you.
Sorry, I'm short on cash myself.
textos.Lo sueltas a tu lado y te quedan libres: You drop it beside you and its slots are freed up. If you want it again, stand next to it and press Enter.
I know. I have that gift.
textos.Lo tenemos, Dani. Los sobres, el coche o: We've got it, Dani. The envelopes, the official car, the driver who talks. With this the public works councilman falls.
textos.Lo tengo. Cada viernes un mensajero de L: Got it. Every Friday a Los Calaveras courier leaves the fish market with an envelope for Varela. Today is Friday.
textos.Lo tienes delante. Enciende la sirena co: He is right in front of you. Turn on the siren with P and stay behind him.
You've got it. Take it to {nombre} and get paid.
textos.Lo trae la banda: no tiene que ser tuyo: The gang brings it: it doesn't have to be yours or be nearby. The driver waits for you in it with the engine running.
textos.Lo traen a {nombre} en unos {entero} a {: It's delivered to {nombre} in about {entero} to {entero2} game minutes, more if it rains. When it arrives, the doorbell rings: if you're home, you take it right then. If you're not, the delivery person calls you, waits at the door for a while and leaves.
textos.Lo ves desde la barra: pasa una hora y t: You watch it from the bar: an hour goes by and your mood goes up a little.
textos.Lo último lo contestó {v}, con el modelo: The last answer came from {v}, with the model {modelo}, in {segundos} seconds
textos.Lo último que ha pasado en las empresas,: The latest that has happened at the companies, with the day of each piece of news.
textos.Lo último que se ha dicho en personaje y: The latest things said in character and the actions described, most recent first.
textos.Lo último que se ha dicho fuera de perso: The latest things said out of character on the server, most recent first.
A canvas, ropes and a hanging punching bag.
textos.Los Aljibes empezamos llenando los depós: We Los Aljibes started by filling the grandmothers' tanks. Now we also scare off the ones who come to break them.
textos.Los Calaveras de Puerto Bravo mandan rec: Los Calaveras from Puerto Bravo send their regards. They say you can be dealt with. They propose splitting the coast.
textos.Los Calaveras han pasado por tres tienda: Los Calaveras have been to three shops in the neighborhood asking for money. Yours is next.
textos.Los Calaveras le han robado un cargament: Los Calaveras stole a shipment from La Rusa.
textos.Los Calaveras los guardan para Belmonte: Los Calaveras are keeping them for Belmonte in the abandoned factory in the industrial estate. Get them back and one is yours.
textos.Los Calaveras me han robado una caja. Un: Los Calaveras stole a box from me. An important box. They keep it in their hideout, the old cannery.
textos.Los Calaveras pasan a respetarte: no te: Los Calaveras start to respect you: they won't attack you in the street or touch your neighborhoods. The newspaper loses its story.
textos.Los Calaveras quieren pasar mucho más di: Los Calaveras want to run a lot more money through your register. By day you're still who you are; by night, we'll see.
textos.Los Calaveras sin Belmonte son perro sin: Los Calaveras without Belmonte are a dog without a master. They bite everyone. My customers too.
textos.Los Calaveras van a por la caja del conc: Los Calaveras are going after the councilman's box, and they want you to go in first.
textos.Los Calaveras ya no volverán a atacarte: Los Calaveras will no longer attack you on the harbor streets.
textos.Los Lagartos de San Lucero preguntan por: Los Lagartos from San Lucero are asking about you. They say you're their boss now. Well then, we're family.
Los Lagartos were waiting for you at the door. Get rid of them.
textos.Los Lagartos pasan a respetarte: no te a: Los Lagartos start to respect you: they won't attack you or touch your neighborhoods. And they leave 500 euros as a down payment.
textos.Los Lagartos que quedan en La Marina pid: The Lagartos left in La Marina ask to talk. What do you do?
textos.Los Lagartos se han adueñado del puerto: Los Lagartos have taken over the San Lucero marina.
textos.Los Miradores: chalés en la colina, seto: Los Miradores: villas on the hill, watered hedges and full swimming pools. Up and down the slopes ride the motorcycles of Los Vigías, who see everything.
Los Miradores: villas on the hill, watered hedges and full swimming pools. On the slopes you hardly see the motorcycles of Los Vigías anymore, who used to see everything.
textos.Los Vigías avisan desde arriba, la Peña: Los Vigías signal from above, the Club blocks Calle de las Naves and Los Aljibes wait in the riverbed. You carry the key. Run.
textos.Los agentes vuelven al coche patrulla y: The officers go back to the patrol car and continue their rounds.
textos.Los alquileres están imposibles. Pagas m: Rents are impossible. You pay more for less.
textos.Los antecedentes penales están desactiva: Criminal records are turned off in Options.
The alerts for the neighborhoods that are yours.
textos.Los bancos refuerzan su seguridad tras l: Banks tighten security after the latest robberies.
textos.Los barrios de las bandas: conquistarlos: The gang neighborhoods: conquer them, defend yours, recruit people and make deals. Each neighborhood of yours pays you every midnight.
textos.Los barrios de tu banda dejan %d euros e: Your gang's neighborhoods leave %d euros in the till.
textos.Los barrios los reclama el jefe o su man: Neighborhoods are claimed by the boss or their right hand.
textos.Los barrios que son tuyos, sumando todas: The neighborhoods that are yours, adding up all the cities. Each one pays you every midnight and lets you keep more people in your gang.
textos.Los bidones se compran en las gasolinera: Gas cans are bought at gas stations. You have to be in your vehicle or next to it.
textos.Los billetes van a tu bolsillo. La estam: The bills go into your pocket. The San Telmo holy card watches you from the empty wallet.
textos.Los canales de chat para interpretar a t: The chat channels to play your character and what you hear from the other players.
textos.Los canales de rol son de los servidores: Role channels belong to online servers. When playing with friends, the message goes to everyone: press F10.
textos.Los chinos. Tienes {dinero} euros: Coin guessing game. You have {dinero} euros
textos.Los choques contra paredes y contra otro: Crashes into walls and other vehicles hurt yours less, and you inside. You can hear it: impacts sound drier and lower.
textos.Los coches de la avenida están parados:: The cars on the avenue are stopped: you can cross the avenue, walking east or west.
textos.Los coches de la calle están parados: pu: The cars on the street are stopped: you can cross the street, walking north or south.
textos.Los comerciantes tenemos un turno de pal: We merchants have a speaking slot, and we voted on who speaks. It came out you. Don't make that face: you're the only one who gets listened to the same at the fish market as in La Colina.
textos.Los compañeros te mandan esto. No es muc: Your comrades send you this. It's not much, we're on strike, but it's from the heart. And you always have a home here whenever you want.
I've known them since they were kids. They're nobody.
textos.Los contratos fijos con su nómina y el t: Permanent contracts with their paychecks and how shops treat each player according to their standing.
textos.Los contratos fijos se firman en las ofi: Permanent contracts are signed at the job centers. Without a contract, you work when you want, as always
textos.Los contratos, los combates del gimnasio: Contracts, gym fights, robberies and car jobs that are really completed do not use up the hourly earnings: the server accepts them, up to this number per hour of each kind. With 0 it recognizes none and they all count against the hourly earnings.
textos.Los cruces por los que pasan las vías, e: The junctions the tracks pass through, in order. It is enough to list the junctions where they turn: between one and the next, the tracks run first along the street and then along the avenue. After the last one they go back to the first. Each stop halts at the point on the tracks closest to it. If you leave it empty, the game lays the tracks through the junction nearest each stop.
textos.Los créditos se piden en un banco: Loans are requested at a bank
textos.Los críos bien, creciendo. Comen como li: The kids are good, growing up. They eat like horses.
textos.Los críos de ahora saben mucho de pantal: Kids today know a lot about screens and little about life.
textos.Los críos no levantan la vista de la pan: The kids don't look up from the screen.
textos.Los cuatreros han vuelto a Villaseca, y: The rustlers are back in Villaseca, and this time they're armed.
textos.Los cuatro pasos para oír tu propia músi: The four steps to hear your own music on the vehicle radio, and the option that opens the folder where songs are copied.
textos.Los cuatro pesos se comparan entre sí: e: The four weights are compared with each other: the neighborhood with the most points is the one chosen.
textos.Los cumpleaños, a partir de cierta edad,: Birthdays, past a certain age, are a recount.
textos.Los códigos de invitación, los más nuevo: The invitation codes, newest first: the free ones and those someone has already used. They work when entry to the server is by invitation. Each code is good for creating one character only.
textos.Los datos de tu juego no son exactamente: Your game's data isn't exactly the same as this server's: you can play, but what you have that's different won't be seen by others.
textos.Los datos de tu juego no son los de este: Your game's data is not this server's, which runs version %s: you have mods that change the world, or a version the server cannot check.
textos.Los de arriba no pisan la calle. Por eso: The ones at the top never set foot in the street. That's why they know nothing.
textos.Los de la banda y los guardaespaldas que: The gang members and bodyguards who are at that distance or less when the mission's enemies appear.
The kind used in kitchens and hospitals.
textos.Los de la cooperativa de Villaseca traen: The Villaseca cooperative folks bring the wine themselves, with nobody in between. They ask for you every time they come.
textos.Los de {banda} que quedan en pie se larg: The {banda} members still standing take off: they've had enough for today.
textos.Los de {banda} que quedan salen corriend: The {banda} members still standing run away.
textos.Los de {lugar} han jurado no tratar cont: The people at {lugar} have sworn not to deal with you: {dias} without being able to buy from them.
textos.Los de {lugar} no olvidan: han puesto pr: The people at {lugar} do not forget: they have put a price on teaching you a lesson. Watch your back for the next few hours.
textos.Los de {lugar} seguirán tratando contigo: The people at {lugar} will keep dealing with you, but they will make you pay for it: {dias} with sky-high prices.
textos.Los del barrio son majos. Saludan y todo: The people in the neighborhood are nice. They even say hello.
textos.Los del fondo han mandado a tres con gar: The fund's people sent three men with jerricans of diesel to the sunflower field and the mill. If the harvest burns, we sell for nothing.
textos.Los del mercado podemos organizarnos, si: We at the market can organize, if you give us room. You decide: here your word rules.
textos.Los delitos no cuentan y nadie te persig: Crimes don't count and nobody chases you.
The rest simply won't let you in.
textos.Los disparos dejan de oírse desde lejos:: Gunshots can no longer be heard from far away: people don't flee and nobody calls the police over the noise. Anything you do in plain sight is still seen. You lose it along with the weapon if you get arrested.
textos.Los domingos comemos todos juntos. Es sa: On Sundays we all eat together. It's sacred.
textos.Los dos números a los que se puede casar: The two numbers a tile can be matched to, and how many tiles each player has left.
textos.Los dos primeros pagarán en cuanto te ve: The first two will pay as soon as they see you. The guy at the beach bar has hired bodyguards. Convince them.
textos.Los dueños de las cajas del faro han ven: The owners of the crates at the lighthouse have come for the delivery kid.
textos.Los días de calma, las veces siguientes: The calm days, the following times
textos.Los enemigos de la misión de {nombre} so: The enemies of {nombre}'s mission are yours too: there are {nuevos}. Press Q to lock onto the nearest.
textos.Los enemigos de las misiones aguantan la: Mission enemies take fifty percent more damage. Each active modifier makes you earn experience twenty-five percent faster.
textos.Los escondites están en las ciudades. Ve: The hideouts are in the cities. Go to one.
The fireworks on the last day are the best.
textos.Los garajes vienen con algunas casas. Co: Garages come with some houses. Buy one that has one and you'll be able to keep your vehicles there.
textos.Los gatos del puerto están mejor aliment: The cats at the harbor are better fed than I am.
textos.Los gritos y las quejas de la gente, con: People's shouts and complaints, in male or female voices, are always heard. With yes, the game also says in words who runs off or steps aside and in which direction, at most once every few seconds; if there are several, it says it all at once. With no, they are only heard.
textos.Los guardaespaldas de los tres abren fue: The bodyguards of the three open fire. Leave the tower above them.
textos.Los habladores y los amables, más; los s: The talkative and friendly, more; the dry and shy, less.
textos.Los han avisado. Tenéis unos {segundos}: They've been warned. You have about {segundos} seconds, not one more.
textos.Los han visto subir hacia la ermita con: They've been seen heading up to the chapel in a van. Go up and look. If they're there, make them leave what isn't theirs.
textos.Los impuestos y las facturas están desac: Taxes and bills are turned off.
Just enough. Not many, not few.
textos.Los jóvenes se van fuera. Aquí solo qued: Young people leave. Only the usual folks are left here.
textos.Los libros del prestamista están en la f: The loan shark's books are in the old factory, and it's not empty.
textos.Los lugares de este grupo, en orden alfa: The places in this group, in alphabetical order and with where each one is. On a place, F1 says what it's like.
textos.Los matones de Belmonte quieren volar la: Belmonte's thugs want to blow up the mine and blame the union.
textos.Los mensajes de la partida, del más reci: The game's messages, from newest to oldest.
textos.Los motores se reproducen en bucle y el: Engines play in a loop and the game raises their pitch with speed. Record the engine at idle, at a constant rpm.
textos.Los números premiados de la semana. Intr: This week's winning numbers. Press Enter to read.
textos.Los pantalanes de Playa Dorada, en Puert: The jetties of Playa Dorada, in Puerto Bravo.
textos.Los pasos para poner la versión nueva tú: The steps to put the new version in place yourself, downloading it with the browser and unzipping it over the game folder. Your saved games and options are kept.
Dogs obey me the first time.
textos.Los pescadores de Cala Brava denuncian q: Cala Brava fishermen complain there are more and more old boots in the sea.
textos.Los pescadores de aquí saben más del tie: The fishermen here know more about the weather than the TV does.
textos.Los precios cambian cada día y en cada l: Prices change every day and in every town: buy where it's cheap and sell where it's expensive, or retail on the street, which pays better but is riskier.
textos.Los precios cambian cada día y son disti: Prices change every day and are different in every town
textos.Los precios cambian cada medianoche. Gan: Prices change every midnight. You win if you sell for more than you paid; some companies pay dividends
textos.Los puntos son coordenadas, no cruces: The points are coordinates, not junctions
As many as I look, not one more.
textos.Los que corren por la avenida de noche v: The ones who race down the avenue at night are going to kill somebody.
textos.Los que explotan la mina a escondidas ha: The ones secretly working the mine have come down to town looking for whoever stole their dump truck.
textos.Los que más se oyen y más ayudan a orien: The ones you hear most and that help you get your bearings, in the order it's best to learn them.
Those that come out when you conquer a neighborhood from them. The first is the ordinary gangster and the last, the toughest. With none checked, the game's gangsters.
textos.Los que tengo los he vivido a gusto, que: The ones I have, I've lived happily, which is what matters.
textos.Los que van contigo se dispersan. Siguen: Those who are with you scatter. They stay in your gang and keep getting paid, and they come back when you call them.
textos.Los sanitarios están trabajando y no te: The paramedics are working and won't let you get in.
The paramedics treat you on the spot. Health at maximum.
textos.Los sanitarios te curan donde estás y te: The paramedics treat you where you are and leave your health at maximum. They don't come if there are enemies nearby, and if you are not hurt they don't charge you.
textos.Los sanitarios terminan y la ambulancia: The paramedics finish and the ambulance leaves.
textos.Los segundos que hay que aguantar en la: The seconds you have to hold out at the door to empty the till of another player's business. The owner gets the alert.
textos.Los sonidos de lo que pasa a tu alrededo: The sounds of what happens around you: engines, footsteps, gunshots, doors and hits. A sample plays when you change it. Change it with the left and right arrows.
textos.Los sonidos de los menús, del dinero, de: The sounds of menus, money, messages and missions, and the beacons. A sample plays when you change it. Change it with the left and right arrows.
textos.Los sonidos del pack realista, con ambie: The sounds of the realistic pack, with neighborhood ambiences recorded in stereo. The orientation sounds are the default ones.
textos.Los sonidos están por los mismos grupos: Sounds are in the same groups as in Learn the sounds. Each one is adjusted from 30 to 200 percent of its default volume, and the general volumes for effects, ambience and alerts apply on top. Press Enter to open a group
Events are drawn with these weights. With zero, that one never comes up.
Enough to take you around twice.
textos.Los taxis están en la parada. Te llevan: The taxis are at the stand. They take you wherever you want if you pay.
textos.Los tengo a todos contra la pared. Nadie: I've got them all against the wall. Nobody moves.
textos.Los tesoros que has sacado en toda la pa: The treasures you have found in the whole game, at all the search spots.
textos.Los trabajos con vehículo se empiezan to: Vehicle jobs all start the same way: get in the right vehicle and press J. A taxi to carry customers, an ambulance, a bus, a truck, an ice cream van.
textos.Los tres del banco trabajan para ti, aun: The three on the bench work for you, though they don't know it yet. The town hall, the countryside and the market. It just needs organizing.
textos.Los tres negocios en los que te metiste: The three businesses you got involved with want to sit down at one table. And there's only one chair at the head.
textos.Los turistas dejan dinero y basura, a pa: Tourists leave money and trash, in equal parts.
textos.Los turistas vienen por los ciervos, hij: Tourists come for the deer, kid. Without deer there's no spa.
textos.Los tuyos que estén cerca y los de la ba: Your people who are nearby and the gang's
textos.Los títulos que tienes y los que estás s: The degrees you have and the ones you are working toward. They are studied at the academies, one session a day, and open better positions and upgrades for your businesses.
textos.Los títulos que ya tienes son tuyos para: The degrees you already have are yours forever. The ones you're working on are completed session by session, one a day.
textos.Los vecinos cocinan para los vecinos. Si: Neighbors cook for neighbors. Water and hands are always needed.
textos.Los vecinos de {barrio} han visto movimi: The neighbors of {barrio} have seen strange movement: something is brewing there for {cuando}.
textos.Los vecinos salen con garrafas, cubos y: Neighbors come out with jugs, buckets and even a child's bathtub. Nobody asks where the water comes from.
textos.Los vecinos se ayudan. Eso no ha cambiad: The neighbors help each other. That hasn't changed.
The neighbors think better of you.
textos.Los vecinos, agradecidos, hacen una cole: The grateful neighbors take up a collection for you.
textos.Los vehículos del jugador no desaparecen: The player's vehicles never disappear. Past this number, the oldest goes by itself to a garage with space; if there is no space, the game warns you.
textos.Los viernes, una copa. Solo una. Bueno,: On Fridays, one drink. Just one. Okay, two.
textos.Los vuelos comerciales necesitan el vuel: Commercial flights need real flight, which you have turned off in Options, Movement and driving.
textos.Los últimos Lagartos no aceptan que el p: The last of Los Lagartos won't accept that the harbor is no longer theirs.
textos.Los últimos avisos, asaltos y resultados: The latest warnings, attacks and results, in case you missed any.
textos.Los últimos matones del concejal te espe: The councilman's last thugs were waiting for you at the door. Get rid of them.
textos.Los últimos mensajes del servidor, del m: The latest messages on the server, from newest to oldest.
textos.Lotería La Bruja de Bravo: La Bruja de Bravo Lottery Shop
textos.Lotería La Gota de Oro: La Gota de Oro Lottery Shop
textos.Lotería La Veta de Oro: La Veta de Oro Lottery Shop
textos.Lotería: el premio más alto que paga una: Lottery: the highest prize a shop or bar pays
textos.Lotería: lo que sube el bote cada día qu: Lottery: how much the jackpot grows each day nobody hits it
textos.Lotería: premio por la última cifra, el: Lottery: prize for the last digit, the refund
textos.Lotería: premio por las cuatro últimas c: Lottery: prize for the last four digits
textos.Lotería: premio por las dos últimas cifr: Lottery: prize for the last two digits
textos.Lotería: premio por las tres últimas cif: Lottery: prize for the last three digits
textos.Lucero Tecnología presenta un invento qu: Lucero Technology presents an invention that everybody wants.
textos.Lucero Tecnología retrasa su producto es: Lucero Technology delays its flagship product.
textos.Luces bajas y música fuerte. Aquí te ati: Low lights and loud music. You're served here.
textos.Lucía aparece ahora en Vida social, en e: Lucía now appears in Social life, on the phone. There are five other people around the region: introduce yourself when you're at their usual spot.
textos.Lugar sin sonido propio: Place with no sound of its own
textos.Lugares incluidos en el propio mapa: Places included in the map itself
textos.Luz y agua de cada vivienda, en euros: Electricity and water for each home, in euros
textos.Límite de velocidad, en kilómetros por h: Speed limit, in kilometers per hour
textos.Límpiame la calle. Luego llevas tú las p: Clean up the street for me. Then you take the plates to the old bottling plant, which is where we've printed since they raised our rent.
textos.Línea %d: no existe la opción %s. No se: Line %d: there is no option %s. Ignored; it may be from another version of the server.
textos.Línea %d: no la entiendo, le falta el si: Line %d: I do not understand it, it is missing the equals sign. Ignored.
Old wood and barrels. You order here.
Getting up early isn't of this world.
textos.Manda al servidor la orden escrita. Es l: Sends the typed command to the server. It's the same as pressing Enter in the field.
textos.Mandar tu aeronave a uno de tus hangares: Send your aircraft to one of your hangars
textos.Mandar tu vehículo a uno de tus garajes: Send your vehicle to one of your garages
textos.Mandar tu vehículo a uno de tus garajes:: Send your vehicle to one of your garages: {precio} euros
textos.Mandarla a un hangar: {precio} euros: Send it to a hangar: {precio} euros
textos.Mandarlo a un garaje: {precio} euros: Send it to a garage: {precio} euros
textos.Mandas recado a {banda}: que vengan a {b: You send word to {banda}: come to {barrio} if they dare. And they dare.
textos.Mando conectado: {nombre}. En cualquier: Gamepad connected: {nombre}. At any time, help tells you what each button does.
textos.Mando desconectado. Puedes seguir con el: Gamepad disconnected. You can continue with the keyboard.
textos.Mandos de Xbox y PlayStation: ver qué ha: Xbox and PlayStation controllers: see what each button does, reassign them and turn on vibration.
textos.Mangueras fuera. Aguanta junto al fuego: Hoses out. Hold your position by the fire for a few seconds.
textos.Mantel de hilo y precios de mirador. El: Linen tablecloths and viewpoint prices. The water comes in a glass bottle.
textos.Mantenimiento en el hangar: cada décima: Hangar maintenance: each tenth of the damage
textos.Mapa del aire: dónde está cada localidad: Air map: where each town is
textos.Mapa del aire: dónde está una localidad: Air map: where a town is
textos.Maquetas de barcos, un esqueleto de ball: Ship models, a whale skeleton and the story of the pirate One-Eye, who hid his treasure on Isla Tortuga.
textos.Mar adentro puedes pescar con la P, hace: Out at sea you can fish with P, do courier runs with J, race the regatta from the buoy and dive the wreck for treasure.
textos.Mar adentro, donde pasan los atunes rojo: Out at sea, where the bluefin tuna pass. Press P to fish.
Marker added to the session log.
textos.Marca conocida en toda la comarca: A brand known throughout the region
textos.Marca el barrio en el GPS. La defensa em: Set the neighborhood on the GPS. The defense starts when you enter it: they come in waves, each tougher than the last, and your gang comes along at your side. While you fight, the deadline doesn't run. If you leave the neighborhood or go down, the attack continues and you can try again or send your crew.
textos.Marca los mods que quieres que cargue el: Check the mods you want the game to load. Unchecked ones are kept, but the game does not read them.
Checks all items in the list.
Mark a destination with the L key.
textos.Marcado: {v}, en {nombre}. Con pasar por: Set: {v}, in {nombre}. Just passing by counts as a visit.
textos.Marcar en el GPS el camino hasta su loca: Mark the route to its town on the GPS
textos.Marcar en el GPS el campo donde está: Mark on the GPS the airfield where it is
textos.Marcar en el GPS la casa donde está: Mark on the GPS the house where it is
textos.Marcarlo en el GPS para visitarlo: Set it on the GPS to visit it
textos.Marineros, dados y un tablón de encargos: Sailors, dice and a job board that is better not read aloud.
textos.Marta ha localizado al mensajero que lle: Marta has tracked down the courier who carries Belmonte's payments.
textos.Marta tiene un plan para desenmascarar a: Marta has a plan to expose Chief Varela.
textos.Masa fina, horno de leña y reparto en mo: Thin crust, wood-fired oven and motorcycle delivery. They're looking for a delivery rider.
textos.Material de laboratorio para una tanda,: Lab supplies for one batch, adult content
textos.Material de laboratorio, una tanda: {pre: Lab supplies, one batch: {precio} euros. You have {material}
textos.Material para una tanda. Tienes para {ma: Supplies for one batch. You have enough for {material}.
Enrollment forms and schedules. You sign up here.
textos.Mayúsculas izquierda con las flechas: Left Shift with the arrow keys
textos.Mañana esto es chatarra y aquí no ha pas: Tomorrow this is scrap metal and nothing ever happened here.
textos.Mañana nos la cortan otra vez. Pero ya h: Tomorrow they'll cut it off again. But now they've seen it can be done.
textos.Mañana sale el nombre. Esta noche están: Tomorrow the name comes out. Tonight they're burning papers at the Aguas headquarters. I need to know how many boxes they carry out and where they take them.
textos.Mañana sale lo del casino. Los repartido: Tomorrow the casino story comes out. The delivery guys don't dare, so I'm left with one person I trust: you.
textos.Mañana se paga la nómina entera, por pri: Tomorrow the full payroll gets paid, for the first time since summer. You won't be forgotten here.
textos.Mañana vuelve a su pared, y nadie sabrá: Tomorrow it's back on its wall, and nobody will know it was gone. You and I will.
I'm glad you're out. Keep your spirits up.
I'm glad you find it funny.
textos.Me alegro, hombre. Ya era hora de oír al: I'm glad, man. About time I heard something good.
textos.Me apunté al gimnasio en enero. Fui dos: I signed up for the gym in January. I went two days. I've been paying ever since because I'm too embarrassed to go cancel.
Tells me their life story for a while.
textos.Me cuentan que de noche entran cisternas: I'm told tankers enter the La Gota bottling plant at night, and they appear in no record.
textos.Me da miedo... prefiero no hablar de eso: It scares me... I'd rather not talk about that.
textos.Me duele todo, pero el médico dice que e: Everything hurts, but the doctor says I'm healthy as an ox.
textos.Me encanta el cine. Si echan algo bueno,: I love the movies. If something good is playing, let me know.
textos.Me encanta el mercado. Te encuentras a t: I love the market. You run into everybody.
textos.Me encanta. Con música todo se lleva mej: I love it. Everything's easier with music.
textos.Me encantan los animales. Si puedes, ado: I love animals. If you can, adopt one.
textos.Me espera cada noche en la puerta de atr: He waits for me every night at the back door. I've told him no in every way possible. Today he came with two friends.
textos.Me están hundiendo. Sale de aquí un cami: They're ruining me. A truck leaves here with jug wine and my label. It loads at the chapel, at night.
I like the way you look at me. Keep talking.
textos.Me gusta de todo, menos lo que pone mi v: I like everything, except what my neighbor plays.
textos.Me gusta ir a mirar los barcos... es tra: I like going to watch the boats... it's peaceful.
textos.Me gusta leer, pero me quedo dormid{o} e: I like reading, but I fall asleep on the second page.
textos.Me gusta lo que hago. No todo el mundo p: I like what I do. Not everyone can say that.
textos.Me gusta mucho. Ser {oficio} es muy agra: I like it a lot. Being a {oficio} is very rewarding.
textos.Me gusta. Mira, podría hacerte desaparec: I like it. Look, I could make you disappear, but talent is scarce. Work for me and we forget about the courier.
I like... potato omelette. My mother's.
textos.Me gustaba estudiar... era lo único que: I liked studying... it was the only thing I was good at.
textos.Me gustaría viajar. No he salido de la c: I'd like to travel. I've never left the county.
textos.Me gustaría... no sé, que no me diera ve: I'd like... I don't know, to not feel embarrassed about everything.
textos.Me ha dado el nombre de quien firma los: He gave me the name of whoever signs the orders. Between you and me, we're going to dry up their business.
textos.Me ha llamado Ramiro. Dice que has estad: Ramiro called me. He says you were very convincing. But watch out: Los Calaveras don't forget. You'll need something better than a bat.
textos.Me han cortado el suministro. Dicen que: They've cut off my supply. They say I owe bills I already paid.
textos.Me han dicho que quieres algo tuyo. Bien: They tell me you want something of your own. Good. A business isn't buying a place and sitting back to collect. You have to be there: the customer wants to see the owner.
They broke a window and half my dishes. And two neighbors came out to help you without anyone asking.
textos.Me has dejado cuatro hombres sin trabaja: You've left me four men out of work for a week. Sit down. Around here they call me La Fundi.
textos.Me he tenido que dar una vuelta: había u: I had to take a turn around the block: there was a patrol. Be right there.
textos.Me hubiera gustado estudiar más, pero ha: I would have liked to study more, but I had to work.
textos.Me llamo Dani Roca. He salido esta mañan: My name is Dani Roca. I got out this morning and I can't even afford a coffee.
textos.Me llamo {yo}. Perdona, no me había pres: My name is {yo}. Sorry, I hadn't introduced myself.
textos.Me llamo {yo}. Qué bien que preguntes, l: My name is {yo}. It's nice that you ask, people don't even introduce themselves anymore.
textos.Me metí en un grupo de vecinos por el mó: I joined a neighbors' group on my phone and now I find out things I'd rather not know. The lady on the second floor waters her plants at three in the morning.
textos.Me pongo con ella. Dame {segundos} segun: I'm on it. Give me {segundos} seconds.
textos.Me quedo sin sal en una isla de salinas,: I run out of salt on an island of salt flats, how funny. Bring me a sack from the salt flats and water from the cistern.
Your face looks familiar, but I can't place it.
I have to go. See you.
textos.Me tiemblan las manos. Salimos, pero nos: My hands are shaking. We're out, but they saw us leave.
I'm going back to the others.
textos.Media hora de charla: te cuenta cosas su: Half an hour of chat: they tell you about themselves and gain a little loyalty. Once a day.
Half an hour of your time.
textos.Medio enemigo por cada uno quiere decir: Half an enemy for each one means one more for every two.
textos.Medio metro de hierro para abrir bocas d: Half a meter of iron for opening hydrants. It opens other things too.
textos.Medio pueblo quiere vender y medio no. T: Half the town wants to sell and half doesn't. You're an outsider and you stood up for us. What you say carries weight.
Better now that I see you, {tu}.
textos.Mejor que ayer, que ayer tuve un día que: Better than yesterday, because yesterday I had a day, you wouldn't believe it.
textos.Mejor sol{o} que mal acompañad{o}, que d: Better alone than in bad company, as my mother used to say.
textos.Mejoran solas con la práctica. F1 explic: They improve by themselves with practice. F1 explains each one
textos.Mejorar: {nombre}, por {hon_mejora_coste: Upgrade: {nombre}, for {hon_mejora_coste} euros. It raises what it earns by {int} percent over the base and takes one more employee
textos.Mejoras: el negocio ya está en su nivel: Upgrades: the business is already at its highest level
textos.Memoria de sonidos. Cada flecha tiene su: Sound memory. Each arrow has its own note: up is the highest, down is the lowest, right and left sound on their own side. Listen to the sequence and repeat it. Each round adds a note. Press an arrow to try them out, and we begin.
textos.Mendoza ha conseguido la otra mitad del: Mendoza has gotten the other half of the treasure map.
textos.Mendoza necesita llevar medicinas a Isla: Mendoza needs to take medicine to Isla Tortuga in a storm.
textos.Mendoza te cuenta las monedas una a una,: Mendoza counts the coins out to you one by one, laughing.
textos.Mensaje al móvil de tu mejor informante:: Phone message from your best informant: {banda} will attack {barrio}, {cuando}, around {hora}. Strength, about {fuerza} out of 100. {motivo}
textos.Mensaje del &día, el aviso que oye cada: Message of the &day, the notice each player hears on joining. Empty, none:
Message of the day changed and saved.
textos.Mensaje del día cambiado, hasta que el s: Message of the day changed, until the server restarts. To make it permanent, put it in the configuration.
textos.Mensaje fuera de personaje, para todo el: Out-of-character message, for the whole server
textos.Mensaje para quien esté a menos de ochen: Message for anyone within eighty meters
textos.Mensajería del mar: lleva el paquete a {: Sea courier: take the package to {nombre}.
What a character. I'll leave you to it.
textos.Menú del día, dos platos y postre: Set menu, two courses and dessert
textos.Mercancía que te llevas, como poco: Product you take away, at least
textos.Mesas con mantel de papel. Huele a fritu: Tables with paper tablecloths. It smells of frying.
Small tables and a TV on.
textos.Meteorología: una tormenta en tu rumbo,: Weather: a storm on your course, {km} kilometers away. Your call.
textos.Meter en el garaje {nombre}, que has dej: Put {nombre} in the garage, which you left {int} meters away
textos.Meterte en medio y calmarlos: Step in between and calm them down
textos.Metes el sobre por debajo de la puerta d: You slip the envelope under the soup kitchen door and keep walking.
textos.Metes la llave de bronce en la válvula g: You put the bronze key in the main valve and push with your whole body. It turns.
textos.Metros a los que afloja del todo: Meters at which it eases off completely
textos.Metros a los que alejarse de un aviso ya: Meters of moving away from a warning already started that make it count as lost
textos.Metros a los que cuenta que estás en cas: Meters at which you count as being at home
textos.Metros a los que cuenta que uno de los t: Distance in meters within which one of your crew counts as being with you
textos.Metros a los que cuenta uno de los tuyos: Meters at which one of yours counts
textos.Metros a los que empieza a aflojar: Meters at which it starts to ease off
textos.Metros a los que llega lo dicho en perso: Meters what is said in character reaches
textos.Metros a los que queda el aparato al des: Distance in meters at which the aircraft ends up on takeoff
textos.Metros a los que se le pierde de vista: Meters at which you lose sight of them
textos.Metros a los que se le pierde de vista,: Meters at which you lose sight of them, with help
textos.Metros a los que se sigue a los demás al: Meters within which others are followed in detail
textos.Metros a los que tienes que estar si cub: Distance in meters you must be within if you cover whoever opens it
textos.Metros a los que tienes que estar si la: Distance in meters you must be within if you open it yourself
textos.Metros a los que vale un vehículo tuyo p: Distance in meters within which one of your vehicles works for the getaway
textos.Metros alrededor de un campo que cuentan: Meters around an airfield that count as runway
textos.Metros alrededor de un sospechoso en los: Meters around a suspect within which using force is not a crime
textos.Metros alrededor del sitio donde vale po: Meters around the spot where setting down is valid
textos.Metros de altitud de crucero por cada ki: Meters of cruising altitude for each kilometer of trip, at most
textos.Metros de altitud que cambia por segundo: Meters of altitude changed per second
textos.Metros desde la esquina oeste o sur de l: Meters from the west or south corner of the block, from 0 to 72.
textos.Metros desde los que se avisa: Meters from which a warning is given
textos.Metros desde los que se vuela alto: Meters from which you are flying high
textos.Metros por encima de los que no afecta: Meters above which it has no effect
textos.Metros por segundo que baja al aterrizar: Meters per second it descends on landing
textos.Metros por segundo que cae sin motor: Meters per second it falls without an engine
textos.Metros que da un depósito lleno a veloci: Meters a full tank gives at cruising speed
textos.Metros que sube o baja cada pulsación: Meters climbed or descended with each press
textos.Mi abuela decía que la familia es lo úni: My grandmother used to say family is the only thing you don't choose. And she was right.
textos.Mi abuela echaba las cartas. Acertaba lo: My grandmother read cards. She got the bad stuff right.
textos.Mi abuelo cortejó a mi abuela cuatro año: My grandfather courted my grandmother for four years. Now people break up in four days.
textos.Mi abuelo salía a pescar a las cuatro de: My grandfather went out fishing at four in the morning. That was real work.
textos.Mi abuelo tenía una escopeta de caza col: My grandfather had a hunting shotgun hanging in the living room. He never fired it. He said it was to scare off the debt collectors.
textos.Mi caja. Bien. ¿Sabes una cosa? Los Cala: My box. Good. You know what? Los Calaveras don't have the money for these weapons. Someone is paying for them. Someone with their own tower.
textos.Mi cartera... Vacía. Bueno. Qué se le va: My wallet... Empty. Well. What can you do. At least my ID.
My landlord won't even fix a light bulb.
textos.Mi coche hace un ruido raro desde hace u: My car has made a weird noise for a year. The mechanic says it's the clutch, my brother-in-law says it's the belt, and I think it's just fed up with me.
textos.Mi coche lo conoce todo el barrio por el: The whole neighborhood knows my car by its noise.
textos.Mi consejo: come bien, duerme bien y no: My advice: eat well, sleep well and don't owe money.
My brother-in-law has been looking for a year and nothing.
textos.Mi cuñado perdió el coche en una partida: My brother-in-law lost his car in a card game. Now he takes the bus and says hello to everyone.
textos.Mi deporte es subir la cuesta de casa co: My sport is climbing the hill to my house with the groceries.
My cat runs the house. I just pay.
textos.Mi hermano limpia el despacho del direct: My brother cleans the prison warden's office. He says there's a file with your name and a handwritten note from Chief Varela: fabricate evidence, at Mr. Belmonte's request.
textos.Mi hijo estudia fuera. Sale más caro que: My son studies away from home. It costs more than a boat.
textos.Mi hijo saca mejores notas que las que s: My son gets better grades than I did in my entire life.
textos.Mi jefe es un santo. Un santo de los que: My boss is a saint. The kind of saint who doesn't perform miracles.
textos.Mi madre decía: antes de hablar, cuenta: My mother used to say: before you speak, count to ten. I've never gotten past three, and look how that's going.
textos.Mi madre hace unas croquetas que resucit: My mother makes croquettes that could raise the dead.
My mother prays for the both of us.
textos.Mi madre sigue viviendo en la casa de si: My mother still lives in the same house. Nobody can get her out.
textos.Mi madre, con ochenta y tantos, sale tod: My mother, in her eighties, goes out every day for bread and comes back with all the neighborhood news.
textos.Mi música: cómo poner tus canciones en l: My music: how to put your songs on the radio, step by step
My music: how to put your songs on the radio. There are four steps: go through them with the arrow keys
textos.Mi música: poner tus canciones en la rad: My music: put your songs on the radio
textos.Mi música: todavía no hay canciones. Est: My music: there are no songs yet. This station plays yours. To add them, press Escape and choose My music: the steps are there, along with the option Open my music folder, which opens the folder where they are copied. It is also in Options, Sound and music. mp3, ogg, flac and wav files work.
textos.Mi nieto me enseñó a mandar fotos. Ahora: My grandson taught me to send photos. Now I send them all crooked.
textos.Mi padre era pescador. De él aprendí lo: My father was a fisherman. From him I learned the little I know.
textos.Mi padre mandaba en {barrio}. Algo se he: My father ran {barrio}. Some things are inherited.
textos.Mi padre trabajó para él. No habla de aq: My father worked for him. He doesn't talk about that.
textos.Mi pareja trabaja en el mercado. Nos vem: My partner works at the market. We see each other at dinnertime.
My dog is like me: nobody messes with him.
My dog is my best company.
textos.Mi perro se llama Capitán y ladra a todo: My dog is named Captain and he barks at everyone except burglars. They broke in once and he wagged his tail at them. He all but carried the stuff out for them.
textos.Mi piso tiene cuarenta metros y vivimos: My apartment is forty square meters and four of us live in it. To use the bathroom you have to take a number, like at the butcher's.
textos.Mi primo es municipal. Buen chaval, pero: My cousin is a city cop. Good kid, but don't tell him anything.
textos.Mi primo estuvo dentro. Salió y ahora ti: My cousin did time. He got out and now he runs a fruit stand.
textos.Mi sobrino estuvo dos años parado y al f: My nephew was unemployed for two years and ended up as a delivery guy. Now he never stops, poor thing. He says he misses being bored.
textos.Mi tía vio una luz en el mar una noche y: My aunt saw a light at sea one night and didn't sleep for a month. Then it turned out to be her neighbor's fishing boat.
textos.Mi tío tocaba el acordeón en las verbena: My uncle played the accordion at street parties, and I followed behind passing the hat. That's how I paid for my first bicycle. Well, half a bicycle.
textos.Mi vecina guarda el agua de fregar para: My neighbor saves the dishwater for the toilet tank and the tank water for the plants. How the plants are still alive, I don't know.
textos.Mientras duermes, los vehículos guardado: While you sleep, the vehicles stored in this garage get repaired.
textos.Mientras dura, lo que hacéis juntos acer: While it lasts, what you do together brings you half as close, and if it happens again, it breaks.
textos.Mientras dure el veto, compra a otro pro: While the ban lasts, buy from another supplier. When it's over, they sell to you again.
textos.Mientras el servidor volvía, otro jugado: While the server was coming back, another player took the vehicle you were in: you're left on foot.
textos.Mientras haya salud, lo demás se arregla: As long as there's health, everything else works out.
textos.Mientras huye, cada pocos segundos puede: While fleeing, every few seconds they may scream again, so it isn't just a single scream. At zero, only the scream when they get scared is heard.
textos.Mientras le pagues, lo que se sepa de tu: As long as you pay them, what is known about your other life does half the damage, holds back the press and can appeal the penalties from an inspection. It renews by itself every week; Enter again dismisses them.
textos.Mientras no estabas, tu gente ha aguanta: While you were away, your crew held out in {nombre}, but can't take any more: you have {_rato} left to defend it or send reinforcements.
textos.Mientras no estabas, {get} se llevó tu {: While you were away, {get} took your {get2} from where you left it.
textos.Mientras no esté a tu lado no puedes aca: While it is not by your side you can't pet it, feed it or send it to search.
As long as there's no storm, everything's fine.
textos.Mientras no sea dinero ni mudanzas, lo q: As long as it's not money or moving, whatever you want.
textos.Mientras nosotros vamos allí, en la otra: While we go there, at the other end of the city a warehouse is being robbed. It's no coincidence.
textos.Mientras se maten entre ellos, a mí que: As long as they kill each other, leave me alone.
textos.Mientras tapen los baches, me da igual q: As long as they fill the potholes, I don't care who's in charge.
textos.Mientras te desconectabas en plena pelea: While you were disconnecting in the middle of a fight, {get} took you down. You lost {n} euros.
textos.Mientras te recuerda, no te atienden. Lo: While they remember you, they won't serve you. What is in each till and who keeps it is in the Venue tills section.
textos.Mientras tengas antecedentes vivos, esto: While you have an active criminal record, this is out of your reach. When it expires or you appeal it, it opens up again.
textos.Mientras trabajas no: termina el servici: Not while you're working: finish the job first.
textos.Mientras trabajas, la tecla O te dice qu: While you work, the O key tells you what to do next, and the GPS guides you. To quit the job, press J again.
textos.Mientras unos tienen tres casas, otros n: While some have three houses, others don't even have one.
textos.Mil quinientos euros. A cambio, tus lice: One thousand five hundred euros. In exchange, your licenses will always come through the first time: forty euros more each night.
textos.Minutos antes de una quedada en que se a: Minutes before a meet-up at which a warning is given
textos.Minutos de verdad entre declarar una gue: Real minutes between declaring a war and its start.
textos.Minutos del juego entre dos situaciones: Game minutes between two street situations, at least
textos.Minutos del juego que espera el repartid: Game minutes the delivery person waits if you are not there
textos.Minutos del juego que te retiene: Game minutes it holds you up
textos.Minutos que espera antes y después de la: Minutes they wait before and after the time
textos.Minutos que se espera como mucho a que v: Maximum minutes to wait for the server to come back
textos.Minutos sin moverse ni hacer nada tras l: Minutes without moving or doing anything after which a player is kicked to make room. With 0, never. Admins are not kicked.
textos.Mira el precinto: es de fábrica y lleva: Look at the seal: it's factory-made and carries the company's stamp. If it reads high, it came that way from home.
textos.Mira en la fuente elegida si hay una ver: Checks the chosen source for a newer version. If there is one, it offers to read what's new and install it; if not, it tells you that you have the latest. You need a connection.
textos.Mira por el retrovisor y pisa a fondo. P: He looks in the rearview mirror and floors it. Chase: you have to stop him by force.
Look at you. We'll talk later.
textos.Mira qué bien, alguien con cara de pocos: Well, look at that, someone with a sour face. My name is Remedios and I've been selling spices in this market for forty years.
Look at these arms. They don't build themselves.
Well, look at that, Dani. Now that it wasn't needed.
textos.Mira varias decisiones a la vez, aunque: Checks several decisions at once, even from different stories. Write each as the decision's name, a colon and an option number, separated by commas. For example: concejal:1, trono:3. With nothing else, all are needed.
Look, I don't know anything about that.
textos.Mira, por la mañana el mercado, a mediod: Look, in the morning the market, at noon a rice dish at the harbor, in the afternoon a nap, which is sacred, and at night whatever comes up. That's my perfect plan and I wouldn't change it.
textos.Mis abuelos eran del interior, pero yo s: My grandparents were from inland, but I'm a sea person.
textos.Mis compañeros de Puerto Bravo me han co: My colleagues in Puerto Bravo told me about the councilman. Two case files and in both you appear, on the same side. It's no coincidence.
textos.Mis listas sustituyen a las del juego: My lists replace the game's lists
textos.Mis profesores fueron muy buenos conmigo: My teachers were very good to me.
textos.Mis vehículos: {len} en la calle del ser: My vehicles: {len} on the server's street and {mis_en_garajes} in garages
textos.Mis vehículos: {mis_en_calle} en la call: My vehicles: {mis_en_calle} on the street, out of {tope}, and {mis_en_garajes} in garages
textos.Misiones completadas: {len}. Dinero: {di: Missions completed: {len}. Money: {dinero} euros in hand and {banco} in the bank
textos.Misiones que hay que completar antes: Missions that must be completed first
textos.Misión abandonada. Puedes volver a inten: Mission abandoned. You can try it again whenever you want from the same place.
textos.Misión completada con {get}: {get2}. Tu: Mission completed with {get}: {get2}. Your share: {n} euros.
textos.Misión completada: %s. Ya cobraste por a: Mission complete: %s. You already got paid for helping with it.
textos.Misión necesaria para que abra: Mission needed for it to open
textos.Mitad para nosotros, mitad para ti. Y la: Half for us, half for you. And my word: nobody touches you.
textos.Mitad para ti, mitad para mí. Así da gus: Half for you, half for me. That's how I like to work.
textos.Mochila: {carga} de 100 unidades. En la: Backpack: {carga} of 100 units. On the street, {reputacion_txt}
textos.Modelo instalado y modo IA activado. El: Model installed and AI mode turned on. The model is loading: in a few seconds you can use Test now, in the previous menu.
textos.Modelo local quitado. Se ha borrado la c: Local model removed. The folder data, local AI has been deleted.
textos.Modelo local: hay un programa de modelos: Local model: there is a model program open on this computer and the game will use it
textos.Modelo local: sin instalar. Intro para d: Local model: not installed. Enter to download it
textos.Moderado: hasta un {get} por ciento más: Moderate: up to {get} percent more enemies. Strong: up to {get2}
textos.Modo IA al hablar con la gente: {v}: AI mode when talking to people: {v}
textos.Modo pasivo activado: no puedes herir a: Passive mode on: you can't hurt other players and they can't hurt you.
textos.Modo pasivo quitado: vuelves a estar exp: Passive mode off: you're exposed again.
textos.Modo: guerra de barrios en la calle: Mode: neighborhood wars on the street
textos.Modo: poder trabajar de policía: Mode: be able to work as a police officer
textos.Molino, girasoles, la era y la fuente. P: Mill, sunflowers, the threshing floor and the spring. A little over three minutes, because the bread won't wait.
textos.Montar un laboratorio clandestino aquí:: Set up a clandestine lab here: {precio} euros
textos.Montar un laboratorio clandestino en una: Set up a clandestine lab in a house, adult content
textos.Montas un laboratorio en el cuarto del f: You set up a lab in the back room. To work in it you need supplies: any supplier sells them.
textos.Montañas de chatarra y una prensa que no: Mountains of scrap and a press that never rests. They buy any vehicle without asking where it comes from.
textos.Monteferro celebra el fin de la huelga m: Monteferro celebrates the end of the miners' strike with a street party in the square.
textos.Monteferro, la ciudad minera de la sierr: Monteferro, the mining city of the mountains. La Fundición is its working-class neighborhood: chimneys, soot and shift-change sirens.
textos.Monumento o sitio de interés, solo descr: Monument or place of interest, description only
textos.Moqueta gruesa, recepcionista discreto y: Thick carpet, a discreet receptionist and breakfast until noon.
textos.Moral que gana la banda que te quita un: Morale gained by the gang that takes a neighborhood from you
textos.Moral que pierde la banda rechazada: Morale lost by the rejected gang
textos.Motor: más velocidad punta y aceleración: Engine: more top speed and acceleration, and it sounds higher-pitched
textos.Motores fueraborda y un velero pequeño e: Outboard motors and a small sailboat on dry land.
textos.Motos, quads y vehículos de trabajo, nue: Motorcycles, quads and work vehicles, new and used.
textos.Mucha suerte si juegas. Pero con cabeza,: Good luck if you gamble. But use your head, okay?
textos.Mudaros a otra casa tuya: Move to another home of yours
textos.Muelle de la Isla de los Vientos, desde: Isla de los Vientos Pier, from the sea
textos.Muelles del Cobre: grúas oxidadas, monta: Muelles del Cobre: rusty cranes, mountains of scrap and the smell of diesel. The Copper Club rules here, buying and selling anything that weighs.
Muelles del Cobre: rusty cranes, mountains of scrap and the smell of diesel. The Copper Club ruled here, buying and selling anything that weighed.
textos.Muelles, grúas y almacenes que huelen a: Docks, cranes and warehouses that smell of salt air and diesel.
textos.Muestra la información completa del elem: Shows the full information of the selected item.
textos.Muestra una vista previa antes de aplica: Shows a preview before applying the changes.
Moves the item down one place.
textos.Mueve el elemento un puesto hacia arriba: Moves the item up one place.
textos.Multa en el acto, por cada nivel de búsq: On-the-spot fine, per wanted level; one twentieth of what you carry is added
textos.Multa o soborno cuando te cogen por poco: Fine or bribe when you get caught for something minor
textos.Multa por cada unidad de mercancía requi: Fine for each unit of product seized, adult content
textos.Multa por saltarse un semáforo: Fine for running a red light
textos.Multa por {motivo}: {importe} euros y {i: Fine for {motivo}: {importe} euros and {int} license points.
textos.Munición de {nombre}: ya no llevas esa a: {nombre} ammo: you no longer carry that weapon, so it is no use to you.
textos.Munición para {nombre}, {balas} {unidad}: Ammo for {nombre}, {balas} {unidad}: {int} euros. You have {reserva} in reserve
textos.Munición para {nombre}, {get} balas: {in: Ammo for {nombre}, {get} rounds: {int} euros. You have {reserva} in reserve
textos.Munición que sueltan, como poco: tanto p: Ammunition they drop, at least: percent of a magazine
textos.Muros de hormigón, alambre de espino y t: Concrete walls, barbed wire and watchtowers. You spent three years in here.
textos.Muy bien todos, gracias. Mi madre te cae: All very well, thanks. You'd like my mother.
textos.Muy bien, gracias por preguntar. Da gust: Very well, thanks for asking. It's nice when somebody asks.
textos.Muy bien. Has usado el GPS. Ahora, el ra: Very good. You've used the GPS. Now, the radar and the scanner.
textos.Máquina de memoria: premio por aguantar: Memory machine: prize for lasting five rounds
Memory machine: prize for lasting twelve rounds
Memory machine: prize for lasting eight rounds
Huge machines and the smell of ink.
textos.Máquinas recreativas, una caseta de tiro: Arcade machines, a shooting booth and the hardest sound memory machine in the region.
Mark it on a single type.
textos.Mármol, aire acondicionado y una fuente: Marble, air conditioning and a fountain in the lobby.
textos.Más abajo están la página del proyecto,: Further down are the project page, where to report a bug and the author's Mastodon profile.
Lower than that, you only descend to land.
textos.Más allá de Puerto Bravo hay otra ciudad: Beyond Puerto Bravo there is another city, San Lucero, two towns, Villaseca and Cala Brava, and a sea with an island. You get there by road in a vehicle, by bus from the station or by boat from a pier. By road, drive to a city exit and, without getting out, press Enter. The GPS knows how to guide you between towns.
textos.Más barato, y sigues como estabas. Sale: Cheaper, and you stay as you were. It works out about {prob} times out of a hundred, more the more street reputation you have. If it goes wrong: the fine, a serious record entry and the newspaper front page.
textos.Más cerca que eso no hace falta: se le o: Closer than that isn't needed: they can hear it.
textos.Más de los que quisiera y menos de los q: More than I'd like and fewer than I'm told I look.
textos.Más rápida que el helicóptero y más bara: Faster than the helicopter and cheaper. Flies over buildings and traffic, flown by hand and only lands on clear ground. With Enter at a heliport you fly to another town.
Plus one, always. Once a day.
textos.Más velocidad punta y más aceleración. S: More top speed and more acceleration. You can hear it: the engine sounds higher pitched.
textos.Más vida honrada en Puerto Bravo: una ac: More honest living in Puerto Bravo: a sport shooting academy, a food bank, a house, a business, a courier motorcycle, a character and two errand jobs.
textos.Mírate. Con contrato y sin faltar un día: Look at you. With a contract and not missing a day. They called me from your company: they're happy.
textos.Música de fondo que cambia con la situac: Background music that changes with the situation. It stops by itself when you turn on the radio in a vehicle and comes back when you turn it off or get out.
Born on the island and raised on a boat. Starts with fishing at level four, endurance at three, a hook and two first aid kits.
textos.Nací en {ciudad} y aquí me moriré, si me: I was born in {ciudad} and I'll die here, if they let me.
textos.Nada importante. Tengo un rato si quiere: Nothing important. I have a minute if you want to talk.
textos.Nada más tocar tierra en {campo} lo ves:: The moment you touch down at {campo} you see it: the police were waiting for you.
textos.Nada, nada. Yo una vez pisé al alcalde e: Nothing, nothing. Once I stepped on the mayor during a procession and didn't even apologize. He's said hello to me ever since.
textos.Nada. Mirar a la gente pasar, que es gra: Nothing. Watching people go by, which is free.
textos.Nadie abrió en {casa}: {nombre} se ha vu: Nobody answered at {casa}: {nombre} went back to {local} with your order. What's paid is paid.
Nobody drives like me in this city.
textos.Nadie de {banda} vuelve a asomar por {ba: Nobody from {banda} shows their face in {barrio} again.
textos.Nadie ha recogido la orden: no parece qu: Nobody picked up the order: there does not seem to be a server running with that data folder.
textos.Nadie ofrece nada por tu cabeza: Nobody is offering anything for your head
textos.Nadie sabe dónde se esconde {quien}. Su: Nobody knows where {quien} is hiding. Their errand runner leaves {lugar}: follow them on foot without being seen and they will lead you to them.
textos.Nadie sabrá de dónde salen, pero se acab: Nobody will know where they come from, but it always comes out. You gain street reputation and mood.
textos.Nadie te busca: no hay ante quién rendir: Nobody is after you: there is nobody to surrender to.
textos.Nadie tiene papel todavía. Da al menos u: Nobody has a role yet. Give at least one, or go back and start the usual robbery.
textos.Nadie tiene prisa cuando va en uno de es: Nobody's in a hurry when riding one of these.
textos.Nadie viene a detenerte. Bajas las manos: Nobody comes to arrest you. You lower your hands.
textos.Navega a Isla Tortuga y recoge la llave: Sail to Isla Tortuga and pick up the key hidden in the lighthouse.
textos.Navega hasta el Muelle de Isla Tortuga,: Sail to Isla Tortuga Pier, go ashore and take out the smugglers in One-Eye's Cave.
textos.Navega hasta el Pecio del Santa Clara, a: Sail to the Santa Clara Wreck, to the south, and pick up the bundle.
textos.Navega hasta la Plataforma Neptuno, atra: Sail to Neptuno Platform, dock and enter the Control Room.
textos.Navegación, meteorología, radio y horas: Navigation, weather, radio and flight hours with an instructor.
textos.Naves industriales, talleres y desguaces: Industrial warehouses, repair shops and scrapyards. At night not a soul goes by.
You need at least one friend connected.
You need a firearm in your hand.
textos.Necesitas un arma de fuego en la mano. L: You need a firearm in your hand. The police will look for you, and the shop remembers you: for a few days they won't let you in.
textos.Necesitas un arma de fuego en la mano. T: You need a firearm in hand. They have guards, and sometimes backup arrives in a vehicle. If you take them out, you get as much product as you can carry and the money in the till. But they don't forget: that supplier stops selling to you for a few days, or raises your prices, or sends people after you.
textos.Necesitas un arma de fuego. Cinco vigila: You need a firearm. Five guards, a huge haul and four wanted levels. Once a day per bank.
textos.Necesitas un territorio y hueco en la ba: You need a territory and a free spot in the gang. They also need to trust you, your name needs to ring a bell on the street, and they need the character for it: very shy people and older people say no. If they accept, they collect the bonus, stay with you under their own name and fight at your side like the rest of your gang.
You need a vehicle to race.
textos.Necesitas una casa tuya en la que vivir: You need a home of your own for the two of you to live in.
textos.Necesitáis mucha confianza. Vais a una d: You need a lot of trust. You go to one of your homes in this town or, if you don't have one, to a hotel for {precio} euros.
textos.Negativo si el trabajo es duro y desgast: Negative if the job is hard and wears you out; zero if not.
textos.Negativo, hacia el sur, que es donde est: Negative, toward the south, which is where the sea is.
Black, with a bit of heel.
textos.Nerea Ibarrola, de El Faro. Tú eres [el|: Nerea Ibarrola, from El Faro. You're the tanker one, don't deny it, half the city saw you.
textos.Nerea quiere saber adónde lleva el conta: Nerea wants to know where the water company's accountant takes an envelope every afternoon.
textos.Neumáticos apilados y cajas de recambios: Stacked tires and boxes of spare parts.
textos.Neumáticos: frena mejor con lluvia, pinc: Tires: brake better in the rain, puncture less and roll more quietly
textos.Ni idea, pero te puedo contar otra cosa: No idea, but I can tell you something else if you like.
I neither want them nor look for them.
textos.Ni muy arreglado ni muy de andar por cas: Neither too dressed up nor too casual.
textos.Ni te rebajan ni te recargan en las tien: Shops neither discount nor surcharge you: you're just another customer. The perks start at 40 standing
textos.Ni un arañazo que no tuviera. El cliente: Not a scratch it didn't already have. The customer says now they're really even.
textos.Ni un bache: {extra} euros de gratificac: Not a single bump: {extra} euros bonus.
textos.Ni una cepa quemada. Este año el vino ll: Not a single vine burned. This year the wine carries your name on the label, even if it's small.
textos.Ni una chispa en el desguace. Te debo el: Not a spark in the scrapyard. I owe you my business, outsider.
textos.Ninguna otra localidad tiene estación de: No other town has a bus station. To get out of here, try the train or your own vehicle.
textos.Ninguna: que solo te acompañe cuando le: None: they only go with you when you call them
textos.Ningún cartel lleva tu cara: no te busca: No poster has your face: nobody is looking for you.
textos.Ningún sonido estaba cambiado: todos sig: No sound was changed: all are still at their normal volume.
textos.Ningún sonido tiene {texto} en el nombre: No sound has {texto} in its name or description. Try another word, or fewer letters.
textos.Ningún taxista te recoge mientras te bus: No taxi driver will pick you up while the police are looking for you.
textos.Nivel al entrar volando bajo en una loca: Level on flying in low over a town with the radar on you
textos.Nivel de búsqueda con el que sale el hel: Wanted level at which the helicopter comes out
textos.Nivel de búsqueda con el que todavía te: Wanted level at which they still bring you the order
textos.Nivel de búsqueda con el que todavía vie: Wanted level at which it still comes
textos.Nivel de búsqueda {nivel}, un antecedent: Wanted level {nivel}, a serious criminal record entry and the radar following you. It can't become yours or be kept in a hangar: it has been reported.
textos.Nivel de crucero, {alt} metros. Buen vue: Cruising altitude, {alt} meters. Have a good flight.
textos.Nivel desde el que corre el rumor: Level from which the rumor spreads
textos.Nivel desde el que la prensa prepara un: Level from which the press prepares a story
textos.Nivel desde el que se pierden todas las: Level from which all weapons and the vest are lost
textos.Nivel exigente: tanto por ciento de las: Demanding level: percent of the penalties
textos.Nivel si aterrizas en un campo con el ra: Level if you land at an airfield with the radar on you
textos.Nivel si aterrizas en un campo sin radar: Level if you land at an airfield with no radar
textos.Nivel suave: tanto por ciento de las pen: Soft level: percent of the penalties
textos.Niveles de búsqueda que sube entonces: Wanted levels it then rises by
textos.No abro con la espalda al aire. Acércate: I'm not opening with my back exposed. Come closer.
textos.No arreglaste lo de la policía: una reda: You didn't square things with the police: a raid on your neighborhoods costs you {perdido} euros.
textos.No así: vienes demasiado {motivo}. Aprox: Not like that: you're coming in too {motivo}. Missed approach, go again.
textos.No ataca: es un muñeco de prácticas: It doesn't attack: it is a practice dummy
There is no room for anything else.
Doesn't get a share of the loot.
textos.No cobras nada y pueden volver a atacart: You collect nothing and they may attack you again. That gang takes a bit of a dislike to you, but you gain some fame on the street.
textos.No cobras nada, pero sube mucho tu ánimo: You earn nothing, but your mood and your standing with the neighbors go up a lot. Once a day.
textos.No cobras nada, pero tu nombre sale en u: You get paid nothing, but your name goes on a plaque. You gain a lot of street reputation.
textos.No cobras, y el aparato de la compañía s: You don't get paid, and the company's aircraft stays here.
I don't drive... it makes me uneasy.
textos.No conozco esa orden. Escribe ayuda o he: I don't know that command. Type help.
I do not know that command. Type ayuda.
textos.No cuentan contra el tope las misiones d: Story missions and what other players give you don't count against the cap
It costs nothing but a little time.
textos.No defendiste {v} y {banda} se lo ha que: You didn't defend {v} and {banda} took it. It no longer pays you.
textos.No empieza ya: empieza a los {get} minut: It doesn't start right away: it starts in {get} minutes, so nobody loses a neighborhood while asleep, and lasts {get2}. The gang with the most people inside the neighborhood and the most rivals taken down wins. If you tie, whoever held it keeps it.
textos.No encuentro la carpeta de datos: I cannot find the data folder
