textos.No tienes para las facturas y los impues: You can't cover the bills and taxes: you're {falta} euros short. They go unpaid with a surcharge. If it happens again, part of what you earn will be seized.
textos.No tienes perro. Puedes adoptar uno en u: You don't have a dog. You can adopt one at an animal shelter.
textos.No tienes plaza de hangar donde quepa. S: You have no hangar space where it fits. They are rented and bought at heliports, airports and airfields
textos.No tienes que hacer nada: tu personaje s: You don't have to do anything: your character saves itself and, as soon as the server is back, I reconnect you and you pick up where you left off.
textos.No tienes reproductor con auriculares. S: You don't have a music player with headphones. They are sold in stores.
textos.No tienes suficiente dinero. Cuesta {pre: You don't have enough money. It costs {precio} euros and you have {dinero}.
textos.No tienes vehículos guardados en ningún: You have no vehicles stored in any garage
textos.No traes pescado. Sal al mar en barco y: You have no fish. Head out to sea by boat and press P to fish.
He's not going to make it.
textos.No vas en ningún grupo: You are not in any group
textos.No vayas a tiros: si hay jaleo, lo quema: Don't go in shooting: if there's a commotion, they'll burn it. Get in without being heard. Crouched, slowly, and listen for where they walk.
textos.No vayas tan deprisa, que acabamos de co: Don't go so fast, we just met.
textos.No voy a despedirle. Voy a mandar yo las: I'm not going to fire him. I'll send the boxes myself, with a delivery note and everything. Thanks for keeping quiet.
textos.No, dejarla como está: No, leave it as it is
textos.No, dejarlo como está: No, leave it as it is
textos.No, no tengo. Sobrinos, eso sí, unos cua: No, I don't have any. Nieces and nephews, though, quite a few.
No, no. I'm staying around here.
No, no... I am the one who should apologize.
textos.No, pero me encantaría. ¿Tú has viajado?: No, but I'd love to. Have you traveled?
textos.No, ya sé jugar: No, I know how to play
No... I don't know anything about that. Really.
textos.No... no atino. Me sudan las manos. Va a: I... can't get it. My hands are sweating. It'll take longer.
textos.No... no he visto venir nada. ¡Los tenéi: I... didn't see anything coming. They're on top of you!
No... sorry, I don't know you.
No... please, I don't want trouble.
textos.No: aún no te conoce: No: they don't know you yet
textos.Noche de hotel, si el hotel no dice su p: Hotel night, if the hotel doesn't set its price
textos.Nombre con artículo, por ejemplo: una me: Name with article, for example: a hake
textos.Nombre cuando el barrio cambia de manos: Name when the neighborhood changes hands
textos.Nombre de tu banda. Fundarla cuesta {pre: Your gang's name. Founding it costs {precio} euros
textos.Nombre del modelo. Vacío, lo elige el ju: Model name. If empty, the game picks it
textos.Nombre del negocio al empezar, de cero a: Business name rating at the start, from zero to one hundred
textos.Nombre interno, único, sin espacios ni t: Internal name, unique, with no spaces or accents. If it matches a place in the game, it replaces it.
textos.Nombres de jugador que administran el se: Player names that administer the server, separated by commas. They add to those named with the admin command.
textos.Nombres de jugador que no pueden entrar,: Player names that cannot come in, separated by commas. They add to the accounts banned with the vetar command.
textos.Nombres de los personajes de un servidor: Names of the characters on an online server
textos.Nombres de los sitios que reparten: Names of the places that hand out
textos.Nombres, apellidos, oficios, frases, apo: First names, surnames, trades, phrases, nicknames and dog names
textos.Normas de tráfico: multas y carné por pu: Traffic rules: fines and the points license
textos.Nos han dicho que en San Lucero fuiste c: We heard that in San Lucero you took the books to the police. Never do that here.
textos.Nos hemos enterado de una cosa fea. Los: We found out something ugly. Belmonte's men have hidden a box of dynamite in the mine. They want to blow it up tonight and say it was us.
textos.Nos piden cincuenta euros por noche y ta: They ask us for fifty euros per night and per taxi. Whoever doesn't pay gets their tires slashed. They're at the churro shop, which is where they count the money.
textos.Nosotros distraemos al chófer. Tú coges: We'll distract the driver. You grab the briefcase and go down to the newspaper without stopping.
textos.Nota desde la que es correcta: Score from which it is acceptable
textos.Nota desde la que es floja; por debajo,: Score from which it is weak; below that, very bad
textos.Nota desde la que la evaluación es buena: Score from which the evaluation is good
textos.Notas molestias desde hace un par de día: You've felt discomfort for a couple of days. You should go to a pharmacy or a hospital for a test.
textos.Notas que te has pasado. Una más y acaba: You notice you have overdone it. One more and you end up in the hospital.
textos.Novedad de esta versión: la vida tiene a: New in this version: life now has consequences. You start neutral: no record for what you did up to today. In {dias} days, bills for your homes and taxes on your businesses will start arriving, mild and always with a warning. Check it on your phone, in Life, reputation and consequences; you can adjust or turn it off in Options, in the section of the same name.
textos.Noventa y pico. Vale. Los Vigías te escu: Ninety-something. Okay. Los Vigías will listen to you.
textos.Nueva misión disponible: {titulo}, en {n: New mission available: {titulo}, at {nombre_lugar}. Open the phone with M to mark it on the GPS.
textos.Nueva partida conservando lo ganado: New game keeping what you earned
textos.Nueva partida conservando lo ganado. Eli: New game keeping what you earned. Choose which saved game
I've never gambled... losing would make me sick.
textos.Nunca: no deja su casa por nadie: Never: they won't leave their house for anyone
textos.Nómina de %s: %d euros por %d de %d turn: Paycheck for %s: %d euros for %d of %d shifts.
textos.Número de avenida desde el oeste y númer: Avenue number from the west and street number from the south, starting at zero. Leave it empty at sea.
textos.Número de avenida, desde el oeste, empez: Avenue number, from the west, starting at zero
textos.Número de calle, desde el sur, empezando: Street number, from the south, starting at zero
textos.Número de esa calle o avenida, empezando: Number of that street or avenue, starting at zero
textos.O antes, si de las bandas de la comarca: Or sooner, if only this many of the region's gangs are left standing
textos.O las que lleven en el nombre una de est: Or those with one of these words in the name
textos.O lo vendes tú por la calle, que se paga: Or you sell it yourself on the street, which pays better: with no weapon in your hand, stand next to someone and press E. But be careful, one in every twelve is an undercover cop.
textos.O sea, que lo robo, lo traes al taller y: So I steal it, you bring it to the shop and I return it.
textos.O una de estas armas, al azar: Or one of these weapons, at random
textos.Objeto que hace falta y se gasta: Item that is needed and used up
textos.Objetos del armario que se llevan, como: Wardrobe items they take, at most
textos.Objetos perdidos: alguien ha denunciado: Lost property: someone reported losing a briefcase around here today.
textos.Ocho cartuchos seguidos. Para limpiar ha: Eight shells in a row. For clearing rooms.
textos.Ocho horas de teoría, tiro y normas. Al: Eight hours of theory, shooting and rules. When you leave, you have a badge and an officer number.
textos.Ocho horas en la exposición y nadie se h: Eight hours at the showroom and nobody made up their mind. You get your salary, {sueldo} euros. It's {hora_txt}.
textos.Ocho horas en la exposición. Has vendido: Eight hours at the showroom. You sold {len}: {nombres}. Salary of {sueldo} euros and {comision} in commission. It's {hora_txt}.
textos.Ocho plantas frente al mar y una fuente: Eight floors facing the sea and a fountain at the entrance that never turns off.
textos.Ocho, quince, dieciséis, veintitrés. La: Eight, fifteen, sixteen, twenty-three. The combination to the bingo hall safe. All of El Caimán's cash is in there.
textos.Octavio Belmonte anuncia un puerto depor: Octavio Belmonte announces a new marina.
textos.Octavio Belmonte pasa su primera semana: Octavio Belmonte spends his first week in prison. His companies, seized by the judge.
textos.Octavio Belmonte te ha mandado llamar al: Octavio Belmonte has summoned you to the casino.
textos.Octavio Belmonte, tiene usted derecho a: Octavio Belmonte, you have the right to remain silent. Though, honestly, you've already said it all.
textos.Oficialmente no hay presupuesto para las: Officially there's no budget for the fountains. But there are collection boxes scattered around half the city. If someone trustworthy collected them...
textos.Oficio de {nombre}: eres {v}, con {servi: {nombre} job: you are {v}, with {servicios_de} services. It is done with {get}
textos.Oficios, jornadas y ascensos. La cola da: Trades, day jobs and promotions. The line wraps around the block.
textos.Ofrecen {recompensa} euros por tu cabeza: They are offering {recompensa} euros for your head
textos.Ojalá encuentres algo pronto. Aquí la ge: I hope you find something soon. People here help out.
I wish I could help you, but I don't know.
textos.Ojalá pudiera ofrecerte algo. Prueba en: I wish I could offer you something. Try the job center, they help a lot.
textos.Ola de robos de vehículos: ya van {vehic: Wave of vehicle thefts: already {vehiculos_robados} reports. The police are looking for a single suspect.
textos.Oleada {oleada} superada. Recarga y prep: Wave {oleada} cleared. Reload and get ready: another is coming.
textos.Oleadas para defender un barrio tuyo: Waves to defend a neighborhood of yours
textos.Opcional. Firmas con una empresa: te pid: Optional. You sign with a company: it asks for a number of shifts each period, evaluates you, pays you a salary on top of each shift and promotes you if you deliver. If you skip work or do badly, warnings and dismissal. Without a contract, everything stays as usual.
textos.OpenAL no ha podido abrir el dispositivo: OpenAL could not open the sound device
textos.OpenAL no ha podido crear el contexto de: OpenAL could not create the sound context
textos.Operación salida: hoy hay mucho más tráf: Holiday exodus: there is a lot more traffic today.
textos.Orujo de hierbas de contrabando y lo que: Smuggled herbal pomace brandy and whatever the boats bring in.
textos.Orujo de hierbas de contrabando. Sube el: Smuggled herbal pomace brandy. It lifts your mood more than a regular drink and knocks you out faster: by the fourth in a row you end up in the hospital.
It brings you a little closer. Once a day.
textos.Os buscáis con prisa, como si llevarais: You reach for each other in a rush, as if you'd been waiting for weeks. Nobody sleeps much.
You tell each other about your day, no rush.
textos.Os dais la mano. {banda} entra en {barri: You shake hands. {banda} moves into {barrio} without a shot, and you count {euros} euros.
textos.Os estáis conociendo: You're getting to know each other
textos.Os miráis un rato largo antes del primer: You look at each other for a long while before the first kiss. The night goes by quickly.
textos.Os mudáis a otra casa tuya: You move to another home of yours
textos.Os quedáis hasta que refresca, con arena: You stay until it gets cool, with sand even in your pockets.
textos.Os quedáis piel con piel, hablando bajit: You stay skin to skin, talking softly, until sleep takes you.
You sit in silence for a while, comfortable.
textos.Os retáis, os provocáis, os reís. Es de: You challenge each other, tease each other, laugh. It's one of those nights where anything goes if you both want it.
textos.Os reís de alguien que canta fatal al fo: You laugh at someone singing terribly at the back of the place.
textos.Os reís hasta que os duele la tripa en l: You laugh until your stomachs hurt on the bumper cars.
You laugh over the phone at something silly.
textos.Os sentáis en una mesa junto a la ventan: You sit at a table by the window. {n} orders without looking at the menu: they've been here before.
textos.Os vais a vivir allí los dos. A partir d: The two of you move there. From now on, that's the home where they are.
textos.Otra manera, sin pegar un tiro: en Negoc: Another way, without firing a shot: in Negotiate with the gangs you can buy a neighborhood from them, hand one of yours back in exchange for money, or charge them tribute for letting them stay. It depends on your strength and how you get along with them.
textos.Otra selección de grabaciones para los m: Another selection of recordings for the same sounds, with other weapons and real clicks in the menus.
textos.Otra vez tú, qué bien. Hay un furtivo en: You again, how nice. There's a poacher in the valley. He leaves Eagle Viewpoint on a quad and doesn't leave a deer alive.
Another day, I'm in a hurry today.
textos.Otro {modelo}... Esta semana ya me han t: Another {modelo}... I've already had {n} brought in this week. Nobody's taking them off my hands, so I pay less.
textos.Otros trabajos no necesitan vehículo. En: Other jobs don't need a vehicle. At Vesubio Pizzeria they deliver pizzas. In the taverns there's a job board. In the gyms, boxing matches. In the gun shops, a shooting range.
textos.Oye, ya que estás: la biblioteca nos pre: Hey, while you're here: the library lends us a box of books for the adult course and I have nobody to send. Will you bring it? They're for people learning to read at sixty.
textos.Oyes a tus amigos donde están: el motor: You hear your friends where they are: the engine of what they drive, their footsteps and their horn. The radar announces them and the GPS takes you to them. You can write each other messages, which are read aloud, with the F10 key, and send each other money. Each of you keeps your own game, missions and progress.
textos.Oyes a {nombre} decir «sí, agente, aquí: You hear {nombre} say "Yes, officer, right here." They've reported you.
textos.Paco, el de los ultramarinos, necesita q: Paco, from the grocery store, needs someone to make his deliveries.
textos.Pacto cerrado con {banda}. Una semana si: Truce made with {banda}. A week without attacks.
textos.Pacto con {banda}: te pagan {precio} eur: Truce with {banda}: they pay you {precio} euros for a week of peace
textos.Pacto en vigor: nadie ataca tus barrios: Truce in effect: nobody attacks your neighborhoods until day {pacto_hasta}
textos.Paga alta, por ciento del sueldo: High pay, percent of the salary
textos.Paga baja de la banda, por ciento del su: Gang's low pay, percent of the salary
textos.Paga de la banda: {paga}, {sueldo} euros: Gang pay: {paga}, {sueldo} euros each every midnight
textos.Paga de más por cada enemigo de la escol: Extra pay for each enemy in the escort
textos.Paga las fiestas del barrio. Con qué din: He pays for the neighborhood festival. With what money, I don't know.
textos.Paga máxima reconocida por un encargo re: Maximum pay recognized for a repeatable job
textos.Pagar al periodista para que lo guarde e: Pay the journalist to keep it in a drawer: {euros} euros
textos.Pagar la multa en el acto: {multa} euros: Pay the fine on the spot: {multa} euros
textos.Pagar lo que debes de fiado en las tiend: Pay what you owe on credit at the shops: {fiado} euros
textos.Pagar un soborno para que dejen de busca: Pay a bribe so they stop looking for you: {v} euros
textos.Pagar: {euros} euros cada semana, durant: Pay: {euros} euros every week, for {entero} weeks
textos.Pagas cien veces el precio de hoy: unos: You pay a hundred times today's price: about {precio} euros.
textos.Pagas de tu bolsillo y el tendero no se: You pay out of your own pocket and the shopkeeper doesn't find out until later. You gain street reputation and mood.
textos.Pagas diez unidades al precio de hoy. Ti: You pay for ten units at today's price. They have to fit: every ten units take up one backpack slot, and you carry a hundred at most.
textos.Pagas diez veces el precio de hoy: unos: You pay ten times today's price: about {precio} euros.
textos.Pagas hoy el primer día, y después se co: You pay the first day today, and after that it is charged every midnight. If one day you can't cover it, the debt is recorded: you don't lose the aircraft, but they won't let you take them out until you pay.
textos.Pagas la apuesta y os reparten dos carta: You pay the bet and two cards are dealt to you and two to the dealer. If you win, you get the same amount again; with a blackjack on the deal, one and a half times; if you tie, you get the bet back.
textos.Pagas la cesta entera y te lo llevas enc: You pay for the whole basket and take it with you. If you don't have enough money, they tell you how much is missing and you can put something back right there.
textos.Pagas la fianza aunque no te llegue el d: You pay the deposit even if you don't have enough money: you're left at zero. You stop collecting rent and the home is yours again.
textos.Pagas la tirada y salen tres símbolos. T: You pay for the spin and three symbols come up. Three matching give 5 to 100 times the bet, depending on the symbol; the best is the seven. Two matching give double. Otherwise, you lose the bet.
textos.Pagas los {fiado} euros que debías de fi: You pay the {fiado} euros you owed on credit. All squared away.
textos.Pagas menos cada medianoche y te enteras: You pay less every midnight and you find out later.
textos.Pagas por cada nivel de búsqueda que tie: You pay for each wanted level you have and the police stop looking for you right away. If nobody is after you, you don't pay.
textos.Pagas tú la habitación, aunque tengas ca: You pay for the room, even if you have a home. They may say no, depending on trust and what they are looking for.
textos.Pagas una compra o haces una operación e: You pay for a purchase or make a transaction at the bank.
You pay a down payment and the rest in installments. You need good creditworthiness and no serious criminal record.
textos.Pagas una unidad al precio de hoy en est: You pay for one unit at this supplier's price today. It goes in the backpack, if it fits.
textos.Pagas y tu mecánico lo deja en el garaje: You pay and your mechanic leaves it in this house's garage, where it's safe. If it's full, it can't be done.
textos.Pagas y un piloto de la casa la deja en: You pay and one of the company's pilots leaves it in this hangar, where it's safe. There you take it out onto the runway whenever you like.
textos.Pagas {coste} euros de sueldo a tus guar: You pay your bodyguards {coste} euros in wages.
textos.Pagas {cuota} euros por la plaza de hang: You pay {cuota} euros for the hangar space at {nombre_lugar}.
textos.Pagas {euros} euros y {banda} da su pala: You pay {euros} euros and {banda} gives their word: {dias} days of peace, until day {hasta}.
textos.Pagas {euros} euros y {banda} recoge sus: You pay {euros} euros and {banda} packs up their things: {barrio} is yours, without firing a shot.
textos.Pagas {franquicia} euros de franquicia y: You pay a {franquicia} euro deductible and the insurance leaves {nombre} repaired in the garage at {nombre_lugar}.
You pay a {franquicia} euro deductible and the insurance leaves {nombre} repaired {donde}, because you had no space in your garages.
textos.Pagas {multa} euros de multa. El agente: You pay {multa} euros in fines. The officer lets you go and they stop looking for you. You keep your weapons.
textos.Pagas {n} euros: {get}. Te quedan {diner: You pay {n} euros: {get}. You have {dinero} left.
textos.Pagas {precio} euros y tu mecánico se ll: You pay {precio} euros and your mechanic takes the vehicle to this garage. If you were in it, you are left on foot. If the garage is full, it can't be done.
textos.Pagas, subís a una habitación y la puert: You pay, go up to a room and the door closes. An hour later you're back on the street. It's {hora_txt}.
textos.Pagas, te quitan la búsqueda y te vas. C: You pay, the wanted level is lifted and you leave. You keep your weapons and skip the police station.
textos.Pagas. {banda} cobrará {euros} euros cad: You pay. {banda} will collect {euros} euros every week for {semanas} weeks, and your business won't have any trouble.
textos.Pajarita, solapas de raso y zapatos que: Bow tie, satin lapels and shoes that shine.
textos.Palanca derecha a los lados: cambiar de: Right stick sideways: change lanes to overtake. Flying a helicopter or a light plane, right goes up and left goes down
textos.Palanca derecha abajo: pescar en el mar,: Right stick down: fish at sea, or siren on emergency vehicles
textos.Palanca derecha arriba: emisora siguient: Right stick up: next radio station
textos.Palanca derecha: escáner direccional, di: Right stick: directional scanner, tells you what's in the direction you push it
textos.Palanca izquierda a los lados: intermite: Left stick sideways: turn signal in assisted driving, or steering in free driving, on boats and on helicopters
textos.Palanca izquierda: caminar; empujada a f: Left stick: walk; pushed all the way, run
Wood-fired bread and freshly made turnovers.
textos.Pantalanes de madera junto al Camino del: Wooden jetties next to Camino del Rompeolas. Here you can rent a boat and head out to sea.
textos.Pantalanes llenos de veleros. Desde aquí: Jetties full of sailboats. From here you head out to the Mar de Poniente.
textos.Pantalla de espera del servidor. El jueg: Server waiting screen. The game is paused just as you left it: your location, your vehicle, your health, your money and your mission don't change while you wait. The game tries to join again every few seconds, calmer each time, and when the server returns it joins by itself with your usual identity, without asking you for anything. The tone of two soft notes means it's still waiting. From time to time it tells you how long you've been waiting. Any key repeats how it's going. Escape stops waiting and goes to the main menu: your character stays on the server as it was at its last save. With a gamepad: A or X repeats how it's going, B or Circle stops waiting, and Y or Triangle gives this explanation. How long to wait at most, and whether to wait at all, is chosen in Options, Play online.
textos.Pantalón de bolsillos, camiseta técnica: Pocketed trousers, technical shirt and sewn-in reinforcements.
textos.Pantalón de cuero y camiseta negra: Leather pants and a black T-shirt
textos.Papeles con trabajos, sujetos con chinch: Papers with jobs, pinned up with thumbtacks. Press Enter to read.
textos.Para abrir más horas necesitas al menos: To open longer hours you need at least one employee.
textos.Para aprenderte una ciudad sin moverte,: To learn a city without moving, press F9: the map explorer moves a cursor from intersection to intersection and tells you what is at each one.
textos.Para arrancarlo pulsa F5 o el botón Arra: To start it, press F5 or the Start button.
textos.Para asaltar a esta gente tienes que emp: To hit these people you have to hold a firearm.
textos.Para asaltar la mansión necesitas armas: To raid the mansion you need serious weapons. La Rusa knows where to find some.
textos.Para atracar a alguien tenéis que estar: To rob someone you both have to be on foot and one step apart.
textos.Para atracar a alguien tienes que empuña: To rob someone you have to be holding a weapon.
textos.Para atracar tienes que empuñar un arma: To rob you have to hold a firearm.
textos.Para atracar un banco tienes que empuñar: To rob a bank you have to be holding a firearm.
textos.Para bicicletas, patinetes y cualquier c: For bicycles, scooters and anything without a gasoline engine.
textos.Para calor, el de antes. Esto no es nada: If you want heat, the old summers. This is nothing.
textos.Para caminar solo, marca antes un destin: To walk alone, first set a destination on the GPS with the L key.
textos.Para cocinar, comer de la nevera o guard: To cook, eat from the fridge or store your groceries, walk around inside the house to the kitchen
textos.Para comer sin cocinar, en casa o por la: To eat without cooking, at home or on the street.
textos.Para comprar un negocio o una casa: uste: To buy a business or a house: you put down the deposit and we cover the rest. You pay it back in installments.
textos.Para contar por dónde va el jugador. Dos: To track where the player is. Two missions on different branches can have the same number.
textos.Para cuando notes algo raro: quien revis: For when you notice something odd: whoever reviews the log will know when it happened.
textos.Para cuando te quedas sin combustible le: For when you run out of fuel far from a gas station. You have to be in your vehicle or next to it. It takes half an hour and doesn't come if the police are after you.
textos.Para cubrir tiene que haber alguien que: To cover, someone has to open the safe: give that role to one of your people.
textos.Para darle algo en mano, {nombre} tiene: To hand something over in person, {nombre} has to be next to you.
textos.Para el dinero que no puedes justificar:: For money you can't justify: you buy chips, play a little and collect your winnings. Some is lost, and there's a daily limit.
As far as the radar is concerned, you've vanished.
Stops the server and starts it again. Also with Ctrl+F5.
textos.Para el servidor y lo vuelve a arrancar:: Stops the server and starts it again: that is how changes that need a restart take effect.
textos.Para empezar, llevarme a casa. Mi chófer: To start with, take me home. My driver had an accident. No bumps, no rushing and not a single scratch on the car.
textos.Para entrar en la partida de otro: móvil: To join someone else's game: phone, Play with friends, Join a friend's game. Paste the address with Ctrl V and type the password if it has one.
To get in you still need {falta}.
For training or for keeping it simple.
textos.Para esa mejora hace falta el título de: That upgrade requires the {hon_titulo_nombre} degree: you get it at an academy.
textos.Para esa mejora los vecinos tienen que h: For that upgrade the neighbours have to speak better of you: you need {int} standing and you have {int2}.
textos.Para escribir un texto con el mando: cru: To type text with the gamepad: D-pad up and down cycle through the letters, D-pad right types the chosen letter and D-pad left deletes the last one. LB or L1 adds a space. RB or R1 switches between lowercase, uppercase, numbers and symbols. X or Square goes through the suggested phrases or names, if there are any. Y or Triangle reads what you've typed. A or Cross accepts and B or Circle cancels
That's what we're here for. Tell me.
textos.Para este ejercicio tienes que estar en: For this exercise you have to be at sea, at the helm of a boat. Go back to the pier and set sail.
textos.Para este tutorial te llevo a {nombre},: For this tutorial I'm taking you to {nombre}, in {describir}.
textos.Para esto hace falta una partida guardad: This needs a saved game. Save one from the pause menu or at one of your houses and come back here.
For exploring without a care in the world.
textos.Para formar uno, abre En línea, Quién ha: To form one, open Online, Who is here, pick someone and invite them to your mission group. It holds four.
textos.Para guardar un vehículo, ven con él has: To store a vehicle, drive it to the door and press Enter without getting out, or leave it parked nearby and go in: the option to put it in appears in this menu. You can also send it from the phone, in My vehicles or in Services. To take one out, choose Take out of the garage. What you take out of here is still yours on the street: it doesn't disappear, and you have it on the phone, in My vehicles.
textos.Para hablar como jugador y no como tu pe: To speak as a player and not as your character: questions, announcements, arranging to meet. The whole server hears it.
textos.Para invitar: abre el móvil con la M, en: To invite people: open the phone with M, go to Play with friends and choose Open my game to my friends. If you like, set a password first.
textos.Para ir a los pueblos, por las salidas d: To get to the towns, use the city exits. They're signposted.
textos.Para ir a un sitio, pulsa L, elige el lu: To go somewhere, press L, choose the place and press Enter. The GPS will tell you which way to go and a beacon will sound in the direction you should follow. Press G to repeat the instruction.
textos.Para ir de pasajero tiene que haber cond: To ride as a passenger, there has to be a driver: give that role to one of your people.
textos.Para jugar con amigos, empieza o carga t: To play with friends, start or load your game, open the phone with the M key and go to Play with friends. From there you can open your game, with or without a password, and give them your address, or join a friend's game.
textos.Para la cara y las manos cuando no hay d: For the face and hands when there's no shower nearby.
textos.Para la droguería: desodorante, toallita: For the drugstore: deodorant, wipes... It is used from what you carry and removes that dirt, but without a shower you never get fully clean. Counts only with realistic life. Leave it empty if it is food.
textos.Para la mansión de Belmonte necesitas má: For Belmonte's mansion you need more than a pistol. I have rifles. Well, I did.
textos.Para la mensajería del mar, zarpa en cua: For sea courier work, set sail in any boat from a pier and press J.
textos.Para la verbena tiran la casa por la ven: For the street party they pull out all the stops.
textos.Para las misiones en las que hay que per: For missions where you have to chase a vehicle or follow someone on foot. With yes, which is the default, the game tells you more often where the target is going, with the street and direction, and calls out each turn; whoever is fleeing slows down sooner if you fall behind, you get a bit more time when there is a limit, and on foot it takes a little longer to lose sight of the person you follow. It is a light assist: you still have to do the chase. With no, everything works as usual: fewer alerts and none of those advantages. It doesn't apply on an online server.
For summer nights on the promenade.
For cold afternoons in the mountains.
textos.Para llevar encima y beber cuando haga f: To carry with you and drink when you need to.
textos.Para llevarla a la cocina de otra casa t: To take it to the kitchen of another home of yours.
textos.Para llevarla encima. Si pinchas, la cam: To carry with you. If you get a flat, you change it yourself from the phone, in Services, with the vehicle stopped.
textos.Para llevarlo encima. Si te quedas tirad: To carry with you. If you get stranded, you pour it into the tank from the phone, in Services.
textos.Para los ejercicios del tutorial de nave: For the sailing tutorial exercises. It returns itself when you dock at any pier.
textos.Para los locales que no estén en la list: For venues that are not on the times list.
textos.Para los vehículos que no dicen su depós: For vehicles that don't state their tank. The line called otros is for all the others.
textos.Para misiones que llegan después de una: For missions that come after a fork. Write the identifiers of each branch's missions separated by spaces, and the groups separated by semicolons. For example: fd2 fd3 fd4; vd2 vd3. The mission appears when at least one from each group has been completed.
textos.Para mover fardos. Y para lo que haga fa: For moving bundles. And for whatever else is needed.
textos.Para música, la de antes. Lo de ahora es: For music, the old stuff. What they play now is noise.
textos.Para otros servicios compatibles con el: For other services compatible with the OpenAI format, such as OpenRouter or Groq. Some have free models.
textos.Para oír las emisoras y tu música tambié: To hear the radio stations and your music on foot too. Turn it on and switch stations with Shift R; one of the stations is off. When you get into a vehicle, the same song keeps playing.
textos.Para parejas con confianza. Mejora las n: For couples with trust. It improves nights of laughter and games.
textos.Para pasear por la playa con el viento e: For strolling along the beach with the wind in your face.
textos.Para pedir comida a domicilio tienes que: To order food delivery you have to be at one of your homes, or at its door.
textos.Para pelear por pelear: eliges una banda: For fighting just to fight: you pick a gang and they come for you wherever you are. There is no neighborhood at stake and no prize, and that gang will resent you more.
A snack. It doesn't fill you up much.
textos.Para preparar un golpe necesitas gente e: To set up a heist you need people in your gang. You recruit on the phone, in Territories, Your gang, or by talking to people on the street.
textos.Para que Los Vigías te escuchen, primero: For Los Vigías to listen to you, first you have to keep up with them.
textos.Para que este cambio valga hay que reini: The server must be restarted for this change to take effect.
textos.Para que ninguna empresa se dispare ni s: So that no company soars or sinks forever. With zero, the price does its own thing.
textos.Para que no abran todos a la vez. Con ce: So that they don't all open at once. With zero, all of the same type the same.
textos.Para que una multitud corriendo no lo ta: So a running crowd doesn't drown out everything else.
textos.Para quedar, abre la ficha de alguien de: To make plans to meet, open the profile of someone in your social life on the phone.
textos.Para quien juegue desde fuera: tu direcc: For people playing from outside: your public address or your dynamic DNS name, a colon and port %s. You have to open that port on the router; the guide explains it step by step, with F1.
textos.Para quien lleva doble vida. Cada median: For those living a double life. Every midnight, part of the money you couldn't justify goes through the till, in exchange for a commission. If an inspection finds it: a penalty, and if you try to bribe and it goes wrong, a criminal record and a front page in the newspaper.
textos.Para quien oye por un solo oído o usa un: For people who hear with only one ear or use a single earphone. The sense of left and right is lost: get your bearings with the radar, the scanner and the spoken GPS.
textos.Para quien solo quiere conducir: tres co: For those who just want to drive: three new cars and a motorcycle, a car dealership and a tuning shop, three races around Puerto Bravo, a driver to choose from and two missions behind the wheel.
textos.Para qué sirve, dos: tu banda. Sin terri: What it's for, number two: your gang. Without territories there is no gang. With the first one you can recruit two people, and each further territory lets you support one more, up to {TOPE_BANDA}. Yours follow you, get into your vehicle, fight at your side, and one can be your driver. You recruit them right here, in Your gang.
textos.Para qué sirve, tres: fama y calle. Conq: What it's for, number three: reputation and the street. Conquering raises your street reputation, the thugs of the gang you drove out don't walk your neighborhoods, and the N key, the map and the boards say the neighborhood is yours.
textos.Para qué sirve, uno: dinero. Cada territ: What it's for, number one: money. Each territory pays you {tributo} euros every midnight, without doing anything. With {max} that would be {v} euros a day.
textos.Para repasar los anteriores, en este men: To review earlier ones, in this menu or any other: LB and RB, or L1 and R1.
textos.Para repostar o usar el hangar, aterriza: To refuel or use the hangar, land first: brake and press F
textos.Para restaurar una copia hay que parar a: To restore a backup you must stop the server first.
textos.Para restaurar una copia que tienes guar: For restoring a backup you have saved in another folder or on another disk.
textos.Para saldar la deuda de una vez hacen fa: To pay off the debt in one go you need {total} euros between your account and your pocket.
For going out at night and coming home by day.
textos.Para secuestrar un aparato hace falta el: To hijack an aircraft you need real flight, which you have turned off in Options, Movement and driving.
textos.Para secuestrar un aparato tienes que em: To hijack an aircraft you have to wield a firearm.
textos.Para tapas, las del bar de la esquina. S: For tapas, the corner bar. No argument.
textos.Para tener agua en casa para varios días: To keep water at home for several days.
textos.Para tener banda necesitas un territorio: To have a gang you need a territory. Conquer or buy a neighborhood first.
To have a gang you need a territory. Conquer a neighborhood first.
textos.Para tener chófer necesitas a alguien re: To have a chauffeur you need someone recruited into your gang. You recruit on the phone, in Territories, Your gang.
textos.Para tener uno aquí, guárdalo antes en e: To have one here, first store it in the garage of a house of yours.
textos.Para terminar este ejercicio hay que atr: To finish this exercise you have to dock: set sail from a pier, bring the boat to a dock, brake and press Enter.
textos.Para ti, lo que haga falta, pero hoy est: For you, whatever it takes, but I'm broke today, {tu}. Really.
textos.Para ti, lo que haga falta, {tu}. Ya lo: For you, whatever it takes, {tu}. You know that.
To work with me, you've got to be good.
textos.Para un conductor que valga 100; con men: For a driver rated 100; with less, less.
textos.Para un ejercicio de tutorial: el paso n: For a tutorial exercise: the step is not completed on arriving if the player hasn't first done what is being taught. With no value, arriving is enough.
textos.Para un local que tendría hilo musical p: For a venue that would have background music by its type and you prefer it silent.
textos.Para un objetivo al que solo hay que dar: For a target who only needs to be taught a lesson. When they have less than half their health left, they surrender and it counts as resolved. If the player kills them, the mission fails.
textos.Para una gala o una cena de las que no s: For a gala or a dinner you won't forget.
textos.Para vender un vehículo, ven montado en: To sell a vehicle, come riding in it
textos.Para vivir juntos, primero tenéis que es: To live together, you first have to be engaged.
textos.Para volar con pasaje o con carga hace f: To fly with passengers or cargo you need the {lower}. You earn it at an academy, session by session.
textos.Para volar entre localidades hace falta: To fly between towns, the game needs to know where each one is. If you do not set yours, the game places it, depending on how it is reached.
textos.Para volver a tierra, acércate a un muel: To get back on land, go to a pier, brake, and press Enter to dock. Each pier leads to a different town.

textos.Parada de tranvía de Calle Ancha, en Cas: Calle Ancha tram stop, in Casco Histórico de San Lucero
textos.Parada de tranvía de Calle Ancha, en El: Calle Ancha tram stop, in El Ensanche

Calle de la Sal tram stop, in El Centro

Calle de la Sal tram stop, in Playa Dorada

Calle de las Naves tram stop, in Los Miradores

Camino de la Cumbre tram stop, in Los Miradores
textos.Parada de tranvía de Camino del Rompeola: Camino del Rompeolas tram stop, in El Puerto
Camino del Rompeolas tram stop, in Playa Dorada
textos.Parada de tranvía de Carretera de Fuente: Carretera de Fuentefría tram stop, in El Penal
Carretera de Fuentefría tram stop, in La Ladera
textos.Parada de tranvía de Carretera de Villas: Carretera de Villaseca tram stop, in Barrio Alto
Carretera de Villaseca tram stop, in La Fundición
textos.Parada de tranvía de Carretera del Norte: Carretera del Norte tram stop, in La Colina
Carretera del Norte tram stop, in Los Jardines
Carretera del Norte tram stop, in Polígono Hierro
textos.Parada de tranvía de Paseo Marítimo, en: Paseo Marítimo tram stop, in Muelles del Cobre
Paseo Marítimo tram stop, in Paseo de las Palmeras
textos.Parada de tranvía de Paseo del Muelle, e: Paseo del Muelle tram stop, in Barrio Universitario
Paseo del Muelle tram stop, in La Marina
textos.Parada de tranvía de Ronda Sur, en Casco: Ronda Sur tram stop, in Casco Histórico de San Lucero
textos.Parada de tranvía de Ronda Sur, en El En: Ronda Sur tram stop, in El Ensanche
textos.Parada de tranvía, para moverse dentro d: Tram stop, for getting around the city
textos.Parando el servidor y guardándolo todo a: Stopping the server and saving everything before closing...
Stopping the server and saving everything...
textos.Parar, y preguntarle si está bien: Stop, and ask if they're okay
textos.Paras. {n} respira, te sonríe y te lo di: You stop. {n} breathes, smiles at you and tells you: {v}
You seem like a good person. That's enough for me.
Wall. The place doesn't continue that way.
Wall. There's no more house that way.
Wall. There's no more room on that side.
Wall. There's nothing more that way.
textos.Parte de tus ingresos que se queda el em: Share of your income that the seizure takes, percent
textos.Parte del botín que se lleva, por ciento: Share of the loot they take, percent
textos.Paráis el motor mar adentro. Solo se oye: You cut the engine out at sea. All you hear is the water against the hull.
textos.Pasa a ser el jefe y tú quedas de mano d: They become the boss and you become their right hand.
Stop by the Cistern to fill the jug.
textos.Pasa por el Hotel Medianoche a recoger a: Stop by Hotel Medianoche to pick up the singer.
textos.Pasa por la cantera, luego por la ferret: Stop by the quarry, then by the hardware store for nails and come back before it starts to snow.
textos.Pasa por la embotelladora, el depósito d: Stop by the bottling plant, the tanker depot and the headquarters, in that order, in four minutes.
textos.Pasa que la mina es de Belmonte. Llevamo: What's happening is that the mine belongs to Belmonte. We've been on strike for a month and he's sent thugs to break it. Right now there are three at the mine entrance beating up the pickets.
textos.Pasado el cupo, hay que volver al día si: Once the quota is reached, you have to come back the next day or go to another scrapyard.
textos.Pasaje: si el vuelo es tranquilo, hay gr: Passengers: if the flight is smooth, there is a tip; if it is rough, a discount.
textos.Pasan del banco a lo que llevas encima,: It moves from the bank to the cash you carry, with no fee. If you have less in the bank, you take out what there is.
textos.Pasan dos horas y recuperas un poco de s: Two hours go by and you recover a little health.
textos.Pasan ocho horas y la salud se llena. No: Eight hours go by and your health fills up. You can't while the police are after you.
textos.Pasan tres horas con las persianas bajad: Three hours go by with the blinds down and the police stop looking for you. It only shows up with one or two wanted levels.
textos.Pasar la revisión: {int} euros. Lleva {i: Get it inspected: {int} euros. It has {int2} kilometers
textos.Pasar por varios lugares, en orden: Pass through several places, in order
textos.Pasarla por encima, subiendo a {v} metro: Fly over it, climbing to {v} meters
textos.Pasas cuatro horas sirviendo comidas. Sa: You spend four hours serving meals. You leave tired and happy. It's {hora_txt}.
You walk past and go back to the pharmacy.
You move from one option to another in a menu.
textos.Pasas esa cantidad del efectivo a tu cue: You move that amount of cash into your account, if you're carrying it. With dirty money, the bank only accepts up to a certain amount a day without asking questions.
textos.Pasas por encima de la tormenta: abajo s: You pass over the storm: you can see the lightning below.
textos.Pasas {horas} horas en {negocio}: atiend: You spend {horas} hours at {negocio}: you serve, tidy up and chat with the customers. It shows. It's {hora}.
textos.Pase privado. Luces bajas, música lenta: Private dance. Low lights, slow music and a dance just for you, an arm's length away and without touching. You leave with your pulse racing.
textos.Pasean alrededor del lugar. Agachado se: They stroll around the place. Crouching you are heard within three meters; walking, six; running, eleven.
textos.Paseando un poco. ¿Y tú, qué haces por {: Just walking a bit. And you, what are you doing in {barrio}?
textos.Paseantes, rateros, pistoleros, ladrones: Passers-by, pickpockets, gunmen, car thieves and robbers the server runs, the same for everyone. They only appear where there are players. With 0, none.
textos.Paseo de las Palmeras: playa ancha, palm: Paseo de las Palmeras: wide beach, palm trees, hotels and lowered cars cruising slowly with the music loud. Water is never short here.
textos.Pasos en el muelle, pie derecho: Footsteps on the pier, right foot
textos.Pasos en el muelle, pie izquierdo: Footsteps on the pier, left foot
textos.Pasos en la acera, pie derecho: Footsteps on the sidewalk, right foot
textos.Pasos en la acera, pie izquierdo: Footsteps on the sidewalk, left foot
textos.Pasos en la calzada, pie derecho: Footsteps on the roadway, right foot
textos.Pasos en la calzada, pie izquierdo: Footsteps on the roadway, left foot
textos.Pasos en una plaza, pie derecho: Footsteps on a square, right foot
textos.Pasos en una plaza, pie izquierdo: Footsteps on a square, left foot
textos.Pasos sobre las vías, pie derecho: Footsteps on the tracks, right foot
textos.Pasos sobre las vías, pie izquierdo: Footsteps on the tracks, left foot
textos.Pasáis la noche juntos. La escena se res: You spend the night together. The scene fades out.
textos.Pasáis la noche y pasan unas horas. Si e: You spend the night together and a few hours go by. If it's the way they prefer, it brings you closer. What you bought for the occasion gets used up and makes a difference.
You have a good time together.
textos.Pasáis un rato agradable, aunque no es s: You have a pleasant time, though it's not their favorite plan.
textos.Pasó ocho años en el ejército. Empieza c: Spent eight years in the army. Starts with aim at level four, extra health, a switchblade and two first aid kits. Solves problems head on.
textos.Patrona de pesca de Costa Dorada. Empiez: Fishing boat captain of Costa Dorada. Starts with fishing at level five, good endurance, an oar, three hundred euros and the respect of the neighbors.
textos.Patrullas de policía circulando por la c: Police patrols driving around the streets
textos.Patrullas que hacen la ronda cerca del j: Patrols that make the rounds near the player, by day
textos.Pechera, hombreras, casco y protecciones: Chest plate, shoulder pads, helmet and arm and leg guards. Brings armor to 200, double a vest. Heavy, but it holds.
textos.Pedido de {local}. Perdone la espera, qu: Order from {local}. Sorry for the wait, the traffic was impossible.
textos.Pedir las llaves para una prueba y no vo: Ask for the keys for a test drive and not come back
textos.Pedir que te lo traigan: {precio} euros: Have it brought to you: {precio} euros
textos.Pedir un crédito de {importe} euros: {n}: Request a loan of {importe} euros: {n} payments of {cuota}
textos.Pedir un crédito personal, ver tus cuota: Request a personal loan, see your installments and pay them off, and check what you will be charged in bills and taxes. What they lend you depends on your standing, your steady income and your criminal record.
textos.Pedirle el número y ser amigos: Ask for their number and become friends
textos.Pedirle que se venga a vivir contigo: Ask them to move in with you
textos.Pedirle que sea tu pareja: Ask them to be your partner
textos.Pedirles tu parte por no haber visto nad: Ask them for your cut for not having seen anything
textos.Pedís en la barra y os vais a una esquin: You order at the bar and head to a quiet corner.
You apologize to the neighbor for the laughing.
textos.Pedís un postre para los dos y os peleái: You order one dessert for both and fight playfully over the last spoonful.
textos.Pega aquí la identidad que guardaste: Paste here the identity you saved
textos.Pegad[o|a] a la fachada, el helicóptero: Pressed against the facade, the helicopter cannot see you. Hold on like that for a few seconds.
textos.Pegado a una fachada. Al entrar en un ed: Pressed against a building front. When you enter a building they lose you at once.
textos.Pelea con {banda} en {nombre}, sin barri: Fight with {banda} in {nombre}, no neighborhood at stake
textos.Pelea en la calle: dos que se pegan: Street fight: two people hitting each other
textos.Pelear es de tontos. Correr es de listos: Fighting is for fools. Running is for the smart.
textos.Pelear por pelear. Si lo que quieres es: Fighting just to fight. If what you want is a fight with a gang without conquering anything, this menu has Look for a fight with a gang: they come for you wherever you are and there is no neighborhood at stake.
textos.Pelota, pesas de hierro fundido y combat: Pelota, cast-iron weights and bouts at festivals.
textos.Pequeña y muy volátil: puede doblar o hu: Small and very volatile: it can double or sink in a week. It pays no dividends.
textos.Pequeño, barato y nervioso. Escupe balas: Small, cheap and jumpy. Spits bullets at full speed.
Small, slow and easy to park.
textos.Pequeño, ruidoso y con más encanto que c: Small, loud and with more charm than horsepower.
textos.Perdona, hoy estoy que no doy una. Mi ex: Sorry, today I'm a mess. My ex has been waiting for me outside work for a week. Says he just wants to talk. Yesterday he broke my mirror.
textos.Perfecto. Ahora sabremos adónde va cada: Perfect. Now we'll know where he goes every night. My bet: the marina.
textos.Perfecto. Ya sabes orientarte a pie. Que: Perfect. You know how to get around on foot. Driving is next.
textos.Periodos sin avisos para irte con carta: Periods without warnings to leave with a letter of recommendation
textos.Permitir dos sesiones con la misma ident: Allow two sessions with the same identity
textos.Pero si ya lo sabes, {tu}. {yo}, el de s: But you already know, {tu}. {yo}, the same as always.
textos.Pero un título no te lo quita nadie. Con: But nobody can take a diploma away from you. With one you start as head waiter or journeyman; with the administration one, as manager. And without it, you can be a genius and never get past the first step.
textos.Pero van a volver, y nosotros solos no l: But they'll be back, and we can't make it alone. We have to talk to the dock people, even if it costs me.
textos.Perros recogidos de las naves abandonada: Dogs rescued from the abandoned warehouses. You can adopt one here.
textos.Persecución: un vehículo que no para: Chase: a vehicle that doesn't stop
textos.Perseguir y destruir un vehículo que huy: Chase and destroy a fleeing vehicle
textos.Persigue el Platino blindado de Belmonte: Chase Belmonte's armored Platino and stop it before time runs out. Press Q to lock onto it.
textos.Persigue el camión blindado de la compañ: Chase the company's armored truck and stop it any way you can. Press Q to lock onto it.
textos.Persigue el coche del comisario Varela y: Chase Chief Varela's car and stop it. Press Q to lock onto it.
textos.Persigue el coche del mensajero y destrú: Chase the courier's car and destroy it with your fists or with gunfire. Press Q to lock onto it: you'll hear where it is.
textos.Persigue el furgón blindado y reviéntalo: Chase the armored van and blow it up with grenades or with your fists. Press Q to lock onto it.
textos.Persigue el quad del furtivo por las cal: Chase the poacher's quad through the streets of the town and destroy it. Press Q to lock onto it.
textos.Persigue el todoterreno del capataz por: Chase the foreman's off-road vehicle through the streets of the town and destroy it. Press Q to lock onto it.
textos.Persigue la limusina de El Caimán y dest: Chase El Caimán's limousine and destroy it before time runs out. Press Q to lock onto it.
textos.Personaje para elegir al empezar: Character to choose at the start
textos.Personas a las que puedes conocer, con l: People you can get to know, meet up with and, if things go well, become partners, get engaged, live together and get married. No adult content.
textos.Personas, «{get}»: tiene que ser una per: People, "{get}": must be an adult, 18 or older.
textos.Pesa como un muerto y huele a siglos. Es: It weighs a ton and smells of centuries. It's perfect.
textos.Pesa lo suyo y tarda en volver, pero don: It's heavy and takes a while to come back, but where it lands, it lands.
Heavy and slow, but every blow counts. Not sold at the gun shops: you find it in the stores, with the hardware.
textos.Pesas de hierro fundido y un cuadriláter: Cast iron weights and a ring with history.
textos.Pescado a la sal, como se ha hecho siemp: Salt-baked fish, the way it has always been done here.
Fried fish fresh out of the sea.
textos.Pescador de Cala Brava. Manos ásperas, v: Fisherman from Cala Brava. Rough hands, soft voice, and the habit of looking at the sky before answering.
textos.Pescar en el mar, o sirena en vehículos: Fish at sea, or siren on emergency vehicles
textos.Peso del prestigio en la solvencia, por: Weight of standing in solvency, percent
textos.Pestañas. Cambie de pestaña con Control+: Tabs. Switch tabs with Ctrl+Tab or with the arrow keys.
textos.Peñas Altas, un pueblo minero colgado de: Peñas Altas, a mining town clinging to the mountainside. Slate houses, chimney smoke and an iron headframe you can see from all over the valley.
textos.Picos, carabinas de monte y, bajo el mos: Pickaxes, mountain carbines and, under the counter, what was left over from the mine.
textos.Pide al router de tu casa que abra el pu: Asks your home router to open the server port, so people can join from outside. It closes when the server stops. Not all routers allow it.
textos.Pides las llaves de un {nombre} para pro: You ask for the keys to a {nombre} for a test drive and drive off without paying. The dealership alarm goes off.
Asking the router to open the port...
textos.Pierdes lo que te daban y te ganas un en: You lose what they were giving you and you make an enemy. In exchange, you sleep again.
textos.Pierdes: como nadie te conoce, los guard: You lose: since nobody knows you, bodyguards charge you {int} percent more
textos.Pierdes: en las tiendas te cobran un {in: You lose: shops charge you {int} percent more, witnesses report you more eagerly
textos.Piezas de serie creadas. Si borras este: Default tracks created. If you delete this file, any missing ones are created again.
textos.Pilotando sin piloto automático, dos cha: While flying without autopilot, two clicks that sound on the side you need to steer toward. In the center and higher pitched, you are well lined up.
textos.Pilotando, cuatro pitidos apremiantes: q: While flying, four urgent beeps: fuel is very low, there is an obstacle or traffic ahead, or the engine has stopped.
textos.Pilotando, una nota que suena cada vez q: While flying, a note that sounds every time your altitude changes: the higher the pitch, the higher you fly.
textos.Piloto automático puesto. No vuela tan b: Autopilot on. It doesn't fly this low: climb to {int} meters.
textos.Piloto automático puesto: lleva el rumbo: Autopilot on: it holds the heading and altitude.
Autopilot off: you fly it yourself.
textos.Piloto automático quitado: pilotas tú. L: Autopilot off: you fly it yourself. The clicks tell you which way to turn.
textos.Piloto comercial. Con la licencia, que s: Commercial pilot. With the license, which you get at a flight academy, every airfield offers three flights a day, passengers or cargo. You fly to the destination airfield and get paid when you land. It is legal work.
textos.Piloto del GPS activado para cuando cond: GPS autopilot on for when you drive on land. In the air it doesn't take the controls
textos.Piloto del GPS activado, pero en el agua: GPS autopilot on, but it doesn't drive on water: only on land.
textos.Piloto del GPS activado, pero solo funci: GPS autopilot on, but it only works in assisted driving. Change it in Options, Movement and driving.
textos.Piloto del GPS activado. Marca un destin: GPS autopilot on. Set a destination on the GPS and the car will drive itself: it accelerates, brakes, turns and stops at traffic lights.
textos.Piloto del GPS activado: el coche va sol: GPS autopilot on: the car drives itself to {nombre}. Any arrow key or Space puts you back in control.
textos.Piloto del GPS, el coche va solo hasta e: GPS autopilot, the car drives itself to the destination
textos.Pintar y cambiar matrículas: {precio} eu: Repaint and change plates: {precio} euros. Removes the police search
textos.Pintura nueva y matrículas nuevas. La po: New paint and new plates. The police are no longer looking for this vehicle.
textos.Pintura y matrículas nuevas: la policía: New paint and plates: the police stop looking for you and for this vehicle. You can't with officers or a patrol car nearby.
Runway in sight. Keep it up: cleared.
textos.Pistas, pesas y piscina. Abierto a todo: Courts, weights and a pool. Open to everyone.
Think it over twice. And then a third time.
textos.Placas rígidas por delante y por detrás,: Rigid plates front and back, over the vest. Brings armor to 150: it holds half again as much as the vest alone.
textos.Plan de vuelo: volar a otra localidad: Flight plan: fly to another town
textos.Planchas calientes y sin una arruga. A l: Hot plates and not a wrinkle. By six it's at every newsstand.
textos.Planes para parejas: un paseo sin rumbo,: Plans for couples: an aimless walk, the movies, a dinner, a boat trip, an afternoon at the beach... Each one is told with a different scene every time. One a day.
textos.Plaza de hangar alquilada en {nombre}: {: Hangar space rented at {nombre}: {precio} euros a day, charged every midnight.
textos.Plaza de hangar alquilada: lo que cuesta: Rented hangar space: the cost per day
textos.Plazas, parques, playas y muelles. Las d: Squares, parks, beaches and piers. The rest are buildings.
textos.Plazos: una falta leve caduca a los {ent: Deadlines: a minor offense expires after {entero} days, a medium one after {entero2} and a serious one after {entero3}
textos.Pleno al 0, paga treinta y cinco a uno: Straight up on 0, pays thirty-five to one
textos.Pleno al 17, paga treinta y cinco a uno: Straight up on 17, pays thirty-five to one
textos.Pleno al 7, paga treinta y cinco a uno: Straight up on 7, pays thirty-five to one
Poor. A coffee and then home.
textos.Poco tiempo y mucha salud. El pescado no: Little time and lots of health. Fish doesn't wait: cook it soon.
textos.Podéis hacer carreras con apuesta y repa: You can race for bets and do team deliveries. And on foot, next to a friend's parked vehicle, F gets you in as a passenger.
textos.Pone el servidor en marcha. También con: Starts the server. Also with F5.
textos.Poner el transporte público que falte: Add the public transport that is missing
textos.Poner música bajita y servir dos copas: Put on soft music and pour two drinks
textos.Poner nivel de búsqueda y despistar a la: Set wanted level and lose the police
textos.Poner un bar. Todo el mundo quiere poner: Opening a bar. Everybody wants to open a bar.
textos.Poner una marca en el registro de la ses: Put a mark in the session log
textos.Ponerlos de tu bolsillo y no decir nada: Pay them out of your own pocket and say nothing
You set two plates. {n} has seconds.
textos.Pones el {_nombre} y te quedas sin ficha: You play the {_nombre} and run out of tiles.
textos.Pones la mesa para ti y das cuenta de to: You set the table for yourself and polish it all off.
textos.Pones los cuarenta euros. La semana que: You put in the forty euros. Next week it's missing again, and now you don't know why.
textos.Pones tu precio. Otro jugador lo compra: You set your price. Another player buys it at the door and the money comes to you, whether you are connected or not.
textos.Pones una ficha de {apuesta} euros a un: You put a {apuesta} euro chip on a single number out of thirty-seven. If it comes up, you win {premio} euros plus your chip.
textos.Pones una ficha de {apuesta} euros y gir: You put down a {apuesta} euro chip and the ball spins. If you win, you get your chip back and the same again. With zero you lose.
textos.Pones una ficha de {apuesta} euros. Acie: You put down a {apuesta} euro chip. You win if one of those twelve numbers comes up, and you win twice the chip. With zero you lose.
textos.Por carretera no. En el helipuerto está: Not by road. The company helicopter is at the heliport. Have you ever flown one?
textos.Por cierto: el fondo que compró la coope: By the way: the fund that bought the Villaseca cooperative is also a client of ours. They already know you there. Everything stays in the family.
textos.Por debajo de 1, esa sustancia es barata: Below 1, that substance is cheap here.
textos.Por debajo de esta lealtad, alguien pued: Below this loyalty, someone may betray you
textos.Por debajo de esta lealtad, un camello s: Below this loyalty, a dealer keeps a bit more and, if arrested, talks
textos.Por debajo se pierden solo las de fuego,: Below it, only firearms are lost, as in any arrest.
textos.Por dónde escucha el servidor y cómo pro: Where the server listens and how it protects the connection.
textos.Por dónde va, cada {get} segundos; con l: Where they are, every {get} seconds; with help, every {get2}
textos.Por dónde vas en la historia. Debajo est: Where you are in the story. Below are your decisions and the missions you have done.
textos.Por ejemplo 0,7 para un 30 por ciento de: For example 0.7 for a 30 percent discount.
textos.Por ejemplo motor_moto. Con otros, vale: For example motor_moto. With otros, it applies to all those not in the list.
textos.Por ejemplo, una alarma: con 75, entran: For example, an alarm: with 75, four times fewer break-ins.
textos.Por ejemplo: Jornada de panadero. Sale e: For example: Baker's shift. It appears at the job center.
textos.Por encima, la policía de tierra no te s: Above that, the ground police do not follow you and the radar sees you.
textos.Por encima, pide explicaciones, no lo ad: Above it, they ask questions, won't accept it and notify the tax office.
textos.Por eso ahora el banco no te presta. Cua: That's why the bank won't lend to you right now. When it's sorted out, the loans it offers you appear here.
That's why it's not a robbery. It's a collection.
textos.Por eso rompen las bocas y arrancan las: That's why they break the hydrants and rip out the pipes. They don't want to sell you water, Dani. They want the neighborhood empty so they can build.
textos.Por eso te doy granadas. Lánzalas con Es: That's why I'm giving you grenades. Throw them with Space toward the locked target. And don't stay close.
textos.Por eso te lo pido a ti y no voy yo. Cua: That's why I'm asking you and not going myself. When you have it, shake off the police and take it to the scrapyard, where they'd change even its name.
That's why. Throw them out and bring me back the tractor.
textos.Por esta carretera solo se sale en un ve: This road can only be left in a vehicle: drive up to here and press Enter without getting out. On foot, you travel by bus, from the station.
textos.Por esta vez, un aviso. Arranca despacio: Just a warning this time. He pulls away slowly, as if carrying eggs.
textos.Por favor, nada de peleas. No merece la: Please, no fights. It's not worth it.
textos.Por hoy ya no compramos más. Vuelve maña: No more buying for today. Come back tomorrow, or try another scrapyard.
textos.Por la mañana levantas la persiana y sal: In the morning you raise the shutter and greet Casilda, who goes by with her shopping cart. At night you count bills that didn't come in through the door.
textos.Por lo robado el prestamista paga mucho: The pawnbroker pays much less for stolen goods: he knows where they come from.
textos.Por mar también se llega a muchos sitios: You can reach a lot of places by sea too, if you have a boat.
textos.Por muy poco. Lo vas a ver en un papel c: By a hair. You'll be seeing this on official letterhead.
textos.Por un objeto encontrado, la casa de emp: For a found item, the pawn shop pays this percent of its value
textos.Por un objeto robado, este por ciento: For a stolen item, this percent
textos.Por un vehículo que no es tuyo, el desgu: For a vehicle that isn't yours, the scrapyard pays this percent
textos.Potaje de la sierra y pan de horno de le: Mountain stew and wood-fired oven bread.
textos.Precio de cambiar la rueda en el taller: Price of changing the wheel at the repair shop
textos.Precio de la mochila grande, en euros: Price of the big backpack, in euros
textos.Precio de partida de la acción, en euros: Starting price of the stock, in euros
textos.Precio del curso de recuperación de punt: Price of the points recovery course
textos.Precio del litro en esta gasolinera: Price per liter at this gas station
textos.Precio del primer nivel de refuerzo: Price of the first reinforcement level
textos.Precio del recurso de un abogado, por gr: Price of a lawyer's appeal, per degree
textos.Precio en concesionario o náutica: Price at the car dealership or boat dealer
textos.Precio para otros jugadores. Cero para n: Price for other players. Zero to not sell it
textos.Precios {precios}. {ayuda} Ahora da {ing: Prices {precios}. {ayuda} It now earns {ingreso_negocio} euros a day.
textos.Precisión {_grado}: acierta {int} de cad: Accuracy {_grado}: hits {int} out of a hundred, and less the farther away
I'd rather not talk about that with you.
I'd rather not talk about that.
textos.Pregunta a los mayores. Saben más de lo: Ask the elders. They know more than it seems.
textos.Pregunta en el bar, que allí se enteran: Ask at the bar, they find out everything there.
textos.Pregunta en la oficina de empleo. Jornad: Ask at the job center. There are work shifts.
textos.Pregunta en la taberna. Allí apuntan los: Ask at the tavern. They write down the jobs in chalk there.
textos.Preguntar a qué se dedica: Ask what they do for a living
textos.Pregúntame qué se cuenta por ahí y te di: Ask me what people are saying around here and I'll tell you the latest.
textos.Premio de más por cada cinco objetos de: Extra prize for every five collectibles
textos.Premio de más por cada victoria que llev: Extra prize for each victory you have
textos.Premio por encontrar todos los objetos d: Prize for finding all the collectibles
textos.Prendas sin un estilo concreto, con su p: Clothes without a specific style, with their price. What's already yours you put on for free.
textos.Prepara el doctorado en San Lucero y cen: She is working on her doctorate in San Lucero and has a sandwich for dinner almost every night. Curious, ironic and opinionated about everything.
textos.Preparando las voces de tu personaje, pa: Preparing your character's voices, so the story can call you by your name. This only happens the first time. It takes a few seconds; press Escape if you'd rather start now.
textos.Preparando las voces de tu personaje: {h: Preparing your character's voices: {hechas} of {meta}. Escape to start now.
textos.Preparar el golpe con tu banda: repartir: Plan the heist with your gang: hand out the roles before the robbery
textos.Preparar {que}: {nombre}. Tienes al lado: Set up {que}: {nombre}. You have {len} of {v} next to you
textos.Presentarte a {nombre}, que está aquí mi: Introduce yourself to {nombre}, who is right here
textos.Presentas la dimisión. {jefe}: «Aquí tie: You hand in your resignation. {jefe}: "The door is always open for you."
textos.Prestigio desde el que las bandas te tra: Standing from which gangs treat you as a good person
textos.Prestigio entre los vecinos para ingresa: Standing with the neighbors to join, from 0 to 100
textos.Prestigio inicial entre los vecinos, de: Starting standing with the neighbors, from 0 to 100
textos.Prestigio que da conseguir un título: Standing gained by earning a qualification
textos.Prestigio que da o quita: Standing it gives or takes away
textos.Prestigio que da un periodo bien evaluad: Standing gained by a well-evaluated period
textos.Prestigio que quita salir en el periódic: Standing lost by appearing in the newspaper
textos.Preséntate a los vecinos, que luego son: Introduce yourself to the neighbors, because they're the ones who lend you change, hold a package for you or warn you if they see something odd. Paco's Grocery Store, Luna Pharmacy and the fish market. Tell them I sent you.
textos.Preséntate allí con un coche. Salís tres: Show up there with a car. Three of you start. You can hear the other two engines: you'll know whether you have them ahead of you or behind you.
textos.Preséntate en Ultramarinos Paco, en la F: Introduce yourself at Paco's Grocery Store, Luna Pharmacy and the fish market, in that order.
textos.Prima por una evaluación buena, por cien: Bonus for a good evaluation, percent of the payslip
textos.Prima, en tanto por ciento de la tarifa: Bonus, in percent of the recruiting rate
textos.Primer ejercicio: fija el muñeco con la: First exercise: lock onto the dummy with Q, walk up to it and hit it with Space.
textos.Primer ejercicio: ir andando a la Farmac: First exercise: walk to Luna Pharmacy. Press L, find the pharmacy in the list and press Enter. The GPS will tell you which way to go and you'll hear a beacon: walk toward the sound. G repeats the direction.
textos.Primer ejercicio: llega a la Farmacia Lu: First exercise: get to Luna Pharmacy. Press L to set it on the GPS and follow the beacon, or press U to walk there alone.
textos.Primer ejercicio: zarpar. Pulsa Intro aq: First exercise: set sail. Press Enter here, at the pier, and choose the tutorial practice boat, which is free.
textos.Primera entrega: la casa baja de la call: First delivery: the low house on Calle del Cauce. Two minutes.
textos.Primera manzana, de oeste a este: First block, from west to east
textos.Primera manzana, de sur a norte: First block, from south to north
textos.Primera válvula: la Desaladora. Tienes d: First valve: the Desalination Plant. You have two and a half minutes.
textos.Primera y última manzana, empezando en c: First and last block, starting at zero.
textos.Primero el reparto, que te conozco desde: Deliveries first, I've known you since you were in diapers.
textos.Primero elige algo con el radar, pulsand: First choose something with the radar, pressing Tab.
textos.Primero es un temblor en el suelo. Luego: First it's a tremor in the ground. Then, from every hydrant in the neighborhood at once, water comes out.
textos.Primero las guerras, luego las bandas y: Wars first, then gangs, then who owns each neighborhood
textos.Primero lo que está en venta. Intro marc: What is for sale first. Enter marks the location on the GPS
textos.Primero, el Depósito municipal: abre pas: First, the Municipal Depot: clear a path through the guards.
textos.Primero, las que puedes hacer ahora: First, the ones you can make now
textos.Primero, los vigías de {banda}: 2, junto: First, the {banda} lookouts: 2, next to {nombre}. Don't let them raise the alarm.
textos.Probabilidad de que a alguien sin nervio: Chance that someone with no nerves fails, percent
textos.Probabilidad de que alguien se haga el h: Chance that someone plays the hero, percent
textos.Probabilidad de que dañen el negocio si: Chance that the business is damaged if you refuse, percent
textos.Probabilidad de que den la alarma antes: Chance that they raise the alarm early, percent
textos.Probabilidad de que detengan al vigilant: Chance that the lookout is arrested, percent
textos.Probabilidad de que el soborno salga bie: Chance that the bribe goes well, percent
textos.Probabilidad de que hieran al escolta si: Chance that the escort is wounded if there is a guard, percent
textos.Probabilidad de que los vecinos encubran: Chance that the neighbors cover up an offense, percent
textos.Probabilidad de que no te atiendan, por: Chance that they do not serve you, percent
textos.Probabilidad de que salga mal, por cient: Chance that it goes badly, percent
textos.Probabilidad de que uno de una banda dej: Chance that a gang member lets good people through, percent
textos.Probabilidad de una decisión de responsa: Chance of a responsibility decision in each shift, percent
textos.Probabilidad diaria de que te pare un ag: Daily chance that an officer stops you, percent
textos.Probador de la Escudería Viento Sur hast: Test driver for the Viento Sur Racing Team until he crashed the boss's car. Starts with driving at level six: nobody drives better. In exchange, he has almost no money.
textos.Propina por completar el reparto: Tip for completing the delivery run
textos.Proponer a los demás jugadores una carre: Propose a race with a bet or a team delivery run to the other players, or sign up for the one they have proposed.
textos.Proponer una alianza a otra banda o romp: Propose an alliance to another gang or break one you have. Allies can't hurt each other or declare war on each other.
textos.Proponer una carrera hasta un lugar: 100: Propose a race to a place: 100 euro bet
textos.Proponerle ir a un hotel: {precio} euros: Suggest going to a hotel: {precio} euros
textos.Proponerle que se una a tu banda: prima: Ask them to join your gang: bonus of {prima_recluta} euros
textos.Proponerle salir contigo a dar una vuelt: Suggest going out for a stroll together
textos.Propones un reparto en equipo en {nombre: You propose a team delivery run in {nombre}: four deliveries in six minutes. When your friends accept, press Start.
textos.Propones una carrera hasta {nombre} con: You propose a race to {nombre} with a bet of {apuesta} euros. When your friends accept, press Start.
textos.Proteger a alguien de quienes llegan a p: Protect someone from those coming for them and take them to a safe place
textos.Prueba a pescar. Engancha, y nunca mejor: Try fishing. It hooks you, literally.
textos.Prueba de salud sexual, gratis. El trata: Sexual health test, free. Treatment, if needed, {precio} euros
textos.Prueba del motor de voz en un proceso ap: Voice engine test in a separate process
Try another airfield, or come back another day.
textos.Práctica de un tutorial: comprueba que e: Tutorial practice: checks that the player does something
textos.Práctica que da cada plato cocinado, de: Practice each cooked dish gives, from 0 to 100
textos.Próximo cobro de facturas e impuestos, d: Next collection of bills and taxes, in {quedan} days: nothing for now.
textos.Próximo sorteo, {cuando_txt}. Bote: {lot: Next draw, {cuando_txt}. Jackpot: {lot_bote} euros. You have {n} {v}
textos.Puede invitar, sacar de la caja, reclama: They can invite, take from the till, claim neighborhoods and declare wars.
textos.Puede marcharse, o plantarte cara. Baja: They might walk away, or stand up to you. Your standing goes down.
textos.Puede salir bien o mal, según la confian: It can go well or badly, depending on trust, your mood and what the other person is looking for. No means no.
textos.Puede salir bien, o puedes llevarte un g: It might go well, or you might take a hit.
textos.Puedes comer en un bar, pedir comida a d: You can eat at a bar, order food delivered to one of your homes, or buy groceries at a food store and cook at home, which is the most filling.
You can trust me. I won't say a word.
textos.Puedes fundar la tuya aquí debajo, o esp: You can found your own just below, or wait for the boss or the right hand of another gang to invite you.
textos.Puedes quedarte el bate y la pistola. En: You can keep the bat and the pistol. The gun shops have more, and a shooting range to keep practicing.
textos.Puedes responder sin bajarte: pulsa Q pa: You can fight back without getting out: press Q to lock on to whoever is nearby and Ctrl to fire from the vehicle, with a firearm in hand. The I key switches weapons.
textos.Puedes trabajar con un taxi, repartir pi: You can work with a taxi, deliver pizzas, drive ambulances, buses and trucks, fish, run races, buy houses, businesses, cars and boats, or gamble your money at the casino. The phone, with the M key, brings it all together.
textos.Puerto Bravo no puede funcionar en este: Puerto Bravo can't run on this computer. Its processor is too old: it lacks instructions that the game's sound engine needs. It's not an installation problem and downloading it again won't fix it. You need a computer with a processor made from around 2009 onward.
textos.Puerto Bravo, Villaseca y San Lucero qui: Puerto Bravo, Villaseca and San Lucero want to sign an agreement together, and someone doesn't want those papers to arrive.
textos.Puerto Bravo. Una ciudad de mar, con un: Puerto Bravo. A city by the sea, with a harbor that never sleeps and a beach that never rests.
Well, now that you mention it, I don't know.
textos.Pues bien, aunque esta mañana me he leva: Well, fine, although this morning I got up with a pain right here in my side, you wouldn't believe it, but it went away with a coffee.
textos.Pues en el bar de abajo ponen una tapa c: Well, the bar downstairs gives you a tapa with every beer, so you eat dinner for free. I go on Thursdays, when there's tripe. Well, and Tuesdays. And some Mondays.
Well, that's just what I said yesterday.
Then we'll have to knock on the door.
textos.Pues hoy es un buen día. Sube, despega y: Well, today is a good day. Get in, take off and, without leaving the heliport, press Enter to set course for Puerto Bravo.
textos.Pues iba a la farmacia, pero me he encon: Well, I was going to the pharmacy, but I ran into Paqui, then the guy from the kiosk, then you... At this rate I'll get there tomorrow.
textos.Pues igualito que lo que me pasó a mí. B: Well, just like what happened to me. Okay, similar.
Well, I owe you... no, wait. I owe you. Those are the rules.
textos.Pues mira, de salud bien, que es lo impo: Well, health-wise I'm good, which is what matters.
textos.Pues mira, de {oficio} llevo desde los d: Well, I've been a {oficio} since I was sixteen, and I've seen it all. The other day, just for example, a guy came in who... well, better not tell you, you'll get me in trouble.
textos.Pues mira, mi cuñado buscaba a uno para: Well, my brother-in-law was looking for someone for a construction job, but he already found him. It was his cousin. Everything stays in the family here.
textos.Pues mira, mi rodilla dice que va a llov: Well, my knee says it's going to rain, and my knee hasn't been wrong since ninety-two. Not even the weatherman.
textos.Pues mira, nací el año que se inundó el: Well, I was born the year the market flooded, so do the math. And I remember it perfectly. Well, they told me about it.
Well, look, I hadn't thought of it that way.
Then he won't get to file his report.
textos.Pues no, y eso que le he dado vueltas. A: Well, no, and I've turned it over in my mind. Other things too, but turned it over.
textos.Pues ya te irás haciendo. Al principio t: You'll get the hang of it. At first all the streets look the same.
textos.Pues yo el arroz lo hago con el caldo de: Well, I make my rice with my grandmother's broth, which has monkfish head and ñora pepper, and a secret I can't tell you because she'd disown me from the other world.
textos.Pues {hora}, que acabo de oír las campan: Well, {hora}, I just heard the bells. Well, the bells have run fast since they fixed them, so take five minutes off.
That will be {total}. Come back anytime.
textos.Puesto {v}: {nombre}. {int} turnos por p: Position {v}: {nombre}. {int} shifts per period, {int2} euros of payroll
textos.Puestos de fruta, embutidos y encurtidos: Stalls of fruit, cured meats and pickles under an iron roof.
textos.Puestos, del primero al más alto: Positions, from the first to the highest
textos.Pulsa C en cualquier momento para saber: Press C at any time to find out where you are. Press Tab to sweep what is near you with the radar: each thing sounds from its position and is announced with its distance.
Press Enter to continue the trip.
