textos.REGISTRO DE UNA SESIÓN DE PUERTO BRAVO::
SESSION LOG OF PUERTO BRAVO: LEY DEL ASFALTO

If the game has crashed on you, compress this whole folder into a ZIP and send it to whoever makes the game.
With it, they can see what happened without being there.

WHAT IT CONTAINS
  sistema.txt       Game version, Windows version, screen reader, sound, mods, packs and options.
  sesion.log        What has happened in this session, in order: screens opened, keys pressed in the game,
                    what the game has said, the state of the game every few seconds, warnings and errors.
  errores.log       The errors, with their technical detail.
  fallo_grave.log   It only has anything if the program shut down abruptly.

WHAT IT DOES NOT CONTAIN
  Nothing you type in text boxes: messages, passwords, addresses or keys.
  No chat messages, no name of yours on the network, no names of your friends.
  No internet addresses, no Windows user name, no computer name, no folder paths.
  No names of your music, no saved games.

They are text files: you can open and read them before sending them.
The last five sessions are kept; older ones are deleted automatically.

textos.Se lee en el menú y en «Cómo funciona es: It is read in the menu and in "How this works".
textos.Se lleva además de la ropa: uno de cada: Worn on top of the clothes: one of each kind. Wearing something new lifts your mood.
textos.Se lo das ahora, si te llega. Cuanto más: You give it to them now, if you have enough. The more you give, the closer it brings you. Once a day.
textos.Se lo dices a esa banda. Si su jefe ya o: You tell that gang. If their boss had already proposed it to you, it is sealed; if not, it is sealed when they do.
textos.Se lo lleva ahora y, a los {dias} días,: He takes it now and, after {dias} days, pays into your bank what is left after his {comision} percent. Now and then he vanishes with the money.
textos.Se lo pides al servidor: si tienes el di: You ask the server for it: if you have the money and it is still for sale, the business becomes yours.
You ask the server for it: if you have the money and it is still for sale, the home becomes yours.
textos.Se lo pides para esta casa. Dice que sí: You ask them to move into this home. They say yes if you get along well enough and have been on dates; if not, you'll have to wait a few days to ask again.
textos.Se marchan y dejan de cobrarte los {prec: They leave and stop charging you the {precio} euros each midnight.
textos.Se me ha calado. Ya está, ya arranca. He: It stalled on me. There, it's starting. We lost our head start.
textos.Se me ha partido la ganzúa. Empiezo otra: My lockpick snapped. I'm starting over.
textos.Se me ha pasado. ¡Están ahí mismo!: It slipped past me. They're right there!
textos.Se me ha puesto malo el de la limusina y: My limousine driver has fallen ill and I have a singer waiting at Hotel Medianoche. Do you drive smoothly?
textos.Se me ha roto la pantalla tres veces est: I've broken my screen three times this year.
textos.Se miran un rato largo. Luego la Fundi p: They look at each other for a long moment. Then La Fundi puts two glasses on the table.
textos.Se multiplica por su valor: los de poco: It is multiplied by their value: those with little personality almost never.
textos.Se oye que hay alguien moviendo los hilo: Word is somebody is pulling strings at the harbor. New people.
textos.Se oye un helicóptero: la policía te bus: A helicopter is heard: the police are looking for you from the air too. {situar}. While it has you located you cannot lose anyone: press against a facade, go into a building or switch vehicles without it seeing you.
textos.Se oye un timbre al fondo: han dado la a: A bell rings in the back: someone raised the alarm while you were opening it.
textos.Se oye una ambulancia: viene a atender a: An ambulance is heard: it is coming to tend to the wounded.
textos.Se pasa el efecto de una sustancia y lle: The effect of a substance wears off and the crash comes.
textos.Se pasa el efecto de {lower} y llega el: The effect of {lower} wears off and the crash arrives.
textos.Se pesca al atardecer, con el sol de car: Fishing is at sunset, with the sun in your face.
textos.Se pide en el propio local que quiera co: You request it at the very premises you want to buy: right there they let you choose between paying cash or with a mortgage. The better your name and the higher your income, the better the terms.
textos.Se premia por las últimas cifras que coi: Prizes go by the last digits that match the number drawn: the last one, the refund, {v} euros; the last two, {v2}; the last three, {v3}; the last four, {v4}; and all five, the jackpot, which grows every day nobody wins it.
textos.Se puede hacer con el vehículo del jugad: Can be done with the player's vehicle
textos.Se pueden usar {quien}, el apodo del obj: You can use {quien}, the target's nickname; {lugar}; {n}, how many are with them; {modelo}, the vehicle; {objeto}; {persona} and {destino}.
textos.Se queda aquí, con comida y agua, hasta: It stays here, with food and water, until you come back for it or call it from the phone.
textos.Se queda en la caja de cada negocio hast: It stays in each business's cash box until you come by for it. Going in person gets you ten percent more. Each cash box holds seven days: anything over that is lost.
textos.Se queda fuera. Cuando salta la alarma,: Stays outside. When the alarm goes off, they stall the police a while and tell you over the radio how long until they arrive.
textos.Se queda un {entero} por ciento y, a los: They keep {entero} percent and, after {entero2} days, deposit it in your bank, clean. They can't always be trusted
textos.Se quedan contigo {_cuantos}, que no cab: {_cuantos} stay with you, as they don't fit.
textos.Se recluta gente en Territorios, Tu band: People are recruited in Territories, Your gang. You need at least one territory.
They are visited in the order they appear. The time limit, if you set one, covers the whole route.
textos.Se recorren en este orden. Sin ninguno,: They are visited in this order. With none, shops of this type do not sell food to take home.
textos.Se recuerda a los comercios que refuerce: Stores are reminded to strengthen their alarms after the latest robberies.
textos.Se rompe al momento y se avisa a esa ban: It breaks immediately and that gang is told. From then on you can hurt each other and declare war.
textos.Se rompe un cristal: una ventanilla o un: Glass breaks: a car window or a shop window.
textos.Se rumorea en la calle que alguna banda: Word on the street is that some gang is planning something against one of your neighborhoods, today. Nobody can tell you more.
textos.Se separan refunfuñando y cada uno se va: They separate, grumbling, and each goes their own way.
textos.Se sigue caducando el mismo día. Se come: It still expires on the same day. It is eaten from the phone, in Inventory.
Joins the defense of the neighborhood.
textos.Se te acaba la concentración. Tiempo nor: Your focus runs out. Normal time.
textos.Se te cierran los ojos. Apuntas peor y v: Your eyes are closing. You aim worse and move slower.
textos.Se te ha escapado. La central anota la d: He got away from you. Dispatch notes the description and moves on.
textos.Se te ha escapado. Pulsa P para lanzar o: It got away. Press P to cast again.
textos.Se te ha pegado un poco al fondo. Se pue: It stuck a little to the bottom. You can eat it, but it's not the same.
textos.Se te va de las manos y arde. Sales tosi: It gets out of hand and catches fire. You come out coughing, with burns. The lab is lost, and half the neighborhood has called the police.
textos.Se usa el primero que exista. Si va en u: The first one that exists is used. If it is in a vehicle, they arrive in it.
textos.Se usa el primero que vaya en un vehícul: The first one that is in a vehicle is used.
textos.Se va a borrar la cuenta de %s con su pe:
The account of %s will be deleted with its character, its houses and businesses and its place in the gang. It can't be undone.

If that person joins again, they will start from scratch. To keep them from coming back, what you need to do is ban them.
textos.Se va a tu vivienda y te espera allí, co: It goes to your home and waits for you there, with food and water. You need to have a house. To bring it back, you call it from this same menu.
textos.Se va de la banda para siempre y deja de: They leave the gang for good and stop collecting their pay.
The founder of Lucero Technology leaves.
textos.Se va porque te busca la policía: Leaves because the police are after you
textos.Se va sin hacerte daño. Solo pierdes una: He leaves without hurting you. You only lose part of what you're carrying, and your mood drops. He doesn't touch what's in the bank or at home.
textos.Se va y no vuelve. Tu banda tiene una pe: They leave and don't come back. Your gang is one person down.
textos.Se va. Ha cargado su todoterreno y tira: He's leaving. He has loaded his off-roader and is heading for the Puerto Bravo road. If he makes it, he'll come back with more people.
textos.Se van a cambiar los datos del servidor: The server data will be replaced with the data from backup %s. What is there now is saved to another backup first, just in case.%s
textos.Se van en dos lanchas, despacio, sin dar: They leave in two boats, slowly, without turning their backs on you.
textos.Se van todos los que llevas y dejan de c: All the ones you have leave and stop charging you every midnight.
textos.Se vende en las tiendas que tengan ese p: Sold in shops that have that aisle.
textos.Se viene contigo de verdad: te sigue a p: They really come with you: they follow you on foot and get into whatever vehicle you drive. Walking, taking them to eat, to a bar, to the movies or to the fair pleases them and brings you closer. Not if you get into trouble with the police. Once a day; it lasts three game hours at most.
textos.Se vuela alto desde {get} metros; la tra: You fly high from {get} meters; the crossing goes {get2} times faster than the clock
textos.Secuestrar el aparato de línea que está: Hijack the airliner that is about to depart
textos.Secuestrar el {nombre} de línea y quedár: Hijack the airline {nombre} and keep it
textos.Secuestrar un aparato. En un helipuerto,: Hijack an aircraft. At a heliport, an airport or an airfield, on foot and with a firearm in your hand, you can take the airliner that was about to depart. It is a major crime: wanted level {entero}, a serious criminal record entry and, if you have the police helicopter turned on, it comes after you.
textos.Secuestrarlo por encargo: dejarlo junto: Hijack it on contract: leave it next to {nombre}, in {nombre2}, {km_txt} kilometers away, for {paga} euros
textos.Sed que quita beber en una fuente: Thirst quenched by drinking from a fountain
textos.Sed, higiene, averías y normas de tráfic: Thirst, hygiene, breakdowns and traffic rules
textos.Seguir a alguien a pie sin que te descub: Follow someone on foot without being noticed
textos.Seguir a pie a su recadero hasta la guar: Follow their runner on foot to the hideout, then take them out
Second delivery: the Neighborhood Soup Kitchen.
Second valve: the Municipal Depot. A minute and a half.
textos.Segundo ejercicio: hay dos dianas. Fija: Second exercise: there are two targets. Lock onto one with Q, fire with Space until it falls, then the other. Pressing Q again switches to the next target.
textos.Segundo ejercicio: llega a Ultramarinos: Second exercise: get to Paco's Grocery Store. Find it with Tab and set it with B.
textos.Segundo ejercicio: llegar a Ultramarinos: Second exercise: get to Paco's Grocery Store using the radar. Press F6 until you hear places, then Tab until you hear Paco's Grocery Store, and then B.
textos.Segundo ejercicio: llevar el timón. Acel: Second exercise: take the helm. Accelerate with the up arrow and sail about two hundred meters, turning with the left and right arrows until you change course. C tells you where you're heading.
textos.Segundo ejercicio: tumba las dos dianas: Second exercise: knock down both targets with the pistol. Q to lock on, Space to fire, R to reload.
textos.Segundos al descubierto para que te reco: Seconds in the open before they recognize you
textos.Segundos antes de que lleguen a los que: Seconds before those they warn again arrive
textos.Segundos de aviso antes de reiniciar por: Seconds of warning before restarting for an update or maintenance
textos.Segundos de espera entre una pelea busca: Seconds of waiting between one sought-out fight and the next
textos.Segundos de la caja según el tipo de loc: Seconds for the safe depending on the type of venue
textos.Segundos de más antes de darlo por perdi: Extra seconds before giving it up as lost, with help
textos.Segundos de más que gana el conductor si: Extra seconds the driver gains if they have not arrived yet
textos.Segundos de respiro entre oleadas, como: Seconds of breathing room between waves, at least
textos.Segundos de travesía entre un suceso y e: Seconds of crossing between one event and the next, roughly
textos.Segundos de vuelo que pasan en cada segu: Seconds of flight that pass in each second of crossing
textos.Segundos detrás de él con la sirena para: Seconds behind them with the siren on for them to stop
textos.Segundos en los que cuentan esas bajas: Seconds during which those casualties count
textos.Segundos entre disparo y disparo del tir: Seconds between each of the shooter's shots
textos.Segundos entre dos avisos de por dónde v: Seconds between two updates on where they are heading
textos.Segundos entre dos avisos, como poco: Seconds between two alerts, at least
textos.Segundos entre dos avisos, con la ayuda: Seconds between two alerts, with help
textos.Segundos entre dos frases de gente que h: Seconds between two lines from people fleeing
textos.Segundos fuera de su vista para que te p: Seconds out of their sight for them to lose you
textos.Segundos hasta que vuelve otro: Seconds until another one comes back
textos.Segundos para dejar paso al otro aparato: Seconds to give way to the other aircraft
textos.Segundos para la doble pulsación del obj: Seconds for the target's double press
textos.Segundos que entretiene el vigilante a l: Seconds the lookout stalls the police
textos.Segundos que se puede estar fuera del ba: Seconds you can stay out of the neighborhood without losing the fight
textos.Segundos que se retrasa el conductor que: Seconds the late driver is delayed, at least
textos.Segundos que sigue buscando antes de irs: Seconds they keep searching before leaving
textos.Segundos que tarda en abrirse o cogerse: Seconds it takes to open or be taken
textos.Segundos que tarda en llegar la policía: Seconds it takes the police to arrive
textos.Segundos que tarda una caja, como poco: Seconds a safe takes, at least
textos.Segundos que te acompaña, como poco: Seconds they stay with you, at least
textos.Segundos sin poder herir ni ser herido a: Seconds without being able to hurt or be hurt when coming in and when respawning.
textos.Segundos volando bajo sobre una localida: Seconds flying low over a town for the radar to lose you
textos.Segundos, como poco, entre dos giros can: Seconds, at least, between two called-out turns
textos.Segundos, de media, entre dos chillidos: Average seconds between two screams from someone fleeing
textos.Seguro contratado. Cubre a todos tus veh: Insurance taken out. It covers all your land vehicles from tomorrow. Every midnight {seguro_cuota} euros are charged for each one you have on the street; those in the garage don't pay. If one blows up, it is returned repaired and with its upgrades the next day, paying the deductible.
textos.Seguro dado de baja. Lo que esté ya en m: Insurance canceled. Whatever is already in the insurer's hands is still returned to you.
Vehicle insurance: not taken out. It would cost {v} euros a day with the ones you currently have on the street.{espera}
textos.Seguro de tus vehículos: {cubre}. Pagas: Vehicle insurance: {cubre}. You pay {seguro_cuota} euros a day for each one on the street; right now, {v}. You have paid {int} euros so far, deductibles included.{espera}
textos.Según los planos, hay una sala de válvul: According to the blueprints, there's a valve room at the desalination plant. With the master key, the whole Cauce branch opens, no meter.
Six bullets that kick like a mule.
textos.Seis meses de sueldo para trescientas fa: Six months of wages for three hundred families. Tonight everyone in Monteferro eats. Your share, you earned it.
textos.Seis unidades. Evitan sustos: sin ellos,: Six units. They prevent scares: without them, every encounter with someone you don't know well has its risk.
textos.Seiscientos euros cada medianoche, pero: Six hundred euros every midnight, but today you'll have to deal with all three groups' people, and tomorrow with their resentment.
textos.Seiscientos euros. Le dirás que ya estab: Six hundred euros. You'll tell her it was already empty. Maybe she'll believe you.
textos.Seisdedos ha dejado de comprarme y ahora: Seisdedos has stopped buying from me and now loads it himself. He has people at the pier putting copper on a barge.
textos.Seisdedos saca por mar lo que ya no pued: Seisdedos is taking out by sea what he can no longer take out by land.
textos.Seisdedos sale del coche cojeando, con l: Seisdedos gets out of the car limping, hands up, and waits for the police sitting on the curb.
textos.Seisdedos se va. Ha vaciado la caja de l: Seisdedos is leaving. He's emptied the company's cash box and is heading for the highway in his SUV.
textos.Seisdedos viene a cobrarse lo del embarc: Seisdedos is coming to collect for the pier incident.
textos.Selector de fecha. Cambie día, mes y año: Date picker. Change the day, month and year with the arrow keys.
textos.Selector de hora. Cambie horas y minutos: Time picker. Change the hours and minutes with the arrow keys.
textos.Selector de ruta. Escriba la ruta o use: Path picker. Type the path or use the Select button.
textos.Semiautomática y precisa a media distanc: Semi-automatic and accurate at medium range.
Simple and comfortable. Doesn't draw attention.
textos.Sentarlos y repartir los turnos entre lo: Sit them down and split the shifts between the two
textos.Separación suficiente. El otro aparato p: Enough separation. The other aircraft passes by.
textos.Ser buena persona, delincuente o las dos: Being a good person, a criminal or both: how much standing and street reputation weigh, plus taxes, criminal record and relationships.
Owning all of this. And I will.
textos.Ser {oficio} tiene sus días. Hoy es de l: Being a {oficio} has its days. Today is one of the bad ones.
textos.Servicio apuntado: {v} de 3 para complet: Service logged: {v} of 3 to complete a turn of your contract.
textos.Servicio hecho. En la parada de taxis pu: Job done. At the taxi stand you can buy your own taxi and work whenever you like.
textos.Servicios: hospital, comisaría y taxi: Services: hospital, police station and taxi
textos.Servicios: vehículo, chófer, guardaespal: Services: vehicle, chauffeur, bodyguard, ambulance and taxi
textos.Servidor añadido a tu lista. Pulsa Intro: Server added to your list. Press Enter on it to join.
textos.Servidor en línea de Puerto Bravo: Ley d: Puerto Bravo: Ley del Asfalto online server
Server «%s», running for %s. Port %s, %s. World from version %s, fingerprint %s, with %d towns. There are %d %s%s and %d server characters.
textos.Sesenta años en este barrio y nunca me h: Sixty years in this neighborhood and nobody had ever taken me to the doctor. God bless you, kid.
textos.Sesenta euros cada noche, para siempre,: Sixty euros every night, forever, and nobody touches your business. Nobody looks at you the same way either.
textos.Sesión de {nombre}: llevas {hechas} de {: Session of {nombre}: you've done {hechas} of {total}. It's {hora}.
Shh... better not say that name out loud.
textos.Si Windows no deja copiar, el juego está: If Windows won't let you copy, the game is in a protected folder: move the whole game folder somewhere else, for example inside Documents, and repeat step three.
textos.Si aceptas, cobras y durante siete días: If you accept, you get paid and for seven days nobody attacks your neighborhoods. If you turn it down, you gain some street reputation.
textos.Si al escuchar tu nombre no suena bien,: If your name doesn't sound right when you listen to it, type it here as it is pronounced, for example Jonathan as Jonuhthun. On screen and in braille it still appears as you typed it above. You can leave it empty.
textos.Si atacan al jugador y no hay patrulla c: If the player is attacked and there is no patrol nearby, out of every hundred times, how many one shows up
textos.Si buscas algo, pregúntame dónde hay lo: If you're looking for something, ask me where to find what you need.
textos.Si buscas algo, pásate por la oficina de: If you're looking for something, stop by the job center. There are always odd jobs.
textos.Si buscas un sitio, pregúntame dónde hay: If you're looking for a place, ask me where to find what you need. That I can tell you.
textos.Si cambia de manos el barrio, que sea pa: If the neighborhood changes hands, let it be for the better.
textos.Si coincide con una del juego, la cambia: If it matches one in the game, it replaces it; if it is new, it is added to the recipe book.
textos.Si coincide con una prenda del juego, la: If it matches a garment in the game, it replaces it.
textos.Si coincide con uno de la carta del jueg: If it matches one on the game's menu, it replaces it; if it is new, it is added to the menu.
textos.Si coincide con uno del juego, lo cambia: If it matches one in the game, it replaces it; if it is new, the tavern board can offer it.
If it matches one in the game, it replaces it; if it is new, the radio station can play it.
textos.Si creas el sonido tomar_ seguido de est: If you create the sound tomar_ followed by this identifier in the sounds folder, it will play when it is taken.
If you say you're innocent, I believe you. I've got nothing to gain by not believing you.
textos.Si el cielo está así por la tarde, mañan: If the sky looks like this in the afternoon, tomorrow will be nice. It never fails.
textos.Si el grupo es mayor, vienen en varios v: If the group is larger, they come in several vehicles. For the police, how many officers get out of each patrol car.
textos.Si el jugador no va ni envía a nadie y h: If the player is not going and is not sending anyone, and there is a fixed guard.
textos.Si el vehículo es tuyo, se queda contigo: If the vehicle is yours, it stays with you. If it belongs to the gang, [he|she] takes it, and if you were inside, drops you on the sidewalk.
textos.Si encuentran esas cajas en el faro, cie: If they find those crates in the lighthouse, they'll shut down the whole town. There's a loaded buggy next to the heliport. Dump it all at Naranjo's scrapyard.
textos.Si es menor que la de apertura, cierra d: If it is lower than the opening time, it closes after midnight: a bar open from 12 to 2.
textos.Si es su regalo favorito, le encanta y o: If it's their favourite gift, they love it and it brings you twice as close. One gift a day; delivered to their home you pay for shipping and it's appreciated less.
textos.Si es un secreto, no me lo cuentes. Así: If it's a secret, don't tell me. That way I can't let you down.
textos.Si ese tipo va en vehículo, en el último: If this type is in a vehicle, they arrive in it in the last round of a conquest. With no value, they have no reinforcements.
textos.Si esta misión cierra el buen camino. Se: If this mission closes the straight and narrow. The first one whose condition is met is said.
textos.Si estos días le han llegado al desguace: If other cars of the same model have arrived at the scrapyard these days, it pays less for each one.
textos.Si está en mi mano, sí. Si no, te digo q: If it's in my hands, yes. If not, I'll tell you who.
textos.Si estás herid{o}, ve al hospital. No te: If you're hurt, go to the hospital. Don't play the hero.
textos.Si ganamos el derbi, me doy por satisfec: If we win the derby, I'll be satisfied all year.
textos.Si has pinchado y no llevas repuesto. Cu: If you got a flat and have no spare. It costs double what the repair shop charges, takes half an hour and doesn't come if the police are after you.
If there's a strike, better stay home.
textos.Si hay un mando conectado y cuál es. Se: Whether a controller is connected and which one. It is detected by itself when you plug it in, without leaving the game.
textos.Si insistes a quien has ofendido: de cad: If you keep pushing someone you have offended, out of every hundred times, how many they hit you
textos.Si insultas a alguien y se va: de cada c: If you insult someone and they leave, out of every hundred times, how many they report you
If you're buying, I won't say no.
You break it, you pay for it.
textos.Si las partes de los papeles suman más,: If the roles' shares add up to more, they shrink in proportion.
textos.Si le hace gracia, sube la confianza y t: If they find it funny, trust and your mood go up; if not, trust drops a little. It depends on their character.
textos.Si llamo a la policía, lo queman. Hay tr: If I call the police, they'll burn it. There are three men on guard. Get in without being heard and bring it to me.
textos.Si llegas en ese margen, la cita pasa; s: If you arrive within this margin, the date goes ahead; if not, you stood them up.
textos.Si llevas las dos vidas a la vez, lo que: If you live both lives at once, what becomes known about you. It goes up when you are seen committing crimes, get arrested or an inspection finds something; it goes down with quiet days.
textos.Si llevas menos de diez, vendes las que: If you carry fewer than ten, you sell what you have. You're paid in dirty money and your street reputation goes up.
textos.Si llevas {entero} periodos o más y ning: If you go {entero} periods or more with no warning, you get a letter of recommendation.
textos.Si lo atiendes, coge nombre y da más. Si: If you tend it, it gets a name and earns more. If you neglect it, it dies slowly. Hire people when you can, because nobody can be everywhere. And pay your taxes, because the inspector comes when you least expect it.
textos.Si lo dejas sin valor, quien juega elige: If you leave it empty, the player chooses at the start whether they are addressed in masculine or feminine. Set it only if the character has to be a he or a she. In texts, what changes is written in brackets with both forms: Welcome, [the nephew|the niece].
textos.Si lo dejas vacío, el juego busca un mod: If you leave it empty, the game looks for a free model and, if there is none, uses the first one on the list.
textos.Si lo dejas vacío, valen los del chófer: If you leave it empty, those of the gang's driver apply.
textos.Si lo marcas, servidor.conf se cambia po: If you check it, servidor.conf is replaced with the one saved in the backup. If not, the current settings stay.
textos.Si lo que buscas es trabajo honrado, la: If you're after honest work, the job center. If it's the other kind, I don't know anything.
textos.Si lo rellenas, al completar esta misión: If you fill it in, completing this mission says this text as the ending and it is noted in the journal. With several missions like this, each after a different decision, the story has several endings.
textos.Si lo supiera no te lo iba a decir grati: If I knew, I wouldn't tell you for free.
textos.Si marcas alguna, cada enemigo de este t: If you tick any, each enemy of this type comes out with one of them. Tick the same idea several times on different types if you want more variety.
textos.Si me hubieran fichado a mí, otro gallo: If they'd signed me, it would be a different story.
textos.Si no consigue entrar: AdGuard, antiviru: If they can't get in: AdGuard, antivirus and firewall
textos.Si no haces nada, defenderá sola la guar: If you do nothing, the neighborhood guard will defend on its own.
If you do nothing, you lose it.
textos.Si no hay manera, se puede actualizar a: If there is no way, you can update by hand: Options, Updates, Update by hand explains how.
textos.Si no llega el dinero: If the money does not arrive
textos.Si no lo pagas tú, se cobra solo con las: If you don't pay it yourself, it is charged automatically with the bills of the period.
If you don't cover me, I'm not going on. Come back here.
textos.Si no nos reímos nosotros, ¿quién?: If we don't laugh, who will?
textos.Si no quieres caminar tú, pulsa U y el p: If you'd rather not walk, press U and the character follows the route by himself. Any arrow key stops him.
If you don't know how to get there, ask at the station. They're very friendly.
textos.Si no tienes casa en esta localidad, vai: If you don't have a home in this town, you go to a hotel for {precio} euros.
textos.Si pagas, no hay redada. Si llega la med: If you pay, there's no raid. If midnight comes and you haven't paid, a raid costs you one day's tribute from all your neighborhoods.
textos.Si pierdes un barrio. Deja de pagarte, p: If you lose a neighborhood. It stops paying you, it goes to the gang that took it from you, and if you are left with none, your gang has nowhere to be. It can be conquered again just like the first time.
textos.Si pinchas, la cambias tú desde el móvil: If you get a flat, you change it yourself from the phone, in Services, with the vehicle stopped.
If I can... I don't know if I'll manage.
textos.Si quien lleva el servidor permite el co: Whether the person running the server allows the game's adult content.
textos.Si quieres ayudar, en el comedor social: If you want to help, the soup kitchen always needs hands.
textos.Si quieres que deje de comprarlo, tráeme: If you want me to stop buying it, bring me something worth more. The police seized a loaded station wagon from me. It's in the police station yard.
textos.Si quieres verme, ya sabes por dónde and: If you want to see me, you know where I hang out.
textos.Si sales de noche, ve por las calles con: If you go out at night, stick to the lit streets.
textos.Si se iría a vivir con el jugador: Whether they would move in with the player
textos.Si se marca, el lugar solo existe con es: If ticked, the place only exists with that option turned on.
textos.Si se niegan al tributo y el jugador pes: If they refuse the tribute and the player has little weight: out of every hundred times, how many they send someone after them
textos.Si se puede hablar en personaje, contar: Whether you can speak in character, describe what your character does and write a profile. It is in Online, Role-play.
textos.Si se va, se lleva los nombres de los qu: If he leaves, he takes the names of those who got paid. Don't let him leave the city.
textos.Si su sitio es un local con horario, se: If their spot is a venue with opening hours, the venue's hours are used. Each person also has one day off a week.
textos.Si te aburres, apúntate a un curso en la: If you're bored, sign up for a course at the academy.
textos.Si te dejara a ti, tendría que dejar a m: If I let you, I'd have to leave half the neighborhood.
textos.Si te encuentras mal, hay una farmacia c: If you feel sick, there's a pharmacy nearby. Don't put it off.
textos.Si te falta agua, en el comedor vecinal: If you're short on water, they hand it out at the neighborhood kitchen.
textos.Si te gusta el arroz, tienes que probar: If you like rice, you have to try the Sunday one at the harbor. You'll love it.
textos.Si te gusta pescar, en el espigón pican: If you like fishing, the fish bite well at the breakwater at dusk.
textos.Si te han dejado, que les den. Hay más p: If they dumped you, to hell with them. There are plenty more fish in the sea.
If someone hurt you, I'm sorry. It'll pass.
textos.Si te metes en líos, pulsa Q para fijar: If you get into trouble, press Q to lock onto the enemy: you will hear a tone coming from where they are. Space attacks, R reloads and Z uses a first aid kit. From a vehicle you can also shoot without getting out: Q locks on the same way and Ctrl fires, with a firearm in your hand.
textos.Si te pierdes, pregunta. Aquí la gente c: If you get lost, ask. People here answer.
textos.Si te quedas así de atrás, quien huye va: If you fall this far behind, the one fleeing goes a bit slower.
textos.Si tienes dinero, el casino. Si no, la p: If you have money, the casino. If not, the beach, which is free.
textos.Si tienes en este campo una aeronave tuy: If you have an aircraft of yours at this airfield that is worth it, you fly it and get a surcharge; if not, the company lends you one.
textos.Si tienes sueño, vete a dormir. El cuerp: If you're sleepy, go to bed. The body rules.
textos.Si tienes un mando de Xbox o de PlayStat: If you have an Xbox or PlayStation controller, plug it in: the game recognizes it by itself, vibrates with what happens and the help tells you what each button does.
textos.Si tu amigo está en otra casa, hay que a: If your friend is in another house, a port has to be opened on your router. The manual explains it step by step in the Play with friends section.
textos.Si tu conexión funciona para lo demás, p: If your connection works for everything else, a network filter such as AdGuard, an antivirus or a firewall may be blocking the game: add Puerto Bravo to its exclusions, or try the other source in Update from.
textos.Si tu vehículo tiene una rueda pinchada,: If your vehicle has a flat tire, they change it and it runs well again. If not, you pay nothing.
textos.Si tú o tu amigo usáis AdGuard, un antiv: If you or your friend use AdGuard, an antivirus with network protection or a firewall, it may be blocking the connection: add Puerto Bravo to its exceptions, or turn off filtering for this program, and try again.
textos.Si un día no les pagas, uno se va, el me: If you do not pay them one day, one leaves, the least loyal, and the others lose this much loyalty
textos.Si vas lejos, mejor en autobús que condu: If you're going far, take the bus rather than driving. You'll save yourself the scare.
textos.Si vienes a pedir, te equivocas de perso: If you came to beg, you've got the wrong person.
textos.Si ya te buscan: probabilidad de que te: If you are already wanted: chance that it takes a level off you, percent
textos.Si yo fuera alcalde, esto estaría arregl: If I were mayor, this would be fixed in two days.
textos.Siempre pasa algo, pero nunca cambia nad: Something always happens, but nothing ever changes.
textos.Siete y media. Tienes {dinero} euros: Seven and a half. You have {dinero} euros
textos.Siete. Los compañeros quieren ir con los: Seven. The comrades want to go with their pickaxes. I won't let them get killed.
textos.Siguen siendo tuyos: te los vuelves a po: They're still yours: you put them back on for free whenever you like, here or at home.
textos.Sigues con lo mismo, ¿eh?: Still at the same thing, huh?
textos.Sigues en el desvío a {nombre}. Cuando l: You're still on the detour to {nombre}. When you finish it, the GPS will go to {nombre2}.
textos.Sigues jugando sin la misión. Queda pend: You keep playing without the mission. It stays pending: you can try it again whenever you like from the same place.
You keep going straight, toward the storm.
textos.Sigues sobre las vías del tranvía o del: You are still on the tram or train tracks: get off them.
textos.Sigues tu camino ante una situación: You go on your way in a situation
textos.Siguiendo a alguien a pie: cada cuánto a: While following someone on foot: how often it warns you that they are getting away or that you are too close.
textos.Siguiente cruce, hacia el {hacia}: {nomb: Next intersection, to the {hacia}: {nombre}, {metros} away. You're on {por}.
textos.Silencio, olor a papel viejo y una secci: Silence, the smell of old paper and an audiobook section better stocked than you would expect.
textos.Silencio. Te has quedado sin combustible: Silence. You've run out of fuel and glide down.
textos.Silenciosa y rápida. Solo sirve a un pas: Silent and fast. Only works at arm's length.
textos.Silenciosa, lenta y ecológica. No necesi: Silent, slow and eco-friendly. Needs no key.
textos.Sillas de plástico y una máquina de café: Plastic chairs and a coffee machine.
Chairs in a row and people with folders.
textos.Sillones y copas. Aquí se habla de diner: Armchairs and drinks. Money gets talked about here.
Armchairs and a piano nobody plays.
textos.Sin canales de rol, los mensajes van por: Without role-play channels, messages go through the usual chat: to everyone, to those nearby, to your gang or to your group.
textos.Sin cobrar. Le quita {entero} días a tu: Unpaid. Removes {entero} days from your most serious criminal record entry. Once a day.
textos.Sin cobrar. Le quita {entero} días al an: Unpaid. It takes {entero} days off the most serious record and the neighbors look on it favorably. Once a day.
textos.Sin comisario y sin dinero, a Belmonte s: With no chief and no money, all Belmonte has left is his account book: the names of every politician he's bought. He keeps it in the mansion.
textos.Sin contraseña: entrará cualquiera que t: No password: anyone with the address can join.
textos.Sin contraseñas ni correo: la primera ve: No passwords or email: the first time, the game creates a key and saves it in your data folder. Each server recognizes you by it. If you delete the data folder or switch computers, you lose it, and your characters with it, unless you saved it beforehand.
textos.Sin ducharte, cuánto baja la calidad de: Without showering, how much the quality of a work shift drops
textos.Sin ducharte, cuánto menos vendes en el: Without showering, how much less you sell at the car dealership, in points out of a hundred
textos.Sin ducharte, una cita acerca este por c: Without showering, a date gets this percent closer than normal
textos.Sin fama, sin banda y sin escolta, tus n: With no street reputation, no gang and no escort, your businesses are easy prey: some gang will try to charge you "protection". With {entero} street reputation they leave you alone
textos.Sin informantes: de cada cien asaltos, d: With no informants: out of every hundred assaults, how many have a rumor arrive the same day
textos.Sin informantes: te enteras el mismo día: Without informants: you find out the same day, at best through a rumor, or when they've already arrived.
textos.Sin marcar ninguno, se imparten los cuat: With none ticked, all four are taught.
textos.Sin marcar ninguno, vende todos los que: With none ticked, it sells everything that has a price.
Without an engine there is no autopilot.
textos.Sin motor, el aparato baja solo. Dirígel: Without an engine, the aircraft descends on its own. Steer it with left and right.
textos.Sin multa. A los vecinos les gusta un ag: No fine. The neighbors like an officer with a light touch: your standing goes up.
textos.Sin más. Los Calaveras sabrán que no fui: Nothing more. Los Calaveras will know you didn't come after them.
textos.Sin mí, aquello se hunde. Lo saben todos: Without me, that place sinks. Everybody knows it.
Without me, the street party doesn't start.
textos.Sin papel: viene contigo y pelea a tu la: No role: they come with you and fight at your side, as always
textos.Sin práctica y sin cocina equipada. Con: Without practice and without an equipped kitchen. With zero, never.
textos.Sin práctica. Con cero, solo con la prác: Without practice. With zero, only with practice.
textos.Sin tarea: solo te acompaña cuando le ll: No task: only goes with you when you call
textos.Sin tener ninguna ciudad entera. Con una: Without owning any whole city. Owning a whole city starts the full version.
textos.Sin un solo barrio tuyo no eres nadie pa: Without a single neighborhood of your own, you're nobody to collect from a gang. Conquer one first.
textos.Sin valor, lo decide el juego para cada: With no value, the game decides for each playthrough.
textos.Sin valor, no se les ve por la calle. Co: With no value, they are not seen on the street. With a value, among the people of the neighborhoods that belong to this gang there are some of their own.
textos.Sin valor, se puede hacer en cualquier p: With no value, it can be done anywhere.
textos.Sin valor, va a pie. Con valor, llega en: With no value, they go on foot. With a value, they arrive in it: it comes down the street toward the player, stops nearby and they get out. For the police it is the patrol car.
textos.Sirve para saber a quién le puedes gusta: It lets the game know who might like you. If you'd rather not say, anyone might like you.
textos.Sitio de más en la nevera con la cocina: Extra space in the fridge with the equipped kitchen
textos.Sitio para {int} vehículos. Huele a gaso: Room for {int} vehicles. It smells of gasoline.
textos.Situaciones de la calle: ayudar o aprove: Street situations: help or take advantage
textos.Situación de la calle: ayudar o aprovech: Street situation: help or take advantage
textos.Situación: {dumps}\n\nEl jugador te dice:
Situation: {dumps}

The player says to you: {v}
textos.Soborno al inspector, por ciento del pre: Bribe to the inspector, percent of the business price
textos.Soborno en comisaría, por cada nivel de: Bribe at the police station, per wanted level
textos.Sobre la mesa hay tres cosas: las llaves: On the table there are three things: the keys to El Caimán's office, his account books and a card from the police station.
textos.Sobre los que trae la misión. Con 50, do: On top of those the mission brings. With 50, where there were four there can be six.
textos.Sobre urgente para el hospital. Si llega: Urgent envelope for the hospital. If you get there in three minutes, there's a tip.
textos.Sobrino de Custodia, criado entre cister: Custodia's nephew, raised among tankers. Starts with driving at level four, good endurance, a tanker key, two hundred fifty euros and a good name with the neighbours.
textos.Socorrismo, ambulancia, bomberos y vigil: Lifeguarding, ambulance, firefighting and security. A position of trust: they ask for a clean record.
textos.Soldadora y delegada del sindicato en Mo: Welder and union rep in Monteferro. Tough on the outside, loyal to the end, and the best dancer at the street parties.
textos.Soldadura, carpintería, mecánica y desca: Welding, carpentry, mechanics and unloading. Hard work and well paid.
textos.Soldadura, mecánica y carpintería, con s: Welding, mechanics and carpentry, with their safety rules.
textos.Solo a quien tiene un negocio y nadie re: Only to someone who has a business and is not respected on the street.
textos.Solo afecta a quien entra por primera ve: It only affects whoever comes in for the first time: whoever already has a character can always come back in.
textos.Solo aparece si se cruzan estas decision: Only appears if these decisions are combined
textos.Solo aparece si se tomó la decisión: Only appears if the decision was made
textos.Solo con el modo de guerra de barrios en: Only with the street neighborhood war mode turned on.
textos.Solo con la opción de horarios. Sin valo: Only with the schedules option. With no value, the venue's, or the default.
textos.Solo con la reconquista de barrios. Sube: Only with neighborhood reconquest. It rises with the gang's strength and if you are on bad terms.
textos.Solo conducía mal y ha parado cuando se: He was only driving badly and stopped when you asked: arresting him is going too far, and it will be noted against you.
textos.Solo cuenta con el modo IA activado. Con: It only counts with AI mode on. With yes, besides answering, the model can suggest that the character goes along with you for a while, leaves, gets angry or joins your gang. It is a closed list and the model decides nothing: the game decides, with the same rules as without AI, so there is no point in typing that they must obey you. That list contains no money or items: no character gives you anything for what you type. With no, which is the default, the AI can only leave or get angry, as before. It doesn't work with the local model.
textos.Solo cuenta con la opción de combustible: Only counts with the fuel option turned on. When empty, the game sets it by engine: 45 liters for a car, 14 for a motorcycle, 70 for a van, 60 for a sports car and 160 for a truck. Boats and aircraft do not use any.
textos.Solo cuenta con la opción de vida en par: Only counts with the partner life option turned on. With no value, the game decides for each playthrough: most accept when the relationship is going very well, and some never accept.
textos.Solo cuenta con la vida realista activad: Only counts with realistic life turned on.
Only counts with realistic life turned on. With 100, it removes all hunger.
Only counts with realistic life turned on. Cooked food should be more filling than packaged: a sandwich removes 28.
textos.Solo cuenta si juegas con un personaje h: Only applies if you play with a character you created. With yes, the story lines that say your name are generated on your computer, with the characters' voices, the first time you play with that name: a few seconds of waiting at the start and the rest while you play. With no, or if your computer can't handle the generator, your screen reader says those lines.
textos.Solo cuenta si la misión tiene un paso d: Only counts if the mission has a step to steal a vehicle. With no, which is normal, the mission requires its own: you have to get in that specific vehicle and deliver it. With yes, the player can arrive in their own to where the mission's vehicle is, stop beside it and do the mission with it: on delivery, they keep it. It has to be the same class: if the mission's flies, theirs must too. The mission summary tells the player, before accepting, whether a vehicle is provided and whether their own is valid.
textos.Solo desde una casa tuya, o en su puerta: Only from one of your homes, or at its door. You choose from the menu, pay for the order and delivery, and after a while the doorbell rings. What you order takes away hunger and thirst in realistic life and gives some health. If you're not home when it arrives, the delivery person waits a while and leaves.
Only the boss can disband the gang.
textos.Solo el jefe puede echar a alguien de la: Only the boss can kick someone out of the gang.
Only the boss hands out ranks.
textos.Solo el jefe y su mano derecha pueden in: Only the boss and their right hand can invite.
textos.Solo en el nivel exigente y donde te evi: Only at the demanding level and where people avoid you. Decided once a day in each shop.
textos.Solo en la casa en la que vivís: Only in the house where you live together
textos.Solo en las administraciones de lotería: You can only ask for a specific number at lottery offices.
textos.Solo en los puestos marcados con respons: Only in the positions marked with responsibility.
textos.Solo entra el chico de los recados. No q: Only the errand boy goes in. I don't want to accuse him without knowing. He leaves the bank at twelve, after making the deposit.
textos.Solo hace falta si usas un servicio que: This is only needed if you use a service other than OpenRouter.
textos.Solo informa: Intro lo vuelve a leer. La: Information only: Enter reads it again. Keys are changed in Options, Keyboard: change the keys.
textos.Solo la pasa por encima un aparato cuyo: Only an aircraft whose ceiling is a hundred meters higher flies over it.
textos.Solo la sueltan si el jugador lleva un a: They only drop it if the player carries a weapon identical to theirs.
Only that player will hear it.
textos.Solo para el otro servicio. En los demás: Only for the other service. For the rest, the game always picks the model.
textos.Solo para pruebas. De serie, no: si algu: For testing only. By default, no: if someone comes in with their character from somewhere else, the previous session is closed.
textos.Solo puede empezarla quien la ha propues: Only whoever proposed it can start it.
textos.Solo puedes zarpar con él desde el muell: You can only set sail with it from the pier where it's moored.
Only your own homes can be rented out.
textos.Solo se les puede dar papel a los que es: Only those who are with you can be given a role. Call them from this menu or from Territories, Your gang.
textos.Solo se puede dar papel a quien esté a e: A role can only be given to someone at that distance or closer.
textos.Solo se usa si eliges actualizar desde u: Only used if you choose to update from a custom address. Enter to type it.
textos.Solo si el nombre menciona a la banda qu: Only if the name mentions the gang that rules the neighborhood, such as a hideout. Used when the neighborhood becomes the player's or another gang's. Empty: the name does not change.
textos.Solo si la descripción dice quién manda: Only if the description says who is in charge here. Used when the neighborhood becomes the player's or another gang's. Empty: the description does not change.
textos.Solo si la descripción habla de quién ma: Only if the description talks about who is in charge or who is seen on its streets. Used when the neighborhood becomes the player's or another gang's. Empty: the description does not change.
textos.Solo si quieres usar un certificado tuyo: Only if you want to use your own certificate: the path of its PEM file. Empty, the server uses the one it creates itself in the data folder.
textos.Solo si se cruzan estas decisiones: Only if these decisions are combined
textos.Solo si se tomó la decisión: Only if the decision was made
textos.Soltarlo con un aviso: Let him go with a warning
Single and unattached. And in no hurry.
textos.Solvencia mínima para un crédito persona: Minimum solvency for a personal loan
We're few, but we get along.
textos.Son cuatro, pero hacen ruido por cuarent: There are only four of them, but they make noise for forty.
textos.Son la base de la accesibilidad del jueg: They are the foundation of the game's accessibility. If you change them, keep them short, clear and easy to locate in space. The locators loop from the position of an object or a mission.
It is nine at night: an owl.
textos.Son las parejas a las que se oye hablar: These are the couples you overhear talking as you pass.
textos.Son las siete de la mañana: canta un gal: It is seven in the morning: a rooster crows.
textos.Son todos iguales. Prometen y luego ni s: They're all the same. They promise and then don't even remember.
textos.Son tres válvulas: la de la desaladora,: There are three valves: the desalination plant's, the depot's and the riverbed's. They have to be opened in a row or the pressure trips.
textos.Son {hora}. Si tienes prisa, no te entre: It's {hora}. If you're in a hurry, I won't keep you.
textos.Son {hora}. ¿Llegas tarde a algún sitio?: It's {hora}. Are you late for something?
textos.Son {total}. Aquí tiene su compra. Hasta: That's {total}. Here's your shopping. See you around.
textos.Sonido en bucle que emite. Sin valor, us: Looping sound it emits. With no value, it uses the one for its type.
textos.Sonido holgado, para equipos donde el au: Relaxed sound, for computers where the audio clicks or cuts out: {v}
textos.Sonido mono, lo mismo por los dos oídos: Mono sound, the same in both ears
textos.Sonido, voz, movimiento, orientación, di: Sound, voice, movement, orientation, difficulty, keys, gamepad and the rest of the settings, by sections. Changes are saved when you leave.
textos.Sonidos cortos de la interfaz. Conviene: Short interface sounds. They should be brief and discreet.
textos.Sonidos de consola antigua, de 8 y 16 bi: Old console sounds, 8 and 16 bit, for footsteps, hits, shots, explosions, coins, alerts and menus; the rest are real recordings.
textos.Sorteo del día {s}: salió el {cifras}: Draw of day {s}: number {cifras} came up
I'm from here. I haven't been out much.
textos.Soy de fuera, pero me acogieron tan bien: I'm from out of town, but they welcomed me so well that I'm from here now.
textos.Soy de {ciudad}, que no es lo mismo que: I'm from {ciudad}, which isn't the same as being from the outskirts.
I'm funny when I want to be.
textos.Soy la presidenta del sindicato, no una: I'm the union president, not a murderer. But you're not in the union.
textos.Soy una tumba. Bueno, una tumba con una: I'm a tomb. Well, a tomb with a crack.
textos.Soy {oficio}, y de l{o}s mejores. Pregun: I'm a {oficio}, and one of the best. Ask anyone you like.
I'm {yo}, from here all my life.
I dreamed of 47 and played it. 48 came up. Since then I don't even trust my dreams.
textos.Su nombre, dónde está, cómo está de daño: Its name, where it is, how damaged it is and the upgrades it has.
textos.Su rango en la banda y si está conectado: Their rank in the gang and whether they are online now.
textos.Su tren sale a las seis y ve muy poco. A: Her train leaves at six and she can barely see. Escort her to the station. She walks slowly and talks a lot.
textos.Suave al {get} por ciento; cobros cada {: Soft at {get} percent; collections every {get2} days; work periods of {get3} days
textos.Sube a la Bocamina de La Encantada, al n: Go up to the La Encantada Mine Entrance, to the northeast, next to the lake.
textos.Sube a la Torre del Semáforo y toca la c: Climb the Signal Tower and ring the bell. You have two minutes.
textos.Sube a la Torre del Vigía, en Los Mirado: Climb the Lookout Tower, in Los Miradores, in under three minutes.
textos.Sube a la cisterna que hay en la puerta: Get on the tanker at the garage door. It's unlocked.
Go up to the Fuentefría chapel.
textos.Sube a la furgoneta de reparto que hay j: Get in the delivery van next to the repair shop.
textos.Sube a la moto de vigía que hay junto a: Get on the lookout motorcycle next to the tower.
textos.Sube al Faro Viejo, al noreste del puebl: Go up to the Old Lighthouse, northeast of town, and check the padlock.
textos.Sube al Platino GT de Belmonte, aparcado: Get in Belmonte's Platino GT, parked in front of the casino.
textos.Sube al depósito municipal, en Las Naves: Go up to the municipal depot, in Las Naves, and tell me how many tankers are parked. Look carefully, because I already know.
textos.Sube al taxi de prácticas que hay junto: Get in the practice taxi next to the job center. Walk up and press F.
textos.Sube al tractor de Anselmo, aparcado jun: Get in Anselmo's tractor, parked next to La Era.
textos.Sube con cada plato que cocinas. Con más: It goes up with every dish you cook. At a higher level, you burn the food less and it turns out better more often.
textos.Sube con el prestigio entre los vecinos,: It goes up with standing with the neighbors, with a payroll, with businesses and with repaid loans. It goes down with criminal records, missed payments and seizures.
textos.Sube con la fama en la calle y baja en e: It rises with street reputation and drops at the demanding level.
textos.Sube con los barrios que tenga esa banda: Rises with the neighborhoods that gang owns.
textos.Sube cuando tumbas a alguien que no te h: It goes up when you knock down someone who hadn't attacked you. Whoever knocks you down takes what is on offer.
Haul the anchor aboard: press Enter.
textos.Sube el ánimo y afloja la lengua. Con ca: Lifts your mood and loosens your tongue. With every drink you walk more crookedly and aim worse. By the fifth in a row, you end up in the hospital.
textos.Sube el ánimo, y es buen sitio para cono: It lifts your mood, and it's a good place to meet someone.
textos.Sube el ánimo. Puede haber redada, puede: It lifts your mood. There may be a raid, you may get robbed and, if you have a partner, they may find out. Without condoms there is a risk to your health.
textos.Sube la confianza y, la primera vez, tu: It raises trust and, the first time, your standing with the neighbors.
textos.Sube la confianza, más o menos según su: It raises trust, more or less depending on their character, and lifts your mood a little. If you have been talking for a long while, it gives little.
textos.Sube la habilidad mucho más deprisa que: Raises the skill much faster than practice. One course a day.
Raises what is known about your other life.
textos.Sube mucho la confianza. Una vez por per: It raises trust a lot. Once per person.
textos.Sube o baja a la vez todo el sonido del: Raises or lowers all the game's sound at once, in steps of ten. Your screen reader's voice doesn't change. A sample plays when you change it. Change it with the left and right arrows.
textos.Sube un poco tu prestigio entre los veci: It raises your standing with the neighbors and your mood a little. You can repeat it as often as you like.
Raise a skill to level ten.
Rises and falls with the mining strike.
textos.Sube, deja el petate y descansa. Mañana: Come up, drop your bag and rest. Tomorrow we'll talk about how you make a living, because this city has changed a lot. A man named Belmonte runs things now.
You come up to the surface gulping water.
You get into a vehicle or out of it.
textos.Subes a {int} metros para pasarla por en: You climb to {int} meters to fly over it.
textos.Subes a {nombre} de pasajero: conduce {n: You get into {nombre} as a passenger: {nombre2} drives. Mark a destination with L and [he|she] takes you there. With Q you lock on and with Ctrl you shoot. With F you get out, and [he|she] waits for you. To dismiss, use the phone, in Services.
textos.Subes a {nombre}{suyo}. Estado {int} por: You get into {nombre}{suyo}. Condition {int} percent. You are facing {cardinal}.
textos.Subes al tranvía. Vas hasta {nombre}, {l: You board the tram. You're going to {nombre}, {len} {v}. The first one: {nombre2}. Press Enter when you want to get off at the next one.
textos.Subes de pasajero con {nombre}. Pulsa F: You get in as a passenger with {nombre}. Press F to get out when they stop.
textos.Subes de rango en un oficio y cobras más: You rank up in a trade and earn more, or you get promoted in your permanent job.
textos.Subes de un salto y echas al piloto. Por: You jump in and throw the pilot out. The alarm is already sounding over the loudspeakers.
textos.Subís a la noria. Arriba del todo, {n} t: You ride the Ferris wheel. At the very top, {n} kisses you.
textos.Suceso: alguien ha perdido un maletín po: Event: someone lost a briefcase near here. {situar}. Find it with the radar, pressing Tab.
textos.Suceso: están atracando a alguien. {situ: Event: someone is being robbed. {situar}. To help, press Q to lock onto the robber.
textos.Suceso: unos pandilleros tienen atemoriz: Event: some gang members have the street terrified. {situar}. If you want to chase them off, press Q to lock onto them.
textos.Suciedad desde la que hueles mal: Dirt level from which you smell bad
textos.Suciedad desde la que te hace falta una: Dirt level from which you need a shower, from 0 to 100
textos.Sucio desde {get}; hueles mal desde {get: Dirty from {get}; you smell bad from {get2}
textos.Sudadera grande, pantalón ancho y logoti: Oversized sweatshirt, baggy pants and clearly visible logos.
textos.Sueldo de cada miembro de tu banda, cada: Pay for each member of your gang, every midnight
textos.Sueldo diario de un empleado, por ciento: An employee's daily wage, percent of what the business earns at base
textos.Sueldo fijo de una jornada de vendedor e: Fixed pay for a day as a salesperson at a car dealership
textos.Suele estar en {nom} de {_hora} a {_hora: Usually at {nom} from {_hora} to {_hora2}, and off on {v}.
textos.Sueltas amarras a bordo de {nombre} y sa: You cast off aboard {nombre} and head out to {nombre2}. Bow to the {cardinal}. At sea you take the helm: left and right turn, up accelerates. Press P to fish, Tab to hear what is nearby and L to choose a heading.
textos.Suena a beber y se pide con sed, no con: Sounds like drinking and is ordered when thirsty, not hungry.
It sounds with every stroke you swim.
textos.Suena desde donde está el enemigo fijado: It sounds from where the locked-on enemy is: they are too far for your weapon.
It sounds from where the locked-on enemy is: they are within range of your weapon.
textos.Suena desde el vehículo que te pide la m: It sounds from the vehicle the mission asks for, and from your driver's vehicle while he waits for you.
textos.Suena desde la posición de lo que acaba: It sounds from the position of whatever the radar has just announced.
textos.Suena desde un lugar donde hay una misió: It sounds from a place where a mission is waiting for you.
textos.Suena desde un objeto que hay en el suel: It sounds from an object lying on the ground. Stand on it and pick it up.
textos.Suena desde un punto de interés que no t: It sounds from a point of interest that has no sound of its own.
textos.Suena desde una de las cintas de casete: It sounds from one of the cassette tapes hidden around the city, or from another collectible.
textos.Suena el móvil: {nombre}, de {local}, ha: Your phone rings: {nombre}, from {local}, rang the doorbell at {casa} and nobody answers. They'll wait {minutos} minutes for you.
textos.Suena el pitido de la puerta. ¡Al ladrón: The door beeps. Thief! You run out with the shopping, and they know you here now.
textos.Suena el teléfono en el piso de la abuel: The phone rings in Grandma's apartment. Something is wrong.
textos.Suena en la dirección del siguiente punt: It sounds in the direction of the next point on the route. The closer you are, the faster it repeats.
textos.Suena la radio de fondo al entrar: The radio plays in the background when you walk in
textos.Suena música bajita. Bailáis en el salón: Soft music plays. You dance in the living room, very close, and the rest comes on its own.
They sound like a jingle that rises and falls. If you hear something like that, walk up and press Enter. And if you get bored, La Cepa Wine Bar hires bodyguards.
textos.Suenan diez dianas a la izquierda, al ce: Ten targets sound on the left, in the center or on the right, and you quickly press the arrow for that side. With seven hits you win {p7} euros; with nine, {p9}.
textos.Suerte de cada bando, hasta: Luck of each side, up to
Luck, just enough. But I'm not complaining.
Enough to know what this is all about.
Supermarket open until the small hours.
textos.Supermercado abierto toda la noche. Luce: All-night supermarket. White lights and a bored cashier.
textos.Suplemento por volar con tu aparato, por: Surcharge for flying your own aircraft, percent
textos.Suprimir, en Ajustar el volumen de cada: Delete, in Adjust the volume of each sound
textos.Surtidores bajo una marquesina y una tie: Pumps under a canopy and a small store. This is where you fill the tank.
textos.Sustancias y trapicheo, solo con el cont: Substances and dealing, only with adult content
textos.Sustituye la de este ordenador por la qu: It replaces the one on this computer with the one you paste.
textos.Susurrarle una tontería al oído: Whisper something silly in their ear
Clean sheets and the sea in the background.
textos.Sándwiches, ensaladas envasadas y cosas: Sandwiches, packaged salads and snacks, to eat without cooking.
textos.Sé quién eres. Por eso no quiero hablar: I know who you are. That's why I don't want to talk to you.
textos.Sé quién es quién. Y ellos saben quién s: I know who's who. And they know who I am.
textos.Sé quién lo tiene: lo guardan en el depó: I know who has it: it's kept at the municipal impound lot, among junk, until someone pays.
textos.Sí, cuando la relación va muy bien: Yes, when the relationship is going very well
textos.Sí, pedirle que se vaya: Yes, ask them to move out
textos.Sí, salir al menú principal: Yes, exit to the main menu
textos.Sí, soy mayor de 18 años: activarlo: Yes, I'm over 18: turn it on
textos.Sí, y con menos afinidad que las demás: Yes, and with less affinity than the others
Yes... it scares me. A lot.
textos.Síguele a pie, de lejos. No hace falta v: Follow him on foot, from a distance. You don't need to see him: listen to his steps. If you get too close, he notices. If you fall behind, you lose him.
textos.Síguele de lejos y dime adónde va. Si te: Follow him from a distance and tell me where he goes. If he sees you, it's over: I'll never learn the truth.
textos.Taberna con dados, guardaespaldas y cont: Tavern with dice, bodyguards and contracts
textos.Taberna de estibadores. Está en venta: u: Dockworkers' tavern. It is for sale: a modest but safe business.
textos.Tablón de encargos de {nombre}. Llevas {: Job board of {nombre}. You have completed {get} contracts
textos.Taller de chapa y pintura. Un cambio de: Body and paint shop. One color change and the police stop looking for you.
Quick repair shop by the harbor.
textos.Taller, desguace o concesionario: Repair shop, scrapyard or car dealership
textos.Taller: parte fija de una reparación, a: Repair shop: fixed part of a repair, plus the damage
textos.Taller: pintar y cambiar matrículas: Repair shop: paint and change license plates
textos.Talleres para los vecinos: gimnasia de m: Workshops for the neighbors: maintenance exercise and rod fishing.
Also with F10 during the game.
textos.También con la tecla F10, sin abrir el m: Also with the F10 key, without opening the phone.
textos.También decide cuántas veces le hace gra: It also decides how many times they find it funny.
textos.También puedes crearlos en la sección Lu: You can also create them in the Places section by choosing this town.
textos.También puedes pescar, desde un espigón: You can also fish, from a breakwater or at sea with P, and sell the fish at the fish market. And the businesses you buy pay you every midnight.
textos.También se cambia durante el juego con F: It can also be changed during the game with F2.
textos.Tanto por ciento al que avisa de la rese: Percent at which it warns of the reserve
textos.Tanto por ciento al que suena la alarma: Percent at which the alarm sounds
textos.Tanto por ciento de descuento del produc: Percent discount on the featured product
textos.Tanto por ciento de ese crecimiento en t: Percent of that growth while calm
textos.Tanto por ciento de estado del vehículo: Percent of the vehicle's condition at which they surrender
textos.Tanto por ciento de fuerza que conserva: Percent of strength it keeps after you take a neighborhood from it
textos.Tanto por ciento de fuerza que pierde co: Percent of strength it loses from the blow
textos.Tanto por ciento de la defensa cuando la: Percent of the defense when the guard defends alone
textos.Tanto por ciento de la defensa del barri: Percent of the neighborhood's defense subtracted from their strength
textos.Tanto por ciento de la multa que se llev: Percent of the fine the officer takes
textos.Tanto por ciento de salud con el que un: Percent of health at which a suspect surrenders
textos.Tanto por ciento de su fuerza con el que: Percent of their strength with which they attack while calm
textos.Tanto por ciento de su fuerza que aporta: Percent of its strength that the ally contributes
textos.Tanto por ciento de su velocidad a esa d: Percent of their speed at that distance
textos.Tanto por ciento de su velocidad cuando: Percent of their speed when they ease off completely
textos.Tanto por ciento del ritmo con todas las: Percent of the pace with all cities conquered
textos.Tanto por ciento del ritmo en la versión: Percent of the pace in the soft version
textos.Tanto por ciento en el que avisa la rese: Percent at which the reserve warns
textos.Tanto por ciento más de puntería por cad: Percent more aim for each one of yours
textos.Tanto por ciento más de salud por cada u: Percent more health for each one of yours
textos.Tanto por ciento más que se cobra por ca: Percent more charged for each rank
textos.Tanto por ciento que alimenta de menos u: Percent less nourishment from a burnt dish
textos.Tanto por ciento que alimenta de más un: Percent more nourishment from a high-class dish
textos.Tanto por ciento que conserva tras ser r: Percent it keeps after being rejected
textos.Tanto por ciento que se gana al regatear: Percent gained when haggling, if it goes well
textos.Tanto por ciento que se puede pasar del: Percent you can go over the limit without a fine
textos.Tanto por ciento que tarda de más si llu: Percent longer it takes if it rains
textos.Tardará {cuanto}. Cuando llegue, oirás e: It will take {cuanto}. When it arrives, you'll hear the horn.
textos.Tardáis media hora, pero salen los dos c: It takes you half an hour, but both leave satisfied. Your boss finds out how you handled it.
textos.Taxi, autobús, camión, grúa y mensajería: Taxi, bus, truck, tow truck and courier. Three services make a shift.
Taxi: pick up the customer at {nombre}.
textos.Taxi: ¿a dónde te llevo? El precio depen: Taxi: where to? The price depends on the distance
White taxis with an orange stripe.
Cups, bottles and the coffee machine whistling. You order here.
textos.Te agachas como para ayudar y te llevas: You bend down as if to help and take the watch. Ninety euros at the pawn shop. Nobody saw you.
You bend down as if to help and take the watch. A woman shouts, "He's robbing him!" The neighborhood won't forget it.
textos.Te agachas: haces menos ruido y cuesta m: You crouch: you make less noise and are harder to see.
textos.Te ahorras su sueldo, pero el negocio da: You save their wage, but the business earns less. If you're left with nobody, extended hours go back to normal.
He catches up and takes {quita} euros from you.
textos.Te alejas del puesto. Vuelve: está a {in: You are moving away from your post. Go back: it is {int} meters away, {direccion_txt}.
textos.Te apuntas. Si es una carrera, tienes qu: You sign up. If it's a race, you have to be carrying the money for the bet. It starts when whoever proposed it says so.
textos.Te atacaron primero y hay testigos que l: They attacked you first and witnesses tell it that way: this won't start any war.
textos.Te bajas del tranvía en {corto}. {descri: You get off the tram at {corto}. {describir}. It is {hora_txt}.
You get off at the next one: {nombre}.
textos.Te buscan pero no te ven: sigue así unos: They are looking for you but can't see you: keep it up for a few seconds and you will throw them off. Higher pitched, it is the helicopter that can't see you.
textos.Te cobran {euros} euros de facturas e im: You're charged {euros} euros in bills and taxes. {detalle}.
textos.Te compra {n} de {lower} por {cobro} eur: They buy {n} of {lower} from you for {cobro} euros. You have {v} left.
textos.Te comprometes a un número de turnos cad: You commit to a number of shifts every {entero} days. You are paid for each shift as always and, at the end of the period, the payroll according to your evaluation. Missing shifts or doing them badly brings warnings, and with {entero2} warnings you are fired.
textos.Te contesta, pero sin acercarse mucho. E: They answer, but without getting too close. The smell doesn't help.
textos.Te convence para llevarte una camisa que: They talk you into taking home a shirt you'd never have worn.
Tells you what this place is like.
They tell you how their day has gone.
They tell you in two sentences how their day is going.
textos.Te cuenta qué datos salen de tu ordenado: Tells you what data leaves your computer when you talk to people using AI mode.
textos.Te cuenta su oficio. Sube un poco la con: They tell you their job. It raises trust a little.
textos.Te cuentan lo mismo con palabras distint: They tell you the same thing in different words: those who lost out because of what you did have sent people to La Gaviota Bar. And those who came out ahead have come to warn you.
textos.Te cuentan que {n} trabaja ahora para ot: You hear that {n} now works for others. They did not say goodbye.
You get patched up. Health at maximum.
textos.Te dan otra carta y se suma a lo que lle: You're dealt another card and it's added to what you have. Face cards are worth half a point. If you go over seven and a half, you lose your bet.
textos.Te dan otra carta. Si pasas de 21, pierd: You get another card. If you go over 21, you lose; if you hit exactly 21, you stand automatically.
textos.Te dan un coche patrulla, que te espera: They give you a patrol car, waiting at the door. The radio sends you calls: respond before time runs out. On foot, H orders a stop; if someone resists, subdue them without killing them, and when they surrender, Enter to arrest them. A reckless driver is stopped by getting behind them with the siren, which is P.
textos.Te dan un número que no lleves ya para e: You get a number you don't already have for the next draw. Up to {TOPE_BOLETOS} tickets per draw.
textos.Te dan una carta. Pide más o plántate. L: You're dealt a card. Draw more or stand. Face cards are worth half a point and the others, their number. If you go over seven and a half, you lose. When you stand, the dealer draws cards until matching you or going over: if it matches you, the dealer wins. Winning pays double what you bet; winning with exactly seven and a half, triple.
textos.Te dan vehículo: {nombre}. El tuyo se qu: They give you a vehicle: {nombre}. Yours stays parked and safe.
textos.Te deja en la acera y se lleva el vehícu: Drops you on the sidewalk and takes the vehicle. You are left on foot.
textos.Te deja limpio, como la ducha de casa. D: Leaves you clean, like the shower at home. After working out, free.
textos.Te dejan la salud al máximo. Pagas por c: They bring your health to the maximum. You pay for each point you are missing; if you aren't missing any, you pay nothing.
textos.Te dejan un taxi aparcado en la calle. S: They leave you a taxi parked on the street. Get in with F and press J to start taking fares and get paid for each one.
textos.Te dejan un vehículo, {nombre}, pero pue: They lend you a vehicle, {nombre}, but you can do it with yours: you choose.
textos.Te despides de tu perro para siempre y s: You say goodbye to your dog for good and it stays here. The donation is not returned. Later you can adopt another.
You are arrested in the middle of the fight.
textos.Te dice cuál es el más cercano, a cuánto: They tell you which is the nearest, how many meters away and in which direction, and mark it on your GPS. If there is none in this town, they tell you.
textos.Te dice dónde está lo más cercano y te l: It tells you where the nearest one is and marks it on the GPS.
textos.Te dice en qué barrio estás y cómo es. S: They tell you which neighborhood you are in and what it is like. It raises trust a little.
textos.Te dice en qué carpeta se está guardando: Tells you which folder this session's log is being saved in and how many sessions are kept.
textos.Te dice las teclas de la travesía: subir: It tells you the keys for the crossing: climbing and descending, turning, the autopilot, speeding up and what the tower says.
textos.Te dice si ha tocado. Los premios se cob: They tell you if you won. Prizes are collected where tickets are sold; those over {precio} euros, at a lottery office.
textos.Te dicen qué ha salido y te pagan cualqu: They tell you what came up and pay any prize, the jackpot too.
textos.Te dicen qué ha salido y te pagan los pr: They tell you what came up and pay the prizes. Here they pay up to {precio} euros; larger ones, at a lottery office.
textos.Te doy un bate. Primer ejercicio: fija e: I'll give you a bat. First exercise: lock onto the dummy with Q, walk toward the sound of the tone and, when it turns low, press Space until you knock it down.
textos.Te duchas en los vestuarios: You shower in the locker room
textos.Te encuentra en casa con otra persona: Finds you at home with someone else
textos.Te entregas con las manos arriba y nadie: You surrender with your hands up and nobody fires. They cuff you and take you to {nombre}. At wanted level {nivel} no deal is possible: you get out {horas} hours later, {multa} euros poorer and without your firearms
textos.Te esperan en el campo: They are waiting for you at the airfield
textos.Te esposan y te llevan a {nombre}. Tras: They cuff you and take you to {nombre}. After a night in the cell you get out {multa} euros poorer from the fine and without your firearms. It is {hora_txt}.
textos.Te estás quedando sin fuerzas. Busca un: You're running out of strength. Find a boat or a pier.
textos.Te explica de una vez cómo se mueven los: Explains in one go how prices move, how you make money and how dividends are paid.
textos.Te explica qué es un modelo local, qué d: Explains what a local model is, what the game downloads and how long it takes to answer.
textos.Te explico el negocio. Yo compro y vendo: Let me explain the business. I buy and sell. Prices change every day, and they're different in every town. You buy where it's cheap, you sell where it's expensive.
textos.Te falta concentración: {int} por ciento: You lack focus: {int} percent. It recovers on its own.
textos.Te fían en una tienda: They give you credit in a shop
textos.Te guardas las llaves. Remedios se levan: You keep the keys. Remedios gets up from the table without finishing her coffee.
textos.Te guardas los billetes. El hombre asien: You pocket the bills. The man nods, without smiling.
textos.Te ha quedado redondo. Esto no se olvida: It came out perfect. You won't forget this.
textos.Te ha salido de categoría: mejor que en: It came out first-rate: better than at a restaurant.
They tell you about their plans.
textos.Te hablan como a un hombre: bienvenido,: They address you as a man: welcome, Encarna's nephew, son.
textos.Te hablan como a una mujer: bienvenida,: They address you as a woman: welcome, Encarna's niece, daughter.
textos.Te haces agente. Hace falta que los veci: You become an officer. The neighbors have to like you a little and nobody can be looking for you. Then, at any police station, you start your shift: they give you a patrol car and the radio sends you calls. Each resolved call is paid, and with them you get promoted. If you commit crimes, they take your badge.
You take the test. Everything is fine.
textos.Te han atacado primero: defenderte de qu: They attacked you first: defending yourself against whoever attacks you does not count as a crime.
textos.Te han cobrado las facturas, los impuest: Your bills, taxes or loan payment have been charged: a receipt printer and a low note.
textos.Te han despedido de tu empleo fijo: un p: You have been fired from your permanent job: a slammed door and three descending notes.
textos.Te han detenido y te encierran: la puert: You have been arrested and locked up: the cell door.
They've lost you on the radar.
textos.Te han puesto una multa: el silbato del: You have been given a fine: the officer's whistle.
You've been kicked from the server.
You were knocked down before emptying the till.
textos.Te han visto, pero aquí te aprecian: los: They saw you, but they like you here: the neighbours look the other way.
textos.Te han visto. Despista a la policía ante: They've seen you. Shake off the police before you go back.
They've seen you. Shake off the police.
textos.Te han visto. Los dos del bidón vienen a: They've spotted you. The two with the can are coming for you: get rid of them.
textos.Te has alejado y no sigue: You have moved away and they do not follow
textos.Te has apartado y la caja deja de abrirs: You moved away and the box stops opening. Go back next to it.
textos.Te has bajado del vehículo: carrera aban: You got out of the vehicle: race abandoned.
textos.Te has desconectado. Sigues jugando por: You disconnected. You keep playing on your own.
textos.Te has despistado y se ha quemado por un: You got distracted and it burnt on one side. It is less nourishing.
You left before emptying the till.
You moved: the surrender is over.
textos.Te has pasado: el corazón se frena, suen: You overdid it: your heart slows, a continuous beep sounds and you end up in the hospital.
textos.Te has pasado: le querían asustado, no m: You went too far: they wanted [him|her] scared, not dead.
textos.Te has quedado sin aparato: el vuelo com: You're left without an aircraft: the commercial flight is canceled.
textos.Te has quedado sin chófer: {v} y el vehí: You are left without a chauffeur: {v} and the vehicle are gone.
