textos.Te has quedado sin combustible. El motor: You have run out of fuel. The engine stops. With the phone, under Services, you can call roadside assistance, or pour in a gas can if you have one.
textos.Te has quedado sin territorios y tu band: You've run out of territories and your gang has broken up.
textos.Te he dicho que no te rías. Está delante: I told you not to laugh. It's in front of Polo Norte Ice Cream Parlor. And hurry, they're melting.
I've seen you around {barrio} more than once.
textos.Te juegas mucho. Si sale bien, el barrio: You're risking a lot. If it goes well, the neighborhood never forgets it.
textos.Te la da quien lleva el servidor. Puedes: Whoever runs the server gives it to you. You can paste it with Ctrl V. If it has no port, the default one is used.
They leave it on the runway and you fly it yourself. Faster than the helicopter. With it you can go to any airport, airfield or heliport by pressing Enter on arrival.
textos.Te la encuentras en esa casa: en su menú: You find them at that home: in its menu you can talk, eat together, make plans or ask them to leave. Enter here chooses another of your homes, in this town or another, for the two of you to live there.
textos.Te lee lo que se apunta en el registro y: Reads you what goes into the log and what never does, so you know what you are sending.
textos.Te lee lo que trae la versión nueva ante: Reads you what the new version brings before you decide whether to install it.
textos.Te lee los pasos para comprimir la carpe: Reads you the steps to compress the folder of the session that failed and where to send it.
textos.Te levantas. Hace no tanto, la única vez: You stand up. Not so long ago, the only time a judge said your name was to read out a sentence.
textos.Te llama {nombre}, de {local}: está en l: {nombre}, from {local}, calls you: they're at the door of {casa} with your order and say they'll wait {minutos} minutes for you.
textos.Te llaman al despacho: eso no era necesa: You are called into the office: that was not necessary, and it is noted.
textos.Te llamas Dani Roca. Hace tres años te c: Your name is Dani Roca. Three years ago you were convicted of a robbery you did not commit. This morning the gates of Monteferro Prison opened.
textos.Te llega el rumor un día antes, con el b: The rumor reaches you a day ahead, with the neighborhood.
textos.Te lleva a la caja con la cesta como est: Takes you to the checkout with the basket as it is. There you pay, or put something back if you don't have enough.
textos.Te lleva al sitio donde empieza la misió: It takes you to the spot where the mission starts, with your vehicle next to you, and it starts right away. It gives no reward and doesn't change the story.
textos.Te lleva una hora. Los vecinos se entera: It takes you an hour. The neighbors hear about these things.
textos.Te llevas lo que hay en la caja, con un: You take what's in the till, with ten percent more for coming in person. The till holds seven days.
textos.Te llevas toda la que te quepa en la moc: You take all that fits in your backpack; what doesn't fit stays in the wardrobe.
textos.Te llevas un coche de exposición sin pag: You take a showroom car without paying: you choose which one. It's a robbery in plain sight: the alarm goes off and the police come after you hard, the more so the more expensive it is.
textos.Te llevas una mochila grande: ahora cabe: You take a big backpack: it now holds {entero} slots.
textos.Te llevo yo. Sigue mis indicaciones y no: I've got you. Follow my instructions and don't touch anything.
textos.Te lo agradezco, pero hoy no puedo. Otra: I appreciate it, but I can't today. Another time.
You eat it standing by the window.
textos.Te lo comes en el sitio y te sube un poc: You eat it on the spot and it raises your health a little.
They leave it on the runway and you fly it yourself. Slower than the light plane, but it can hover and land in less space.
textos.Te lo guardas todo. Ya habrá tiempo de s: You keep it all. There will be time to be generous.
textos.Te lo ingresan en el banco: It's deposited in the bank for you
textos.Te lo llevas todo encima, donde ya no es: You carry it all on you, where it's no longer safe if you're mugged or arrested.
textos.Te lo llevas todo sin pasar por caja. Es: You take everything without going through the register. This is shoplifting: if they see you, and the more you carry the easier it is, the police look for you, your standing with the neighbors drops and this store won't let you in for a few days. If they don't see you, nothing happens.
I'll let it slide because I'm in a good mood today.
textos.Te lo quitas y lo guardas; sigue siendo: You take it off and put it away; it's still yours.
You have it in the kitchen, no rush.
textos.Te lo traen en mano: It's brought to you in hand
textos.Te lo traen y lo dejan puesto. {v} {v2}: They bring it to you and leave it fitted. {v} {v2}
textos.Te mandan a alguien nuevo que no ha hech: They send you someone new who has never done this in their life.
textos.Te marchas de un aviso ya empezado: You leave an alert that has already started
textos.Te metes la compra bajo la ropa y sales: You tuck the groceries under your clothes and walk out whistling. Nobody noticed.
textos.Te miran, se miran, y te dan ciento vein: They look at you, look at each other, and give you one hundred twenty euros. "You were never here."
textos.Te niegas y dañan el negocio: You refuse and they damage the business
It pays you every midnight without you doing anything. If a gang attacks it, you have until midnight to defend it or you lose it.
textos.Te paga el 40 por ciento de lo que cuest: They pay you 40 percent of what it costs new. The weapon is no longer yours and, if you had it in your hand, you're left with your fists.
textos.Te pagan al momento y el vehículo desapa: They pay you right away and the vehicle disappears. They give more the more it is worth and the better its condition, and less if it is stolen or if you have already sold them others of the same model. Each scrapyard buys only a few a day.
textos.Te pedirá la dirección que te ha dado tu: It will ask for the address your friend gave you and the password, if there is one.
textos.Te pide la dirección que te ha dado quie: It asks for the address the person running the server gave you and adds it to your list.
textos.Te pide que duermas en casa: Asks you to sleep at home
textos.Te pide un detalle: Asks you for a small gift
textos.Te pide un mueble: Asks you for a piece of furniture
textos.Te pide una cena a domicilio: Asks you for a dinner delivered home
textos.Te piden un modelo concreto: róbalo dond: They ask for a specific model: steal it where they tell you and bring it back in good condition. You can repeat it whenever you want.
textos.Te pintan el vehículo en un taller: la p: Your vehicle is being painted at a repair shop: the police stop recognizing it.
textos.Te plantas con {_puntos_txt}. La banca s: You stand with {_puntos_txt}. The dealer draws {join}: {_puntos_txt2}.
textos.Te pones en medio y hablas despacio. A l: You step in between and speak slowly. Two minutes later they're shaking hands, half embarrassed.
textos.Te pones en medio y te cae el manotazo q: You step in between and take the slap that wasn't meant for you. At least, from the shock, they stop.
You put on a bulletproof vest.
You set down as best you can. It wasn't pretty.
textos.Te pregunta antes. Al dejarlo te quedas: It asks you first. When you quit you're left without a contract and go back to working on your own, whenever you like.
textos.Te pregunta antes. La banda desaparece,: It asks you first. The gang disappears, the neighborhoods become free and you keep the till.
textos.Te pregunta antes. Si eres el jefe, el m: It asks you first. If you are the boss, command passes to another member.
textos.Te pregunta antes. Tu personaje se guard: It asks you first. Your character is saved and you go back to the main menu.
textos.Te presentas y se abre su ficha: desde a: You introduce yourself and their profile opens: from there you can chat, meet up or give each other gifts.
textos.Te queda muy poca salud: cúrate o ponte: You have very little health left: heal up or take cover.
You're running low on air. Come up with the X key.
textos.Te quedan {aviso} niveles de habilidad s: You have {aviso} skill levels left to spend. Press Enter again to start like this, or spend them first.
You have {margen} euros of margin left.
textos.Te quedas a la deriva hasta que un pesqu: You drift until a fishing boat picks you up half drowned and drops you in {nombre}. Health {int}.
textos.Te quedas con lo que llevas y juega la b: You stay with what you have and the bank plays. If it goes over, you win; if it ties or beats you, the bank wins.
textos.Te quedas con lo que tienes. La banca sa: You keep what you have. The dealer draws cards until reaching 17 or more, and whoever gets closest to 21 without going over wins.
textos.Te quedas en el menú principal. El servi: You stay at the main menu. The server is still on your list, in Play on a server.
textos.Te quedas sin abogado: You are left without a lawyer
textos.Te quedas tres horas con las persianas b: You stay in for three hours with the blinds down. The police stop looking for you. It is {hora_txt}.
textos.Te quita la sed y recuperas un poco de s: It quenches your thirst and you recover a little health.
textos.Te quitan la plaza de {nombre_lugar}, qu: They take away your space at {nombre_lugar}, which was empty.
textos.Te quitaron la placa. No puedes volver a: They took your badge. You cannot apply again until day {v}.
You get the problem off your back. For today.
textos.Te quitas todos los complementos y los g: You take off all accessories and put them away at home.
textos.Te registran los bolsillos y la mochila:: They search your pockets and your backpack: {que}. A fine won't fix this one.
textos.Te remangas en {negocio}: {horas} horas: You roll up your sleeves at {negocio}: {horas} hours behind the counter. Customers appreciate seeing the owner. It's {hora}.
Your vehicle is being repaired at a repair shop.
textos.Te roba lo que guardas en casa y desapar: Steals what you keep at home and disappears, goes over to another gang or talks, and the police search one of your houses.
textos.Te saltas {titulo}. Cuenta como hecha, s: You skip {titulo}. It counts as done, without reward. You can replay it whenever you want from the phone journal.
textos.Te sientan entre los primos del novio. H: They seat you among the groom's cousins. There's lamb for three days.
textos.Te sientas en la mesa y cada apuesta te: You sit at the table and each bet costs you {a} euros. What you win depends on what you bet on.
You sit down for a while. It's {hora_txt}.
You feel awful. Your body is complaining.
textos.Te sigue a pie, sube contigo a los vehíc: Follows you on foot, gets into vehicles with you and shoots your enemies. Maximum two.
textos.Te sigue con confianza {get}; se une a t: Follows you with trust {get}; joins your gang with {get2}
textos.Te siguen vendiendo, pero más caro: es l: They still sell to you, but at a higher price: that's what you get for having robbed them
textos.Te sube el ánimo y en la isla te tendrán: It lifts your mood, and on the island they'll count you as one of their own.
textos.Te sumerges. Aguantas la respiración una: You dive. You can hold your breath for about half an hourglass: roughly thirty seconds. Press X to come back up.
textos.Te tienen en la pantalla. Por debajo de: They have you on the screen. Below {alt} meters they can't see you.
textos.Te toca cocinar: It is your turn to cook
textos.Te van a ver, eso seguro. Piérdelos ante: They're going to see you, that's for sure. Lose them before you deliver.
A shower would do you good.
textos.Te vistes con lo que ya tienes, sin paga: You dress in what you already own, at no cost. What you buy at clothing stores ends up here
textos.Te voy a decir una cosa que no viene en: I'll tell you something that isn't in any course: in this neighborhood everything gets known. The good and the bad. Whoever helps gets credit at the store. The other one gets avoided on the sidewalk.
textos.Te voy a decir una cosa, y solo una vez:: I'll tell you one thing, and only once: I know who you collect from in Puerto Bravo. Here you did the right thing. There you still have time.
You {v} to watch TV. It boosts your mood. It's {hora_txt}.
textos.Techo del aparato: {int} metros. No sube: Aircraft ceiling: {int} meters. It can't climb any higher.
textos.Teclados, teléfonos y prisas. Aquí te at: Keyboards, phones and rush. You're served here.
textos.Teclas del panel del servidor\n\nF5: arr:
Server panel keys

F5: start the server.
Shift+F5: stop the server.
Ctrl+F5: restart the server.
Ctrl+P: settings.
Ctrl+Q: quit.

Ctrl+N: announcement to all players.
Ctrl+M: message to the selected player.
Ctrl+E: kick the selected player.
Ctrl+I: create an invitation.
Ctrl+D: message of the day.
Ctrl+O: type a command.
F6: refresh the lists and the status.

Ctrl+S: save now.
Ctrl+B: backup now.
Ctrl+R: restore a backup.
Ctrl+G: save the log to a file.

F1: server guide.
Ctrl+H: explains the control you are on.
Ctrl+Tab and Ctrl+Shift+Tab: switch tabs.
Alt plus the underlined letter: go to a control on the tab or open a menu.
Applications key or Shift+F10 in the players and accounts lists: actions on the selected item.
textos.Temas de los que habla la gente entre sí: Topics people talk about among themselves
textos.Ten a la vez 60 de prestigio y 50 de fam: Have 60 standing with the neighbors and 50 street reputation at the same time, with no active criminal record and never having been caught.
textos.Ten cuidado con el coche, que hay mucho: Be careful with your car, there are a lot of crazy drivers out there.
Be careful with those people, seriously.
Be careful when it gets dark, please.
textos.Tenemos amigos comunes en el ayuntamient: We have mutual friends at the Puerto Bravo town hall. They told me you're someone I can talk to. They were right.
textos.Tenemos una donación esperando en el mer: We have a donation waiting at the market and nobody with a license. Do you drive?
textos.Tengo a un señor con un golpe de calor e: I've got a man with heat stroke on the sand and the booth's first aid kit is empty. Run to the pharmacy and then come to the beach.
I have things to do. Really.
textos.Tengo dos. La mayor ha salido a mí, que: I have two. The older one takes after me, never shuts up, and the little one takes after his grandfather, who doesn't say a word. At home we communicate by signs.
I have the latest model. As it should be.
textos.Tengo los mismos que mi prima la del pue: I have the same as my cousin at the harbor, since we were born two days apart.
textos.Tengo pareja, sí, y estoy muy a gusto. G: I have a partner, yes, and I'm very happy. Thanks for asking.
textos.Tengo tres pedidos de garrafas para gent: I have three jug orders for people who can't manage them. Will you give me a hand? I'll pay for the trip.
textos.Tengo un cliente caprichoso. Quiere el C: I have a picky customer. He wants the red Centella in the window at Autos Platino, in Las Torres.
textos.Tengo un cliente que no quiere un descap: I have a customer who doesn't want just any convertible: he wants the golf club president's.
textos.Tengo un coche que tiene más años que yo: I have a car that's older than I am, but it starts.
I have a cat... her name is Miga.
textos.Tengo un hermano fuera. Llama por Navida: I have a brother who lives away. He calls at Christmas and not much else.
textos.Tengo un nieto ya. Me tiene sorbido el s: I have a grandson now. He's got me wrapped around his finger.
textos.Tengo un perro que es más listo que algu: I have a dog that's smarter than some of my neighbors.
I have a wonderful family, really. I've been lucky.
textos.Tengo una fuente que dice que los contad: I have a source who says the Cauce's new meters read double. I need one to take to a lab.
textos.Tengo unas nasas de langosta en el Bajo: I have some lobster pots at Grouper Shoal, to the southwest, out at sea. Go down to the pier, take a boat and bring them to me.
textos.Teniendo el mar al lado, ¿para qué irse: With the sea right next door, why go on vacation?
textos.Tercer ejercicio: atracar. Pulsa L, elig: Third exercise: docking. Press L, choose a pier and follow the beacon to it. When you arrive, brake with the down arrow and press Enter to dock.
textos.Tercer ejercicio: llevar el coche al Gim: Third exercise: take the car to El Yunque Gym. When you get in, the destination is set automatically. Drive yourself, or press Y and let it take you.
textos.Tercer ejercicio: sube al coche de práct: Third exercise: get in the practice car next to Paco's Grocery Store. Walk up and press F.
textos.Tercera válvula: el lecho del Cauce Seco: Third valve: the Cauce Seco riverbed. Two and a half minutes.
Finish what you have in hand first.
textos.Termina antes lo que tienes entre manos:: Finish what you have in hand first:
textos.Termina la historia del buen camino con: Finish the Right Path story with the honest ending.
textos.Termina o abandona antes la misión que t: First finish or abandon the mission you have in progress.
textos.Territorios: cómo funciona. Recorre la e: Territories: how it works. Go through the explanation with the arrow keys
textos.Texto de solo lectura. Recórralo con las: Read-only text. Move through it with the arrow keys and copy it if you need to.
textos.Texto del mensaje. Recórralo con las fle: Message text. Move through it with the arrow keys; you can copy it.
textos.Texto que se dice al empezar el paso: Text said when the step starts
Time played: {h} hours and {mi} minutes. Day {dia}
textos.Tiempo lento: ponerlo o quitarlo: Slow time: turn it on or off
textos.Tienda de barrio donde hay de todo y Pac: Neighborhood shop where there is everything and Paco knows everybody's business.
textos.Tienda de caza para gente bien. Tienen r: Hunting shop for the well-to-do. They carry sniper rifles.
textos.Tienda discreta del club. Tienes {dinero: The club's discreet shop. You have {dinero} euros
textos.Tienda discreta: preservativos, lencería: Discreet shop: condoms, lingerie and more
textos.Tienda que no vende comida para casa: Store that doesn't sell food for home
textos.Tiendas y almacenes de la comarca. Se em: Shops and warehouses of the region. You start by stocking and unloading.
textos.Tiene a raya a la gente: menos héroes y: Keeps people in check: fewer heroes and fewer alarms
textos.Tiene alarma, y a ese club la policía ll: It has an alarm, and the police get to that club fast. Bring it back in one piece, he doesn't want it scratched.
textos.Tiene la palabra, por los comerciantes d: The floor goes to Dani Roca, speaking for the merchants of Barrio Viejo and El Puerto.
textos.Tiene que ser un número de hasta {CIFRAS: It must be a number of up to {CIFRAS} digits.
It has to be a character with a vehicle.
textos.Tiene que ser una persona adulta: 18 año: It has to be an adult: 18 years or older.
textos.Tienen un trabajo difícil. Yo no lo quer: They have a hard job. I wouldn't want it.
textos.Tienes a toda la ciudad detrás. Despísta: The whole city is after you. Shake them off.
textos.Tienes abierto {que}. Para actualizar ha: You have {que} open. To update you have to
textos.Tienes activado el modo de guerra de bar: You have street neighborhood war mode on: neighborhoods are not conquered from the phone. Go to the neighborhood and confront the gang there: they come for you in waves, each tougher than the last, and your gang comes to help. If you win, the neighborhood pays you {precio} euros every midnight.
textos.Tienes contrato y ya has cumplido tus pr: You have a contract and you've already done your first shifts. Aurora wants to see you.
textos.Tienes el albarán de los explosivos. El: You have the explosives delivery note. The quarry foreman offers to buy it from you. What do you do?
textos.Tienes el nombre de quien firma los pedi: You have the name of whoever signs the water orders. What do you do with it?
You have enemies nearby and you are behind the wheel.
textos.Tienes invitaciones pendientes: están en: You have pending invitations: they are in Your gang and in Mission group
textos.Tienes la cartera de Casilda, con seisci: You're holding Casilda's wallet, with six hundred euros inside. What do you do?
textos.Tienes la hora, el sitio, los sobres y l: You've got the time, the place, the envelopes and the notebook. With that, anyone who knows where to look can find everything.
textos.Tienes las pruebas contra el concejal de: You have the evidence against the public works councilman, and you're not the only one who knows it.
textos.Tienes las pruebas contra el concejal. ¿: You have the evidence against the councilman. What do you do with it?
textos.Tienes lo que Los Calaveras le robaron a: You have what Los Calaveras stole from La Rusa. The warehouse is still open and nobody's watching. What do you do?
textos.Tienes media comisaría detrás. Piérdelos: Half the police station is after you. Lose them.
You're very hungry. It's hard to move.
You're very thirsty. It's hard to run.
textos.Tienes más de {tope} vehículos en la cal: You have more than {tope} vehicles on the street: your mechanic takes {nombre}, the one parked the longest, to the garage at {nombre_lugar}.
You have to be at the door, on foot.
textos.Tienes que estar en tu vehículo o al lad: You need to be in your vehicle or next to it.
textos.Tienes que ir con un vehículo: vale el t: You have to go with a vehicle: yours will do.
textos.Tienes todos los componentes al día: no: All your components are up to date: there is nothing to install or update.
You have all your license points.
textos.Tienes un taxi en la calle. {situar}. Su: You have a taxi on the street. {situar}. Get in with F and press J to start taking fares.
There is a guard {int} meters away.
textos.Tienes una cita, o un momento de complic: You have a date, or a moment of closeness with your partner.
textos.Tienes una tregua con {nombre}. Si das e: You have a truce with {nombre}. If you hit them, you break it
textos.Tienes ya {n} barrios, y eso no pasa des: You already have {n} neighborhoods, and that doesn't go unnoticed.
textos.Tienes {len} {v} en vigor; el más grave,: You have {len} {v} in force; the most serious, {v2}.
textos.Tienes {len}, que dan {sum} euros al día: You have {len}, which give {sum} euros a day
textos.Tienes {nombre} a tiro. Fíjalo con la Q: You have {nombre} in range. Lock on with Q and shoot with Ctrl, or ram [him|her]: every hit and every bullet takes health off.
textos.Tienes {nom} y {nom2}: {total}. La banca: You have {nom} and {nom2}: {total}. The dealer shows {nom3}. Hit.
textos.Tienes {n} vehículos en la calle y lo ra: You have {n} vehicles on the street and a reasonable number is {tope}. There is no room left in your garages: they are all still safe, but sell some or buy a house with a garage. You have them on the phone, in My vehicles.
textos.Tienes {n}. El negocio da ahora {ingreso: You have {n}. The business now earns {ingreso_negocio} euros a day.
textos.Tipo de contrato del tablón: Type of contract from the board
textos.Tipo de enemigo de los suyos que andan p: Enemy type of their people walking the street
textos.Tipo de enemigo que llega en un vehículo: Enemy type that arrives in a vehicle
textos.Tipo de lugar que tiene que haber en la: Type of place that must exist in the town
textos.Tipos de local donde no entras oliendo m: Types of venue where you cannot enter smelling bad
textos.Tipos de local donde puede estar: Types of venue where they can be found
textos.Tipos de local donde suena la radio de f: Types of venue where the radio plays in the background
textos.Tipos de local que no se atracan desde s: Types of venue that cannot be robbed from their menu
textos.Tipos de local que no te recuerdan: Types of venue that do not remember you
textos.Tipos de lugar donde está el gestor: Types of place where the manager is
textos.Tipos de lugar donde se entrega el encar: Types of place where the job is delivered
textos.Tipos de lugar que no tienen techo: Types of place with no roof
textos.Tipos de sitio donde se hace: Types of spot where it is done
textos.Tirarlo todo a la basura: Throw it all in the trash
textos.Tiras a la basura {cosas}: se ha echado: You throw {cosas} in the trash: it has spoiled.
textos.Tiras dos dados contra la casa. Si sacas: You roll two dice against the house. If you roll higher, you win your bet; if you tie, you get it back; if you roll lower, you lose it.
textos.Tiras la mesa de una patada y sacas el a: You kick the table over and pull out the weapon. The people at {lugar} did not expect it, but they recover quickly.
textos.Tiras todo lo que queda de esto, de una: You throw away all that is left of this, at once and without asking. It cannot be undone.
textos.Tiritas, botiquines y consejos de la bot: Band-aids, first aid kits and advice from the pharmacist.
textos.Tiro al blanco: premio por nueve dianas: Target shooting: prize for nine bullseyes
textos.Tiro al blanco: premio por siete dianas: Target shooting: prize for seven bullseyes
textos.Tiro deportivo con monitor. Aquí la punt: Sport shooting with an instructor. Here you learn marksmanship without hurting anyone.
textos.Toca el piano en la Sala Crepúsculo y de: Plays piano at the Crepúsculo Hall and by day repairs boats at the shipyards. Quiet, big-handed, and smarter than he lets on.
textos.Tocas el claxon, o te lo toca otro condu: You honk the horn, or another driver honks at you. Your driver honks twice on arrival, and your mechanic when he drops off a vehicle.
textos.Tocas tierra con un golpe seco en {campo: You touch down with a hard thud at {campo}: the aircraft takes a toll.
textos.Todas las cuentas que han entrado alguna: All the accounts that have ever joined: whether they are admins, whether they are banned and when they were last seen. The Applications key opens the actions for the selected account. They can't be seen while the server is stopped.
textos.Todas las noches llevo caldo a los que e: Every night I take broth to those on guard duty: the emergency room, the firefighters and the harbor police station.
textos.Todas las noches pasa un tipo cobrando a: Every night a guy goes around collecting from the venues. Nobody knows who for. Today he's leaving the concert hall: follow him and tell me where he makes his drop.
textos.Todas las opciones del servidor, por pes: All the server options, by tab.
textos.Todas las teclas del juego, a pie, al vo: All the game's keys, on foot, at the wheel and at any time, and the gamepad buttons. If you have changed a key, it says yours.
textos.Todavía es pronto para prometerse: It is still too early to get engaged
It still has more than half a tank.
Nothing has happened yet worth reporting.
textos.Todavía no has hecho ninguna misión de l: You haven't done any story missions yet.
textos.Todavía no hay archivo de configuración:: There is no settings file yet: the default values are used. It is created when you save the settings.
textos.Todavía no hay bandas en este servidor: There are no gangs on this server yet
textos.Todavía no hay datos que copiar: el serv: There is no data to back up yet: the server has never started with this data folder.
textos.Todavía no hay nadie en tu banda: There's nobody in your gang yet
textos.Todavía no se fía: Does not trust you for credit yet
textos.Todavía no se fía de ti desde que se ent: Still doesn't trust you since finding out. About {d} days left.
textos.Todavía no se ha celebrado ningún sorteo: No draw has been held yet.
textos.Todavía no se ha usado ningún servicio e: No service has been used yet in this session
textos.Todavía no tienes ningún servidor en la: You don't have any servers in your list yet
textos.Todo cambia, menos el precio del café, q: Everything changes except the price of coffee, which goes up.
Fully matching, down to the shoes.
textos.Todo el cobre de esta ciudad acaba en el: All the copper in this city ends up in the same place: the Copper Club, at the docks. There's a crew of theirs right now at the Barrena repair shop.
textos.Todo el mundo merece otra oportunidad. O: Everybody deserves a second chance. Or so they say.
textos.Todo el pleno te mira. ¿Cómo hablas?: The whole council is watching you. How do you speak?
Everything has gone up except wages.
textos.Todo lo demás con {n}: regalos, gestos,: Everything else with {n}: gifts, gestures, spending the night
Everything that climbs a rocky slope.
textos.Todo sale de la despensa: nada de esto c: Everything comes from the pantry: none of this expires soon.
textos.Todo se juega de oído, con tu lector de: Everything is played by ear, with your screen reader or the Windows voice, and with the keyboard or a gamepad.
textos.Todo se vuelve negro. Horas después desp: Everything goes black. Hours later you wake up at {nombre}, {nombre2}, with a fresh bandage and {coste} euros less. It is {hora_txt}.
textos.Todo sigue como está: sin relaciones sex: Everything stays as it is: no sexual relationships, paid company or drugs. You can turn it on whenever you like from the options.
textos.Todo tuyo, ya está arrancado. Yo te cant: All yours, it's already started. I'll call out where they're coming from.
textos.Todo va más despacio mientras te quede c: Everything moves slower while you have focus left.
textos.Todo, solo lugares, solo vehículos, solo: Everything, only places, only vehicles, only people or only objects.
textos.Todo. Hasta el último billete. Empiezo a: Everything. Down to the last bill. I'm starting to think I can trust you.
textos.Todos han pagado. Y sin rechistar. San L: Everyone has paid. Without a word. San Lucero is yours, boss.
textos.Todos lo saben y nadie puede probarlo. C: Everybody knows it and nobody can prove it. He gets paid in cash and signs nothing. But every afternoon, when he leaves the town hall, he walks somewhere. Follow him without being seen and tell me where he leaves the money.
textos.Todos los barrios y localidades del jueg: All the neighborhoods and towns in the game, with what each one is like and which ones you have yet to visit.
textos.Todos los lugares de la localidad, por g: All the places in the town, by groups and with where each one is. Enter on one sets it on the GPS.
textos.Todos los sonidos del juego, por los mis: All the game's sounds, in the same groups as in Learn the sounds, with a search box. Enter plays them and the left and right arrow keys raise or lower that specific sound, from 30 to 200 percent. It adds to the general volumes above: each sound's volume applies first, then the effects, ambience or alerts volume on top. It says how many you have changed and lets you reset one, a group or all of them.
textos.Todos los sonidos vuelven a su volumen n: All sounds are back at their normal volume.
textos.Todos necesitan. Toma: pistola de nueve: Everybody needs one. Here: nine millimeter pistol, clean. The first one is a gift. The second, not anymore.
textos.Todos tus vehículos, con su nombre, su m: All your vehicles, with their name, model, condition, upgrades and where each one is. From there you can mark any of them on the GPS, have it brought to you, send it to a garage or rename it. The ones you buy, upgrade at a repair shop, take out of a garage or name are yours: they don't disappear even if you walk away or take another one.
textos.Toma el fusil de arpones de mi difunto m: Take my late husband's harpoon gun. One shot at a time, so aim well.
textos.Toma fuego. El tabaco, no, que es el últ: Here's a light. Not a cigarette, though, it's my last.
textos.Toma la escopeta de mi padre. No quiero: Take my father's shotgun. I don't want anyone dead if it can be avoided, but I don't want you killed either.
textos.Toma mi carabina y dos cartuchos de los: Take my carbine and two sticks of the old kind. With a short fuse, so don't doze off.
textos.Toma, diez bolsitas de hierba para empez: Here, ten baggies of weed to start. Take an envelope from me to the doorman at Club Paraíso and they're yours.
textos.Toma, la porra de mi cuñado, que era por: Here, my brother-in-law's baton, he used to be a doorman. If they get stupid, you get stupider.
textos.Toma. Era de mi padre, que la trajo de l: Here. It was my father's, he brought it back from the war. I don't want it at home, and you'll know how to use it.
textos.Toma. Es una remachadora de astillero. L: Here. It's a shipyard riveter. We've made some modifications.
textos.Tomar el aire. En casa se me caen las pa: Getting some air. At home the walls close in on me.
textos.Tomar una caña con tapa: {precio} euros: Have a beer with a tapa: {precio} euros
You drink alcohol: it is poured and you toast.

textos.Tomas seguidas que provocan sobredosis: Consecutive doses that cause an overdose
textos.Tomas una pastilla: el blíster y un trag: You take a pill: the blister pack and a gulp.

textos.Tope de puntería de más, en tanto por ci: Cap on extra aim, in percent
textos.Tope de salud de más, en tanto por cient: Cap on extra health, in percent

textos.Totalmente silenciosa: nadie oye el disp: Completely silent: nobody hears the shot. One bolt at a time.
He works, like all of us.

textos.Trabajo de autobús y de helados: parte f: Bus and ice cream work: fixed part of each stop
textos.Trabajo de autobús y de helados: prima p: Bus and ice cream work: bonus for completing the line
textos.Trabajo de bombero: parte fija de cada i: Firefighter work: fixed part for each fire put out
textos.Trabajo de grúa: parte fija de cada coch: Tow truck work: fixed part for each car delivered
textos.Trabajo de mensajería en lancha: parte f: Boat courier work: fixed part for each package
textos.Trabajo de paquetería: parte fija de cad: Parcel work: fixed part for each package
textos.Trabajo de taxista: parte fija de cada c: Taxi driver work: fixed part for each fare
textos.Trabajo de vigilante: parte fija de cada: Security guard work: fixed part for each suspect arrested
textos.Trabajo hay, pero de lo que no quiere na: There's work, but the kind nobody wants.
textos.Trabajo hay. Lo que no hay es quien lo p: There's work. What there isn't is anyone to pay for it.
textos.Trabajo honrado: el Banco de Alimentos n: Honest work: the Food Bank needs a driver.
textos.Trabajo honrado: en la playa hace falta: Honest work: at the beach they need someone with legs and a head.
textos.Trabajo honrado: hay vecinos mayores que: Honest work: there are older neighbors who can't carry the water.
textos.Trabajo honrado: la Cocina de la Hermand: Honest work: the Brotherhood Kitchen has a leaky roof and the quarry is giving away the slate.
textos.Trabajo honrado: la protectora tiene cua: Honest work: the shelter has forty dogs and empty water bowls.
textos.Trabajo honrado: llevar pedidos por el p: Honest work: delivering orders around town.
textos.Trabajo honrado: los vecinos quieren arr: Honest work: the neighbors want to fix the square's fountains on their own.
textos.Trabajo honrado: recados por el pueblo a: Honest work: errands around town before the market closes.
textos.Trabajo honrado: recados por la isla ant: Honest work: errands around the island before the tourist boat arrives.
textos.Trabajo honrado: un sobre urgente tiene: Honest work: an urgent envelope has to reach the hospital.
textos.Trabajo legal de piloto: llevas pasaje o: Legal pilot work: you carry passengers or cargo to another town, flying for real, and get paid when you land. You need the commercial pilot license, which you get at a flight academy.
textos.Trabajo sin vehículo: pasan ocho horas y: Work without a vehicle: eight hours pass and you get paid. One shift a day. Raises your standing with the neighbors.
textos.Trabajo, que es más de lo que haces tú,: Work, which is more than you do, from what I can see.
textos.Trabajos que cuentan como turno: Jobs that count as a shift
textos.Trabajó diez años de mensajera en bicicl: She worked ten years as a bicycle courier. Starts with a very good standing with the neighbors, good mood, endurance at level three and two first aid kits: ideal for an honest life.
textos.Tragaperras, ruleta y blackjack para gas: Slot machines, roulette and blackjack to spend your pay.
textos.Traición por debajo de {get} de lealtad;: Betrayal below {get} loyalty; the bank accepts {get2} euros a day in dirty money
textos.Trajes a medida para ejecutivos y para q: Tailored suits for executives and for anyone who wants to look like one.
Stay calm: I'll guide you to the ground.
textos.Tranquilo, lo que se dice tranquilo, no: Quiet, as such, it's not. But it's my home.
Relax, it's not that big a deal.
textos.Transporta el dinero de los bancos. Si l: Carries the banks' money. If you blow it up, it drops a fortune, and the whole police force will come after you.
textos.Transporte: lleva la carga a {nombre}, e: Transport: take the cargo to {nombre}, in {nombre2}, without getting out of the truck.
textos.Tras una pared o un vehículo parado. A c: Behind a wall or a parked vehicle. In cover you get hit much less; if you move, you leave it.
textos.Tras {get} kilómetros de carretera llega: After {get} kilometers of road you arrive at {nombre}. It is {hora_txt}. You are heading {v} on {describir}.
textos.Tratamiento tras la prueba de salud sexu: Treatment after the sexual health test, adult content
textos.Trato cerrado: {barrio} vuelve a ser de: Deal done: {barrio} belongs to {banda} again and you take {euros} euros.
textos.Trato es trato. Toma tu rifle. Y un chal: A deal is a deal. Here's your rifle. And a vest, on the house. I don't want to lose my best customer.
textos.Travesía acelerada, pero solo con el pil: Fast crossing, but only with the autopilot on: now you are flying it yourself.
textos.Travesía acelerada: cuando pase algo irá: Fast crossing: when something happens it will go at its own pace, and afterward it will speed up again.
textos.Travesía en vuelo. {k} y {k2} suben y ba: Flight crossing. {k} and {k2} climb and descend one hundred meters. {k3} and {k4} turn ten degrees. {k5} turns the autopilot on or off, which holds the heading and altitude on its own. {k6} tells you how much is left, the heading, the altitude, the wind and the fuel. {k7} speeds up the crossing or returns it to its own pace. {k8} repeats the last thing the tower said. {k9}, or {k10}, opens the flight menu: change destination, how you want to arrive and assisted landing. Without autopilot, two clicks tell you which way to turn: centered and high-pitched, you are lined up. A note plays when your altitude changes: the higher the pitch, the higher you are. Below {entero} meters the autopilot doesn't fly: the aircraft goes slower, uses more fuel and there are obstacles to jump, but the radar can't see you.
textos.Tregua cerrada con {banda}: {dias} días: Truce sealed with {banda}: {dias} days without attacks from them, until day {hasta}.
textos.Tregua con {banda} en vigor hasta el día: Truce with {banda} in effect until day {tregua}
textos.Treinta sabores de helado y horchata fre: Thirty ice cream flavors and fresh horchata.
textos.Tres asaltos en la jaula, cada uno contr: Three rounds in the cage, each against a tougher opponent than the last, no rest between them and fists only. If you fall in any of them, you lose the night. Pays a lot more than boxing, and each night won raises the prize and the toughness of the next.
textos.Tres avisos falsos en una semana, todos: Three false alarms in a week, all from the same gas station. The firefighters want to know who's calling.
textos.Tres años de ruleta amañada, con fechas: Three years of rigged roulette, with dates and amounts. This is going to hurt.
textos.Tres años sin llover como Dios manda. Es: Three years without proper rain. This isn't normal.
textos.Tres años. Me debes tres años, y eso no: Three years. You owe me three years, and nobody can pay that.
Three years. Three years over a note.
textos.Tres cajas: una al Mesón, otra a la Posa: Three crates: one to the Inn, one to the Guesthouse and one to the Parish Pantry, which is a gift.
textos.Tres cartas en una mañana, Dani. Y las t: Three letters in one morning, Dani. And all three are about you. Sit down, I'll read them to you.
Three unmarked tankers in one night. Water that doesn't exist, sold at a golden price. Now I have my headline.
textos.Tres encargos al día, distintos en cada: Three jobs a day, different at each airfield. You get paid when you land at the destination airfield
textos.Tres encargos para elegir, cada uno de u: Three jobs to choose from, each done a different way: take out someone with their bodyguards, hunt down one who flees by car, go into a venue to find them, follow their errand runner to the hideout, teach someone a lesson without killing, recover something stolen or protect someone. Each contract completed makes the next ones harder and better paid.
textos.Tres negocios me deben la cuota de prote: Three businesses owe me protection money: Club Neón, Sibarita Restaurant and El Espeto Beach Bar.
textos.Tres noches sin luz. Se llevan el cable: Three nights without power. They're taking the copper cable in pieces, and the company says nothing until Monday.
textos.Tres oleadas de pandilleros, cada una má: Three waves of thugs, each tougher than the last. If you win, the neighborhood pays you {precio} euros every midnight.
textos.Tres plantas de aparcamiento siempre lle: Three floors of parking that are always full.
textos.Tres salidas esta semana a la gasolinera: Three call-outs this week to the gas station in the east, and all three times nothing was burning.
textos.Tres sobres, tres sitios, cuatro minutos: Three envelopes, three places, four minutes. No questions.
textos.Tres sonidos avisan: tres notas que sube: Three sounds alert you: three rising notes when someone joins, three falling when someone leaves, and two high ones when a message arrives.
textos.Tres teclas más para recordar. La V dice: Three more keys to remember. V tells you your status: health, money and weapon. O, the objective of the current mission. M opens the phone, with missions, places, services and much more.
textos.Tres tratos que propones tú: devolverles: Three deals you propose: hand a neighborhood of yours back in exchange for money, buy one from them without firing a shot, or charge them daily tribute for letting them stay. What they answer depends on your strength and how you get along with them, and it is not the same every day.
textos.Tres válvulas, una noche y toda la ciuda: Three valves, one night and the whole city watching.
textos.Tres, y los tres distintos como la noche: Three, and all three as different as night and day.
textos.Tres. Abre el ZIP y copia todo lo que tr: Three. Open the ZIP and copy everything inside it into the folder where you have the game, over what's there. When Windows asks, choose to replace the files. Don't delete the folder first: your saved games, your options and your music are inside, and the new version brings none of that, so they aren't overwritten. Your mods aren't deleted either.
textos.Tres. Vuelve al juego con Alt y Tabulado: Three. Go back to the game with Alt and Tab. There is no need to close or restart it.
textos.Trescientas balas en quince segundos. No: Three hundred bullets in fifteen seconds. Nothing is left standing.
textos.Trescientos euros cada noche y la calle: Three hundred euros a night and the street at your feet. You'll always live with one eye on the door.
textos.Tributo que te paga cada territorio, cad: Tribute each territory pays you, every midnight
textos.Truchas con jamón, dados y cazadores que: Trout with ham, dice and hunters who hire themselves out as bodyguards.
Lake trout and, with luck, a pike.
Trout and barbel in clean water.
textos.Tráfico de frente a tu misma altitud, a: Head-on traffic at your altitude, a few kilometers away. Climb or descend a hundred meters, now.
textos.Tráfico detenido delante. Espera, o mant: Traffic stopped ahead. Wait, or hold A to overtake on the left.
textos.Tu abogado consigue que se archive: ese: Your lawyer gets it dismissed: that entry disappears.
textos.Tu abogado encuentra defectos de forma:: Your lawyer finds procedural defects: you pay half and nothing goes on the record.
textos.Tu abogado hace dos llamadas y el periód: Your lawyer makes two calls and the newspaper thinks better of it: the story doesn't run.
textos.Tu abogado recurre y gana: la falta pasa: Your lawyer appeals and wins: the offense becomes {v} and expires in {v2} days.
textos.Tu abogado: lo tienes contratado: Your lawyer: you have one hired
textos.Tu amigo ha dejado el vehículo y te baja: Your friend has left the vehicle and you get out.
textos.Tu apuesta por el total de los dos puños: Your guess for the total in both fists. If you're right, you win double your bet; if your opponent is right, you lose it; if nobody is, it's played again.
textos.Tu banda va sin ti y el resultado se cal: Your gang goes without you and the result is worked out instantly: their strength against the neighborhood's defense plus what each of yours adds, and each side's luck. You're told with the numbers. One of yours may fall. If it goes badly, you lose the neighborhood.
textos.Tu banda: necesitas un territorio para t: Your gang: you need a territory to have one
textos.Tu carrera: vida honrada y vida delictiv: Your career: honest life and criminal life
textos.Tu cartera vale {int} euros: {balance_tx: Your portfolio is worth {int} euros: {balance_txt}. Dividends collected: {get} euros
textos.Tu chófer no encuentra cómo llegar hasta: Your chauffeur can't find a way to get here. You get your money back.
textos.Tu contrato es de una empresa que ya no: Your contract is with a company that no longer exists in this data.
textos.Tu contrato fijo, si lo tienes: jefe, tu: Your permanent contract, if you have one: boss, shifts for the period, payroll and warnings. Contracts are signed at the job centers.
textos.Tu cuenta es la misma en todas las ofici: Your account is the same at every office.
textos.Tu cuerpo pide una sustancia de la que d: Your body craves a substance you depend on: a tremor.
textos.Tu defensa suma {int}: {int2} del barrio: Your defense adds up to {int}: {int2} from the neighborhood and {int3} from
textos.Tu dirección para amigos de fuera es {de: Your address for friends from outside is {deletrear}. It is in this menu so you can copy it.
textos.Tu ficha: una frase sobre tu personaje: Your profile: a sentence about your character
textos.Tu fuerza en la calle: {int} de 100. Tu: Your strength on the street: {int} out of 100. Your gang, {banda}; your neighborhoods, {len}

textos.Tu gente se dispersa. Vuelven cuando los: Your crew scatters. They come back when you call them.
textos.Tu gente, uno por uno: lo que vale cada: Your crew, one by one: what each one is worth

textos.Tu hermano [roncaba como una locomotora|: Your brother [snored like a train|couldn't shut up even underwater]. What's going on in Monteferro?
textos.Tu identidad está copiada en el portapap: Your identity is copied to the clipboard. Paste it into a file and keep it where nobody else can see it. Whoever has it can join as you.
textos.Tu jef[e|a], {jefe}, es {caracter}. Eval: Your boss, {jefe}, is {caracter}. Good evaluations you have toward a promotion: {meritos} of {entero}
textos.Tu jefe se entera de un antecedente: Your boss finds out about a criminal record
textos.Tu jefe te escucha con cara de piedra: «: Your boss listens with a stone face: "You were new once too."
textos.Tu juego es demasiado antiguo para este: Your game is too old for this server. Update the game.
textos.Tu juego es más nuevo de lo que este ser: Your game is newer than this server understands. Whoever runs the server has to update it.
Your game sends too many messages.
textos.Tu juego no ha enviado una identidad vál: Your game has not sent a valid identity.
textos.Tu juego trae cosas que este servidor no: Your game has things this server does not know. %s. You can use them on your own, but against other players those weapons count as bare hands, and those vehicles will look like a compact car to them.
textos.Tu lista de servidores está vacía: no ha: Your server list is empty: there is nothing to remove.
textos.Tu mano en la cocina sube al nivel {nive: Your cooking skill goes up to level {nivel_cocina} of 10.
textos.Tu mano en la cocina: nivel {nivel_cocin: Your hand in the kitchen: level {nivel_cocina} of 10. Dishes cooked: {get}
textos.Tu mecánico lo deja aparcado en la calle: Your mechanic leaves it parked on the street next to you, wherever it is, even if it is in another town. [He|She] won't come if the police are heavily after you.
Your mechanic leaves it parked on the street next to you, wherever it is. [He|She] won't come if the police are heavily after you.
textos.Tu mecánico lo saca del garaje y te lo d: Your mechanic takes it out of the garage and leaves it in the street, next to you. In the middle of the sea or with a lot of police after you, he doesn't come.
textos.Tu mecánico se lleva el vehículo que lle: Your mechanic takes the vehicle you are driving, or the one you just left parked nearby, to the garage of the home you choose. It works for homes in any town.
textos.Tu mecánico se lleva {nombre} al garaje: Your mechanic takes {nombre} to the garage in {nombre_lugar}.
textos.Tu mecánico se lo lleva al garaje de la: Your mechanic takes it to the garage of the house you choose, wherever the vehicle is.
Your mechanic takes it to the garage of the house you choose, and it is no longer on the server's street: it no longer expires and nobody can take it.
textos.Tu mecánico te deja {nombre} en la calle: Your mechanic leaves {nombre} on the street. {situar}.
textos.Tu negocio no está en la lista de los qu: Your business isn't on the list of the ones going up. Someone remembered the person who didn't point a finger at anyone.
textos.Tu nivel de búsqueda es el que diga ahor: Your wanted level is now whatever the server's police says.
textos.Tu nivel en cada habilidad, del uno al d: Your level in each skill, from one to ten, and your maximum health. They go up by themselves with practice, and F1 explains each one.
textos.Tu nivel en cada habilidad, que sube al: Your level in each skill, which goes up as you practice it, and the achievements you have earned so far.
textos.Tu ordenador hace de servidor y tú sigue: Your computer acts as the server and you keep playing normally. Afterwards I'll tell you the address to give them.
textos.Tu papel. Dentro, o abres tú la caja, o: Your role. Inside, you either open the safe yourself, or cover whoever opens it and handle whatever comes. On the getaway, you either drive, or ride as a passenger and shoot with Q and Ctrl.
textos.Tu partida está protegida con contraseña: Your game is password protected: tell your friend
textos.Tu partida no tiene contraseña: entra cu: Your game has no password: anyone with the address can join
textos.Tu pedido de {local} llega a {donde} en: Your order from {local} arrives at {donde} in about {falta} minutes.
textos.Tu perro busca por el olfato el objeto m: Your dog sniffs out the nearest item.
textos.Tu perro: que busque por el olfato: Your dog: have it search by scent
textos.Tu personaje está guardado en el servido: Your character is saved on the server as it was at its last save.
Your character is saved on the server as it was {tiempo_txt} before the cutoff: what you did afterward wasn't saved.
textos.Tu personaje ocupa demasiado para este s: Your character is too big for this server and could not be saved: it stays as it was in the previous save.
textos.Tu personaje quedó guardado en el servid: Your character was saved on the server right before it shut down.
textos.Tu personaje se guarda solo. Cuando el s: Your character saves itself. When the server is back, join again from Play on a server.
textos.Tu personaje tiene armas o vehículos de: Your character has weapons or vehicles from a newer version of the game. With this one you will not see them, but you do not lose them: they stay saved on the server and you will have them again when you come in with that version.
textos.Tu prestigio entre los vecinos sube diez: Your standing with the neighbors goes up ten times more than by donating fifty, and your mood improves too. You can repeat it.
textos.Tu primera ronda de cobros en San Lucero: Your first round of collections in San Lucero. We have to make it clear who's in charge now.
textos.Tu rango, cuántos sois, cuántos barrios: Your rank, how many of you there are, how many neighborhoods you have and the money in the till.
textos.Tu ropa, tu calzado y tus complementos:: Your clothes, shoes and accessories: everything you have ever bought. You put them on without paying. Changing clothes throws the police off if your wanted level is low and no officers are nearby.
textos.Tu router tiene que dejar pasar el puert: Your router has to let port {puerto}, TCP protocol, through to this computer
textos.Tu récord en la máquina de memoria: {get: Your record on the memory machine: {get} rounds
Your health is already at maximum.
textos.Tu solvencia para el banco es {hon_solve: Your creditworthiness for the bank is {hon_solvencia_txt}. Stable income: {hon_ingresos_semana} euros a week
textos.Tu tía Encarna te espera en el Bar La Ga: Your aunt Encarna is waiting for you at La Gaviota Bar, right next door. That's where the story begins. Good luck.
Your aunt Encarna is waiting for you at La Gaviota Bar.
textos.Tu tía tiene que estar reventando de org: Your aunt must be bursting with pride. And so am I, for heaven's sake.
textos.Tu versión del juego no es la misma que: Your game version is not the same as the host's.
textos.Tu ánimo baja de nivel: con el ánimo muy: Your mood drops a level: with very low mood you aim worse and run less.
textos.Tu ánimo es {animo_txt}. En la calle, {r: Your mood is {animo_txt}. On the street, {reputacion_txt}
Your mood rises a level: you aim better.
textos.Tumbas en defensa propia siendo buena ge: You knock someone down in self-defense while being a good person
textos.Turno apuntado en tu contrato: llevas {h: Turn logged on your contract: you have {hechos} of {cupo} this period.
textos.Turnos de contrato que cuentan cada día: Contract shifts that count each day
textos.Turnos que pide por periodo: Shifts it asks for per period
textos.Turnos trabajados con contrato, en total: Shifts worked under contract, in total
textos.Tus amigos te verán como {nombre_online}: Your friends will see you as {nombre_online}.
textos.Tus armas con su munición, los botiquine: Your weapons with their ammo, the first aid kits, the lock picks, the armor and the backpack.
textos.Tus canciones no salen de tu ordenador:: Your songs never leave your computer: on an online server nobody hears them, and game updates don't touch them.
textos.Tus cartas, lo que suman y la carta que: Your cards, what they add up to and the card the dealer is showing. Enter reads it again.
textos.Tus casas, tus negocios con lo que dan a: Your houses, your businesses with what they give per day, your boats and what you have in the bank.
textos.Tus conocidos aparecen aquí: puedes llam: Your contacts show up here: you can call them and meet them for a drink.
textos.Tus créditos e hipotecas, lo que te van: Your loans and mortgages, what they will charge you in bills and taxes and when. Everything is charged automatically, with a warning two days before.
textos.Tus negocios han hecho {total} euros de: Your businesses made {total} euros in takings. {en_caja} euros are waiting to be collected.
textos.Tus negocios ingresan {total} euros en t: Your businesses deposit {total} euros into your bank account. Balance: {banco} euros.
textos.Tus negocios: nivel, empleados, nombre e: Your businesses: level, employees, name among the customers and what they earn. They are run by going to each one.
textos.Tus vehículos siguen donde estaban:: Your vehicles are still where they were:
textos.Tutorial de combate. Estás en el club de: Combat tutorial. You're at the shooting club: nobody attacks you here and the police don't come. You'll practice on dummies.
textos.Tutorial de trabajos. En Puerto Bravo ha: Jobs tutorial. In Puerto Bravo there are plenty of ways to earn money without following the story.
textos.Tutorial del mar. Estás en un embarcader: Sea tutorial. You're at a pier: this is where you head out to Mar de Poniente.
textos.Tutorial jugable de combate: fijar un ob: Playable combat tutorial: lock onto a target, strike, shoot and reload, against dummies that don't fight back. You can't fail.
textos.Tutorial jugable de trabajos: subes a un: Playable jobs tutorial: you get in a taxi, start working with J and do a real service, picking up a customer and taking them to their destination. You can't fail.
textos.Tutorial jugable del mar: zarpas con una: Playable sea tutorial: you set sail in a practice boat, steer for a stretch and dock at a pier. Then, what you can do out at sea. You can't fail.
textos.Tutorial jugable: tres ejercicios cortos: Playable tutorial: three short exercises to learn how to get your bearings, use the GPS and the radar, and drive. You can't fail.
textos.Tutorial. Puedes saltarlo con Escape y r: Tutorial. You can skip it with Escape and repeat any sentence with the up arrow. All the keys are always in the help, with F1.
I had someone. Not anymore. These things happen.
textos.Tía, ¿desde cuándo planeas atracos?: Auntie, since when do you plan robberies?
textos.Títulos que llevan varias sesiones, una: Degrees that take several sessions, one a day, and money. They open better positions in permanent contracts and upgrades for your businesses. You can study and work on the same day.
textos.Tú conduce y no preguntes. Y con cuidado: You drive and don't ask questions. And carefully, the product is delicate.
textos.Tú eres Dani, [el sobrino|la sobrina] de: You must be Dani, Encarna's nephew. She said you might come by. I'm Aurora, the counselor.
You're Dani, Encarna's [nephew|niece]. I need someone who doesn't attract attention.
textos.Tú eres Dani. Encarna dice que eres de f: So you're Dani. Encarna says you can be trusted. I say we'll see.
textos.Tú eres Dani. Me ha hablado de ti Casild: You're Dani. Casilda told me about you, and Casilda doesn't speak well of just anybody. I'm Salva. Thirty years behind a bar, until my knees said enough.
You're Custodia's new hire. I'm Salva. We Los Aljibes look after this neighborhood. Drop by the gym later.
textos.Tú montas la partida o te unes a la de u: You host the game or join a friend's. No outside server is needed
textos.Tú no eres de aquí. Mejor. Aquí todos so: You're not from here. Good. Everyone here is somebody's cousin and nobody wants trouble.
You're the one with legs, go take a look. I'm not moving from here, someone has to guard the rum.
You probably know more than I do about that.
textos.Tú sigue estudiando. Con el título de ad: You keep studying. With the administration degree you're no longer hired hands: you're the one who keeps the books. And whoever keeps the books can, one day, keep their own.
You and I have unfinished business.
textos.Tú, por delante. Si sales de esta, eres: You first. If you make it out of this, you're one of the family.
Ugh, I'm swamped today. But tell me.
Ugh, you caught me off guard.
An admin has shut down the server.
textos.Un administrador ha borrado tu cuenta de: An admin has deleted your account on this server.
textos.Un administrador te ha sacado del servid: An admin has kicked you from the server.
An admin has kicked you from the server. Reason: %s
textos.Un agente la deja pasar una vez al día s: An officer lets it pass once a day if people like you and your record is clean.
textos.Un agente te da el beneficio de la duda: An officer gives you the benefit of the doubt
textos.Un agente te ha cogido. Búsqueda de nive: An officer has caught you. Wanted level {estrellas}. You have {dinero} euros
textos.Un agente te ha visto, te reconoce y lo: An officer saw you, recognizes you and lets it go this time.
textos.Un agente te para: «Documentación». Te t: An officer stops you: "ID." He holds you ten minutes against the wall, going through your papers, and reluctantly lets you go.
textos.Un agente te reconoce: conduces sin carn: An officer recognizes you: you're driving without a license.
textos.Un agente tras una mampara. Aquí te atie: An officer behind a screen. You're served here.
textos.Un almacén portuario sin letrero. Dentro: A port warehouse with no sign. Inside, Irina, whom everyone calls La Rusa, sells good iron at a better price than anyone.
textos.Un andén, una taquilla y el panel de sal: A platform, a ticket window and the departures board. Trains leave from here for the other towns you can reach by land.
A serious criminal record costs triple.
textos.Un antecedente leve pesa uno; uno medio,: A minor criminal record weighs one; a moderate one, two; a serious one, four.
textos.Un antiguo almacén convertido en viviend: An old warehouse turned into a home, with room for two vehicles.
An old convent turned into a hotel.
textos.Un aparato robado no se puede guardar aq: A stolen aircraft can't be kept here: it's been reported all over the region.
textos.Un aparato secuestrado no puede ser tuyo: A hijacked aircraft can't become yours or be kept in a hangar. On an online server you can't hijack.
textos.Un apartado de la explicación. Con las f: A section of the explanation. With the arrow keys you move to the next one or back to the previous one.
textos.Un apartamento con terraza frente al mar: An apartment with a terrace facing the sea and a garage for three vehicles.
textos.Un apunte de la caja: quién metió o sacó: A till entry: who put in or took out money, how much and why.
textos.Un arma solo le alcanza si llega hasta a: A weapon only reaches them if it gets that far.
textos.Un arrecife poco profundo donde han enca: A shallow reef where ships have run aground for centuries. A good place to dive.
textos.Un audiojuego de mundo abierto, en españ: An open-world audio game, designed from the start to be played without seeing the screen
textos.Un autogiro de dos plazas. Vuela por enc: A two-seat autogyro. It flies above everything, like the helicopter, but slower.
textos.Un aviso pide testigos de una carrera il: A notice asks for witnesses of an illegal night race.
textos.Un aviso que oye cada jugador al entrar,: A notice every player hears when coming in, after the welcome: a meetup, a new rule. Empty, none. It can be changed with the server running.
A warning visible from all over the bay. You gain street reputation, and Los Calaveras won't forgive you.
textos.Un baile sensual solo para ti. Sube el á: A sensual dance just for you. It lifts your mood.
textos.Un bajo de roca donde se esconden los me: A rocky shoal where the biggest groupers on the coast hide. Press P to fish.
A bench bolted to the floor.
textos.Un barco no sigue carriles: se gobierna: A boat doesn't follow lanes: you steer it by hand. Up arrow accelerates, down arrow brakes and reverses, and the left and right arrows turn the helm. C tells you your heading.
textos.Un barco pequeño. Para salir yo sol{o},: A small boat. To go out alone, with nobody.
textos.Un barco zarpa. En el mar, también marca: A ship sets sail. At sea, it also marks nightfall.
textos.Un barrio con dueño. Le deja dinero a es: A neighborhood with an owner. It leaves money for that gang every server midnight.
textos.Un barrio o una localidad, y cómo es. Lo: A neighborhood or a town, and what it's like. The ones you haven't set foot in yet say unvisited.
textos.Un barrio se compra por unos {get} euros: A neighborhood is bought for about {get} euros; tribute of about {get2} a day
textos.Un bazar donde hay absolutamente de todo: A bazaar where there is absolutely everything.
textos.Un baño largo te sube más el ánimo y te: A long bath lifts your mood more and takes away some of your bruises.
textos.Un baño largo, con el agua bien caliente: A long bath, with really hot water. You come out like new.
textos.Un beso o la noche, oliendo mal: A kiss or the night, smelling bad
textos.Un botón y lo que hace. Se cambia en Rea: A button and what it does. It is changed in Reassign, in the controller menu.
textos.Un buen libro y el ruido del mar. No pid: A good book and the sound of the sea. I don't ask for more.
textos.Un buen maestro vale más que cien libros: A good teacher is worth more than a hundred books.
textos.Un café siempre apetece. Y con compañía,: A coffee always sounds good. And with company, even better.
textos.Un caldo, un bocadillo y el camino hasta: A broth, a sandwich and the walk to the soup kitchen. They know him there: "About time you came, Tomás."
textos.Un camión cisterna llega hasta la aerona: A tanker truck pulls up to the aircraft and puts in half a tank, so you can take off and refuel at an airfield.
textos.Un camión cisterna llega hasta {nombre}: A tanker truck pulls up to {nombre} and puts in half a tank.
textos.Un camión volquete lento y durísimo. Con: A slow, tough dump truck. Press the J key to haul loads between towns.
textos.Un canal para hablar como tu personaje,: A channel to speak as your character, heard by those nearby; another to speak out of character, heard by the whole server; a command to describe what your character does; and a profile sentence others can read. It depends on the server having them.
A treat: doesn't fill you up much and cheers you up.
textos.Un cartel descolorido ofrece recompensa: A faded poster offers a reward for a parrot that knows how to swear.
textos.Un cazador furtivo anda matando los cier: A poacher is killing the deer in the Fuentefría valley.
textos.Un chalé de montaña con chimenea y garaj: A mountain villa with a fireplace and a garage for four vehicles.
textos.Un chalé en lo alto de la colina, con cu: A villa at the top of the hill, with four garage spaces and the whole city at your feet.
textos.Un cine al aire libre con sillas de tije: An open-air cinema with folding chairs.
A neighborhood cinema with a double feature.
textos.Un cine de una sola sala, con butacas de: A single-screen cinema, with red velvet seats and stale popcorn.
textos.Un claxon a lo lejos, de ambiente: no es: A distant car horn, as ambience: it is not for you.
textos.Un cliente del Chispas quiere un deporti: A customer of El Chispas wants one very specific sports car.
textos.Un cliente del desguace paga muy bien po: A scrapyard customer pays very well for one particular convertible, which sleeps on the golf course.
textos.Un cliente quiere un {nombre}. Hay uno a: A customer wants a {nombre}. There's one parked next to {nombre2}. Steal it.
textos.Un cliente reclama a gritos por un error: A customer is shouting about a mistake that isn't yours, but is your crew's.
textos.Un cliente se ha llevado un Viento GT si: A customer has driven off with a Viento GT without paying.
textos.Un club de tiro deportivo, con instructo: A sport shooting club, with certified instructors.
textos.Un club nocturno del puerto, de luces ro: A harbor nightclub, with red lights and a broad-shouldered doorman. Adults only.
A classic that never goes out of style.
textos.Un cobrador pasa cada noche por los loca: A collector goes around the venues every night, and the churro maker wants to know who he works for.
textos.Un coche de carreras de verdad va a pasa: A real race car is going to spend a night at the stadium.
textos.Un coche de carreras de verdad. Lo más r: A real race car. The fastest thing on wheels, and the most fragile.
textos.Un coche de policía. Robarlo no pasa des: A police car. Stealing it doesn't go unnoticed. With J you chase suspects.
textos.Un coche del ayuntamiento. Esto ya no es: A town hall car. This is no longer a neighborhood loan shark: it's something else. Good work, Dani.
textos.Un coche levantado y herramientas por el: A car on a lift and tools on the floor.
textos.Un coche patrulla que va a por ti, o un: A patrol car coming for you, or a fire truck.
textos.Un cocido en invierno y un gazpacho en v: A stew in winter and a gazpacho in summer. And that's living.
textos.Un combate a puñetazos. Cada victoria su: A fistfight. Each victory raises the prize and the toughness of the next opponent.
textos.Un contable de la fundición anda sacando: A foundry accountant has been taking money that isn't his. Stop by the offices: they'll tell you there.
textos.Un cristal grueso y el armero detrás. Aq: Thick glass and the gunsmith behind it. You buy here.
A glass window and a clerk. You do your banking here.
textos.Un crédito pequeño ahora; una hipoteca c: A small loan now; a mortgage when you earn a bit more. You pay in installments, you get a notice before each one, and whoever pays on time finds the door more open next time.
textos.Un cuartelillo pequeño junto a los muell: A small post by the docks.
textos.Un cuarto de hora de gato y llave: rueda: A quarter of an hour with a jack and wrench: tire changed. {nombre} rolls well again.
textos.Un cuarto preparado para fabricar mercan: A room set up to make product. It brings in a lot of money and a lot of trouble: the neighbours smell things, the police ask questions, and if you make a mistake it can burn.
textos.Un cupé largo, bajo y pintado a mano. No: A long, low, hand-painted coupe. It doesn't go fast, but it holds up and sounds deep.
textos.Un dato de tu partida, que se va poniend: A figure from your game, which keeps updating as you play. Enter reads it again.
textos.Un derrumbe cierra una galería de Montef: A cave-in closes a gallery at Monteferro.
textos.Un disparo apagado: apenas lo oye nadie: A muffled shot: hardly anyone around hears it.
textos.Un disparo cada vez que aprietas, y rápi: One shot each time you squeeze, and fast. Halfway between the carbine and the assault rifle: ten bullets that reach far.
textos.Un disparo seco y muy corto, que se repi: A dry, very short shot, repeating very fast.
A shot has whizzed past you.
textos.Un disparo, un problema menos. Alcanza c: One shot, one less problem. Reaches almost a hundred meters.
textos.Un día por línea, en minúsculas y con ti: One day per line, in lowercase and with the accent: lunes, martes, miércoles, jueves, viernes, sábado, domingo.
textos.Un edificio con reloj y campanas. En el: A building with a clock and bells. On the balcony, a banner: water is scarce, use it wisely.
textos.Un edificio gris desde el que se decide: A gray building from which the whole city's life is decided. The company belongs to Belmonte.
textos.Un enemigo prepara el arma: medio segund: An enemy readies their weapon: half a second later they will fire. It also sounds when you switch weapons.
textos.Un espera se respeta. Parar y escuchar e: A "wait" is respected. Stopping and listening is what brings you closest.
textos.Un espigón donde los jubilados echan la: A breakwater where retirees cast their rods. Here you can fish from land.
textos.Un espray para salir del paso. No sustit: A spray to get by. It's no substitute for a shower, but it helps. Used from what you carry.
textos.Un estampido grave y, detrás, la correde: A deep boom and, right behind it, the slide.
textos.Un estudio moderno en pleno Centro, con: A modern studio right in El Centro, with a parking space for two vehicles.
textos.Un faro apagado hace cuarenta años. Dice: A lighthouse that went dark forty years ago. They say that from up there you can see all the way to Isla Tortuga.
textos.Un fondo de la ciudad quiere comprar la: A fund from the city wants to buy the entire Villaseca cooperative, and Anselmo asks you for advice.
textos.Un gesto de cariño, cara a cara. Hace fa: A gesture of affection, face to face. It takes some trust, and each one can be repeated once a day.
textos.Un gimnasio de boxeo de los de antes: sa: An old-school boxing gym: punching bags, liniment and a coach who yells.
textos.Un gimnasio moderno con vistas al mar y: A modern gym with sea views and a boxing ring.
A gust of wind shakes the aircraft.
textos.Un golpe de hacha: el silbido y el golpe: An axe strike: the whoosh and the dull thud of the blade.
textos.Un golpe fuerte con el vehículo: se daña: A hard hit with the vehicle: it takes damage.
textos.Un golpe hueco, de tubo: sale una granad: A hollow thump, like a tube: a grenade is launched.
A swing that hits no one.
A sharp thud from below: you've touched ground.
textos.Un grito: el tuyo para espantar a la gen: A scream: yours to scare people off, or an enemy who has spotted you and alerts their friends.
textos.Un grito: los peatones de alrededor se a: A shout: pedestrians around you move away.
textos.Un guarda te mira desde la garita y apun: A guard watches you from the booth and writes something in a notebook.
textos.Un guardaespaldas llega en un minuto y s: A bodyguard arrives in a minute and stands by your side. They charge {precio} euros every midnight.
textos.Un hombre duerme en un portal, tapado co: A man is sleeping in a doorway, covered with cardboard. His lips are purple from the cold.
textos.Un hombre grita de susto y sale corriend: A man yells in fright and runs off.
textos.Un hombre mayor se ha caído en un paso d: An older man has fallen at a crosswalk. He's bleeding from an eyebrow and isn't getting up.
textos.Un hombre presume de lo que pescó el dom: A man brags about what he caught on Sunday. Nobody believes him.
textos.Un hotel de cinco estrellas frente al ma: A five-star hotel facing the sea. The doorman wears more stripes than an admiral.
textos.Un hotel señorial junto a la plaza de la: A stately hotel next to Cathedral Square.
textos.Un informante te lo sopla: {banda} irá a: An informant tips you off: {banda} will go after {barrio}, {cuando}.
textos.Un inspector de licencias pide un sobre: A license inspector asks every merchant for an envelope. Matilde needs proof.
textos.Un inspector te hace saber que estás en: An inspector lets you know you're on his list. For {precio} euros he'll look the other way. Otherwise, there'll be a raid. Sort it out on your phone, under Territories, before midnight.
textos.Un invernadero entre los olivos. Lo que: A greenhouse among the olive trees. What Uncle Lucas grows isn't tomatoes.
textos.Un juego de cartas con baraja española c: A card game with a Spanish deck against the house. You bet ten, fifty or two hundred euros.
A hot-or-cold game with your ears. The beeping speeds up and gets higher as you get closer to the treasure. Three searches a day at each place.
textos.Un lanchón de hierro con una grúa en pop: An iron barge with a crane at the stern. Slow and hard as an anvil.
textos.Un logro se consigue solo, en cuanto hac: An achievement is earned by itself, as soon as you do what it says, and the game announces it with a sound.
textos.Un masaje lento, una ducha larga, y os d: A slow massage, a long shower, and you fall asleep in each other's arms.
textos.Un mastodonte: lento, pero lo aplasta to: A behemoth: slow, but it crushes everything. With the J key you do hauls between towns.
textos.Un mensaje de la partida. Para escribir: A message from the game. To write one, press F10 while playing.
textos.Un mensaje del servidor. El más reciente: A message on the server. The newest comes first.
textos.Un mensaje «%s» de %s no se ha podido at: A «%s» message from %s could not be handled and is let through: %s: %s
textos.Un mes después, el pleno devuelve la des: A month later, the council returns the desalination plant to the city. Custodia cuts the ribbon with the bronze key hanging from her neck.
textos.Un minijuego de oído. Suenan dos tonos:: A hearing minigame. Two tones play: a steady one, which is the sweet spot, and another that drifts away. With up arrow and down arrow you bring yours up to match the steady one, and hold it there. The longer they match, the better the batch comes out and the more units you get. If you let it drift too high for too long, it can catch fire.
textos.Un minuto del juego son dos segundos de: One game minute is two clock seconds.
textos.Un modelo local es una inteligencia arti: A local model is a small artificial intelligence that runs on your own computer: it is free, needs no internet or key, and nothing you type leaves your machine. It answers more slowly and with less flair than the online services, and the older your computer, the longer it takes. The game downloads two things to the folder data, local AI: the program called dot c p p, which is open source, and the model you choose. While AI mode uses it, the game starts it when it opens and always closes it on exit: nothing is ever left running.
textos.Un mostrador con campanilla. Aquí te ati: A counter with a little bell. You're served here.
textos.Un mostrador con facturas. Aquí se encar: A counter with invoices. You order the work here.
textos.Un mostrador con toallas. Aquí te apunta: A counter with towels. You sign up here.
textos.Un mostrador frío con bandejas. De fondo: A cold counter with trays. In the background, the cold cut slicer.
textos.Un mostrador y gente esperando. Aquí te: A counter and people waiting. You're served here.
textos.Un muelle de hormigón entre dos grúas. D: A concrete pier between two cranes. From here you head out to open sea.
textos.Un muelle de piedra donde antes cargaban: A stone pier where they used to load the salt.
A wooden pier with four boats.
textos.Un museo con un planetario y un péndulo: A museum with a planetarium and a giant pendulum.
textos.Un narrador te explica cómo se juega: el: A narrator explains how to play: the sound, movement and the basic keys. You can skip it with Escape.
textos.Un negocio atendido rinde más y uno aban: A business that is looked after earns more and a neglected one, less. Its name among the customers goes up if you stop by here, if you put in hours and with low prices.
textos.Un niño de unos seis años llora junto a: A boy about six years old is crying next to a traffic light. He says he can't find his grandfather.
textos.Un nombre por línea. Van de oeste a este: One name per line. They run from west to east.
textos.Un nombre por línea. Van de sur a norte: One name per line. They run from south to north and are 90 meters apart.
textos.Un olmo centenario y un caño de agua hel: A hundred-year-old elm and a spout of ice-cold water.
textos.Un ordenador y un montón de impresos. Aq: A computer and a pile of forms. You're served here.
textos.Un pantalán de tablas medio podridas, el: A jetty of half-rotten planks, the island's only mooring point.
textos.Un par de gotas y te sientes otra person: A couple of drops and you feel like a new person.
textos.Un paseo por el puerto y lo ves distinto: A walk around the harbor and you see it differently. It works for me.
textos.Un paseo, el cine, una cena, una travesí: A walk, the movies, a dinner, a boat trip... Each plan plays out a different scene. One a day.
A long corridor with targets at the end.
textos.Un paso para actualizar a mano. Con flec: One step to update by hand. Down arrow takes you to the next one.
A pedestrian can take 50 and the player, 100.
textos.Un peatón murmura al hablarte, o dos que: A pedestrian murmurs as they talk to you, or two passersby chat with each other.
textos.Un perchero y las llaves colgadas. Por a: A coat rack and keys hanging up. This way out to the street.
textos.Un periodista prepara un reportaje sobre: A journalist is working on a story about your other life. You have {dias} days to decide what to do; it's on your phone, in Life, reputation and consequences, Pending matters.
A journalist is working on a story about your other life. {plazo}
textos.Un perro ladra. Si es el tuyo, avisa de: A dog barks. If it's yours, it warns you of a nearby enemy or that it has sniffed something out.
textos.Un perro te acompaña a todas partes, avi: A dog goes everywhere with you, warns you about enemies and sniffs out objects.
