textos.Un perro te cambia la vida. Y los zapato: A dog changes your life. And your shoes.
textos.Un pez ha mordido el anzuelo: tira enseg: A fish has bitten the hook: pull right away, within a second.
textos.Un peñasco blanco de guano. El griterío: A white rock covered in guano. The racket of the seagulls can be heard half a mile away.
textos.Un piloto de la casa se la lleva a una p: A house pilot flies it to one of your hangar spaces, wherever the aircraft is. An aircraft isn't brought to your door: you go find it at the airfield.
textos.Un piloto de la casa se lleva {nombre} a: A company pilot takes {nombre} to the hangar at {nombre_lugar}.
textos.Un piso compartido que ahora puede ser s: A shared apartment that can now be all yours. Garage for three vehicles.
A full dish for several days.
textos.Un pueblo de viñas al norte de Puerto Br: A vineyard town north of Puerto Bravo: three missions about a wine fraud, an honest job, a tractor race, river fishing, a hunting shotgun, a sickle, a tractor with trailer, a country off-roader and a character.
textos.Un pueblo minero en lo alto de la sierra: A mining town high in the mountains: four missions about a mine someone is working in secret, an honest job, an adult story, a carbine, a pickaxe and dynamite, a quad, a trials motorcycle and a dump truck for hauling loads, a mountain climb, fishing in the lake, treasure hunting and two characters.
textos.Un pueblo pesquero nuevo al oeste de Pue: A new fishing town west of Puerto Bravo, with its story in five missions, honest work, weapons, vehicles, a sailboat, an autogyro, a race and two characters. It serves as an example of everything a mod can include.
textos.Un puñetazo, un batazo o un atropello qu: A punch, a bat swing or a hit-and-run that lands on someone.
textos.Un pájaro, en los parques y en los barri: A bird, in parks and quiet neighborhoods.
textos.Un quiosco de helados y bocadillos dentr: An ice cream and sandwich kiosk inside the park.
textos.Un regalo a domicilio da este por ciento: A gift delivered to the door gives this percent of the affinity it would give in person
textos.Un regalo para tu pareja, o para estrena: A gift for your partner, or to try out on your next night together: it makes it more special.
textos.Un resfriado me tuvo en cama la semana p: A cold kept me in bed last week.
textos.Un resumen de por dónde vas en la histor: A summary of where you are in the story and the list of missions you have done. From there you can replay any of them.
textos.Un resumen de tu vida: cómo te ven, lo q: A summary of your life: how people see you, the honest work you have done and what you have done outside the law.
textos.Un rifle de los de antes: siete balas, y: An old-style rifle: seven bullets, and you can hear the lever between shots. Accurate and cheaper than a modern one. Second-hand, at the pawn shops.
textos.Un roce o un golpe flojo con el vehículo: A scrape or a light bump with the vehicle.
textos.Un salón recreativo dentro de un viejo v: An arcade inside an old mine car.
textos.Un scooter con luces de colores bajo el: A scooter with colored lights under the chassis.
textos.Un servidor es un mundo que no se apaga,: A server is a world that never shuts down, with real players: you can do everything you do playing on your own, and also meet the others, trade, form gangs, fight over neighborhoods or do missions as a group. Your character is saved on the server.
textos.Un sobre cambia de manos y tu expediente: An envelope changes hands and your file disappears. They're no longer looking for you.
textos.Un socio del Grupo Belmonte se va dando: A partner of the Belmonte Group leaves, slamming the door.
textos.Un sofá en el que caben cuatro y una tel: A sofa that seats four and a huge TV.
textos.Un sofá grande y una tele nueva: A big sofa and a new TV
textos.Un sofá, la tele y una ventana a la call: A sofa, the TV and a window onto the street.
textos.Un sofá, una cocina nueva, una cama de l: A sofa, a new kitchen, a really good bed, a bathtub, plants and paintings, and a workbench if the house has a garage. Each item improves what you do in its room when you walk around inside the house, or how well you rest when you sleep.
textos.Un solar lleno de hierro. Está en venta: A lot full of iron. It's for sale to anyone who gets along with the Club. Earns money every midnight.
textos.Un solo arpón por disparo y tarda en rec: One harpoon per shot and it takes a while to reload, but it's nearly silent and where it hits, it stays.
textos.Un sonido de {que} vuelve a su volumen d: One sound from {que} is back at its default volume.
A pump and a tiny shop.
textos.Un sótano con buen sonido y mala ventila: A basement with good sound and bad ventilation. Someone plays almost every night.
textos.Un tajo de navaja, de machete o de katan: A slash of a knife, a machete or a katana.
textos.Un taller de neumáticos con clientela fi: A tire shop with a steady clientele. It is for sale.
textos.Un tanque flotante. Lento e indestructib: A floating tank. Slow and indestructible.
textos.Un taxi con luz verde y radio de la coop: A taxi with a green light and the co-op radio. Press the J key to carry passengers.
An old theater converted into a cinema.
textos.Un temporal deja amarrados los barcos de: A storm leaves the Poniente Shipping boats tied up in port.
textos.Un tercero sin ascensor en el Barrio Vie: A third-floor walk-up in Barrio Viejo. It smells of coffee and clean sheets. It is your home: here you can save the game, rest and leave up to two vehicles.
textos.Un tercero sin ascensor, pequeño y lumin: A small, bright third-floor walk-up with one garage space.
A text of up to %d letters.
textos.Un texto de hasta %d letras. Se guarda t: A text of up to %d letters. It is saved as is in the file: do not show it to anyone.
textos.Un tipo de lugar por línea, por ejemplo: One type of place per line, for example cine, or bar, taberna and club. An in-person date comes with you and the plan happens on arriving at one of those places; when you meet up, the game picks one near where that person usually is. Empty, a walk: done on foot, with no fixed place.
textos.Un tipo de lugar por línea: casino, club: One type of place per line: casino, club...
textos.Un tipo de lugar por línea: club, casino: One type of place per line: club, casino...
textos.Un tipo enorme deja la cerveza y se leva: A huge guy puts down his beer and stands up. From now on he follows you and shoots anyone who attacks you. He charges {precio} euros every midnight.
textos.Un tipo te sale al paso con una navaja:: A guy steps in front of you with a knife: "Your wallet. Now."
textos.Un todoterreno viejo de los que arrancan: An old off-roader, the kind that always starts.
textos.Un toque que suena desde la dirección qu: A tap that sounds from the direction you need to follow. A sample plays when you turn it on.
textos.Un tren alcanza al autobús por la vía qu: A train catches up with the bus on the track running alongside the road.
textos.Un utilitario preparado: no corre tanto,: A tuned compact car: it isn't that fast, but it comes out of the corners like a shot.
textos.Un vecino ha notado el olor y ha llamado: A neighbour noticed the smell and called the police.
textos.Un vecino mayor tiene que llegar al hosp: An elderly neighbor has to get to the hospital and doesn't trust going alone.
textos.Un vecino te avisa en voz baja: los de {: A neighbour warns you in a low voice: the {banda} people have been asking about your business.
A vehicle brakes hard or skids.
A vehicle or a building is on fire. If it's a vehicle, it is going to explode: get away.
textos.Un velero de dos palos. Silencioso y mar: A two-masted sailboat. Quiet and seaworthy.
A calm sailboat with an auxiliary motor. For fishing without a rush.
textos.Un viejo asegura que antes esto era otra: An old man swears this used to be something else.
A little wine with lunch and that's it.
textos.Un volquete baja cargado de la mina cuan: A loaded dump truck comes down from the mine while the town sleeps.
textos.Un ático con terraza sobre los letreros: A penthouse with a terrace above the neon signs. Two garage spaces.
textos.Un ático con terraza y tres plazas de ga: A penthouse with a terrace and three garage spaces. You can hear the sea from the bed.
textos.Un ático de lujo con vistas a toda la ba: A luxury penthouse with views of the whole bay and a garage for four vehicles.
textos.Una aeronave no cabe en el garaje de una: An aircraft doesn't fit in a house garage: it is kept in a hangar, a heliport, an airport or an airfield.
An aircraft doesn't fit in a house garage: it is kept in a hangar, a heliport, an airport or an airfield. From the phone, in My vehicles, you can send it to one.
textos.Una alianza se cierra cuando los dos jef: An alliance is made when both bosses propose it to each other. Allies can't hurt each other
textos.Una ambulancia: la tuya, o la que acude: An ambulance: yours, or the one that comes after a shooting or a hit-and-run.
textos.Una antigua conservera con las pintadas: An old cannery with half-erased skull graffiti. Los Calaveras no longer run this neighborhood and nobody is left on guard here.
textos.Una antigua conservera cubierta de pinta: An old cannery covered in skull graffiti. Better not to go near without a reason.
textos.Una armería grande y bien surtida, con l: A big, well-stocked gun shop, with the most modern weapons.
textos.Una avenida, de sur a norte: An avenue, from south to north
textos.Una avioneta de ocho plazas con piloto,: An eight-seat light plane with a pilot, which lands on the short runways of the villages.
textos.Una bala da en una pared, en un vehículo: A bullet hits a wall, a vehicle or something else.
textos.Una banda cobra a los taxistas por dejar: A gang charges taxi drivers for letting them stop in front of the venues.
textos.Una banda del servidor, con cuántos miem: A gang on the server, with how many members it has and how many neighborhoods it controls.
textos.Una banda prepara un asalto a un barrio: A gang is preparing an assault on one of your neighborhoods, or has just started it: deep drums, ever more frequent, and two tense notes. Check the phone, under Territories.
textos.Una banda te ha quitado un barrio: una c: A gang has taken a neighborhood from you: a deep bell and descending notes.
textos.Una banda te pide dinero: A gang asks you for money
textos.Una boda no se prepara en un día: podréi: A wedding isn't planned in a day: you can get married in {faltan} {v}.
textos.Una boda sencilla: la familia, cuatro am: A simple wedding: the family, four friends and aunt Encarna crying in the front row. {n} and you are married.
textos.Una bodega familiar con buen vino. Los h: A family winery with good wine. Belmonte's men want to buy it by force.
textos.Una botella incendiaria que daña todo en: An incendiary bottle that damages everything within six meters. Thrown at the locked-on enemy.
A small apothecary that smells of eucalyptus.
textos.Una cabaña de madera frente al mar. No t: A wooden cabin facing the sea. It has no garage, and doesn't need one.
textos.Una cabaña de troncos entre abetos, con: A log cabin among the firs, with a shed for two vehicles.
textos.Una cadena de restaurantes se queda toda: A restaurant chain takes the entire output of Cala Brava Canned Goods.
textos.Una calle, de oeste a este: A street, from west to east
textos.Una cama ancha, con un colchón de los ca: A wide bed, with one of those expensive mattresses.
textos.Una cantimplora abollada con un aljibe g: A dented canteen with a cistern engraved on it. In the Cauce, whoever carries it can be trusted.
textos.Una caracola con un cordel. No sirve par: A conch shell on a string. Useless, but it starts conversations.
textos.Una caracola de la rompiente: A conch shell from the breakers
A mountain race among the pines.
textos.Una casa baja de piedra, encalada, con u: A low whitewashed stone house with a cistern and views over the whole sea.
textos.Una casa con ruedas. Lenta, pero muy res: A house on wheels. Slow, but very sturdy.
textos.Una casa con vistas a los veleros y gara: A house with views of the sailboats and a garage for four vehicles.
textos.Una casa de labranza con corral. Tranqui: A farmhouse with a yard. Total peace and quiet and room for three vehicles.
textos.Una casa de piedra con lagar y cochera p: A stone house with a wine press and a carport for three vehicles.
textos.Una casa de piedra con tejado de pizarra: A stone house with a slate roof and a garage for two vehicles.
textos.Una casa de pizarra con estufa de leña y: A slate house with a wood stove and a carport for two vehicles.
textos.Una casa de una planta con patio, parra: A one-story house with a patio, a grapevine and a water tank on the roof.
textos.Una casa tuya y cuántos vehículos tienes: A house of yours and how many vehicles you have in its garage. There you can save the game, rest and store or take out vehicles.
textos.Una casita blanca colgada sobre el mar,: A little white house hanging over the sea, with room for two vehicles.
textos.Una casita con vistas al mar y que no me: A little house with a sea view where nobody calls me.
textos.Una casita encalada frente a la playa, c: A whitewashed cottage facing the beach, with a shed for two vehicles.
textos.Una caña con tapa en un bar o una tabern: A small beer with a snack at a bar or tavern
textos.Una caña después del trabajo no se le ni: A beer after work is something you don't deny anybody.
A beer and a tapa. Health {int}.
textos.Una cerveza, un café, un bocadillo. Gana: A beer, a coffee, a sandwich. Earns more loyalty than talking. Once a day.
textos.Una ciudad grande y nueva en la costa oe: A big new city on the west coast: six neighborhoods, three gangs, more than fifty places and a story of its own in twenty-one missions, in a city in drought where water is contraband. With honest living, five vehicles, three weapons, three races and two characters.
textos.Una clínica privada con moqueta y música: A private clinic with carpeting and ambient music.
textos.Una consecuencia que dura después de la: A lasting consequence after the mission and after the story ends. Negative, if it costs money.
textos.Una cooperativa de taxis nocturnos en ve: A night taxi co-op for sale. There's always a taxi at the door: get in and press J.
textos.Una copa en un bar o una taberna: A drink at a bar or tavern
textos.Una cortina y cajas apiladas. No te deja: A curtain and stacked boxes. They won't let you through.
textos.Una cosa más. Me ha llamado la inspector: One more thing. The San Lucero inspector called me: what El Caimán's accountant testified also names our councilman. Your name appears in both case files, and in both on the right side.
textos.Una crupier del casino está dispuesta a: A casino croupier is willing to tell everything. She's afraid, and rightly so. Go find her at the summer cinema and bring her here.
textos.Una de cal y otra de arena: A bit of good, a bit of bad
textos.Una decisión del jugador, con consecuenc: A decision by the player, with consequences
textos.Una doctora firma el recibo sin levantar: A doctor signs the receipt without looking up. Job done.
textos.Una doctoranda que ha encontrado un uso: A doctoral student who has found a very profitable use for the faculty lab.
textos.Una ducha caliente. Sales como nuev[o|a]: A hot shower. You come out like new.
textos.Una embotelladora que Aguas del Ocaso tu: A bottling plant that Aguas del Ocaso had to let go. Earns money every midnight.
textos.Una empleada del casino quiere hablar, p: A casino employee wants to talk, but doesn't dare cross the city alone.
textos.Una empresa de mensajería en venta. En l: A courier company for sale. There's always a delivery motorcycle at the door: get on and press J.
textos.Una ermita blanca entre viñas, con una c: A white chapel among the vines, with a bell that warns of storms.
textos.Una ermita de piedra con una campana que: A stone chapel with a bell that can be heard all over the valley.
textos.Una escalera de hierro baja hasta el agu: An iron ladder goes down to the water.
textos.Una escena por línea, con {n}. Se cuenta: One scene per line, with {n}. All are counted, in order.
An open area with a windsock.
textos.Una explanada de tierra batida por el vi: A wind-swept stretch of packed earth.
textos.Una explanada donde duermen las cisterna: A flat esplanade where the water delivery tankers sleep. At night there's only one guard.
textos.Una explicación corta, con las cifras de: A short explanation, with the figures from your game: what each neighborhood pays, the gang, how to conquer, how to defend and what happens if you lose it.
textos.Una ferretería con otra tienda detrás. M: A hardware store with another shop behind it. Cheaper than the one downtown, for those from the neighborhood.
textos.Una frase por línea. Donde pongas {quien: One line per phrase. Where you put {quien}, it will say "A man", "A woman" or their name, if they have already told you.
One phrase per line; it says one at random.
textos.Una frase por línea; dice una al azar. L: One phrase per line; it says one at random. Anything that changes depending on whether the protagonist is male or female goes in brackets: [he|she].
textos.Una frase sobre tu personaje que cualqui: A sentence about your character that any player can read: in Who is here, by picking you, or with Shift J if they are near you.
textos.Una fuente de cuatro caños en el centro: A four-spout fountain in the middle of Plaza Vieja. The retirees spend their mornings here playing dominoes.
textos.Una fuente me ha dejado unos documentos: A source left me some documents in the locker at Hotel Miramar. If I go, I'll be followed. They don't know you yet.
textos.Una fuente, cuatro naranjos y los puesto: A fountain, four orange trees and the market stalls.
A foundry closed twenty years ago. Broken glass, echoes and pigeons.
textos.Una furgoneta, dos viajes y una planta q: One van, two trips and a plant that barely survived: the move to {casa} is done.
textos.Una fábrica de conservas en venta. Da di: A cannery for sale. It pays out money every midnight.
textos.Una galería abandonada junto a la mina,: An abandoned tunnel next to the mine, where goods are swapped for money without witnesses.
textos.Una garrafa con mecha. Se lanza como una: A jug with a wick. Thrown like a grenade, it leaves the ground burning.
textos.Una gotera en {casa}: {euros} euros de f: A leak in {casa}: {euros} euros for a plumber that you pay.
textos.Una gran empresa extranjera invierte en: A big foreign company invests in Lucero Technology.
textos.Una guerra declarada por un barrio. Gana: A war declared over a neighborhood. The gang with the most people inside the neighborhood and the most rivals knocked down wins; if they tie, whoever had it keeps it.
textos.Una guerra empieza a los {get} minutos d: A war starts {get} minutes after it is declared and lasts {get2}
textos.Una guitarra y una noche de verano. No h: A guitar and a summer night. You don't need more.
textos.Una herramienta de astillero arreglada p: A shipyard tool fixed up by the Copper Club. Short range and slow, but it hits hard and is almost silent.
textos.Una hora de olla, cinco raciones y cuatr: An hour in the pot, five servings and four days in the fridge.
textos.Una hora. No hay nada que agradezcan más: An hour. Nothing is more appreciated.
textos.Una inspección, un periodista o una exto: An inspection, a journalist or an extortion attempt. After the deadline it resolves itself.
textos.Una isla nueva en el Mar de Poniente, a: A new island in the Mar de Poniente, reached by sailing: three missions against some wreckers, an honest job, a house, salt flats that pay out money, fishing, treasure hunting, a silent fishing gun, a hook, a catamaran, a jet ski and a seafaring character.
textos.Una jornada atendiendo clientes. Cobras: A shift serving customers. You get a fixed salary and a commission for each car you sell: you sell more the better your charm and your standing with the neighbors. One shift a day.
textos.Una jornada es un turno. Con vehículo, t: A workday is one shift. With a vehicle, three services make one shift.
textos.Una lancha sencilla para moverse por la: A simple boat for getting around the bay.
textos.Una lavandería de autoservicio. Negocio: A self-service laundromat. A boring and safe business.
textos.Una lectora de toda la vida se va a vivi: A lifelong reader is moving in with her daughter and doesn't dare cross half the city alone.
A bookstore with a long history. It is for sale.
A concrete slab with a painted H.
textos.Una lámpara de carburo restaurada. De re: A restored carbide lamp. A keepsake.
textos.Una línea de lo dicho. La más reciente v: A line of what was said. The newest comes first.
textos.Una línea del resumen de tu vida en la p: One line of the summary of your life in the game. Down arrow takes you to the next one.
textos.Una mano iba hacia el botón de la alarma: A hand was going for the alarm button. It didn't make it.
textos.Una manta de lana de la sierra: A wool blanket from the mountains
textos.Una marquesina con un banco y el cartel: A shelter with a bench and the line sign. The tram runs through Bahía del Ocaso, stopping in every neighborhood.
A shelter with a bench and the line sign. The tram runs through Monteferro, stopping in every neighborhood.
A shelter with a bench and the line sign. The tram runs through Puerto Bravo, stopping in every neighborhood.
A shelter with a bench and the line sign. The tram runs through San Lucero, stopping in every neighborhood.
A shelter with a bench and the line sign. The tram runs through {nombre}, stopping in every neighborhood.
textos.Una marquesina de pizarra frente a la fr: A slate shelter in front of the forge.
A shelter next to the market.
textos.Una marquesina y un banco. El autobús pa: A shelter and a bench. The bus comes when it comes.
textos.Una mejora que se paga una vez y se qued: An upgrade you pay for once and keep: lookouts, doors and warned neighbors. Each level raises the defense, and each level costs more than the last. With more defense, whoever attacks you does worse against your crew, and if you go yourself, fewer come in each wave. If you lose the neighborhood, it drops a level.
textos.Una mesa y los libros de cuentas. Aquí s: A table and the account books. Deals are made here.
A table and a scale. Deals are made here.
textos.Una mesa, una silla y pocas palabras. Aq: A table, a chair and few words. Deals are made here.
textos.Una misión corta, cada vez distinta, en: A short mission, different each time, in the city you're in: you raid the hideout where they're rebuilding. If you complete it, they lose {entero} percent of their strength, it counts as a defeat and, if they were the ones preparing an attack, it's called off. They need enough strength to have a hideout, and it can't be repeated against the same gang until {_dias} have passed. If you have a truce with them, you break it.
textos.Una moto de monte aligerada. Sube las cu: A lightened dirt bike. It climbs the slopes of Los Miradores as if they were flat, and breaks with little.
A delivery motorcycle with a box on the back. Press the J key to work as a courier.
textos.Una moto ligera y rapidísima. Un golpe y: A light and very fast motorcycle. One hit and you're on the ground.
textos.Una mujer con un mono de soldador te mir: A woman in welder's overalls watches you from the doorway, unhurried, and heads toward the tavern.
textos.Una mujer cuenta que le han subido el al: A woman says they've raised her rent again.
textos.Una mujer grita de susto y sale corriend: A woman yells in fright and runs off.
textos.Una máquina de bocadillos que, milagrosa: A sandwich machine that, miraculously, still works.
textos.Una más si llegan con mucha fuerza, y ot: One more if they arrive with great strength, and another if it is an alliance.
textos.Una nave enorme en el polígono. Poco aco: A huge warehouse in the industrial estate. Not very cozy, but it fits six vehicles.
textos.Una nave sin rótulo. Dentro venden lo qu: An unmarked warehouse. Inside they sell what can't be sold outside.
textos.Una nevera larga que zumba, con la puert: A long humming fridge with a glass door.
A girl. It's the best thing I've ever done.
textos.Una noche de risas y juegos: A night of laughter and games
textos.Una noche de sofá, película y manta: A night of couch, movie and blanket
textos.Una noche oí un ruido en la escalera y b: One night I heard a noise on the stairs and went down with a frying pan. It was my neighbor, who'd lost his keys. I nearly split his head open.
textos.Una noria, tiro al blanco y máquinas rec: A Ferris wheel, target shooting and arcade machines.
textos.Una noticia de una empresa, del día que: A piece of news about a company, from the day it says. News moves its price.
textos.Una noticia hace que la empresa dé un sa: A piece of news makes the company jump, up or down.
textos.Una nómina, buen nombre en el barrio y n: A payslip, a good name in the neighborhood and not a single pending paper with the law. With that, we'll lend to you here.
textos.Una obra a lo lejos, en el puerto y en l: Construction work in the distance, at the harbor and in the industrial estates.
textos.Una opción por línea: nombre = valor. La: One option per line: name = value. Lines starting with a hash sign do not count.
textos.Una palabra por línea: atraco (al atraca: One word per line: atraco (when robbing a pedestrian), guantera (when breaking into a car), caido (from the pocket of someone who falls) or buceo (from the seabed). What comes up from diving counts as found; the rest, as stolen.
textos.Una palabra que la identifica, sin espac: A word that identifies it, with no spaces: concejal, traicion. With it, other missions and steps can depend on what was chosen.
textos.Una palabra sin espacios. Los de serie s: One word with no spaces. The default ones are conductor, vigilante, escolta, caja and tirador: with the same identifier, your mod changes that role.
textos.Una palabra sin espacios: reloj, portati: A word with no spaces: reloj, portatil.
textos.Una palabra: honrado, prudente, doble, r: One word: honrado, prudente, doble, redimido. The straight and narrow achievement requires the honrado class.
textos.Una parada con un banco de piedra bajo u: A stop with a stone bench under an elm.
textos.Una parada de montaña con marquesina de: A mountain stop with a wooden shelter.
textos.Una pareja decide adónde ir de vacacione: A couple tries to decide where to go on vacation, unable to agree.
textos.Una parte de la explicación. Con flecha: One part of the explanation. Down arrow takes you to the next one.
textos.Una parte de la explicación. Las demás,: One part of the explanation. The others, with the up and down arrows.
textos.Una patrulla que rondaba por aquí viene: A patrol that was cruising around here is coming for you.
textos.Una pelea corta: vienen {v} de una vez: A short fight: {v} come at once
textos.Una periodista de El Faro del Ocaso anda: A reporter from El Faro del Ocaso has been asking about the neighborhood's meters.
textos.Una periodista de El Faro quiere hablar: A journalist from El Faro wants to talk to you.
textos.Una perla de la lonja: A Pearl from the Fish Market
textos.Una pista entre pinos, para quien no qui: A track among pines, for those who don't want to go down the slopes.
textos.Una pistola que dispara sola mientras ap: A pistol that fires by itself while you squeeze. Empties its eighteen bullets in two seconds: fits in your pocket and does a lot of damage up close.
textos.Una plataforma petrolífera abandonada en: An abandoned oil platform in the middle of the Mar de Poniente. Rusty iron, wind and seagulls. You get there by boat or helicopter.
textos.Una plaza con cuatro fuentes. Solo funci: A square with four fountains. Only one works, and only when the television comes.
textos.Una plaza de hangar, alquilada o comprad: A hangar spot, rented or bought, to keep your aircraft: there they are never lost, and they get checked and refueled. They appear on the phone, in My Vehicles.
textos.Una por línea, con su artículo: unas zap: One per line, with its article: a pair of new sneakers.
textos.Una por línea, con {ciudad}. Detrás va l: One per line, with {ciudad}. The explanation follows.
textos.Una por línea, con {d}: los días que que: One per line, with {d}: the days left.
textos.Una por línea, con {euros} y {n}, que di: One per line, with {euros} and {n}, which says how many houses.
textos.Una por línea, con {modelo} y {n}, que d: One per line, with {modelo} and {n}, which says how many are going.
textos.Una por línea, con {nombre}. Lo que camb: One per line, with {nombre}. Anything that changes with the protagonist goes in brackets.
textos.Una por línea, con {n}, {casa} y {antes}: One per line, with {n}, {casa} and {antes}, the house you are leaving.
textos.Una por línea, con {n}. Escríbelas de fo: One per line, with {n}. Write them so they work for both a man and a woman.
textos.Una por línea, con {n}. Se cumple dándol: One per line, with {n}. It is met by giving them at least what "The least that counts if they asked you for money" says.
textos.Una por línea, con {que}: lo que encuent: One per line, with {que}: what they find.
textos.Una por línea, con {total}, {dinero} y {: One per line, with {total}, {dinero} and {falta}, which already include the word euros.
textos.Una por línea, en minúscula y sin el nom: One per line, in lowercase and without the name in front: waves hello. The game puts the character's name in front.
textos.Una por línea, en minúsculas: súper, mer: One per line, in lowercase: súper, mercado, gasolinera. The first type in the list that fits wins.
textos.Una por línea. Al escribir un mensaje a: One per line. When writing a message to the other players, Tab, or a gamepad button, cycles through them and leaves the chosen one typed: so you do not have to type.
textos.Una por línea. Cada vez que se hace el p: One per line. Each time the plan is carried out, two are counted, and they do not repeat until all have been heard. Where you put {n} goes your partner's name. Write them so they work whether your partner is a man or a woman.
textos.Una por línea. Donde pongas {n} irá cuán: One per line. Where you put {n} goes how many there are.
textos.Una por línea. Es lo que dice de vez en: One per line. It is what a character of that kind, among those the server runs, says from time to time to someone nearby. Empty, the ones the server brings.
textos.Una por línea. Es lo que te dice alguien: One per line. It is what someone says to you when you press Enter next to them.
textos.Una por línea. Las dice el lector, con s: One per line. The reader says them, with their name in front. Anything that changes depending on whether the protagonist is male or female goes in brackets: Go get [him|her].
textos.Una por línea. Lo que cambie según el pr: One per line. Anything that changes depending on whether the protagonist is male or female goes in brackets: proud.
One per line. Anything that changes depending on whether the protagonist is male or female goes in brackets: quiet.
textos.Una por línea. Se ofrecen al hablar en p: One per line. They are offered when speaking in character on a server with role-play channels.
textos.Una por línea. {banda} es la banda y {ba: One per line. {banda} is the gang and {barrio}, the neighborhood.
textos.Una por línea. {cosas} es lo que se tira: One per line. {cosas} is what gets thrown out.
textos.Una por línea. {local} es el sitio, {cos: One per line. {local} is the place, {cosas} what you order, {minutos} how long it will take and {casa} your home.
textos.Una por línea. {nombre} es el nombre del: One per line. {nombre} is the protagonist's name.
textos.Una por línea. {n} es cuántos de los tuy: One per line. {n} is how many of your people are going with you.
One per line. {n} is their name.
textos.Una por línea. {quienes} es quién los ma: One per line. {quienes} is who sends them, for example "La Trastienda's people" or "Los Lagartos", and {n}, how many are coming.
textos.Una por línea. {quien} es quien atiende: One per line. {quien} is whoever is serving and {botin}, the money.
textos.Una por línea. {quien} es «Un hombre» o: One per line. {quien} is "A man" or "A woman", and {quien_min}, the same in lowercase. The phrase they say follows.
textos.Una por línea. {total} es lo que suma la: One per line. {total} is what the basket adds up to, already with the word euros.
textos.Una por línea: el identificador, un igua: One per line: the identifier, an equals sign and how it is said. The game understands vender and cocinar.
textos.Una por línea; dice una al azar. {lugar}: One per line; it says one at random. {lugar} is the place and {modelo}, the vehicle.
One per line; one is said at random.
A closed door. Better not to ask.
textos.Una ración le quita el hambre de casi un: One portion takes away almost a day of its hunger and raises its trust a lot. Dog food is bought at the animal shelter and in stores.
textos.Una ranchera reforzada con chapa de barc: A station wagon reinforced with ship plating. Used at the docks for hauling scrap.
textos.Una receta que sabes hacer, con lo que l: A recipe you know how to make, with what it needs. It is cooked in the kitchen of one of your houses, in Cook.
A grille and a magnifying glass. Deals are made here.
A tailor shop of the old kind.
textos.Una sesión al día; se puede estudiar y t: One session a day; you can study and work on the same day.
textos.Una señora se queja de que ya no se pued: A lady complains that you can't park anywhere anymore.
textos.Una sirena a lo lejos, de ambiente: no v: A distant siren, as ambience: they are not coming for you.
textos.Una sola vez. Cuanto más pesas en la cal: Only once. The more weight you carry on the street and the better you get along with them, the easier it is for them to give in. If it doesn't work, they leave the table and there's no deal for a few days.
textos.Una sucursal pequeña con un cajero de lo: A small branch with an old-fashioned ATM.
textos.Una tecla que has cambiado tú. Se cambia: A key you have changed yourself. It is changed or restored in Options, Keyboard: change the keys.
textos.Una tienda de pueblo donde hay de todo y: A village shop where they have everything and you can buy on credit until the end of the month.
textos.Una torre de vigilancia antigua. A sus p: An old watchtower. At its foot the motorcycles of Los Vigías used to gather, when the neighborhood was theirs.
An old watchtower. At its foot the motorcycles of Los Vigías gather.
textos.Una tragaperras que canta sola. Intro pa: A slot machine singing to itself. Press Enter to drop some coins.
textos.Una vecina lo ha visto todo y baja la pe: A neighbour saw everything and pulls down her shutter without a word. Because it's you.
textos.Una vecina mayor sube la cuesta con cuat: An older neighbor is climbing the hill with four grocery bags and stops every ten steps.
textos.Una ventanilla y un cajero que tarda en: A teller window and an ATM that takes a while to wake up.
textos.Una vez al día; el doble si el plato sal: Once a day; double if the dish turns out high-class. Only with adult content and partner life.
textos.Una vez juntos, en ese mismo menú ves qu: Once you're together, in that same menu you can see who's there and where. Press Enter on a friend to set them on the GPS or send them money. You can also write each other messages.
textos.Una vez me tocó el reintegro. Lo celebré: Once I won my money back on the lottery. I celebrated like it was the jackpot.
textos.Una vieja plataforma petrolífera en mita: An old oil platform in the middle of the sea, to the southwest. It has a jetty for mooring.
textos.Una voluntaria con una lista. Aquí te at: A volunteer with a list. You're served here.
textos.Una vuelta por el puerto al atardecer. E: A stroll around the harbor at sunset. It never fails.
textos.Una vuelta, una foto y lo devolvemos. O: One lap, one photo and we return it. Or not. Bring it to the straight in a hundred seconds, I want to see it arrive.
textos.Una última cosa, y esta no te la dice el: One last thing, and the bank won't tell you this. As soon as you open, someone will come and tell you your business needs protection. It's up to you what you answer. I said no for thirty years, and here I still am.
textos.Unidades de mercancía que caben en un hu: Units of product that fit in a slot
textos.Unidades que cocina al día alguien en tu: Units that someone in your lab cooks per day, at least
textos.Unidades que vende al día un camello, co: Units that a dealer sells per day, at least
textos.Uno al azar al firmar. Si empieza por ex: One at random when signing. If it starts as demanding, it evaluates harder; as patient, softer.
textos.Uno de ellos se revuelve contra ti: «¡Tú: One of them turns on you: "Mind your own business!"
textos.Uno de los carteles lleva tu descripción: One of the posters has your description
textos.Uno de los conductores de las cisternas: One of the tanker drivers will talk if you beat him at the Las Naves circuit.
textos.Uno de los que conducen esas cisternas c: One of the drivers of those tankers races on Fridays at the Las Naves circuit. He says he only respects whoever beats him.
textos.Uno de los tres números que tienen colga: One of the three numbers they have hanging up today. To ask for your own number, go to a lottery office.
textos.Uno de tu banda viene con un vehículo de: One of your crew shows up with a vehicle from your garage or one of the gang's and drives to the destination you set on the GPS. You ride as a passenger and can shoot.
textos.Uno de tus barcos y el sitio donde está: One of your boats and the place where it is moored.
textos.Uno de una banda deja pasar a la buena g: A gang member lets good people through
textos.Uno del catálogo de la sección Tipos de: One from the catalog in the Enemy types section: it provides the name, weapon, health, aim, phrases and, if it has one, the vehicle they arrive in. If you choose it, the fields below are only needed to change something of that type in this group. If you leave it empty, write at least the name and the weapon.
textos.Uno menos que pagar cada medianoche, y m: One less to pay every midnight, and less defense.
textos.Uno pide perdón, el otro se sacude la ro: One apologizes, the other dusts off his clothes. Nothing happened here.
textos.Uno por línea, con el nombre interno del: One per line, with the internal name of the conversation base topic: tiempo, futbol, trabajo_duro, dinero, comida... If you leave it empty, the default ones apply.
One per line, with the internal name of the type of place. One far from the airfields is chosen.
One per line, with the internal name of the type. When entering any other place, the helicopter stops seeing the player.
One per line, with the internal name of the type: banco, tienda, taller...
One per line, with the internal name of the type: bar, taberna, gimnasio...
One per line, with the internal name of the type: tienda, comida, bar, taberna, ropa, gimnasio... Each place can also require it or remove it on its own.
textos.Uno por línea, con el tipo, un signo igu: One per line, with the type, an equals sign and what it is called: taller=The mechanic. It appears in the robbery phrases.
textos.Uno por línea, con su artículo: el Chato: One per line, with its article: El Chato, La Culebra.
textos.Uno por línea, con su artículo: la testi: One per line, with its article: the witness, the accountant.
textos.Uno por línea, con su artículo: un malet: One per line, with its article: a briefcase with documents.
textos.Uno por línea, con su artículo: una pare: One per line, with its article: a young couple with a baby.
textos.Uno por línea, hasta cuatro: el coche ro: One per line, up to four: the red car, the white van.
textos.Uno por línea. Al ponerle nombre a un ve: One per line. When naming a vehicle, Tab, or a gamepad button, suggests a few at random: so you do not have to type.
textos.Uno por línea. Cada pedido sale de uno,: One per line. Each order comes from one of them, at random.
textos.Uno por línea. El banco y el proveedor t: One per line. The bank and the supplier have their own robbery.
textos.Uno por línea. El juego elige uno al rec: One per line. The game picks one when recruiting the first person; it can be changed afterward.
textos.Uno por línea. Lo que cambie con el prot: One per line. Anything that changes with the protagonist goes in brackets: inspector.
One per line. They are chosen at random.
textos.Uno por línea. Son los de la gente con l: One per line. They are those of the people you talk to on the street.
textos.Uno por línea. Son los personajes que ll: One per line. They are the characters the server runs when someone joins it with this data.
textos.Uno por línea. Una jornada se escribe jo: One per line. A workday is written as jornada, a colon and its identifier: jornada:camarero. A trade with a vehicle, as oficio, a colon and its type: oficio:taxi. Three services with a vehicle make one shift.
textos.Uno por línea: el identificador, un igua: One per line: the identifier, an equals sign and how it is said. For example, elegante=elegant, or calle=casual. The clothing store groups by these styles, and the clothes, footwear and people use the identifier.
textos.Uno por línea: el nombre interno del tip: One per line: the internal name of the type, an equals sign and the seconds. For example, banco=26.
textos.Uno quería hacerse el héroe. Ya no quier: One wanted to play hero. Not anymore.
textos.Uno tuyo, comprado o mejorado, se paga e: One of yours, bought or upgraded, is paid in full according to its value and condition; a stolen one, only this share.
textos.Uno. Abre la página de descargas del jue: One. Open the game's downloads page with the option below, or from another computer or your phone if the network is blocked on this one, and download the ZIP file of the latest version: its name starts with PuertoBravo, all together, and continues with the version number.
textos.Uno. Elige más abajo Abrir la carpeta de: One. Further down, choose Open my music folder. A Windows window opens with a folder: it is the one for your songs. The game stays open behind it.
textos.Unos cuatreros me han robado el tractor: Some rustlers stole my new tractor and they're keeping it at La Era, calm as you please. Around here everyone is somebody's cousin and nobody wants trouble.
textos.Unos días después de prometeros. Una cer: A few days after getting engaged. A simple ceremony with family and friends. The neighbours look on it kindly.
textos.Unos matones molestan al proveedor de En: Some thugs are bothering Encarna's supplier at the fish market.
textos.Unos novios y su fotógrafo: A newlywed couple and their photographer
textos.Unos raqueros asaltan las barcas pequeña: Some wreckers raid small boats and hide the loot on the island.
textos.Unos tipos salen de entre los árboles, m: Some guys come out from between the trees, look over the aircraft and pay you without asking questions: {paga} euros.
textos.Unos {max} minutos de vuelo. El piloto a: About {max} minutes of flight. The autopilot holds the heading and altitude: you don't have to do anything. {_tecla_txt} turns it off and on, {_tecla_txt2} speeds up the crossing, {_tecla_txt3} tells you how it's going and {_tecla_txt4} explains everything.
textos.Urgencias abiertas día y noche. Aquí te: Emergency room open day and night. This is where they patch you up when things go wrong.
textos.Usa las flechas arriba y abajo para move: Use the up and down arrow keys to move and press Enter to choose
textos.Usar la voz de Windows en lugar del lect: Use the Windows voice instead of the screen reader
textos.Usar también las teclas cambiadas en los: Also use the changed keys in menus and dialogs: {v}
textos.Usas ese efectivo, pierdes un {entero} p: You use that cash, lose {entero} percent and two hours go by. If you carry less, have less unexplained money or reach the daily limit, only what is possible gets laundered.
textos.Usas un botiquín. Salud {int}. Te quedan: You use a first aid kit. Health {int}. You have {botiquin} left.
textos.Usas {lower}. Algo mejor, aunque nada co: You use {lower}. A bit better, though nothing like a shower.{necesidades_txt}
textos.Uy, de eso tengo yo una historia, pero e: Oh, I've got a story about that, but it's a long one.
textos.Uy, eso es duro. Mi tío estuvo tres mese: Oh, that's rough. My uncle did three months for something silly and came out able to play cards like nobody else.
textos.Uy, eso es largo de contar. Resumiendo:: Oh, that's a long story. In short: complicated.
textos.Uy, me encantaría, pero tengo que recoge: Oh, I'd love to, but I have to pick up my mother, stop by the pharmacy and take the car in. Another day, for sure.
textos.Uy, mi familia. Somos siete hermanos, y: Oh, my family. We're seven siblings, each with a different mother and father, so to speak. The oldest is at the harbor, the second opened a notions shop, the third, we don't know where he is...
Oh, no. I don't even carry enough for myself.
textos.Uy, qué directo. Primero invítame a algo: Wow, how direct. Buy me something first, right?
textos.Uy, si te contara lo que me hizo ayer el: Oh, if I told you what the little one did to me yesterday...
textos.Va a velocidad de ciudad y corre más sol: Drives at city speed and only goes faster when needed: with the siren on or in a mission against the clock, when it also doesn't wait at traffic lights; in a job against the clock it goes faster, but waits at red lights.
textos.Va bien, gracias. Siempre hay faena, y e: It's going well, thanks. There's always work, and that's good.
textos.Va con tacones, así que paciencia. Si ll: She's wearing heels, so be patient. If you have a car, even better.
Goes in front of the robbery phrase.
textos.Va demasiado rápido para abrir la puerta: It's going too fast to open the door.
It's going too fast to open the door. Get in front of it: it will brake.
textos.Va en el vehículo de la huida y dispara: Rides in the getaway vehicle and shoots out the window at whoever chases you.
textos.Va incluido en lo que le pagas: el repor: It's included in what you pay him: the story doesn't run.
textos.Vacaciones, las justas. Una semana en el: Vacation, just the bare minimum. A week in the village and that's it.
textos.Vacías el bidón en el depósito de {nombr: You empty the gas can into the tank of {nombre}.{combustible_txt}
textos.Vacío, 1. Con 3 sale tres veces más que: Empty, 1. With 3 it appears three times more than an ordinary one among people their age.
textos.Vacío, cualquiera. La gente de la calle: Empty, anyone. People on the street are between 19 and 74 years old.
textos.Vacío, cualquiera. Por ejemplo 27 para u: Empty, anyone. For example 27 for a student, or 66 for a job people retire from.
textos.Vacío, el paso vale siempre. Si escribes: Empty, the step always applies. If you write the name of a decision, this step is only played when the option you indicate below was chosen.
textos.Vacío, el precio general, que está en la: Empty, the general price, which is in the Fuel section.
textos.Vacío, es ropa corriente. Con un número,: Empty, it is ordinary clothing. With a number, when you put it on, your armor rises up to that value if you had less.
Empty, the one for their enemy type.
textos.Vacío, la de su tipo de enemigo. Un peat: Empty, the one for their enemy type. A pedestrian can take 50 and the player, 100.
textos.Vacío, la misión aparece siempre. Si esc: Empty, the mission always appears. If you write the name of a decision, it only appears when the option you indicate below was chosen. This makes the story branch.
Empty, the ones the stock weapon comes with.
textos.Vacío, lo de serie: 7 el motor, 15 los f: Empty, the defaults: 7 the engine, 15 the brakes, 25 the armor, 25 the tires, 15 the suspension, 30 the exhaust and 30 the tank.
textos.Vacío, si se dice igual: taxista, estudi: Empty, if it is said the same: taxi driver, student.
textos.Vacío, sin tope. Con cero, la misión apa: Empty, no cap. With zero, the mission appears only if none is met.
textos.Vacío, todas. Con un número, basta con q: Empty, all of them. With a number, it is enough for that many to be met.
textos.Vacío, vale siempre. Con el nombre de un: Empty, it always applies. With the name of a decision, this ending is for whoever chose the option below.
textos.Vais lentos, pero al final del turno ya: You go slowly, but by the end of the shift he can hold his own. He truly thanks you.
textos.Valdeolmos, un pueblo de viñas y bodegas: Valdeolmos, a town of vineyards and wineries. It smells of grape must in September and of firewood the rest of the year.
textos.Vale para todas las emisoras y para Mi m: Applies to all stations and to My music. Paused: when you get out, the song stops, and when you get into any vehicle it continues right where it left off; each station remembers its own, so when you go back to one you left, it carries on with its song. Not paused: the station keeps running even if you don't hear it, and when you come back you find it further along. Songs shorter than a minute and a half always start from the beginning.
textos.Vale también para desviarte a un campo m: It also works for diverting to a closer airfield if you don't have enough fuel.
textos.Vale también para las cuotas de los créd: It also applies to loan installments.
textos.Vale también para los objetivos de los c: It also applies to the targets of contracts where you only have to scare them.
textos.Vale una palabra o un trozo: por ejemplo: A word or part of a word works: for example siren, door or police. It doesn't matter whether you type accents or not, or capitals or lowercase. With several words, you get the sounds that have all of them.
textos.Vale. Me has ganado. Los sobres van al d: Okay. You beat me. The envelopes go to the public works councilman's office. And I didn't tell you anything.
textos.Valor mínimo de su carácter, de 0 a 100: Minimum value of their character, from 0 to 100
textos.Vamos a hacer un servicio de prueba. Jun: Let's do a test service. There's an open taxi next to the office. Get in with F.
textos.Van a dispararte: They are going to shoot you
textos.Van a pie aunque su tipo tenga vehículo: They go on foot even if their type has a vehicle
They're going after the one that earns you the most money.
textos.Van a por {persona}, que te espera en {l: They are coming for {persona}, who is waiting for you at {lugar}. {n} arrive in a vehicle: take them out and take {persona} on foot or by car to {destino}.
Jeans, T-shirt and a thin sweatshirt. The everyday look.
textos.Varela guarda en su coche patrulla una g: Varela keeps a recorder in his patrol car with all his conversations with Belmonte. He covers his back, the sly fox.
textos.Varela sale del coche con las manos en a: Varela steps out of the car with his hands up, just as the honest officers left in the city arrive. One of them looks at you, nods and pretends he didn't see you.
textos.Varios vecinos te señalan a gritos. Lo c: Several neighbours point you out, shouting. They tell everything, and gladly.
textos.Vas a borrar el programa y el modelo loc: You are about to delete the program and the local model from your disk. You can download them again whenever you want
textos.Vas a pie: sube cuanto antes a un vehícu: You're on foot: get into a fast vehicle as soon as you can, with F next to one, or call yours on the phone, in My vehicles.
textos.Vas con prisa: {v} corre más: You are in a hurry: {v} runs faster
textos.Vas con retraso y los viajeros protestan: You're running late and the passengers complain. Next stop.
textos.Vas de camino a {destino}. Quedan unos {: You're on your way to {destino}. About {max} seconds left. Enter to arrive now.
textos.Vas de viaje en avión: el zumbido de la: You are on a plane trip: the hum of the cabin in flight.
textos.Vas de viaje en tren: el vagón en marcha: You are on a train trip: the carriage rolling along, with the clatter of the rails.
You are riding a bicycle: the click of the chain.
textos.Vas en el grupo de otro: solo invita qui: You are in someone else's group: only its leader invites.
textos.Vas en el tranvía. Próxima parada: {nomb: You're on the tram. Next stop: {nombre}, in about {max} seconds. {v}
textos.Vas en tranvía: un zumbido eléctrico sob: You are on a tram: an electric hum over rails.
textos.Vas en tu helicóptero: el vuelo es grati: You are in your helicopter: the flight is free
textos.Vas en un grupo. Lo lleva: You are in a group. It is led by
textos.Vas en {nombre}. Cuando te bajes, con Ma: You're in {nombre}. When you get out, Shift L will tell you where you left it.
textos.Vas tarde: este paquete ya no tiene prop: You're late: this package no longer has a tip.
Oh well. We all have bad days.
Go to La Era and throw out the two rustlers.
textos.Ve a Ultramarinos Paco, en la Avenida de: Go to Paco's Grocery Store, on Avenida del Faro.
textos.Ve a la Churrería La Madrugada y échalos: Go to La Madrugada Churro Shop and throw them out.
textos.Ve a la Comisaría Central a poner la den: Go to Central Police Station to file the report.
textos.Ve a la Desaladora y quita de en medio a: Go to the Desalination Plant and take out the private security.
textos.Ve a la Embotelladora La Gota y vigílala: Go to La Gota Bottling Plant and watch it from close by, unseen. When you hear footsteps approaching, stay still or crouch with the X key.
textos.Ve a la Ermita de San Roque y acaba con: Go to San Roque Chapel and take out the ones loading the fake wine.
textos.Ve a la Fuente de los Leones y encárgate: Go to the Lion Fountain and deal with the three Lagartos.
textos.Ve a la Fábrica abandonada y elimina a l: Go to the Abandoned Factory and take out the six Calaveras.
textos.Ve a la Heladería Polo Norte y haz que e: Go to Polo Norte Ice Cream Parlor and make Lucía's ex understand it's over.
textos.Ve a la Lonja de Costa Dorada y sigue al: Go to the Costa Dorada Fish Market and follow the skipper without being noticed. Follow the sound of his footsteps.
textos.Ve a la Lonja de pescado y dales una lec: Go to the Fish Market and teach the two Calaveras a lesson. Press Q to lock onto an enemy and Space to attack.
textos.Ve a la Lonja del Ocaso y llega hasta la: Go to Ocaso Fish Market and reach the door without the guards hearing you. Crouch with the X key, don't run and listen to their footsteps.
textos.Ve a la Mina La Esperanza y recoge la ca: Go to La Esperanza Mine and pick up the box of dynamite before time runs out.
textos.Ve a la Mina La Esperanza, en el Barrio: Go to La Esperanza Mine, in Barrio Alto, and throw them out.
Go to Nave Catorce, in Las Naves.
textos.Ve a la Plataforma Neptuno y sube al hel: Go to Neptuno Platform and get in the helicopter.
textos.Ve a la Poza del Río Frío, campo a travé: Go to Río Frío Pool, across the fields, and throw out the people dumping waste.
textos.Ve a la Prisión de Monteferro, en El Pen: Go to Monteferro Prison, in El Penal, and deal with the three corrupt guards.
textos.Ve a la escombrera vieja y acaba con los: Go to the old spoil heap and take out the Tunnel Three crew.
textos.Ve a la fábrica abandonada y acaba con l: Go to the abandoned factory and take out the councilman's guards.
textos.Ve a la fábrica vieja y llega hasta ella: Go to the old factory and get to it without the lookouts hearing you. Crouch with X and don't run.
textos.Ve a la gasolinera del este y vigílala d: Go to the gas station in the east and watch it from nearby, without being seen. When you hear footsteps approaching, stay still or crouch with X.
textos.Ve a la guarida de Los Calaveras a cerra: Go to the Los Calaveras Hideout to close the deal.
textos.Ve a la lonja de San Lucero y echa a los: Go to the San Lucero Fish Market and throw out the last Lagartos.
textos.Ve a la sala de conciertos El Sótano y s: Go to El Sótano concert hall and follow the collector without being noticed. Follow the sound of his footsteps.
textos.Ve a la terminal del ferry y vigílala de: Go to the ferry terminal and watch it from nearby, without being seen. When you hear footsteps approaching, stay still or crouch with X.
textos.Ve a las Dunas del Naufragio, al este de: Go to the Shipwreck Dunes, on the east side of the island.
textos.Ve a las Oficinas de la Compañía Minera,: Go to the Mining Company Offices, in La Ladera, and take out the seven gunmen.
textos.Ve a las Salinas de Poniente y acaba con: Go to the Poniente Salt Flats and take out the wreckers.
textos.Ve a una de esas ciudades y vuelve a abr: Go to one of those cities and open this menu again to see its neighborhoods.
textos.Ve al Banco Mercantil a preguntar por la: Go to Mercantil Bank to ask about mortgages.
textos.Ve al Banco de la Bahía y sigue al conta: Go to Bahía Bank and follow the accountant without being found out. Go by the sound of his steps. The O key tells you how fast he's going.
textos.Ve al Bingo La Suerte y elimina a los ci: Go to La Suerte Bingo Hall and take out the five guards.
textos.Ve al Bingo La Suerte, en El Ensanche, y: Go to La Suerte Bingo Hall, in El Ensanche, and pick up the hard drive.
textos.Ve al Casino Belmonte y elimina a los ci: Go to Casino Belmonte and take out the five guards.
textos.Ve al Chiringuito El Espeto y encárgate: Go to El Espeto Beach Bar and deal with the bodyguards.
Go to Club Neón and pick up the envelope.
textos.Ve al Colmado La Garrafa y echa a los ho: Go to La Garrafa Grocery Store and throw out Seisdedos's men.
textos.Ve al Depósito municipal de cisternas, e: Go to the Municipal Tanker Depot, in Las Naves, north of the neighborhood.
textos.Ve al Embarcadero de los Astilleros y ec: Go to Shipyards Pier and throw out Seisdedos's men.
textos.Ve al Hotel Miramar y recoge el maletín: Go to Hotel Miramar and pick up the briefcase of documents.
textos.Ve al Mirador de la Bahía. Alguien te es: Go to the Bay Viewpoint. Someone is waiting for you there.
textos.Ve al Molino viejo, campo a través, y ac: Go to the Old Mill, across the fields, and take out the five rustlers.
textos.Ve al Muelle pesquero de Cala Brava, alq: Go to Cala Brava Fishing Pier, rent a boat and sail to Grouper Shoal.
textos.Ve al Piso de La Química, en el Barrio U: Go to La Química's Apartment, in Barrio Universitario in San Lucero, and pick up the package.
textos.Ve al Piso de la abuela, en la Calle May: Go to Grandma's Apartment, on Calle Mayor. The GPS and the sound beacon guide you: press G to repeat the direction.
textos.Ve al Puerto deportivo de San Lucero y a: Go to the San Lucero Marina and take out the six Lagartos.
textos.Ve al Restaurante Sibarita, en La Colina: Go to Sibarita Restaurant, in La Colina, and pick up the envelope.
textos.Ve al Taller Hermanos Barrena, en los mu: Go to Hermanos Barrena Repair Shop, at the docks, and stop the crew.
textos.Ve al ayuntamiento y quítales las cajas: Go to the town hall and take the boxes from the company guards.
textos.Ve al banco de Monteferro y sigue al con: Go to the Monteferro bank and follow the accountant without being spotted. Follow the sound of his footsteps.
textos.Ve al banco y sigue al chico de los reca: Go to the bank and follow the errand boy without being spotted. Follow the sound of his footsteps; the O key tells you how far you are.
textos.Ve al banco y sigue al prestamista sin q: Go to the bank and follow the loan shark without being spotted. Follow the sound of his footsteps; the O key tells you how far you are.
textos.Ve al campo de golf y llévate el descapo: Go to the golf course and take the president's convertible. It's locked and has an alarm.
textos.Ve al centro cívico del Barrio Viejo y p: Go to the Barrio Viejo Community Center and ask for Paulino.
Go to the San Telmo Soup Kitchen.
textos.Ve al depósito municipal y llega hasta é: Go to the municipal impound lot and reach it without the guards hearing you. Crouch with X and don't run.
textos.Ve al embarcadero y acaba con los de la: Go to the pier and take out the crew of the black boat.
Go to the Alameda Park Pond.
textos.Ve al muelle de Cala Brava, alquila una: Go to the Cala Brava pier, rent a boat and sail to the reef.
textos.Ve al polvorín y llega hasta la puerta s: Go to the powder magazine and reach the door without the guards hearing you. Crouch with the X key and don't run.
textos.Ve con cuidado. No soy el único que ha c: Be careful. I'm not the only one who bought a piece of that map.
textos.Ve con un coche. Corréis tres. A los otr: Go in a car. Three of you race. You'll hear the other two's engines: that's how you'll know where they are.
textos.Ve con un vehículo a la Curva del Minero: Go with a vehicle to the Miner's Curve and stop at the start. Then win the race: mine, viewpoint and prison.
textos.Ve con un vehículo a la Recta del Polígo: Go with a vehicle to the Industrial Estate Straight and stop at the start. Then win the race: scrapyard, gas station and abandoned factory.
textos.Ve con un vehículo a la salida del circu: Go with a vehicle to the Las Naves circuit start and stop there. Then win the race: tanker depot, desalination plant and bottling plant.
textos.Ve despacio a un taller, o llama a la as: Drive slowly to a repair shop, or call roadside assistance from the phone, in Services.
textos.Ve y cuéntalas. No entres: quédate cerca: Go count them. Don't go in: stay close and listen. A guard comes out to walk around every so often. When you hear his steps, stay still or crouch.
textos.Vecinos de la comarca hablan de una pers: Locals around the region talk of a mysterious person who shows up when there's trouble and leaves without giving their name.
textos.Vehículo de la huida: el que tenga la ba: Getaway vehicle: whichever the gang has on hand
textos.Vehículo siempre aparcado en la puerta: Vehicle always parked at the door
textos.Vehículos de la banda con los que puede: Gang vehicles they can come with
textos.Vehículos del jugador que caben en la ca: Player vehicles that fit on the street
textos.Vehículos que circulan y aparcan: Vehicles that drive around and park
textos.Vehículos que compra cada desguace al dí: Vehicles each scrapyard buys per day
Vehicles stolen: {vehiculos_robados}. Sold to the scrapyard: {vendidos}
textos.Veinte años hace que no piso esa taberna: I haven't set foot in that tavern in twenty years. We were partners, La Fundi and I. She kept the scrap and I the tankers, and we said everything to each other.
textos.Veinte metros de lujo flotante. Solo par: Twenty meters of floating luxury. Only for those who already have everything.
textos.Velocidad de crucero, en kilómetros por: Cruising speed, in kilometers per hour
textos.Velocidad de los rivales, en metros por: Rivals' speed, in meters per second
textos.Ven con el vehículo, déjalo aparcado cer: Come with the vehicle, leave it parked nearby or store it in the garage, and come in again.
textos.Ven con un vehículo para repararlo, pint: Come with a vehicle to repair, paint or upgrade it
textos.Ven conmigo. Si puede ser en coche, mejo: Come with me. If we can go by car, better.
textos.Ven cuando quieras a echar una mano. No: Come whenever you like to lend a hand. It doesn't pay, but you gain something.
textos.Vende en la calle tu mercancía: Sell your product on the street
textos.Venden desde lanchas neumáticas hasta ya: They sell everything from inflatable boats to yachts. They leave your boat moored at the marina.
textos.Venden veleros y los dejan amarrados en: They sell sailboats and leave them moored at the pier.
textos.Venden y reparan barcos. Los dejan amarr: They sell and repair boats. They leave them moored at the pier.
textos.Vender 10 al 85 por ciento del precio: Sell 10 at 85 percent of the price
textos.Vender al mercado por {v} euros: Sell to the market for {v} euros
textos.Vender en la calle la mercancía que guar: Sell on the street the product you keep in the wardrobe of your homes, or cook in one of your labs with the materials you have. At the end of the day they bring you what was sold, minus their cut. A dealer can be arrested, and a not-so-loyal one skims a bit more.
textos.Vender todo lo de la mochila por {sum} e: Sell everything in the backpack for {sum} euros
textos.Vender tu pesca: {len} capturas por {sum: Sell your catch: {len} fish for {sum} euros
textos.Vendes todas las que tienes de esta empr: You sell all the shares you have in this company at today's price, and it tells you how much you gain or lose on the sale.
textos.Vendes todo lo de la mochila: You sell everything in the backpack
textos.Vendes todo lo que has pescado de una ve: You sell everything you've caught at once and get paid on the spot. You fish from a boat, pressing P, or from a pier.
textos.Vendes todo lo que llevas de esto al 85: You sell all you carry of this at 85 percent of today's price, in dirty money. Your street reputation goes up.
textos.Vendes todos los objetos de una vez y co: You sell all the items at once and get paid on the spot. What you get for stolen goods is dirty money, which you can't account for.
textos.Vendes {k} acciones. Con esta venta, {ba: You sell {k} shares. With this sale, {balance_txt}. You have {v} left.
You sell {k} of {lower} for {cobro} euros. You have {v} left.
textos.Vendérselo al capataz por 700 euros: Sell it to the foreman for 700 euros
textos.Vendía seguros y sabe ganarse a cualquie: Used to sell insurance and can win over anyone. Starts with eight hundred euros, a good mood, some street reputation and the neighbours' esteem: earns more on honest jobs and the police overlook minor offenses.
I'm coming from work and heading home. Nothing more.
textos.Venta al mercado, en tanto por ciento: Sale to the market, as a percentage
textos.Ventaja: la policía tardará unos {int} s: Advantage: the police will take about {int} seconds longer to find you.
textos.Ventaja: sale por donde no os esperan. N: Advantage: they leave by where nobody expects. Wanted level {estrellas}.
textos.Veo que has estudiado. Saca esa caja de: I see you've studied. Get that box out of there before nightfall.
textos.Ver la puesta de sol desde el Mirador de: Watch the sunset from Ocaso Viewpoint
Watching TV lifts your mood twice as much.
textos.Ver las estrellas desde el Lago Negro: Watch the stars from the Black Lake
textos.Verde, marrón y negro. Con protecciones: Green, brown and black. With chest protection.
textos.Ves el espectáculo desde la barra. Sales: You watch the show from the bar. You come out an hour later, at {hora_txt}.
textos.Vestirte con lo que ya tienes: Get dressed with what you already have
textos.Viaje en taxi: bajada de bandera, a la q: Taxi ride: base fare, plus the distance
textos.Viajes en taxi y en autobús con trayecto: Taxi and bus rides with a route
textos.Vibración de prueba. Si no notas nada, t: Test vibration. If you feel nothing, your gamepad doesn't support it or it is turned off.
textos.Vida delictiva. Mercancía vendida por va: Criminal life. Product sold worth {get} euros
textos.Vida delictiva. Vehículos robados: {vehi: Criminal life. Vehicles stolen: {vehiculos_robados}. Contracts: {get}. Bank robberies: {get2}. Territories: {len}. Arrests: {detenciones}
textos.Vida en pareja: poder pedirle a tu parej: Life as a couple: being able to ask your partner to move in with you
textos.Vida honrada. Fuiste policía: Honest life. You were a police officer
textos.Vida honrada. Jornadas trabajadas: {serv: Honest life. Shifts worked: {servicios_de}. Volunteering: {get} times. Donated: {get2} euros. Incidents resolved: {get3}
textos.Vida realista: hambre, sed, sueño e higi: Realistic life: hunger, thirst, sleep and hygiene
textos.Vida sentimental: conocer a alguien, cit: Love life: meeting someone, dates, engagement and wedding
textos.Vida, reputación y consecuencias: número: Life, reputation and consequences: numbers and phrases
textos.Viene a recogerte y conduce él hasta lo: They come to pick you up and drive to whatever you mark on the GPS. You ride as a passenger.
textos.Viene a recogerte, tú subes de pasajero: Comes to pick you up, you ride as a passenger and [he|she] drives to the destination you mark on the GPS. Arrival time depends on traffic
textos.Viene bien para hablar con la familia qu: It's good for talking to family who live far away.
textos.Viene con un coche de la banda, el que t: Comes with a gang car, whichever they have on hand. When you dismiss [him|her], [he|she] takes it. Further down you can choose which one.
textos.Viene con uno de ellos, al azar, cuando: It comes with one of them, at random, when you do not ask for one from your garage.
textos.Viene tormenta y tengo media cosecha en: A storm is coming and I have half the harvest in the Old Vineyard. Do you know how to drive a tractor? Doesn't matter, you'll learn.
textos.Vienen a por la chatarrería. Tres coches: They're coming for the scrapyard. Three cars. If they burn my scrapyard, the Club is finished and Seisdedos keeps the docks.
textos.Vienen a por ti donde estás ahora, a pie: They come for you right where you are now, on foot, and you have to stay in the neighborhood until it's over. No neighborhood or money is won, except whatever they drop when they fall. Your gang comes to help. Your relationship with that gang gets worse, and if there is gunfire, the police may show up, as in any fight.
textos.Vienen a por ti {oleadas} oleadas de pan: {oleadas} waves of thugs come for you, each tougher than the last. If you have a gang, it comes to help. If you fall or leave, you lose nothing but the opportunity: you can try again. Bring a firearm, plenty of ammo and first aid kits. The O key tells you how the fight is going.
textos.Vienen por la avenida. {segundos} segund: They're coming down the avenue. {segundos} seconds and they're on top of you.
textos.Vienen por la calle hacia el jugador, pa: They come down the street toward the player, stop nearby and get out. Empty, whatever their enemy type says, which can be on foot.
textos.Viento con lluvia, por ciento del normal: Wind with rain, percent of normal
textos.Viento máximo, en kilómetros por hora: Maximum wind, in kilometers per hour
textos.Vigila la Sede de Aguas del Ocaso sin qu: Watch the Aguas del Ocaso Headquarters without being seen. When you hear footsteps, stay still or crouch with the X key.
textos.Vigila la sede sin que te vean. Luego, s: Watch the headquarters without being seen. Then, if you can, keep whatever they carry out.
textos.Vigilante: detén el vehículo del sospech: Security: stop the suspect's vehicle, seen near {nombre}. Ram it or shoot it.
textos.Vigilar un lugar un rato sin que te vean: Watch a place for a while without being seen
textos.Villaseca sigue siendo de sus vecinos. T: Villaseca still belongs to its neighbors. They make you a member: one hundred fifty euros every midnight, forever, and plenty of street reputation here.
textos.Villaseca vuelve a ser un pueblo tranqui: Villaseca is a quiet town again. You can buy Villaseca Winery and Los Olivos Farm.
textos.Villaseca, un pueblo de la sierra rodead: Villaseca, a mountain village surrounded by olive trees and sunflowers. Three hundred residents, one bar and a lot of silence.
textos.Vine de joven por trabajo y ya ves, me q: I came when I was young for work and, you see, I stayed.
textos.Vino caliente, dados y mineros jubilados: Hot wine, dice and retired miners who know everything.
textos.Vino de la casa, partidas de dados y gen: House wine, games of dice and people who know everything that goes on in the valley.
textos.Vino de la casa, partidas de dados y tip: House wine, dice games and big guys looking for bodyguard work.
textos.Vino de la tierra, dados y un tablón con: Local wine, dice and a board with jobs.
Visit every place in the game.
textos.Vive aquí contigo, pero tiene su vida. D: Lives here with you, but has a life of their own. At night they're always here; during the day, now and then.
textos.Vive aquí contigo. Hablar, comer juntos,: Lives here with you. Talk, eat together, make plans or ask them to move out.
textos.Vive en ella un inquilino que paga cada: A tenant lives there who pays every midnight, a little different each day. Sometimes there is damage that you pay for, and now and then it is a day late. You need the garage empty, your partner not living here, and another free house. You can take it back whenever you want, returning the deposit: {entero} days of rent.
textos.Vives allí con tu pareja. Para alquilarl: You live there with your partner. To rent it out, move to another house first.
textos.Vivir en pareja está desactivado. Se act: Living together as a couple is turned off. Turn it on in Options, Adult content.
textos.Vivir en pareja, contenido para adultos: Living together as a couple, adult content
textos.Vivo aquí al lado. Es humilde, pero se e: I live right next door. It's humble, but comfortable.
textos.Vivo aquí cerca. Un piso pequeño, pero m: I live close by. A small apartment, but mine. Well, the bank's.
I live with my mother. We're fine.
textos.Vivo en lo mejor de {barrio}. No podía s: I live in the best part of {barrio}. It couldn't be any other way.
textos.Vivo en {barrio}. No digo el número, por: I live in {barrio}. I won't say the number, just in case.
textos.Voces sin palabras, pasos de otros y el: Voices without words, other people's footsteps and the dog.
textos.Volando bajo: consumo, por ciento del no: Flying low: fuel use, percent of normal
textos.Volando bajo: segundos entre obstáculos,: Flying low: seconds between obstacles, roughly
textos.Volando bajo: velocidad, por ciento de l: Flying low: speed, percent of cruising speed
textos.Volar: cómo funciona. Recorre la explica: Flying: how it works. Go through the explanation with the arrow keys
textos.Volumen de la música de fondo de los loc: Volume of the venues' background music, in percent
textos.Volumen de la radio por los auriculares,: Volume of the radio through headphones, on foot, in percent
textos.Volumen de los chillidos de pánico, de c: Volume of panic screams, from zero to a hundred
textos.Voluntarios que reparten comida por toda: Volunteers who hand out food all over the region.
textos.Voluntarios, cajas de fruta y mucha cola: Volunteers, fruit crates and a long line at the end of the month.
textos.Volver a buscar el modelo más barato: Look for the cheapest model again
textos.Volver al objetivo de la misión: GPS y r: Back to the mission objective: GPS and radar
textos.Volver al objetivo: marcarlo en el GPS y: Back to the objective: mark it on the GPS and the radar
textos.Volvió de la ciudad para llevar el bar d: He came back from the city to run his father's bar. He distills his own liqueur, reads at the bar when nobody's around and says things only once.
textos.Volvéis a casa andando, con los zapatos: You walk home, shoes in hand.
textos.Volvéis a puerto con las luces ya encend: You head back to the harbor with the lights already on, salt on your skin, saying nothing.
You head back slowly, stretching out the walk.
textos.Volúmenes, música de ambiente y packs de: Volumes, ambient music and sound packs.
textos.Voy a llevar los papeles al juzgado yo m: I'm going to take the papers to the court myself, to the town hall, which is where the office is. And I know they're waiting for me on the way.
I go to Mass on festival days and at funerals.
textos.Voy a por el pan y vuelvo. Lo de todos l: I'm going out for bread and coming back. The usual.
I go to the movies when there's shooting. The rest puts me to sleep.
I'm going to the market to see what they have today.
textos.Voy con retraso, hay un atasco. Aguantad: I'm running late, there's a traffic jam. Hold on a bit.
textos.Voy en bici a todas partes. Barato y san: I go everywhere by bike. Cheap and healthy.
On my way. Give me a minute.
textos.Voy tirando. La espalda me da guerra, pe: Getting by. My back gives me trouble, but I'm fine.
textos.Vuela a Isla Tortuga: en el helipuerto p: Fly to Isla Tortuga: at the heliport press Enter and choose Helicopter Clearing. You have five minutes.
textos.Vuela hasta el Helipuerto de Las Torres,: Fly to Las Torres Heliport, in Puerto Bravo. At the heliport, press Enter and choose the destination.
Flies over buildings and traffic. Flown by hand and only lands on clear ground. With Enter at a heliport you fly to another town.
textos.Vuelas bajo: el radar no te ve por debaj: You fly low: the radar can't see you below {entero} meters, but you have to jump whatever comes up. When you hear the alarm, climb.
textos.Vuelo alto: desde el suelo ya no te sigu: High flight: they can't track you from the ground anymore.
textos.Vuelo comercial: parte fija de la paga: Commercial flight: fixed part of the pay
textos.Vuelo comercial: {lower}, hasta {nombre_: Commercial flight: {lower}, to {nombre_lugar}. {donde}. They pay {paga} euros when you land there.
Flight complete. You get paid {paga} euros.
textos.Vuelo en helicóptero con piloto, si el d: Helicopter flight with pilot, if the destination doesn't set its own
textos.Vuelo real: altura, y travesías de verda: Real flight: altitude, and real crossings between towns
textos.Vuelo tranquilo: te dan {extra} euros má: Smooth flight: you get {extra} euros more.
textos.Vuelos que ofrece cada campo al día: Flights each airfield offers per day
textos.Vuelve a El Fogón de Barlovento antes de: Go back to El Fogón de Barlovento before the boat docks.
Go back to Barral Cranes and Tankers.
Go back to Paco's Grocery Store.
textos.Vuelve a la Cocina de la Hermandad antes: Go back to the Brotherhood Kitchen before it snows. You have almost three minutes.
Go back to the Viento Sur Racing Team.
Go back to the Market Pharmacy.
textos.Vuelve a la Luna Llena antes de que abra: Go back to Luna Llena before the doors open.
textos.Vuelve a la Taberna del Capitán, en Cala: Go back to Captain's Tavern, in Cala Brava.
Go back to the Union Tavern.
textos.Vuelve a la Trastienda de El Gordo, en P: Go back to El Gordo's Back Room, in Puerto Bravo.
Go back to the Los Calaveras Hideout.
Go back to the Fish Market with Salva.
textos.Vuelve a la mochila, si te caben sus hue: It goes back into the backpack, if its slots fit.
textos.Vuelve a leer el estado, los jugadores,: Reads the status, the players, the accounts and the invitations again.
textos.Vuelve a leer la lista de cuentas. Tambi: Reads the accounts list again. Also with F6.
Reads the invitations list again. Also with F6.
It is called {t} again, like the model.
textos.Vuelve a tus armas con su munición. Si y: It goes back to your weapons with its ammo. If you already carry the same one, you keep its bullets.
Go back to Almacén Siete Gun Shop.
textos.Vuelve al Bar La Gaviota antes de que ll: Go back to La Gaviota Bar before they arrive: three and a half minutes.
Go back to La Gaviota Bar.
Go back to El Espeto Beach Bar.
Go back to the Central Market with Matilde.
Go back to the Food Market.
Go back to the soup kitchen with the wallet.
textos.Vuelve al menú de opciones. También sirv: Goes back to the options menu. Escape works too.
textos.Vuelve al muelle de Cala Brava, atraca c: Go back to the Cala Brava pier, dock with Enter and take the anchor to the boat dealer.
Go back to the Cala Brava pier, dock with Enter and take the lobsters to Captain's Tavern.
textos.Vuelve con el pedido a la Sala Crepúscul: Go back to the Crepúsculo Hall with the order.
Come back when you have experience.
textos.Vuelven los que faltaban, y con esta nie: The missing ones are coming back, and in this fog you can't even see the pier. Go up to the signal station and ring the bell: the neighbors know what it means.
textos.Vuelven más raqueros, de noche y con nie: More wreckers are coming back, at night and in the fog.
textos.Vuelves a casa por la Calle Mayor. Sea l: You head home along Calle Mayor. Whatever you've decided, tomorrow the shutter goes up all the same.
