textos.Vuelves a la calle con tres direcciones: You're back on the street with three addresses in your head: the job center, the academy and the soup kitchen. None of them asks for a weapon.
You show up on the radar again.
textos.Vuelves a subir las escaleras del periód: You climb the newspaper stairs again. The reporter says nothing: she just takes the envelope with both hands.
textos.Vuelves al juego con el GPS apuntando al: You go back to the game with the GPS pointing to the place. Get there on time: if you don't show up, they take it badly.
textos.Vuelves al juego con el GPS hacia esta p: You go back to the game with the GPS set to this person. If they are in another town, it takes you to the place nearest to where they are. If they move, mark them again.
textos.Vuelves al juego con el GPS hacia tu ami: You go back to the game with the GPS set to your friend. If they are in another town, it takes you to the place nearest to where they are. If they move, mark them again.
textos.Vuelves al juego con el GPS puesto hacia: You go back to the game with the GPS set to that point. If it is in another town, you have to travel there first.
textos.Vuelves al juego y la propiedad sale a l: You go back to the game and the property goes up for sale to anyone. If the server has no record of you paying for it here, it gives you no money.
textos.Vuelves al juego y llegan todos juntos a: You go back to the game and they all come for you together, in a single wave.
textos.Vuelves al lugar donde empieza la misión: You go back to where the mission starts, with the money, health and weapons you had when you accepted it.
textos.Vuelves al menú principal. Lo que no hay: You go back to the main menu. Anything you haven't saved is lost.
textos.Vuelves al momento en que empezó el últi: You go back to the moment the last stage you reached began, with what you had then. You don't repeat what came before.
You go back to the objective.
textos.Vuelves al último punto de control de {t: You go back to the last checkpoint of {titulo}.
You go back in a menu.
textos.Windows la usa para cerrar la ventana: Windows uses it to close the window
textos.Windows la usa para ir a la barra de men: Windows uses it to go to the menu bar
textos.Windows no deja escribir en la carpeta d: Windows does not allow writing to the game folder and could not {que}. This usually happens if the game is in a protected folder, such as Program Files, or if an antivirus or controlled folder access blocks it. Move the game to another folder, for example inside Documents, or add an exclusion in your antivirus.

Windows does not allow writing to the game folder. This usually happens if it is in a protected folder, such as Program Files, or if an antivirus or controlled folder access blocks it. Move the game to another folder, for example inside Documents, or add an exclusion in your antivirus.
textos.Windows no dejó escribir {que}: acceso d: Windows did not allow writing {que}: access denied. This usually happens if the game is in a protected folder, such as Program Files, if Windows controlled folder access is on, or if an antivirus blocks it. Move the game to another folder, for example inside Documents, or add an exclusion in your antivirus.
textos.Y además, tanto por ciento del dinero qu: And also, percent of the money you carry, per level
textos.Y al menos una de cada grupo: And at least one from each group
textos.Y alrededor de un vehículo que huye, mie: And around a fleeing vehicle, while you chase it
textos.Y cinco gorilas en la puerta, me imagino: And five bouncers at the door, I imagine.
textos.Y con cuidado, que si llega abollada el: And be careful, because if it arrives dented Sento won't pay you.
And with what they pay, you see how it is.
textos.Y cuántas más si empuñas un arma de fueg: And how many more if you wield a firearm
textos.Y cuánto baja cada vez: And how much it drops each time
textos.Y cuánto sube por cada producto de más e: And how much it rises for each extra product in the basket
textos.Y dicen que en San Lucero ahora mandas t: And they say you run San Lucero now. The councilman likes ambitious people. We'll talk.
textos.Y dile a tu jefa que no me mire así cuan: And tell your boss not to look at me like that when she comes, because we both know what it is to build a business alone.
textos.Y el asalto que preparaban a {barrio} qu: And the attack they were preparing on {barrio} is called off.
textos.Y el calzado, a juego: se nota que te ha: And the shoes match: it shows you made an effort.
textos.Y el dinero para empezar no hace falta t: And you don't need to have all the money to start. That's what mortgages are for. Go to the bank and let them explain it; then come back and I'll introduce you to the suppliers.
textos.Y en esta oficina de empleo, y en las ac: And at this job center, and at the academies, there's the honest life: steady jobs with schedules and courses to get promoted. It's all on the phone too, with M.
textos.Y en la esquina, apoyado en una moto, un: And on the corner, leaning on a motorcycle, one of Los Calaveras nods at you.
And that's even though I'm not feeling inspired today.
textos.Y he sabido lo de Villaseca. Una coopera: And I heard about Villaseca. A cooperative that doesn't sell is news: I'm sending a photographer on Monday.
textos.Y la primera noche de otoño, sin que nad: And on the first night of autumn, when nobody expects it, it rains in Bahía del Ocaso.
textos.Y la tercera a la Despensa de la Parroqu: And the third to the Parish Pantry, before they close.
textos.Y la tercera, de San Lucero, de una insp: And the third, from San Lucero, from an inspector. She says El Caimán has been convicted, and that if one day you want an honest job, call her.
textos.Y la tercera, de San Lucero. Doña Remedi: And the third, from San Lucero. Doña Remedios says nobody at the market pays to work anymore, and that she's saving you some good saffron.
textos.Y la tercera, de San Lucero. No es una c: And the third, from San Lucero. It's not a letter: it's the week's takings, with a note that says "for the boss". Oh, Dani.
textos.Y lo que se suma por kilómetro: And what is added per kilometer
textos.Y no se queda ahí: {banda} se lo ha toma: And it doesn't end there: {banda} took it as an insult. They'll send someone to explain it to you.
textos.Y no van solos: {banda} y {aliada} se ha: And they're not alone: {banda} and {aliada} have allied for a big hit.
textos.Y o Triángulo para la ayuda de la opción: Y or Triangle for help on the option
textos.Y otra cosa: una nómina no es solo diner: And another thing: a payslip isn't just money. It's a paper that says you're reliable. Stop by Mercantil Bank and ask what you can do with it.
And you want me to steal a police car. From the door of the police station.
textos.Y quieres que te la traiga antes de que: And you want me to bring it to you before it starts.
textos.Y segundos de más por cada metro de dist: And extra seconds for each meter of distance
textos.Y si además el calzado va a juego: And if the footwear also matches
textos.Y si no quieres conducir, pulsa la Y: es: And if you don't want to drive, press Y: it's the GPS autopilot. With a destination set, the car accelerates, brakes, turns, waits at traffic lights and stops when it arrives.
textos.Y si puedes traer el maletín, mejor. Den: And if you can bring the briefcase, even better. Inside is the bread for two hundred families.
textos.Y si vas conjuntado: And if you are dressed in a matching outfit
textos.Y todas las tiendas que no encajen en ni: And all the shops that do not fit any other type
And you want to go for a spin.
textos.Ya en tierra, con Intro en el campo tien: Once on the ground, Enter at the airfield gives you fuel, the hangar and commercial flights.
I'm here. Get in whenever you like.
textos.Ya estoy en la puerta. ¡Vamos, vamos!: I'm at the door. Go, go!
It's in. Nobody can stop him now.
textos.Ya está descargada y comprobada. El jueg: It's already downloaded and verified. The game saves your game, closes, updates and reopens by itself in a few seconds.
textos.Ya está puesto en esta casa. No hace fal: It's already in this home. There's no need to buy it again.
All your crew is with you now.
textos.Ya está. Mañana descargan los barcos sin: That's it. Tomorrow the boats unload without paying anyone, for the first time in ten years.
textos.Ya están aquí: vienen a por {persona}. Q: They're here already: they are coming for {persona}. Don't let them through.
textos.Ya estás en el sitio: no hace falta acer: You're already at the spot: no need to get closer. Without getting out of the vehicle, press Enter to take the road{a}.
textos.Ya estás en una banda. Sal de ella antes: You are already in a gang. Leave it before founding another.
textos.Ya estás trabajando. Haz un servicio com: You're working now. Do a full service: go where the GPS points, stop so the customer can get in and take them to their destination. Drive yourself, or press Y to let the car drive itself. O repeats what's next.
textos.Ya habéis hablado hoy. {nombre} tiene co: You've already talked today. {nombre} has things to do.
textos.Ya habéis hablado un buen rato hoy. {nom: You've already talked a good while today. {nombre} is doing their own thing.
You've already met up today. Better another day.
textos.Ya has apretado una vez. Ahora, o lo tom: You've already pushed once. Now, take it or leave it.
textos.Ya has cobrado %d encargos de este tipo: You have already been paid for %d jobs of this kind in the last hour, which is what this server recognizes: this one counts against your hourly earnings. In %d minutes it will recognize another one.
textos.Ya has entrenado hoy. Tienes agujetas ha: You already worked out today. You're sore down to your eyelashes.
textos.Ya has ido a clase hoy. La cabeza no da: You've already been to class today. Your head can't take any more.
You have sailed in a straight line long enough. Now take the helm: turn with the left and right arrow keys until you change heading.
textos.Ya hay un %s en esta carpeta. No lo toco: There is already a %s in this folder. I am not touching it.
There is already a robbery in progress.
textos.Ya hay una actividad propuesta o en marc: There's already an activity proposed or in progress.
There is already a gang with that name.
textos.Ya hay una guerra declarada por este bar: There is already a war declared for this neighborhood.
textos.Ya le has hecho un regalo hoy. No hay qu: You've already given them a gift today. Don't crowd them.
textos.Ya llevas dos guardaespaldas. Más sería: You already have two bodyguards. More would be a parade.
textos.Ya llevas una protección igual o mejor,: You already wear equal or better protection, in perfect condition.
textos.Ya llevas {TOPE_BOLETOS} boletos para el: You already have {TOPE_BOLETOS} tickets for the draw {cuando_txt}. No more are sold per person.
You already have it up to date.
textos.Ya me han llamado los tres. Has caído bi: All three have already called me. They liked you. Paco says you look like someone who pays suppliers, which coming from him is a compliment.
You'll pay me back for this.
textos.Ya no estás en la banda: You are no longer in the gang
You're no longer in any gang.
textos.Ya no hay quien avise. El escondite está: There's no one left to warn you. The hideout is next to {nombre}: {v} remain.
Nobody is guarding it now. Grab the box.
textos.Ya no lo guarda nadie. Busca {objeto} y: Nobody guards it anymore. Look for {objeto} and grab it.
textos.Ya no pueden enseñarte nada más: tienes: They can't teach you anything more: you're at the maximum level.
textos.Ya no queda nadie en pie. Coge la mercan: Nobody is left standing. Grab the goods and the box.
textos.Ya no queda nadie en tu banda para venir: Nobody is left in your gang to come pick you up.
I'm not a kid anymore, that's for sure.
They are no longer looking for you.
textos.Ya puedes decir que eres de la isla. El: Now you can say you're from the island. The catamaran at the slipway is yours: a man who isn't coming back left it unpaid.
textos.Ya que nos entendemos: esta noche salen: Since we understand each other: tonight three tankers go out that must not cross paths with anyone. You clear the way.
textos.Ya sabes pilotar. En los helipuertos pue: You know how to fly now. At heliports you can take a helicopter or pay for a flight, and Autos San Lucero sells them.
textos.Ya se te escapó antes, y lo sabe: va más: [He|She] got away from you before, and knows it: more nervous now and doesn't run as fast.
textos.Ya son {n}. Un coleccionista te adelanta: That makes {n}. A collector advances you {precio} euros and your name starts to get around.
textos.Ya sé dónde está el chaval. Lo tienen lo: I know where the kid is. The black boat crew has him at the pier, because he saw what he shouldn't have.
I already told you before, but fine.
textos.Ya tienes pareja: {nombre}. Tendrías que: You already have a partner: {nombre}. You'd have to break up first.
All your components are now up to date.
You already have a hijacked aircraft.
textos.Ya tienes un contrato fijo. Para firmar: You already have a permanent contract. To sign another, leave the one you have first.
You already have a personal loan running. Finish paying it before asking for another.
textos.Ya tienes un negocio. La presidenta de l: You have a business now. The president of the merchants wants to meet you.
You already have an order on the way.
textos.Ya tienes un título. Paulino necesita a: You have a degree now. Paulino needs someone he can trust for an errand downtown.
textos.Ya tienes un vuelo comercial entre manos: You already have a commercial flight in progress.
You already have an open connection.
textos.Ya tienes una pelea en marcha. La tecla: You already have a fight going. The O key tells you how it's going.
textos.Ya tienes una tregua con {banda}, hasta: You already have a truce with {banda}, until day {tregua}.
textos.Ya tienes uno esperando en la pista. Sal: You already have one waiting on the runway. Leave the terminal and get in with F.
textos.Ya tienes uno. Se enciende con Mayúscula: You already have one. Turn it on with Shift R, on foot.
textos.Ya tienes {destino} debajo. Elige dónde: You're over {destino}. Choose where to land.
You are already riding as a passenger with another player.
textos.Yo a las diez estoy en casa. Lo que pase: I'm home by ten. What happens outside is none of my business.
textos.Yo a ti te conozco. Tú eres Dani Roca. M: I know you. You're Dani Roca. My brother [shared a cell with you|crossed paths with you] up there, in the prison. He says you're the real deal.
I can take whatever they throw at me.
textos.Yo anoche no pegué ojo. El vecino de arr: I didn't sleep a wink last night. The guy upstairs bought a drum kit. A drum kit! At sixty years old.
I dance better than anybody in this city.
textos.Yo canto en la ducha, y los vecinos lo s: I sing in the shower, and the neighbors know it.
textos.Yo canto fatal, pero me lo paso muy bien: I sing terribly, but I have a great time.
I'm an average cook, but I put love into it.
I eat everything. And it shows.
textos.Yo compro cobre. No pregunto de dónde sa: I buy copper. I don't ask where it comes from. Seisdedos pays me triple if it comes from your neighborhood, and until today I didn't want to know why.
textos.Yo compro en la tienda de siempre. Me fí: I shop at the usual store. They even give me credit.
Four hours of sleep is plenty for me.
textos.Yo con ellos, buenos días y buenas tarde: With them, I say good morning and good afternoon. Nothing more.
textos.Yo corría de joven. Ahora corro si me pe: I used to run when I was young. Now I run if someone's chasing me.
I believe what I see. And sometimes not even that.
textos.Yo creo que harás lo correcto. Se te ve: I think you'll do the right thing. You seem like a good person.
textos.Yo cuando estoy mal me hago un chocolate: When I'm down I make hot chocolate and call my sister. She doesn't let me get a word in, but I feel better.
textos.Yo cumplo en agosto y nunca tuve fiesta,: My birthday is in August and I never had a party, because everyone was on vacation. Now I celebrate it in September and buy myself whatever I want.
I don't know anything about that, sorry.
I know just enough about that.
I know more about soccer than the coach.
textos.Yo diría que sí, pero no pongo la mano e: I'd say yes, but I wouldn't bet on it.
I sleep little and badly. It's age.
textos.Yo el móvil lo uso para llamar. Lo demás: I use my phone to make calls. The rest I don't understand.
textos.Yo en esas cosas no creo, pero haberlas,: I don't believe in those things, but they do exist.
textos.Yo en fiestas me voy. No aguanto el ruid: During the festival I leave. I can't stand the noise.
textos.Yo estudié lo justo. La calle enseña más: I studied just enough. The street teaches more.
I smoke cigars. Cigarettes are for amateurs.
textos.Yo he sacado un atún así de grande. Preg: I once pulled in a tuna this big. Ask at the fish market.
textos.Yo jugué de joven. Era mal{o}, pero poní: I played when I was young. I was bad, but I gave it my all.
I read the paper and that's it.
textos.Yo lleno cubos cuando sale, por si acaso: I fill buckets when the water comes on, just in case.
textos.Yo me baño todo el año. Bueno, hasta oct: I swim all year round. Well, until October.
textos.Yo me enamoré a los quince de la hija de: I fell in love at fifteen with the baker's daughter. I gained fifteen pounds from buying bread.
textos.Yo me entero de todo en el bar. Es más f: I find out everything at the bar. It's more reliable.
I'll handle the people. You do your thing.
textos.Yo me peleé una vez, de joven. Perdí. Fi: I got into a fight once, when I was young. I lost. End of story.
textos.Yo nací en {barrio}, en la casa que hací: I was born in {barrio}, in the corner house, which is a store now. My father too, and my grandfather. That's four generations already.
textos.Yo nado hasta la boya y vuelvo sin despe: I swim to the buoy and back without messing up my hair.
I don't take buses. People drive me.
textos.Yo no contrato a nadie. Bastante tengo c: I don't hire anyone. I have enough on my plate.
textos.Yo no entiendo mucho, pero me alegro cua: I don't understand much, but I'm happy when the local team wins.
textos.Yo no envidio a los ricos. Bueno, un poc: I don't envy the rich. Well, a little.
I don't do favors. I do business.
textos.Yo no he oído nada. Ni lo que me vas a d: I haven't heard anything. Not even what you're about to tell me.
textos.Yo no juego. Bastante lotería es la vida: I don't gamble. Life is enough of a lottery.
I don't judge anyone by what they say.
I don't tie myself down. Let them miss me.
textos.Yo no me pongo enferm{o}. No tengo tiemp: I don't get sick. I don't have time.
I don't need weapons. I'm enough on my own.
I don't need luck. I have talent.
I didn't need to study. I was born knowing.
I don't ask about anybody's past.
textos.Yo no pregunto. Tú tampoco. Así dura el: I don't ask. Neither do you. That's how the business lasts.
I can't leave my post. You take her. Don't run, because if the balloon slips away nobody can move her.
I don't dream. I get things done.
textos.Yo no tengo nada, pero en la oficina de: I don't have anything, but at the job center there are always shifts.
textos.Yo no veo nada, no oigo nada y no digo n: I see nothing, I hear nothing and I say nothing.
I don't watch movies. I live them.
I pay, I keep quiet and I close early.
textos.Yo paseo por la orilla todos los días. E: I walk along the shore every day. It's my medicine.
textos.Yo prefiero escribir que hablar... por e: I prefer writing to talking... that's why I like it.
If I were you, I wouldn't complicate my life.
textos.Yo quería ser cantante, luego torero, lu: I wanted to be a singer, then a bullfighter, then an astronaut. I ended up a {oficio}. Not bad, but it's not the same.
textos.Yo quise un perro, pero en mi piso no ca: I wanted a dog, but not even I fit in my apartment.
textos.Yo reparto agua con dos cisternas más vi: I deliver water with two tankers older than I am. Before I give you one, I want to see if you can get around the city.
I went out to sea once with my brother-in-law. Once. I got seasick before we cast off and he still tells everyone about it at Christmas.
textos.Yo siempre estoy bien. Los que están mal: I'm always fine. It's everybody else who's doing badly.
textos.Yo siempre llevo. Otra cosa es que te lo: I always carry some. Whether I'm going to show you is another matter.
Without my eight hours I'm not a person.
textos.Yo solo como bien. Para comer mal, no co: I only eat well. I don't eat badly.
textos.Yo solo sé enseñarte la segunda. Trabajo: I only know how to teach you the second one. There's work: by the day whenever you like, or with a contract, with a boss, a payslip and promotions. And if you study, a better position.
textos.Yo soy de aquí. Los que venís de fuera s: I'm from here. You out-of-towners stand out a mile away.
textos.Yo soy del equipo de aquí, gane o pierda: I'm for the local team, win or lose. Mostly lose.
I'll hold, you turn. It goes faster that way.
I know a lot of things, but not that one.
I know all the secrets of this city.
textos.Yo también me siento así a veces... lo s: I feel that way sometimes too... sorry.
textos.Yo una vez cogí el autobús equivocado y: Once I took the wrong bus and ended up in the mountains. I had an amazing lamb, though.
I vote, because it was hard to win that right. Then I regret it.
textos.Yo voy al médico lo justo. Me pone nervi: I go to the doctor only when I have to. It makes me nervous.
textos.Yo voy andando a todas partes. Así no me: I walk everywhere. That way they can't fine me.
I go... when there aren't many people.
I'm too old for those scares.
textos.Yo ya no bebo como antes. El hígado tien: I don't drink like I used to. The liver has a memory.
textos.Yo ya no sueño. Me conformo con llegar a: I don't dream anymore. I'll settle for making it to the end of the month.
textos.Yo, con el castellano y las manos, me en: Me, with plain talk and my hands, I get along with anyone.
textos.Yo, de café. El alcohol lo dejé hace tie: Me, coffee. I gave up alcohol a while ago.
textos.Yo, la radio puesta todo el día. Sin mús: Me, I keep the radio on all day. I can't work without music.
textos.Yo, las manos en los bolsillos. Así no m: Me, hands in my pockets. That way I stay out of trouble.
textos.Yo, mientras tenga para comer y para un: As long as I have something to eat and money for a coffee, I'm happy.
textos.Yo... estoy bien, gracias. Un poco de al: I... am fine, thanks. A little allergy.
textos.Yo... me pongo nervios{o} cuando los veo: I... get nervous when I see them. And I haven't done anything.
I... don't remember much from before.
Me... I pray sometimes. When I'm scared.
I... a soft drink. I don't drink much.
I... am just getting by. Like everyone, I guess.
textos.Zapatillas, botas, zapatos de vestir, ta: Sneakers, boots, dress shoes, heels, sandals... If they fit the style of the clothes, you're matching.
textos.Zarpa primero: los repartos se hacen por: Set sail first: deliveries are made by sea.
textos.Zarpar con la lancha de prácticas del tu: Set sail on the tutorial practice boat: free
textos.Zarpar: estar en el mar a bordo de un ba: Set sail: be out at sea aboard a boat
textos.Zona residencial tranquila alrededor del: Quiet residential area around the big Alameda Park.
textos.Zona segura: aquí nadie puede herir a na: Safe zone: nobody can hurt anybody here.
textos.Zonas seguras en hospitales, comisarías,: Safe zones in hospitals, police stations, homes and inside buildings:
So you're Encarna's nephew. Or niece. I can't hear a thing with this noise.
textos.[Jefe|Jefa]. El bingo, la discoteca y la: Boss. The bingo hall, the nightclub and the seafood restaurant. If you collect in person today, tomorrow there's no need to even go.

textos.apagado, todo como en versiones anterior: off, everything as in previous versions
here the cash box is guarded.
textos.asistida, el coche sigue el carril solo: assisted, the car follows the lane by itself
textos.atacar o disparar. Con armas automáticas: attack or shoot. With automatic weapons, hold it down

textos.avisa a todos, lo guarda todo y para el: warns everyone, saves everything and stops the server

textos.cobras un veinte por ciento más en los t: you earn twenty percent more on honest jobs

textos.{perro} huele el pienso y no lo quiere:: {perro} sniffs the food and doesn't want it: it isn't hungry.
textos.{perro} llega corriendo y se pone a tu l: {perro} comes running and stands by your side.
textos.{perro} mueve el rabo y se aprieta contr: {perro} wags its tail and presses against your leg.
textos.{perro} no está aquí ahora mismo: vuelve: {perro} isn't here right now: it comes back to you as soon as you set foot on land
textos.{perro} se come la ración con ganas.{pac: {perro} eats the portion eagerly.{paces} You have {pienso} portions of dog food left.
textos.{perro} se deja tocar, con las orejas ga: {perro} lets you touch it, ears drooping. It's still afraid of you. Keep calm, or feed it.
textos.{perro} sigue a gusto con la caricia de: {perro} is still enjoying the petting from before. Give it a moment.
textos.{perro} te espera en casa: llévatelo con: {perro} is waiting for you at home: take [him|her] with you
{perro} licks your hand and wags its tail. You've made peace: it goes at your side again.
textos.{que} Voy a intentar volver a entrar yo: {que} I'll try to rejoin on my own. If I manage it, you're right where you were, with everything you were carrying.
textos.{que} a {nombre}: ya lo has hecho hoy: {que} to {nombre}: you already did it today
textos.{que}. Están al caer. No salgas del barr: {que}. They're about to arrive. Don't leave the neighborhood.
textos.{que}. Muévete con las flechas: el pitid: {que}. Move with the arrow keys: the beep gets faster and higher the closer you are to the treasure, and it comes from the side where it is. When you think you're on top of it, press Enter to {v}. You have 45 seconds and three tries.
textos.{que}. Vienen {total} oleadas: la primer: {que}. {total} waves are coming: the first is about to arrive. Don't leave the neighborhood.
textos.{que}{cuanto} Te reconectaré en cuanto v: {que}{cuanto} I'll reconnect you as soon as it's back and you'll be right where you were, with everything you were carrying.
textos.{quienes} no olvidan: {n} de los suyos v: {quienes} do not forget: {n} of their people come to collect.
textos.{quien} anda por {lugar} con {n} guardae: {quien} is around {lugar} with {n} bodyguards. Someone is paying for them to never come home.
textos.{quien} da media vuelta. Ahora vas hacia: {quien} makes a U-turn. Now you are heading {v}.
textos.{quien} debe dinero a quien no debe. Est: {quien} owes money to the wrong people. They are at {lugar} with {n} others. They don't need to be killed: beat them until they give up. Fists or a melee weapon work best.
textos.{quien} está dentro de {nombre}, con {n}: {quien} is inside {nombre}, with {n} of their people. Get to the door, on foot.
textos.{quien} está en {lugar}. Lleva {n} de es: {quien} is at {lugar}. They have {n} as escort, and some patrol the area in a vehicle: they will arrive when the trouble starts.
textos.{quien} está en {nombre} con {n} más. A: {quien} is at {nombre} with {n} others. Don't kill them: beat them until they give up. As for the rest, do as you see fit.
textos.{quien} guarda {objeto} en {nombre}, con: {quien} keeps {objeto} at {nombre}, with {n} men. Take them out.
textos.{quien} huye en un {nombre} desde {nombr: {quien} is fleeing in a {nombre} from {nombre2}. Catch up with them in a vehicle and wreck it: ram them, or lock on with Q and fire with Ctrl.
textos.{quien} le dice a quien va a su lado:: {quien} says to the person next to them:
textos.{quien} levanta las manos y se aparta de: {quien} raises their hands and steps away from the cash box. Go get it.
textos.{quien} no sale de {lugar}, y dentro tie: {quien} never leaves {lugar}, and has {n} of their people inside. You have to go in and find them.
textos.{quien} se ha enterado de que le buscan: {quien} has learned they are being hunted and is leaving {lugar} in a {modelo}. You have to catch up and leave them without a vehicle: go with something fast.
textos.{quien} se llevó {objeto} que no era suy: {quien} took {objeto} that wasn't theirs. It is kept at {lugar}, with {n} men. Take it from them and bring it back.
textos.{quien}, camino de {destino}.{radio} Pul: {quien}, on the way to {destino}.{radio} Press Enter if you want to arrive now.
{situar}. Get in with F and get out of here.
textos.{strip} {frase} Pierdes los {precio} eur: {strip} {frase} You lose the {precio} euros it gave you every midnight, and some reputation. You can win it back like any other neighborhood, on the phone, in Territories.
textos.{titulo}. Pulsa la tecla que quieres usa: {titulo}. Press the key you want to use. Escape cancels.
textos.{total_g} euros a los {guardias} guardia: {total_g} euros to the {guardias} guards of your neighborhoods
textos.{total}, justos. ¿Le hace falta bolsa? B: {total}, exactly. Do you need a bag? Have a good day.
textos.{upper}{v} que tenías {v2} a arrancar so: {upper}{v} you had {v2} automatically: the players who were waiting will be able to rejoin.
textos.{v} de {nombre}. {situar}. Pulsa Q para: {v} of {nombre}. {situar}. Press Q to lock on to the nearest.
{v} wants nothing to do with you.
textos.{v} no te sigue a otra localidad: {v} doesn't follow you to another town
textos.{v} {n} euros. En el armario hay {int} y: {v} {n} euros. There are {int} in the wardrobe and you're carrying {dinero}.
textos.{v}: quedan {quedan} cuotas de {cuota} e: {v}: {quedan} payments of {cuota} euros left. The next one, in {quedan2} {v2}
textos.{yo} me pusieron, y con {yo} me he queda: They named me {yo}, and I've stuck with {yo}.
textos.{yo}, como mi abuelo, que también se lla: {yo}, like my grandfather, who had the same name and was just as talkative.
textos.{yo}, mucho gusto. ¿Y tú cómo te llamas?: {yo}, nice to meet you. And what's your name?
{yo}. Write it down, it's going to sound familiar.
textos.{yo}. Bueno, en casa me dicen de otra ma: {yo}. Well, at home they call me something else, but I won't tell you that.
textos.¡%s os declara la guerra por %s! Empieza: %s declares war on you for %s! It starts in %d minutes and lasts %d. Whoever has the most people inside the neighborhood and knocks down the most rivals wins.
textos.¡A {nombre} le han dado! Se arrastra hac: {nombre} got hit! They crawl toward the door: out of the heist.
textos.¡Agua! Niñas, sacad las ollas grandes. H: Water! Girls, get out the big pots. Today there's stew for everyone who comes.
textos.¡Alguien ha avisado a la policía! Despís: Someone has called the police! Lose them to keep what was in the box.
textos.¡Alguien ha pulsado la alarma antes de t: Someone hit the alarm too early!
textos.¡Alto! ¡Las manos donde yo las vea!: Stop! Hands where I can see them!
textos.¡Ascenso! Desde hoy eres {rango}: cobras: Promotion! From today you are {rango}: you earn {extra} percent more per call.
textos.¡Ascenso! Ya eres {nombre} {v}: cobras u: Promotion! You're now {nombre} {v}: you earn {v2} percent more.
textos.¡Ascenso! {jefe} te ofrece el puesto de: Promotion! {jefe} offers you the position of {puesto}: more responsibility, {cupo} turns per period and {sueldo} euros paycheck.
textos.¡Así que tú eres [el|la] de Encarna! Yo: So you're Encarna's kid! I'm Casilda. I've been feeding people here for twenty years, and I know everybody.
textos.¡Atraco! Salta la alarma y a {get} le ll: Robbery! The alarm goes off and {get} gets the alert. Hold out at the door for {get2} seconds, on foot, without moving away.
textos.¡Bajad, bajad! ¡Está ahí!: Get down here, get down here! It's over there!
textos.¡Basta! ¡Pago, pago!: Enough! I will pay, I will pay!
textos.¡Con la policía pegada no puedes salir a: You can't hit the road with the police right behind you! Shake them off first.
textos.¡Con título y todo! Ya te dije que no er: A degree and everything! I told you it wasn't that hard. The hard part is showing up every afternoon after work, and you did that.
textos.¡Corre al Bar La Gaviota y acaba con los: Run to La Gaviota Bar and take out the five hitmen before it's too late!
textos.¡Cuidado! Alguien ha sacado un arma de d: Careful! Someone pulled a weapon from under the counter.
textos.¡Cuidado! ¡No has venido sol[o|a]! ¡Belm: Watch out! You didn't come alone! Belmonte didn't trust you!
textos.¡Dani! Acaba de salir con su Platino bli: Dani! He just left in his armored Platino. If he reaches the midnight ferry, we'll never see him again. Step on it!
textos.¡Dani! El Caimán acaba de salir del Gran: Dani! El Caimán just left the Grand Hotel San Lucero in his armored limousine. If he escapes, he'll come back with more people.
textos.¡Dani! El capataz de Belmonte acaba de s: Dani! Belmonte's foreman just left the winery. He gave them one day to sell. He's in a black off-road vehicle.
textos.¡Dani! Los de Seisdedos han arrancado la: Dani! Seisdedos's people ripped out the pumps from the old well and loaded them onto a truck. Without that well, the neighborhood won't last a week.
textos.¡Dani! Menos mal. Tengo una furgoneta ca: Dani! Thank goodness. I have a van loaded with spare parts that has to be at Hotel Miramar in three minutes, or I lose the customer.
textos.¡Dani! Qué alegría. Oye, tengo la espald: Dani! What a joy. Listen, my back is killing me and I have three orders left to deliver. Can you take them? I'll give you a tip and tell you a secret.
textos.¡Dani! ¡Están aquí! ¡Los hombres de Belm: Dani! They're here! Belmonte's men are wrecking the bar! Run!
textos.¡Dani! ¡Pero mírate! Te lo dije: Dani Ro: Dani! Just look at you! I told you: Dani Roca always comes back.
textos.¡Dani! ¡Pero mírate! Tres años en Montef: Dani! Just look at you! Three years in Monteferro and you still have that same butter-wouldn't-melt face.
textos.¡De aquí no sales andando!: You're not walking out of here!
textos.¡Despista a la policía de San Lucero!: Shake off the San Lucero police!
textos.¡Desplegaos! ¡Que no salga de la manzana: Spread out! Don't let [him|her] leave the block!
textos.¡Eh, cuidado, que soy de los tuyos!: Hey, watch it, I'm one of yours!
textos.¡Eh, que eso no lo has pagado! El tender: Hey, you didn't pay for that! The shopkeeper runs out after you shouting and someone calls the police.
textos.¡El conductor abre la puerta y sale corr: The driver opens the door and runs! Order him to stop with H or catch up with him.
textos.¡El furgón blindado revienta y las sacas: The armored van bursts open and the money bags are left on the ground! All the police are heading here.
textos.¡El gol del domingo! Yo estaba en el bar: Sunday's goal! I was at the bar, and when they scored a whole table fell over. Three beers on the floor. And the owner, instead of getting angry, bought another round.
textos.¡El helicóptero te ha vuelto a localizar: The helicopter has located you again! Over the loudspeaker:
textos.¡El tren embiste tu vehículo y lo saca d: The train rams your vehicle and knocks it off the tracks!
textos.¡El vehículo está ardiendo! ¡Pulsa F par: The vehicle is on fire! Press F to get out, it's going to explode!
textos.¡Empieza la guerra por %s! Todos al barr: The war for %s begins! Everyone to the neighborhood.
textos.¡En marcha! Cuatro entregas en {destino}: Go! Four deliveries in {destino} in six minutes. Split up: each of you takes the nearest one.
textos.¡Encallas en la arena de una isla!: You run aground on the sand of an island!
textos.¡Era un policía de paisano! Saca la plac: It was an undercover cop! He pulls out his badge.
textos.¡Ese ya no nos sigue igual!: That one can't keep up with us like before!
This one won't go quietly! They pull out a knife.
textos.¡Esto es un atraco! Acaba con los vigila: This is a robbery! Take out the security guards.
textos.¡Esto es un atraco! Pero aquí la caja ti: This is a robbery! But here the cash box has someone guarding it: take out {guardia}.
textos.¡Esto es un atraco! {quien} te mira, tra: This is a robbery! {quien} looks at you, swallows and gives you what there is: {botin} euros. As you leave you hear the alarm.
textos.¡Ha saltado la alarma del bingo! Despist: The bingo hall alarm went off! Shake off the police.
textos.¡Ha saltado la alarma silenciosa! Despis: The silent alarm went off! Shake the police to keep the loot.
textos.¡Ha saltado la alarma! Despista a la pol: The alarm went off! Shake off the police.
textos.¡Has derribado el helicóptero de la poli: You have shot down the police helicopter! It falls in flames, {metros}, {direccion_txt}: get clear. All the police in the region turn out to look for you: for two minutes it will take you twice as long to lose them, and if they catch you, you will pay {int} euros more for the helicopter.
textos.¡Has encontrado todos los objetos de col: You found all the collectibles! A collector pays you {precio} euros for the whole set.
textos.¡Has ganado la carrera! Te llevas {bote}: You won the race! You take {bote} euros.
textos.¡Has pescado {nombre}! Llevas {len} capt: You caught {nombre}! You have {len} catches. Sell them at a fish shop or the fish market.
textos.¡Has pinchado! El coche tira hacia un la: You got a flat! The car pulls to one side and won't go fast.
textos.¡Has plantado cara a {banda} en su barri: You stood up to {banda} in their neighborhood! The war for {barrio} begins.
Ha! I hadn't heard that one.
textos.¡Justo a tiempo! Cuando quieras correr t: Just in time! Whenever you want to race, come here with any vehicle. There are races in the industrial estate, in San Lucero, in Villaseca and even regattas at sea.
textos.¡La tenemos vista! Sale de la sede en la: We've spotted her! She's leaving the headquarters in the limousine, with the concession deeds. If she signs them in another province, she'll be back in a year under another name.
textos.¡Largo de aquí, que esto no va contigo!: Get out of here, this has nothing to do with you!
textos.¡Las manos donde yo las vea!: Hands where I can see them!
textos.¡Las manos donde yo las vea! ¡No te muev: Hands where I can see them! Do not move!
textos.¡Le has dado a {nombre}! Gañe y se apart: You hit {nombre}! It yelps and shies away from you. It no longer trusts you: it won't warn you or search for anything until you make peace. With pets, food and time it passes: Shift Y.
textos.¡Le has dado a {nombre}! Gañe y se encog: You hit {nombre}! It yelps and cowers. Be careful: if you hit it again, it will stop trusting you.
We made it! And with my hair still in place. Come to the reception later, you've earned a plate.
textos.¡Lleva la moto a la Recta del Polígono e: Take the bike to the Industrial Estate Straight in under two minutes!
textos.¡Lo hemos publicado! Está en todas las r: We published it! It's on every radio station. But Varela has emptied his office and is leaving the police station right now, heading for the north highway.
We got it! Two years of conversations. Varela is finished... if we survive to publish it.
textos.¡Lo tengo! El mapa dice: desde el faro d: I've got it! The map says: from the island's lighthouse, where the skull looks out to sea. The chest is in the cave, but you have to go to the lighthouse first for the key.
textos.¡Manos arriba! {quien} vacía la caja sin: Hands up! {quien} empties the cash box without a word: {botin} euros. They hit the alarm, get out of there!
textos.¡Meta! Has terminado {nombre} en {int} s: Finish line! You completed {nombre} in {int} seconds.
textos.¡Mi cartera! Y está todo. Todo. Ay, [hij: My wallet! And it's all there. All of it. Oh, dear, you don't know what this means to me.
textos.¡Nadie se mueve! En {lugar} se mueve tod: Nobody move! At {lugar} everybody moves, and all of them toward their weapons.
textos.¡Ni un arañazo! Bueno, casi. Tienes futu: Not a scratch! Well, almost. You have a future. When you want to earn some money, bring me cars at the scrapyard next door: they pay by model and condition.
textos.¡No hagas ninguna tontería! ¡Las manos a: Do not do anything stupid! Hands up!
textos.¡No me digas! Cuéntamelo todo, con detal: You don't say! Tell me everything, with details. It's been ages since I heard a good one.
No way! Go on, go on.
textos.¡No para! Acelera y se salta el cruce: a: He does not stop! He speeds up and runs the intersection: now it is a chase. Ram him until he stops.
Again! One more and I won't be answerable.
textos.¡Otros buscadores de tesoros! Acaba con: Other treasure hunters! Take them out.
textos.¡Policía en la puerta! Salid como podáis: Police at the door! Get out however you can.
textos.¡Por fin! Otro día sin gamba y cierro. T: Finally! Another day without prawns and I would have closed. Here, and tell Amparo I owe her a paella.
textos.¡Pues espera que te cuente otra! Bueno,: Well, wait till I tell you another one! Actually, no, that one's a long story.
textos.¡Que no salga de aquí!: Don't let [him|her] get out of here!
textos.¡Quiet[o|a]! ¡Al suelo, despacio!: Freeze! Get down on the ground, slowly!
textos.¡Qué alegría! Me alegro muchísimo por ti: That's great news! I'm so happy for you.
textos.¡Qué bonito es, madre mía! Decidido: no: How beautiful it is, my goodness! Decided: we're not returning it.
textos.¡Qué maravilla! Escucha ese motor. Eres: How wonderful! Listen to that engine. You're an artist, Dani.
textos.¡Redada! La policía entra en el club y t: Raid! The police storm the club and you get a fine of {multa} euros.
textos.¡Refuerzos! ¡Que no salga del barrio!: Backup! Don't let [him|her] leave the neighborhood!
textos.¡Reparto completado entre todos! Cobráis: Delivery run completed together! You each get {premio} euros.
textos.¡Salida! Carrera hasta {destino}. Hay {v: Go! Race to {destino}. There are {v} euros at stake.
textos.¡Sospechoso armado! ¡Fuego a discreción!: Armed suspect! Open fire at will!
textos.¡Suena la sirena del penal! Despista a l: The prison siren is sounding! Shake off the police.
textos.¡Te ha arrollado el tranvía! Te aparta d: The tram ran you over! It knocks you off the tracks.
textos.¡Te ha arrollado el tren! Sales despedid: The train ran you over! You're thrown off the tracks.
textos.¡Te ha atropellado un vehículo!: A vehicle has run you over!
textos.¡Te han descubierto! Acaba con los maton: They've spotted you! Take out the thugs.
textos.¡Tienes a la policía encima! Despístalos: The police are right on you! Shake them off a bit before painting.
textos.¡Tienes a media comisaría detrás! Despis: Half the police station is on your tail! Shake off the police.
textos.¡Toda la policía de la ciudad te busca!: The whole city police force is looking for you! Lose them.
textos.¡Todo el mundo quieto! {guardia} no pien: Everybody freeze! {guardia} does not think the same: coming for you.
textos.¡Un marinero te ha visto y da la voz de: A sailor has spotted you and raises the alarm!
textos.¡Un {nombre} te ha visto! {situar}. Puls: A {nombre} has spotted you! {situar}. Press Q to lock on.
A ridge right ahead! Up, now.
textos.¡Uno de los que estaban en el suelo se l: One of the ones on the floor gets up and comes at you!
textos.¡Viene el tranvía, {direccion_txt}! Sal: The tram is coming, {direccion_txt}! Get off the tracks.
textos.¡Viene el tren, {direccion_txt}! Sal de: The train is coming, {direccion_txt}! Get off the tracks.
textos.¡Virgen del Carmen, cuánto billete! Con: Holy Virgen del Carmen, so much cash! With this I'll fix the roof and still have enough to treat the whole neighborhood.
And without sinking the boat! You have what it takes. If you want to earn a few euros, press P at sea to fish and sell the catch at the Fishermen's Guild. The big fish are far from the coast.
That's it! Everything in the bag.
They're here! I'm getting out of the way.
textos.¡Ya se oyen las sirenas! Os quedan {segu: I can already hear the sirens! You have {segundos} seconds left.
textos.¡Ya, ya! ¡Mañana tiene su dinero!: Yes, yes! You will have your money tomorrow!
textos.¡{get} está atracando {de_quien}, {v}! T: {get} is robbing {de_quien}, {v}! You have {get2} seconds to stop it.
textos.¡{get} te atraca a punta de arma! Te qui: {get} holds you up at gunpoint! They take {n} euros from you. Press Q to lock onto them.
textos.¡{get} te saca del vehículo y se lo llev: {get} pulls you out of the vehicle and takes it!
textos.¡{nombre} es tuya! Aquí puedes guardar l: {nombre} is yours! Here you can save the game, rest and park {get} vehicles.
textos.¡{nombre} es tuyo! Ganarás {ingresos} eu: {nombre} is yours! You will earn {ingresos} euros every day.
textos.¡{nombre} es tuyo! Te espera amarrado en: {nombre} is yours! It's waiting for you moored at {nombre2}.
textos.¡{nombre} te ataca! Pulsa Q para fijarlo: {nombre} attacks you! Press Q to lock onto it.
textos.¡{quienes} te han encontrado! Vienen {n}: {quienes} have found you! {n} of them are coming for you.
textos.«Amor en el desguace»: lloras, y no sabe: "Love at the Scrapyard": you cry, and you can't tell if it's from sadness or laughter.
textos.«Aquí no te atendemos. Haz el favor de s: "We don't serve you here. Please leave."
textos.«Despacio. Hoy quiero que dure.»: "Slowly. Today I want it to last."
textos.«Déjamelo a mí», dice el gestor. «{dias}: "Leave it to me," says the fixer. "{dias} days and it will be in your account as if it were from an inheritance."
textos.«El comisario honrado»: ciencia ficción,: "The Honest Chief": science fiction, according to the man in the next seat.
textos.«El último tranvía»: un drama lentísimo: "The Last Tram": an incredibly slow drama where nothing happens, but it happens very well.
textos.«Hablamos luego», dices, lo bastante baj: "We'll talk later," you say, low enough that Matilde can't hear. El Mellao nods: he understood.
textos.«La venganza del boquerón»: cine de terr: "Revenge of the Anchovy": seafaring horror. You leave hungry.
"It's no use you telling me," says {n}. "Prove it to me."
textos.«No». Lo dices sin levantar la voz. El M: "No." You say it without raising your voice. El Mellao smiles with the teeth he has left and slowly walks away.
textos.«Nunca hemos hablado». El reportaje no s: "We never talked." The story won't run.
textos.«Por esta vez». El acta desaparece en su: "Just this once." The report disappears into his briefcase, and so does the envelope.
textos.«Qué bien te queda eso», te dice {n}. Ha: "That looks great on you," {n} tells you. You nailed the outfit.
textos.«Rápidos y jubilados»: persecuciones en: "Fast and Retired": compact-car chases at forty miles an hour. A gem.
textos.«Sí. Claro que sí». {n} te abraza. Desde: "Yes. Of course." {n} hugs you. From today you're engaged.
textos.«Tiburones en la Gran Vía»: tan mala que: "Sharks on Gran Vía": so bad the audience gives it a standing ovation.
textos.«Tranquil[o|a], que tú eres de casa». Qu: "Relax, you're one of us." {euros} euros noted down in the notebook.
textos.«Tú sabrás», dice {nombre}. Deja la band: "Your call," says {nombre}. They leave the gang and disappear down the street.
textos.«Tú, ven aquí». Te registran los bolsill: "You, come here." They go through your pockets without hurry. They find nothing and let you go with a warning.
textos.«Uf. Primero, una ducha», te dice {n}, m: "Ugh. Shower first," {n} tells you, half joking, half serious.
textos.«{texto}» usa la letra «{letra}», difíci: "{texto}" uses the letter "{letra}", which is hard to press with Alt.
textos.«¡Eh! ¡Que os estoy viendo!». Salen corr: "Hey! I can see you!" They run off without looking back.
textos.«¡Eh!». Uno sale corriendo; el otro te s: "Hey!" One runs off; the other throws a punch before leaving. It hurts, but the shutter is still in place.
textos.«¿Has cocinado tú?», dice {n}, y te da u: "Did you cook this yourself?" says {n}, and gives you a kiss.
Where are we going? Mark the place for me.
textos.¿A qué casa le pides a {nombre} que se v: Which home do you ask {nombre} to move into?
textos.¿A qué casa os mudáis {nombre} y tú?: Which home do you and {nombre} move into?
textos.¿Al comedor social? Así que era eso. Las: To the soup kitchen? So that was it. The boxes weren't being sold: they were being given away.
textos.¿Alquilas {nombre_lugar} por unos {renta: Rent {nombre_lugar} for about {renta_de} euros a day? While it lasts you will not be able to sleep, save the game or use the garage here
textos.¿Cualquiera con nombre y apellidos?: Anyone with a first and last name?
textos.¿Cuánto le das a {nombre}? Tienes {diner: How much do you give {nombre}? You have {dinero} euros
textos.¿Cómo quieres que te hablen{v}?: How do you want people to address you{v}?
textos.¿De cuál pides las llaves? Cuanto más ca: Which one do you ask the keys for? The pricier it is, the harder the police look for you
textos.¿De parte de Aurora? Pasa, pasa. Aquí da: Aurora sent you? Come in, come in. We give single courses and degrees here. The degrees take several afternoons, one a day, and they cost a fair bit.
textos.¿De parte de Remedios? Pasa y no toques: On Remedios's behalf? Come in and don't touch anything. I've been tracking Los Lagartos' accounts for months. They launder the money at La Suerte Bingo Hall.
textos.¿Dinero? Si te cuento cómo está mi cuent: Money? If I told you how my account looks, we'd both cry. Between the mortgage and the car, which broke on Tuesday...
textos.¿Echas a {n} de la banda? No vuelve: Kick {n} out of the gang? They won't be back
textos.¿Entregas la placa? Podrás volver a ingr: Hand in your badge? You can rejoin by paying for the course
textos.¿Eres uno de ellos? Pues entonces ya lo: Are you one of them? Then you already know.
textos.¿Has probado las sardinas del Espeto? Gl: Have you tried the sardines at El Espeto? Pure heaven.
textos.¿Has venido en helicóptero? Madre mía, D: You came by helicopter? Good grief, Dani. Give me that. Tomorrow it's on the front page.
textos.¿Le pides a {n} que se vaya de casa? Le: Do you ask {n} to move out? It will hurt, and it'll be a while before they want to come back
textos.¿Los tomates de Anselmo? Ya era hora. To: Anselmo's tomatoes? About time. Here, yours. And listen, you look like someone who can fix problems. Come see me another day, this market has plenty.
textos.¿Los tres, y calientes? Yo tardo el dobl: All three, and hot? It takes me twice as long. Tomorrow, if you like, my ankle will still hurt.
textos.¿Me has visto cara de oficina de informa: Do I look like an information desk to you?
textos.¿No sabes quién soy? {yo}. Pregunta por: You don't know who I am? {yo}. Ask around.
textos.¿Nuev{o}? Pues te cuento: el pan, en la: New here? Let me fill you in: bread on the corner, coffee in the square, and trouble down at the harbor. That's all you need to know.
textos.¿Otro {modelo}? Tengo {n} en el patio de: Another {modelo}? I've got {n} in the yard from the last few days. Take it or leave it.
textos.¿Para qué quieres saber dónde vivo?: Why do you want to know where I live?
Fight? Whenever you want, wherever you want.
textos.¿Por qué lo preguntas? ¿Has hecho algo?: Why do you ask? Did you do something?
textos.¿Que si me he enterado? Yo me entero ant: Did I hear? I hear things before the newspaper does. I've got my sister-in-law, who's better than a news agency.
textos.¿Quieres escuchar el tutorial?: Do you want to hear the tutorial?
textos.¿Quieres que robe la furgoneta de los he: You want me to steal the ice cream van?
textos.¿Quién te manda? ¡Te pago el doble!: Who sent you? I'll pay you double!
textos.¿Qué opciones quieres dejar como vienen: Which options do you want to reset to their defaults? Nothing is saved until you press OK or Apply.
textos.¿Recuperas {nombre_lugar}? El inquilino: Take back {nombre_lugar}? The tenant moves out and you return {fianza} euros of deposit
textos.¿Repetir {titulo}? Te lleva al lugar don: Replay {titulo}? It takes you to where it starts. It doesn't count and gives no reward
textos.¿Sabes llevar un barco? No, claro. Los d: Can you sail a boat? No, of course not. You city folk can't even swim. Well, today you learn.
textos.¿Sabes lo que vale esta ciudad sin mí? N: Do you know what this city is worth without me? Nothing. I brought the water.
textos.¿Sabes lo que veo yo? Que Los Calaveras: You know what I see? That Los Calaveras from here and Los Lagartos from there now have a friend in common. And that's not a friendship, it's a noose.
textos.¿Sabes lo que veo yo? Que el dinero del: You know what I see? That the councilman's money and the Villaseca fund's money come from the same bank. And you get paid by both.
textos.¿Sabes lo que veo yo? Que el vino de Vil: You know what I see? That Villaseca wine is now sold at the San Lucero market with nobody collecting in between. You did that, in two places at once.
textos.¿Sabes lo que veo yo? Que lo de aquí y l: You know what I see? That what's here and what's there already know each other. The reporter and the inspector call each other every week, and they say that with the papers from both, more people will fall.
textos.¿Sales del servidor? Tu personaje queda: Leave the server? Your character stays saved
textos.¿Salir al menú principal? Se perderá lo: Exit to the main menu? Anything you haven't saved will be lost
textos.¿Seguro que dejas la banda?: Are you sure you want to leave the gang?
textos.¿Seguro que disuelves la banda? Los barr: Are you sure you want to disband the gang? The neighborhoods become free and you keep the till
textos.¿Siempre eres así, o es que hoy te has l: Are you always like this, or did you just get lucky today?
textos.¿Tengo cara de banco?: Do I look like a bank?
Got the time? Never mind, I'm late.
Got a minute? There's a deal.
textos.¿Todo repartido? Pues ya eres del pueblo: Everything delivered? Then you're one of the town now, whether you like it or not. Here you get in through the bread.
textos.¿Tú eres Dani? Dicen que conduces sin ro: Are you Dani? They say you drive without breaking anything. I have a freshly built Brisa Rally and a customer waiting at the Autos Platino dealership.
textos.¿Tú eres Dani? Marta me dijo que podía f: You're Dani? Marta told me I could trust you. Here, this memory stick has Belmonte's entire accounting.
textos.¿Tú eres de Puerto Bravo? Mala gente, lo: You're from Puerto Bravo? Bad people, those from the capital. But I need someone who isn't from the town.
textos.¿Tú haces recados? Tres cosas, y rápido,: Do you run errands? Three things, and quickly, because I close at two.
textos.¿Un favor? Cuenta, cuenta. Yo le hice un: A favor? Go on, tell me. I did one for my neighbor once and ended up painting his whole apartment.
textos.¿Un secreto? Soy la persona ideal. No se: A secret? You've come to the right person. I won't tell anyone... anyone who doesn't ask me.
textos.¿Vendes {nombre} al mercado por {v} euro: Sell {nombre} to the market for {v} euros? It goes up for sale again for anyone
textos.¿Ves qué fácil? Ahora firma aquí, y de e: See how easy that was? Now sign here, and from tonight on you're a partner. Or don't sign, and we'll pretend this month never happened. But then you know what we are when we're not friends.
textos.¿Ves? Si es lo que yo digo siempre. Lo q: See? It's what I always say. The thing is, nobody listens to me.
textos.¿Vienes por el anuncio? Soy Custodia Bar: Are you here about the ad? I'm Custodia Barral. We've gone three years without rain here, and the tap runs two hours a day, when it runs at all.
textos.¿Viste el partido? Yo lo oí por la radio: Did you see the game? I heard it on the radio.
textos.¿Y para qué quieres saberlo?: And why do you want to know?
textos.¿Y quieres que entre yo sol[o|a] ahí?: And you want me to go in there alone?
textos.¿Ya estamos? Qué corto se me ha hecho. T: Are we there already? How short it felt. Here, you keep the novel, I already know how it ends.

textos.Ánimo, de verdad. Vales más de lo que cr: Cheer up, really. You're worth more than you think.
Hang in there. This will pass too.

textos.Échalos de allí. Y si encuentras las lla: Throw them out. And if you find the keys to that boat, keep it, you've earned it.

textos.Última manzana, de sur a norte: Last block, from south to north
You see more of them lately. Something must be up.
